atirātrañca sampūjya tathāptoryāmamarcayet / mano buddhimahaṅkāraṃ śabdaṃ sparśañca rūpakaṃ
rasaṃ gandhañca padmeṣu caturviṃśatiṣu kramāt / 1 pratyagniṣṭomakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ jyotiṣṭomakamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 84 jīvaṃ manodhipañcāhaṃ prakṛtiṃ śabdamātrakaṃ
vāsudevādimūrtīñca tathā caiva daśatmakaṃ / manaḥ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ prārcya cakṣuś ca rasanaṃ tathā
ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇipādañca dvātriṃśadvārijeṣvimān / caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sāṅgāḥ saparivārakāḥ
pāyūpasthau ca sampūjya māsānāṃ dvādaśādhipān / puruṣottamādiṣaḍviṃśān vāhyāvaraṇake yajet
cakrābje teṣu sampūjyā māsānāṃ patayaḥ kramāt / aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ ṣaḍvā pañcātha caturo 'pare
rajaḥ pātaṃ tataḥ kuryāllikhite maṇḍale śṛṇu / karṇikā pītavarṇā syādrekhāḥ sarvāḥ sitāḥ samāḥ
dvihaste 'ṅguṣṭamātrāḥ syurhaste cārdhasamāḥ sitāḥ / padmaṃ śuklena sandhīṃstu kṛṣṇena śyāmatothavā
keśarā raktapītāḥ syuḥ koṇān raktena pūrayet / bhūṣayedyogapīṭhantu yatheṣṭaṃ sārvavarṇikaiḥ
latāvitānapatrādyair vīthikāmupaśobhayet / pīṭhadvāre tu śuklena śobhāraktena pītataḥ
upaśobhāñca nīlena koṇaśaṅkhyāṃś ca vai sitān / bhadrake pūraṇaṃ proktamevamanyeṣu pūraṇaṃ
trikoṇaṃ sitaraktena kṛṣṇena ca vibhūṣayet / dvikoṇaṃ raktapītābhyāṃ nābhiṃ kṛṣṇena cakrake
arakān pītaraktābhiḥ śyāmān nemintu raktataḥ / sitaśyāmāruṇāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ pītā rekhāstu vāhyataḥ
śālipiṣṭādi śuklaṃ syādraktaṃ kausumbhakādikam / haridrayā ca hāridraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ syāddagdhadhānyataḥ
śamīpatrādikaiḥ śyāmaṃ vījānāṃ lakṣajāpyataḥ / caturlakṣaistu mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ lakṣasādhanam
ayutaṃ buddhividyānāṃ stotrāṇāñca sahasrakam / pūrvamevātha lakṣeṇa mantraśuddhis tathātmanaḥ
tathāpareṇa lakṣeṇa mantraḥ kṣetrīkṛto bhavet / pūrvamevāsamo homo vījānāṃ samprakīrtitaḥ
pūrvasevā daśāṃśena mantrādīnāṃ prakīrtitā / paraś carye tu mantre tu māsikaṃ vratamācaret
bhuvi nyasedvāmapādaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt pratigraham / evaṃ dvitriguṇenaiva madhyamottamasiddhayaḥ
mantradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syānmantrajaṃ phalam / sthūlaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpaṃ vigrahaṃ vāhyamiṣyate
sukṣmāṃ jyotirmayaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ bhavet / cintayā rahitaṃ yattu tat paraṃ prakīrtitam
varāhasiṃhaśaktīnāṃ sthūlarūpaṃ pradhānataḥ / cintayā rahitaṃ rūpaṃ vāsudevasya kīrtitam
itareṣāṃ smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ sadā / sthūlaṃ vairājamākhyātaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vai liṅgitaṃ bhavet
cintayā rahitaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ parikīrtitam / hṛtpuṇḍarīkanilayañcaitanyaṃ jyotiravyayam
vījaṃ vījātmakaṃ dhyāyet kadambakusumākṛtiṃ / kumbhāntaragato dīpo niruddhaprasavo yathā
saṃhataḥ kevalastiṣṭhedevaṃ mantreśvaro hṛdi / anekaśuṣire kumbhe tāvanmātrā gabhastayaḥ
prasaranti vahistadvannāḍībhirvījaraśmayaḥ / athāvabhāsato daivīmātmīkṛtya tanuṃ sthitāḥ
hṛdayāt prasthitā nāḍyo darśanendriyagocarāḥ / agnīṣomātmake tāsāṃ nāḍyau nāsāgrasaṃsthite

saṃśuddhabhūtatanmātraḥ sakāmo yogamabhyasan / aṇimādimavāpnoti viraktaḥ pravilaṅghya ca / devātmake bhūtamātrānmucyate cendriyagrahāt
maṇḍalavidhiḥ nārada uvāca madhye padme yajedbrahma sāṅgaṃ pūrvebjanābhakaṃ /
mārjanavidhānaṃ agnir uvāca rakṣāṃ svasya pareṣāñca vakṣye tāṃ mārjanāhvayāṃ / yayā vimucyate duḥkhaiḥ sukhañca prāpnuyānnaraḥ(2)
oṃ namaḥ paramārthāya puruṣāya mahātmane / arūpabahurūpāya vyāpine paramātmane
niṣkalmaṣāya śuddhāya dhyānayogaratāya ca / namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yat tatsidhyatu me vacaḥ
varāhāya nṛsiṃhāya vāmanāya mahāmune / namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ

oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya khaḍgine / namaḥ puṣkaranetrāya keśavāyādicakriṇe

ye vātaprabhavā rogā ye ca pittasamudbhavāḥ / kaphodbhavāś ca ye kecit ye cānye sānnipātikāḥ

nābhyantaṃ dvādaśagranthiṃ tathā gandhapavitrake / dvyaṅgulāt kalpanādau dvirmālā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ
athavārkacaturviṃśaṣaḍtriṃśanmālikā dvijaḥ / anāmāmadhyamāṅguṣṭhair mandādyaiḥ mālikārthibhiḥ (4)

1 pādāntareṇa mālā syādaṣṭottarasahasraśaḥ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gadādyamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 cakrāṅgadau pavitrake iti gha, cihnitaputakapāṭhaḥ 4 mandādau iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ mandrādyair iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 94 kaniṣṭādau dvādaśa vā granthayaḥ syuḥ pavitrake / raveḥ kumbhahutāśādeḥ sambhave viṣṇuvanmatam
pīṭhasya pīṭhamānaṃ syānmekhalānte ca kuṇḍakaṃ / yathāśakti sūtragranthiparicāretha vaiṣṇave
sūtrāṇi vā saptadaśa sūtreṇa trivibhaktake(1) / rocanāgurukarpūraharidrākuṅkumādibhiḥ
rañjayeccandanādyair vā snānasandhyādikṛnnaraḥ / ekādaśyāṃ yāgagṛhe bhagavantaṃ hariṃ jayet
samastaparivārāya baliṃ pīṭhe samarcayet / kṣyauṃ kṣetrapālāya dvārānte dvāropari tathā śriyaṃ
dhātre dakṣe vidhātre ca gaṅgāñca yamunāṃ tathā / śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjya madhye vāstvapasāraṇaṃ sāraṅgāyeti bhūtānāṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ sthitaś caret

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(2) gandhatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ || oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(3) rasatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(4) rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ || oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(5) sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ 1 trisūtrāṇi ca bhadrake iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hūṃ haḥ phaṭ hūmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ hrūṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭ hrīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 95 oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(1) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ || pañcodghātair gandhatanmātrarūpaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalaṃ / caturasrañca pītañca kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitam
indrādhidaivataṃ pādayugmamadhyagataṃ smaret / śuddhañca rasatanmātraṃ pravilipyātha saṃharet rasamātrarūpamātre krameṇānena pūjakaḥ

oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(2) rasatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ(3) rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(4) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ jānunābhimadhyagataṃ(5) śvetaṃ vai padmalāñchitaṃ / śuklavarṇaṃ cārdhacandraṃ dhyāyedvaruṇadaivataṃ
caturbhiś ca tadudghātaiḥ śuddhaṃ tadrasamātrakaṃ / saṃharedrūpatanmātrai rūpamātre ca saṃharet

oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ iti tribhistadudghātaistrikoṇaṃ vahnimaṇḍalam / nābhikaṇṭhamadhyagataṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitaṃ

dhyātvānalādhidaivantacchuddhaṃ sparśe layaṃ nayat / 1 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭ hamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhḥ 2 oṃ hrīṃ phaṭ hamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ hraṃ haḥ phaṭ hūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 padmāsanamadhyagatamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 96 oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(1) sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(2) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ || kaṇṭhanāsāmadhyagataṃ vṛttaṃ vai vāyumaṇḍalam
dvirudghātair dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyāyecchuddhendulāñchitam / sparśamātraṃ śabdamātraiḥ saṃhareddhyānayogataḥ
oṃ hrauṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi namaḥ ekodghātena cākāśaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham / nāsāpuṭaśikhāntasthamākāśamupasaṃharet
śoṣaṇādyair dehaśuddhiṃ kuryādevam kramāttataḥ / śuṣkaṃ kalevaraṃ dhyāyet pādādyañca śikhāntakam
yaṃ vījena vaṃ vījena jvālāmālāsamāyutam(3) / dehaṃ ramityanenaiva brahmarandhrādvinirgatam
vindundhyātvā cāmṛtasya tena bhasmakalevaram / samplāvayellamityasmāt dehaṃ sampādya divyakam
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā kare dehe mānasaṃ yāgamācaret / viṣṇuṃ sāṅgaṃ hṛdi padme mānasaiḥ kusumādibhiḥ
mūlamantreṇa deveśamprārcayedbhuktimuktidam / svāgataṃ devadeveśa sannidhau bhava keśava
gṛhāṇa mānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārthaṃ(4) paribhāvitām / ādhāraśaktiḥ kūrmātha pūjyonanto mahī tataḥ

madhyegnyādau ca dharmādyā adharmādīndramukhyagam(4) / 1 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ kṣauṃ haḥ phaṭ krūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 jvālāmālāsamaprabhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 yathāsvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 dharmādīnindrādau viparītakāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 97 sattvādi madhye padmañca māyāvidyākhyatattvake
kālatattvañca sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ pakṣirājakaḥ / madhye tataś ca vāyavyādīśāntā gurupaṅktikāḥ
gaṇaḥ sarasvatī pūjyā(1) nārado nalakūvaraḥ / gururgurupādukā ca paro guruś ca pādukā
pūrvasiddhāḥ parasiddhāḥ keśareṣu ca śaktayaḥ / lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī prītiḥ kīrtiḥ śāntiś ca kāntikā
puṣṭistuṣṭirmahendrādyā madhye vācāhito hariḥ / dhṛtiḥ śrīratikāntyādyā mūlena sthāpito 'cyutaḥ
oṃ abhimukho bhaveti prārthya sannihito bhava / vinyasyārghyādikaṃ datvā gandhādyair mūlato yajet
oṃ bhīṣaya bhīṣaya hṛt śirastrāsaya vai punaḥ / mardaya mardaya śikhā agnyādau śastratostrakaṃ
rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya(2) namastataḥ / oṃ hrūṃ(3) phaṭ astrāya namo mūlavījena cāṅgakaṃ
pūrvadakṣāpyasaumyeṣu mūrtyāvaraṇamarcayet / vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ
agnyādau śrīdhṛtiratikāntayo mūrtayo hareḥ / śaṅkhacakragadāpadmamagnyādau pūrvakādikaṃ
śārṅgañca muṣalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālāñca tadvahiḥ / indrādyāś ca tayānanto nairṛtyāṃ varuṇastataḥ
brahmendreśānayormadhye astrāvaraṇakaṃ vahiḥ / airāvatastataśchāgo mahiṣo vānaro jhaṣaḥ

1 gaṇaś ca tāsu pūjyo 'tha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hrīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 98 mṛgaḥ śaśo 'tha vṛṣabhaḥ kūrmo haṃsastato vahiḥ / pṛśnigarbhaḥ kumudādyā dvārapālā dvayaṃ dvayaṃ
pūrvādyuttaradvārāntaṃ hariṃ natvā baliṃ vahiḥ / viṣṇupārṣadebhyo namo balipīṭhe baliṃ dadet
viśvāya viśvaksenātmane īśānake yajet / devasya dakṣiṇe haste rakṣāsūtrañca bandhayet
saṃvatsarakṛtācāryāḥ sampūrṇaphaladāyine / pavitrārohaṇāyedaṃ kautukaṃ dhāraya oṃ namaḥ
upavāsādiniyamaṃ kuryādvai devasannidhau / upavāsādiniyato devaṃ santoṣayāmyaham
kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve mā me tiṣṭhantu sarvathā / adyaprabhṛti deveśa yāvadvaiśeṣikaṃ dinam
yajamāno hy aśaktaścet kuryānnaktādikaṃ vratī / hutvā visarjayet stutvā śrīkarannityapūjanam oṃ hrīṃ(1) śrīṃ śrīdharāya trailokyamohanāya namaḥ
homādividhiḥ agnir uvāca viśedanena mantreṇa yāgasthānañca bhūṣayet / namo brahmaṇyadevāya śrīdharāyāvyayātmane
1 oṃ krīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 99 ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya śabdadehāya / vilikhya maṇḍalaṃ sāyaṃ yāgadravyādi cāharet
prakṣālitakarāṅghriḥ san vinyasyārghyakaro naraḥ / arghyādibhistu śiraḥ prokṣya dvāradeśādikaṃ yathā
ārabhed dvārayāgañca toraṇeśān prapūjayet / aśvatthodumbaravaṭaprakṣāḥ pūrvādigā nagāḥ
ṛgindraśobhanaṃ prāsyāṃ yujuryamasubhadrakam / sāmāpaś ca sudhanvākhyaṃ somātharvasuhotrakam
toraṇāntaḥ patākāś ca kumudādyā ghaṭadvayam / dvāri dvāri svanāmnārcyāḥ pūrve pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraḥ
ānandanandanau dakṣe vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇakaḥ / sambhavaprabhavau saumye dvārapāṃś caiva pūjayet
astrajaptapuṣpakṣepādvighnānutsārya saṃviśet / bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha vinyasya kṛtamudravaḥ
phaṭkārāntāṃ śikhāṃ japtvā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet / vāsudevena gomūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇena gomayam
pradyumnena payastajjāt dadhi nārāyaṇād ghṛtam / ekadvitryādivārāṇi ghṛtādvai bhāgatodhikam
ghṛtapātre tadekatra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam / maṇḍapaprokṣaṇāyaikañcāparamprāśanāya ca
ānīya daśakumbheṣu indrādyān lokapān yajet / pūjyājñāṃ śrāvayettāṃś ca sthātavyaṃ cājñayā hareḥ
yāgadravyādi saṃrakṣya vikirān vikirettataḥ / mūlāṣṭaśatasañjaptān kuśakūrcān hareś ca tān
aiśānyāṃ diśi tatrasthaṃ sthāpyaṃ kumbhañca vardhanīṃ / kumbhe sāṅgaṃ hariṃ prārcya vardhanyāmastramarcayet
pradakṣiṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vardhanyācchinnadhārayā / siñcannayettataḥ kumbhaṃ pūjayecca sthirāsane
sapañcaratnavastrāḍhyakumbhe gandhādibhirharim / vardhanyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ yajedastrañca vāmataḥ
tatsamīpe vāstulakṣmīṃ bhūvināyakamarcayet / srapanaṃ kalpayedviṣṇoḥ saṅkrāntyādau tathaiva ca
pūrṇakumbhān nava sthāpya navakoṇeṣu nirbraṇān
pūrvādikalasegnyādau pañcāmṛtajalādikam / dadhi kṣīraṃ madhūṣṇīdaṃ pādyaṃ syāccaturaṅgakam
padmaśyāmākadūrvāś ca viṣṇupatnī ca pādyakam / tathāṣṭāṅgārghyamākhyātaṃ yavagandhaphalākṣatam
kuśāḥ siddhārthapuṣpāni tilā dravyāṇi cārhaṇam(1) / lavaṅgakakkolayute dadyādācamanīyakam
snāpayenmūlamantreṇa devaṃ pañcāmṛtair api / śuddhodaṃ madhyakumbhena devamūrdhni viniḥkṣipet
kalaśānniḥsṛtaṃ toyaṃ kūrcāgraṃ(2) saṃspṛśennaraḥ / śuddhodakena pādyañca arghyamācamanandadet
parimṛjya paṭenāṅgaṃ savastraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nayet / tatrābhyarcyācareddhomaṃ kuṇḍādau prāṇasaṃyamī
prakṣālya hastau rekhāś ca tisraḥ pūrvāgragāminīḥ / 1 cārhaṇā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 dūrvāgramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 101 dakṣiṇāduttarāś ca tisraś caivaottarāgragāḥ
arghyodakena samprokṣya yonimudrāmpradarśayet / dhyātvāgnirūpañcāgnintu yonyāṃ kuṇḍe kṣipennaraḥ
pātrāṇyāsādayet paścāddarbhaśrukśruvakādibhiḥ / bāhumātrāḥ paridhaya idhmavraś canameva ca
praṇītā prokṣaṇīpātramājyasthālī ghṛtādikam / prasthadvayaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ yugmaṃ yugmamadhomukham
praṇītāprokṣaṇīpātre nyaset prāgagragaṃ kuśam / adbhiḥ pūryapraṇītāntu dhyātvā devaṃ prapūjya ca
praṇītāṃ sthāpayedagre dravyāṇāñcaiva madhyataḥ / prokṣaṇīmadbhiḥ sampūrya prārcya dakṣe tu vinyaset
caruñca śrapayedagnau brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset / kuśānāstīrya pūrvādau paridhīn sthāpayettataḥ
vaiṣṇavīkaraṇaṃ kuryād garbhādhānādinā naraḥ / garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanañjaniḥ
nāmādisamāvartanāntaṃ juhuyādaṣṭa cāhutīḥ / pūrṇāhutīḥ pratikarma śrucā sruvasuyuktayā
kuṇḍamadhye ṛtumatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sañcintya homayet / kuṇḍalakṣmīḥ samākhyātā prakṛtistriguṇātmakā
sā yoniḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidyāmantragaṇasya ca / vimukteḥ kāraṇaṃ vahniḥ paramātmā ca muktidaḥ
prācyāṃ śiraḥ samākhyātaṃ bāhū koṇe vyavasthitau / īśānāgneyakoṇe tu jaṅghe vāyavyanairṛte
udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniryonirvidhīyate / guṇatrayaṃ mekhalāḥ syurdhyātvaivaṃ samidho daśa
pañcādhikāṃstu juhuyāt praṇavānmuṣṭimudrayā(1) / punarāghārau juhuyādvāyvagnyantaṃ tataḥ śrapet
īśāntaṃ mūlamantreṇa ājyabhāgau tu homayet / uttare dvādaśāntena dakṣiṇe tena madhyataḥ
vyāhṛtyā padmamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedvahnintu saṃskṛtam / vaiṣṇavaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham
candravaktrañca(2) sūryākṣaṃ juhuyācchatamaṣṭa ca / tadardhañcāṣṭa mūlena aṅgānāñca daśāṃśataḥ
pavitrādhivāsanādividhiḥ agnir uvāca sampātāhutināsicya(2) pavitrāṇyadhivāsayet / nṛsiṃhamantrajaptāni guptānyastreṇa tāni tu
vastrasaṃveṣṭitānyeva pātrasthānyabhimantrayet / vilvādyadbhiḥ prokṣitāni mantreṇa caikadhā dvidhā(4)
kumbhapārśve tu saṃsthāpya rakṣāṃ vijñāpya deśikaḥ / dantakāṣṭhañcāmarakaṃ pūrve saṅkarṣaṇena tu

pradyumnena bhasmatilān dakṣe gomayamṛttikāṃ / 1 svastimudrayeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 pañcavaktraṃśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 saṅghātāhutināsicyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 mantrāṇāṃ caikadhā dvidheti kha, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 103 vāruṇena cāniruddhena saumye nārāyaṇena ca
darbhodakañcātha hṛdā agnau kuṅkumarocanaṃ / aiśānyāṃ śirasā dhūpaṃ śikhayā nairṛtepyatha
mūlapuṣpāṇi divyāni kavacenātha vāyave / candanāmbvakṣatadadhidūrvāś ca puṭikāsthitāḥ
gṛhaṃ trisūtreṇāveṣṭya punaḥ siddhārthakān kṣipet / dadyātpūjākrameṇātha svaiḥ svair gandhapavitrakaṃ
mantrair vai dvārapādibhyo viṣṇukumbhe tvanena ca / viṣṇutejobhavaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanaṃ
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ tavāṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ / sampūjya dhūpadīpādyair vrajeddvārasamīpataḥ
gandhapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ pavitrañcākhilerpayet (1) / pavitraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mahāpātakanāśanaṃ
dharmakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ svakeṅge dhārayāmyahaṃ / āsane parivārādau gurau dadyāt pavitrakaṃ
gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādimat / viṣṇutejobhavetyādimūlena harayerpayet
vahnisthāya tato datvā devaṃ samprārthayettataḥ / kṣīrodadhimahānāgaśayyāvasthitavigrahaḥ
prātastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi sannidhau bhava keśava / indrādibhastato datvā viṣṇupārṣadake baliṃ
tato devāgrataḥ kumbhaṃ vāsoyugasamanvitaṃ / rocanācandrakāśmīragandhādyudakasaṃyutaṃ
gandhapuṣpādinābhūṣya mūlamantreṇa pūjayet / 1 pavitraṃ pārśvato nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 104 maṇḍapādvahirāgatya vilipte maṇḍalatraye
pañcagavyañcarundantakāṣṭhañcaiva kramādbhavet / purāṇaśravaṇaṃ stotraṃ paṭhan jāgaraṇaṃ niśi
parapreṣakabālānāṃ strīṇāṃ bhogabhujāṃ tathā / sadyodhivāsanaṃ kuryādvinā gandhapavitrakaṃ
pavitrāropaṇavidhānaṃ agnir uvāca prātaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā dvārapālān(1) prapūjya ca / praviśya gupte deśe ca samākṛṣyātha dhārayet
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dravyaṃ vastrābharaṇagandhakaṃ / nirasya sarvanirmālyaṃ devaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet
pañcāmṛtaiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca śuddhagandhodakaistataḥ / pūrvādhivāsitaṃ dadyādvastraṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpakaṃ
agnau hutvā nityavacca devaṃ samprārthayennamet (2) / samarpya karma devāya pūjāṃ naimittikīṃ caret
dvārapālaviṣṇukumbhavardhanīḥ prārthayeddhariṃ / ato deveti mantreṇa mūlamantreṇa kumbhake
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ / 1 lokapālāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 prārthayennyasediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 105 pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ
pavitrakaṃ kurudhvādya yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ / śuddho bhavāmyahaṃ deva tvatprasādāt sureśvara
pavitrañca hṛdādyaistu ātmānamabhiṣicya ca / viṣṇukumbhañca samprokṣya vrajeddevasamīpataḥ
pavitramātmane dadyādrakṣābandhaṃ visṛjya ca(1) / gṛhāṇa brahmasūtrañca yanmayā kalpitaṃ prabho
karmaṇāṃ pūraṇārthāya yathā doṣo na me bhavet / dvārapālāsanagurumukhyānāñca pavitrakam
kaniṣṭādi ca devāya vanamālāñca mūlataḥ / hṛdādiviśvaksenānte pavitrāṇi samarpayet
vahnau hutvāgnivartibhyo viṣṇvādibhyaḥ pavitrakam / prārcya pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt prāyaścittāya mūlataḥ
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi pañcopaniṣadaistataḥ / maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu garuḍadhvaja / vanamālā yathā deva kaustubhaṃ satataṃ hṛdi
tadvat pavitratantūṃś ca pūjāṃ ca hṛdaye vaha(2) / kāmato 'kāmato vāpi yatkṛtaṃ niyamārcane
vidhinā vighnalopena paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me / prārthya natvā kṣamāpyātha pavitraṃ mastake 'rpayet

datvā baliṃ dakṣiṇābhirvaiṣṇavantoṣayedguruṃ / 1 rakṣābandhaṃ vimucya ceti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pavitraṃ mūlato dadyādrakṣārthaṃ tadvisṛjya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 pavitrakaṃ tvañca pūjāyāṃ hṛdaye vaheti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 106 viprān bhojanavastrādyair divasaṃ pakṣameva vā
pavitraṃ snānakāle ca avatārya samarpayet / anivāritamannādyaṃ dadyādbhuṅktetha ca svayaṃ
visarjane 'hni sampūjya pavitrāṇi visarjayet / sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhivanmama
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ viṣṇulokaṃ visarjitaḥ / madhye someśayoḥ prārcya viṣvaksenaṃ hi tasya ca
pavitrāṇi samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya samarpayet / yāvantastantavastasmin pavitre parikalpitāḥ
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate / kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya daśa pūrvān daśāparān / viṣṇulokaṃ tu saṃsthāpya svayaṃ muktimavāpnuyāt
sarvadevapavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ agnir uvāca saṅkṣepāt sarvadevānāṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ(1) śṛṇu / pavitra sarvalakṣma syāt svarasānalagaṃ tvapi
jagadyone samāgaccha parivāragaṇaiḥ saha / nimantrayāmyahaṃ prātardadyāntubhyaṃ pavitrakaṃ /
jagatsṛje(2) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ / 1 pavitrāropaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 jagatsūte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 107 pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ
śivadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ / maṇividrumamālābhirmandārakusumādibhiḥ
iyaṃ sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu vedavitpate / sāṃvatsarīmimāṃ pūjāṃ sampādya vidhimanmama
vraja pavitrakedānīṃ svargalokaṃ visarjitaḥ / sūryadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ / śivadeva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ / vāṇeśvara(1) namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ / śaktideva namastubhyaṃ gṛhṇīṣvedaṃ pavitrakaṃ
pavitrīkaraṇārthāya varṣapūjāphalapradaṃ / nārāyaṇamayaṃ sūtramaniruddhamayaṃ varaṃ(2)
dhanadhānyāyurārogyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te / kāmadevamayaṃ sūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇamayaṃ varaṃ
vidyāsantatisaubhāgyapradaṃ sampradadāmi te / vāsudevamayaṃ sūtraṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadaṃ
saṃsārasāgarottārakāraṇaṃ pradadāmi te / viśvarūpamayaṃ sūtraṃ sarvadaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ
1 gaṇeśvara iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 paramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 108 atītānāgatakulasamuddhāraṃ dadāmi te / kaniṣṭhādīni catvāri manubhistu kramāddade
devālayanirmāṇaphalaṃ agnir uvāca vāsudevādyālayasya kṛtau vakṣye phalādikaṃ / cikīrṣordevadhāmādi sahasrajanipāpanut
manasā sadmakartṝṇāṃ śatajanmāghanāśanaṃ / yenumodanti kṛṣṇasya kriyamāṇaṃ narā gṛhaṃ(1)
tepi pāpair vinirmuktāḥ prayāntyacyutalokatāṃ / samatītaṃ bhaviṣyañca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ
viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ / vasanti(2) pitaro dṛṣṭvā(3) viṣṇuloke hy alaṅkṛtāḥ
vimuktā nārakair duḥkhaiḥ kartuḥ kṛṣṇasya mandiraṃ / brahmahatyādipāpaughaghātakaṃ devatālayaṃ
phalaṃ yannāpyate yajñair dhāma kṛtvā tadāpyate / devāgāre kṛte sarvatīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet
devādyarthe hatānāñca raṇe yattatphalādikaṃ / śāṭhyena pāṃśunā vāpi kṛtaṃ dhāma ca nākadaṃ

1 gṛhādikaṃ ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 nandanti iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ / valganti iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 hṛṣṭā iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 109 ekāyatanakṛt svargī tryagārī brahmalokabhāk / pañcāgārī śambhulokamaṣṭāgārāddharau sthitiḥ
ṣoḍaśālayakārī tu(1) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ
svargaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ mokṣamāpnoti ca kramāt / śreṣṭhamāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā yaddhanavān labhet
kaniṣṭhenaiva tat puṇyaṃ prāpnotyadhanavānnaraḥ / samutpādya dhanaṃ kṛtyā svalpenāpi(2) surālayaṃ
kārayitvā hareḥ puṇyaṃ samprāpnotyadhikaṃ varaṃ / lakṣaṇātha sahasreṇa śatenārdhena vā hareḥ
kārayan bhavanaṃ yāti yatrāste garuḍadhvajaḥ / bālye tu krīḍamāṇā ye pāṃśubhirbhavanaṃ hareḥ
vāsudevasya kurvanti tepi tallokagāminaḥ / tīrthe cāyatane puṇye saddhakṣetre tathāṣṭame
karturāyatanaṃ viṣṇoryathoktāttriguṇaṃ phalaṃ / bandhūkapuṣpavinyāsaiḥ sudhāpaṅkena vaiṣṇavaṃ
ye vilimpanti bhavanaṃ te yānti bhagavatpuraṃ / patitaṃ patamānantu tathārdhapatitaṃ naraḥ
samuddhṛtya harerdhāma prāpnoti dviguṇaṃ phalaṃ / patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patitasya ca rakṣitā
viṣṇorāyatanasyeha naro viṣṇulokabhāk / iṣṭakānicayastiṣṭhed yāvadāyatane hareḥ
sakulastasya vai kartā viṣṇuloke mahīyate / 1 ṣoḍaśāgārakārī tu iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 svalpenaiveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 110 sa eva puṇyavān pūjya iha loke paratra ca
kṛṣṇasya vāsudevasya yaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ / jātaḥ sa eva sukṛtī kulantenaiva pāvitaṃ
viṣṇurudrārkadevyādergṛhakartā sa kīrtibhāk / kiṃ tasya vittanicayair mūḍhasya parirakṣitaḥ
duḥkhārjitair yaḥ kṛṣṇasya na kārayati ketanaṃ / nopabhogyaṃ dhanaṃ yasya pitṛvipradivaukasāṃ
nopabhogāya bandhūnāṃ vyarthastasya dhanāgamaḥ / yathā dhruvo nṛṇāṃ mṛtyurvittanāśas tathā dhruvaḥ
mūḍhastatrānubadhnāti jīvitetha cale ghane / yadā vittaṃ na dānāya nopabhogāya dehināṃ
nāpi kīrtyai na dharmāthaṃ tasya svāmyetha ko guṇaḥ / tasmādvittaṃ samāsādya daivādvā pauruṣādatha
dadyāt samyag dvijāgryebhyaḥ kīrtanāni ca kārayet / dānebhyaścādhikaṃ yasmāt kīrtanebhyo varaṃ yataḥ
atastatkārayeddhīmān viṣṇvādermandirādikaṃ / viniveśya harerdhāma bhaktimadbhir narottamaiḥ
niveśitaṃ bhavet kṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃ / bhūtaṃ bhavayam bhaviṣyañca sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tathetarat(1)
ābrāhmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ samudbhavaṃ / tasya devādidevasya sarvagasya(2) mahātmanaḥ
niveśya bhavanaṃ viṣṇor na bhūyo bhuvi jāyate / yathā viṣṇordhāmakṛtau phalaṃ tadvaddivaukasāṃ
1 tathaiva ca iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 sarveśasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 111 śivabrahmārkavighneśacaṇḍīlakṣmyādikātmanāṃ / devālayakṛteḥ puṇyaṃ pratimākaraṇedhikaṃ(3)
pratimāsthāpane yāge phalasyānto na vidyate / mṛṇmayāddāruje puṇyaṃ dārujādiṣṭkābhave
iṣṭakotthācchailaje syāddhemāderadhikaṃ phalaṃ / saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prārambhādeva naśyati
devālayasya svargī syānnarakaṃ na sa gacchati / kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ nayennaraḥ
yamo yamabhaṭānāha devamandirakāriṇaḥ / yama uvāca pratimāpūjādikṛto nāneyā narakaṃ narāḥ
devālayādyakartāra āneyāste tu gocare(1) / visāradhvaṃ yathānyāyanniyogo mama pālyatāṃ (2)
nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit / kevalaṃ te jagattātamanantaṃ samupāśritāḥ
bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ nātrāsti saṃsthitiḥ / ye ca bhagavatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ
pūjayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ / yastiṣṭhan prasvapan gacchannuttiṣṭhan skhalite sthite(4)
saṅkīrtayanti govindaṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ / nityanaimittikair devaṃ ye yajanti janārdanam

nāvalokyā bhavadbhiste tadgatā yānti tadgatim / 1 āneyāstvaviśeṣata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 niyamo me 'nupālyatāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 jantavaḥ kvaciditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 112 ye puṣpadhūpavāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścātivallabhaiḥ
arcayanti na te grāhyā narāḥ kṛṣṇālaye gatāḥ(1) / upalepanakartāraḥ sammārjanaparāś ca ye
kṛṣṇālaye parityajyāsteṣāṃ putrās tathā kulam / yena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavam
puṃsāṃ śataṃ nāvalokyaṃ bhavadbhirduṣṭacetasā / yastu devālayaṃ viṣṇordāruśailamayaṃ tathā
kārayen mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / ahanyahani yajñena yajato yan mahāphalam
prāpnoti tat phalaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ / kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śataṃ
kārayan bhagavaddhāma nayatyacyutalokatāṃ / saptalokamayo viṣṇustasya yaḥ kurute gṛhaṃ
tārayatyakṣayāṃllokānakṣayān pratipadyate / iṣṭakācayavinyāso yāvantyabdāni tiṣṭhati
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkarturdivi saṃsthitiḥ / pratimākṛdviṣṇulokaṃ sthāpako līyate harau / devasadmapratikṛtipratiṣṭhākṛttu gocare
agnir uvāca yamoktā nānayaṃstetha pratiṣṭhādikṛtaṃ hareḥ / hayaśīrṣaḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ(2) devānāṃ brahmaṇe 'bravīt
bhūparigrahavidhānaṃ hayagrīva uvāca viṣṇvādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhādi vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me / proktāni pañcarātarāṇi saptarātrāṇi vai mayā
vyastāni munibhirloke pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā / hayaśīrṣaṃ tantramādyaṃ tantraṃ trailokyamohanaṃ
vaibhavaṃ pauṣkaraṃ tantraṃ prahrādaṅgārgyagālavaṃ / nāradīyañca sampraśnaṃ śāṇḍilyaṃ vaiśvakaṃ(1) tathā
satyoktaṃ śaunakaṃ tantraṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ jñānasāgaraṃ / svāyambhuvaṃ kapilañca tārkṣaṃ nārāyaṇīyakaṃ
ātreyaṃ nārasiṃhākhyamānandākhyaṃ tathāruṇaṃ / baudhāyanaṃ tathārṣaṃ tu(2) viśvoktaṃ tasya sārataḥ
pratiṣṭhāṃ hi dvijaḥ kuryānmadhyadeśādisambhavaḥ / nakacchadeśasambhūtaḥ kāverīkoṅkaṇodgataḥ
kāmarūpakaliṅgoptyaḥ kāñcīkāśmīrakośalaḥ(3) / ākāśavāyutejombu bhūretāḥ pañca rātrayaḥ
acaitanyāstamodriktāḥ pañcarātravivarjitaṃ / brahmāhaṃ viṣṇuramala iti vidyātsa deśikaḥ

sarvalakṣaṇahīṇopi sa gurustantrapāragaḥ / 1 caiśvaraṃ tatheti ga, ṅa, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 tathāṣṭāṅgamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 kāśmīrake sthita iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 114 nagarābhimukhāḥ sthāpyā devā na ca parāṅmukhāḥ
kurukṣetre gayādau ca nadīnāntu(1) samīpataḥ / brahmā madhye tu nagare pūrve śakrasya śobhanaṃ
agnāvagneś ca mātṝṇāṃ bhūtānāñca yamasya ca / dakṣiṇe caṇḍikāyāś ca pitṛdaityādikasya ca
vairṛte mandiraṃ kuryāt varuṇādadeś ca vāruṇe / vāyor nāgasya vāyavye saumye yakṣaguhasya ca
caṇḍīśasya maheśasya aiśe viṣṇoś ca sarvaśaḥ / pūrvadevakulaṃ pīḍya prāsādaṃ svalpakaṃ tvatha
samaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi na kartavyaṃ vijānatā / ubhayordviguṇāṃ sīmāṃ tyaktvā cocchrayasammitāṃ
prāsādaṃ kārayedanyaṃ nobhayaṃ pīḍayedbudhaḥ / bhūmau tu śodhitāyāṃ tu kuryādbhumiparigrahaṃ
prākārasīmāparyantaṃ tato bhutabaliṃ haret / māṣaṃ haridrācūrṇantu salājaṃ dadhisaktubhiḥ
aṣṭākṣareṇa saktūṃś ca pātāyitvāṣṭadikṣu ca / rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca yesmiṃstiṣṭhanti bhūtale
sarve te vyapagacchantu sthānaṃ kuryāmahaṃ hareḥ / halena vāhayitvā gāṃ gobhiś caivāvadārayet
pramāṇvaṣṭakenaiva trasareṇuḥ prakīrtyate //19
tair aṣṭabhistu bālāgraṃ likhyā tair aṣṭabhirmatā / tābhiryūkāṣṭabhiḥ khyātā tāścāṣṭau yavamadhyamaḥ
1 nadyadriṣu iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ :p 115 yavāṣṭakair aṅgulaṃ syāccaturviṃśāṅgulaḥ karaḥ / caturaṅgulasaṃyuktaḥ sa hastaḥ(1) padmahastakaḥ
arghyadānavidhānaṃ bhagavānuvāca pūrvamāsit mahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraṃ / taddevair nihitaṃ bhumau sa vāstupuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
catuḥṣaṣṭipade kṣetre īśaṃ koṇārdhasaṃsthitaṃ / ghṛtākṣataistarpayettaṃ parjanyaṃ padagataṃ tataḥ
utpalādibhirjayantañca dvipadasthaṃ patākayā / mahendrañcaikakoṣṭhasthaṃ sarvaraktaiḥ pade raviṃ
vitānenārdhapadagaṃ satyaṃ pade bhṛśaṃ ghṛtaiḥ / vyoma śākunamāṃsena(2) koṇārdhapadasaṃsthitaṃ
srucā cārdhapade vahniṃ pūṣāṇaṃ lājayaikataḥ / svarṇena vitathaṃ dviṣṭhaṃ mathanena gṛhākṣataṃ
māṃsaudanena dharmeśamekaikasmin sthitaṃ dvayaṃ / gandharvaṃ dvipadaṃ gandhair bhṛśaṃ śākunajihvayā
ekasthamūrdhvasaṃsthañca mṛgaṃ nīlapaṭais tathā / pitṝn kṛśarayārdhasthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaiḥ padasthitaṃ
1 nṛhasta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vyoma śākulamāṃseneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 116 dauvārikaṃ dvisaṃsthañca sugrīvaṃ yāvakena tu / puṣpadantaṃ kuśastambaiḥ padmair varuṇamekataḥ
asuraṃ surayā dviṣṭhaṃ pade śeṣaṃ ghṛtāmbhasā / yavaiḥ pāpaṃ padārdhasthaṃ rogamardhe ca maṇḍakaiḥ
nāgapuṣpaiḥ pade nāgaṃ mukhyaṃ bhakṣyair dvisaṃsthitaṃ / mudgaudanena bhallāṭaṃ pade somaṃ pade tathā
madhunā pāyasenātha śālūkena ṛṣiṃ dvaye / pade ditiṃ lopikābhirardhe ditimathāparaṃ
pūrikābhistataścāpamīśādhaḥ payasā pade / tatodhaścāpavatsantu dadhnā caikapade sthitaṃ
laḍḍukaiś ca marīcintu pūrvakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaye(1) / savitre raktapuṣpāṇi brahmādhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyāt sāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ / vivaste 'ruṇaṃ dadyāccandanañcaturaṅghriṣu
rakṣodhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu indrāyānnaṃ niśānvitaṃ / indrajayāya tasyādho ghṛtānnaṃ koṇakoṣṭhake
catuṣpadeṣu dātavyamindrāya guḍapāyasaṃ / vāyvadhaḥkoṇadeśe tu rudrāya pakvamāṃsakaṃ
tadadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu yakṣāyārdraṃ phalantathā / mahīdharāya māṃsānnaṃ māghañca caturaṅghriṣu
madhye catuṣpade sthāpyā brahmaṇe tilataṇḍulāḥ / carakīṃ māṣasarpibhyāṃ skandaṃ kṛśarayāsṛjā
raktapadmair vidārīñca kandarpañca palodanaiḥ / pūtanāṃ palapittābhyāṃ māṃsāsṛgbhyāñca jambhakaṃ
1 madhyacatuṣṭaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 117 pittāsṛgasthibhiḥ pāpāṃ pilipiñjaṃ(1) srajāsṛjā / īśādyān raktamāṃsena abhāvādakṣatair yajet
rakṣomātṛgaṇebhyaś ca piśācādibhya eva ca / pitṛbhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyo balīn dadyāt prakāmataḥ
āhutvaitānasantarpya prāsādādīnna kārayet / brahamasthāne hariṃ lakṣmīṃ gaṇaṃ paścāt samarcayet
mahīśvaraṃ vāstumayaṃ(2) vardhanyā sahitaṃ ghaṭaṃ / brahmāṇaṃ madhyataḥ kumbhe brahmādīṃś ca digīśvarān
dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ paścāt svasti vācya praṇamya ca / pragṛhya karkarīṃ samyak maṇḍalantu pradakṣiṇaṃ
sūtramārdeṇa he brahmaṃstoyadhārāñca bhrāmayet / pūrvavattena mārgeṇa sapta vījāni vāpayet
prārambhaṃ tena mārgeṇa tasya khātasya kārayet / tato gartaṃ khanenmadhye hastamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ
caturaṅgulakaṃ cādhaścopalipyārcayettataḥ / dhyātvā caturbhujaṃ viṣṇumarghyaṃ dadyāttu kumbhataḥ
karkaryā pūrayet śvabhraṃ śuklapuṣpāṇi ca nyaset / dakṣiṇāvartakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bījair mṛddbhiś ca pūrayet
arghyādānaṃ viniṣpādya govastrādīndadedgurau / kālajñāya sthapataye vaiṣṇavādibhya arcayet
tatastu khānayedyatnajjalāntaṃ yāvadeva tu / puruṣādhaḥsthitaṃ śalyaṃ(3) na gṛhe doṣadaṃ bhavet

1 pilipicchamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 mahīdharaṃ vāstumayamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ śalyamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 118 asthiśalye vidyate vai bhittirvai gṛhiṇo 'sukhaṃ / yannāmaśabdaṃ śṛṇuyāttatra śalyaṃ tadudbhavaṃ
śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ bhagavānuvāca pādapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣāmi śilāvinyāsalakṣaṇaṃ / agrato maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ kuṇḍalānāntu catuṣṭayaṃ
kumbhanyāseṣṭakānyāso dvārastambhocchrayaṃ śubhaṃ / pādonaṃ pūrayet khātaṃ tatra vāstuṃ yajet same
iṣṭakāś ca supakvāḥ syurdvādaśāṅgulasammitāḥ / savistāratribhāgena vaipulyena(1) samanvitāḥ
karapramāṇā śreṣṭhā syācchilāpyatha śilāmaye(2) / nava kumbhāṃstāmramayān sthāpayediṣṭakāghaṭān
adbhiḥ pañcakaṣāyeṇa sarvauṣadhijalena ca / gandhatoyena ca tathā kumbhaistoyasupūritaiḥ
hiraṇyavrīhisaṃyuktair gandhacandanacarcitaiḥ / āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha
tarat samandīriti ca(3) pāvamānībhireva ca / uduttamaṃ varuṇamiti kathānaś ca tathaiva ca

1 suvistāraṃ vibhāgena naipuṇyaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śilā syānna śilāmaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 bhavatatsamandīritīti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 119 varuṇasyeti mantreṇa haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityapi / śrīsūktena tathā śilāḥ saṃsthāpya saṃghaṭāḥ(1)
śayyāyāṃ maṇḍape prācyāṃ maṇḍale harimarcayet / juhuyājjanayitvāgniṃ samidho dvādaśīstataḥ
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu praṇavenaiva kārayet / aṣṭāhutīs tathāṣṭāntair ājyaṃ(2) vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt
lokeśānāmagnaye vai somāyāvagraheṣu ca(3) / puruṣottamāyeti ca vyāhṛtīrjuhuyāttataḥ
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ pūrṇāṃ mūrtimāṃsaghṛtāṃstilān / vedādyair dvādaśāntena(4) kumbheṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak
prāṅmukhastu guruḥ kuryādaṣṭadikṣu vilipya ca / madhye caikāṃ śilāṃ kumbhaṃ nyasedetān surān kramāt
padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathā / kumudañca tathā nandaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhañca padminīṃ
kumbhānna cālayetteṣu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ / īśānāntāś ca pūrvādāviṣṭakāṃ prathamaṃ nyaset
śaktayo vimalādyāstu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ / nyasanīyā yathā yogaṃ madhye nyasyā tvanugrahā
avyaṅge cākṣata pūrṇaṃ muneraṅgirasaḥ sute / iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmyahaṃ

mantreṇānena vinyasya iṣṭakā deśakramottamaḥ / 2 aṣṭāhutīplathā pūrṇair ājyamiti ga, gha, ṅa, iti pustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 somāya ca grahāya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 dvādaśārṇena iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 120 garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ kuryānmadhyasthāne samāhitaḥ
kumbhopariṣṭhādeveśaṃ padminīṃ nyasya devatāṃ / mṛttikāś caiva puṣpāṇi dhātavo ratnameva ca(1)
lauhāni dikpaterastraṃ yajedvai garbhabhājane / dvādaśāṅgulavistāre caturaṅgulakocchraye
padmākāre tāmramaye bhājane pṛthivīṃ yajet / ekānte sarvabhūteśe parvatāsanamaṇḍite
samudraparivāre tvaṃ devi garbhaṃ samāśraya / nande nandaya vāsiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā(2) saha
jaye bhārgavadāyāde prajānāṃ vijayāvahe / pūrṇeṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kuruṣva māṃ
bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama / sarvavījasamāyukte sarvaratnauṣadhīvṛte
jaye surucire nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha / prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi
subhage suprabhe bhadre gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ / pūjite paramāś carye gandhamālyair alaṅkṛte
bhavabhūtikarī devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ / deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe
manuṣyādikatuṣṭyarthaṃ paśuvṛddhikarī bhava / evamuktvā tataḥ khātaṃ gomūtreṇa tu secayet
kṛtvā nidhāpayedgarbhaṃ garbhādhānaṃ bhavenniśi / govastrādi pradadyācca guravenyeṣu bhojanaṃ
1 rasameva ceti ga. gha. ṅa. cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 priyayeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 121 garbhaṃ nyasyeṣṭakā nyasya tato garbhaṃ prapūrayet / pīṭhabandhamataḥ kuryānmitaprāsādamānataḥ(1)
pīṭhottamañcocchrayeṇa prāsādasyārdhavistarāt / padahīnaṃ madhyamaṃ syāt kaniṣṭhaṃ cottamārdhataḥ
pīṭhabandhopariṣṭhāttu vāstuyāgaṃ punaryajet / pādapratiṣṭhākārī tu niṣpāpo divi modate
devāgāraṃ karomīti manasā yastu cintayet / tasya kāyagataṃ pāpaṃ tadahnā hi praṇaśyati
kṛte tu kiṃ punastasya prāsāde vidhinaiva tu / aṣṭeṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ yaḥ kuryāddevatālayaṃ
na tasya phalasampattirvaktuṃ śakyeta kenacit / anenaivānumeyaṃ hi phalaṃ prāsādavistarāt
grāmamadhye ca pūrve ca pratyagdvāraṃ prakalpayet / vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu grāme pratyaṅmukho bhavet / dakṣiṇe cottare caiva paścime prāṅmukho bhavet
prāsādalakṣaṇakathanaṃ hayagrīva uvāca prāsādaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu / caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhajet ṣoḍaśadhā budhaḥ
madhye tasya caturbhistu kuryādāyasamanvitaṃ / 1 samaprāsādamānata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 122 dvadaśaiva tu bhāgāni bhittyarthaṃ parikalpayet
jaṅghocchrāyantu kartavyaṃ caturbhāgeṇa cāyataṃ(1) / jaṅghāyāṃ dviguṇocchrāyaṃ mañjaryāḥ kalpayed budhaḥ
turyabhāgena mañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ samyak pradakṣiṇaḥ(2) / tanmānanirgamaṃ kāryamubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ samaṃ
śikhareṇa samaṃ kāryamagre jagati vistaraṃ / dviguṇenāpi kartavyaṃ yathāśobhānurūpataḥ
vistārānmaṇḍapasyāgre garbhasūtradvayena tu / dairghyātpādādhikaṃ kuryānmadhyastambhair vibhūṣitaṃ
prāsādagarbhamānaṃ vā kurvīta mukhamaṇḍapaṃ / ekāśītipadair vyāstuṃ paścāt maṇḍapamārabhet
śukān prāgdvāravinyāse pādāntaḥsthān yajet surān / tathā prākāravinyāse yajed dvātriṃśadantagān(3)
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ caitat prāsādasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ / mānena pratimāyā vā prāsādamaparaṃ śṛṇu
pratimāyāḥ pramāṇana kartavyā piṇḍikā śubhā / garbhastu piṇḍikārdhena garbhamānāstu bhittayaḥ
bhitterāyāmamānena utsedhantu prakalpayet / bhittyucchrāyāttu dviguṇaṃ śikharaṃ kalpayed budhaḥ
śikharasya tu turyeṇa bhramaṇaṃ parikalpayet / śikharasya caturthena vyagrato mukhamaṇḍapaṃ

1 catyurbhāgeṇa vā yutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / caturbhāgeṇa saṃyutamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 samyak kuryāt pradakṣiṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dvātriṃśadantare iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 123 aṣṭamāṃsena garbhasya rathakānāntu nirgamaḥ / paridherguṇabhāgena rathakāṃstatra kalpayet
tattṛtīyeṇa(4) vā kuryādrathakānāntu nirgamaṃ / vāmatrayaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ rathakatritaye sadā
śikharārthaṃ hi sūtrāṇi catvāri vinipātayet / śukanāśordhvataḥ sūtraṃ tiryagbhūtaṃ nipātayet
śikharasyārdhabhāgasthaṃ siṃhaṃ tatra tu kārayet / śukanāsāṃ sthirīkṛtya madhyasandhau nidhāpayet
apare ca tathā pārśvaṃ tadvat sūtraṃ nidhāpayet / tadūrdhvantu bhavedvedī sakaṇṭā manasārakaṃ
skandhabhagnaṃ na kartavyaṃ vikarālaṃ tathaiva ca / ūrdhvaṃ ca vedikāmānāt kalaśaṃ parikalpayet
vistārāddviguṇaṃ dvāraṃ kartavyaṃ tu suśobhanaṃ / udumbarau tadūrdhvañca nyasecchākhāṃ sumaṅgalaiḥ
dvārasya tu caturthāṃśe kāryau caṇḍapracaṇdakau / viśvaksenavatsadaṇḍau śikhordhvoḍumbare śriyaṃ
diggajaiḥ snāpyamānāntāṃ ghaṭeḥ sābjāṃ surūpikāṃ / prāsādasya caturthāṃśaiḥ prākārasyocchrayo bhavet
prāsādāt pādahīnastu gopurasyocchrayo bhavet / pañcahastasya devasya ekahastā tu pīṭhikā
gāruḍaṃ maṇḍapañcāgre ekaṃ bhaumādidhāma ca / kuryāddhi pratimāyāntu dikṣu cāṣṭamāsu copari
pūrve varāhaṃ dakṣe ca nṛsiṃhaṃ śrīdharaṃ jale / uttare tu hayagrīvanāgneyyāṃ jāmadagnyakaṃ
1 tatturīyeṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 124 nairṛtyāṃ rāmakaṃ vāyau vāmanaṃ vāsudevakaṃ / īśe prāsādaracanā deyā vasvarkakādibhiḥ / dvārasya cāṣṭamādyaṃśaṃ tyatkā bedho na doṣabhāk
prāsādadevatāsthāpanaṃ bhagavānuvāca prāsāde devatāḥ sthāpyā vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me / pañcāyatamadhye tu vāsudevaṃ niveśayet
vāmanaṃ nṛhariñcāśvaśīrṣaṃ tadvañca śūkaraṃ / āgneye nairṛte caiva vāyavye ceśagocare
atha nārāyaṇaṃ madhye āgneyyāmambikāṃ nyaset / nairṛtyāṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyau brahmāṇaṃ liṅgamīśake
athavā rudrarūpantu athavā navadhāmasu / vāsudevaṃ nyasenmadhye pūrvādau vāmavāmakān
indrādīn lokapālāṃś ca athavā navadhāmasu / pañcāyatanakaṃ kuryāt madhye tu puruṣottamaṃ
lakṣmīvaiśravaṇau pūrvaṃ dakṣe mātṛgaṇaṃ nyaset / skandaṃ gaṇeśamīśānaṃ sūryādīn paścime grahān
uttare daśa matsyādīnāgneyyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā / nairṛtyāmambikāṃ sthāpya vāyavye tu sarasvatīṃ
padmāmaiśe vāsudevaṃ madhye nārāyaṇañca vā / trayodaśālaye madhye viśvarūpaṃ nyaseddhariṃ
pūrvādau keśavādīn vā anyadhāmasvayaṃ hariṃ(1) / mṛṇmayī dārughaṭitā lohajā ratnajā tathā
śailajā gandhajā caiva kausumī(2) saptadhā smṛtā / kausumī gandhajā caiva mṛṇmayī pratimā tathā
tatkālapūjitāś caitāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ / atha śailamayīṃ vakṣye śilā yatra ca gṛhyate
parvatānāmabhāve ca gṛhṇīyādbhūgatāṃ śilāṃ / pāṇḍarā hy aruṇā pītā kṛṣṇā śastā tu vairṇināṃ
na yadā labhyate samyag varṇināṃ varṇataḥ śilā / varṇādyāpādānaṃ tatra juhyāt siṃhavidyayā
śilāyāṃ śuklarekhāgryā kṛṣṇāgryā siṃhahomataḥ / kāṃsyaghaṇṭāninādā syāt puṃliṅgā visphuliṅgikā
tanmandalakṣaṇā(3) strī syādrūpābhāvānnapuṃsakā / dṛśyate maṇḍalaṃ yasyāṃ sagarbhāṃ tāṃ vivarjayet
pratimārthaṃ vanaṃ gatvā vrajayāgaṃ samācaret / tatra khātvopalipyātha maṇḍape tu hariṃ yajet
baliṃ datvā karmaśastraṃ ṭaṅkādikamathārcayet / hutvātha śālitoyena astreṇa prokṣayecchilāṃ
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā nṛsiṃhena mūlamantreṇa pūjayet(4) / hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāttato bhūtabaliṃ guruḥ

1 anyadhāmasu yajñaviditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 kaumudī iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 unmattalakṣaṇā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 mantrayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 126 atra ye saṃsthitāḥ sattvā yātudhānāś ca guhyakāḥ / siddhādayo vā ye cānye tān sampūjya kṣamāpayet
viṣṇubimbārthamasmākaṃ(1) yātraiṣā keśavājñayā / viṣṇvarthaṃ yadbhavet kāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavet
anena balidānena prītā bhavata sarvathā /
prabodhitāḥ sattvā yānti tṛptā yathāsukhaṃ / śilpibhiś ca caruṃ prāśya svapnamantraṃ japenniśi
oṃ namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave / viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye(2) namaḥ
ācakṣva devadeveśa prasuptosmi(3) tavāntikaṃ / svapne sarvāṇi kāryāṇi hṛdisthāni tu yāni me
oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ viṣṇave svāhā(4) śubhe svapne śubhaṃ sarvaṃ hy aśubhe siṃhahomataḥ / prātararghyaṃ śilāyāṃ tu datvāstreṇāstrakaṃ yajet
kuddālaṭaṅkaśastrādyaṃ madhvānyāktamukhañcaret / ātmānaṃ cintayedviṣṇuṃ śilpinaṃ viśvakarmakaṃ(5)
śastraṃ viṣṇvātmakaṃ(6) dadyāt mukhapṛṣṭhādi darśayet / jitendriyaḥ ṭaṅkahastaḥ śilpī tu caturasrakāṃ

1 lokasiddhyarthamasmākamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 viśvādhipataye iti kha, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ 3 prapanno 'smi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 viśvakarmaṇimiti kha, ga, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ 6 viśvātmakamiti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ :p 127 śilāṃ kṛtvā piṇḍikārthaṃ kiñcinnyūnāntu kalpayet / rathe sthāpya samānīya savastrāṃ kāruveśmani / pūjayitvātha ghaṭayet pratimāṃ sa tu karmakṛt
vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇavidhiḥ bhagavānuvāca vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te / prāsādasyottare pūrvamukhīṃ vā cottarānanāṃ
saṃsthāpya pūjya ca baliṃ datvātho madhyasūcakaṃ / śilāṃ śilpī tu navadhā vibhajya navame 'ṃśake
sūrpabhaktaiḥ śilāyāṃ tu bhāgaṃ svāṅgulamucyate / dvyaṅgulaṃ golakaṃ nāmnā kālanetraṃ taducyate
bhāgamekaṃ tridhā bhaktvā pārṣṇibhāgaṃ prakalpayet / bhāgamekaṃ tathā jānau grīvāyāṃ bhāgameva ca
mukuṭaṃ tālamātraṃ syāttālamātraṃ tayā mukhaṃ / tālenaikena kaṇṭhantu tālena hṛdayaṃ tathā
nābhimeḍhrāntarantālaṃ dvitālāvūrukau tathā / tāladvayena jaṅghā syāt sūtrāṇi śṛṇu sāmprataṃ
kāryaṃ sūtradvayaṃ pāde jaṅghāmadhye tathāparaṃ / jānau sūtradvayaṃ kāryamūrūmadhye tathāparaṃ
meḍhre tathāparaṃ kāryaṃ kaṭyāṃ sūtrantathāparaṃ / mekhalābandhasiddhyarthaṃ nābhyāṃ caivāparantathā
hṛdaye ca tathā kāryaṃ kaṇṭhe sūtradvayaṃ tathā / lalāte cāparaṃ kāryaṃ mastake ca tathāparaṃ
mukuṭopari kartavyaṃ sūtramekaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ / sūtrāṇyūrdhvaṃ pradeyāni saptaiva kamalodbhava(1)
kakṣātrikāntareṇaiva ghaṭ sūtrāṇi pradāpayet / madhyasūtraṃ tu santyajya sūtrāṇyeva nivedayet
lalāṭaṃ nāsikāvaktraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulaṃ / grīvākarṇau tu kartavyau āyāmāccaturaṅgulau
dvyaṅgule hanuke kārye vistārāccibukantathā / aṣṭāṅgulaṃ lalāṭantu vistāreṇa prakīrtitam
pareṇa dvyaṅgulau śaṅkhau kartavyāvalakānvitau / caturaṅgulamākhyātamantaraṃ karṇanetrayoḥ
dvyaṅgulau pṛthukau karṇau karṇāpāṅgārdhapañcame / bhrūsamena tu sūtreṇa karṇaśrotraṃ prakīrtitam
viddhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ karṇamaviddhañcaturaṅgulam / civukena samaṃ viddhamaviddhaṃ vā ṣaḍaṅgulam
gandhapātraṃ tathāvartaṃ śaṣkulīṃ kalpayettathā / dvyaṅgulenādharaḥ kāryastasyārdhenottarādharaḥ
ardhāṅgulaṃ tathā netraṃ(2) vaktrantu caturaṅgulam / āyāmena tu vaipulyāt sārdhamaṅgulamucyate
avyāttamevaṃ syādvaktraṃ vyāttaṃ tryaṅgulamiṣyate / nāsāvaṃśasamucchrāyaṃ mūle tvekāṅgulaṃ matam
ucchrāyā dvyaṅgulaṃ cāgre karavīropamāḥ smṛtāḥ / 1 mukuṭopari iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tathā gojī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 129 antaraṃ cakṣuṣoḥ kāryaṃ caturaṅgulamānataḥ
dvyaṅgulaṃ cākṣikoṇaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ cāntaraṃ tayoḥ / tārā netratribhāgeṇa dṛktārā pañcamāṃśikā
tryaṅgulaṃ netravistāraṃ droṇī cārdhāṅgulā matā / tatsamāṇā bhruvorlekhā bhruvau caiva same mate
bhrūmadhyaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ bhrūdairghyaṃ caturāṅgulam(1) / ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmammastakasya tu veṣṭanam
mūrtīnāṃ keśavādīnāṃ dvātriṃśadveṣṭanaṃ bhavet / pañcanetrā tvadhogrīvā vistārādveṣṭanaṃ punaḥ
triguṇantu bhavedūrdhvaṃ vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ punaḥ / grīvātriguṇamāyāmaṃ grīvāvakṣontaraṃ bhavet
skandhāvaṣṭāṅgulau kāryau trikalāvaṃśakau śubhau / saptanetrau smṛtau bāhū prabāhū ṣoḍaśāṅgulau
trikalau vistṛtau bāhū prabāhū cāpi tatsamau / bāhudaṇḍordhvato jñeyaḥ pariṇāhaḥ kalā nava
saptadaśāṅgulo madhye kūrpārordhe ca ṣoḍaśa / kūrpārasya bhavennāhaḥ triguṇaḥ kamalodbhava
nāhaḥ prabāhumadhye tu ṣoḍaśāṅgula ucyate / agrahaste parīṇāho dvādaśāṅgula ucyate
vistareṇa karatalaṃ kīrtitaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam / dairghyaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ madhyā pajcāṅgulā matā
tarjanyanāmikā caiva tasmādardhāṅgulaṃ vinā / kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau kāryau caturaṅgulasammitau
1 bhrūdairghyāccaturaṅgulā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 130 dviparvoṅguṣṭhakaḥ kāryaḥ śeṣāgulyastriparvikāḥ / sarvāsāṃ parvaṇordhena nakhamānaṃ vidhīyate
vakṣaso yat pramāṇantu jaṭharaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ / aṅgulaikaṃ bhavennābhī vedhena ca pramāṇataḥ
tato meḍhrāntaraṃ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ / nābhimadhye prīṇāho dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ
antaraṃ stanayoḥ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ / civukau(1) yavamānau tu maṇḍalaṃ dvipadaṃ bhavet
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ veṣṭanaṃ vakṣasaḥsphuṭam / caturmukhañca tadadhoveṣṭanaṃ parikīrtitam
pariṇāhas tathā kaṭyā catuḥpañcāśadaṅgulaiḥ / vistāraścorumūle tu procyate dvādaśaṅgulaḥ
tasmādabhyadhikaṃ madhye tato nimnataraṃ kramāt / vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ jānutriguṇā pariṇāhataḥ
jaṅghāmadhye tu vistāraḥ saptāṅgula udāhṛtaḥ / triguṇā paridhiścāsya jaṅghāgraṃ pañcavistarāt
triguṇā paridhiścāsya pādau tālapramāṇakau / āyāmādutthitau pādau caturaṅgulameva ca
gulphāt pūrvaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pramāṇāccaturaṅgulam / trikalaṃ vistṛtau pādau tryaṅgulo guhyakaḥ smṛtaḥ
pañcāṅgulastu nāhosya dīrghā tadvat pradeśinī / aṣṭamāṣṭāṃśatonyūnaḥ śeṣāṅgulyaḥ krameṇa tu
sapādāṅgulamutsedhamaṅguṣṭasya prakīrtitaṃ / yavonamaṅgulaṃ kāryamaṅguṣṭhasya nakhaṃ tathā
1 cūcukau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 131 ardhāṅgulaṃ tathānyāsāṃ(1) kramān nyūnaṃ tu kārayet / aṅgulau vṛṣaṇau kāryau meḍhraṃ tu caturaṅgulam
pariṇāhotra koṣāgraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulam / ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhau vṛṣaṇau parikīrtitau
pratimā bhūṣaṇāḍhyā syādetaduddeśalakṣaṇam / anayaiva diśā kāryaṃ loke dṛṣṭvā tu lakṣaṇam
dakṣiṇe tu kare cakramadhastāt padmameva ca / vāme śaṅkhaṃ gadādhastādvāsudevasya lakṣaṇāt
śrīpuṣṭau vāpi kartavye padmavīṇākarānvite / ūrumātrocchitāyāme mālāvidyādharau(2) tathā
prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃsthau tau prabhā hastyādibhūṣaṇā / padmābhaṃ pādapīṭhantu pratimāsvevamācaret
piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye dairghyeṇa pratimāsamā / ucchrāyaṃ pratimārdhantu catuḥṣaṣṭipuṭāṃ(2) ca tām

tyaktvā paṅktidvayaṃ cādhastadūrdhvaṃ yattu koṣṭhakam / 1 sārdhāṅgulaṃ tathāyāmamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 maṇividyādharāviti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 catuḥṣaṣṭipadāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 132 samantādubhayoḥ pārśve antasthaṃ parimārjayet
ūrdhvaṃ paṅgktidvayaṃ tyaktvā adhastād yattu koṣṭhakam / antaḥ sammārjayet yatnāt pārśvayorubhayoḥ samam
tayormadhyagatau tatra catuṣkau mārjayettataḥ / caturdhā bhājayitvā tu ūrdhvapaṅktidvayaṃ budhaḥ
mekhalā bhāgamātrā syāt khātaṃ tasyārdhamānataḥ / bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ parityajya pārśvayorubhayoḥ samaṃ
datvā caikaṃ padaṃ vāhye pramāṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ / tribhāgeṇa ca bhāgasyāgre syāttoyavinirgamaḥ
nānāprakārabhedena bhadreyaṃ(1) piṇḍikā śubhā / aṣṭatālā tu kartavyā devī lakṣmīstayā striyaḥ
bhruvau yavādhike kārye yavahīnā tu nāsikā / golakenādhikaṃ vaktramūrdhvaṃ tiryagvivarjitaṃ
āyate nayane kārye tribhāgonair yavaistribhiḥ / tadardhena tu vaipulyaṃ netrayoḥ parikalpayet
karṇapāśo .dhikaḥ kāryaḥ sṛkkaṇīsamasūtrataḥ / namraṃ kalāvihīnantu kuryādaṃśadvayaṃ tathā
grīvā sārdhakalā kāryā tadvistāropaśobhitā / netraṃ vinā tu vistārau ūrū jānū ca piṇḍikā
aṅghripṛṣṭhau sphicau kaṭyāṃ yathābhāgaṃ prakalpayet / saptāṃśonās tathāṅgulyo dīrghaṃ viṣkambhanāhataṃ
netraikavarjitāyāmā jaṅghorū ca tathā kaṭiḥ / madhyapārśvaṃ ca tadvṛttaṃ ghanaṃ pīnaṃ kucadvayaṃ
1 tatreyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 133 tālamātrau stanau karyau kaṭiḥ sārdhakalādhikā / lakṣma śeṣaṃ purāvatsyāt dakṣiṇe cāmubujaṃ kare
vāme vittvaṃ striyau pārśve śubhe cāmarahastake / dīrghaghoṇastu garuḍaś cakrāṅgādyānatho vade
śālagrāmādimūrtilakṣaṇakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca śālagrāmādimūrteś ca vakṣyehaṃ bhuktimuktidāḥ / vāsudevo 'sito dvāre śālagrāmadvicakrakaḥ
jñeyaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo lagnadvicakro rakta uttamaḥ / sūkṣmacakro bahucchidraḥ pradyumno nīladīghavaḥ
pīto niruddhaḥ padmāṅgo vartulo dvitrirekhavān / kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo nābhyunnataḥ śuṣiradīrghavān
parameṣṭho sābjacakraḥ pṛṣṭhacchidrakaś ca(1) vindumān / sthūlacakro 'sito viṣṇurmadhye rekhā gadākṛtiḥ
nṛsiṃhaḥ kapikaḥ sthūlavakraḥ syāt pañcavindukaḥ / varāhaḥ śaktiliṅgaḥ syāt taccakrau viṣamau sṛtau
indranīlanibhaḥ sthūlastrirekhālāñchitaḥ śubhaḥ / kūrmastathonnataḥ pṛṣṭhe vartulāvartako 'sitaḥ
hayagrīvoṅkuśāvārarekho nīlaḥ savindukaḥ / 1 pṛthuśccchidraśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 134 vaikuṇṭhaḥ ekacakro 'bjī maṇibhiḥ puccharekhakaḥ
matsyo dīrghastrivinduḥ syāt kācavarṇastu pūritaḥ / śrīdharo vanamālāṅkaḥ pañjarekhastu vartulaḥ
vāmano vartulaścātihrasvo nīlaḥ savindukaḥ / śyāmastrivikramo dakṣarekho vāmena vindukaḥ
ananto nāgabhogāṅgo naikābho naikamūrtimān / sthūlo dāmodaro madhyacakro dvāḥsūkṣmavindukaḥ(1)
sudarśanastvekacakro lakṣmīnārāyaṇo dvayāt / tricakraścācyuto devastricakrako vā trivikramaḥ
janārdanaś catuś cakro vāsudevaś ca pañcabhiḥ / ṣaṭvakraś caiva pradyumnaḥ saṅkarṣaṇañca saptabhiḥ
puruṣottamoṣṭacakro navavyūho navāṅkitaḥ / daśāvatāro daśabhirdaśaikenāniruddhakaḥ / dvādaśātmā dvādaśabhirata ūrdhvamanantakaḥ
śālagrāmādipūjākathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca śālagrāmādicakrāṅkapūjāḥ siddhyai vadāmi te / trividhā syāddhareḥ pūjā kāmyākāmyobhayātmikā

mīnādīnāntu pañcānāṃ kāmyātho vobhayātmikā(2) / 1 madhyacakrādhaḥ sūkṣmavinduka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 kāmyārthevobhayātmaketi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 135 varāhasya nṛsiṃhasya vāmanasya ca muktaye
cakrādīnāṃ trayāṇāntu śālagrāmārcanaṃ śṛṇu / uttamā niṣphalā pūjā kaniṣṭhā saphalārcanā
madhyamā mūrtipūjā syāccakrābje caturasrake / praṇavaṃ hṛdi vinyasya ṣaḍaṅgaṅkaradehayoḥ
kṛtamudrātrayaś cakrād vahiḥ pūve guruṃ yajet / āpye gaṇaṃ vāyave ca dhātāraṃ nairṛte yajet
vidhātārañca kartāraṃ hartāraṃ dakṣasaumyayoḥ / viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśe āgneye kṣetrapālakam
ṛgādivedān prāgādau ādhārānantakaṃ bhuvaṃ / pīṭhaṃ padmaṃ cārkacandravahnyākhyaṃ maṇḍalatrayaṃ
āsanaṃ dvādaśārṇena tatra sthāpya śilāṃ yajet / astena ca samastena svavījena yajet kramāt
pūrvādāvatha vedādyair gāyatrībhyāṃ jitādinā / praṇavenārcayet pañcānmudrāstisraḥ pradarśayet
viśvaksenasya cakrasya kṣetrapālasya darśayet / śālagrāmasya prathamā pūjārtho niṣphalocyate
pūrvavat ṣoḍaśārañca sapadmaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet / śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgair gurvādyaṃ pūrvavadyajet(1)
pūrve saumye dhanurvāṇān vedādyair āsanaṃ dadet / śilāṃ nyased dvādaśārṇaistṛtīyaṃ pūjanaṃ śṛṇu

aṣṭāramabjaṃ vilikhet gurvādyaṃ(2) pūrvavadyajayet / 1 caturbhiḥ pūrvavadyajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gandhādyair iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 136 aṣṭārṇenāsanaṃ datvā tenaiva ca śilāṃ nyaset / pūjayeddaśadhā tena gāyatrībhyāṃ jitaṃ tathā(1)
caturviṃśatimūrtistotrakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca oṃrūpaḥ keśavaḥ padmaśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / nārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhapadmagadācakrī pradakṣiṇaṃ
tato gado mādhavoriśaṅkhapadmī namāmi taṃ / cakrakaumodakīpadmaśaṅkhī govinda ūrjitaḥ
bhokṣadaḥ śrīgadī padmī śaṅkhī viṣṇuś ca cakradhṛk / śaṅkhacakrābjagadinaṃ madhusūdanamāname
bhaktyā trivikramaḥ padmagadī cakrī ca śaṅkhyapi / śaṅkhacakragadāpadmī vāmanaḥ pātu māṃ sadā
gaditaḥ śrīdharaḥ padmī cakraśārṅgī ca śaṅkhyapi(2) / hṛṣīkeśo gadācakrī padmī cakraśaṅkhī ca pātu naḥ
varadaḥ padmanābhastu śaṅkhābjārigadādharaḥ / dāmodaraḥ padmaśaṅkhagadācakrī namāmi taṃ
tene gadī śaṅkhacakrī vāsudevobjabhṛjjagat / saṅkarṣaṇo gadī śaṅkhī padmī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ

1 jitaṃ tata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 cakrī gadyatha śaṅkhyapi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 137 gadī cakrī śaṅkhagadī (1) pradyumnaḥ padmabhṛt prabhuḥ / aniruddhaś cakragadī śaṅkhī padmī ca pātu naḥ
sureśoryabjaśaṅkhāḍhyaḥ śrīgadī puruṣottamaḥ / adhokṣajaḥ padmagadī śaṅkhī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ
devo nṛsiṃhaś cakrābjagadāśaṅkhī namāmi tam / acyutaḥ śrīgadī padmī cakrī śaṅkhī ca pātu vaḥ
bālarūpī śaṅkhagadī upendraś cakrapadmyapi / janārdanaḥ padmacakrī śaṅkhadhārī gadādharaḥ
śaṅkhī padmī ca cakrī ca hariḥ kaumodakīdharaḥ / kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhī gadī padmī cakrī me bhuktimuktidaḥ
ādimūttirvāsudevastasmāt saṅkarṣaṇobhavat / saṅkarṣaṇācca pradyumnaḥ pradyumnādaniruddhakaḥ
keśavādiprabhedena aikaikasya tridhā kramāt / dvādaśākṣarakaṃ stotraṃ caturviṃśatimūrtimat / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi nirmalaḥ sarvamāpnuyāt
matsyādilakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ bhagavānuvāca daśāvatāraṃ matsyādilakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te / matsyākārastu matsyaḥ syāt kūrmaḥ kārmākṛlirbhavet
1 śaṅkhapadmī iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 138 narāṅgo vātha kartavyo bhūvarāho gadādibhṛt / dakṣiṇe vāmake śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīrvā padmameva vā
śrīvāmakūrparasthā tu kṣmānantau caraṇānugau / varāhasthāpanādrājyaṃ bhavābdhitaraṇaṃ bhavet
narasiṃho vivṛttāsyo vāmorukṣatadānavaḥ(1) / tadvakṣo dārayanmālī sphuraccakragadādharaḥ
chatrī daṇḍī vāmanaḥ syādathavā syāccaturbhujaḥ / rāmaścāpeṣuhastaḥ syāt kaḍgī paraśunānvitaḥ
rāmaścāpī śarī khaḍgī śaṅkhī vā dvibhujaḥ smṛtaḥ / gadālāṅgaladhārī ca rāmo vātha caturbhujaḥ
vāmordhve lāṅgalaṃ dadyādadhaḥ śaṅkhaṃ suśobhanaṃ / muṣalaṃ dakṣiṇordhve tu cakrañcādhaḥ suśobhanaṃ
śāntātmā lambakarṇaś ca gaurāṅgaścāmbarāvṛtaḥ(2) / ūrdhvapadmasthito buddho varadābhayadāyakaḥ
dhanustūṇānvitaḥ(3) kalkī mlecchotsādakaro dvijaḥ / athavāśvasthitaḥ khaḍgī śaṅkhacakraśarānvitaḥ
lakṣaṇaṃ vāsudevādinavakasya vadāmi te / dakṣiṇordhve gadā vāme vāmordhve cakramuttamaṃ
brahmeśau pārśvagau nityaṃ vāsudevosti pūrvavat / śaṅkhī sa varado vātha dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ

lāṅgalī muṣalī rāmo gadāpadmadharaḥ smṛtaḥ / 1 vāmoruhṛtadānava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gaurāṅgaścāyudhāvṛta iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 dhanurvāṇānvita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 139 pradyumno dakṣiṇe vajraṃ(1) śaṅkhaṃ vāme dhanuḥ kare
gadānābhyāvṛtaḥ(2) pītyā pradyumno vā dhanuḥśarī / caturbhujo niruddhaḥ syāttathā nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ
caturmukhaś caturbāhurvṛhajjaṭharamaṇḍalaḥ / lambakūrco(3) jaṭāyukto vrahmā haṃsāgravāhanaḥ
dakṣiṇe cākṣasūtrañca sruvo vāme tu kuṇḍikā / ājyasthālī sarasvatī sāvitrī vāmadakṣiṇe
viṣṇuraṣṭabhujastārkṣe kare khaḍgastu dakṣiṇe / gadāśaraś ca varado vāme kārmukakheṭake
cakraśaṅkhau caturbāhur narasiṃhaś caturbhujaḥ / śaṅkhacakradharo vāpi vidāritamahāsuraḥ
acaturbāhurvarāhastu śeṣaḥ pāṇitale dhṛtaḥ / dhārayan bāhunā pṛthvīṃ vāmnena kamalādharaḥ(4)
pādalagnā dharā kāryā padā lakṣmīrvyavasthitā / trailokyamohanastārkṣye aṣṭabāhustu dakṣiṇe
cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca muṣalaṃ aṅkuśaṃ vāmake kare / śaṅkhaśārṅgagadāpāśān padmavīṇāsamanvite
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī kārye viśvarūpo 'tha dakṣiṇe / mudgaraṃ ca tathā pāśaṃ śaktiśūlaṃ śaraṃ kare

vāme śaṅkhañca śārṅgañca gadāṃ pāśaṃ ca tomaraṃ / 1 dakṣiṇe cakramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gadī ratyāvṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 lambabhruva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭaḥ 4 dhārayannākulāṃ pṛthvīṃ vāmena kamalāmadha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 140 lāṅgalaṃ paraśuṃ daṇḍaṃ churikāṃ carmakṣepakaṃ(1)
viṃśadbāhuś caturvaktro dakṣiṇasthotha vāmake / trinetre vāmapārśve na śayito jalaśāyyapi
śriyā dhṛtaikacaraṇo vimalādyābhirīḍitaḥ / nābhipadmacaturvaktro hariśaṅkarako hariḥ
śūlarṣṭidhārī dakṣe ca gadācakradharo pade / rudrakeśavalakṣmāṅgo gaurīlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ
śaṅkhacakragadāvedapāṇiścāśvaśirā hariḥ / vāmapādo dhṛtaḥ śeṣe dakṣiṇaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhagaḥ
dattātreyo dvibāhuḥ syādvāmotsaṅge śriyā saha / viśvaksenaś cakragadī halī śaṅkhī harergaṇaḥ
devīpratimālakṣaṇakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca caṇḍī viṃśatibāhuḥ syādbibhratī dakṣiṇaiḥ karaḥ / śūlāsiśakticakrāṇi pāśaṃ kheṭāyudhābhayaṃ
ḍamaruṃ śaktikāṃ vāmair nāgapāśañca kheṭakaṃ / kuṭhāṅkuśacāpāṃś ca ghaṇṭādhvajagadāṃs tathā
ādarśamudgarān hastaiś caṇḍī vā daśabāhukā / tadadho mahiṣaśchinnamūrdhā patitamastakaḥ
1 carma cottamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 141 śastrodyatakaraḥ kruddhastadgrīvāsambhavaḥ pumān / śūlahasto vamadrakto raktasraṅmūrdhajekṣaṇaḥ
siṃhenāsvādyamānastu pāśabaddho gale bhṛśaṃ / yāmyāṅghyrākrāntasiṃhā ca savyāṅghrirnīcagāsure
caṇḍikeyaṃ trinetrā ca saśastrā ripumardanī / navapadmātmake sthāne pūjyā durgā svamūrtitaḥ
ādau madhye tathendrādau navātattvātmabhiḥ(1) kramāt / aṣṭādaśabhujaikā tu dakṣe muṇḍaṃ ca kheṭakaṃ
ādarśatarjanīcāpaṃ dhvajaṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā / pāśaṃ vāme bibhratī ca śaktimudgaraśūlakaṃ
vajrakhaḍgāṅkuśaśarān cakrandevī śalākayā / etair evāyudhair yuktā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśabahukāḥ
ḍamaruṃ tarjanīṃ tyaktvā rudracaṇḍādayo nava / rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā
caṇḍā caṇdavatī caiva caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā / ugracaṇḍā ca madhyasthā rocanābhāruṇāsitā
nīlā śuklā dhūmrikā ca pītā śvetā ca siṃhagāḥ / mahiṣotha pumān śastrī tatkacagrahamuṣṭikāḥ
ālīḍhā nava(2) durgāḥ syuḥ sthāpyāḥ putrādivṛddhaye / tathā gaurī ca caṇḍikādyā kuṇḍyakṣararadāgnidhṛk
saiva rambhā vane siddhāgnihīnā lalitā tathā / skandhamūrdhakarā vāme dvitīye dhṛtadarpaṇā
1 navatatvādibhirirti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śālāsu nava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 142 yāmye phalāñjalihastā saubhāgyā tatra cordhvikā / lakṣmīryāmyakarāmbhojā vāme śrīphalasaṃyutā
pustākṣamālikāhastā vīṇāhastā sarasvatī / kumbhābjahastā śvetābhā makaropari jāhnavī (1)
kūrmagā yamunā kumbhakarā śyāmā ca pūjyate / savīṇastumburuḥ śuklaḥ śūlī mātragrato vṛṣe
gaurī caturmukhī brāhmī akṣamālāsurānvitā / kuṇḍakṣapātriṇī vāme haṃsagā śāṅkarī sitā
śaracāpau dakṣiṇe 'syā vāme cakraṃ(2) dhanurvṛṣe / kaumārī śikhigā raktā śaktihastā dvibāhukā
cakraśaṅkhadharā savye vāme lakṣmīrgadābjadhṛk / daṇḍaśaṅkhāsi(3) gadayā vārāho mahiṣasthitā
aindrī vāme vajrahastā sahasrākṣī tu siddhaye / cāmuṇḍā koṭarāghnī syānnirmāṃsā tu trilocanā
nirmāṃsā asthisārā vā ūrdhvakeśī kṛśodarī / dvīpacarmadharā vāme kapālaṃ paṭṭiśaṅkare
śūlaṃ kartrī dakṣaṇe 'syāḥ śavārūḍhāsthitabhūṣaṇā / vināyako narākāro vṛhatkukṣirgajānanaḥ
vṛhacchuṇḍo hy upavīto mukhaṃ saptakalaṃ bhavet / vistārāddairghyatacaiva śuṇḍaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ
kalā dvādaśa nāḍī tu grīvā sārdhakalocchritā / ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ guhyamadhyardhamaṅgulaṃ

1 makareddhari jāhnavīti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustatrayakapāṭhaḥ 2 vāme vajramiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 śaṅkhāri iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 143 nābhirūrū dvādaśañca jaṅghe pāde tu dakṣiṇe / svadantaṃ paraśuṃ vāme laḍḍukañcotpalaṃ śaye
sumukhī ca viḍālākṣī pārśve skando mayūragaḥ / svāmī śākho viśākhaś ca dvibhujo bālarūpadhṛk
dakṣe śaktiḥ kukkuṭotha ekavaktrotha ṣaṇmukhaḥ / ṣaḍbhujo vā dvādaśabhirgrāmeraṇye dvibāhukaḥ
śaktīṣupāśanistriṃśatotradostarjanīyutaḥ / śaktyā dākṣiṇahasteṣu ṣaṭsu vāme kare tathā
śikhipicchandhanuḥ kheṭaṃ patākābhayakukkuṭe / kapālakartarīśūlapāśabhṛdyāmyasaumyayoḥ
gajacarmabhṛdūrdhvāsyapādā syāt rudracarcikā / saiva cāṣṭabhujā devī śiroḍamarukānvitā
tena sā rudracāmuṇḍā nāṭeśvaryatha nṛtyatī / iyameva mahālakṣmīrupaviṣṭā caturmukhī
nṛvājimahiṣebhāṃś ca khādantī ca kare sthitān / daśabāhustrinetrā ca śastrāsiḍamarutrikaṃ
bibhratī dakṣiṇe haste vāme ghaṇṭāṃ ca kheṭakaṃ / khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca triśūlañca siddhacāmuṇḍakāhvayā
siddhayogeśvarī devī sarvasiddhapradāyikā / etadrūpā bhavedanyā pāśāṅkuśayutāruṇā
bhairavī rūpavidyā tu bhujair dvādaśabhiryutā / etāḥ śmaśānajā raudrā ambāṣṭakamidaṃ(1) smṛtaṃ
1 ādyāṣṭakamidamiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ :p 144 kṣamā śivāvṛtā(1) vṛddhā dvibhujā vivṛtānanā / danturā kṣemakarī syādbhūmau jānukarā sthitā
yakṣiṇyastabdhadīrghākṣāḥ śākinyo vakradṛṣṭayaḥ(2) / piṅgākṣāḥ syurmahāramyā rūpiṇyopsarasaḥ(3) sadā
sākṣamālī triśūlī ca nandīśo dvārapālakaḥ / mahākālosimuṇḍī syācchūlakhaṭakavāṃs tathā
kṛśo bhaṅgī ca nṛtyan vai kuṣmāṇḍasthūlakharvavān / gajagokarṇavaktrādyā vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ
ghaṇṭākarṇoṣṭadaśadoḥ pāparogaṃ vidārayan / vajrāsidaṇḍacakreṣumuṣalāṅkuśamudgarān
dakṣiṇe tarjanīṃ kheṭaṃ śaktiṃ muṇḍañca pāśakaṃ / cāpaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ kuṭhārañca dvābhyāñcaiva triśūlakaṃ / ghaṇṭāmālākulo devo visphoṭakavimardanaḥ(4)
sūryādipratimālakṣaṇaṃ bhagavānuvāca sasaptāśve saikacakre rathe sūryo dvipadmadhṛk / masībhājanalekhanyau bibhratkuṇḍī tu dakṣiṇe

vāme tu piṅgalo dvāri daṇḍabhṛt sa ravergaṇaḥ / 1 śivācyuteti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vajradṛṣṭaya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 mahārathyo rūpiṇyo 'psarasa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 visphoṭakaruṇardana iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 145 bālavyajanadhāriṇyau pārśve rājñī ca niṣprabhā
athavāśvārūḍhaḥ kārya ekastu bhāskaraḥ / varadā dvyabjanaḥ sarve dikpālāstrakarāḥ kramāt
mudgaraśūlacakrābjabhṛtognyādividiksthitāḥ / sūryāryamādirakṣontāś caturhastā dviṣaḍdale
varuṇaḥ sūryanāmā ca sahasrāṃśus tathāparaḥ / dhātā tapanasañjñaś ca savitātha gabhastikaḥ
raviś caivātha parjanyastvaṣṭā mitrotha viṣṇukaḥ / meṣādirāśisaṃsthāś ca mārgādikārttikāntakāḥ
kṛṣṇo rakto manāgraktaḥ pītaḥ pāṇḍarakaḥ sitaḥ / kapilaḥ pītavarṇaś ca śukābho dhavalas tathā
dhūmro nīlaḥ kramādvarṇāḥ śaktayaḥ keśarāgragāḥ / iḍā suṣumnā viśvārcirindusañjñā pramardinī(1)
praharṣiṇī mahākālī kapilā ca prabodhanī / nīlāmbarā ghanāntasthā amṛtākhyā ca śaktayaḥ
varuṇādeś ca tadvarṇāḥ keśarāgreṣu vinyaset / tejaś caṇḍo mahāvakro(2) dvibhujaḥ padmakhadgabhṛt(3)
kuṇḍikājapyāmālīnduḥ kujaḥ śaktyakṣamālikaḥ / budhaścāpākṣapāṇiḥ syājjīvaḥ kuṇḍyakṣamālikaḥ

1 viśvācī vindusañjñāpravardhanī iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 mahārakta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / mārtaṇḍaś ca mahārakta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 padmakhaḍgadhṛgiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapustakapāṭhaḥ / khaḍgacarmabhṛditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 146 śukraḥ kuṇḍyakṣamālī syāt kiṇkiṇīsūtravāñchaniḥ(1) / ardhacandradharo rāhuḥ ketuḥ khaḍgī ca dīpabhṛt
anantastakṣakaḥ karkaḥ padmo mahābjaḥ śaṅkhakaḥ / kulikaḥ sūtriṇaḥ sarve phaṇavaktrā mahāprabhāḥ
indro vajrī gajārūḍhaśchāgagogniś ca śaktimān / yamo daṇḍī ca mahiṣe nairṛtaḥ khaḍgavān kare
makare varuṇaḥ pāśī vāyurdhvajadharo mṛge / gadī(2) kuvero meṣastha īśānaś ca jaṭī vṛṣe
dvibāhavo lokapālā viśvakarmākṣasūtrabhṛt / hanūmān vajrahastaḥ syāt padbhyāṃ sampīḍitāśrayaḥ
vīṇāhastāḥ kinnarāḥ syurmālāvidyādharāś ca khe(3) / durbalāṅgāḥ piśācāḥ syurvetālā vikṛtānanāḥ(4) / kṣetrapālāḥ śūlavantaḥ(5) pretā mahodarāḥ kṛśāḥ

devīpratimālakṣaṇaṃ bhagavānuvāca yoginyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ vakṣye aindrādīśāntataḥ kramāt / 1 śikhinīsūtravān śaniriti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 khaḍgo iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 maṇividyādharāś ca khe iti kha, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 vistṛtānanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 śūlayutā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 147 akṣobhyā rūkṣakarṇo ca rākṣasī kṛpaṇākṣayā(1)
piṅgākṣī ca kṣayā kṣemā ilā līlālayā tathā / lolā laktā balākeśī(2) lālasā vimalā punaḥ(3)
hutāśā ca viśālākṣī huṅkārā vaḍavāmukhī / mahākrūrā krodhanā tu bhayaṅkarī mahānanā
sarvajñā taralā tārā ṛgvedā tu hayānanā / sārākhyā rudraśaṅgrāhī(4) sambarā tālajaṅghikā
raktākṣī suprasiddhā tu vidyujjihvā karaṅkiṇī / meghanādā pracaṇḍogrā kālakarṇī(5) varapradā
candrā candrāvalī(6) caiva prapañcā pralayāntikā / śiśuvaktrā piśācī ca piśitāśā ca lolupā
dhamanī tāpanī caiva rāgiṇī(7) vikṛtānanā / vāyuvegā vṛhatkukṣirvikṛtā viśvarūpikā
yamajihvā jayantī ca durjayā ca jayāntikā / viḍālī revatī caiva pūtanā vijayāntikā

aṣṭahastāś caturhastā icchāstrāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ / 1 kṣapaṇā kṣamā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / kṣapaṇā kṣapā iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayakapāṭhaḥ 2 lolā raktā ca lokeśo iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihniapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 vimalā tata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 4 rasasaṅgrāhī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vasusaṅgrāhī iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 kālavarṇī iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 6 caṇḍā caṇdavatīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 vāmanī iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 148 bhairavaścārkahastaḥ syāt kūrparāsyo(1) jaṭendubhṛt
khaḍgāṅkuśakuṭhāreṣuviśvabhayabhṛdekataḥ / cāpatriśūlakhaṭvāṅgapāśakārdhavarodyataḥ
gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāsohibhūṣataḥ / pretāśano mātṛmadhye pūjyaḥ pañcānanothavā
avilomāgniparyantaṃ dīrghāṣṭakaikabheditaṃ / tatṣaḍaṅgāni jātyantair anvitaṃ ca kramād yajet
mandirāgnidalārūḍhaṃ(2) suvarṇarasakānvitaṃ / nādavindvandusaṃyuktaṃ mātṛnāthāṅgadīpitaṃ
vīrabhadro vṛṣārūḍho mātragre sa caturmukhaḥ / gaurīṃ tu dvibhujā tryakṣā śūlinī darpaṇānvitā
śūlaṃ galantikā kuṇḍī(3) varadā ca caturbhujā / abjasthā lalitā skandagaṇādarśaśalākayā(4)
caṇḍikā saśahastā syāt khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛk / dakṣe vāme nāgapāśaṃ carmāgkuśakuṭhārakaṃ / dhanuḥ siṃhe ca mahiṣaḥ śūlena prahatogrataḥ
liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ bhagavānuvāca liṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye kamalodbhava tacchṛṇu / dairghyārdhaṃ vasubhirbhaktvā tyaktvā bhāgatrayaṃ tataḥ
viṣkambhaṃ bhūtabhāgaistu caturasrantu kārayet / āyāmaṃ mūrtibhirbhaktvā ekadvitrikramān nyaset
brahmaviṣṇuśivāṃśeṣu vardhamānoyamucyate / caturasresya varṇārdhaṃ guhyakoṇeṣu lāñchayet
aṣṭāgraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgaṃ sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ / ṣoḍaśāsraṃ tataḥ kuryāddvātriṃśāsraṃ tataḥ punaḥ
catuḥṣaṣṭyasrakaṃ kṛtvā vartulaṃ sādhayettataḥ / kartayedatha liṅgasya śiro vai deśikottamaḥ
vistāramatha liṅgasya aṣṭadhā saṃvibhājayet / bhāgārdhārdhantu santyajya cchatrākāraṃ śiro bhavet
triṣu bhāgeṣu sadṛśamāyāmaṃ yasya cistaraḥ / tadvibhāgasamaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ
dairghyasya tu caturthena viṣkambhaṃ devapūjite / sarveṣāmeva liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu sāmprataṃ
madhyasūtraṃ samāsādya brahmarudrāntikaṃ(1) budhaḥ / ṣoḍaśāṅgulaliṅgasya ṣaḍbhāgair bhājito yathā
tadvaiyamanasūtrābhyāṃ mānamantaramucyate / yavāṣṭamuttare kāryaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ yavahānitaḥ
adhobhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā tvardhamekaṃ parityajet / 1 vrajedātyantikamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 150 aṣṭadhā taddvayaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvabhāgatryaṃ tyajet
ūrdhvañca pañcamādbhāgād bhrāmya rekhāṃ pralambayet / bhāgamekaṃ parityajya saṅgaṃ kārayettayoḥ
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mayā / sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye piṇḍikāntānnibodha me
brahmabhāgapraveśañca jñātvā liṅgasya cocchrayaṃ / nyased brahmaśilāṃ vidvān samyakkarmaśilopari
tathā sumucchrayaṃ jñātvā piṇḍikāṃ pravibhājayet / dvibhāgamucchritaṃ pīṭhaṃ vistāraṃ liṅgasammitam
tribhāgaṃ madhyataḥ khātaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ(1) vibhājayet / svamānārdhatribhāgeṇa bāhulyaṃ parikalpayet
bāhulyasya tribhāgeṇa mekhalāmatha kalpayet / khātaṃ syānmekhalātulyaṃ kramānnimnantu kārayet
mekhalāṣoḍaśāṃśena khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇajñaḥ / ucchrāyaṃ tasya pīṭhasya vikārāṅgaṃ tu(2) kārayet
bhūmau praviṣṭamekaṃ tu bhāgaikena(3) piṇḍikā / kaṇṭhaṃ bhāgaistribhiḥ kāryaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikā
dyaṃgena cordhvapaṭṭantu(4) ekāṃśāḥ śeṣapaṭṭikā / bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ praviṣṭantu yāvat kaṇṭhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ
nirgamaṃ bhāgamekaṃ tu yāvadvai śeṣapaṭṭikā / praṇālasya tribhāgena nirgamastu tribhāgataḥ

1 madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vikārāṃśāṃśceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 bhāgenaikeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 cārdhapaṭṭantu iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 151 mūleṅgulyagravistāramagre tryaṃśena cārdhataḥ / īṣannimnantu kurvīta khātaṃ taccottareṇa vai / piṇḍikāsahitaṃ liṅgametat sādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam
liṅgamānādikathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca vakṣyāmyanyaprakāreṇa(1) liṅgamānādikaṃ śṛṇu / vakṣye lavaṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ ghṛtajaṃ buddhivardhanam
bhūtaye vastraliṅgantu liṅgantātkālikaṃ viduḥ / pakvāpakvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ syādapakvāt pakvajaṃ varaṃ
tato dārumayaṃ puṇyaṃ dārujāt śailajaṃ varaṃ / śailādvaraṃ tu muktājaṃ tato lauhaṃ suvarṇajaṃ
rājataṃ kīrtitaṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ / raṅgajaṃ (2) rasaliṅgañca bhuktimuktipradaṃ varaṃ
rasajaṃ rasalohādiratnagarbhantu vardhayet / mānādi neṣṭaṃ siddhādi sthāpitetha svayambhuvi
vāme ca svecchayā teṣāṃ pīṭhaprāsādakalpanā / pūjayet sūryavimbasthaṃ darpaṇe prativimbitaṃ
pūjye harastu sarvatra liṅge pūrṇārcanaṃ bhavet / hastottaravidhaṃ śailaṃ(3) dārujaṃ tadvadeva hi

1 pravakṣye 'haṃ prakāreṇeti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 ratnajamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 haste tu vividhaṃ śailamiti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 152 calamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitam(1) / aṅgulād gṛhaliṅgaṃ syādyāvat pañcaśāṅgulaṃ
dvāramānāt trisaṅkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥ / navadhā garbhamānena liṅgandhāmni ca pūjayet
evaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśat jñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥ / madhyamānena ṣaṭtriṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśadadhamena ca
itthamaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet / ekāṅgulādipañcāntaṃ kanyasañcalamucyate
ṣadvādidaśaparyantañcalaṃ liṅgañca madhyamaṃ / ekādaśāṅgulādi syāt jyeṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāntakam
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ mahāratnai ratnair anyair navāṅgulam / ravibhirhemabhārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaistripañcabhiḥ
ṣoḍaśāṃśe ca vedāṃśe yugaṃ luptvordhvadeśataḥ / dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāṃś ca(2) koṇayostu vilopayet
caturniveśanāt kaṇṭho viṃśatistriyugais tathā(3) / pārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaraṃ(4)
dhāmno yugartunāgāṃśair dvāraṃ hīnāditaḥ kramāt / liṅgadvārocchrayādarvāg bhavet pādonataḥ kramāt
garbhārdhenādhamaṃ liṅgaṃ bhūtāṃśaiḥ syāt tribhirvaraṃ / tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta sampātayet samaṃ

1 vanamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakare sthitamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśārdhañceti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 viṃśatistriguṇaistatheti gha, cihnitapusutakapāṭhaḥ 4 vanaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaramiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / calaliṅgaṃ bhaved dhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 153 evaṃ syurnava sūtrāṇi bhūtasūtraiś ca madhyamaṃ / dvyantaro vāmavāmañca(1) liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā nava
hastādvivardhate hasto yāvatsyur nava pāṇayaḥ / hīnamadhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ trividhātmakam
ekaikaliṅgamadhyeṣu trīṇi trīṇi ca pādaśaḥ / liṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu cāṣṭottareṣu ca
sthiradīrghaprameyāttu dvāragarbhakarātmikā / bhāgeśañcāpyamīśañca devejyantulyasaṃjñitaṃ
catvāri liṅgarūpāṇi viṣkambheṇa tu lakṣayet / dīrghamāyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāt trirūpakaṃ
caturaṣṭāṣṭavṛttañca tattvatrayaguṇātmakaṃ / liṅgānāmīpsitaṃ dairghyaṃ tena kṛtvāṅgulāni vai
dhvajādyāyaiḥ surair bhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haret kṛtiṃ / tānyaṅgulāni yaccheṣaṃ lakṣayecca śubhāśubhaṃ
dhvajādyā dhvajasiṃhebhavṛṣāḥ jyeṣṭhāḥ pare śubhāḥ / svareṣu ṣaḍjagāndhārapañcamāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ
bhūteṣu ca śubhā bhūḥ syādagniṣvāhavanīyakaḥ / uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe nāgāṃśair bhājite kramāt
rasabhūtāṃśaṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśarair bhavet / āḍhyānāḍhyasurejyārkatulyānāñcaturasratā
pañcamaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ vyāsānnāhapravṛddhitaḥ / dvidhā bhedā bahūnyatra vakṣyante viśvakarmataḥ

āḍhyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavadhūtaṃ tadaṣṭadhā(2) / 1 antare vāmavāme ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 sthaulyād yavavṛddhyā tadaṣṭadhā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 154 tridhā hastājjinākhyañca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca(1)
pañcaviṃśatiliṅgāni nādye(2) devārcite tathā / pañcasaptabhirekatvājjinair bhaktair bhavanti hi
caturdaśasahasrāṇi caturdaśaśatāni ca / evamaṣṭāṅgulavistāro(3) navaikakaragarbhataḥ
teṣāṃ koṇārdhakoṇasthaiścintyāt koṇāni(4) sūtrakaiḥ / vistāraṃ madhyamaḥ kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayaṃ
vibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāsro(5) dvyaṣṭāsraḥsyācchivāṃśakaḥ / pādājjānvantako brahmā nābhyanto viṣṇurityataḥ
mūrdhvānto bhūtabhāgeśo vyakte 'vyakte ca tadvati / pañcaliṅgavyavasthāyāṃ śiro vartulamucyate
chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ vā bālendupratimākṛtiḥ(6) / ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ(7) kāmyabhedāt phalaṃ vade
liṅgamastakavistāraṃ vasubhaktantu kārayet / ādyabhāgaṃ caturdhā tu(8) vistārocchrāyato bhajet

catvāri tatra sūtrāṇi(9) bhāgabhāgānupātanāt / 1 pūjayet sarvameva ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 nāḍhye devārcita iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 evamaṣṭāṅgualavinyāsa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 chindyāt koṇānīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / chindyāt koṣāṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 dvibhāgādūrdhavamaṣṭāsra iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 bālendutrapuṣākṛtiriti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 caturbhāgair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 8 antyabhāgamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 9 catvāri tatra chatrāṇi iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭyapāṭhaḥ :p 155 puṇḍarīkantu bhāgena viśālākhyaṃ vilopanāt
triśātanāttu śrīvatsaṃ śatrukṛdvedalopanāt / śiraḥ sarvasame śreṣṭhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ surāhvaye(1)
caturbhāgātmake liṅgetrapuṣaṃ dvayalopanāt / anādyasya śiraḥ proktamardhacandraṃ śiraḥ śṛṇu
aṃśāt prānte yugāṃśaiś ca tvekāhānyāmṛtākṣakaṃ(2) / pūrṇabālendukumudaṃ dvitrivedakṣayāt kramāt
catustrirekavadanaṃ mukhaliṅgamataḥ śṛṇu / pūjābhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyagnipadakalpitaṃ(3)
arkāṃśaṃ pūrvavat tyaktvā ṣaṭ sthānāni vivartayat / śironnatiḥ prakartavyā lalāṭaṃ nāsikā tataḥ
vadanaṃ civukaṃ grīvā yugabhāgair bhujākṣibhiḥ / karābhyāṃ mukulīkṛtya(4) pratimāyāḥ pramāṇataḥ
mukhaṃ prati samaḥ kāryo vistārādaṣṭamāṃśataḥ / caturmukhaṃ mayā proktaṃ trimukhañcocyate śṛṇu
karṇapādādhikāstasya lalāṭādīni nirdiśet / bhujau caturbhirbhāgaistu kartavyau paścimorjitaṃ
vistarādaṣṭamāṃśena mukhānāṃ pratinirgamaḥ / ekavaktraṃ tathā kāryaṃ pūrvasyāṃ saumyalocanaṃ

lalāṭanāsikāvaktragrīvāyāñca vivartayet / 1 kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 dvaikahānyā sutāhvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 ṛtvagnipadakalpitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, mukhabhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 156 bhujācca pañcamāṃśena(1) bhujahīnaṃ vivartayet
vistārasya ṣaḍaṃśena mukhair nirgamanaṃ hitaṃ / sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ trapuṣaṃ vātha kukkuṭaṃ
piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca ataḥ paraṃpravakṣyāmi pratimānāntu piṇḍikām / dairghyeṇa pratimātulyā tadardhena tu vistṛtā
ucchritāyāmatordhena suvistārārdhabhāgataḥ / tṛtīyena tu vā tulyaṃ(2) tattribhāgeṇa mekhalā
khātaṃ ca tatpramāṇaṃ tu kiñciduttarato natam / vistārasya caturthena praṇālasya vinirgamaḥ
samūlasya vistāramagre kuryāttadardhataḥ / vistārasya tṛtīyena toyamārgantu kārayet
piṇḍikārdhena vā tulyaṃ(3) dairghyamīśasya(4) kīrtitam / īśaṃ vā(5) tulyadīrghañca jñātvā sūtraṃ prakalpayet

1 bhujārdhapañcamāṃśeneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tribhāgena tu bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 dairghyaṃ kuśasyeti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 kuśambāhulyadīrghañceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 157 ucchrāyaṃ pūrvavat kuryādbhāgaṣoḍaśasaṅkhyayā / adhaḥ ṣaṭkaṃ dvibhāgantu kaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttribhāgakam
śeṣāstvekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ pratiṣṭhānirgamās tathā / paṭṭikā piṇḍikā ceyaṃ sāmānyapratimāsu ca
prāsādadvāramānena pratimādvāramucyate(1) / gajavyālakasaṃyuktā prabhā syāt pratimāsu ca
piṇḍikāpi yathāśobhaṃ kartavyā satataṃ hareḥ / sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śiṣṇūktaṃ mānamucyate / devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ lakṣmyuktaṃ mānamucyate
dikpālayāgakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ vakṣye pratimātmā tu pūruṣaḥ / prakṛtiḥ piṇḍikā lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhā yogakastayoḥ
icchāphalārthibhistasmātpratiṣṭhā kriyate naraiḥ / garbhasūtraṃ tu niḥsārya(2) prāsādasyāgrato guruḥ
aṣṭaṣoḍaśaviṃśāntaṃ maṇḍapañcādhamādikam / snānaṃ kalaśārthañca yāgadravyārthamardhataḥ

tribhāgeṇārdhabhāgena vediṃ kuryāttu śobhanām / 1 pratimādravyamucyate iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 garbhasūtrantu nirmāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 158 kalaśair ghaṭikābhiś ca vitānādyaiś ca bhūṣayet
pañcagavyena samprokṣya sarvadravyāṇi dhārayet / alaṅkṛto gururviṣṇuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ prapūjayet
aṅgulīyaprabhṛtibhirmūrtipān valayādibhiḥ / kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthāpayecca mūrtipāṃstatra pāragān
catuṣkoṇe cārdhakoṇe vartule padmasannibhe / pūrvādau toraṇārthantu pippaloḍumbarau vaṭaṃ
plakṣaṃ suśobhanaṃ pūrvaṃ subhadrandakṣatoraṇaṃ / sukarma ca suhotrañca āpye saumye samucchrayam
pañcahastaṃ tu saṃsthāpya syonāpṛthvīti pūjayet / toraṇastambhamūle tu kalaśānmaṅgalāṅkurān
pradadyādupariṣṭācca kuryāccakraṃ sudarśanaṃ / pañcahastapramāṇantu dhvajaṃ kuryāddvicakṣaṇaḥ
vaipulyaṃ cāsya kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṅgulasanmitaṃ / saptahastocchritaṃ vāsya kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ surottama(1)
aruṇogninibhaś caiva kṛṣṇaḥ śuklotha pītakaḥ / raktavarṇas tathā śvetaḥ śvetavarṇādikakramāt(2)
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ / śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ
pūjyā koṭiguṇair yuktāḥ pūrvādyā dhvajadevatāḥ / jalāḍhakasupūrāstu pakvavimbopamā ghaṭāḥ

1 samāhita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śvetavarnakramāt dhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 159 aṣṭāviṃśādhikaśataṃ kālamaṇḍanavarjitāḥ / sahiraṇyā vastrakaṇṭhāḥ sodakāstoraṇādvahiḥ
ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāś ca pūrvādau vedikāyāś ca koṇagān / caturaḥ sthāpayet kumbhānājighreti ca mantrataḥ
kumbheṣvāvāhya śakrādīn pūrvādau pūjayet kramāt / indrāgaccha devarāja vajrahasta gajasthita
pūrvadvārañca me rakṣa devaiḥ saha namostu te / trātāramindramantreṇa arcayitvā yajed budhaḥ
āgacchāgre śaktiyuta(1) cchāgastha balasaṃyuta / rakṣāgneyīṃ diśaṃ devaiḥ pūjāṃ gṛha namostu te
agnimūrdhetimantreṇa(2) yajedvā āgneya namaḥ / mahiṣastha yamāgaccha daṇḍahasta mahābala
rakṣa tvaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vaivasvata namostu te / vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanamityanena yajedyamaṃ
nairṛtāgaccha khaḍgāḍhya balavāhanasaṃyuta(3) / idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ nairṛtīṃ diśaṃ
eṣa te nairṛte mantreṇa yajedarghyādibhir naraḥ / makarārūḍha varuṇa pāśahasta mahābala
āgaccha paścimaṃ dvāraṃ rakṣa rakṣa namostu te / uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaṃ yajedarghyādibhirguruḥ
āgaccha vāyo sabala dhvajahasta savāhana / vāyavyaṃ rakṣa devaistvaṃ samarudbhir namostu te

1 śaktihasta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 agnimūrdhveti arghyādyair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 naravāhanasaṃyuta iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 160 vāta ity ādibhiścārvedonnamo vāyavepi vā / āgaccha soma sabalā gadāhasta savāhana
rakṣa tvamuttaradvāraṃ sakuvera namostu te / somaṃ rājānamiti vā yajetsomāya vai namaḥ
āgaccheśāna sabala śūlahasta vṛṣasthita / yajñamaṇḍapasyaiśānīṃ diśaṃ rakṣa namostu te
īśānamasyeti yajedīśānāya namopi vā / brahmannāgaccha haṃsastha sruksruvavyagrahastaka
salokordhvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣa yajñasyāja namostu te / hiraṇyagarbheti yajennamaste brahmaṇepi vā
anantāgaccha cakrāḍhya kūrmasthāhigaṇeśvara / adhodiśaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ananteśa namostu te / namostu sarpeti yajedanantāya namopi vā
kumbhādhivāsavidhiḥ bhagavānuvāca bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryāt kṣipedbrīhīṃś ca sarṣapān / nārasiṃhena rakṣoghnān prokṣoghnān prokṣayet pañcagavyataḥ
bhūmiṃ ghaṭe tu sampūjya saratne sāṅgakaṃ hariṃ / astramantreṇa karakaṃ(1) tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ yajet
acchinnadhārayā siñcan brīhīn saṃskṛtya dhārayet / 1 astramantreṇa kavacamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 161 pradakṣiṇaṃ paribhrāmya kalaśaṃ vikiropari
savastre kalaśe bhūyaḥ pūjayedacyutaṃ śriyaṃ / yoge yogeti mantreṇa nyasecchayyāntu maṇḍale
kuśopari tūlikāñca śayyāyāṃ digvidikṣu ca / vidyādhipān yajedviṣṇuṃ madhughātaṃ trivikramaṃ
vāmanaṃ dikṣu vāyvādau(1) śrīdharañca hṛṣīkapaṃ / padmanābhaṃ dāmodaramaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇḍape
abhyarcya paścādaiśānyāṃ catuṣkumbhe(2) savedike / snānamaṇḍaṣake sarvadravyāṇyānīya nikṣipet
snānakumbheṣu kumbhāṃstāṃś caturdikṣvadhivāsayet / kalaśāḥ sthāpanīyāstu abhiṣekārthamādarāt
vaṭodumbarakāśvatthāṃś campakāśokaśrīdrumān(3) / palāśārjunaplakṣāṃstu kadambavakulāmrakān
pallavāṃstu samānīya pūrvakumbhe(4) vinikṣipet / padmakaṃ rocanāṃ dūrvāṃ darbhapiñjalameva ca
jātīpuṣpaṃ kundapuṣpacandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ / siddhārthaṃ tagarañcaiva taṇḍulaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset
savarṇaṃ rajatañcaiva kūladvayamṛdantathā / nadyāḥ samudragāminyā viśeṣāt jāhnavīmṛdaṃ
gomayañca yavān śālīṃstilāṃś caivāpare nyaset / viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmalatāṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ śatāvarīṃ

1 dikṣu vahnyādāviti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 catustambhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 padmakāśokaśrīdrumāniti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 parṇakumbha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 162 sahadevāṃ mahādevīṃ(1) balāṃ vyaghrīṃ salakṣmaṇāṃ / aiśānyāmapare kumbhe maṅgalyānviniveśayet
valmīkamṛttikāṃ saptasthānotthāmapare nyaset / jāhnavīvālukātoyaṃ vinyasedapare ghaṭe
varāhavṛṣanāgendraviṣāṇoddhṛtamṛttikāṃ / mṛttikāṃ padmamūlasya kuśasya tvapare nyaset
tīrthaparvatamṛdbhiś ca yuktamapyapare nyaset / nāgakeśarapuṣpañca kāśmīramapare nyaset
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ caivāpare nyaset / vaidūryaṃ vidrumaṃ muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vajrameva ca
etānyekatra nikṣipya sthāpayeddevasattama / nadīnadataḍāgānāṃ salilair aparaṃ nyaset
ekāśītipade cānyānmaṇḍape kalaśān nyaset / gandhodakādyaiḥ sampūrṇān śrīsūktenābhimantrayet
yavaṃ siddhārthakaṃ gandhaṃ kuśāgraṃ cākṣataṃ tathā / tilān phalaṃ tathā puṣpamarghyārthaṃ pūrvato nyaset
padmaṃ śyāmalatāṃ dūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ kuśāṃstathā / pādyārthaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge madhuparkaṃ tu dakṣiṇe(2)
kakkolakaṃ lavaṅgañca tathā jātīphalaṃ śubhaṃ / uttare hy ācamanāya agnau dūrvākṣatānvitaṃ
pātraṃ nīrājanārthaṃ ca tathodvartanamānile / gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ pātrake nyaset

1 sahadevāṃ siṃhapucchīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sahadevāṃ javāṃ siṃhīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 madhuparkantu paścime iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 163 murāmāṃsī cāmalakaṃ sahadevāṃ niśādikaṃ / ṣaṣṭidīpānnyasedaṣṭau nyasennīrājanāya ca
śaṅkhaṃ cakrañca śrīvatsaṃ kuliśaṃ paṅkajādikaṃ / hemādipātre kṛtvā tu nānāvarṇādipuṣpakaṃ
snānādividhiḥ bhagavānuvāca aiśānyāṃ janayet kuṇḍaṃ gururvahniñca vaiṣṇavaṃ / gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sampātavidhinā ghaṭān
prokṣayet kāruśālāyāṃ śilpibhirmūrtipair vrajet / tūryaśabdaiḥ kautukañca bandhayeddakṣiṇe kare
viṣṇave śipiviṣṭeti ūrṇāsūtreṇa sarṣapaiḥ / paṭṭavastreṇa kartavyaṃ deśikasyāpi kautukaṃ
maṇḍape(1) pratimāṃ sthāpya savastrāṃ pūjitān stuvan / namastercye sureśāni praṇīte viśvakarmaṇā
prabhāvitāśeṣajagaddhātri tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ / tvayi sampūjayāmīśe nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ
rahitā śilpidoṣaistvamṛddhiyuktā sadā bhava / evaṃ vijñāpya pratimāṃ nayettāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ
śilpinantoṣayeddravyair gurave gāṃ pradāpayet / citraṃ deveti mantreṇa netre conmīlayettataḥ
1 maṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 164 agnirjyotīti dṛṣṭiñca dadyādvai bhadrapīṭhake / tataḥ śuklāni puṣpāṇi ghṛtaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tathā
dūrvāṃ kuśāgraṃ devasya dadyācchirasi deśikaḥ / madhuvāteti mantreṇa netre cābhyañjayedguruḥ
hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa imaṃ meti ca kīrtayet / ghṛtenābhyañjayet paścāt paṭhan ghṛtavatīṃ punaḥ
masūrapiṣṭe nodvartya(1) ato deveti kīrtayan / kṣālayeduṣṇatoyena sapta te 'greti deśikaḥ
drupadādivetyanulimpedāpo hi ṣṭheti secayet / nadījaistīrthajaiḥ snānaṃ pāvamānīti ratnajaiḥ
samudraṃ gaccha candanaistīrthamṛtkalaśena ca / śanno devīḥ snāpayecca gāyatryāpyuṣṇavāriṇā(2)
pañcamṛddhirhiraṇyeti snāpayetparameśvaraṃ / sikatādbhirirmaṃ meti valmīkodaghaṭena ca
