tadviṣṇoriti oṣadhyadbhiryā oṣadhīti mantrataḥ / yajñāyajñeti kāṣāyaiḥ pañcabhirgavyakaistataḥ
payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mantreṇa yāḥ phalinī phalāmbubhiḥ / viśvataś cakṣuḥ saumyena pūrveṇa kalasena ca
somaṃ rājānamityevaṃ viṣṇo rarāṭaṃ dakṣataḥ / haṃsaḥ śuciḥ paścimena kuryādudvartanaṃ hareḥ
mūrdhānandivamantreṇa dhātrīṃ māṃsīṃ ca ke dadet(3) / mānastoketi mantreṇa gandhadvāreti gandhakaiḥ

1 mayūrapicchenodvartya iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gāyatryā gandhavāriṇā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 dhātrīmāṃsyudakena ceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 165 idamāpeti ca ghaṭair etāśītipadasthitaiḥ / ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrāhakāraka
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namostu te / anenāvāhya deveśaṃ kuryāt kautukamocanaṃ
muñcāmi tveti sūktena deśikasyāpi mocayet / hiraṇmayena pādyaṃ dadyādato deveti cārghyakaṃ
madhuvātā madhuparkaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi cācamet / akṣannamīmadanteti kireddarvākṣataṃ budhaḥ
kāṇḍānnirmañchanaṃ kuryādgandhaṃ gandhavatīti ca / unnayāmīti(1) mālyañca idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pavitrakaṃ
vṛhaspate vastrayugmaṃ vedāhamityuttarīyakaṃ / mahāvratena sakalīpuṣpaṃ cauṣadhayaḥ kṣipet
dhūpaṃ dadyāddhūrasīti vibhrāṭsūktena cāñjanaṃ / yuñjantīti ca tilakaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭveti mālyakaṃ
indracchatreti chatrantu ādarśantu virājataḥ / cāmarantu vikarṇena bhūṣāṃ rathantareṇa ca
vyajanaṃ vāyudaivatyair muñcāmi tveti puṣpakaṃ / vedādyaiḥ saṃstutiṃ kuryāddhareḥ puruṣasūktataḥ
sarvametatsamaṃ kuryāt piṇḍikādau harādike / devasyotthānasamaye sauparṇaṃ sūktamuccaret
uttiṣṭheti samutthāpya śayyāyā maṇḍape nayet / śākunenaiva sūktena devaṃ brahmarathādinā
ato deveti sūktena prātimāṃ piṇḍikāṃ tathā / śrīsūktena ca śayyāyāṃ viṣṇostu śakalīkṛtiḥ
1 tattvāyāmīti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 166 mṛgarājaṃ vṛṣaṃ nāgaṃ vyajanaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā / vaijayantīṃ tathā bherīṃ dīpamityaṣṭamaṅgalaṃ
darśayedaśvasūktena pādadeśe tripāditi / ukhāṃ pidhānakaṃ pātramambikāṃ darvikāṃ dadet
muṣalolūkhalaṃ dadyācchilāṃ sammārjanīṃ tathā / tathā bhojanabhāṇḍāni gṛhopakāraṇāni ca
śirodeśe ca nidrākhyaṃ vastraratnayutaṃ ghaṭaṃ / khaṇḍakhādyaiḥ pūrayitvā snapanasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
adhivāsanakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca hareḥ sānnidhyakaraṇamadhivāsanamucyate / sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ dhyātvā ātmānaṃ puruṣottamaṃ
oṃkāreṇa samāyojya cicchaktimabhimāninīṃ(1) / niḥsāryātmaikatāṃ kṛtvā svasmin(2) sarvagate vibhau
yojayenmarutāṃ pṛthvīṃ vahnivījena dīpayet / saṃharedvāyunā cāgniṃ vāyumākāśato nayet
1 matiśālinīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 kṛtvā puṃsīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 167 adhibhūtādidevaistu sādhyākhyair vibhavaiḥ(1) saha / tanmātrapātrakān kṛtvā saṃharettat kramād budhaḥ
ākāśaṃ manasāhatya manohaṅkaraṇe kuru(2) / ahaṅkārañca mahati tañcāpyavyākṛte nayet
avyākṛtaṃ jñānarūpe vāsudevaḥ sa īritaḥ(3) / sa tāmavyākṛtiṃ māyāmabhyaṣṭa sisṛkṣayā
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saṃ śabdātmā sparśākhyamasṛjat prabhuḥ / kṣobhya māyāṃ sa pradyumnaṃ tejorūpaṃ sa cāsṛjat
aniruddhaṃ rasamātraṃ brahmāṇaṃ gandharūpakaṃ / aniruddhaḥ sa ca brahmā apa ādau sasarja ha
tasmin hiraṇmayañcāṇḍaṃ so 'sṛjat pañcabhūtavat / tasmin saṅkrāmite jīve(4) śaktirātmopasaṃhṛtā
prāṇo jīvena saṃyukto vṛttimāniti śabdyate / jīvovyāhṛtisañjñastu prāṇeṣvādhyātmikaḥ smṛtaḥ
prāṇair yuktā tato buddhiḥ sañjātā cāṣṭamūrtikī(5) / ahaṅkārastato jajñe manastasmādajāyata
arthāḥ prajajñire pañca saṅkalpādiyutāstataḥ / śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca raso gandha iti smṛtā

jñānaśaktiyutānyetair ārabdhānīndriyāṇi tu / 1 sādhyārthair vibhavair iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ sādhyādyair vibhavair iti ṅa, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 manasāhṛtya mano 'haṅkaraṇe kṣare iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vāsudeve samāhita iti ṅa, iti cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 saṅkramate jīva iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 cāṣṭavṛttikīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 168 tvakśrotraghrāṇacakṣūṃṣi jihvābuddhīndriyāṇi tu
pādau pāyuḥs tathā pāṇī vāgupasthaś ca pañcamaḥ / karmendriyāṇi caitāni pañcabhūtānyataḥ śṛṇu
ākāśavāyutejāṃsi salilaṃ pṛthivī tathā / sthūlamebhiḥ śarīrantu sarvādhāraṃ prajāyate
eteṣāṃ vācakā mantrā nyāsāyocyanta uttamāḥ / jīvabhūtaṃ makārantu devasya(1) vyāpakaṃ nyaset
prāṇatattvaṃ bhakārantu jīvopādhigataṃ nyaset / hṛdayasthaṃ bakārantu buddhitattvaṃ nyased budhaḥ
phakāramapi tatraiva ahaṅkāramayaṃ nyaset / manastattvaṃ pakārantu nyasetsaṅkalpasambhavaṃ
śabdatanmātratattvantu nakāraṃ mastake nyaset / sparśātmakaṃ dhakārantu vaktradeśe tu vinyaset
dakāraṃ rūpatattvantu hṛddeśe viniveśayet(2) / thakāraṃ vastideśe tu rasatanmātrakaṃ nyaset
takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ jaṅghayorviniveśayet / ṇakāraṃ śrotrayor nyasya ḍhakāraṃ vinyasettvaci
ḍakāraṃ netrayugme tu rasanāyāṃ ṭhakārakaṃ / ṭakāraṃ nāsikāyāntu ñakāraṃ vāci vinyaset
jhakāraṃ karayor nyasya pāṇitattvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ / jakāraṃ padayor nyasya chaṃ pāyau camupasthake
vinyaset pṛthivītattvaṃ ṅakāraṃ pādayugmake / vastau ghakāraṃ gaṃ tattvaṃ taijasaṃ hṛdi vinyaset
1 makārantaddehasyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 viniyojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 169 khakāraṃ vāyutattvañca nāsikāyāṃ niveśayet / kakāraṃ vinyasennityaṃ khatattvaṃ mastake budhaḥ
hṛtpuṇḍarīke vinyasya yakāraṃ sūryadaivataṃ / dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayādabhiniḥsṛtāḥ
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ makāraṃ tatra vinyaset / tanmadhye cintayenmantrī vinduṃ vahnestu maṇḍalaṃ
hakāraṃ(1) vinyasettatra praṇavena surottamaḥ / oṃ āṃ parameṣṭhyātmane āṃ namaḥ puruṣātmane
oṃ vāṃ manonivṛttyātmane nāñca viśvātmane namaḥ / oṃ vaṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ pañca śaktayaḥ(2)
sthāne tu prathamā yojyā dvitīyā āsane matā / tṛtīyā śayane tadvaccaturthī pānakarmaṇi(3)
pratyarcāyāṃ(4) pañcamī syātpañcopaniṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ / hūṅkāraṃ(5) vinyasenmadhye dhyātvā mantramayaṃ hariṃ
yāṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayettasmāt(6) mūlamantraṃ nyasettataḥ / oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya mūlakaṃ
śiroghrāṇalalāṭeṣu mukhakaṇṭhahṛdi kramāt / bhujayorjaṅghayoraṅghyroḥ keśavaṃ śirasi nyaset

nārāyaṇaṃ nyasedvaktre grīvāyāṃ mādhavaṃ nyaset / 1 krūṃkāramiti ṅa, cihnitaopustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ ṣaṃ parameṣṭyātmane yannamaḥ puruṣātmane / laṃ namo viśvātmane namaḥ // naṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ pañcaśaktayaḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dānakarmaṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 abhyarcāyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 kṣakāramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 yā mūrtiḥ sthāpyate tasyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 170 govindaṃ bhujayornyasya viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye nyaset
madhusūdanakaṃ pṛṣṭhe vāmanaṃ jaṭhare nyaset / kakṣyāntrivikramaṃ nyasya jaṅghāyāṃ śrīdharaṃ nyaset
hṛṣīkeśaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ padmanābhaṃ tu gulphake / dāmodaraṃ pādayoś ca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakaṃ
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktamādirmūrtestu sattama / athavā yasya devasya prārabdhaṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavet
tasyaiva mūlamantreṇa sajīvakaraṇaṃ bhavet / yasyā mūrtestu yannāma tasyādyaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca yat
tat svairair dvādaśair bhedya hy aṅgāni parikalpayet / hṛdayādīni deveśa mūlañca daśamākṣaraṃ
yathā deve tathā dehe(1) tattvāni viniyojayet / cakrābjamaṇdale viṣṇuṃ yajedgandhādinā tathā(2)
pūrvavaccāsanaṃ dhyāyetsagātraṃ(3) saparicchadaṃ / śubhañcakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ hy upariṣṭādvicintayet
trinābhicakraṃ dvinemi svaraistacca samanvitaṃ / pṛṣṭhadeśe tataḥ prājñaḥ prakṛtyādīnniveśayet

pūjayedārakāgreṣu(4) sūryaṃ dvādaśadhā punaḥ / 1 yathā tattve tathā dehe iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 yajed gandhādinā tata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / yajedāhutibhis tathā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dhyāyet tanmātramiti ga, cihhnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / dhyāyet samātramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 pūjayed dvādaśāgreṣu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pūjayed dvādaśāreṣu iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 171 kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ somantatra vicintayet
sabalaṃ tritayaṃ nābhau cintayeddeśikottamaḥ / padmañca dvādaśadalaṃ padmamadhye vicintayet
tanmadhye pauruṣīṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvābhyarcya ca diśikaḥ(1) / pratimāyāṃ hariṃ nyasya tatra taṃ pūjayet surān(2)
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyak sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ kramāt / dvādaśākṣaravījaistu keśavādīn samarcayet
dvādaśāre maṇḍale tu laukapālādikaṃ kramāt / pratimāmarcayet paścādgandhapuṣpādibhirdvijaḥ
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śriyāḥ sūktena piṇḍikāṃ / jananādikramāt paścājjanayedvaiṣṇavānalaṃ
hutvāgniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ / agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate
dakṣiṇegniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ / agnimagnīti pūrve tu kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ
uttare praṇayedagnimagnimagnī havāmahe / agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate
palāśasamidhānāntu aṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ / kuṇḍe kuṇḍe homayecca vrīhīn vedādikais tathā
sājyāṃstilān vyāhṛtibhirmūlamantreṇa vai ghṛtaṃ / kuryāttataḥ śāntihomaṃ madhuratritayena ca
dvādaśārṇaiḥ spṛśet pādau nābhiṃ hṛn mastakaṃ tataḥ / ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo hutvā spṛśenmūrdhanyatho tataḥ

1 dhyātvā paścāttu deśika iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tatra tān pūjayet surāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 172 spṛṣṭvā śironābhipādāṃś catasraḥ sthāpayennadīḥ(1) / gaṅgā ca yamunā godā kramānnāmnā sarasvatī
dahettu viṣṇugāyatryā gāyatryā śrapayeccaruṃ / homayecca baliṃ dadyāduttare bhojayeddvijān
sāmādhipānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ hemagāṃ gurave dadet / dikpatibhyo baliṃ dattvā rātrau kuryācca jāgaraṃ / brahmagītādiśabdena sarvabhāgadhivāsanāt
vāsudevapratiṣṭhādividhiḥ bhagavānuvāca piṇḍikāsthāpanārthantu garbhāgāraṃ tu saptadhā / vibhajed brahmabhāge tu pratimāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ
devamanuṣapaiśācabhāgeṣu na kadācana / brahmabhāgaṃ parityajya kiñcidāśritya cāṇḍaja
devamānuṣabhāgābhyāṃ sthāpyā yatnāttu piṇḍikā(3) / napuṃsakakaśilāyāntu ratnanyāsaṃ samācaret

nārasiṃhena hutvā ratnanyāsaṃ(4) ca tena vai / 1 catasraḥ sthāpayecca gā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapaṭhaḥ 2 ghoṣayecca tato makhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 sthāpayedāśu piṇḍikāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 varṇanyāsamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 173 vrīhīn ratnāṃstridhātūṃś ca lohādīṃś candanādikān
pūrvādinavagarteṣu nyasen madhye yathāruci / atha cendrādimantraiś ca garto guggulunāvṛtaḥ
ratnanyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratimāmālabhedguruḥ / saśalākair darbhapuñjaiś ca sahadevaiḥ samanvitaiḥ
savāhyantaiś ca saṃskṛtya pañcagavyena śodhayet / prokṣayeddarbhatoyena(1) nadītīrthodakena ca
homārthe khaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ / sārdhahastapramāṇaṃ tu caturasraṃ suśobhanaṃ
aṣṭadikṣu yathānyāsaṃ kalaśānapi vinyaset / pūrvādyānaṣṭavarṇena agnimānīya saṃskṛtaṃ
tvamagnedyubhiriti gāyatryā samidho hunet / aṣṭārṇenāṣṭaśatakaṃ(2) ājyaṃ pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet
śāntyudakaṃ āmrapatraiḥ(3) mūlena śatamantritaṃ / siñceddevasya tanmūrdhni śrīś ca te hy anayā ṛcā
brahmayānena(4) coddhṛtya uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate / tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa prāsādābhimukhaṃ nayet
śivikāyāṃ hariṃ sthāpya bhrāmayīta purādikaṃ / gītavedādiśabdaiś ca(5) prāsādadvāri dhārayet

1 prokṣayed gandhatoyeneti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 aṣṭāntenāṣṭaśatakamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 śāntyudakamājyapātrair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 brahmapātreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 gītavādyādiśabdaiś ca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 174 strībhirviprair maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭaiḥ(1) saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ / tato gandhādinābhyarcya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ
ato deveti vastrādyamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ nivedya ca / sthire lagne piṇḍikāyāṃ devasya tveti dhārayet
oṃ trailokyavikrāntāya namastestu trivikrama / saṃsthyāpya piṇḍikāyāntu sthiraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa viśvataś cakṣurityapi / pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya kṣālya gandhadakena ca
pūjayet sakalīkṛtya sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ hariṃ / dhyāyet svaṃ tasya mūrtintu pṛthivī tasya pīṭhikā
kalpayedvigrahaṃ tasya taijasaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ / jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi pañcaviṃśatitattvagaṃ
caitanyaṃ paramānandaṃ jāgratsvapnavivarjitaṃ / dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ hṛdayeṣu vyavasthitaṃ / hṛdayāt pratimāvimbe sthiro bhava pareśvara
sajīvaṃ kuru bimbaṃ tvaṃ savāhyābhyantarasthitaḥ / aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo dehopādhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ
jyotirjñānaṃ paraṃ brahma ekamevādvitīyakaṃ / sajīvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena nibodhayet
sānnidhyakaraṇannāma hṛdayaṃ spṛśya vai japet / sūktantu pauruṣaṃ dhyāyan idaṃ guhyamanuṃ japet
namastestu sureśāya santoṣavibhavātmane / 1 maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭe iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 175 jñānavijñānarūpāya brahmatejonuyāyine
guṇātikrāntaveśāya(1) puruṣāya mahātmane / akṣayāya purāṇāya viṣṇo sannihito bhava
yacca te paramaṃ tattvaṃ(2) yacca jñānamayaṃ vapuḥ / tat sarvamekato līnamasmindehe vibudhyatāṃ
ātmānaṃ sannidhīkṛtya brahmādiparivārakān / svanāmnā sthāpayedanyānāyudhān svamudrayā
yātrāvarṣādikaṃ dṛṣṭvā(3) jñeyaḥ sannihito hariḥ / natvā stutvā stavādyaiś ca japtvā cāṣṭākṣarādikaṃ
caṇḍapracaṇḍau dvārasthau nirgatyābhyarcayedguruḥ / agnimaṇḍapamāsādya garuḍaṃ sthāpya pūjayet
digīśān diśi devāṃś ca sthāpya sampūjya deśikaḥ / viśvaksenaṃ tu saṃsthāpya śaṅkhacakrādi pūjayet
sarvapārṣadakebhyaś ca baliṃ bhūtebhya arcayet / paramavastrasuvarṇādi gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet
yāgopayogidravyādyamācāryāya narorpayet / ācāryadakṣiṇārdhantu ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadet
anyebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhojayed brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ / avāritān phalān(4) dadyādyajamānāya vai guruḥ

viṣṇuṃ nayet pratiṣṭhātā(5) cātmanā sakalaṃ kulaṃ / 1 guṇātikrāntarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 yacca te paramaṃ guhyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 yātrāvarṣādikaṃ kṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 avāritaphalamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 pratiṣṭhākṛditi kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ :p 176 sarveṣāmeva devānāmeṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ / mūlamantrāḥ pṛthakteṣāṃ śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ samānakaṃ
dvārapratiṣṭhādhvajārohāṇādividhiḥ bhagavānuvāca vakṣe cāvabhṛtasnānaṃ viṣṇor natveti(1) homayet / ekāśītipade kumbhān sthāpya saṃsthāpayeddhariṃ
pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyair baliṃ datvā guruṃ yajet / dvārapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣyāmi dvārādho hema vai dadet
aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ sthāpya śākhodumbarakau guruḥ / gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya mantrair vedādibhirguruḥ
kuṇḍeṣu homayedvahniṃ samillājatilādibhiḥ / datvā śayyādikañcādho dadyādādhāraśaktikāṃ
śākhayorvinyasenmūle devau caṇḍapracaṇdakau / ūrdhvodumbarake devīṃ lakṣmīṃ suragaṇārcitāṃ
nyasyābhyarcya(3) yathānyāyaṃ śrīsūktena caturmukhaṃ / datvā tu śrīphalādīni ācāryādestu dakṣiṇāṃ

pratiṣṭhāsiddhadvārasya tvācāryaḥ sthāpayeddhariṃ / 1 viṣṇurnuketi gha, ṅa, cihnitapurstakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 samidājyatilādibhiriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 athābhyarcyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 177 prāsādādasya pratiṣṭhantu hṛtpratiṣṭheti tāṃ śṛṇu
samāptau śukanāśāyā(1) vedyāḥ prāgdarbhamastake / sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhamathavā śuklanirmitaṃ(2)
aṣṭaratnauṣadhīdhātuvījalauhānvitaṃ śubhaṃ / savastraṃ pūritaṃ cādbhirmaṇḍale cādhivāsayet
sapallavaṃ nṛsiṃhena hutvā sampātasañcitaṃ / nārāyaṇākhyatattvena prāṇabhūtaṃ nyasettataḥ
vairājabhūtāntaṃ(3) dhyāyet prāsādasya sureśvara / tataḥ puruṣavatsarvaṃ prāsādaṃ cintayed budhaḥ
adho datvā suvarṇaṃ tu tadvavad bhūtaṃ(4) ghaṭaṃ nyaset / gurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇādeś ca bhojanaṃ
tataḥ paścādvedibandhaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kaṇṭhabandhanaṃ / kaṇṭhopariṣṭāt kartavyaṃ vimalāmalasārakaṃ
tadūrdhvaṃ vṛkalaṃ(5) kuryāccakrañcādyaṃ sudarśanaṃ / mūttiṃ śrīvāsudevasya grahaguptāṃ nivedayet
kalaśaṃ vātha kurvīta tadūrdhvaṃ cakramuttamaṃ / vedyāś ca paritaḥ sthāpyā aṣṭau vighneśvarāstvaja(6)

1 vanamālāyāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śuktinirmalamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ / śulvanirmitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vairājarūpaṃ tamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 tattvabhūtamiti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 tadūrdhvaṃ cūrṇakaṃ kuryāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / tadūrdhvaṃ culvakaṃ kuryāditi kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 6 aṣṭau vedyeśvarāstvaja iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ :p 178 catvāro vā caturdikṣu sthāpanīyā garutmataḥ / dhvajārohaṃ ca vakṣyāmi yena bhūtādi naśyati
prāsādavimbadravyāṇāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkartā viṣṇulokabhāk
kumbhāṇḍavedivimbānāṃ bhramaṇādvāyunānagha / kaṇṭhasyāveṣṭanāj jñeyaṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ dhvajāt
patākānāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi daṇḍaṃ puruṣarūpiṇaṃ / prāsādaṃ vāsudevasya mūrtibhedaṃ(1) nibodha me
dhāraṇāddharaṇīṃ(2) viddhi ākāśaṃ śuṣirātmakaṃ / tejastat pāvakaṃ viddhi vāyuṃ sparśagataṃ tathā
pāṣāṇādiṣveva jalaṃ pārthivaṃ pṛthivīguṇaṃ(3) / pratiśabdodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sparśaṃ syāt karkaśādikaṃ
śuklādikaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ rasamannādidarśanaṃ(4) / dhūpādigandhaṃ gandhantu vāg bheryādiṣu saṃsthitā
śukanāśāśritā nāsā bāhū tadrathakau smṛtau / śirastvaṇḍaṃ nigaditaṃ kalaśaṃ mūrdhajaṃ smṛtaṃ
kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhamiti jñeyaṃ skandhaṃ vedī nigadyete / pāyūpasthe praṇāle tu tvak sudhā parikīrtitā
mukhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavedasya pratimā jīva ucyate / tacchaktiṃ piṇḍikāṃ viddhi prakṛtiṃ ca tadākṛtiṃ

1 mūrtibhūtamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ viddhi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ devīmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /dhāraṇīṃ dharaṇīṃ viddhi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 pārthivaṃ pṛthivītalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pārthivaṃ pṛthivījalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 rasamāsthāya darśanaṃ rasamāhvādi darśanamiti kha, cihnitapsuatakapāṭhaḥ :p 179 niś calatvañca garbhosyā adhiṣṭhātā tu keśavaḥ / evameva hariḥ sākṣātprāsādatvena saṃsthitaḥ
jaṅghā tvasya śivo jñeyaḥ skandhe dhātā vyavasthitaḥ / ūrdhvabhāge sthito viṣṇurevaṃ tasya sthitasya hi
prāsādasya pratiṣṭhāntu dhvajarūpeṇa me śṛṇu / dhvajaṃ kṛtvā surair daityā jitāḥ śastrādicihnitaṃ(1)
aṇḍordhvaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya tadūrdhvaṃ vinyaseddhvajaṃ / vimbārdhamānaṃ daṇḍasya(2) tribhāgenātha kārayet
aṣṭāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ vā madhye mūrtimatānvitaṃ / nārasiṃhena tārkṣyeṇa dhvajadaṇḍastu nirbraṇaḥ
prāsādasya tu vistāro mānaṃ daṇḍasya kīrtitaṃ / śikharārdhena vā kuryāt tṛtīyārdhena vā punaḥ
dvārasya dairghyād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā parikalpayet / dhvajayaṣṭirdevagṛhe aiśānyāṃ vāyavethavā
kṣaumādyaiś ca dhvajaṃ kuryādvicitraṃ vaikavarṇakaṃ(3) / ghaṇṭācāmarakiṅkiṇyā bhūṣitaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ
daṇḍāgrāddharaṇīṃ yāvaddhastaikaṃ vistareṇa tu / mahādhvajaḥ sarvadaḥ syātturyāṃśāddhīnatorcitaḥ
dhvaje cārdhena vijñeyā patākā mānavarjitā / vistareṇa dhvajaḥ kāryo viṃśadaṅgulasannibhaḥ

adhivāsavidhānena cakraṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā / 1 jitāḥ śaktyādicihnitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / jitāḥ śakrādicihnitamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vimbārdhamānaṃ cakrantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vicitrañcaiva varṇakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 180 devavat sakalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ
netronmīlanakaṃ tyaktā pūrvoktaṃ sarvamācaret / adhivāsayecca vidhinā śayyāyāṃ sthāpya deśikaḥ
tataḥ sahasraśīrṣeti sūktaṃ cakre nyased budhaḥ / tathā sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ manastattvaṃ niveśayet
manorūpeṇa tasyaiva sajīvakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ / areṣu mūrtayo nyasyāḥ keśavādyāḥ surottama
nābhyabjapratinemīṣu nyasettattvāni deśikaḥ / nṛsiṃhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ vā abjamadhye niveśayet
sakalaṃ vinyaseddaṇḍe sūtrātmānaṃ sajīvakaṃ / niṣkalaṃ paramātmānaṃ dhvaje dhyāyan nyaseddhariṃ
tacchaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ dhyāyed dhvajarūpāṃ balābalāṃ(1) / maṇḍape(2) sthāpya cābhyarcya homaṃ kuṇḍeṣu kārayet
kalaśe svarṇakalaśaṃ nyasya ratnāni pañca ca / sthāpayeccakramantreṇa svarṇacakramadhastataḥ(3)
pāradena tu samplāvya netrapaṭṭena cchādayet(4) / tato niveśayeccakraṃ tanmadhye nṛhariṃ smaret
oṃ kṣoṃ nṛsiṃhāya(5) namaḥ pūjayet sthāpayeddhariṃ / tato dhvajaṃ gṛhītvā tu yajamānaḥ sabāndhavaḥ

1 calācalāmiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, sulocanamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 maṇḍale iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 svarṇacakrantu madhyata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 netraṃ yatnena cchādayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 oṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhāya nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 181 dadhibhaktayute pātre dhvajasyāgraṃ niveśayet / dhruvādyena phaḍantena dhvajaṃ mantreṇa pūjayet
śirasyādhāya tat pātraṃ nārāyanamanusmaran / pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvīta turyamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ
tato niveśayet daṇḍaṃ mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu / muñcāmi tveti sūktena dhvajaṃ muñcedvicakṣaṇaḥ
pātraṃ dhvajaṃ kuñjarādi dadyādācāryake dvijaḥ / eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ prokto dhvajasyārohaṇe vidhiḥ
yasya devasya yaccihnaṃ tanmantreṇa sthiraṃ caret / svargatvā dhvajadānāttu rājā balī bhavet
lakṣmīpratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ bhagavānuvāca samudāyena devādeḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ pravadāmi te / lakṣmyāḥ pratiṣṭhā prathamaṃ tathā devīgaṇasya ca
pūrvavat sakalaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ(1) / bhadrapīṭhe śriyaṃ nyasya sthāpayedaṣṭa vai ghaṭān(2)
ghṛtenābhyajya mūlena snapayet pañcagavyakaiḥ / hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇī netre conmīlayecchriyāḥ

1 maṇḍalasnapanādikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 sthāpayedvaruṇe ghaṭāniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 182 tanma āvaha(1) ity evaṃ pradadyānmadhuratrayam / aśvapūrveti pūrveṇa tāṃ kumbhenābhiṣecayet(2)
kāmosmiteti yāmyena paścimenābhiṣecayet / candraṃ prabhāsāmuccāryādityavarṇeti cottarāt
upaitu meti cāgneyāt kṣutpipāseti nairṛtāt / gandhadvāreti vāyavyāṃ manasaḥ kāmamākṛtim
īśānakalaśenaiva śiraḥ sauvarṇakardamāt / ekāśītighaṭaiḥ snānaṃ mantreṇāpaḥ sṛjan kṣitim(3)
ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ gandhair ārdrāmityādipuṣpakaiḥ / tanmayāvaha mantreṇa ya ānanda ṛcākhilaṃ(4)
śāyantīyena śayyāyāṃ śrīsūktena ca sannidhim / lakṣmīvījena cicchaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcayet punaḥ
śrīsūktena maṇḍapetha kuṇḍeṣvabjāni homayet / karavīrāṇi vā hutvā sahasraṃ śatameva vā
gṛhopakaraṇāntādi śrīsūktenaiva cārpayet / tataḥ prāsādasaṃskāraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat
mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhānaṃ tataḥ śriyaḥ(5) / śrīsūktena ca sānnidhyaṃ pūrvavat pratyṛcaṃ japet(6)

cicchaktiṃ bodhayitvā tu mālāt sānnidhyakaṃ caret / 1 asminnāvaha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 aśvamūrdheti mantreṇa tāṃ kumbhebhiniveśayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 mantreṇa cāsṛjat kṣitimiti kha, cihnatapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 ya ānandeti vāsasamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ sthāpayan śriya iti ṅa, cihntapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 pratyṛcaṃ yajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 183 bhūsvarṇavastragonnādi(1) gurave brahmaṇerpayet / evaṃ devyo 'khilāḥ sthāpyāvāhya svargādi bhāvayet
sudarśanacakrādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca evaṃ tārkṣyasya cakrasya brahmaṇo nṛhares tathā / pratiṣṭhā viṣṇuvat kāryā svasvamantreṇa tāṃ śṛṇu

sudarśana mahācakra śānta duṣṭabhayaṅkara / cchinda chinda bhinda bhinda vidāraya vidāraya paramantrān grasa grasa bhakṣaya bhakṣaya bhūtān trāyasa trāyasa hūṃ phaṭ sudarśanāya namaḥ || abhyarcya cakraṃ cānena raṇe dārayete ripūn

oṃ kṣauṃ narasiṃha ugrarūpa jvala jvala prajvala prajvala svāhā || narasiṃhasya mantroyaṃ pātālākhyasya vacmi te(2) / oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya pradīptasūryakoṭisahasrasamatejase vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāyaṃ sphuṭavikaṭavikīrṇakesarasaṭāprakṣubhitamahārṇavāmbhodadundubhinirghoṣāya sarvamantrottāraṇāya ehyehi bhagavannarasiṃha puruṣaparāparabrahmasatyena sphura sphura vijṛmbha vijṛmbha ākrama garja garja muñca muñca siṃhanādān vidāraya vidāraya vidrāvaya vidrāvaya āviśa 1 bhūsvarṇagavānnādi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 pātālākhyasya vakṣyate iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 184 āviśa sarvamantrarūpāṇi sarvamantrajātayaś ca hana hana chinda saṅkṣipa saṅkṣipa sara sara(1) dāraya dāraya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya jvālāmālāsaṅghātamaya sarvato 'nantajvālāvajrāśanicakreṇa sarvapātālān utsādaya utsādaya sarvato 'natajvālāvajraśarapañjareṇa sarvapātālān parivāraya parivāraya sarvapātālāsuravāsināṃ hṛdayānyākarṣaya ākarṣaya śīghraṃ daha daha paca paca matha matha śoṣaya śoṣaya nikṛntaya nikṛntaya tāvadyāvanme vaśamāgatāḥ pātālebhyaḥ phaṭ asurebhyaḥ phaṭ mantrarūpebhyaḥ phaṭ mantrajātibhyaḥ phaṭ saṃśayānmāṃ bhagavannarasiṃharūpa viṣṇo sarvāpadbhyaḥ sarvamantrarūpebhyo rakṣa rakṣa hrūṃ phaṭ(2) namo 'stu te || narasiṃhasya vidyeyaṃ harirūpārthasiddhidā(3)
trilokyamohanair mantraiḥ sthāpyastrailokyamohanaḥ / gado dakṣe śāntikaro dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ
vāmordhve kārayeccakraṃ pāñcajanyamatho hy adhaḥ / śrīpuṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ kuryād balena saha bhadrayā
prāsāde sthāpayedviṣṇuṃ gṛhe vā maṇḍape 'pi vā / vāmanaṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ hayāsyamaniruddhakaṃ
sthāpayejjalaśayyāsthaṃ matsyādīṃścāvatārakān / saṅkarṣaṇaṃ viśvarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ vai rudramūrtikaṃ
ardhanārīśvaraṃ tadvaddhariśaṅkaramātṛkāḥ / bhairavaṃ ca tathā sūryaṃ grahāṃstadvināyakam

1 dara dara iti kha, ga, ṅa, iti cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 rakṣa rakṣa oṃ phaṭ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / rakṣa rakṣa hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 harirūpā sumidvidā iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 185 gaurīmindrādikāṃ lepyāṃ(1) citrajāṃ ca balābalāṃ / pustakānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye likhanatadvidhiṃ
svastike maṇḍale 'bhyarcya śarapatrāsane sthitaṃ(2) / lekhyañca likhitaṃ pustaṃ gururvidyāṃ hariṃ yajet
yajamāno guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ lipikṛtaṃ naraṃ / prāṅmukhaḥ padminīṃ dhyāyet likhitvā ślokapañcakaṃ
raupyasthamasyā haimyā ca lekhanyā nāgarākṣaraṃ(3) / brāhmaṇān bhojayecchakyā śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ(4)
guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ prārcya purāṇādi likhennaraḥ / pūrvavanmaṇḍalādye(5) ca aiśānyāṃ bhadrapīṭhake
darpaṇe pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā secayet pūrvavad ghaṭaiḥ / netronmīlanakaṃ kṛtvā śayyāyāṃ tu nyasennaraḥ
nyasettu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ devādyaṃ tatra pustake / kṛtvā sajīvīkaraṇaṃ prārcya hutvā caruṃ tataḥ
samprāśya dakṣiṇābhistu gurvādīn bhojayeddvijān / rathena hastinā vāpi bhrāmyet pustakaṃ naraiḥ(6)
gṛhe devālayādau tu pustakaṃ sthāpya pūjayet / vastrādiveṣṭitaṃ pāṭhādādāvante samarcayet(7)

1 indrādikāṃ japyamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śarayantrāsane sthitamiti kha, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 raupyamayyātha haimyā vā lekhanyatha varākṣaramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 prāṅmukhaḥ padminīṃ dhyāyet likhitvā ca pradāpayet / brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā śaktyādadyācca dakṣiṇāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 pūrvamaṇḍapapārśve iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 pustakaṃ nara iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 ante sadārcayediti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 186 jagacchāntiñcāvadhārya pustakaṃ vācayennaraḥ / adhyāyamekaṃ kumbhādbhiryajamānādi secayet
dvijāya pustakaṃ datvā phalasyānto na vidyate / trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvīṃ sarasvatī
vidyādānaphalaṃ datvā masyantaṃ patrasañcayaṃ / yāvattu patrasaṅkhyānamakṣarāṇāṃ tathānagha
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate / pañcarātraṃ purāṇāni bhāratāni dadannaraḥ / kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya pare tattve tu līyate
kūpādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi tāṃ śṛṇu / jalarūpeṇa hi hariḥ somo varuṇa uttama
agnīṣomamayaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇurāpastu kāraṇaṃ / haimaṃ raupyaṃ ratnajaṃ vā varuṇaṃ kārayennaraḥ
dvibhujaṃ haṃsapṛṣṭhasthaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradaṃ / vāmena nāgapāśaṃ taṃ nadīnāgādisaṃyutaṃ
yāgamaṇḍapamadhye syādvedikā kuṇḍamaṇḍitā / toraṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ kumbhaṃ nyasecca karakānvitaṃ
bhadrake cārdhacandre vā svastike dvāri kumbhakān / agnyādhānaṃ cāpyakuṇḍe kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet
varuṇaṃ snānapīṭhe tu ye te śateti saṃspṛśet / ghṛtenābhyañjayet paścānmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ
śanno devīti prakṣālya śuddhavatyā śivodakaiḥ / adhivāsayedaṣṭakumbhān sāmudraṃ pūrvakumbhake
gāṅgamagnau varṣatoyaṃ dakṣe rakṣastu nairjharaṃ / nadītoyaṃ paścime tu vāyavye tu nadodakaṃ
audbhijjaṃ cottare sthāpya aiśānyāṃ tīrthasambhavaṃ / alābhe tu nadītoyaṃ(1) yāsāṃ rājeti mantrayet(2)
devaṃ nirmārjya nirmañchya durmitriyeti vicakṣaṇaḥ(3) / netre conmīlayeccitraṃ taccakṣurmadhuratrayaiḥ
jyotiḥ sampūrayeddhaimyāṃ gurave gāmathārpayet / samudrajyeṣṭhetyabhiṣiñcayedvaruṇaṃ pūrvakumbhataḥ
samudraṃ gaccha gāṅgeyāt somo dhenviti varṣakāt / devīrāpo nirjharādbhir nadādbhiḥ pañcanadyataḥ
udbhidadbhyaścodbhidena pāvamānyātha tīrthakaiḥ / āpo hi ṣṭhā pañcagavyāddhiraṇyavarṇeti svarṇajāt
āpo asmeti varṣoptyair vyāhṛtyā kūpasambhavaiḥ / varuṇañca taḍāgoptyair varuṇādbhistu vaśyataḥ
āpo devīti girijair ekāśīvighaṭaistataḥ / snāpayedvaruṇasyeti tvanno varuṇā cārghyakaṃ
vyāhṛtyā madhuparkantu vṛhaspateti vastrakaṃ / varuṇeti pavitrantu praṇavenottarīyakaṃ

1 nadīkṣodamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 āsāṃ rudreti kīrtayediti ṅa, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 indriyeti vicakṣaṇa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 188 yadvāraṇyena puṣpādi pradadyādvaruṇāya tu / cāmaraṃ darpaṇaṃ chatraṃ vyajanaṃ vaijayantikāṃ
mūlenottiṣṭhetyutthāpya tāṃ rātrimadhivāsayet / varuṇañceti sānnidhyaṃ yadvāraṇyena pūjayet
sajīvīkaraṇaṃ mūlāt punargandhādinā yajet / maṇḍape(1) pūrvavat prārcya kuṇḍeṣu samidādikaṃ
vedādimantrair gandhādyāś catasro dhenavo duhet / dikṣvatho vai yavacaruṃ tataḥ saṃsthāpya homayet(2)
vyāhṛtyā vātha gāyatryā mūlenāmantrayettathā / sūryāya prajāpataye dyauḥ svāhā cāntarikṣakaḥ
tasyai pṛthivyai dehadhṛtyai iha svadhṛtaye tataḥ / iha ratyai ceha ramatyā ugro bhīmaś ca raudrakaḥ
viṣṇuś ca varuṇo dhātā rāyaspoṣo mahendrakaḥ(3) / agniryamo nairṛto 'tha varuṇo vāyureva ca
kuvera īśo 'nanto 'tha brahmā rājā jaleśvaraḥ / tasmai svāhedaṃ viṣṇuś ca tadviprāseti homayet
somo dhenviti ṣaḍ hutvā imaṃ meti ca homayet / āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhirimā rudreti homayet
daśādikṣu baliṃ dadyāt gandhapuṣpādinārcayet / pratimāṃ tu samutthāpya maṇḍale vinyased budhaḥ

pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyair hemapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt / 1 maṇḍale iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 mūle tvagnau ca homayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vāyuḥ somo mahendraka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 189 jalāśayāṃstu digbhāge vitastidvayasammitān
kṛtvāṣṭau sthaṇḍilān ramyān saikatān deśikottamaḥ / varuṇasyeti mantreṇa sājyamaṣṭaśataṃ tataḥ
caruṃ yavamayaṃ hutvā(1) śāntitoyaṃ samācaret / secayenmūrdhni devaṃ tu sajīvakaraṇaṃ caret
dhyāyettu varuṇaṃ yuktaṃ gauryā nadanadīgaṇaiḥ / oṃ varuṇāya namo 'bhyarcya tataḥ sānnidhyamācaret
utthāpya(2) nāgapṛṣṭhādyair bhrāmayettaiḥ samaṅgalaiḥ / āpo hi ṣṭheti ca kṣipettrimadhvākte ghaṭe jale
jalāśaye madhyagataṃ suguptaṃ viniveśayet / snātvā dhyāyecca varuṇaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikāṃ
agnivījena sandagddhya tadbhasma plāvayeddharāṃ / sarvamapomayaṃ lokaṃ dhyāyet tatra jaleśvaraṃ
toyamadhyasthitaṃ devaṃ tato yūpaṃ niveśayet / caturasramathāṣṭāsraṃ vartulaṃ vā pravartitaṃ(3)
ārādhya devatāliṅgaṃ daśahastaṃ tu kūpake / yūpaṃ yajñīyavṛkṣotthaṃ mūle haimaṃ phalaṃ nyaset
vāpyāṃ pañcadaśakaraṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ tu viṃśatikaṃ / taḍāge pañcaviṃśākhyaṃ jalamadhye niveśayet
yāgamaṇḍapāṅgeṇa vā yūpabrasketi mantrataḥ (4) / sthāpya tadveṣṭayedvastrair yūpopari patākikāṃ

1 caruṃ sacamasaṃ hutveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 utthāya iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 suvartitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 yūpasthāneti mantrata iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 190 tadabhyarcya ca gandhādyair jagacchāntiṃ samācaret / dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyādbhūgohemāmbupātrakaṃ
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā āgatān bhojayettathā / ābrahmastambaparyantā ye kecitsalilārthinaḥ
te tṛptimupagacchantu taḍāgasthena vāriṇā / toyamutsarjayedevaṃ(1) pañcagavyaṃ vinikṣipet
āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śāntitoyaṃ dvijaiḥ kṛtaṃ / tīrthatoyaṃ kṣipet puṇyaṃ gokulañcārpayedvijān(2)
anivāritamannādyaṃ sarvajanyañca kārayet / aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ yaḥ samācaret
ekāhaṃ sthāpayettoyaṃ tatpuṇyamayutāyutaṃ / .vimāne modate svarge narakaṃ na sa gacchati
gavādi pivate yasmāttasmāt kartur na pātakaṃ / toyadānātsarvadānaphalaṃ prāpya divaṃ yajet
sabhāsthāpanakathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca sabhādisthānaṃ vakṣye tathaiva teṣāṃ pravartanaṃ / bhūmau parīkṣitāyāñca vāstuyāgaṃ samācaret

svecchayā tu sabhāṃ kṛtvā svecchayā sthāpayet surān / 1 toyaṃ samutsṛjedevamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gokulaṃ pāyayed dvijāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 191 catuṣpathe grāmādau(1) ca na śūnye kārayet sabhāṃ
nirmalaḥ kulamuddhṛtya kartā svarge vimodate / anena vidhinā kuryāt saptabhaumaṃ harergṛhaṃ
yathā rājñāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ pūrvādyāś ca dhvajādayaḥ / koṇabhujān varjayitvā catuḥśālaṃ tu vartayet
triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ vā ekaśālamathāpi vā / vyayādhikaṃ na kurvīta vyayadoṣakaraṃ hi tat
āyādhike bhavet pīḍā tasmāt kuryāt samaṃ dvayaṃ / kararāśiṃ samastantu kuryādvasuguṇaṃ guruḥ
saptārciṣā hṛte bhāge gargavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ / aṣṭadhā bhājite tasmin yaccheṣaṃ sa vyayo gataḥ
athavā kararāśiṃ tu hanyāt saptārciṣā budhaḥ / vasubhiḥ saṃhṛte bhāge pṛthvyādi(2) parikalpayet
dhvajo dhūmras tathā siṃhaḥ śvā vṛṣastu kharo gajaḥ / tathā dhvāṅkṣastu pūrvādāvudbhavanti vikalpayet
triśālakatrayaṃ śastaṃ udakpūrvavivarjitaṃ / yāmyāṃ paragṛhopetaṃ dviśālaṃ labhyate sadā
yāmye śālaikaśālaṃ tu pratyakśālamathāpi vā / ekaśāladvayaṃ śastaṃ śeṣāstvanye bhayāvahāḥ
catuḥśālaṃ sadā śastaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitaṃ / ekabhaumādi kurvīta bhavanaṃ saptabhaumakaṃ
dvāravedyādirahitaṃ pūraṇena vivarjitaṃ / devagṛhaṃ devatāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhinā sadā
1 pūś catuṣpathagrāmādāviti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 dhvajādi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 192 saṃsthāpya manujānāñca samudāyoktakarmaṇā / prātaḥ sarvauṣadhīsnānaṃ kṛtvā śuciratandritaḥ
madhuraistu dvijān bhojya pūrṇakumbhādiśobhitaṃ / satoraṇaṃ svasti vācya dvijān goṣṭhahastakaḥ(1)
gṛhī gṛhaṃ praviśecca daivajñān prārcya(2) saṃviśet / gṛhe puṣṭikaraṃ mantraṃ paṭheccemaṃ samāhitaḥ
oṃ nande nandaya vāśiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā saha / jaye bhārgavadāyade prajānāṃ vijayāvahe
pūrṇe 'ṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kurudhva māṃ / bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama
sarvavījauṣadhīyukte sarvaratnauṣadhīvṛte / rucire nandane nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha
prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi / subhage suvrate devi gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ
pūjite paramācāryair gandhamālyair alaṅkṛte / bhavabhūtikare devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ
avyakte vyākṛte pūrṇe muneraṅgirasaḥ sute / iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmyahaṃ
deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe / manuṣyadhanahastyaśvapaśuvṛddhikarī bhava
sādhāraṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānaṃ bhagavānuvāca samudāyapratiṣṭhāñca vakṣye sā vāsudevavat / ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve 'śvinau tathā
ṛṣayaś ca tathā sarve vakṣye teṣāṃ viśeṣakaṃ / yasya devasya yannāma tasyādyaṃ gṛhya cākṣaraṃ
mātrābhirbhedayitvā tu dīrghāṇyaṅgāni bhedayet(1) / prathamaṃ kalpayedvījaṃ savinduṃ praṇavaṃ natiṃ(2)
sarveṣāṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjanaṃ sthāpanaṃ tathā / niyamavratakṛcchrāṇāṃ maṭhasaṅkramaveśmanāṃ
māsopavāsaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ity ādisthāpanaṃ vade / śilāṃ pūrṇaghaṭaṃ kāṃsyaṃ sambhāraṃ sthāpayettataḥ
brahmakūrcaṃ samāhṛtya śraped yavamayaṃ caruṃ / kṣīreṇa kapilāyāstu tadviṣṇoriti sādhakaḥ
praṇavenābhighāryaiva darvyā saṅghaṭṭayettataḥ / sādhayitvāvatāryātha viṣṇumabhyarcya homayet
vyāhṛtā caiva gāyatryā tadviprāseti homayet / viśvataś cakṣurvedyair bhūragnaye tathaiva ca
sūryāya prajāpataye antarikṣāya homayet / dyauḥ svāhā brahmaṇe svāhā pṛthivī mahārājakaḥ

tasmai somañca rājānaṃ indrādyair homamācaret / 1 aṅgāni kalpayediti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 praṇavaṃ gatimiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 194 evaṃ hutvā(1) carorbhāgān dadyāddigbalimādarāt
samidho 'ṣṭaśataṃ hutvā pālāśāṃścājyahomakaṃ / kuryāt puruṣasūktena irāvatī tilāṣṭakaṃ
hutvā tu brahmaviṣṇvīśadevānāmanuyāyināṃ / grahāṇāmāhutīrhutvā lokeśānāmatho punaḥ
parvatānāṃ nadīnāñca samudrāṇāṃ tathā.ahutīḥ / hutvā ca vyāhṛtīrdaddyāt sruvapūrṇāhutitrayaṃ
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena pitāmaha / pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ prāśya datvācāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ
tilapātraṃ hemayuktaṃ savastraṃ gāmalaṅkṛtāṃ / prīyatāṃ bhagavān viṣṇurityutsṛjedvrataṃ budhaḥ
māsopavāsāderanyāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi pūrṇataḥ / yajñenātoṣya deveśaṃ śrapayedvaiṣṇavaṃ caruṃ
tilataṇḍulanīvāraiḥ śyāmākair athavā yavaiḥ / ājyenādhārya cottārya homayenmūrtimantrakaiḥ

viṣṇvādīnāṃ māsapānāṃ tadante homayet punaḥ / oṃ viṣṇave svāhā / oṃ viṣṇave(2) nibhūyapāya svāhā / oṃ viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya svāhā / oṃ narasiṃhāya svāhā / oṃ puruṣottamāya svāhā dvādaśāśvatthasamidho homayedghṛtasamplutāḥ

viṣṇo rarāṭamantreṇa tato dvādaśa cāhutīḥ / 1 evaṃ datvā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / etān datvā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ viṣṇave pravṛṣāya svāhā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 195 idaṃ viṣṇurirāvatī carordvādaśa āhutīḥ
hutvā cājyāhutīstadvattadviprāseti homayet / śeṣahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyāt pūrṇāhutitrayaṃ
yuñjatetyanuvākantu(1) japtvā prāśīta vai caruṃ / praṇavena svaśabdānte kṛtvā pātre tu paippale
tato māsādhipānāntu viprān dvādaśa bhojayet / trayodaśa gurustatra tebhyo dadyāttrayodaśa
kumbhān svādvambusaṃyuktān(2) sacchatropānahānvitān /
gāvaḥ prītiṃ samāyāntu pracarantu praharṣitāḥ / iti gopathamutsṛjya yūpaṃ tatra niveśayet
daśahastaṃ prapā.arāmamaṭhasaṅkramaṇādiṣu / gṛhe ca homamevantu kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathāvidhi
pūrvoktena vidhānena praviśecca gṛhaṃ gṛhī / anivāritamannādyaṃ sarveṣveteṣu kārayet
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ / ārāmaṃ kārayedyastu nandane sa ciraṃ vaset
maṭhapradānāt svarloke śakraloke vasettataḥ / prapādānādvāruṇena saṅkrameṇa vaseddivi
iṣṭakāsetukārī ca goloke mārgakṛdgavāṃ / niyamavratakṛdviṣṇuḥ kṛcchrakṛtsarvapāpahā

gṛhaṃ datvā vasetsvarge yāvadābhūtasamplavaṃ / 1 añjatetyanuvākastu iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 svādvannasaṃyuktāniti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ :p 196 samudāyapratiṣṭheṣṭā śivādīnāṃ gṛhātmanāṃ
jīrṇoddhāravidhānaṃ bhagavānuvāca jīrṇāddhāravidhiṃ vakṣye bhūṣitāṃ snapayedguruḥ(1) / acalāṃ vinyasedgehe atijīrṇāṃ parityajet
vyaṅgāṃ bhagnāṃ ca śailāḍhyāṃ nyasedanyāṃ ca pūrvavat / saṃhāravidhinā tatra tattvān saṃhṛtya deśikaḥ
sahasraṃ nārasiṃhena hutvā tāmuddhared guruḥ / dāravīṃ dārayedvahnau śailajāṃ prakṣipejjale
dhātujāṃ ratnajāṃ vāpi agādhe vā jale 'mbudhau / yānamāropya jīrṇāṅgaṃ chādya vastrādinā nayet
vāditraiḥ prakṣipettoye gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet / yatpramāṇā ca yaddravyā tanmānāṃ sthāpayeddine / kūpavāpītaḍāgāderjīrṇoddhāre mahāphalaṃ
yātrotsavavidhikathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca vakṣye vidhiṃ cotsavasya sthāpite tu sure caret / tasminnabde caikarātraṃ trirātrañcāṣṭarātrakaṃ
utsavena vinā yasmāt sthāpanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet / ayane viṣuve cāpi śayanopavane gṛhe(1)
kārakasyānukūle vā yātrāndevasya kārayet / maṅgalāṅkuraropaistu gītanṛtyādivādyakaiḥ
śarāvaghaṭikāpālīstvaṅkurārohaṇe hitāḥ / yavāñchālīṃstilān mudgān godhūmān sitasarṣapān
kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvān kṣālayitvā tu vāpayet / pūrvādau ca baliṃ dadyāt bhraman dīpaiḥ puraṃ niśi
indrādeḥ kumudādeś ca sarvabhūtebhya eva ca / anugacchanti te tatra pratirūpadharāḥ punaḥ
pade pade 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ / āgatya devatāgāraṃ devaṃ vijñāpayed guruḥ
tīrthayātrā tu yā deva śvaḥ kartavyā surottama / tasyārambhamanujñātumarhase deva sarvathā
devamevantu vijñāpya tataḥ karma samārabhet(2) / prarohaghaṭikābhyāntu vedikāṃ bhūṣitāṃ vrajet

1 śayanotthāpane gṛhe iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śayanotthāpane hareriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 samācarediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 198 catuḥstambhāntu tanmadhye svastike pratimāṃ nyaset / kāmyārthāṃ lekhyacitreṣu sthāpya tatrādhivāsayet
vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha kurvīta ghṛtābhyaṅgantu mūlataḥ / ghṛtadhārābhiṣekaṃ vā sakalāṃ śarvarīṃ budhaḥ
darpaṇaṃ darśya nīrājaṃ gītavādyaiś ca maṅgalaṃ / vyajanaṃ pūjanaṃ dīpaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet
haridrāmudgakāśmīraśuklacūrṇādi mūrdhni / pratimāyāś ca bhaktānāṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ dhṛte
snāpayitvā samabhyarcya yātrāvimbaṃ rathe sthitaṃ / nayedgurur nadīrnādaiśchatrādyai rāṣṭrapālikāḥ
nimnagāyojanādarvāk tatra vedīntu kārayet / vāhanādavatāryainaṃ tasyāṃ vedyānniveśayet
caruṃ vai śrapayet tatra pāyasaṃ homayettataḥ / abliṅgaiḥ(1) vaidikair mantraistīrthānāvāhayettataḥ
āpo hiṣṭhopaniṣadaiḥ pūjayedarghyamukhyakaiḥ / punardevaṃ samādāya toye kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ
snāyānmahājanair viprair vedyāmuttārya taṃ nyaset / pūjayitvā tadahnā ca prāsādaṃ tu nayettataḥ / pūjayet pāvakasthantu guruḥ syādbhuktimuktikṛt
snānavidhānaṃ agnir uvāca brahman śṛṇu pravakṣāmi snapanotsavavistaraṃ / prāsādasyāgrataḥ kumbhānmaṇḍape maṇḍale nyaset
kuryād dhyānārcanaṃ homaṃ harerādau ca karmasu / sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi homayet pūrṇayā saha
snānadravyāṇyathāhṛtya kalaśāṃścāpi vinyaset / adhivāsya sūtrakaṇṭhān dhārayenmaṇḍale ghaṭān
caturasraṃ puraṃ kṛtvā rudraistaṃ pravibhājyet(1) / madhyena tu caruṃ sthāpya pārśve paṅktiṃ pramārjayet
śālicūrṇādināpūrya pūrvādinavakeṣu ca / kumbhamudrāṃ tato badhvā ghaṭaṃ tatrānayed budhaḥ
puṇḍarīkākṣamantreṇa darbhāṃstāṃstu visarjayet / adbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaratnayutaṃ madhye nyased ghaṭaṃ
yavavrīhitilāṃś caiva nīvarān śyāmakān kramāt / kulatthamudgasiddhārthāṃstacchuktānaṣṭadikṣu ca
aindre tu navake madhye ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset / palāśāśvatthanyagrodhavilvodumbaraśīrṣāṃ
jambūśamīkapitthānāṃ tvakkaṣāyair ghaṭāṣṭakaṃ / āgneyanavake madhye madhupūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset
gośṛṅganaśvagaṅgāgajendradaśaneṣu ca / tīrthakṣetrakhaleṣvaṣṭau mṛttikāḥ syurghaṭāṣṭake
1 pravibhāvayediti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ :p 200 yāmye tu navake madhye tilatailaghaṭaṃ nyaset / nāraṅgamatha jambīraṃ kharjūraṃ mṛdvikāṃ kramāt
nārikelaṃ nyaset pūgaṃ dāḍimaṃ panasaṃ phalaṃ / nairṛte navake madhye kṣīrapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset
kuṅkumaṃ nāgapuṣpañca campakaṃ mālatīṃ kramāt / mallikāmatha punnāgaṃ karavīraṃ mahotpalaṃ
puṣpāṇi cāpye navake madhye vai nārikelakam / nādayematha sāmudraṃ sārasaṃ kaupameva ca
varṣajaṃ himatoyañca nairjharaṅgāṅgameva ca / udakānyatha vāyavye navake kadalīphalaṃ
sahadevīṃ kumārīṃ ca siṃhīṃ vyāghrīṃ tathāmṛtāṃ / viṣṇuparṇīṃ śataśivāṃ vacāṃ divyauṣadhīrnyaset
pūrvādau saumyanavake madhye dadhighaṭaṃ nyaset / patramelāṃ tvacaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bālakaṃ candanadvayaṃ
latāṃ kastūrikāṃ caiva kṛṣṇāgurumanukramāt / siddhadravyāṇi pūrvādau śāntitoyamathaikataḥ
candratāraṃ kramācchuklaṃ girisāraṃ trapu nyaset / ghanasāraṃ(1) tathā śīrṣaṃ pūrvādau ratnameva ca
ghṛtenābhyarjya codvartya snapayenmūlamantrataḥ / gandhādyaiḥ pūjayedvahnau hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret
baliñca sarvabhūtebhyo bhojayeddattadakṣiṇaḥ / devaiś ca munibhirbhūpair devaṃ(2) saṃsthāpya ceśvarāḥ

1 ghoṣasāramiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 devaiś ca munibhiḥ sārdhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / divyaiś ca balibhirdhūpair devamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 201 babhūvuḥ sthāpitvetthaṃ snapanotsavakaṃ caret / aṣṭottarasahasreṇa ghaṭānāṃ sarvabhāg bhavet
yajñāvabhṛthasnānena pūrṇasaṃsnāpanaṃ kṛtam / gaurīlakṣmīvivāhādi cotsavaṃ snānapūrvakam
vṛkṣādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ bhagavānuvāca pratiṣṭhāṃ pādapānāñca vakṣye 'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ / sarvauṣadhyudakair liptān piṣṭātakavibhūṣitān
vṛkṣānmālyair alaṅkṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet / sūcyā sauvarṇayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ karṇavedhanam
hemaśalākayāñjanañca vedyāntu phalasaptakam / adhivāsayecca pratyekaṃ ghaṭān balinivedanaṃ
indrāderadhivāso 'tha homaḥ kāryo vanaspateḥ / vṛkṣamadhyādutsṛjedgāṃ tato 'bhiṣekamantrataḥ
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiś ca vāruṇair maṅgalai ravaiḥ(1) / vṛkṣavedikakumbhakaiś ca(2) snapanaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ
tarūṇāṃ yajamānasya kuryuś ca yajamānakaḥ / bhūṣito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādgobhūbhūṣaṇavastrakaṃ
1 vāruṇamanumirvarariti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vṛkṣavedīśakumbhaistu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 202 kṣīreṇa bhojanaṃ dadyādyāvaddinacatuṣṭayaṃ / homastilādyaiḥ kāryastu palāśasamidhais tathā
ācārye dviguṇaṃ dadyāt pūrvavan maṇḍapādikam / pāpanāśaḥ parā siddhirvṛkṣārāmapratiṣṭhayā
skandāyeśo yathā prāha pratiṣṭhādyaṃ tathā śṛṇu / sūryeśagaṇaśaktyādeḥ parivārasya vai hareḥ
gaṇeśapūjāvidhiḥ aiśvara uvāca gaṇapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi nirvighnāmakhilārthadāṃ(1) / gaṇāya svāhā hṛdayamekadaṃṣṭrāya vai śiraḥ
gajakarṇine ca(2) śikhā gajavaktrāya varma ca / mahodarāya svadantahastāyākṣi(3) tathāstrakam
gaṇo guruḥ pādukā ca śaktyanantau ca dharmakaḥ / mukhyāsthimaṇḍalaṃ(4) cādhaścordhvacchadanamarcayet
padmakarṇikavījāṃś ca jvālinīṃ nandayārcayet / sūryeśā kāmarūpā ca udayā kāmavartinī

1 nirvighnāṃ pāpanāśinīmiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 balakarṇine ceti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 mahodarāye daṇḍahastāyākṣi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 mukhyāstimaṇḍalamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 203 satyāṃ ca vighnanāśā ca āsanaṃ gandhamṛttikā / yaṃ śoṣā raṃ ca dahanaṃ plavo laṃ vaṃ tathāmṛtam
lambodarāya vidmahe mahodarāya dhīmahi tanno dantī pracodayāt / gaṇapatirgaṇādhipo gaṇeśo gaṇanāyakaḥ / gaṇakrīḍo vakratuṇḍa ekadaṃṣṭro mahodaraḥ
gajavaktro lambuka kṣirvikaṭo vighnanāśanaḥ(1) / dhūmravarṇā mahendrādyāḥ pūjyā gaṇapateḥ smṛtāḥ
snānaviśeṣādikathanaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣyāmi skanda nityādyaṃ snānaṃ pūjāṃ pratiṣṭhayā / khātvāsinā samuddhṛtya mṛdamaṣṭāṅgulāṃ tataḥ
sarvātmanā samuddhṛtya punastenaiva pūrayet / śirasā payasastīre nidhāyāstreṇa śodhayet(2)
tṛṇāni śikhayoddhṛtya varmaṇā vibhajettridhā / ekayā nābhipādāntaṃ prakṣālya punaranyayā
astrābhilabdhayālabhya dīptayā sarvavigrahaṃ / niruddhākṣāṇi pāṇibhyāṃ prāṇān saṃyamya vāriṇi

nimajyāsīta hṛdyastraṃ smaran kālānalaprabhaṃ / 1 vighnarājaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 nijāstreṇa viśodhayediti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 204 malasnānaṃ viśodhayetthaṃ samutthāya jalāntarāt
astrasandhyāmupāsyātha vidhisnānaṃ samācaret / sārasvatāditīrthānāṃ ekamaṅkuśamudrayā
hṛdākṛṣya tathā snāpya punaḥ saṃhāramudrayā / śeṣaṃ mṛdbhāgamādāya praviśya nābhivāriṇi
vāmapāṇitale kuryādbhāgatrayamudaṅmukhaḥ / aṅgair dakṣiṇamekādyaṃ pūrvamastreṇa saptadhā
śivena daśadhā saumyaṃ japedbhāgatrayaṃ kramāt / sarvadikṣu kṣipet pūrvaṃ hūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā(1)
kuryācchivena saumyena śivatīrthaṃ bhujakramāt / sarvāṅgamaṅgajaptena mūrdhādicaraṇāvadhi
dakṣiṇena samālabhya paṭhannaṅgacatuṣṭayam / pidhāya khāni sarvāṇi sammukhīkaraṇena ca
śivaṃ smarannimajjeta hariṃ gaṅgeti vā smaran / vauṣaḍantaṣaḍaṅgena ke kuryādabhiṣecanaṃ
kumbhamātreṇa rakṣārthaṃ pūrvādau nikṣipejjalaṃ / snātvā rajopacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādibhiḥ
snātvā cottīrya tattīrthaṃ saṃhāriṇyopasaṃharet / athāto vidhiśuddhena saṃhitāmantritena ca
nivṛtyādiviśuddhena bhasmanā snānamācaret / śirastaḥ pādaparyantaṃ hrūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā(2)

tena kṛtvā malasnānaṃ vidhisnānaṃ samācaret / 1 krūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 krūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 205 īśatatpuruṣāghoraguhyakājātasañcaraiḥ(1)
krameṇoddhūnayenmūrdhni vaktrahṛdguhyavigrahāt / sandhyātraye niśīthe ca varṣāpūrvāvasānayoḥ
suptvā bhuktvā payaḥ pītvā kṛtvā cāvaśyakādikam / strīpunnapuṃsakaṃ śūdraṃ viḍālaśaśamūṣikam
snānamāgneyakaṃ spṛṣṭvā śucā vuddhūlakaṃ caret / sūryāṃśuvarṣasamparkaiḥ prāṅmukhenordhvabāhunā
māhendraṃ snānamaiśena kāryaṃ saptapadāvadhi / gosaṅghamadhyagaḥ kuryāt khurotkhātakareṇubhiḥ(2)
pāvanaṃ navamantreṇa snānantadvarmaṇāthavā / sadyojātādibhirmantrair ambhobhirabhiṣecanam
mantrasnānaṃ bhavedevaṃ vāruṇāgneyayorapi / manasā mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram
kurvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yat / vaiṣṇavādau ca tanmantrair evaṃ snānādi kārayet
sandhyāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrair bhinnaiḥ samaṃ guha / saṃvīkṣya triḥ pivedambu brahmatīrthena śaṅkaraiḥ
svadhāntair ātmatattvādyaistataḥ khāni spṛśeddhṛdā / śakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmena saṃsthitaḥ
triḥ samāvartayen mantrī manasā śivasaṃhitāṃ / ācamya nyasya sandhyāñca brāhmīṃ prātaḥ smarennaraḥ(3)

haṃsapadmāsanāṃ raktāṃ caturvaktrāṃ caturbhujāṃ / 1 guhyakājātasaṃravair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tatkharotkhātareṇubhiriti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 smarettata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 206 praskandamālinīṃ dakṣe vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍaluṃ
tārkṣyapadmāsanāṃ dhyāyenmadhyāhne vaiṣṇavīṃ sitāṃ / śaṅkhacakradharāṃ vāme dakṣiṇe sagadābhayaṃ
raudrīṃ dhyāyed vṛṣābjasthāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśibhūṣitāṃ / triśūlākṣadharāṃ dakṣe vāme sābhayaśaktikāṃ
sākṣiṇīṃ karmaṇāṃ sandhyāṃ(1) ātmānaṃtatprabhānugaṃ / caturthī jñāninaḥ sandhyā niśīthādau vibhāvyate
hṛdbindubrahmarandhreṣu arūpā tu pare sthitā / śivabodhaparā yā tu sā sandhyā maramocyate
paitryaṃ mūle pradeśinyāḥ kaniṣṭhāyāḥ prajāpateḥ / brāhmyamaṅguṣṭhamūlasthaṃ tīrthaṃ daivaṃ karāgrataḥ
savyapāṇitale vahnestīrthaṃ somasya vāmataḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ tu samagreṣu aṅgulīparvasandhiṣu
tataḥ śivātmakair mantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ śivātmakaṃ / mārjanaṃ saṃhitāmantraistattoyena samācaret
vāmapāṇipatattoyayojanaṃ savyapāṇinā / uttamāṅge kramānmantrair mārjanaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ
nītvā tadupanāsāgraṃ dakṣapāṇipuṭasthitaṃ / bodharūpaṃ sitaṃ toyaṃ vāmamākṛṣya stambhayet(2)
tatpāpaṃ kajjalābhāsampiṅgayāricya muṣṭinā / kṣipedvajraśilāyāntu tadbhavedaghamarṣaṇaṃ
svāhāntaśivamantreṇa kuśapuṣpākṣatānvitaṃ / śivāyārghyāñjalindatvā gāyatrīṃ śaktito japet

1 dākṣiṇyaḥ karmaṇāṃ sandhyā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 kumbhayediti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 207 tarpaṇaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devatīrthena mantrakāt / tarpayeddhauṃ śivāyeti svāhānyān svāhayā yutān
hrāṃ hṛdyāya hrīṃ śirase hrūṃ śikhāyai hraiṃ kavacāya / astrāyāṣṭau devagaṇān hṛdādityebhya eva ca
hāṃ vasubhyo 'tha rudrebhyo viśvebhyaś caiva marudbhyaḥ / bhṛgubhyo hāmaṅgirobhya ṛṣīn kaṇṭhopavītyatha
atreye 'tha vasiṣṭhāya namaścātha pulastaye(1) / kṛtave bhāradvajāya viśvāmitrāya vai namaḥ
pracetase manuṣyāṃś ca sanakāya vaṣaṭ tathā / hāṃ sanandāya vaṣaṭ sanātanāya vai vaṣaṭ
sanatkumārāya vaṣaṭ kapilāya tathā vaṣaṭ / pañcaśikhāya dyubhave saṃlagnakaramūlataḥ
sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo vauṣaṭ bhūtān devapitṝnatha / dakṣaskandhopavītī ca kuśamūlāgratastilaiḥ
kavyabālānalāyātha somāya ca yamāya ca / aryamṇe cāgnisomāya varhiṣadbhyaḥ svadhāyutān
ājyapāya ca somāya viśeṣasuravat pitṝn / oṃ hāṃ īśānāya pitre svadhā dadyāt pitāmahe(2)
śāntaprapitāmahāya tathāpretapitṝṃs tathā / pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhātha prapitāmahe
vṛddhaprapitāmahebhyo mātṛbhyaś ca svadhā tathā / hāṃ mātāmahebhyaḥ svadhā hāṃ pramātāmahebhyaś ca

vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pitṛbhyas tathā / 1 marīcaye pulastyāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 hāṃ īśānāya pitre ca sadājyāya pitāmahāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 208 sarbhebhyaḥ svadhā jñātibhyaḥ sarvācāryebhya eva ca / diśāṃ dikpatisiddhānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ graharakṣasāṃ
sūryapūjāvidhiḥ īśvara uvāca vakṣye sūryārcanaṃ skanda karāṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ / ahaṃ tejomayaḥ sūrya iti dhyātvārghyamarcayet
pūrayedraktavarṇena lalāṭākṛṣṭavindunā / taṃ saṃpūjya raveraṅgaiḥ kṛtvā rakṣāvaguṇṭhanaṃ
samprokṣya tajjalair dravyaṃ pūrvāsyo bhānumarcayet / oṃ aṃ hṛdvījādi(1) sarvatra pūjanaṃ daṇḍipiṅgalau
dvāri dakṣe vāmapārśve īśāne aṃ gaṇāya ca / agnau guruṃ pīṭhamadhye prabhūtaṃ cāsanaṃ yajet
agnyādau vimalaṃ sāramārādhyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ / sitaraktapītanīlavarṇān siṃhanibhān yajet
padmamadhye rāṃ ca dīptāṃ rīṃ sūkṣmāṃ raṃ jayāṃkramāt(2) / rūṃ bhadrāṃ reṃ vibhūtīś ca vimalāṃ raimamoghayā

roṃ rauṃ vidyutā śaktiṃ pūrvādyāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ / 1 oṃ hāṃ hṛdvījādīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 ruṃ jayāṃ kramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 209 raṃ madhye arkāsanaṃ syāt sūryamūrtiṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ
oṃ haṃ khaṃ kholkayeti yajedāvāhya bhāskaraṃ / lalāṭākṛṣṭamañjalyāṃ dhyātvā raktaṃ nyasedraviṃ
hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ(1) sūryāya namo mudrayāvāhanādikaṃ / vidhāya prītaye vimbamudrāṃ gandhādikaṃ dadet
padmamudrāṃ bilvamudrāṃ pradarśyāgnau hṛdīritaṃ / oṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ arkāya śirase tathā
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sureśāya śikhāyai(2) nairṛte yajet / huṃ kavacāya(3) vāyavye hāṃ netrāyeti(4) madhyataḥ
vaḥ astrāyeti pūrvādau tato mudrāḥ pradarśayet / dhenumudrā hṛdādīnāṃ goviṣāṇā ca netrayoḥ
astrasya trāsanī yojyā grahaṇāṃ ca namaskriyā / soṃ somaṃ buṃ budhaṃ vṛñca jīvaṃ bhaṃ bhārgavaṃ yajet
dale pūrvādike 'gnyādau aṃ bhaumaṃ śaṃ śanaiś caraṃ / raṃ rāhuṃ keṃ ketave ca gandhādyaiś ca khakholkayā
mūlaṃ japtvārghyapātrāmbu datvā sūryāya saṃstutiḥ / natvā parāṅmukhañcārkaṃ(5) kṣamasveti tato vadet

śarāṇunā phaḍantena samāhatyāṇusaṃhṛtiṃ(6) / 1 hrīṃ hraṃ hraiṃ sa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 sureśāya jvāliniśikhāyai iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 krūṃ kavacāya iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 4 hrīṃ netrāyetīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / bhāṃ netrāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 parāṅmukhañcārghyamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 śavānunā phaḍantena samāhṛtyānusaṃhatimiti kha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ / śavāṇunā phaḍantena samahatyārthaṃ saṃhatimiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 210 hṛtpadme śivasūryetisaṃhāriṇyopasaṃskṛtiṃ(1)
yojayettejaś caṇḍāya ravinirmālyamarpayet / abhyarcyaiśe(2) japāddhyānāddhomātsarvaṃ raverbhavet
śivapūjākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca śivapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi ācamya praṇavārghyavān / dvāramastrāmbunā prokṣya homādidvārapānyajet
gaṇaṃ sarasvatīṃ lakṣmīmūrdhvodumbarake yajet / nandigaṅge dakṣiṇe 'tha sthite(3) vāmagate yajet
mahākālaṃ ca yamunāṃ divyadṛṣṭinipātitaḥ / utsārya divyān vighnāṃś ca puṣpākṣepāntarikṣagān
dakṣapārṣṇitribhirghātaibhūmiṣṭhānyāgamandiraṃ / dehalīṃ laṅghayedvāmaśākhāmāśritya vai viśet
praviśya dakṣapādena vinyasyāstramudumbare / oṃ hāṃ vāstvadhipataye brahmaṇe madhyato yajet

1 saṃhāriṇyopasaṃhatamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / saṃhāriṣṇopasaṃhṛtamiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 abhyarcya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dakṣaśākhāsthite iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 211 nirīkṣaṇādibhiḥ śastraiḥ śuddhānādāya gaḍḍukān(1) / labdhānujñaḥ śivānmaunī gaṅgādikamanuvrajet
pavitrāṅgaḥ prajaptena vastrapūtena vāriṇā / pūrayedambudhau tāṃstān gayatryā hṛdayena vā
gandhakākṣata(2) puṣpādisarvadravyasamuccayaṃ / sannidhīkṛtya pūjārthaṃ bhūtaśuddhādi kārayet
devadakṣe tato nyasya saumyāsyaś ca śarīrataḥ(3) / saṃhāramudrayādāya mūrdhni mantreṇa(4) dhārayet
bhogyakarmopabhogārthaṃ pāṇikacchapikākhyayā / hṛdambuje nijātmānaṃ dvādaśāntapade 'thavā
śodhayet pañcabhūtāni sañcintya śuṣirantanau(5) / caraṇāṅguṣṭhayoryugmān śuṣirāntarvahiḥ smaret
śaktiṃ hṛdvyāpinīṃ paścāddhūṅkāre(6) pāvakaprabhe / randhramadhyasthite(7) kṛtvā prāṇarodhaṃ hi cintakaḥ
niveśayedrecakānte(8) phaḍantenātha tena ca / hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhre vibhidya ca

1 gandhakān iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / luḍḍukāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 guḍḍukākṣateti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /gaṇḍūkākṣateti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 saumyāsyaḥ svaśarīrata iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 mūrtimantreṇeti ga, gha, ṅa, cihinitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 5 svaśirastanau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 paścādoṅkāre iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 candramadhyasthite iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ cakramadhyasthite iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 8 nivodhayedrecakānte iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 212 granthīnnirbhidya hūṅkāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya jīvanaṃ / sampuṭaṃ hṛdayenātha pūrakāhitacetanaṃ
hūṃ śikhopari vinyasya śuddhaṃ vindvātmakaṃ(1) smaret / kṛtvātha kumbhakaṃ śambhau ekodghātena yojayet
recakena vījavṛttyā śive līno 'tha śodhayet / pratilomaṃ svadehe tu(2) vindvantaṃ tatra vindukaṃ
layannītvā mahīvātau jalavahnī parasparaṃ / dvau dvau sādhyau tathākāśamavirodhena tacchṛṇu
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitaṃ / haumityātmīyavījena(3) tannivṛttikalāmayaṃ
padādārabhya mūrdhānaṃ vicintya caturasrakaṃ / udghātapañcakenaiva vāyubhūtaṃ vicintayet
ardhacandraṃ dravaṃ saumyaṃ śubhrasambhojalāñchitaṃ(4) / hrīmityanena vījena pratiṣṭhārūpatāṃ gataṃ
saṃyuktaṃ rāmamantreṇa(5) puruṣāntamakāraṇaṃ / arghyañcaturbhirudghātair vahnibhūtaṃ viśodhayet
āgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tryastraṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitaṃ / hūmityanena vījena vidyārūpaṃ vibhāvayet

ghorāṇutribhirudghātair jalabhūtaṃ viśodhayet / 1 viṣṇvātmakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 svahetau tu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 haumityunnīya vījeneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /haumityāgneyavījeneti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 ardhacandraṃ tataḥ saumye śivaṃ pūrveṇa yojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 vāmaṃ mantreṇeti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vā samantreṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 213 ṣaḍasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vāyorvindubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅkitaṃ
kṛṣṇaṃ hremiti vījena jātaṃ śāntikalāmayaṃ / sañcityodghātayugmena pṛthvībhūtaṃ viśodhayet
nabhovindumayaṃ vṛttaṃ vinduśaktivibhūṣitaṃ / vyomākāraṃ suvṛttañca śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaṃ
hauṅkāreṇa phaḍantena śāntyatītakalāmayaṃ / dhyātvaikodghātayogena suviśuddhaṃ vibhāvayet
āpyāyayettataḥ sarvaṃ mūlenāmṛtavarṣiṇā(1) / ādhārākhyāmanantañca dharmajñānādipaṅkajaṃ
hṛdāsanamidaṃ(2) dhyātvā mūrtimāvāhayettataḥ / sṛṣṭyā śivamayaṃ tasyāmātmānaṃ dvādaśāntataḥ
atha tāṃ śaktimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sarvataḥ / divyāmṛtena samplāvya kurvīta sakalīkṛtaṃ
hṛdayādikarānteṣu(3) kaniṣṭhādyaṅgulīṣu ca / hṛdādimantravinyāsaḥ sakalīkaraṇaṃ mataṃ
astreṇa rakṣya prākāraṃ tanmantreṇātha tadvahiḥ / śaktijālamadhaścordhvaṃ mahāmudrāṃ pradarśayet
āpadamastakaṃ yāvad bhāvapuṣpaiḥ(4) śivaṃ hṛdi / padme yajet pūrakeṇa ākṛṣṭāmṛtasadghṛtaiḥ

śivamantrair nābhikuṇḍe tarpayeta śivānalaṃ / 1 mūlenāmṛtasecanāditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 hṛdyāsanamidamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgena iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 tāvat puṣpair iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 214 lalāṭe vindurūpañca cintayecchubhavigrahaṃ(1)
ekaṃ svarṇādipātrāṇāṃ pātramastrāmbuśodhitaṃ / vinduprasūtapīyūṣarūpatoyākṣatādinā
hṛdāpūrya ṣaḍaṅgena pūjayitvābhimantrayet / saṃrakṣya heti mantreṇa kavacena viguṇṭhayet
racayitvārghyamaṣṭāṅgaṃ secayeddhenumudrayā(2) / abhiṣiñcedathātmānaṃ mūrdhni tattoyavindunā
tatrasthaṃ yāgasambhāraṃ prokṣayedastravāriṇā / abhimantrya hṛdā piṇḍaistanutrāṇena veṣṭayet
darśayitvāmṛtāṃ mudrāṃ puṣpaṃ datvā nijāsane / vidhāya tilakaṃ mūrdhni puṣpaṃ mūlena yojayet
snāne devārcane home bhojane yāgayogayoḥ / āvaśyake jape dhīraḥ sadā vācaṃyamo bhavet
nādāntoccāraṇānmantraṃ śodhayitvā susaṃskṛtaṃ / pūjane 'bhyarcya gāyatryā sāmānyārghyamupāharet
brahmapañcakamāvartya mālyamādāya liṅgataḥ / aiśānyāndiśi caṇḍāya hṛdayena nivedayet
prakṣālya piṇdikāliṅge astratoye tato hṛdā / arghyapātrāmbunā siñcediti liṅgaviśodhanaṃ
ātamadravyamantraliṅgaśuddhau sarvān surānyajet / vāyavye gaṇapataye hāṃ gurubhyo 'rcayecchive
1 cintayet saparigrahamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 rocayeddhenumudrayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 215 ādhāraśaktimaṅkuranibhāṃ kūrmaśilāsthitāṃ / yajed brahmaśilārūḍhaṃ śivasyānantamāsanaṃ
vicitrakeśaprakhyānamanyonyaṃ pṛṣṭadarśinaḥ / kṛtatretādirūpeṇa śivasyāsanapādukāṃ
dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañcāgnidiṅmukhān / kūrpārakuṅkumasvarṇakajjalābhān yajet kramāt
padmañca karṇikāmadhye pūrvādau madhyato nava / varadābhayahastāś ca śaktayo dhṛtacāmarāḥ
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikāriṇī / balavikaraṇī pūjyā balapramathanī kramāt
hāṃ sarvabhūtadamanī keśarāgre manonmanī / kṣittyādi śuddhavidyāntu tattvavyāpakamāsanaṃ
nyaset siṃhāsane devaṃ śuklaṃ pañcamukhaṃ vibhuṃ / daśabāhuṃ ca khaṇḍenduṃ dadhānandakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ
śaktyṛṣṭiśūlakhaṭvāṅgavaradaṃ vāmakaiḥ karaiḥ / ḍamaruṃ vījapurañca nīlābjaṃ sūtrakotpalaṃ
dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetāṃ śaivīṃ mūrtintu madhyataḥ / hāṃ haṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye svaprakāśaṃ śivaṃ smaran
brahmādikāraṇatyāgānmantraṃ nītvā śivāspadaṃ / tato lalātamadhyasthaṃ sphurattārāpatiprabhaṃ
ṣaḍaṅgena samākīrṇaṃ vindurūpaṃ paraṃ śivaṃ / puṣpāñjaligataṃ dhyātvā lakṣmīmūrtau niveśayet
oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāya nama āvāhanyā hṛddā tataḥ / āvāhya sthāpya sthāpanyā sannidhāyāntikaṃ śivaṃ
nirodhayenniṣṭhurayā kālakāntyā phaḍantataḥ / vighnānutsārya viṣṭhyātha(1) liṅgamudrāṃ namaskṛtiṃ
hṛdāvaguṇṭhayet paścādāvāhaḥ sammukhī tataḥ / niveśanaṃ sthāpanaṃ syātsannidhānaṃ tavāsmi bhoḥ
ākarmakāṇḍaparyantaṃ sannedheyoparikṣayaḥ / svabhakteś ca(2) prakāśoyastadbhavedavaguṇṭhanaṃ
sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mantraiḥ ṣaḍbhirathaikatāṃ / aṅgānāmaṅginā sārdhaṃ vidadhyādamṛtīkṛtaṃ
cicchaktihṛdayaṃ śambhoḥ śiva aiśvaryamaṣṭadhā(3) / śikhāvaśitvaṃ cābhedyaṃ tejaḥ kavacamaiśvaraṃ
pratāpo duḥsahaścāstramantarāyāpahārakaṃ / namaḥ svadhā ca svāhā ca vauṣaṭ ceti yathākramaṃ
hṛtpuraḥsaramuccārya pādyādīni nivedayet / pādyaṃ pādāmbujadvandve vaktreṣvācamanīyakaṃ
arghyaṃ śirasi devasya dūrvāpuṣpākṣatāni ca / evaṃ saṃskṛtya saṃskārair daśabhiḥ parameśvaraṃ
yajet pañcopacāreṇa vidhinā kusumādibhiḥ / abhyukṣyoddhartya nirmbhañjya rājikālavaṇādibhiḥ
arghyodavindupuṣpādyair gaḍḍūkaiḥ(4) snāpayecchanaiḥ / payodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyair anukramāt

īśādimantritardravyair arcya teṣāṃ(5) viparyayaḥ / 1 choṭyātha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 abhuktejyā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 śivamaiśvaryamaṣṭadhā iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 4 gandhakair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 ity ādimantritair bhakṣyaiś caiṣāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 217 toyadhūpāntaraiḥ sarvair mūlena snapayecchivaṃ
virūkṣya yavacūrṇena yatheṣṭaṃ śītalair jalaiḥ / svaśaktyā gandhatoyena saṃsnāpya śucivāsasā
nirmārjyārghyaṃ pradadyācca nopari bhrāmayet karaṃ / na śūnyamastakaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣpaiḥ kuryāttato dadet
candanādyaiḥ samālabhya puṣpaiḥ prārcya śivāṇunā(1) / dhūpabhājanamastreṇa prokṣyābhyarcya śivāṇunā(2)
astreṇa pūjitāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ cādāya guggulaṃ dadet / dadyādācamanaṃ paścāt svadhāntaṃ hṛdayāṇunā(3)
ārātrikaṃ samuttārya tathaivācāmayet punaḥ / praṇamyādāya devājñāṃ bhogāṅgāni prapūjayet
hṛdagnau candrabhaṃ caiśe śivaṃ cāmīkaraprabhaṃ / śikhāṃ raktāñca nairṛtye kṛṣṇaṃ varma ca vāyave
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ(4) dalasthān(5) pūjayedimān / daṃṣṭrākarālamapyastraṃ pūrvādau vajrasannibhaṃ
mūle hauṃ śivāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hīṃ hoṃ śiraś ca / hṛṃ śikhāyai haiṃ varma haścāstraṃ parivārayutāya ca
śivāya dadyāt pādyañca ācāmañcārghyameva ca / gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ naivedyācamanīyakaṃ

karodvartanatāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsañca darpaṇaṃ / 1 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 hṛdayātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 caturvaktrāṃś caturbāhūn iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 5 dalāgre iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 218 śirasyāropya devasya dūrvākṣatapavitrakaṃ
mūlamaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā hṛdayenābhimantritaṃ / carmaṇāveṣṭitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rakṣitaṃ kuśapuṣpakaiḥ
akṣatair mudrāyā yuktaṃ śivamudbhavasañjñayā / guhyātiguhyaguptyarthaṃ(1) gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ
siddhirbhavatu me yena(2) tvatprasādāttvayi sthite / bhogī ślokaṃ paṭhitvādyaṃ(3) dakṣahastena śambhave
mūlāṇunārghyatoyena varahaste(4) nivedayet / yatkiñcit kurmahe deva sadā sukṛtaduskṛtaṃ
tanme śivapadasthasya hūṃ kṣaḥ kṣepaya śaṅkara / śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivaḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat
śivo jayati sarvatra yaḥ śivaḥ sohameva ca / ślokadvayamadhītyaivaṃ japaṃ devāya cārpayet
śivāṅgānāṃ(5) daśāṃśañca datvārghyaṃ stutimācaret / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nameccāṣṭāṅgañcāṣṭamūrtaye(6) / natvā dhyānādibhiś caiva yajeccitre 'nalādiṣu
agnisthāpanādividhiḥ īśvara uvāca arghapātrakaro yāyādagnyāgāraṃ susaṃvṛtaḥ / yāgopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā ca kalpayet(1)
udaṅmukhaḥ kuṇḍamīkṣet praokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃkuśaiḥ / vidadhyādastramantreṇa varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ mataṃ
khaḍgena khātamuddhāraṃ pūraṇaṃ samatāmapi / kurvīta varmaṇā sekaṃ kuṭṭanantu śarātmanā(2)
sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanaṃ / trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyarcanaṃ sadā
rekhātrayamudak kuryādekāṃ pūrvānanāmadhaḥ / kuśena ca śivāstreṇa yadvā tāsāṃ viparyayaḥ
vajrīkaraṇamantreṇa hṛdā darbhaiś catuṣpathaṃ / akṣapātrantatanutreṇa vinyasedviṣṭaraṃ hṛdā
hṛdā vāgīśvarīṃ tatra īśāmāvāhya pūjayet / vahniṃ sadāśrayānītaṃ śuddhapātroparisthitaṃ
kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ / audaryaṃ caindavaṃ bhautaṃ ekīkṛtyānalatrayaṃ
oṃ hūṃ vahnicaitanyāya vahnivījena vinyaset / saṃhitāmantritaṃ vahniṃ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtaṃ
rakṣitaṃ hetimantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhitaṃ / pūjitantriḥ paribhrāmya kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ
1 divyadṛṣṭyā vilpkayediti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 śarāṇuneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 220 śivavījamiti dhyātvā vāgīśāgarbhagocare / vāgīśvareṇa devena kṣipyamānaṃ vibhāvayet
bhūmiṣṭhajānukko mantrī hṛdātmasammukhaṃ kṣipet / tato 'ntasthitavījasya(1) nābhideśe samūhanaṃ
sambhṛtiṃ paridhānasya śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdā / garbhāgneḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tadrakṣārthaṃ śarāṇunā(2)
badhnīyādgarbhajaṃ devyāḥ kakaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇipallave / garbhādhānāya sampūjya sadyojātena pāvakaṃ
tato hṛdayamantreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayaṃ / puṃsavanāya vāmena tṛtīye yāsi pūjayet
āhutitritayaṃ dadyācchirasāmbukaṇānvitaṃ / sīmantonnayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe māsi sampūjya rūpiṇā
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ śikhayā śikhayaiva tu / vaktrāṅgakalpanāṃ kuryādvaktrodghāṭananiṣkṛtī
jātakarmanṛkarmabhyāṃ daśame māsi pūrvavat / vahniṃ sandhukṣya darbhādyaiḥ(3) snānaṃ garbhamalāpahaṃ
suvarṇabandhanaṃ devyā kṛtaṃ dhyātvā hṛdārcayet / sadyaḥsūtakanāśāya prokṣayedastravāriṇā
kumbhantu(4) vahirastreṇa tāḍayedvarmaṇokṣayet / astreṇottarapūrvāgrānmekhalāsu vahiḥ kuśān

1 tatontasthitadevasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śarātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 gandhādyair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 kuṇḍantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 221 āsthāpya(1) sthāpayetteṣu hṛdā paridhivistaraṃ / vaktāṇāmastramantreṇa tato nālāpannuttaye
samidhiḥ pañca hotavyāḥ prānte mūle ghṛtaplutāḥ / brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumanantañca hṛdārcayet
dūrvākṣataiś ca paryantaṃ paridhisthānanukramāt / indrādīśānaparyantāntānviṣṭarasthānanukramāt
agnerabhimukhībhūtān nijadikṣu hṛdārcayet / nivārya vighnasaṅghātaṃ vālakaṃ pālayiṣyatha
śaivīmājñābhimānteṣāṃ śrāvayettadanantaraṃ / gṛhītvā sruksruvāvūrdhvavadanādhomukhaiḥ kramāt
pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet / kuśaspṛṣṭapradeśe tu ātmavidyāśivātmakaṃ
kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasya hāṃ hīṃ hūṃ saṃ(2) ravaiḥ kramāt / sruvi śaktiṃ sruve śambhuṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunā
trisūtrīveṣṭitagrīvo pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ / kuśānāmupariṣṭāttau sthāpayitvā svadakṣiṇe
gavyamājyaṃ samādāya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ / svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintyādāya tadghṛtaṃ
kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ hṛdāvartya bhrāmayitvāgnigocare / punarviṣṇumayīṃ dhyātvā ghṛtamīśānagocare

dhṛtvādāya kuśāgreṇa svāhāntaṃ śirasāṇunā(2) / 1 āstīryeti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 hāṃ hrīṃ hraṃ samiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / hūṃ hāṃ krūṃ samiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 śirasātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 222 juhuyādviṣṇave vinduṃ rudrarūpamanantaraṃ
bhāvayannijamātmānaṃ nābhau dhṛtvāplavettataḥ / prādeśamātradarbhābhyāmaṅguṣṭānāmikāgrakaiḥ
dhṛtābhyāṃ sammukhaṃ vahnerastreṇāplavamācaret / hṛdātmasammukhaṃ tadvat kuryāt samplavanantataḥ
hṛdālabdhadagdhadarbhaṃ śastrakṣepāt pavitayet / dīptenāparadarbheṇa nivāhyānena dīpayet
astramantreṇa nirdagdhaṃ vahnau darbhaṃ punaḥ kṣipet / kṣiptvā ghṛte kṛtagranthikuśaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ
pakṣadvayamiḍādīnāṃ trayaṃ cājye vibhāvayet / krāmādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya homayet
svetyagnau hā ghṛte(1) bhāgaṃ śeṣamājyaṃ kṣipet kramāt / oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā / oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā udghāṭanāya netrāṇāṃ agnernetratraye mukhe
sruveṇa ghṛtapūrṇena caturthīmāhutiṃ yajet / oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā abhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgena bodhayeddhenumudrayā
avaguṇṭhya tanutreṇa rakṣedājyaṃ śarāṇunā(2) / hṛdājyavinduvikṣepāt kuryādabhyukṣya śodhanaṃ

vaktrābhighārasandhānāṃ vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ tathā / oṃ hāṃ sadyojātāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ 1 svāhetyagnau ghṛte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śarātmaneti ṇa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 223 aghorāya svāhā / oṃ tatpuruṣāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ īśānāya svāhā ityekaikaghṛtāhutyā kuryādvaktrābhighārakaṃ

auṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāghorābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ aghoratatpuruṣābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ tatpuruṣeśānābhyāṃ svāhā itivaktrānusandhānaṃ mantrair ebhiḥ kramāccaret / agrito gatayā vāyuṃ nirṛtādiśivāntayā
vaktrāṇāmekatāṃ kuryāt sruveṇa ghṛtaghārayā / oṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhā itīṣṭavaktre vaktrāṇāmantarbhāvastadākṛtiḥ
īśena vahnimabhyarcya datvāstreṇāhutitrayaṃ / kuryāt sarvātmanā nāma śivāgnistvaṃ hutāśana
hṛdārcitau visṛṣṭāgnau pitarau vidhipūraṇīṃ / mūlena vauṣaḍantena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi
tato hṛdambuje sāṅgaṃ sasenaṃ bhāsuraṃ paraṃ(1) / yajet pūrvavadāvāhya prārthyājñāntarpayecchivaṃ
yāgāgniśivayoḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamātmanā / śaktyā mūlāṇunā homaṃ kuryādaṅgair daśāṃśataḥ
ghṛtasya kārṣiko homaḥ kṣīrasya madhunas tathā / śaktimātrāhutirdadhnaḥ prasṛtiḥ pāyasyatu
yathāvat sarvabhakṣāṇāṃ lājānāṃ muṣṭisammitaṃ / khaṇḍatrayantu mūlānāṃ kalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ

1 sasenaṃ bhāskaraṃ paramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāsanaṃ bhāskaraṃ paramiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāśanaṃ bhāsraṃ paramiti ṅa cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāsanaṃ tryakṣaraṃ paramiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 224 grāsārdhamātramannānāṃ sūkṣmāṇi pañca homayet / ikṣorāparvikaṃ mānaṃ latānāmaṅguladvayaṃ
puṣpaṃ patraṃ svamānena samidhāṃ tu daśāṅgulaṃ / candracandanakāśmīrakastūrīyakṣakardamān
kalāyasammitānenān guggulaṃ vadarāsthivat / kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ juhuyādvidhivat paraṃ
homaṃ nirvartayedevaṃ brahmavījapadaistataḥ / ghṛtena sruci pūrṇāyāṃ nidhāyādhomukhaṃ sruvaṃ
srugagre puṣpamāropya paścādvāmena pāṇinā / punaḥ savyena tau dhṛtvā śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā
samudgato ardhakāyaś ca samapādaḥ samitthitaḥ / nābhau tanmūlamādhāya srugagravyagralocanaḥ
brahmādikāraṇātyāgādviniḥsṛtya suṣumṇayā(1) / vāmastanāntamānīya tayormūlamatandritaḥ
mūlamantramavispaṣṭaṃ vauṣaḍantaṃ samuccaret / tadagnau juhuyādājyaṃ yavasammitadhārayā
ācāmaṃ candanaṃ datvā tāmbūlaprabhṛtīnapi / bhaktyā tadbhūtimāvandya vidadhyātpraṇatiṃ parāṃ
tato vahniṃ samabhyarcya paḍantāstreṇa saṃvarān / saṃhāramudrayāhṛtya kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca

bhāsurān(2) paridhīstāṃś ca pūrakeṇa hṛdāṇunā(3) / 1 viniḥsṛtya svapṛṣṭayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /viniḥsṛtya svapuṣṭayā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 bhāsvarāniti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 hṛdātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 225 śraddhayā parayātmīye sthāpayeta hṛdambuje
sarvapākāgramādāya kṛtvā maṇḍalakadvayaṃ(1) / antarvahirbaliṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ kuṇḍasannidhau
oṃ hāṃ rudrebhyaḥ svāhā pūrve mātṛbhyo dakṣiṇe tathā / vāruṇe hāṃ gaṇebhyaś ca svāhā tebhyastvayaṃ baliḥ
uttare hāñca yakṣebhya īśāne hāṃ grahebhya u(2) / agnau hāmasurebhyaś ca rakṣobhyo nairṛte baliḥ
vāyavye hāñca nāgebhyo nakṣatrebhyaś ca madhyataḥ / hāṃ rāśibhyaḥ(3) svāhā vahnau viśvebhyo nairṛte yathā
vāruṇyāṃ(4) kṣetrapālāya antarbalirudāhṛtaḥ / dvitīye maṇḍale vāhye indyāyāgniyamāya ca
nairṛtāya jaleśāya vāyave dhanarakṣiṇe / īśānāya ca pūrvādau hīśāne brahmaṇe namaḥ
nairṛte viṣṇave svāhā vāyasādervahirbaliḥ / balidvayagatānmantrān saṃhāramudrayā.atmani
caṇdapūjākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca tataḥ śivāntikaṅgatvā pūjāhomādikaṃ mama / gṛhāṇa bhagavan puṇyaphalamityabhidhāya ca
arghyodakena devāya mudrayodbhavasañjñayā / hṛdvījapūrvamūlena sthiracitto nivedayet
tataḥ pūrvavadabhyarcya stutvā stotraiḥ praṇamya ca / arghyaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ datvā kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca
nārācamudrayāstreṇa phaḍantenātmasañcayaṃ / saṃhṛtya divyayā liṅgaṃ mūrtimantreṇa yojayet
sthaṇḍile tvarcite deve mantrasaṅghātamātmani / niyojya vidhinoktena vidadhyāccaṇḍapūjanaṃ
oṃ caṇḍeśānāya namo madhyataś caṇḍamūrtaye / oṃ dhūlicaṇḍeśvarāya(1) hūṃ phaṭ(2) svāhā tamāhṇayet
caṇḍahṛdayāya hūṃ phaṭ oṃ caṇḍaśirase tathā(3) / oṃ caṇḍaśikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ caṇḍāyuḥ(4) kavacāya ca
caṇḍastrāya tathā hūṃ phaṭ caṇḍaṃ rudrāgnijaṃ smaret / śūlaṭaṅkadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣasūtrakaṇḍaluṃ

ṭaṅkākare 'rdhacandre(5) vā caturvaktraṃ prapūjayet / 1 oṃ balicaṇḍeśvarāya iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 krūṃ phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 hūṃ caṇḍaśirase svāheti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 hūṃ phaṭ caṇdata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 5 ṭaṅkāreṇārdhacandre iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 227 yathāśakti japaṃ kuryādaṅgānāntu daśāṃśataḥ
gobhūhiraṇyavastrādimaṇihemādibhūṣaṇaṃ / vihāya śesanirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya nivedayet
lehyacoṣyādyanuvaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ sragvilepanaṃ / nirmālyaṃ bhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattantu śivājñayā
sarvametat kriyākāṇḍaṃ mayā caṇḍa tavājñayā / nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtaṃ mohāt paripūrṇaṃ sadāstu me
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ datvārghyaṃ tasya saṃsmaran / saṃhāramūrtimantreṇa śanaiḥ saṃhāramudrayā
pūrakānvitamūlena mantrānātmani yojayet / nirmālyāpanayasthānaṃ limpedgomayavāriṇā / prokṣyārghyādi visṛjyātha ācānto 'nyatsamācaret
kapilādipūjāvidhanaṃ īśvara uvāca kapilāpūjanaṃ vakṣye ebhirmantrair yajecca gāṃ / oṃ kapile nande namaḥ oṃ kapile bhadrike namaḥ
oṃ kapile suśīle namaḥ kapile surabhiprabhe / oṃ kapile sumanase namaḥ oṃ bhuktimuktiprade namaḥ
saurabheyi jaganmātardevānāmamṛtaprade / gṛhāṇa varade grāsamīpsitārthañca dehi me
vanditāsi vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā / kapile hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca / gāvo me hṛdaye cāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmyahaṃ
dattaṃ gṛhṇantu(1) me grāsaṃ japtvā syāṃ nirmalaḥ śivaḥ / prārcya vidyāpustakāni gurupādau namennaraḥ
yajet snātvā tu madhyāhne aṣṭapuṣpikayā śivaṃ / pīṭhamūrtiśivāṅgānāṃ pūjā syādaṣṭapuṣpikā
madhyāhne bhojanāgāre sulipte pākamānayet / tato mṛtyuñjayenaiva vauṣaḍantena saptadhā
japtaiḥ sadarbhaśaṅkhasthaiḥ siñcettaṃ vārivindubhiḥ / sarvapākāgramuddhṛtya śivāya vinivedayet
athārdhaṃ(2) cullikāhome vidhānāyopakalpayet(3) / viśodhya vidhinā cullīṃ tadvahniṃ pūrakāhutiṃ
hutvā nābhyagninā caikaṃ tato recakavāyunā / vahnivījaṃ samādāya kādisthānagatikramāt(4)
śivāgnistvamiti dhyātvā cullikāgnau niveśayet / oṃ hāṃ agnaye namo vai hāṃ somāya vai namaḥ
sūryāya vṛhaspataye prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ / sarvebhyaś caiva devebhyaḥ sarvaviśvebhya eva ca

1 dattaṃ gṛhāṇeti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 anyārdhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / antyārdhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 nidhānāyopakalpayediti ca, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 4 hṛdi sthānamatikramediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / kādisthānamatikramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 229 hāmagnaye khiṣṭikṛte pūrvādāvarcayedimān / svāhāntāmāhutiṃ datvā kṣamayitvā visarjayet
cullyā dakṣiṇabāhau ca yajeddharmāya vai namaḥ / vāmabāhāvadharmāya kāñjikādikabhāṇḍake
rasaparivartamānāya varuṇāya jalāgnaye(1) / vighnarājo gṛhadvāre peṣaṇyāṃ subhage namaḥ
oṃ raudrike namo girike(2) namaś caolūkhale yajet / balapriyāyāyudhāya namaste muṣale yajet
sammārjanyāṃ devatokte kāmāya śayanīyake / madhyastambhe ca skandāya datvā vāstubaliṃ tataḥ
bhuñjīta pātre sauvarṇe padminyādidalādike / ācāryaḥ sādhakaḥputra samayī maunamāsthitaḥ
vaṭāśvatthārkavātāvisarjabhallātakāṃstyajet / apośānaṃ purādāya prāṇādyaiḥ praṇavānvitaiḥ
svāhāntenāhutīḥ pañca datvādīpyodarānalaṃ / nāgaḥ kūrmo 'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ
etebhya upavāyubhyaḥ svāhāpoṣānavāriṇā / bhaktādikaṃ nivedyāya piveccheṣodakaṃ naraḥ
amṛtopastaraṇamasi prāṇāhutīstato dadet / prāṇāya svāhāpānāya samānāya tatas tathā

udānāya ca vyānāya bhuktvā cullakamācaret / 1 jalāśaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ raudrakoṭigirike iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ :p 230 amṛtāpiścānamasīti śarīre 'nnādivāyavaḥ(1)
pavitrārohaṇakathanaṃ īśvara uvāca pavitrārohaṇaṃ vakṣye kriyārcādiṣu pūraṇaṃ / nityaṃ tannityamuddiṣṭaṃ naimittikamathāparaṃ
āṣāḍhādicaturdaśyāmatha śrāvaṇabhādrayoḥ / sitāsitāsu kartavyaṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu tat
kuryādvā kārttikīṃ yāvattithau pratipādike / vahnibrahmāmbikebhāsyanāgaskandārkaśūlināṃ
durgāyamendragovindasmaraśambhusudhābhujāṃ(2) / sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtādiṣu yathākramaṃ
kalau kārpāsajaṃ cāpi paṭṭapadmādisūtrakaṃ / praṇavaś candramā vahnirbrahmā nāgo guho hariḥ(3)
sarveśaḥ(4) sarvadevāḥ syuḥ krameṇa navatantuṣu / aṣṭottaraśatānyardhaṃ tadardhaṃ cottamādikaṃ

ekāśītyāthavā sūtraistriṃśatāppaṣṭayuktayā / 1 śarīronmādavāyava iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 svadhābhujāmiti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 guho raviriti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ 4 sadeśa iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 231 pañcāśatā vā kartavyaṃ tulyagranthyantarālakaṃ
dvādaśāṅgulamānāni vyāsādaṣṭāṅgulāni ca / liṅgavistāramānāni caturaṅgulakāni vā
tathaiva piṇḍikāsparśaṃ caturthaṃ sarvadaivataṃ / gaṅgāvatārakaṃ kāryaṃ sujātena sudhautakaṃ
granthiṃ kuryācca vāmena aghoraṇātha śodhayet / rañjayet puruṣeṇaiva raktacandanakuṅkumaiḥ
kastūrīrocanācandrair haridrāgair ikādibhiḥ / granthayo daśa kartavyā athavā tantusaṅkhyayā
antaraṃ vā yathāśobhamekadvicaturaṅgulaṃ / prakṛtiḥ pauruṣī vīrā caturthī tvaparājitā
jayānyā vijayā ṣaṣṭhī ajitā ca sadāśivā / manonmanī sarvamukhī granthayo 'bhyadhikāḥ śubhāḥ
kāryā vā candravahnyarkapavitraṃ(1) śivavaddhṛdi / ekaikaṃ nijamūrtau vā puptake guruke gaṇe(2)
syādekaikaṃ tathā dvāradikpālakalaśādiṣu / hastādinavahastāntaṃ liṅgānāṃ syātpavitrakaṃ
aṣṭāviṃśatito yuddhaṃ daśabhirdaśabhiḥ kramāt / dvyaṅgulābhyantarāstatra kramādekāṅgulāntarāḥ
granthayo mānamapyeṣāṃ liṅgavistārasasmitaṃ / saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ

bhūṣayet puṣpavastrādyaiḥ sāyāhne yāgamandiraṃ / 1 caṇḍavahnyarkapavitramiti kha, ga, ṅa. cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 2 pustake gurave gaṇo iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 232 kṛtvā naimittikīṃ sandhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa ca tarpaṇaṃ
parigṛhīte bhūbhāge pavitre sūryamarcayet(1) / ācamya sakalīkṛtya praṇavārghyakaro guruḥ
dvārāṇyastreṇa samprokṣya pūrvādikramato 'rcayet / hāṃ śāntikalādvārāya tathā vidyākalātmane
nivṛttikalādvārāya pratiṣṭhākhyakalātmane / tacchākhayoḥ pratidvāraṃ dvau dvau dvārādhipau yajet
nandine mahākālāya bhṛṅgiṇe 'tha gaṇāya ca / vṛṣabhāya ca skandāya devyai caṇḍāya ca kramāt
nityaṃ ca dvārapālādīn praviśya dvārapaścime / iṣṭvā vāstuṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ viśeṣārghyakaraḥ śivaḥ
prokṣaṇādyaṃ(2) vidhāyātha yajñasambhārakṛnnaraḥ / mantrayeddarbhadūrvādyaiḥ puṣpādyaiś ca hṛdādibhiḥ
śivahastaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ(3) svaśirasyadhiropayet / śivo 'hamādiḥ sarvajño mama yajñapradhānatā
atyarthaṃ bhāvayeddevaṃ jñānakhadgakaro guruḥ / nairṛtīṃ diśamāsādya prakṣipedudagānanaḥ
arghyāmbu pañcagavyañca samastān makhamaṇḍape / catuṣpathāntasaṃskārair vīkṣaṇādyaiḥ(4) susaṃskṛtaiḥ

vikṣipya vikirāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(5) / 1 sūtrite sūryamarcayediti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ 2 prokṣaṇacceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vidhāyaikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 brāhmaṇādyair iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 daśakūrñcopasaṃharediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 233 tānīśadiśi(1) vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet
nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇā dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet / paścimābhimukhaṃ kumbhaṃ sarvadhānyopari sthitaṃ
praṇavena vṛṣārūḍhaṃ siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīntataḥ / kumbhe sāṅgaṃ śivandevaṃ vardhanyāmarcayet(2)
dikṣu śakrādidikpālān viṣṇubrahmaśivādikān(3) / vardhanīṃ samyagādāya ghaṭapṛṣṭānugāminīṃ
śivājñāṃ śrāvayenmantrī pūrvādīśānagocaraṃ / avicchinnapayodhārāṃ mūlamantramudīrayet
samantād bhrāmayedenāṃ rakṣārthaṃ śastrarūpiṇīṃ / pūrvaṃ kalaśamāropya śastrārthantasya(4) vāmataḥ
samagrāsanake kumbhe yajeddevaṃ sthirāsane / vardhanyāṃ praṇavasthāyāmāyudhantadanu dvayoḥ
bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā / kumbhe nivedya bodhāsiṃ mūlamantrajapantathā
taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayedapi(5) / gaṇeśaṃ vāyave 'bhyarcya haraṃ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ

snāpayet pūrvavat prārcya(6) kuṇḍe ca śivapāvakaṃ(7) / 1 anīśadiśi iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 vardhanyāṃ śastramarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 viṣṇubrahmāvasānakāniti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 4 śastrālambhasyeti ka, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 5 rakṣāṃ ca kārayet sadeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 pūrvavat snāpayet prārcediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sthāpayet pūrvavaccāgnimiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 kumbhe vā śivamarcayediti ga, cihnitaspustakapāṭhaḥ :p 234 vidhivacca caruṃ kṛtvā sampātāhutiśodhitaṃ
devāgryātmavibhedena darṣyā taṃ vibhajet tridhā / datvā bhāgau śivāgnibhyāṃ saṃrakṣedbhāgamātmani
śareṇa carmaṇā deyaṃ pūrvato dantadhāvanaṃ / tasmādghoraśikhābhyāṃ vā dakṣiṇe paścime mṛdaṃ
sādyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīkṛtaṃ(1) / jalaṃ(2) vāmena śirasā īśe gandhānvitaṃ jalaṃ
pañcagavyaṃ palāśādipuṭakaṃ vai samantataḥ / aiśānyāṃ kusumaṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ diśi rocanāṃ
aguruṃ nirṛtāśāyāṃ vāyavyāṃ ca catuḥsamaṃ / homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sadyojātaiḥ kuśaiḥ saha
daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupīnabhikṣāpātrāṇi(3) rūpiṇe / kajjalaṃ kuṅkumantailaṃ śalākāṃ keśaśodhanīṃ
tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadyāduttare rocanāmapi / āsanaṃ pāduke pātraṃ yogapaṭṭātapatrakaṃ
aiśānyāmīśamantreṇa dadyādīśānatuṣṭaye / pūrvasyāñcarukaṃ sājyaṃ dadyādgandhādikaṃ nave
pūrvitrāṇi samādāya prokṣitānyarghyavāriṇā / saṃhitāmantrapūtāni nītvā pāvakasannidhiṃ
kṛṣṇājinādinā.acchādya smaran saṃvatsarātmakaṃ / sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakṛtyānāṃ goptāraṃ śivamavyayaṃ

1 sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīyakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare dhāma niṣphalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 phalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupānatīrthapātrāṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 235 sveti heti prayogeṇa mantrasaṃhitayā punaḥ / śodhayecca pavitrāṇi vārāṇāmekaviṃśatiṃ
gṛhādi veṣṭayetsūtrair gandhādyaṃ (1) ravaye dadet / pūjitāya samācamya(2) kṛtanyāsaḥ kṛtārghyakaḥ
nandyādibhyo 'tha(3) gandhākhyaṃ(4) vāstoścātha praviśya ca / śastrebhyo lokapālebhyaḥ svanāmnā śivakumbhake
vardhanyai vighnarājāya gurave hy ātmane yajet / atha sarvauṣadhīliptaṃ dhūpitaṃ puṣpadūrvayā
āmantrya ca pavitraṃ(5) tat vidhāyāñjalimadhyagaṃ / oṃ samastavidhicchidrapūraṇe ca vidhiṃ prati
prabhavamantrayāmi tvāṃ tvadicchāvāptikārikāṃ / tatsiddhimanujānīhi yajataścidacitpate
sarvathā sarvadā śambho namaste 'stu prasīda me / āmantrito 'si deveśa saha devyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ
mantreśair lokapālaiś ca sahitaḥ paricārakaiḥ(6) / nimantrayāmyahantubhyaṃ prabhāte tu pavitrakaṃ
niyamañca kariṣyāmi parameśa tavājñayā / ityevandevamāmantrya recakenāmṛtīkṛtaṃ

śivāntaṃ mūlamuccārya tacchivāya nivedayet / 1 gandhākhyamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapaṭhaḥ 2 pūjanārthaṃ samācamya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 ravyādibhyo 'theti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 gandhādyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 āmantraṇapavitramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 parivārakaiviti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 236 japaṃ stotraṃ pramāṇañca kṛtvā śambhuṃ kṣamāpayet
hutvā carostṛtīyāṃśaṃ taddaddīta śivāgnaye(1) / digvāsibhyo digīśebhyo bhūtamātṛgaṇebhya u(2)
rudrebhyo kṣetrapādibhyo(3) namaḥ svāhā balistvayaṃ / diṅnāgādyaiś ca pūrvādau kṣetrāya cāgnaye baliḥ
samācamya vidhicchidrapūrakaṃ homamācaret / pūrṇāṃ vyāhṛtihomañca kṛtvā rundhīta pāvakaṃ
tata omagnaye svāhā svāhā somāya caiva hi / omagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte tathā
ityāhuticatuṣkantu datvā kuryāttu yojanāṃ / vahnikuṇḍārcitaṃ devaṃ maṇḍalābhyarcite śive
nāḍīsandhānarūpeṇa vidhinā yojayettataḥ / vaṃśādipātre vinyasya astrañca hṛdayantataḥ
adhiropya pavitrāṇi kalābhirvātha mantrayet / ṣaḍaṅgaṃ brahmamūlair vā hṛddharmāstrañca yojayet
vidhāya sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭya pūjayitvāṅgasambhavaiḥ(4) / rakṣārthaṃ jagadīśāya bhaktinamraḥ samarpayet
pūjite puṣpadhūpādyair datvā siddhāntapustake / guroḥ pādāntikaṃ gatvā bhaktyā dadyāt pavitrakaṃ

nirgatya vahirācamya gomaye maṇḍalatraye / 1 śivājñayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 bhūtamātṛgaṇeṣu phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 rudrebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 pūjayitvā tataḥ śivamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pūjayitvātha sañcarair iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 237 pañcagavyañcarundantadhāvanañca kramād yajet
