ācānto mantrasambaddhaḥ kṛtasaṅgītajāgaraḥ / svapedantaḥ smarannīśaṃ bubhukṣurdarbhasaṃstare
anenaiva prakāreṇa mumukṣurapi saṃviśet / kevalambhasmaśayyāyāṃ sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ
: pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ īśvara uvāca atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnānaḥ samāhitaḥ / kṛtasandhyārcano mantrī praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ
samādāya pavitrāṇi avisarjitadaivataḥ / aiśānyāṃ bhājane śuddhe sthāpayet kṛtamaṇḍale
tato visarjya deveśaṃ nirmālyamapanīya ca / pūrvavad bhūtale śuddhekṛtvāhnikamatha dvayaṃ
ādityadvāradikpālakumbheśānau śive 'nale(1) / naimittikīṃ savistarāṃ kuryāt pūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ
mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ prāyaścittahomaṃ śarātmanā(2) / aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ śanaiḥ

1 ādityadvāradikpālān skandeśānau śive 'nale iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śarāṇuneti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ :p 238 pavitraṃ bhānave datvā samācamya dadīta ca / dvāramālādidikpālakumbhavardhanikādiṣu
sannidhāne tataḥ śambhorupaviśya nijāsane / pavitramātmane dadyādgaṇāya guruvahnaye
oṃ kālātmanā tvayā deva yaddiṣṭaṃ māmake vidhau(1) / kṛtaṃ kliṣṭaṃ samutsṛṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ guptañca yatkṛtaṃ
tadastu kliṣṭamakliṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ kliṣṭamasaṃskṛtaṃ(2) / sarvātmanāmunā śambho pavitreṇa tvadicchayā
oṃ pūrayamakhavrataṃ niyameśvarāya svāhā / ātmatattve prakṛtyante pālite padmayoninā
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya pavitreṇārcayecchivaṃ / vidyātattve ca vidyānte viṣṇukāraṇapālite
īśvarāntaṃ samuccārya pavitramadhiropayet / śivānte śivatattve ca rudrakāraṇapālite
śivāntaṃ mantramuccārya tasmai deyaṃ pavitrakaṃ / sarvakāraṇapāleṣu śivamuccārya suvrataḥ(3)
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya dadyādgaṅgāvatārakaṃ(4) / ātmavidyāśivaiḥ proktaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ pavitrakaṃ
vinirdiṣṭaṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ śivatattvātmabhiḥ kramāt / svāhāntaṃ vā namo 'ntaṃ vā mantrameṣāmudīrayet

oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā 1 prabhustvaṃ māmakevidhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 hutaṃ yatra vaṣaṭkṛtamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 sarvatattveṣu suvrata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 4 dadyādaṅgāvatārakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 239 oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā oṃ hauṃ śivatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā oṃ hauṃ sarvatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā natvā gaṅgāvatārantu prārthayettaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ / tvaṅgatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsthitistvañcarācare
antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ(1) draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvara / karmaṇā manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ dravyahīnañca yat kṛtaṃ / japahomārcanair hīnaṃ kṛtaṃ nityaṃ mayā tava
akṛtaṃ vākyahīnaṃ ca tat pūraya maheśvaraṃ(2) / supūtastvaṃ pareśāna(3) pavitraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ
tvayā pavitritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ / khaṇḍitaṃ yanmayā deva vrataṃ vaikalpayogataḥ
ekībhavatu tat sarvaṃ tavājñāsūtragumphitaṃ / japaṃ nivedya devasya bhaktyā stotraṃ vidhāya ca
natvā tu guruṇādiṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamannaraḥ / caturmāsaṃ trimāsaṃ vā tryahamekāhameva ca
praṇamya kṣamayitveśaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ vratī / pāvakasthe śive 'pyevaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ
samāropya samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ / antarbaliṃ pavitrañca rudrādibhyo nivedayet

praviśyāntaḥ śivaṃ stutvā sapraṇāmaṃ kṣamāpayet / 1 antaś cara tvaṃ bhūtānāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 paripūrṇaṃ karo tu me iti ga, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 amṛtastvaṃ pareśāna iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 240 prāyaścittakṛtaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā hutvā ca pāyasaṃ
śanaiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā vahnisthaṃ visṛjecchivaṃ / homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā rundhyānniṣṭhurayānalaṃ
agnyādibhyastato dadyādāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ / dikpatibhyastato dadyāt(1) sapavitraṃ vahirbaliṃ
siddhāntapustake dadyāt sapramāṇaṃ pavitrakaṃ / oṃ hāṃ bhūḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ svaḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā datvā.ahuticatuṣṭayaṃ
oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā / oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā guruṃ śivamivābhyarcya vastrabhūṣādivistaraiḥ / samagraṃ saphalaṃ tasya kriyākāṇḍādi vārṣikaṃ
yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ samyagityāha parameśvaraḥ / itthaṃ guroḥ samāropya hṛdālambipavitrakaṃ
dvijātīn bhojayitvā tu bhaktyā vastrādikaṃ dadet / dānenānena deveśa prīyatāṃ me sadā śivaḥ
bhaktyā snānādikaṃ prātaḥ kṛtvā śambhoḥ samāharet / pavitrāṇyaṣṭapuṣpaistaṃ pūjayitvā visarjayet
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā vistareṇa yathā purā / pavitrāṇi samāropya praṇamyāgnau śivaṃ yajet

prāyaścittaṃ tato 'streṇa hutvā(2) pūrṇāhutiṃ yajet / 1 dikpālebhyastato datveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tato 'streṇa kṛtveti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 241 bhuktikāmaḥ śivāyātha kuryāt karmasamarpaṇaṃ
tvatprasādena karmedaṃ māstu phalasādhakaṃ / muktikāmastu karmedaṃ māstu me nātha bandhakaṃ
vahnisthaṃ nāḍīyogena śivaṃ saṃyojayechive / hṛdi nyasyāgnisaṅghātaṃ pāvakaṃ ca visarjayet
samācamya praviśyāntaḥ kumbhānugatasaṃvarān / śive saṃyojya sākṣepaṃ kṣamasveti visarjayet
visṛjya lokapālādīnādāyeśāt pavitrakaṃ / sati caṇḍeśvare pūjāṃ kṛtvā datvā pavitrakaṃ
tannirmālyādikaṃ tasmai sapavitraṃ samarpayet / athavā sthaṇḍile caṇḍaṃ vidhinā pūrvavadyajet
yat kiñcidvārṣikaṃ karma kṛtaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ mayā / tadastu paripūrṇaṃ me caṇḍa nātha tavājñayā
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ natvā stutvā visarjayet / tyaktanirmālyakaḥ śuddhaḥ snāpayitvā śivaṃ yajet / pañcayojanasaṃstho 'pi pavitraṃ gurusannidhau
damanakārohaṇavidhiḥ īśvara uvāca vakṣye damanakārohavidhiṃ pūrvavadācaret / harakopāt purā jāto bhairavo damitāḥ surāḥ
tenātha śapto viṭapo bhaveti tripurāriṇā / prasanneneritaṃ cedaṃ pūjayiṣyanti ye narāḥ
paripūrṇaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nānyathā te bhaviṣyati / saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ damanaṃ saṃhitātmabhiḥ
sampūjya bodhayedvṛkṣaṃ bhavavākyena mantravit / haraprasādasaṃbhūta tvamatra sannidhībhava
śivakāryaṃ samuddiśya netavyo 'si śivājñayā / gṛhe 'pyāmantraṇaṃ kuryāt sāyāhne cādhivāsanaṃ
yathāvidhi samabhyarcya sūryaśaṅkarapāvakān / devasya paścime mūlaṃ dadyāttasya mṛdā yutaṃ
vāmena śirasā vātha nālaṃ dhātrīṃ tathottare / dakṣiṇe bhagnapatrañca prācyāṃ puṣpañca dhāraṇaṃ
puṭikāsthaṃ phalaṃ mūlamathaiśānyāṃ yajecchivaṃ / pañcāṅgamañjalau kṛtvā āmantrya śirasi nyaset
āmantrito 'si deveśa prātaḥkāle(1) mayā prabho / kartavyastapaso lābhaḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ tavājñayā
mūlena śeṣaṃ pātrasthaṃ pidhāyātha pavitrakaṃ / prātaḥ snātvā jagannāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet(2)
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā damanaiḥ pūjayettataḥ / śeṣamañjalimādāya ātmavidyāśivātmabhiḥ

mūlādyair īśvarāntaiś ca caturthāñjalinā tataḥ / oṃ hauṃ makheśvarāya makhaṃ pūraya śūlapāṇaye namaḥ 1 deveśa pūjākāle iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 gandhapuṣpādinārcayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 243 śivaṃ vahniṃ ca sampūjya guruṃ prārcyātha bodhayet
bhagavannatiriktaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā yanmayā kṛtaṃ / sarvaṃ tadastu sampūrṇaṃ yacca dāmanakaṃ mama / sakalaṃ caitramāsotthaṃ phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet
samayadīkṣāvidhānaṃ īśvara uvāca vākṣyāmi bhogamokṣārthaṃ dīkṣāṃ pāpakṣayaṅkarīṃ / malamāyādipāśānāṃ viśleṣaḥ kriyate yayā
jñānañca janyate śiṣye sā dīkṣā bhuktimuktidā / vijñātakalanāmaiko dvitīyaḥ pralayākalaḥ(1)
tṛtīyaḥ sakalaḥ śāstre 'nugrāhyastrividho mataḥ / tatrādyo malamātreṇa mukto 'nyo malakarmabhiḥ
kalādibhūmiparyantaṃ stavaistu sakalo yataḥ / nirādhārātha sādhārā dīkṣāpi dvividhā matā
nirādhārā dvayosteṣāṃ sādhārā sakalasya tu / ādhāranirapekṣeṇa kriyate śambhucaryayā
tīvraśaktinipātena nirādhāreti sā smṛtā / ācāryamūrtimāsthāya māyātīvrādibhedayā
śaktyā yāṃ kurute śambhuḥ sā sādhikaraṇocyate / 1 pralayānala iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pralayātmaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 244 iyaṃ caturvidhā proktā savījā vījavarjitā
sādhikārānadhikārā yathā tadabhidhīyate / samayācārasaṃyuktā savījā jāyate nṛṇāṃ
nirvījā tvasamarthānāṃ samayācāravarjitā / nitye naimittike kāmye yataḥ syādadhikāritā
sādhikārā bhaveddīkṣā sādhakācāryayorataḥ / nirvījā dīkṣitānāntu yadāsa mama putrayoḥ
nityamātrādhikāratvaddīkṣā niradhikārikā / dvividheyaṃ dvirūpā hi pratyekamupajāyate
ekā kriyāvatī tatra kuṇḍamaṇḍalapūrvikā / manovyāpāramātreṇa yā sā jñānavatī matā
itthaṃ labdhādhikāreṇa dīkṣā.acāryeṇa sādhyate / skandadīkṣāṃ guruḥ kuryāt kṛtvā nityakriyāṃ tataḥ(1)
praṇavārgyakarāmbhojakṛtadvārādhipārcaṇaḥ / vighnānutsārya dehalyāṃ nyasyāstraṃ svāsane sthitaḥ
kurvīta bhūtasaṃśuddhiṃ mantrayogaṃ yathoditaṃ / tilataṇḍulasiddhārthakuśadūrvākṣatodakaṃ
sayavakṣīranīrañca viśeṣārghyamidantataḥ / tadambunā dravyaśuddhiṃ tilakaṃ svāsanātmanoḥ
pūjanaṃ mantraśiddhiñca pañcagavyañca pūrvavat / lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣataṃ(2) kuśān

vikirān śuddhalājāṃstān sadhūpānastramantritān / 1 kṛtanityakriyādvaya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 bhasmadūrvākṣatāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 245 śastrāmbu(1)prokṣitānetān kavacenāvaguṇṭhitān
nānāgrahaṇākārān vighnaughavinivārakān / darbhāṇāntālamānena kṛtvā ṣaṭtriṃśatā dalaiḥ
saptajaptaṃ śivāstreṇa veṇīṃ bodhāsimuttamaṃ / śivamātmani vinyasya sṛṣṭyādhāramabhīpsitaṃ
niṣkalaṃ ca śivaṃ nyasya śivo 'hamiti bhāvayet / uṣṇīṣaṃ śirasi nyasya alaṃ kuryātsvadehakaṃ
gandhamaṇḍanakaṃ svīye vidadhyāddakṣiṇe kare / vidhinātrārcayedīśamitthaṃ syācchivamastakaṃ
vinyasya śivamantreṇa bhāsvaraṃ nijamastake / śivādabhinnamātmānaṃ kartāraṃ bhāvayedyathā
maṇḍale karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kalaśe yajñarakṣakaḥ / homādhikaraṇaṃ vahnau śiṣye pāśavimocakaḥ(2)
svātmanyanugṛhīteti ṣaḍādhāro ya īśvaraḥ / so 'hameveti kurvīta bhāvaṃ sthirataraṃ punaḥ
jñānakhaḍgakaraḥ sthitvā nairṛtyābhimukho naraḥ / sārghyāmbupañcagavyābhyāṃ prokṣayedyāgamaṇḍapaṃ
catuṣpathāntasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādīkṣaṇādibhiḥ / vikṣipya vikarāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet
tānīśadiśi vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet / nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇān dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet
āpye ratnaiḥ pūrayantīṃ hṛdā maṇḍaparūpiṇīṃ / 1 astrāmbu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śiṣye pāpavimocaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 246 sāmbuvastre saratne ca dhānyasthe paścimānane
aiśe kumbhe yajecchambhuṃ śaktiṃ kumbhasya dakṣiṇe / paścimasyāntu siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīṃ khaḍgarūpiṇīṃ
dikṣu śakrādidikpālānviṣṇvantān praṇavāsanān / vāhanāyudhasaṃyuktān hṛdābhyarcya svanāmabhiḥ
prathamantāṃ samādāya kumbhasyāgrābhigāminīṃ / avicchinnapayodharāṃ bhrāmayitvā pradakṣiṇaṃ
śivājñāṃ lokapālānāṃ śrāvayenmūlamuccaran / saṃrakṣata yathāyogaṃ kumbhaṃ dhṛtvātha tāṃ dhāret
tataḥ sthirāsane kumbhe sāṅgaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ / vinyasya śodhyamadhvānaṃ vardhanyāmastramarcayet

oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ hūṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ / oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ śrīṃ śirase hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ yaṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ gūṃ kavacāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ phaṭ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ(1)caturvaktraṃ sadaṃṣṭrañca smaredastraṃ saśaktikaṃ / samudgaratriśūlāsiṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaṃ

bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā / 1 oṃ aṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hraṃ phaṭ / oṃ aṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ paśūṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ / oṃ hṛdayāya hraṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ śrīṃ śirase hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ maṃ śikhāyai phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ astrāya phaṭ hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / iti ga, cihnkitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya krūṃ phaṭ / oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ svāṃ svaṃ krūṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya svāhā / oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ paṃ śikhāyai krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ khaṃ kavacāya krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ haṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ namaḥ / iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 247 agguṣṭhena spṛśet kumbhaṃ hṛdā muṣṭyāstravardhanīṃ
bhuktaye muktaye tvādau muṣṭinā vardhanīṃ spṛśet / kumbhasya mukharakṣārthaṃ jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayet
śastrañca mūlamantrasya śataṃ kumbhe niveśayet / taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayettataḥ
yathedaṃ kṛtayatnena bhagavanmakhamandiraṃ / rakṣaṇīyaṃ jagannātha sarvādhvaradhara tvayā
praṇavasthaṃ caturbāhuṃ vāyavye gaṇamarcayet(1) / sthaṇḍile śivamabhyarcya sārghyakuṇḍaṃ vrajennaraḥ
niviṣṭo mantratṛptyarthamarghyagandhaghṛtādikaṃ / vāme 'savye tu vinyasya samiddarbhatilādikaṃ
kuṇḍavahnisrugājyādi prāgvat saṃskṛtya bhāvayet / mukhyatāmūrdhvavaktrasya hṛdi vahnau śivaṃ yajet
svamūrtau śivakumbhe ca sthaṇḍile tvagniśiṣyayoḥ / sṛṣṭinyāsena vinyasya śodhyādhvānaṃ yathāvidhi
kuṇḍamānaṃ mukhaṃ dhyātvā hṛdāhutibhirīpsitaṃ / vījāni saptajihvānāmagnerhomāya bhaṇyate
virephāvantimauvarṇau rephaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitau / induvinduśikhāyuktau jihvāvījānupakramāt
hiraṇyā vanakā raktā kṛṣṇā tadanu suprabhā / atiriktā bahurūpā rudrendrāgnyāpyadiṅmukhā
kṣīrādimadhurair homaṃ kuryācchāntikapauṣṭike / abhicāre tu piṇyākasaktukañcukakāñcikaiḥ
lavaṇair ājikātakrakaṭutailaiś ca kaṇṭakaiḥ / 1 vāyavye kālamarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 248 samidbhirapi vakrābhiḥ kruddho bhāṣyāṇunā yajet
kadambakalikāhomādyakṣiṇī siddhyati dhruvaṃ / bandhūkakiṃśukādīni vaśyākarṣāya homayet
bilvaṃ rājyāya lakṣmārthaṃ pāṭalāṃś campakānapi / padmāni cakravartitve bhakṣyabhojyāni sampade
dūrvā vyādhivināśāya sarvasattvavaśīkṛte / priyaṅgupāṭalīpuṣpaṃ cūtapatraṃ jvarāntakaṃ
mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyujit syād vṛddhiḥ syāttilahomataḥ / rudraśāntiḥ sarvaśāntyai atha prastutamucyate
āhutyaṣṭaśatair mūlamaṅgāni tu daśāṃśataḥ / santarpayeta mūlena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathā purā
tathā śiṣyapraveśāya pratiśiṣyaṃ śataṃ japet / dur nimittāpasārāya sunimittakṛte tathā
śatadvayañca hotavyaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavat / mūlādyaṣṭāstramantrāṇāṃ svāhāntaistarpaṇaṃ sakṛt
śikhāsampuṭitair vījair hrūṃ phaḍantaiś ca(1) dīpanaṃ / oṃ hauṃ śivāya svāhetyādimantraiś ca tarpaṇaṃ
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ śivāya hrūṃ(2) phaḍityādidīpanaṃ / tataḥ śivāmbhasā sthālīṃ kṣālitāṃ varmaguṇṭhitāṃ(3)
candanādisamālabdhāṃ badhnīyāt kaṭakaṃ gale / varmāstrajaptasaddarbhapatrābhyāṃ carusiddhaye

1 huṃ phaḍantaiś ca kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hūṃ śivāya hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ kraṃ hauṃ kraṃ śivāya krūṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dharmaguṇṭhitāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 249 varmādyair āsane(1) datte sārdhendukṛtamaṇḍale(2) / nyastāyāṃ mūrtibhūtāyāṃ bhāvapuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ yajet
vastrabaddhamukhāyāṃ vā sthālyāṃ puṣpair vahirbhavaiḥ / cullyāṃ paścimavaktrāyāṃ nyastāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā
nyastāhaṅkāravījāyāṃ śuddhāyāṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ / dharmādharmaśarīrāyāṃ japtāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā
sthālīmāropayedastrajaptāṃ gavyāmbumārjitāṃ / gavyaṃ payo 'strasaṃśuddhaṃ prāsādaśatamantritaṃ
tuṇḍalān śyāmakādīnāṃ nikṣipettatra tadyathā / ekaśiṣyavidhānāya teṣāṃ prasṛtipañcakaṃ
prasṛtiṃ prasṛtiṃ paścādvardhayed dvyādiṣu kramāt / kuryāccānalamantreṇa pidhānaṃ kavacāṇunā
śivāgnau mūlamantreṇa pūrvāsyaś carukaṃ pacet / sukhinne tatra taccullyāṃ śruvamāpūrya sarpiṣā
svāhāntaiḥ saṃhitāmantrair datvā taptābhighāraṇaṃ / saṃsthāpya maṇḍale sthālīṃ saddarbhe 'strāṇunā kṛte
praṇavena pidhāyāsyāṃ taddehalepanaṃ hṛdā / suśītalo bhavatyevam prāpya śītābhighāraṇaṃ
vidadhyātsaṃhitāmantraiḥ śiṣyaṃ prati sakṛt sakṛt / dharmādyāsanake hutvā(3) kuṇḍamaṇḍalapaścime
sampātañca srucā hutvā śuddhiṃ saṃhitayā caret / carukaṃ sakṛdālabhya tayaiva vaṣaḍantayā

1 dharmādyair āsane iti ka, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 sārdāmbukṛtamaṇḍale iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dharmādyāsanake dhṛtveti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 250 dhenumudrāmṛtībhūtaṃ sthaṇḍileśāntikaṃ nayet(1) / sājyabhāgaṃ svaśiṣyāṇāṃ bhāgo devāya vahnaye
kuryāttu stokapālādeḥ samadhvājyamitidaṃ trayaṃ / namo 'ntena hṛdā dadyāttenaivācamanīyakaṃ(2)
sājyaṃ mantraśataṃ hutvā dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi / maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍataḥ pūrve madhye vā śambhukumbhayoḥ
rudramātṛgaṇādīnāṃ nirvartyāntarbaliṃ hṛdā / śivamadhye 'pyalabdhājño vidhāyaikatvabhāvanaṃ
sarvajñatādiyukto 'haṃ samantāccopari sthitaḥ / mamāṃśo yojanāsthānamadhiṣṭhāhamadhvare
śivo 'hamityahaṅkārī niṣkramed yāgamaṇḍapāt / nyastapūrvāgrasandharbhe śastrāṇukṛtamaṇḍale
praṇavāsanake śiṣyaṃ śuklavastrottarīyakaṃ / snātañcodaṅmukhaṃ muktyai pūrvavaktrantu bhuktaye
ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ samāropya pūrvāsyaṃ pravilokayet / caraṇādiśikhāṃ yāvanmuktau bhuktau vilomataḥ
cakṣuṣā saprasādena śaivaṃ dhāma vivṛṇvatā / astrodakena sammokṣya mantrāmbusnānasiddaye
bhasmasnānāya vighnānāṃ śāntaye pāpabhittaye(3) / sṛṣṭisaṃhārayogena tāḍayedastrabhasmanā

punarastrāmbunā prokṣya sakalīkaraṇāya taṃ / 1 sthaṇḍilopāntikaṃ nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 tenaivācamanīyamiti ka, kha, ga, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ 3 pāśabhittaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 251 nābherūrdhvaṃ kuśāgreṇa mārjanīyāstramuccaran
tridhā.alabheta tanmūlair aghamarṣāya nābhyadhaḥ / dvaividhyāya ca pāśānāṃ ālabheta śarāṇunā
taccharīre śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāsanaṃ vinyasettataḥ / puṣpādipūjitasyāsya netre netreṇa vā hṛdā
badhvāmantritavastreṇa sitena sadaśena ca /. pradakṣiṇakramādenaṃ praveśya śivadakṣiṇaṃ
savastramāsanaṃ dadyāt yathāvarṇaṃ(1) nivedayet / saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ mūrtyā tasya hṛdambuje
nirudhya śodhite kāye nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tamarcayet / pūrvānanasya śiṣyasya mūlamantreṇa mastake
śivahastaṃ pradātavyaṃ rudreśapadadāyakaṃ / śivasevāgrahopāyaṃ dattahastaṃ śivāṇunā(2)
śive prakṣepayet puṣpamapanīyārcakantāraṃ(3) / tatpātrasthānamantrāḍhyaṃ śivadevagaṇānugaṃ
viprādīnāṃ kramānnāma kuryādvā svecchayā guruḥ / praṇatiṃ kumbhavardhanyoḥ kārayitvānalāntikaṃ
sadakṣiṇāsane tadvat(4) saumyāsyamupaveśayet / śiṣyadehaviniṣkrāntāṃ suṣumṇāmiva cintayet

nijagrahalīnāñca darbhamūlena mantritaṃ / 1 suvarṇañceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 apanīyādhikāmbaraṃ iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 sadakṣiṇāsana tatreti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 252 darbhāgraṃ dakṣiṇe tasya vidhāya karapallave
tammūlamātmajaṅghāyāmagrañceti śikhidhvaje / śiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ gatvā recakena śivāṇunā(1)
purakeṇa samāgatya svakīyaṃ hṛdyāntaraṃ / śivāgninā punaḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamīdṛśaṃ
hṛdā tatsannidhānārthañjuhuyādāhutitrayaṃ / śivahastasthiratvārthaṃ(2) śataṃ mūlena homayet / itthaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ bhavedyogyo bhavārcane
saṃskāradīkṣākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣye saṃskāradīkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha / āvāhayenmaheśasya vahnisthasya śiro hṛdi
saṃśliṣṭau tau samabhyarcya santarpya hṛdayātmanā / tayoḥ sannidhaye dadyāttenaivāhutipañcakaṃ
kusumenāstraliptena(3) tāḍayettaṃ hṛdā śiśuṃ / prasphurattārakākāraṃ caitanyaṃ tatra bhāvayet

1 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 2 śivahaste ca sthityarthamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 kusumenāṣṭajapteneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 253 praviśya tatra huṅkāramuktaṃ recakayogataḥ / saṃhāriṇyā tadākṛṣya pūrakeṇa hṛdi nyaset
tato vāgīśvarīyaunau mudrayodbhavasañjñayā / hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa(1) recakena vinikṣipet
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(2) jājvalyamāne nirdhūme juhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye / apravṛddhe sadhūme tu homo vahnau na siddhyati
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sugandhiḥ śasyate 'nalaḥ / viparītasphuliṅgī ca bhūmisparśaḥ praśasyate
ityevamādibhiścihnair hutvā śiṣyasya kalmaṣaṃ / pāpabhakṣaṇahomena(3) dahedvā taṃ bhavātmanā
dvijatvāpādanārthāya tathā rudrāṃśabhāvane / āhāravījasaṃśuddhau(4) garbhādhānāya saṃsthitau
sīmante janmato nāmakaraṇāya ca homayet / śatāni pañca mūlena vauṣaḍādidaśāṃśataḥ
śithilībhūtabandhasya śaktāvutkarṣaṇaṃ ca yat / ātmano rudraputtratve garbhādhānaṃ taducyate
svāntatryātmaguṇavyaktiriha puṃsavanaṃ mataṃ / māyātmanorvivekena jñānaṃ sīmantavardhanaṃ

śivāditattvaśuddhestu svīkāro jananaṃ mataṃ / 1 hṛtsampuṭātmamantreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 pāpakṣayeṇa homaneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 vījasaṃsiddhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 254 bodhanaṃ yacchivatvena śivatvārhasya no mataṃ(1)
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ / vidadhīta samādāya nije hṛdayapaṅkaje
tataḥ kumbhayogena mūlamantramudīrayet / kuryāt samavaśībhāvaṃ tadā ca śivayorhṛdi
brahmādikāraṇātyāgakramādrecakayogataḥ / nītvā śivāntamātmānamādāyodbhavamudrayā
hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa recakena vidhānavit / śiṣyasya hṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ vinikṣipet
pūjāṃ śivasya vahneś ca guruḥ kuryāttadocitāṃ / praṇatiñcātmane śiṣyaṃ samayān śrāvayettathā
devaṃ na nindecchāstrāṇi nirmālyādi na laṅghayet / śivāgnigurupūjā ca kartavyā jīvitāvadhi
bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitātmanāṃ / yathāśakti dadītārthaṃ(2) samarthasya samagrakān
bhūtāṅgāni jaṭābhasmadaṇḍakaupīnasaṃyamān / īśānādyair hṛdādyair vā parijapya yathākramāt
svāhāntasaṃhitamantraiḥ pātreṣvāropya pūrvavat / sampāditadrutaṃ hutvā sthaṇḍileśāya darśayet
rakṣaṇāya ghaṭādhastādāropya kṣaṇamātrakaṃ / śivādājñāṃ samādāya dadīta yatine guruḥ
evaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ viśiṣṭāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / 1 vardhanamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 dadītānnamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 255 vahnihomāgamajñānayogyaḥ sañjāyate śiśruḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca atha nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ kuryānmūlādidīpanaṃ / pāśabandhanaśaktyarthaṃ tāḍanādikṛtena vā
ekaikayā tadāhutyā pratyekaṃ tattrayeṇa vā / vījagarbhaśikhārdhantu hūṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(2) mūlamantrasya dīpanaṃ / oṃ hrūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(3) hṛdaya evaṃ śiromukhe
pratyekaṃ dīpanaṃ kuryāt sarvasmin krūrakarmaṇi / śāntike pauṣṭike cāsya vaṣaḍantādināṇunā(4)
vaṣaḍvauṣaṭsamopetaiḥ sarvakāmyopari sthitaiḥ / havanaṃ saṃvaraiḥ kuryāt sarvatrāpyāyanādiṣu

tataḥ svasavyabhāgasthaṃ maṇḍale śuddhavigrahaṃ / 1 hrīṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /oṃ hūṃ hoṃ hūṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ3 oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /oṃ hraṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 vaṣaḍantādinātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 256 śiṣyaṃ sampūjya tat sūtraṃ suṣumṇeti vibhāvitaṃ
mūlena tacchikhābandhaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhāntamānayet / saṃhāreṇa mumukṣostu badhnīyācchiṣyakāyake
puṃsastu dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme nāryā niyojayet / śaktiṃ ca śaktimantreṇa pūjitāntasya mastake
saṃhāramudrayā.adāya sūtraṃ tenaiva yojayet / nāḍīntvādāya mūlena sūtre nyasya hṛdārcayet
avaguṇṭhya tu rudreṇa hṛdayenāhutitrayaṃ / pradadyātsannidhānārthaṃ śaktāvapyevameva hi
oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namo hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kālādhvane namaḥ(1) śodhyādhvānaṃ hi sūtrake
nyasyāstravāriṇā śiṣyaṃ prokṣyāstramantritena ca / puṣpeṇa hṛdi santāḍya śiṣyadehe praviśya ca
guruś ca tatra hūṅkārayuktaṃ recakayogataḥ / caitanyaṃ haṃsavījasthaṃ viśliṣyedāyudhātmanā
oṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ(2) āchidya śaktisūtreṇa hāṃ haṃ svāheti cāṇunā / saṃhāramudrayā sūtre nāḍībhūte niyojayet

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ vyāpakaṃ bhāvayedenaṃ tanutrāṇāvaguṇṭhayet(3) / 1 oṃ dvām padādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kalādhvane namaḥ / iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hāṃ padātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ varṇātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ mantrātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kālātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 257 āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt hṛdā sannidhihetave
vidyādehañca vinyasya śāntyatītāvalokanaṃ / tasyāmitaratattvādyaṃ mantrabhūtaṃ vicintayet
oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya(1) nama ity anenāvalokayet he tattve mantramapyekaṃ padaṃ varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa / tathāṣṭau bhuvanānyasyāṃ vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ
viṣayañca guṇañcaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ / sitāyāṃ śāntyatītāyāmantarbhāvya prapīḍayet
oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ saṃhāramudrayā.adāya vidadhyāt sūtramastake / pūjayedāhutīṃstisro dadyāt sannidhihetave
tattve dve akṣare dve ca vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ / guṇau mantrau tathābjasthamekaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraṃ
padāni bhānusaṅkhyāni bhuvanāni daśa sapta ca / ekañca viṣayaṃ śāntau kṛṣṇāyāmacyutaṃ smaret
tāḍayitvā samādāya mukhasūtre niyojayet / juhuyānnijavījena sānnidhyāyāhutitrayaṃ
vidyāyāṃ sapta tattvāni pādānāmekaviṃśatiṃ / ṣaḍ varṇān sañcaraṃ caikaṃ lokānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ
guṇānāntrayamekañca viṣayaṃ rudrakāraṇaṃ / antarbhāvyātiriktāyāṃ jīvanāḍīkathadvayaṃ
astramādāya dadhyācca padaṃ dvyadhikaviṃśatiṃ / lokānāñca kalānāñca ṣaṣṭiṃ guṇacatuṣṭayaṃ
1 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hoṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 258 mantrāṇāṃ trayamekañca viṣayaṃ kāraṇaṃ hariṃ / antarbhāvya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ śuklayāntāḍanādikaṃ
vidhāya nābhisūtrasthāṃ sannidhāyāhutīryajet / hrīṃ bhuvanānāṃ(1) śataṃ sāgraṃpadānāmaṣṭaviṃśatiṃ(2) /
vījanāḍīsamīrāṇāṃ dvayorindriyayorapi / varṇantattvañca viṣayamekaikaṃ guṇapañcakaṃ
hetuṃ brahmāṇḍamantrasthaṃ śambarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ / nivṛttau pītavarṇāyāmantarbhāvya pratāḍayet
ādau yattattvabhāgānte(3) sūtre vinyasyapūjayet / juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ sannidhāya pāvake
ityādāya kalāsūtre yojayecchiṣyavigrahāt / savījāyāntu dīkṣāyāṃ samayācārayāgataḥ
dehārambhakarakṣārthaṃ mantrasiddhiphalādapi / iṣṭāpūrtādidharmārthaṃ vyatiriktaṃ prabandhakaṃ
caitanyabodhakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kalānāmantare smaret / amunaiva krameṇātha kuryāttarpaṇadīpane

āhutibhiḥ svamantreṇa tisṛbhistisṛbhis tathā / oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya svāhetyāditarpaṇaṃ oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ(4) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūmphaḍityādidīpanaṃ tat sūtraṃ vyāptibodhāya kalāsthāneṣu pañcasu

1 hrīṃ tribhuvanādhipānāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 padānāmūnaviṃśatimiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 ādau satattvabhāveneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hauṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 259 saṅgṛhya kuṅkumājyena(1) tatra sāṅgaṃ śivaṃ yajet / hūmphaḍantaiḥ kalāmantrair bhittvā pāśānanukramāt

namo 'ntaiś ca praviśyāntaḥ kuryād grahaṇabandhane / oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ śāntyatītakalāṃ gṛhṇāmi badhnāmi cetyādimantraiḥ kalānāṃ grahaṇabandhanādiprayogaḥ pāśādīnāñca svīkāro grahaṇaṃ bandhanaṃ punaḥ
puruṣaṃ prati niḥśeṣavyāpārapratipattaye / upaveśyātha tat sūtraṃ śiṣyaskandhe niveśayet
vistṛtāghapramoṣāya śataṃ mūlena homayet / śarāvasampuṭe puṃsaḥ striyāś ca praṇitodare
hṛdastrasampuṭaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāyābhyarcayeddhṛdā(2) / sūtraṃ śivena sāṅgena kṛtvā sampātaśodhitaṃ
nidadhyāt kalaśasyādho rakṣāṃ vijñāpayediti / śiṣyaṃ puṣpaṃ kare datvā sampūjya kalaśādikaṃ
praṇamayya vahiryāyād yāgamandiramadhyataḥ / maṇḍalatritayaṃ kṛtvā mumukṣvanuttarānanān
bhuktaye pūrvavaktrāṃś ca śiṣyāṃstatra niveśayet / prathame pañcagavyasya prāśayeccullakatrayaṃ
pāṇinā kuśayuktena arcitānantarāntaraṃ / caruntatastṛtīye tu grāsatritayasammitaṃ
aṣṭagrāsapramāṇaṃ vā daśanasparśavarjitaṃ / pālāśapuṭake muktau bhuktau pippalapatrake

1 kumbhamājyeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 260 hṛdā sambhojanaṃ datvā pūtair ācāmayejjalaiḥ / dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā kṛtvā prakṣipecchobhane śubhaṃ
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ / vidhāya sthiṇḍileśāya sarvakarmasamarpaṇaṃ
pūjāvisarjanañcāsya caṇḍeśasya ca pūjanaṃ / nirmālyamapanīyātha śeṣamagnau yajeccaroḥ
kalaśaṃ lokapalāṃś ca pūjayitvā visṛjya ca / visṛjedgaṇamagniñca rakṣitaṃ yadi vāhyataḥ
vāhyato lokapālānāṃ datvā saṅkṣepato baliṃ / bhasmanā śuddhatoyair vā snātvā yā gālayaṃ viśet(1)
gṛhasthān darbhaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣān surakṣitān / hṛdā sadbhasmaśayyāyāṃ yatīn dakṣiṇamastakān
śikhābaddhasikhānastrasaptamāṇavakānvitān / vijñāya snāpayecchiṣyāṃstato yāyāt punarvahiḥ
oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā pañcagavyañcaruṃ prāśya gṛhītvā dantadhāvanaṃ / samācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā śayyāmāsthāya pāvanīṃ(2)
dīkṣāgataṅkriyākāṇḍaṃ saṃsmaran saṃviśedguruḥ / iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto vidhirdīkṣādhivāsane
nirvāṇadīkṣāvidhānaṃ īśvara uvāca atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnanādiko guruḥ / dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ praśastābhyavahāritā
gajāśvarohaṇaṃ svapne śubhaṃ śuklāṃśukādikaṃ(1) / tailābhyaṅgādikaṃ hīnaṃ homo ghoreṇa śāntaye(2)
nityakarmadvayaṃ kṛtvā praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ / svācānto nityavat karma kuryānnaimittike vidhau
tataḥ saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ śivahastaṃ tathātmani / vinyasya kumbhagaṃ prārcya indrādīnāmanukramāt
maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpi prakurvīta śivarcanaṃ / tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vahneḥ pūrṇāntaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ
duḥkhapradoṣamoṣāya śastreṇāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ / hutvā hūṃ sampuṭenaiva vidadhyāt mantradīpanaṃ
antarbalividhānañca madhye sthaṇḍilakumbhayoḥ / kṛtvā śiṣyapraveśāya labdhānujño vahirvrajet
kuryātsamayavattatra maṇḍalāropaṇādikaṃ / sampātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpadarbhakarānugaṃ
tatsannidhānāya tistro hutvā mūlāṇunā.ahutīḥ / kumbhasthaṃ śivamabhyarcya pāśasūtramupāharet(3)

1 śuklāmbarādikamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 asmallabdhapañcapustakeṣu dadhyārdramāṃsamadyāderityārabhya homo ghoreṇa śāntaye ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ pūrveṇānanvita iva pratibhāti 3 pāśasūtraṃ samāharediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 262 svadakṣiṇordhvakāyasya śiṣyasyābhyarcitasya ca / tacchikhāyāṃ nibadhnīyāt pādāṅguṣṭhāvalambitaṃ
taṃ niveśya nivṛttestu vyāptimālokya cetasā / jñeyāni bhuvanānyasyāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ
kapālo 'jaś ca buddhaś ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ(1) / vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ
agnī rudro hutāśo ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ / jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣapāntakau
yāmyamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kāryarañjakaḥ / kālo dharmo 'pyadharmaś ca saṃyoktā ca viyogakaḥ
nairṛto māraṇo(2) hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ / ūrdhvāṃśako virūpākṣo dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravān
balaścātibalaś caiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ / śvetaś ca jayabhadraś ca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ(3)
vaḍavāsyaś ca bhīmaś ca daśaite vāruṇāḥ smṛtāḥ / śīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣapāntakaḥ
pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ / jaṭāmukuṭadhārī ca nānāratnadharas tathā
nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyo saumyadehaḥ prasādakṛt / prakāśo 'pyatha lakṣmīvān kāmarūpo daśottare
vidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥ / mātṛvṛttaś ca piṅgākṣo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ

1 pravardhana iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 varuṇa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 janāntaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 263 sarvavidyāvidhatā ca sukhaduḥkhaharā daśa / anantaḥ pālako dhīraḥ(1) pātālādhipatis tathā
vṛṣo vṛṣadharo vīryo grasanaḥ(2) sarvatomukhaḥ / lohitaś caiva vijñeyā daśa rudrāḥ phaṇisthitāḥ
śambhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ / saṃhāraś ca vihāraś ca lābho lipsurvicakṣaṇaḥ
attā kuhakakālāgnirudro(3) hāṭaka eva ca / kuṣmāṇḍaś caiva satyaś ca brahmā viṣṇuś ca saptamaḥ
rudraścāṣṭāvime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥ / eteṣāmeva nāmāni bhuvanānāmapi smaret
bhavodbhavaḥ sarvabhūtaḥ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ / sarvasānnidhyakṛd brahmaviṣṇurudraśarārcitaḥ

saṃstuta pūrvasthita oṃ sākṣin oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva sarvasarvada sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇurudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ(4) aṣṭāviṃśati pādāni vyomavyāpi mano guha / sadyohṛdastranetrāṇi mantravarṇāṣṭako mataḥ

1 ghora iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vīryāprasanna iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 atha śuklakakālāgnirudra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2 śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ iti / anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo nama iti ca, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 264 vījākāro makāraś ca(1) nāḍyāviḍāpiṅgalāhvaye / prāṇāpānāvubhau vāyū ghrāṇopasthau tathendriye
gandhastu viṣayaḥ prokto gandhādiguṇapañcake / pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅgaṃ caturasrakaṃ
vistāro yojanānāntu koṭirasya śatāhatā / atraivāntargatā jñeyā yonayo 'pi caturdaśa
prathamā sarvadevānāṃ manvādyā devayonayaḥ / mṛgapakṣī ca paśavaś caturdhā tu sarīsṛpāḥ
sthāvaraṃ pañcamaṃ sarvaṃ yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī amānuṣī(2) / paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ caindrameva ca
saumyaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ(3) brāhmamaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ / aṣṭānāṃ pārthivantattvamadhikārāspadaṃ mataṃ
layastu prakṛtau buddhau bhogo brahmā ca kāraṇaṃ / tato jāgradavasthānaiḥ samastair bhuvanādibhiḥ

nivṛttiṃ garbhitāṃ dhyātvā svamantreṇa niyojya ca / oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(4) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ tata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ(5) nivṛttikalāpāśāya svāhetyanenāṅkuśamudrayā pūrakeṇākṛṣya oṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ(6) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaḍityanena saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakenādhaḥ-[!!!] 1 vījoṅkāro makaraśceti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī sumānuṣī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / yoniḥ ṣaṣṭīṣu mānuṣī iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 prajeśvaramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 tata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 oṃ hūṃ hrūṃ hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 265 sthānādādāya oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ity anenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe saṃsthāpya oṃ hāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ity anenārghyaṃ datvā sampūjya vimukhenaiva svāhāntenai sannidhānāyāhutitrayaṃ santarpaṇāhutitrayaṃ ca datvā oṃ hāṃ brahmaṇe nama iti brahmāṇamāvāhya sampūjya ca svāhāntena santarpya brahman tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dokṣyayāmyahaṃ
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena vidhiṃ vijñāpayediti / āvāhayettato devīṃ rakṣāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ hṛdā
icchājñānakriyārūpāṃ ṣaḍvidhāṃ hy ekakāraṇaṃ / pūjayettarpayeddevīṃ prakāreṇāmunā tataḥ
vāgīśvarīṃ viniḥśeṣayonivikṣobhakāraṇaṃ / hṛtsampuṭārthavījādihūṃ phaḍantaśarāṇunā
tāḍayeddhṛdaye tasya praviśetsa(2) vidhānavit / tataḥ śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ hṛdi vahnikaṇopamaṃ
nivṛttisthaṃ yutaṃ pāśair jyeṣṭhayā vibhajedyathā / oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭoṃ hāṃ svāhetyanenātha pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā
tadākṛṣya svamantreṇa gṛhītvā.atmani yojayet / oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(3) ātmane namaḥ pitrorvibhāvya saṃyogaṃ caitanyaṃ recakena tat

brahmādikāraṇatyāgakramānnītvā śivāspadaṃ / 1 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 praviśyecceti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ kṣaṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 266 garbhādhānārthamādāya yugapat sarvayoniṣu
kṣipedvāgīśvarīyonau vāmayodbhavamudrayā / oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(1) pūjayedapyanenaiva tarpayedapi pañcadhā
anyayoniṣu sarvāsu dehaśuddhiṃ hṛdā caret / nātra puṃsavanaṃ stryādiśarīrasyāpi sambhavāt
sīmantonnayanaṃ vāpi daivānyaṅgāni dehavat / śirasā janma kurvīta jugupsan sarvadehināṃ
tathaiva bhāvayedeṣāmadhikāraṃ śivāṇunā(2) / bhogaṃ kavacamantreṇa śastreṇa viṣayātmanā
moharūpamabhedaś ca layasajñaṃ vibhāvayet / śivena śrotasāṃ śuddhiṃ hṛdā tattvaviśodhanaṃ
pañca pañcāhutīḥ kuryāt(3) garbhādhānādiṣu kramāt / māyayā malakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye
niṣkṛtyaiva hṛdā paścād yajeta śatamāhutīḥ / malaśaktinirodhena pāśānāñca viyojanaṃ
svāhāntāyudhamantreṇa pañcapañcāhutīryajet / māyādyantasya pāśasya saptavārāstrajaptayā

kartaryā chedanaṃ kuryāt kalpaśastreṇa tadyathā / oṃ hūṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ 1 oṃ haṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 śikhātmane kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 pañcapañcāhutīrdadyāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 267 bandhakatvañca nirvartya hastābhyāñca śarāṇunā(1)
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya ghṛtapūrṇe sruve dharet / dahedanukalāstreṇa kevalāstreṇa bhasmasāt
kuryāt pañcāhutīrdatvā pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye / oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādastrāhutibhiraṣṭabhiḥ
athāvāhya vidhātāraṃ pūjayettarpayettathā / tata oṃ hāṃ śabdasparśaśuddhabrahman gṛhāṇa svāhetyāhutitrayeṇādhikāramasya samarpayet dagdhaniḥśeṣapāpasya(2) brahmannasya paśostvayā
bandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti / tato visṛjya dhātāraṃ nāḍyā dakṣiṇayā śanaiḥ
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ kumbhakena nijātmanā / rāhuyuktaikadeśena candravimbena sannibhaṃ
ādāya yojayet sūtre recakenodbhavākhyayā / pūjayitvārghyapātrasthatoyavindusudhopamaṃ
visṛjya pitarau dadyādvauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā / pūraṇāya vidhiḥ pūrṇā nivṛttiriti śodhitā
pratiṣṭhākalāśodhanoktiḥ īśvara uvāca tattvayoratha sandhānaṃ kuryācchuddhaviśuddhayoḥ / hrasvadīrghaprayogeṇa nādanādāntasaṅginā
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(1)aptejo vāyurākāśaṃ tanmātrendriyabuddhayaḥ / guṇatrayamahaṅkāraś caturviṃśaḥ pumāniti
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ niviṣṭhāni tattvānyetāni bhāvayet / pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāni khādiyāntākṣarāṇi ca
pañcāśadadhikā ṣaṣṭirbhuvanaistulyasañjñitāḥ / tāvanta eva rudrāś ca vijñeyāstatra tadyathā
amareśaḥ prabhāvaś ca nemiṣaḥ puṣkaro 'pi ca / tathā pādiś ca daṇḍiś ca bhāvabhūtirathāṣṭamaḥ
nakulīśo hariś candraḥ śrīśailo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ / anvīśo 'srātikeśaś ca(2) mahākālo 'tha madhyamaḥ
kedāro bhairavaś caiva dvitīyāṣṭakamīritaṃ / tato gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādike
vimalaścāṭṭahāsaś ca(3) mahendro bhāma eva ca / vasvāpadaṃ rudrakoṭiraviyukto mahāvantaḥ
gokarṇo bhadrakarṇaś ca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇureva ca / ajeśaś caiva sarvajño bhāsvaraḥ sūdanāntaraḥ

subāhurmattarūpī ca viśālo jaṭilas tathā / 1 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 alpīśo bhrāntikeśaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vimalaś caṇḍahāsaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 269 raudro 'tha piṅgalākṣaś ca kāladaṃṣṭrī bhavettataḥ
viduraś caiva ghoraś ca prājāpatyo hutāśanaḥ / kāmarūpī tathā kālaḥ karṇo 'pyatha bhayānakaḥ
mataṅgaḥ piṅgalaś caiva haro vai dhātṛsajñakaḥ / śaṅkukarṇo vidhānaś ca śrīkaṇṭhaś candraśekharaḥ

sahaitena ca paryantāḥ kathyante 'tha padānyapi / vyāpin oṃ arūpa oṃ pramatha oṃ tejaḥ oṃ jyotiḥ oṃ puruṣa oṃ agne oṃ adhūma oṃ abhasma oṃ anādi oṃ nānā oṃ dhūdhū oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ anidhana nidhanodbhava śiva śarva paramātman maheśvara mahādeva sadbhāveśvara mahātejaḥ yogādhipataye muñca prathama sarva sarvesarveti dvātriṃśat padāni vījabhāve trayo mantrā vāmadevaḥ śivaḥ śikhā
gāndhārī ca suṣumṇā ca nāḍyau dvau mārutau tathā / samānodānanāmānau rasanāpāyurindriye
rasastu viṣayo rūpaśabdasparśarasā guṇāḥ / maṇḍalaṃ vartulaṃ tacca puṇḍarīkāṅkitaṃ sitaṃ
svapnāvasthāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ / pratiṣṭhāntakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sañcintya bhuvanādikaṃ

sūtraṃ dehe svamantreṇa praviśyaināṃ viyojayet / oṃ hāṃ khīṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya oṃ phaṭ svāhāntenānainaiva pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā samākarṣet tataḥ oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ(1) pratiṣṭhā kalāpāśāya hrūṃ phaḍityanena saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakena hṛdayādadho nāḍī-[!!!] 1 oṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hāṃ hūṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 270 sūtrādādāya oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ity anenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe samāropayet oṃ hāṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ity anenārcayitvā sampūjya svāhāntenāhutīnāṃ trayeṇa sannidhāya tataḥ oṃ hāṃ viṣṇave nama iti viṣṇumāvāhya sampūjya santarpya viṣṇo tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayediti / tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ vāgīśamapi pūrvavat
āvāhyābhyarcya santarpya śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet / oṃ hāṃ hāṃ haṃ phaṭ(2)praviśedapyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭayāṅkuśamudrayā / oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(3) svāhāntena hṛdākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā
gṛhītvā taṃ namontena nijātmani niyojayet(4) / oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ (5) ātmane namaḥ pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā(6)
vāmayā tadanenaiva devīgarbhe vinikṣipet / oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ dehotpattau hṛdā hy evaṃ śirasā janmanā tathā

1 oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ phaṭ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 nivedayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 6 bhāvayitvā tu dakṣayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 271 śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā / tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānāya pūrvavat
śirasā pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet / evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi tataḥ śāstrajaptayā
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījavatā yathā / oṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya haḥ phaṭ visṛjya vartulīkṛtya(1) pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat
ghṛtapūrṇe śrave datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet / astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuranivṛttaye
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ / oṃ haḥ astrāya hrūṃ phaṭhṛdāvāhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtvā pūjatarpaṇe
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ / oṃ hāṃ rasaśulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya hare tvayā
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti / tato visṛjya govindaṃ vidyātmānaṃ niyojya ca
bāhumuktārdhadṛśyena candravimbena sannibhaṃ / saṃhāramudrayā svasthaṃ(2) vidhāyodbhavamudrayā

sūtre saṃyojya vinyasya toyavinduṃ yathā purā / visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ / 1 vardhanīkṛtyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 saṃhāramadrayātmasthaṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 272 dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena pratiṣṭhāpi viśodhitā
vidyāviśodhanavidhānaṃ īśvara uvāca sandhānamatha vidyāyāḥ prācīnakalayā saha / kurvīta pūrvavat kṛtvā(1) tattvaṃ varṇaya tadyathā
oṃ hoṃ kṣīmiti sandhānaṃ rāgś ca śuddhavidyā ca niyatiḥ kalayā saha / kālo mayā tathāvidyā tattvānāmiti saptakaṃ
ralavāḥ śaṣasāḥ varṇāḥ ṣaḍ vidyāyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ / padāni praṇavādīni ekaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā

oṃ namaḥ śivāya sarvaprabhave haṃ śivāya(2) īśānamūrdhāya tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevaguhyāya(3) sadyojātamūrtaye(4) oṃ namo namo guhyātiguhyāya goptre anidhāya sarvādhipāya(5) jyotirūpāya prameśvārāya bhavena oṃ vyoma 1 pūrvavat dhṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 iṃ śivāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 vacoguhyāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 sadyojātāya mūrtaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 atha nidhāya sarvādhipataya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 273 oṃ rudrāṇāṃ bhuvanānāñca svarūpamatha kaśyape / prathamo vāmadevaḥ syāttataḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ
vajradehaḥ prabhurdhātā kravikramasuprabhāḥ / vaṭuḥ(1) praśāntanāmā ca paramākṣarasañjñakaḥ
śivaś ca saśivo babhrurakṣayaḥ śambhureva ca / adṛṣṭarūpanāmānau tathānyo rūpavardhanaḥ
manonmano mahāvīryaścitrāṅgastadanantaraṃ / kalyāṇa iti vijñeyāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā
mantro ghorāmarau vīje nāḍyau dve tatra te yathā / pūṣā ca hastijihvā ca vyānanāgau prabhañjanau
viṣayo rūpamevaikamindriye pādacakṣuṣī / śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca traya ete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
avasthātra ṣuptiś ca rudro devastu kāraṇaṃ / vidyāmadhyagataṃ sarvaṃ bhāvayedbhavanādikaṃ
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ tatra praveśañcāpi yojanaṃ / ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryādvidyayā hṛtpradeśataḥ
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet / rudraṃ kāraṇamāvāhya vijñāpya ca śiśuṃ prati
pitrorāvahanaṃ kṛtvā(2) hṛdaye tāḍayecchiśuṃ / praviśya pūrvamantreṇa tadātmani niyojayet
ākṛṣyādāya pūrvoktavidhinā.atmani yojayet / vāmayā yojayet yonau gṛhītvā dvādaśāntataḥ
1 buddha iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 āvāhanaṃ kuryāditi ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 274 kurvīta dehasampattiṃ janmādhikārameva ca / bhogaṃ layantathā śrotaḥśuddhitattvaviśodhanaṃ
niḥśeṣamalakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye / niṣkṛtyaiva vidhānena yajeta śatamāhutīḥ
astreṇa pāśaśaithilyaṃ malaśaktiṃ tirohitāṃ / chedanaṃ mardanaṃ teṣāṃ vartulīkaraṇaṃ tathā(1)
dāhaṃ tadakṣarābhāvaṃ prāyaścittamathoditaṃ / rudrāṇyāvāhanaṃ pūjā rūpagandhasamarpaṇaṃ
oṃ hrīṃ rūpagandhau śulkaṃ rudra gṛhāṇa svāhā saṃśrāvya śāmbhavīmājñāṃ rudraṃ visṛjya kāraṇaṃ / vidhāyātmani caitanyaṃ pāśasūtre niveśayet
vinduṃ śirasi vinyasya visṛjet pitarau tataḥ / dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena samastavidhipūraṇīṃ
pūrvoktavidhinā kāryaṃ vidyāyāṃ tāḍanādikaṃ / svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syāditi vidyā viśodhitā
śāntiśodhanakathanaṃ īśvara uvāca sandadhyādadhunā vidyāṃ śāntyā sārdhaṃ yathāvidhi / śāntau tattvadvayaṃ līnaṃ bhāveśvarasadāśivau
1 chedanaṃ bhedanaṃ teṣāṃ bahulīkaraṇantathā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 275 hakāraś ca kṣakāraś ca dvau varṇau parikīrtitau / rudrāḥ samānanāmāno bhuvanaiḥ saha tadyathā
prabhavaḥ samayaḥ kṣudro vimalaḥ śiva ity api / ghanau nirañjanākārau svaśivau dīptikāraṇau
tridaśeśvaranāmā ca tridaśaḥ kālasajjñakaḥ / sūkṣmāmbujeśvaraśceti(1) rudrāḥ śāntau pratiṣṭhitāḥ

vyomavyāpine vyomavyāpyarūpāya(2) sarvavyāpine śivāya anantāya anāthāya anāśritāya dhruvāya śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya nityayogine dhyānāhārāyeti(3) dvādaśapādāni puruṣaḥ kavacau mantrau vīje vindūpakārakau / alambuṣāyasānāḍyau vāyū kṛkarakarmakau
indriye tvakkarāvasyā sparśastu viṣayo mataḥ / guṇau sparśaninādau dvāvekaḥ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ
turmyāvastheti śāntisthaṃ sambhāvya bhuvanādikaṃ / vidadhyāttāḍanaṃ bhedaṃ praveśañca viyojanaṃ
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryācchāntervadanasūtrataḥ / ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet
īśaṃ tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ / bhavyaṃ tvayānukūlena(4) kuryāt vijñāpanāmiti

āvāhanādikaṃ pitroḥ śiṣyasya tāḍanādikaṃ / 1 sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraś caiva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 vyomavyāpakarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyomarūpāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 dhyāyaparāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyānāhārāyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 276 vidhāyādāya caitanyaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā / hṛtsampuṭātmavījena devīgarbhe niyojayet
dehotpattau hṛdā pañca śirasā janmahetave / śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā
layāya śastramantreṇa śrotaḥśuddhau śivena ca / tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānādi pūrvavat
varmaṇā pāśaśaithilyaṃ niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet / malaśaktitirodhane śastreṇāhutipañcakaṃ
evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi(1) tataḥ saptāstrajaptayā / chindyādastreṇa kartaryā pāśānvījavatā yathā
oṃ hauṃ(2) śāntikalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat / ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet
astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye / prāyaścittaniṣedhāya dadyādaṣṭāhutīratha
oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ hṛdeśvaraṃ samāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe / vidadhīta vidhānena tasmai śulkasamarpaṇaṃ
oṃ hāṃ īśvara buddhyahaṅkārau śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasyeśvara tvayā / na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti

1 ekaṃ pāśaviyogārthamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hy aimiti ka, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ omiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ yaimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 277 visṛjedīśvarandevaṃ raudrātmānaṃ niyojayet / īṣaccandramivātmānaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet
sūtre saṃyojayedenaṃ śuddhayodbhavamudrayā / dadyāt mūlena śiṣyasya śirasyamṛtavindukaṃ
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ / dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānajño niḥśeṣavidhipūraṇīṃ
asyāmapi vidhātavyaṃ pūrvavattāḍanādiakaṃ / svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syācchuddhiḥ śānterapīḍitā
nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca sandhānaṃ śāntyatītāyāḥ śāntyā sārdhaṃ viśuddhayā / kurvīta pūrvavattatra tattvavarṇādi tad yathā
oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ iti sandhānāni ubhau śaktiśivau tattve bhuvanāṣṭakasiddhikaṃ / dīpakaṃ rocikañcaiva mocakaṃ cordhvagāmi ca
vyomarūpamanāthañca syādanāśritanaṣṭamaṃ / oṅkārapadamīśāne mantro varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa
akārādivisargāntā vījena dehakārakau / kuhūś ca śaṅkhinī nāḍyau devadattadhanañjayau
marutau sparśanaṃ śrotraṃ indriye viṣayo nabhaḥ / śabdo guṇo 'syāvasthā tu turyātītā tu pañcamī
hetuḥ sadāśivo deva iti tattvādisañcayaṃ / sañcintya śāntyatītākhyaṃ vidadhyāttāḍanādikaṃ
kalāpāśaṃ samātāḍya phaḍantena vibhidya ca / praviśyāntar namo 'ntena phaḍantena viyojayet
śikhāhṛtsampuṭībhūtaṃ svāhāntaṃ sṛṇimudrayā / pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya pāśaṃ mastakasūtrataḥ
kumbhakena samādāya recakenodbhavākhyayā / hṛtsampuṭanamo 'ntena vahniṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet
asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivṛtteriva sādhayet / sadāśivaṃ samāvāhya pūjayitvā pratarpya ca
sadā khyāte 'dhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ / bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena bhaktyā vijñāpayediti
pitrorāvāhanaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇasannidhī / hṛtsampuṭātmavījena śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ praviśya cāpyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ / śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhayāṅkuśamudrayā
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ(1) svāhāntena tadākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā / gṛhītvā tannamo 'ntena nijātmani niyojayet

oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ ātmane namaḥ(2) 1 oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 279 pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā / vāmayā tadanenaiva(1) devyā garbhe niyojayet
garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret / mūlena pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaiva śataṃ japet
malaśaktitirodhāne pāśānāñca viyojane / pañcapañcāhutīrdadyādāyudhena yathā purā
pāśānāyudhamantreṇa sapravārābhijaptayā / chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījayujā yathā
oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśānastreṇa pūrvavat / ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet
astreṇa juhuyāt pajca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye / prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ
sadāśivaṃ hṛdāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe / pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ
oṃ hāṃ sadāśiva manovindu śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya sadāśiva / bandhāya na tvayā stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti
mūlena juhuyāt pūrṇāṃ visṛjettu sadāśivaṃ / tato viśuddhamātmānaṃ śaraccandramivoditaṃ
saṃhāramudrayā raudryā saṃyojya gururātmani / kurvīta śiṣyadehasthamuddhṛtyodbhavamudrayā
dadyādāpyāyanāyāsya mastake 'rghyāmbuvindukaṃ / kṣamayitvā mahābhaktyā pitarau visṛjettathā
1 vāmayā hṛdayenaiveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 280 kheditau śiṣyadīkṣāyai yanmayā pitarau yuvāṃ / kāruṇyanānmokṣayitvā tadvraja tvaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ
śikhāmantritakartaryā bodhaśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ / śikhāṃ chidyācchivāstreṇa śiṣyasya caturaṅgulāṃ
oṃ klīṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ(1) oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ sruci tāṃ ghṛtapūrṇāyāṃ goviḍgolakamadhyagāṃ(2) / saṃvidhāyāstramantreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena homayet
oṃ hauṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ prakṣālya sruksruvau śiṣyaṃ saṃsnāpyācamya ca svayaṃ / yojanikāsthānamātmānaṃ śastramantreṇa tāḍayet
viyojyākṛṣya sampūjya(3) pūrvavad dvādaśāntataḥ / ātmīyahṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ niveśayet
pūritaṃ śruvamājyena vihitādhomukhaśrucā / nityoktavidhinā.adāya śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā
prasāritaśirogrīvo nādoccārānusārataḥ / samadṛṣṭiśivaścāntaḥ parabhāvasamanvitaḥ
kumbhamaṇḍalavahnibhyaḥ(4) śiṣyādapi nijātmanaḥ / gṛhītvā ṣaḍvidhavidhānaṃ śrugagre prāṇanāḍikaṃ
sañcintya vinduvad dhyātvā kramaśaḥ saptadhā yathā / prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃyogasvarūpamaparantataḥ

1 oṃ hūṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hrīṃ śikhāyai hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 govindalokamadhyagāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 viyojyākṛṣya saṅgṛhyeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 kuṇḍamaṇḍalavahnibhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 281 hṛdayādikramoccāravisṛṣṭaṃ mantrasañjñakaṃ / pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk
suṣumṇānugataṃ nādasvarūpantu tṛtīyakaṃ / saptame kāraṇe tyāgātpraśāntavikharaṃ layaḥ
śaktinādordhvasañcārastacchaktivikharaṃ mataṃ / prāṇasya nikhilasyāpi śaktiprameyavarjitaṃ
tatkālavikharaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ śaktyatītañca saptamaṃ / tadetad yojanāsthānaṃ vikharantattvasañjñakaṃ
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk / śanair udīrayan mūlaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmano layaṃ
hakāre taḍidākāre ṣaḍadhvajaprāṇarūpiṇi / ukāraṃ parato nābhervitastiṃ vyāpya saṃsthitaṃ
tataḥ paraṃ makārantu hṛdayāccaturaṅgulaṃ / oṅkāraṃ vācakaṃ viṣṇostato 'ṣṭāṅgulakaṇṭhakaṃ
caturaṅgulatālusthaṃ makāraṃ rudravācakaṃ / tadvallalāṭamadhyasthaṃ vindumīśvaravācakaṃ
nādaṃ sadāśivaṃ devaṃ brahmarandhrāvasānakaṃ / śaktiṃ ca brahmarandhrasthāṃ tyajannityamanukramāt
divyaṃ pipīlikāsparśaṃ tasminnevānubhūya ca / dvādaśānte pare tattve paramānandalakṣaṇe
bhāvaśūnye mano 'tīte śive nityaguṇodaye / vilīya mānase tasmin śiṣyātmānaṃ vibhāvayet
vimuñcan sarpiṣo dhārāṃ jvālānte 'pi pare śive / yojanikāsthiratvāya vauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā(1)

1 vauṣaḍantaśivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 282 datvā pūrṇāṃ vidhānena guṇāpadānamacaret / oṃ hāṃ ātmane(1) sarvajño bhava svāhā / oṃ hāṃ ātmane(2) paritṛpto bhava svāhā / oṃ hrūṃ ātmane(3) anādibodho bhava svāhā/ oṃ hauṃ ātmane(4) svatantro bhava svāhā / oṃ hauṃ ātman(5)aluptaśaktirbhava svāhā / oṃ haḥ ātmane(6) anantaśaktirbhavasvāhāitthaṃ ṣaḍguṇamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā paramākṣarāt
vidhinā bhāvanopetaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojayet / tīvrāṇuśaktisampātajanitaśramaśāntaye
śiṣyamūrdhani vinyasyedarghyādamṛtavindukaṃ / praṇamayyeśakumbhādīn śivāddakṣiṇamaṇḍale(7)
saumyavaktraṃ vyavasthāpya śiṣyaṃ dakṣiṇamātmanaḥ / tvayaivānugṛhīto 'yaṃ mūrtimāsthāya māmakīṃ
deve vahnau gurau tasmādbhaktiṃ cāpyasya vardhaya(8) / iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ praṇamya ca guruḥ svayaṃ

1 oṃ hrīṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 2 oṃ hrīṃ ātmane iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hīṃ ātmanniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 3 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ ātmanniti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 4 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ huṃ ātmanniti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 5 oṃ haiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 7 śivadakṣiṇamaṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ 8 bhaktiṃ nāthāsya vardhayeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 283 śreyastavāstviti brūyādāśiṣaṃ śiṣyamādarāt / tataḥ paramayā bhaktyā datvā deve 'ṣṭapuṣpikāṃ / putrakaṃ śivakumbhena saṃsnāpya visṛjenmakhaṃ
ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca athaikatāttvikī dīkṣā laghutvādupadiśyate / sūtrabandhādi kurvīta yathāyogaṃ nijātmanā
kālāgnyādiśivāntāni tattvāni parabhāvayet / samatattve samagrāṇi sūtre maṇigaṇāniva
āvāhya śivatattvādi garbhādhānādi pūrvavat / mūlena kintu kurvīta sarvaśulkasamarpaṇaṃ
pradadīta tataḥ pūrṇāṃ tattvavātopagarbhitāṃ / ekayaiva yayā śiṣyo nirvāṇamadhigacchati
yojanāyai śive cānyāṃ sthiratvāpādanāya ca / datvā pūrṇāṃ prakurvīta śivakumbhābhiṣecanaṃ
abhiṣekādikathanaṃ īśvara uvāca śivamabhyarcyābhiṣekaṃ kuryācchiṣyādike śriye / kumbhānīśādikāṣṭhāsu kramaśo nava vinyaset
teṣu kṣārodaṃ kṣīrodaṃ dadhyudaṃ ghṛtasāgaraṃ / ikṣukādambarīsvādumastūdānaṣṭasāgarān(1)
niveśayed yathāsaṅkhyamaṣṭau vidyeśvarānatha / ekaṃ śikhaṇḍinaṃ rudraṃ śrīkaṇṭhantu dvitīyakaṃ
trimūrtamekarudrākṣamekanetraṃ śivottamaṃ / saptamaṃ sūkṣmanāmānamanantaṃ rudramaṣṭamaṃ
madhye śivaṃ samudrañca śivamantraṃ ca vinyaset / yāgālayān digīśasya racite snānamaṇḍape
kuryāt karadvayāyāmāṃ vedīmaṣṭāṅgulocchritāṃ / śrīparṇādyāsane tatra vinyasyānantamānasaṃ
śiṣyaṃ niveśya pūrvāsyaṃ sakalīkṛtya pūjayet / kāñjikaudanamṛdbhasmadūrvāgomayagolakaiḥ
siddhārthadadhitoyaiś ca kuryānnirmañchanaṃ tataḥ / kṣārodānukrameṇātha hṛdā vidyeśaśambaraiḥ
kalasaiḥ snāpayecchiṣyaṃ svadhādhāraṇayānvitaṃ / paridhāpya site vastre niveśya śivadakṣiṇe
pūrvoditāsane śiṣyaṃ punaḥ pūrvavadarcayet / uṣṇīṣaṃ yogapaṭṭañca mukuṭaṃ kartarīṃ ghaṭīṃ
akṣamālāṃ pustakādi śivakādyadhikārakaṃ / 1 svādugargodānaṣṭasāgarāniti ka, kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 285 dīkṣāvyākhyāpratiṣṭhādyaṃ jñātvādyaprabhṛti tvayā
suparīkṣya(1) vidhātavyamājñāṃ saṃśrāvayediti / abhivādya tataḥ śiṣyaṃ praṇipatya maheśvaraṃ
vighnajvālāpanodārthaṃ kuryādvijñāpanāṃ yathā / abhiṣekārthamādiṣṭastvayāhaṃ gurumūrtinā
saṃhitāpāragaḥ so 'yamabhiṣikto mayā śiva / tṛptaye mantracakrasya pañcapañcāhutīryajet
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ tataḥ śiṣyaṃ sthāpayennijadakṣiṇe / śiṣyadakṣiṇapāṇisthā aṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīḥ kramāt
lāñchayedupabaddhāya dagdhadarbhāgraśambaraiḥ / kusumāni kare datvā praṇāmaṃ kārayedamuṃ
kumbhe 'nale śive svasmisaṃstataskṛtyamāviśet / anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śāstreṇa suparīkṣitāḥ
bhūpavanmānavādīnāmabhiṣekādabhīpsitaṃ / āṃ śrāṃ śrauṃ paśuṃ hūṃ phaḍiti astrarājābhiṣekataḥ
vividhamantrādikathanaṃ īśvara uvāca abhiṣiktaḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedbhāskarādikān / śaṅkhabheryādinirghoṣaiḥ snāpayet pañcagavyakaiḥ
1 svayaṃ vīkṣyeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 286 yo devāndevalokaṃ sa yāti svakulamuddharan / varṣakoṭisahasreṣu yat pāpaṃ smupārjitaṃ
ghṛtābhyaṅgena devānāṃ bhasmībhavati pāvake / āḍhakena ghṛtādyaiś ca devān snāpya suro bhavet
candanenānulipyātha gandhādyaiḥ pūjayettathā / alpāyāsanaṃ stutibhistutā devāstu sarvadā
atītānāgatajñānamantradhībhuktimuktidāḥ / gṛhītvā praśnasūkṣmārṇe hṛte dvābhyāṃ śubhāśubhaṃ
tribhirjīvo mūladhātuś caturbhirbrāhmaṇādidhīḥ / yañcādau bhūtatattvādi śeṣe caivaṃ japādikaṃ
ekatrikātitrikānte pade dvipamakāntake / aśubhaṃ madhyamaṃ madhyeṣvindrastriṣu nṛpaḥ śubhaḥ
saṅkhyāvṛnde jīvitābdaṃ yamo 'bdadaśahā dhruvaṃ / sūryebhāsyeśadurgāśrīviṣṇumantrair likhet kaje
kaṭhinyā japtayā spṛṣṭe gomūtrākṛtirekhayā / ārabhyaikaṃ trikaṃ yāvattricatuṣkāvasānakaṃ
marud vyoma marudvījaiś catuḥṣaṣṭipade tathā / akṣāṇāṃ patanāt sparśādviṣamādau śubhādikaṃ
ekatrikādimārabhya ante cāṣṭatrikaṃ tathā / dhvajādyāyāḥ samā hīnā viṣamāḥ śobhanādidāḥ(1)
āipallavitaiḥ kādyaiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarapūrvagaiḥ / ādyaistaiḥ sasvaraiḥ kādyaistripurānāmamantrakāḥ
hrīṃ vījāḥ praṇavādyāḥspur namo 'ntā yatra pūjane / mantrā viṃśatisāhasrāḥ śataṃ ṣaṣṭhyadhikaṃ tataḥ
1 śobhanādikāḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 287 āṃ hrīṃ mantrāḥ sarasvatyāś caṇḍikāyāstathaiva ca / tathā gauryāś ca durgāyā āṃ śrīṃ mantrāḥ śriyas tathā
tathākṣauṃ krauṃ mantrāḥ sūryasya(1) āṃ hauṃ mantrāḥśivasya ca / āṃ gaṃ mantrā gaṇeśasya āṃ mantrāś ca tathā hareḥ
śatārdhaikādhikaiḥ kādyais tathā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kharaiḥ / kādyaistaiḥ sasvaraisādyaiḥ kāntair mantrās tathākhilāḥ
ravīśadevīviṣṇūnāṃ svābdhidevendravartanāt / śatatrayaṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kramāt / abhiṣikto japed dhyāyecchiṣyādīn dīkṣayedguruḥ
pratiṣṭhāvidhikathanaṃ īśvara uvāca pratiṣṭhāṃ sampravakṣyāmi kramāt saṅkṣepato guha / pīṭhaṃ śaktiṃ śivo liṅgaṃ tadyogaḥ sā śivāṇubhiḥ
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pañca bhedāsteṣāṃ rūpaṃ vadāmi te / yatra brahmaśilāyogaḥ sā pratiṣṭhā viśeṣataḥ
sthāpanantu yathāyogaṃ pīṭha eva niveśanaṃ / pratiṣṭhābhinnapīṭhasya sthitasthāpanamucyate
utthāpanañca sā proktā liṅgoddhārapuraḥsarā / yasyāṃ tu liṅgamāropya saṃskāraḥ kriyate budhaiḥ
1 tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasyeti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ :p 288 āthāpanaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dvidhā viṣṇvādikasya ca(1) / āsu sarvāsu caitanyaṃ niyuñjīta paraṃ śivam
yadādhārādibhedena(2) prāsādeṣvapi pañcadhā / parīkṣamatha medinyāḥ kuryātprāsādakāmyayā
śuklājyagandhā raktā ca raktagandhā sugandhinī(3) / pītā kṛṣṇā surāgandhā viprādīnāṃ mahī kramāt
pūrveśottarasarvatra pūrvā caiṣāṃ viśiṣyate(4) / ākhāte hāstike yasyāḥ pūrṇe mṛdadhikā bhavet
uttamāntāṃ mahīṃ vidyāttoyādyair vā samukṣitāṃ / asthyaṅgārādibhirduṣṭāmatyantaṃ śodhayed guruḥ(5)
nagaragrāmadurgārthaṃ gṛhaprāsādakāraṇaṃ(6) / khananair gokulāvāsaiḥ karṣaṇair vā muhurmuhuḥ
maṇḍape dvārapūjādi mantratṛptyavasānakaṃ(7) / karma nirvartyāghorāstraṃ sahasraṃ(8) vidhinā yajet
samīkṛtyopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau saṃśodhayeddiśaḥ / svarṇadadhyakṣatai rekhāḥ prakurvīta(9) pradakṣiṇaṃ
madhyādīśānakoṣṭasthe pūrṇakumbhe(10) śivaṃ yajet / vāstumabhyarcya tattoyaiḥ siñcet kuddālakādikaṃ

1 utthāpanaścetyādi, viṣṇvādikasya cetyetyantaḥ sārdhaikaślokātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 2 yathādhārābhibhedeneti ga.. 3 raktagandhānugandhīti kha.. 4 praśasyate iti gha.. 5 śodhayetdhruvamiti gha.. 6 nagaragrāmetyardhaśloko gha. pustake nāsti 7 mantradīptyavasānakamiti ga.. / mantrabhūmyavasānakamiti gha.. 8 nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstramiti ga.. 9 rekhāṃ prakurvīteti kha.. ,ga.. ca 10 svarṇakuṇḍe iti ga.. / svarṇakumbhe iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca :p 289 bāhye rakṣogaṇāniṣṭvā vidhinā digbalaṃ kṣipet / bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsnāpya(1) kuddālādyaṃ(2) prapūjayet
anyaṃ vastrayugacchajñaṃ kumbhaṃ skandhe dvijanmanaḥ / nidhāya gītavādyādibrahmagoṣasamākulaṃ
pūjāṃ kumbhe samāhṛtya prāpte lagne 'gnikoṣṭhake / kuddālenābhiṣiktena madhvaktena tu khānayet
nairṛtyāṃ kṣepayenmṛtsnāṃ khāte kumbhajalaṃ kṣipet / purasya pūrvasīmantaṃ(3) nayed yāvadabhīpsitaṃ
atha tatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhrāmayet(4) paritaḥ puraṃ / siñcan sīmantacihnāni yāvadīśānagocaraṃ
arghyadānamidaṃ proktaṃ tatra kumbhaparibramāt / itthaṃ parigrahaṃ bhūmeḥ kurvīta tadanantaraṃ
karkarāntaṃ jalāntaṃ vā śalyadoṣajighāṃsayā / khānayed bhūḥ kumārīṃ ced vidhinā śalyamuddharet
akacaṭatapayaśahān mānavaścet praśnākṣarāṇi tu(5) / agnerdhvajādipātitāḥ svasthāne śalyamākhyānti
kartuścāṅgavikāreṇa jānīyāttatpramāṇataḥ / paśvādīnāṃ praveśena kīrtanair virutair diśaḥ
mātṛkāmaṣṭavargāḍhyāṃ phalake bhuvi vā likhet / śalyajñānaṃ vargavaśāt pūrvādīśāntataḥ(6) kramāt

avarge caiva lohantu kavarge 'ṅgāramagnitaḥ / 1 bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpyeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 2 kuddālākhyamiti ga.. 3 pūrvamīśāntamiti kha.. 4 srāvayet iti kha.. 5 nava cet praśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante iti ga.. , gha.. ca 6 pūrvādīnāṃ tata iti kha.. :p 290 cavarge bhasma dakṣe syāṭ ṭavarge 'sthi ca nairṛte
tavarge ceṣṭakā cāpye kapālañca pavargake / yavarge śavakītādi śavarge lohamādiśet
havarge rajataṃ tadvadavargāccānarthakarānapi / prīkṣyātmabhiḥ karāpūrair aṣṭāṅgulamṛdantaraiḥ
pādonaṃ khātamāpūrya sajalair mudgarāhataiḥ(1) / liptāṃ samaplavāṃ tatra kārayitvā bhuvaṃ guruḥ
sāmānyārghyakaro yāyānmaṇḍapaṃ vakṣyāmāṇakaṃ / toraṇadvāḥpatīniṣṭvā pratyagdvāreṇa saṃviśet
kuryāttatrātmaśuddhyādi kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃskṛtiṃ / kalasaṃ vardhanīsaktaṃ(2) lokapālaśivārcanaṃ
agnerjananapūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret / yajamānānvito(3) yāyācchilānāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ
śilāḥ prāsādaliṅgasya pādadharmādisañjñakāḥ / aṣṭāṅgulocchritāḥ śastāś caturasrāḥ karāyatāḥ
pāṣāṇānāṃ śilāḥ kāryā iṣṭakānāṃ tadardhataḥ / prāsāde 'śmaśilāḥ śaile iṣṭakā iṣṭakāmaye
aṅkitā navavaktrādyaiḥ(4) paṅkajāḥ paṅkajāṅkitāḥ / nandā bhadrā jayā riktā pūrṇākhyā pañcamī matā(5)
āsāṃ padmo mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkho 'tha makaras tathā / samudraśceti pañcāmī nidhikumbhāḥ kramādhaḥ

nandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā ajitā cāparājitā / 1 muśalair mudgarāhatair iti ṅa.. 2 vardhanīyuktamiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca 3 yajamānārcita iti gha.. 4 navarudrādyair iti gha.. 5 pāṣāṇānāmityādiḥ, pañcamīrmatā ity antaḥ ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti :p 291 vijayā maṅgalākhyā ca dharaṇī navamī śilā
subhadraś ca vibhadraś ca sunandaḥ puṣpanandakaḥ(1) / jayo 'tha vijayaś caiva kumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2)
navānāntu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nidhikumbhaḥ pūrṇastathottaraḥ(2) / āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā(3) tāḍyollikhyaśarāṇunā(4)
sarvāsāmaviśeṣeṇa tanutreṇāvaguṇṭhanaṃ(5) / mṛdbhirgomayayogāmūtrakaṣāyair gandhavāriṇā
astreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena(6) malasnānaṃ samācaret / vidhinā pañcagavyena snānaṃ pañcāmṛtena ca
gandhatoyāntaraṃ kuryānnijanāmāṅkitāṇunā(7) / phalaratnasuvarṇānāṃ gośṛṅgasalilaistataḥ
candanena samālabhya(8) vastrair ācchādayecchilāṃ / svarṇotthamāsanaṃ datvā nītvā yāgaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ
śayyāyāṃ kuśatalpe vā hṛdayena niveśayet(9) / sampūjya nyasya buddhyādidharāntaṃ tattvasañcayaṃ
trikhaṇḍavyāpakaṃ tattvatrayañcānukramān nyaset / buddhyādau cittaparyante cintātanmātrakāvadhau(10)

1 puṣpadantaka it kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 2 pūrvastathottara iti gha.. 3 praṇavaṃ datvā iti kha.. 4 śarātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , ca 5 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhanamiti kha.. 6 huṃ phaḍanteneti ga.. 7 kuryād dvijanāmāṅkitātmaneti kha.. / kuryān nijanāmāṅkitātmaneti ga.. 8 samālipyeti ga.. 9 kuśatalpe vā hṝdayena viśeṣayet iti kha.. / kuśatalpe ca hṛdayena niveśayet iti ga.. 10 buddhyādau cittaparyante cittatanmātrakāvadhau iti gha.. / sampacya ity ādiḥ tanmātrakāvadhāvityantaḥ sārdhaikaślokapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti :p 292 tanmātrādau dharānte ca śivavidyātmanāṃ sthitiḥ / tattvāni nijamantreṇa tattveśāṃś ca hṛdārcayet

sthāneṣu puṣpamālādicihniteṣu yathākramaṃ / oṃ hūṃ(1) śivatattvāya namaḥ / oṃ hūṃ(2) śivatattvādhipataye rudrāya namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ(3) vidyātattvādhipāya(4) viṣṇave namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ(5)kṣamāgniyajamānārkān jalavātendukhāni ca
pratitattvaṃ nyasedaṣṭau mūrtīḥ pratiśilāṃ śilāṃ / sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ cograṃ(6) rudraṃ bhavamatheśvaraṃ(7)
mahādevaṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca mūrtīśāṃś ca yathākramāt / oṃ dharāmūrtaye namaḥ, oṃ dharādhipataye namaḥ,ityādimantrān lokapālān yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nijāṇubhiḥ(8)
vinyasya pūjayet kumbhāṃstanmantrair vā nijāṇubhiḥ(9) / indrādīnāṃ tu vījāni vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tu

lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ yūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūmiti(10) ukto navaśilāpakṣaḥ śilā pañcapadā tathā / 1,2 oṃ hraṃ iti ga.. , gha.. ca 3 oṃ hīṃ iti gha.. 4 vidyātattvādhipataye iti kha.. 5 oṃ hūṃ śivatattvādhipataye ity ādiḥ, oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye brahmaṇe nama ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 6 paśupatiṃ bhīmamiti gha.. 7 bhavamakheśvaram iti gha.. 8,9 nijātmabhiriti kha.. , ga.. / vinyasyetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti 10 oṃ hūṃ ghūṃ būṃ yūṃ mūṃ haṃ kṣamitīti ga.. / oṃ kaṃ sūṃ pūṃ śūṃ hrūṃ kṣamitīti gha.. / lūṃ rūṃ śūṃ pūṃ vūṃ cūṃ mūṃ hūṃ kṣūmitīti kha.. :p 293 pratitattvaṃ nyasenmūrtīḥ sṛṣṭyā pañca dharādikāḥ
brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudra īśvaraś ca sadāśivaḥ / ete ca pañca mūrtīśā yaṣṭavyāstāsu(1) pūrvavat
oṃ pṛthvīmūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ pṛthvīmūrtyadhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ / ity ādi mantrāḥ sampūjya kalaśān pañca krameṇa nijanāmabhiḥ / nirundhīta(2) vidhānena nyāso madhyaśilākramāt
kuryāt prākāramantreṇa bhūtidarbhaistataḥ / kuṇḍeṣu dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcya tarpayet
tattvatattvādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃś ca(3) ghṛtādibhiḥ / tato brahmāṃśaśuddhyarthaṃ mūlāṅgaṃ brahmabhiḥ kramāt
kṛtvā śatādipūrṇāntaṃ prokṣyāḥ śāntijalaiḥśilāḥ(4) / pūjayecca kuśaiḥ spṛṣṭvā pratitattvamanukramāt
sāṃnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ kṛtvā śuddhaṃ(5) punarnyaset(6) / evaṃ bhāgatraye karma gatvā gatvā samācaret

oṃ āṃ īṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvābhyāṃ namaḥ(7) iti / 1 nyastavystāsu iti kha.. 2 nibadhnītīti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca 3 tatra tatrādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃśceti ṅa.. /tantratattvādhipān mūrtīrmūrtīśāṃsveti kha.. 4 prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilāmiti kha.. / prokṣya śāntijalaiḥ śilā iti ga.. , gha.. ca 5 kṛtvā mantramiti ga.. 6 sānnidhyamityarthaśloko ṅa.. pustake nāsti / sānnidhyamatha sandhānaṃ ity ataḥ paraṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ ity ataḥ prāṅmadhvagapāṭho gha.. pustake nāsti 7 oṃ āṃ hāṃ ātmatattvavidyātattvāya nama iti ga.. / oṃ āṃ iṃ uṃ vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ nama iti ḍa.. / oṃ āṃ iṃ ātmavidyātattvāya nama iti kha.. :p 294 saṃspṛśed darbhamūlādyair brahmāṅgāditrayaṃ kramāt / kuryāttattvānusandhānaṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥ
oṃ hāṃ uṃ(1) vidyātattvaśivatattvābhyāṃ namaḥ / ghṛtena madhunā pūrṇāṃstāmrakumbhān saratnakān / pañcagavyārghyarsasiktān(2) lokapālādhidaivatān
pūjayitvā nijair mantraiḥ sannidhau homamācaret / śilānāmatha sarvāsāṃ saṃsmaredadhidaivatāḥ
vidyārūpāḥ kṛtasnānā hemavārṇāḥ śilāmbarāḥ / nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ(3) vāstubhūmeś ca śuddhaye / yajedastreṇa mūrdhāntamāhutīnāṃ(4) śataṃ śataṃ
vāstupūjādividhānam īśvara uvāca tataḥ prāsādamāsūtrya vartayedvāstumaṇḍapaṃ(5) / kuryāt koṣṭhacatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ kṣetre vedāsrake same

koṇeṣu vinyased vaṃśau(6) rajjavo 'ṣṭau vikoṇagāḥ / 2 pañcagavyena saṃsiktān iti ga.. 3 nyūnādidoṣanāśārthamiti gha.. 4 yajedasreṇa śuddhyarthamāhutīnāmiti gha.. 5 vāstumaṇḍalamiti ga. ṅa.. / tata iti ślokārdhaṃ gha.. pustake nāsti 6 vinyasedvaṃśamiti kha.. :p 295 dvipadāḥ ṣaṭpadāstāstu vāstuntatrārcayed yathā
ākuñcitakacaṃ(1) vāstumuttānamasurākṛtiṃ(2) / smaret pūjāsu kuḍyādiniveśe uttarānanaṃ
jānunī kūrparau śakthi diśi vātahutāśayoḥ / paitryāṃ pādapuṭe raudryāṃ śiro 'sya hṛdaye 'ñjaliḥ
asya dehe samārūḍhā devatāḥ pūjitāḥ śubhāḥ / aṣṭau koṇādhipāstatra koṇārdheṣvaṣṭasu sthitāḥ(3)
ṣaṭpadāstu marīcyādyā dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt / madhye catuṣpado brahmā śeṣāstu padikāḥ(4) smṛtāḥ
samastanāḍīsaṃyoge mahāmarmānujaṃ phalaṃ / triśūlaṃ svastikaṃ vajraṃ(5) mahāsvastikasampuṭau
trikuṭuṃ(9) maṇibandhaṃ ca suviśuddhaṃ padaṃ tathā / iti dvādaśa marmāṇi vāstorbhittyādiṣu tyajet
sājyamakṣatamīśāya parjanyāyāmbujodakaṃ / dadītātha jayantāya patākāṃ kuṅkumojjvalāṃ(7)
ratnavāri mahendrāya ravau dhūmraṃ vitānakaṃ / satyāya ghṛtagodhūmamājyabhaktaṃ bhṛśāya ca
vimāṃsamantarīkṣāya śuktuntebhyastu pūrvataḥ / madhukṣīrājyasampūrṇāṃ pradadyādvahnaye śrucaṃ

lājān pūrṇaṃ suvarṇāmbu vitathāya nivedayet / 1 ākuñcitakaramiti gha.. 2 kuryādityādiḥ muttānamasurākṛtimityantaḥ ślokadvayātmakapāṭho ga.. pustakake nāsti 3 koṇārdheṣu vyavasthitā iti gha.. 4 pādikā iti kha.. 5 muṣṭikaṃ vaktramiti kha.. 6 trikoṣṭhamiti ga.. 7 dadīteti ardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti :p 296 dadyād gṛhakṣate kṣaudraṃ(1) yamarāje palaudanaṃ(2)
gandhaṃ gandharvanāthāya jihvāṃ bhṛṅgāya pakṣiṇaḥ / mṛgāya padmaparṇāni(3) yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatāḥ(4)
pitre tilodakaṃ kṣīraṃ vṛkṣajaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ / dauvārikāya devāya pradadyād dhenumudrayā(5)
sugrīvāya diśet pūpān puṣpadantāya darbhakaṃ / raktaṃ pracetase padmamasurāya(6) surāsavaṃ
ghṛtaṃ guḍaudanaṃ śeṣe rogāya ghṛtamaṇḍakān / lājān vā paścimāśāyāṃ devāṣṭakamitīritaṃ
mārutāya dhvajaṃ pītaṃ nāgāya nāgakeśaraṃ / mukhye bhakṣyāṇi bhallāṭe mudgasūpaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ
somāya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ śālūkamūṣaye(7) diśet / lopīmaditaye dityai purīmityuttarāṣṭakaṃ(8)
modakān brahmaṇaḥ prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādāya marīcaye / savitre raktapuṣpāṇi vahnyadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyāt sāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ(9) / dakṣiṇe candanaṃ(10) raktaṃ ṣaṭpadāya vivasvate

haridraudanamindrāya rakṣodhaḥkrīṇakoṣṭhake / 1 bhūtakṣaye raudramiti kha.. , cha.. ca / gṛhakṛte kṣaudramiti gha.. 2 phalaudanamiti kha. gha.. ca 3 yavaparṇānīti gha.. / padmavarṇānīti kha.. cha.. ca 4 yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatā iti kha.. 5 pradadyādaghamudrayeti kha.. / pradadyādvanamudrayeti gha.. , cha.. ca 6 padmaṃ sambarāyeti gha.. 7 śālūkaṃ śṛṇayeti kha.. , cha.. ca 8 purīmityavarāṣṭakamiti ga.. 9 savitre ca kuśodakamiti ga.. 10 sāvitryai candanamiti ga.. :p 297 indrajayāya miśrānnamindrādhastānnivedayet
varuṇyāṃ ṣaṭpadāsīne mitre saṅuḍamodanaṃ / rudrāya ghṛtasiddhānnaṃ vāyukoṇādhare pade
tadadho rudradāsāya māsaṃ mārgamathottare / dadīta māṣanaivedyaṃ(1) ṣaṭpadasthe dharādhare(2)
āpāya śivakoṇādhaḥ tadvatsāya ca tatsthale(3) / kramāddadyāddadhikṣīraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ
catuṣpade niviṣṭāya brahmaṇe madhmadeśataḥ / pañcagavyākṣatopetañcaruṃ sājyaṃ nivedayet
īśādivāyuparyantakoṇeṣvatha yathākramaṃ / vāstuvāhye carakyādyāś catasraḥ pūjayed yathā
carakyai(4) saghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ vidāryai(5) dadhipaṅkaje / pūtanāyai palaṃ pittaṃ rudhiraṃ ca nivedayet
asthīni pāparākṣasyai raktapittapalāni ca / tato māṣaudanaṃ(6) prācyāṃ skandāya vinivedayet
aryamṇe dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ pūpān kṛsarayā yutān / jambhakāya(7) ca vāruṇyāmāmiṣaṃ rudhirānvitaṃ
udīcyāṃ pilipiñjāya(8) raktānnaṃ kusumāni ca / yajedvā sakalaṃ vāstuṃ kuśadadhyakṣaterjalaiḥ

1 māṃsanaivedyamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca 2 varādhare iti gha.. 3 āpavatsacatuṣṭaye iti kha.. / tadvatsāyai ca tattale iti gha.. , ja.. ca 4 vārāhyai iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca 5 vipace iti kha.. , cha.. ca 6 tato māṃsaudanamiti kha. gha.. cha.. ca 7 kumbhakāyeti cha.. 8 pilipicchāyeti ṅa.. / lipipiñjāyeti cha.. :p 298 gṛhe ca nagarādau ca ekāśītipadair yajet / tripadā rajjavaḥ kāryāḥ ṣaṭpadāś ca vikoṇake
īśādyāḥ pādikāstasminnāgadyāś ca dvikoṣṭhagāḥ(1) / ṣaṭpadasthā marīcyādyā brahmā navapadaḥ smṛtaḥ
nagaragrāmakheṭādau vāstuḥ śatapado 'pi(2) vā / vaṃśadvayaṃ koṇagataṃ durjayaṃ durdharaṃ sadā
yathā devālaye nyasas tathā śatapade hitaḥ / grahāḥ skandādayastatra vijñeyāś caiva ṣaṭpadāḥ
carakyādyā bhūtapadā rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat / deśasaṃsthāpane(3) vāstu catustriṃśacchataṃ(4) bhavet
catuḥṣaṣṭipado(5) brahmā marīcyādyāś ca devatāḥ / catuḥpañcāśatpadikā āpādyaṣṭau rasāgnibhiḥ
īśānādyā navapadāḥ skandādyāḥ śaktikāḥ(6) smṛtāḥ / carakyādyāstadvadeva rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat(7)
jñeyo vaṃśasahasraistu vāstumaṇḍalagaḥ padaiḥ / nyāso navaguṇastatra kartavyo deśavāstuvit
pañcaciṃśatpado vāsturvaitālākhyaścitau smṛtaḥ / anyo navapado vāstuḥ ṣoḍaśāṅghris tathāparaḥ

ṣaḍasratryasravṛttādermadhye syāccaturasrakaṃ / 1 nāgādyāścārdhakoṣṭagā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 śatapade 'pīti ga.. 3 daśamaṃ sthāpane iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 4 caturviṃśacchatamiti ga.. 5 catuḥṣaṣṭipade iti gha.. 6 īśānādyāḥ śivapadā skandādyāḥ padikā iti gha.. 7 samañca sthāpane vāstuś catustriṃśacchataṃ bhavediti gha.. pustake 'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ / catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā ity ādiḥ, rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti :p 299 khāte vāstoḥ samaṃ pṛṣṭhe(1) nyāse brahmaśilātmake
śāṣākasya niveśe ca(2) mūrtisaṃsthāpane tathā / pāyasena tu naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ vā pradāpayet
uktānukte tu vai vāstuḥ pañcahastapramāṇataḥ / gṛhaprāsādamānena vāstuḥ śreṣṭhastu sarvadā(4)
śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ īśvara uvāca īśādiṣu carakyādyāḥ(5) pūrvavat pūjayedvahiḥ / āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt pratidevamanukramāt
datvā bhūtabaliṃ lagne śilānyāsamanukramāt / madhyasūtre(6) nyasecchaktiṃ kumbhañcānantamuttamaṃ(7)
nakārārūḍhamūlena kumbhe 'smin dhārayecchilāṃ / kumbhānaṣṭau sabhadrādīn dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt

lokapālāṇubhirnyasya(8) śvabhreṣu(6) nyastaśaktiṣu / 1 khātārambhe samaṃ pṛṣṭhe iti ṅa.. / khāto bāloḥ samaḥ pṛṣṭhe iti cha.. 2 niveśeneti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 paraṃ hastapramānata iti cha.. 4 sarvada iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / sarvaśa iti ga.. , ca 5 īśādyādiṣu brahmādyā iti ga.. 6 madhye śvabhra iti gha.. 7 kumbhañcānantamantikamiti gha.. , cha.. ca / kumbhañcānantamantimamiti ṅa.. 8 lokapālātmabhirnyasyediti kha.. , cha.. ca / lokapālāṇubhirnyasyediti ṅa.. 9 sūtreṣviti ka.. / kumbheṣviti ga.. :p 300 śilāsteṣvatha(1) nandādyāḥ krameṇa(2) viniyojayet
śambarair mūrtināthānāṃ(3) yathā syurbhittimadhyataḥ / tāsu dharmādikānaṣṭau(4) koṇāt koṇaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ(5)
subhadrādiṣu nandādyāś catasro 'gnyādikoṇagāḥ / ajitādyāś ca pūrvādijayādiṣvatha(6) vinyaset
brahmāṇaṃ copari masya(7) vyāpakaṃ ca maheśvaraṃ / cintayedeṣu cādhānaṃ vyomaprasādamadhyagaṃ
balindattvā japedastraṃ vighnadoṣanivāraṇaṃ(8) / śilāpañcakapakṣe 'pi manāguddiśyate yathā
madhye pūrṇaśilānyāsaḥ(9) subhadrakalaśe 'rdhataḥ / padmādiṣu ca nandādyāḥ koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramāt
madhyabhāve(10) catasro 'pi mātṛvadbhāvasammatāḥ / oṃ pūrṇe tvaṃ mahāviśve(11) sarvasandohalakṣaṇe
sarvasampūrṇamevātra kuruṣvāṅgirasaḥ sute / oṃ nande tvaṃ nandinī puṃsāṃ tvāmatra sthāpayāmyahaṃ
prāsāde tiṣṭha santṛptā yāvaccandrārkatārakaṃ / āyuḥ kāmaṃ śriyannande dehi vāsiṣṭha dehināṃ(12)

1 śilādyāstatheti ka.. 2 kramaśa iti gha.. 3 śambarair mūrtinādhānāmiti kha. cha.. ca / śambarair mūrtimādhānamiti ṅa.. 4 tān sudharmādikānaṣṭau iti kha.. 5 vibhāgata iti gha.. 6 pūrvādijayādiṣu ceti ga.. 7 brahmāṇaṃ copavinyasyeti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ca 8 vighnadoṣanivārakamiti ga.. 9 pūrvaśilānyāsa iti gha.. 10 madhyābhāve iti kha.. , ga.. ca 11 mahābhāge iti ga.. 12 dehi māmiti kha.. , cha.. ca / dehi na iti gha.. :p 301 asmin rakṣā sadā(1) kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayā / oṃ bhadre tvaṃ sarvadā bhadraṃ lokānāṃ kuru kāśyapi
āyurdā kāmadā devi(2) śrīpradā ca sadā bhava / oṃ jaye 'tra sarvadā devi śrīdā.ayurdā ca sadā bhava(3)
oṃ jaye 'tra sarvadā(4) devi tiṣṭha tvaṃ sthāpitā maya(5) / nityañjayāya bhūtyai ca svāminī bhava bhārgavi
oṃ rikte 'tiriktadoṣaghne(6) siddhimuktiprade śubhaṃ / sarvadā sarvadeśasthe tiṣṭhāsmin viśvarūpiṇi(7)
gaganāyatanandhyātvā tatra tattvatrayaṃ(8) nyaset / prāyaścittantato hutvā vidhinā visṛjenmakhaṃ
pratiṣṭhā sāmagrīvidhānaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣye liṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāsāde bhuktimuktidāṃ / tāś caret sarvadā muktau bhuktau devadine sati

vinā caitreṇa māghādau pratiṣṭhā māsapañcake / 1 mudā iti kha.. cha.. ca 2 kāmade devīti gha.. 3 jayetretyardhaślokaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti 4 oṃ jaya enaṃ sadeti kha.. cha.. ca 5 mama iti ṅa.. 6 raktātiraktadoṣaghna iti cha.. / raktātriraktadoṣaghne iti kha.. 7 santiṣṭhāsminnīśarūpiṇīti gha.. / śarparūpiṇīti ja.. 8 tattve tattvatrayamiti gha.. 9 sarvadā muktau devādeve grahe satīti gha.. / sarvadā muktyai bhuktyai daivadine satīti ṅa.. :p 302 guruśukrodaye kāryā prathame karaṇetraye
śuklapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇe vā pañcamandinaṃ(1) / caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīṃ
śobhanāstithayaḥ śaṣāḥ krūravāravivarjitāḥ / śatabhiṣā dhaniṣṭhārdrā anurodhottaratrayaṃ(2)
rohiṇī śravaṇaśceti(3) sthirārambhe mahodayāḥ / lagnañca kumbhasiṃhālitulāstrīvṛṣadhanvināṃ
śasto jīvo navarkṣeṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā / budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadiksaptaturyeṣu vinartuṃ(4) śitaḥ
saptartutridaśādisthaḥ(5) śaśāṅkobaladaḥ sadā(6) / ravirdaśatriṣaṭsaṃstho rāhustridaśaṣaḍgataḥ
ṣaṭtristhānagatāḥ śastā mandāṅgārārkaketavaḥ / śubhrāḥ krūraś ca pāpāś ca sarva ekādaśasthitāḥ
eṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunau pūrṇā(7) tvārdhikī grahabhūtayoḥ / pādikī rāmadiksthāne caturaṣṭau(8) pādavarjitā
pādānyūnacaturnāḍī bhogaḥ syānmīnameṣayoḥ / vṛṣakumbhau ca bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ
makaro mithunaṃ pañca cāpāliharikarkaṭāḥ / pādīnāḥ ṣaṭ tulākanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca ca

1 kṛṣṇepyāpañcamaṃ dinamiti kha.. , cha.. ca /kṛṣṇepyāpañcamāddināditi gha.. 2 anurādhottarātrayamiti ca.. 3 śravaṇaś caite iti ca.. 4 budhaḥ ṣaḍṛtuturyeṣu diksaptāha vineti cha.. / budhaḥ ṣaḍdvyaṣṭaturṣeṣu diksaptaṣaḍ vineti kha.. 5 saptāyatridaśādistha iti kha.. cha.. ca 6 budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadigityādiḥ, baladaḥ sadā ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 7 evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇāditi cha.. / evaṃ dṛṣṭivale pūrṇeti kha.. 8 vasvaṣṭau iti kha.., cha.. ca :p 303 keśarī vṛṣabhaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ / carā dhanustulāmeṣā dviḥsvabhāvāstṛtīyakāḥ(1)
śubhaḥ(2) śubhagrahair dṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥśubhāśritaḥ(3) / guruśukrabudhe yukto lagno dadyādbalāyudhī(4)
rājyaṃ śauryaṃ(5) balaṃ putrān yaśodharmādikaṃ bahu / prathamaḥ saptamasturyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate
guruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhiprasādakāḥ / tryekādaśacaturthasthā(6) lagnāt pāpagrahāḥ śubhāḥ
atopyanīcakarmāthaṃ(7) yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥ / dhāmnaḥ pañcaguṇāṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvā vā dhānasammitāṃ(8)
hastād dvādaśasopānāt(9) kuryānmaṇḍamagrataḥ / caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ snānārthantu(10) tadardhataḥ
ekāsyaṃ caturāsyaṃ vā raudryāṃ prācyuttarethavā(11) / hāstiko daśahasto vai maṇḍaporkakaro 'thavā

dvihastottarayā vṛddhyā(12) śeṣaṃ syānmaṇḍapāṣṭakaṃ / 1 karkaṭo makaro dvisthaḥ pravrajyākāryanāśakāḥ / guruśakrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhipradāyakā iti ga. gha.. pustake 'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ 2 sthira iti ga.. 3 śubhānvita iti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 dhanāyuṣīti ga.. 5 rājyaṃ saukhyamiti kha.. 6 dvyekādaśacaturthasthā iti cha.. / tryekādaśetyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti 7 atonyeniṣṭhakarmārthamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 8 tyaktvā vā cāpasammitāmiti kha.. / tyaktvā vā rāmasammitāmiti cha.. 9 hastādvā daśasopānāditi kha.. / hastān vā daśa sopānāditi kha.. 10 snānārhaṃ ceti ṅa.. 11 prācyutare tatheti ṅa.. 12 dvihastottarayāvṛttyā iti gha.. :p 304 vedī catuṣkarā madhye koṇastambhena saṃyutā(1)
vedīpādāntaraṃ tyaktvā(2) kuṇḍāni nava pañca vā / ekaṃ vā śivakāṣṭhāyāṃ(3) prācyāṃ vā tadguroḥ paraṃ
muṣṭimātraṃ śatārdhe syācchate cāratrimātrakaṃ(4) / hastaṃ sahasrahome syānniyute tu dvihāstikaṃ(5)
lakṣe catuṣkāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihome 'ṣṭahastakaṃ / bhagābhamagnau(6) khaṇḍendu dakṣe tryasrañca nairṛte
ṣaḍasraṃ vāyave padmaṃ(7) saumye cāṣṭāsrakaṃ śive / tiryakpātaśivaṃ khātamūrdhvaṃ(8) mekhalayā saha
tadvahirmekhalāstisro vedavahniyamāṅgulaiḥ(9) / aṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekā vā kuṇḍākārāstu mekhalāḥ
tāsāmupari yoniḥ syānmadhye 'śvatthadalākṛtiḥ / ucchrāyeṇāṅgulaṃ tasmādvistāreṇāṅgulāṣṭakaṃ(10)
dairghyaṃ kuṇḍārdhamānena kuṇḍakaṇṭhasamo 'dharaḥ / pūrvāgniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ yoniḥ syāduttarānanā

pūrvānanā tu śeṣāṇāmaiśānye 'nyatarā tayoḥ / 1 koṇastambheṣu saṃyuteti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. ca / koṇastambheṣu sanmateti ṅa.. / koṇastambhenusaṃyuteti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 vedī pādāntaraṃ tyakteti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca 3 śivakāṣṭādau iti ga.. 4 śatārdhasya śate vahnimātrakamiti cha.. / śatārdhasya śate vāratrimātrakamiti gha.. / śatārdhasya śate vā vahnimātrakamiti ṅa.. 5 dvihastakamiti kha.. 6 khadgābhamagnau iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 7 padme iti kha.. , gha.. ca 8 tiryak pātasamamūrdhvamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca 9 vedavahniyavāṅgulair iti gha.. 10 tasya vistareṇāṅgulāṣṭakamiti gha.. :p 305 kuṇḍānāṃ yaś caturviṃśo bhāgaḥ soṅgula ity ataḥ
plakṣodumvarakāśvatthavaṭajāstoraṇāḥ kramāt / śāntibhūtibalārogyapūrvādyā nāmataḥ kramāt
pañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni hastakhātasthitāni ca / tadardhavistarāṇi syuryutānyāmradalādibhiḥ
indrāyudhopamā raktā kṛṣṇā dhūmrā śaśiprabhā / śuklābhā(1) hemavarṇā ca patākā sphāṭikopamā
pūrvāditobjaje(2) raktā nīlānantasya(3) nairṛte / pañcahastāstadardhāś ca dhvajā dīrghāś ca vistarāḥ
hastapradeśitā daṇḍā dhvajānāṃ pañcahastakāḥ / valmīkāddantidantāgrāttathā(4) vṛṣabhaśṛṅgataḥ
padmaṣaṇḍādvarāhāñca goṣṭhādapi catuṣpathāt / mṛttikā dvādaśa grāhyā vaikuṇṭheṣṭau pinākini
nyagrodhodumvarāśvatthacūtajamvutvagudbhavaṃ / kaṣāyapañcakaṃ grāhyamārtavañca phalāṣṭakaṃ
tīrthāmbhāṃsi sugandhīni(5) tathā sarvauṣadhījalaṃ / śastaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ vakṣye ratnagośṛṅgavāri(6) ca
snānāyāpāharet(7) pañca pañcagavyāmṛtaṃ tathā / piṣṭanirmitavastrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāya(8) ca

1 śukrābheti kha.. 2 pūrvādino dhvaje iti ga.. 3 nīlānante 'theti ga.. 4 valmīkāddhastidantāgrāttayeti cha.. 5 tīrthatoyasugandhīni iti ṅa.. 6 varge gośṛṅgavāri ceti cha.. 7 snānāyopaharediti kha.. , cha.. , gha.. ca 8 piṣṭanirmitarudrādidravyaṃ nirmañjanāyeti ga.. / piṣṭanirmitavajrādikaṃ nirmathanāyeti ja.. :p 306 sahasraśuṣiraṃ kumbhaṃ maṇḍalāya ca rocanā(1) / śatamoṣadhimūlānāṃ vijayā lakṣmaṇā balā
guḍūcyatibalā pāṭhā sahadevā śatāvarī / ṛddhiḥ(2) suvarcasā(3) vṛddhiḥ snāne proktā pṛthak pṛthak
rakṣāyai tiladarbhaugho(4) bhasmasnānantu kevalaṃ / yavagodhūmavilvānāṃ(5) cūrṇāni ca vicakṣaṇaḥ
vilepanaṃ(6) sakarpūraṃ snānārthaṃ kumbhagaṇḍakān(7) / khaṭvāñca tūlikāyugmaṃ sopadhānaṃ savastrakaṃ
kuryādvittānusāreṇa śayane lakṣyakalpane(8) / ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātraṃ kuryāt svarṇaśalākikāṃ
vardhanīṃ śivakumbhañca lokapālaghaṭānapi / ekaṃ nidrākṛte kumbhaṃ śāntyarthaṃ kuṇḍasaṅkhyayā(9)
dvārapālādidharmādipraśāntādighaṭānapi / vastulakṣmīgaṇeśānāṃ kalaśānaparānapi

dhānyapuñjakṛtādhārān savastrān(10) sragvibhūṣitān / 1 maṅgalāya ca rocaneti ga.. / maṅgalāya ca rocanamiti ja.. 2 siddhiriti gha.. 3 suvarcaleti ja.. 4 tilagarbhādyamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / tiladarbhājyamiti ja.. 5 yavagodhūmacūrṇānāmiti gha.. / pañcagodhūmavilvānāmiti cha.. 6 lepanañceti ja.. 7 kumbhamaṇḍakāniti kha.. / kumbhagaḍḍukāniti gha.. /kumbhaguṇḍukāniti ṅa.. kumbhasaṇḍakāniti cha.. / kumbhakhaṇḍakāniti ja.. 8 prāyeṇa lakṣyakalpane iti ga.. / śayane lakṣyakaṃ pare iti ja.. 9 kuṇḍasanmitamiti ja.. 10 sarvāṃśceti gha.. , ja.. ca :p 307 sahiraṇyān samālabdhān gandhapānīyapūritān
pūrṇapātraphalādhārān(1) pallavādyān(2) salakṣaṇān / vastrair ācchādayet kumbhānāharedgaurasarṣapān
vikirārthantathā lājān jñānakhaḍgañca pūrvavat / sāpidhānāṃ carusthālīṃ darvīṃ ca tāmranirmitāṃ(3)
ghṛtakṣaudrānvitaṃ pātraṃ pādābhyaṅgakṛte tathā / viṣṭarāṃstriśatādarbhadalair bāhupramāṇakān(4)
caturaś caturastadvat pālāśān paridhīnapi / tilapātraṃ haviḥpātramardhapātraṃ pavitrakaṃ
phalaviṃśāṣṭamānāni ghaṭo dhūpapradānakaṃ(5) / śrukśruvau piṭakaṃ pīṭhaṃ vyajanaṃ śuṣkamindhanaṃ
puṣpaṃ patraṃ gugglañca ghṛtair daupāṃś ca dhūpakaṃ / akṣatāni trisūtrīñca gavyamājyaṃ yavāṃstilān
kuśāḥ śāntyai trimadhuraṃ samidho daśaparvikāḥ / bāhumātraśruvaṃ hastam(6) arkādigrahaśāntaye
samidho 'rkapalāśotthāḥ khādirāmārgapippalāḥ(7) / udumvaraśamīdūrvākuśotthāḥ śatamaṣṭa ca
tadabhāve yavatilā gṛhopakaraṇaṃ tathā / sthālīdarvīpidhānādi devādibhyo 'ṃśukadvayaṃ

mudrāmukuṭavāsāṃsi hārakuṇḍalakaṅkaṇān / 1 pūrvapātraphalādhārāniti cha.. 2 pallavāgrāniti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 3 kurvīta tāmranirmitāmiti kha.. 4 dalair bāhumātrapramāṇata iti ga.. 5 ghaṇṭādhūpapradānakamiti gha.. , cha.. ca 6 bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ hastānāmiti cha.. 7 khādirāpāṅgapippalā iti kha.. , cha.. , ca / khādirāpāmārkapippalā iti gha.. :p 308 kuryādācāryapūjārthaṃ(1) vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet
