tatpādapādahīnā ca mūrtibhṛdastrajāpināṃ(2) / pūjā syājjāpibhistulyā(3) vipradaivajñaśilpināṃ
vajrārkaśāntau(4) nīlātinīlamuktāphalāni ca(5) / puṣpapadmādirāgañca vaidūryaṃ ratnamaṣṭamaṃ(6)
uṣīramādhavakrāntāraktacandanakāguruṃ / śrīkhaṇḍaṃ sārikaṅkuṣṭhaṃ(7) śaṅkṣinī hyoṣadhīguṇaḥ(8)
hematāmramayaṃ raktaṃ rājatañca(9) sakāṃsyakaṃ / śīsakañceti lohāni haritālaṃ manaḥśilā
gairikaṃ hemamākṣīkaṃ pārado(10) vahnigairikaṃ / gandhakābhrakamityaṣṭau(11) dhātavo brīhayas tathā
godhūmān satilānmāṣānmudgānapyāharedyavān / nīvārān śyāmakānevaṃ brīhayo 'pyaṣṭa kīrtitāḥ
adhivāsanavidhiḥ īśvara uvāca snātvā nityadvayaṃ kṛtvā(1) praṇavārghakaro guruḥ(2) / sahāyair mūrtipair vipraiḥ(3) saha gacchenmakhālayaṃ
kṣāntyāditoraṇāṃstatra pūrvavat pūjayet kramāt / pradakṣiṇakramādeṣāṃ śākhāyāṃ dvārapālakān
prāci nandimahākālau yāmye bhṛṅgivināyakau(4) / vāruṇe vṛṣabhaskandau devīcaṇḍau tatottare(5)
tacchākhāmūladeśasthau praśāntaśiśirau ghaṭau / parjanyāśokanāmānau bhūtaṃ sañjīvanāmṛtau(6)
dhanadaśrīpradau(7) dvau dvau pūjayedanupūrvaśaḥ(8) / svanāmabhiś caturthyantaiḥ praṇavādinamontagaiḥ

lokagrahavasudvāḥsthasravantīnāṃ(6) dvayaṃ dvayaṃ / 2 praṇavārghyakaro muniriti ga.. / punararghyakaro muniriti ṅa.. 3 sahāyair ṛtvigvipraiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca / sahāyair bhūpativiprair iti ja.. 4 bhṛṅgavināyakāviti cha.. 5 vṛṣottare iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 6 bhūtasañjīvanāsutau iti cha.. / bhūtasañjīvanāmṛtau iti kha.. , ja.. ca 7 dhanadadvipadau iti kha.. / dhanadau dvipadau iti gha.. / dhanadaścāpadau iti ja.. 8 pūjayedatha pūrvaśa iti ga.. 9 lokagrahavasudvāḥsthahastādīnāmiti ga.. :p 310 bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīrgaṇapatis tathā(1)
iti devāmakhāgāre(2) tiṣṭhanti pratitoraṇaṃ / vighnasaṅghāpanodāya kratoḥ saṃrakṣaṇāya ca
vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ(3) khaḍgaṃ(3) pāśaṃ dhvajaṃgadāṃ / triśūlaṃ cakramambhojampatākāsvarcayet(4) kramāt
oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ(5) ity ādimantraiḥ kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ / śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ(6) supratiṣṭhitaḥ
dhvajāṣṭadevatāḥ(7) pūjyāḥ pūrvādau(8) bhūtakoṭibhiḥ / oṃ kauṃ kumudāya nama ity ādimantraiḥ
hetukaṃ tripuraghnañca śaktyākhyaṃ(9) yamajihvakaṃ(10) / kālaṃ karālinaṃ ṣaṣṭhamekāṅghrimbhīmamaṣṭakaṃ

tathaiva pūjayed dikṣu kṣetrapālānanukramāt / 1 bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistatheti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca /bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistatheti ja.. 2 devāmarāgare iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 3 tathā kuṇḍamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / tathā caṇḍamiti ja.. 4 patākāmarcayediti ga.. / patākāsu yajediti ṅa.. 5 huṃ phaṭ namaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭ nama iti kha.. / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭ nama iti cha./ oṃ huṃ phaṭ vakrāya huṃ phaṭ nama iti ga.. / oṃ huṃ phaṭ vajrāya huṃ phaṭ nama iti ṅa.. 6 pramukha iti ja.. 7 dhvajāś ca devatā iti ga.. 8 pūjādau iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca 9 buddhākhyamiti ga.. / buddhyākhyamiti ja.. 10 ajajihvakamiti ja.. :p 311 balibhiḥ kusumair dhūpaiḥ santuṣṭān paribhāvayet(1)
kambalāstṛteṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśasthūṇāsvanukramāt(2) / pañca kṣityāditattvāni sadyojātādibhiryajet
sadāśivapadavyāpi maṇḍapaṃ(3) dhāma śāṅkaraṃ / patākāśaktisaṃyuktaṃ(4) tattvadṛṣṭyāvalokayet(5)
divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭhavighnānutsārya pūrvavat / praviśet paścimadvārā śeṣadvārāṇi darśayet(6)
pradakṣiṇakramādgatvā niviṣṭovedidakṣiṇe / uttarābhimukhaḥ kuryād bhūtaśuddhiṃ yathā purā
antaryāgaṃ viśeṣārghyaṃ mantradravyādiśodhanaṃ / kurvīta ātmanaḥ(7) pūjāṃ pañcagavyādi pūrvavat
sādhāraṅkalasantasmin vinyasettadanantaraṃ / viśeṣācchivatattvāya tattvatrayamanukramāt
lalāṭaskandhapādāntaṃ śivavidyātmakaṃ paraṃ / rudranārāyaṇabrahmadaivataṃ nijasañcaraiḥ(8)

1 pravibhāvayediti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti kha.. /kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti cha.. /kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramāt iti gha.. /kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāditi ja.. /kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāditi ṅa.. 3 maṇḍalamiti ṅa.. 4 pinākaśaktisaṃyuktāmiti gha.. 5 tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayediti kha.. , cha.. ca 6 śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramediti kha.. , cha.. ca / śeṣadvārāṇi pūjayediti cha.. 7 svātmana iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 8 nijasaṃvarair iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / nijasañcayair iti gha.. :p 312 oṃ haṃ hāṃ(1) mūrtīstadīśvarāṃstatra pūrvavadviniveśayet / tadvyāpakaṃ śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ śivahastañca mūrdhani
brahmarandhrapraviṣṭena tejasā vāhyasāntaraṃ(2) / tamaḥpaṭalamādhūya pradyotitadigantaraṃ(3)
ātmānaṃ mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ sragvastrakusumādibhiḥ(4) / bhūṣayitvā śivosmīti dhyātvā boghāsimuddharet
catuṣpadāntasaṃskāraiḥ(5) saṃskuryānmakhamaṇḍapaṃ / vikṣipya vikirādīni kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(6)
āsanīkṛtya vardhanyāṃ vāstvādīn pūrvavadyajet / śivakumbhāstravardhanyau pūjayecca sthirāsane(7)
svadikṣu kalaśārūḍhāṃllokapālānanukramāt / vāhāyudhādisaṃyuktān pūjayedvidhinā yathā
airāvatagajārūḍhaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ(8) kirīṭinaṃ / sahasranayanaṃ śakraṃ vajrapāṇiṃ vibhāvayet
saptārciṣaṃ ca vibhrāṇamakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ / jvālāmālākulaṃ raktaṃ(9) śaktihastamajāsanaṃ

1 uṃ hāṃ hāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / oṃ īṃ āṃ iti gha.. , ja.. ca 2 tejasā vāhyamantaramiti kha.. / tejasā vāhyābhyantaramiti cha.. / tejasā vāhyamāntaramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 praviṣṭonudigantaramiti gha.. , ja.. ca 4 sragvastramukuṭādibhiriti gha.. , ja.. ca 5 catuṣpathārṇasaṃskārair iti cha.. 6 kuśadūrvopasaṃharediti ga.. 7 śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane iti gha.. , ja.. ca 8 varṇavastramiti ga.. / svarṇavastramiti kha.. , ja.. , ca 9 kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / kālaṃ mālākulaṃ, vyaktamiti ga.. / jvālāmālākulaṃ saktamiti gha.. :p 313 mahiṣasthaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ yamaṃ kālānalaṃ smaret / raktanetraṃ svarārūḍhaṃ(1) khaḍgahastañca nairṛtaṃ
varuṇaṃ makare śvetaṃ nāgapāśadharaṃ smaret / vāyuṃ ca hariṇe nīlaṃ kuveraṃ meghasaṃsthitaṃ(2)
triśūlinaṃ vṛṣe ceśaṃ kūrmenantantu cakriṇaṃ / brāhmāṇaṃ haṃsagaṃ dhyāyeccaturvaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ
stambhamūleṣu kumbheṣu vedyāṃ dharmādikān(3) yajet / dikṣu kumbheṣvanantādīn pūjayantyapi kecana
śivājñāṃ śrāvayet kumbhaṃ bhrāmayedātmapṛṣṭhagaṃ(4) / pūrvavat sthāpayedādau kumbhaṃ tadanu vardhanīṃ
śivaṃ sthirāsanaṃ(5) kumbhe śastrārthañca(6) dhruvāsanaṃ / pūjayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ spṛśedudbhavamudrayā
nijayāgaṃ(7) jagannātha rakṣa bhaktānukampayā / ebhiḥ saṃśrāvya rakṣārthaṃ kumbhe khaḍgaṃ niveśayet(8)
dīkṣāsthāpanayoḥ kumbhe sthaṇḍile maṇḍale 'thavā / maṇḍalebhyarcya deveśaṃ vrajedvai kuṇḍasannidhau
kuṇḍanābhiṃ puraskṛtya niniṣṭhā mūrtidhāriṇaḥ / gurorādeśataḥ kuryur nijakuṇḍeṣu(9) saṃskṛtiṃ

1 śavārūḍhamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 2 mānuṣasthitamiti gha.. 3 karmādikāniti ja.. 4 bhrāmayedanupūjya tamiti ja.. / bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagamiti gha.. 5 sthirāsane iti kha.. , gha.. ca 6 śastrāṇuñceti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca 7 imaṃ yāgamiti ṅa.. 8 śaṅkhannivedayediti ga.. / khaḍgannivedayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 9 kuryur nijakumbheṣviti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 314 japeyurjāpinaḥ saṅkhyaṃ(1) mantramanye tu saṃhitāṃ(2) / paṭheyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntiṃ svaśākhāvedapāragāḥ
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānīś ca(3) maitrakañca vṛṣākapiṃ / ṛgvedī sarvadigbhāge sarvametat samuccaret(4)
devavratantu bhāruṇḍaṃ(5) jyeṣṭhasāma rathantaraṃ / puruṣaṃ gītimetāni sāmavedī tu dakṣiṇe
rudraṃ puruṣasūktañca ślokādhyāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ / brāhmaṇañca yajurvedī paścimāyāṃ samuccaret(6)
nīlarudraṃ tathātharvī sūkṣmāsūkṣmantathaiva ca / uttare 'tharvaśīrṣañca(7) tatparastu samuddharet
ācāryaścāgnimutpādya pratikuṇḍaṃ pradāpayet(8) / vahneḥ pūrvādikān bhāgān(9) pūrvakuṇḍāditaḥ(10) kramāt
dhūpadīpacarūṇāñca dadītāgniṃ samuddharet(11) / pūrvavacchivamabhyarcya śivāgnau mantratarpaṇaṃ

deśakālādisampattau(12) dur nimittapraśāntaye / 1 jāpinosaṅkhyamiti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 2 astramanye tu saṃsthitamiti ga.. / astramanye tu saṃhitāmiti ṅa.. 3 pāvamānīntu iti ja.. 4 sarvametat samuddharediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / sarvamastraṃ samuddharediti ṅa.. 5 bhāvajñamiti cha.. / śrīkuṇḍamiti ṅa.. 6 samuddharediti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 7 uttaretharvasūktañceti ga.. 8 pradīpayediti gha.. 9 pūrvādidigbhāgāditi ja.. / pūrvādikādbhāgāditi gha.. 10 sarvakuṇḍādita iti kha.. , cha.. , ca 11 ācāryaścāgnimutpādyetyādiḥ dadītāgniṃ samuddharedityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 12 deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau iti gha.. :p 315 homaṅkṛtvā tu mantrajñaḥ pūrṇāṃ dattvā śubhāvahāṃ
pūrvavaccarukaṃ kṛtvā pratikuṇḍaṃ nivedayet(1) / yajamānālaṅkṛtāstu vrajeyuḥ snānamaṇḍapaṃ
bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyeśaṃ(2) tāḍayitvāvaguṇṭhayet / snāpayet(3) pūjayitvā tu mṛdā kāṣāyavāriṇā
gomūtrair gomayenāpi vāriṇā cāntarāntarā / bhasmanā gandhatoyena phaḍantāstreṇa vāriṇā
deśiko mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāraṇaśodhanaṃ(4) / dharmajaptena sañchāṭya(5) pītavarṇena vāsasā
sampūjya sitapuṣpaiś ca(6) nayeduttaravedikāṃ / tatra dattāsanāyāñca śayyāyāṃ sanniveśya ca(7)
kuṅkumāliptasūtreṇa vibhajya gururālikhet / śalākayā suvarṇasya akṣiṇī śastrakarmaṇā(8)
añjayellakṣmakṛt paścācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā / kṛtakarmā ca śastreṇa lakṣmī śilpī samutkṣipet(9)

tryaṃśādardhotha(10) pādārdhādardhāyā / ardhayothavā(11) 1 niveśayediti kha.. ,gha.. ca 2 bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyainamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca / tatra pīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti ṅa.. / bhadrapīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti gha.. 3 snapayediti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca 4 kṛcā cākāraśodhanāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca 5 dharmajaptena saṃsthāpyeti ga.. / dharmajalena sañchādyeti ṅa.. 6 sampūjya sitavastraiśceti ga.. / sampūjyasitapuṣpaistu iti gha.. 7 sanniveśayediti cha.. 8 śāstrakarmaṇeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / śāstravarmaṇeti gha.. /śāstrakarmaṇi iti ḍa.. 9 samutkiret iti gha.. , ja.. ca 10 tryaṃśādapyatheti gha.. / tryaṃśādadhotheti ja.. 11 ardhato 'piveti ga.. / ardhato varamiti ja.. :p 316 sarvakāmaprasiddhyarthaṃ śubhaṃ lakṣmāvatāraṇaṃ(1)
liṅgadīrghavikārāṃśe tribhaktaṃ bhāgavarṇanāt(2) / vistāro lakṣma dehasya bhavelliṅgasya(3) sarvataḥ
yavasya navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāvṛtā(6) / hastike(5) lakṣmarekhā ca gāmbhīryād vistarādapi(7)
evamaṣṭāṃśavṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike / bhavedaṣṭayavā(8) pṛthvī gambhīrātra ca hāstike
evamaṣṭāṃśa vṛddhyā tu liṅge sārdhakarādike / bhavedaṣṭayavā pṛthvī gambhīrānnavahāstike(6)
śāmbhaveṣu(10) ca liṅgeṣu pādavṛddheṣu sarvataḥ(11) / lakṣma dehasya viṣkambho bhavedvai yavavardhanāt
gambhīratvaṣṭayuvābhyāṃ rekhāpi tryaṃśavṛddhitaḥ(12) / sarveṣu ca bhavet sūkṣmāṃ liṅgamastakamastakaṃ

1 lakṣmāvatārakamiti gha.. 2 tribhukte bhāvavarṇanāditi ka.. / tribhukte bhāgavarjanāditi gha.. / tribhakte bhāgavarjanāditi ja.. / tribhukte bhāgavartanāditi ṅa.. / vibhakte bhāvavarṇanāditi cha.. 3 bhavelliṅgeṣu sarvata iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa. cha.. ca 4 navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhateti kha.. , cha.. ca / bhavabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirāhateti ja.. / navabhaktasya bhāgair aṣṭābhirādṛteti gha.. 5 hāstikaṃ iti ga.. , gha.. , ca 6 gambhīrā navahāstike iti gha.. 7 liṅge vṛddhikarādike iti kha.. / liṅgeṣu dvikarādiṣu iti ga.. / liṅge vṛddhikarādiṣu iti kha.. , gha.. ca 8 bhavedaṣṭakareti gha.. 9 gambhīrā navahāstike iti ga.. / gambhīrā navahastake iti ja.. 10 sottareṣu iti ja.. 11 yavasya navabhaktasyetyādiḥ / pādavṛddheṣu sarvata ity antaḥ pāṭho ṅa.. pustake nāsti 12 dvyaṃśavṛṃhiteti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / tryaṃśavṛṃhiteti ṅa.. / dvyaṃśavṛddhita iti ja.. :p 317 lakṣmakṣetreṣṭadhābhakte mūrdhnibhāgadvaye śubhe(1) / ṣaḍbhāgaparivartanamuktvā bhāgadvayantvadhaḥ(2)
rekhātrayeṇa sambaddhaṃ(3) kārayet pṛṣṭadeśagaṃ / ratnaje lakṣaṇoddhāro yavau hemasamudbhave
svarūpaṃ lakṣaṇanteṣāṃ prabhā ratneṣu nirmalā / nayanonmīlanaṃ vaktre(4) sānnidhyāya ca lakṣma tat
lakṣmaṇoddhārarekhāñca ghṛtena madhunā tathā / mṛtyuñjayena(5) sampūjya śilpidoṣanivṛttaye
arcayecca(6) tato liṅgaṃ snāpayitvā mṛdādibhiḥ / śilpinantoṣayitvā tu dadyādgāṃ gurave tataḥ
liṅgaṃ dhūpādibhiḥ prācyaṃ gāyeyurbhartṛgāstrayaḥ / savyena cāpasavyena sūtreṇātha kuśena vā
smṛtvā ca rocanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikaṃ(7) / guḍalavaṇadhānyākadānena visṛjecca tāḥ
gurumūrtidharaiḥ(8) sārdhaṃ hṛdā vā praṇavena vā / mṛtsnāgomayagomūtrabhasmabhiḥ(9) salilāntaraṃ

snāpayet pañcagavyena pañcāmṛtapuraḥsaraṃ(10) / 1 mūrtibhāgadvaye cyute iti ja.. / mūrtibhagadvaye yute iti ja.. 2 muktvā bhāgadvayaṃ budha iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ḍa.. , cha.. ca 3 sasiddhamiti ga.. , ja.. ca 4 vyakte iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 5 mṛtyuñjayañceti ga.. 6 arcayettu iti ga.. , ja.. ca 7 puṣpāvarodhanaṃ datvā kuryānnirmanthanādikamiti ja.. /spṛṣṭvā ca rocanāṃ datvā kuryānnirmañjanādikamiti ṅa.. 8 gurumūrtiryavair iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 9 tato mṛṇmayagomūtrabhasmabhiriti ga.. 10 snāpayedityardhaśloko cha.. pustake nāsti :p 318 virūkṣaṇaṃ kaṣāyaiś ca sarvauṣadhijalena vā
śubhrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaratnaśṛṅgayavodakaiḥ(1) / tathā dhārāsahasreṇa divyauṣadhijalena ca(2)
tīrthodakena gāṅgena candanena ca vāriṇā / kṣīrārṇavādibhiḥ(3) kumbhaiḥ śivakumbhajalena ca(4)
virūkṣaṇaṃ vilepañca(5) sugandhaiś candanādibhiḥ / sampūjya brahmabhiḥ(6) puṣpair varmaṇā raktacīvaraiḥ(7)
raktarūpeṇa(8) nīrājya rakṣātilakapūrvakaṃ / ghṛtauṣadhair jaladugdhaiś ca kuśādyair arghyasūcitaiḥ
dravyaiḥ stutyādibhistuṣṭamarcayet(9) puruṣāṇunā(10) / samācamya(11) hṛdā devaṃ brūyādutthīyatāṃ prabho
devaṃ brahmarathenaiva kṣipraṃ dravyāṇi tannayet(12) / maṇḍape paścimadvāre śayyāyāṃ viniveśayet

śaktyādiśaktiparyante(12) vinyasedāsane śubhe / 1 oḍrapuṣpaphalasvarṇaśṛṅgagavodakair iti ga.. 2 divyauṣadhijalena vā iti ga.. 3 kṣārārṇavādibhiriti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 4 saraḥ kumbhajalena tu iti ja.. 5 vikarṣaṇaṃ vilepañceti gha.. , ja.. ca 6 bahubhiriti ja.. 7 brahmaṇā raktacandanair iti ga.. / brahmaṇā raktajīvakair iti ṅa.. 8 bahurūpeṇa iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 9 stutyādibhistutyamarghayediti kha.. , cha.. ca 10 puruṣātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 11 samācaryeti ga.. 12 tarpayediti kha.. , cha.. ca 13 śaktyādimūrtiparyante iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca :p 319 paścime piṇḍikāntasya nyasedbrahmaśalāntadā(1)
śastramastra(2) śatālabdhanidrākumbhadhruvāsanaṃ(3) / prakalpya śivakoṇe ca datvārghyaṃ hṛdayena tu
utthāpyoktāsane liṅgaṃ śirasā pūrvamastakaṃ / samāropya nyasettasmin(4) sṛṣṭyā dharmādivandanaṃ(5)
dadyāddhūpañca sampūjya tathā vāsāṃsi varmaṇā / gṛhopakṛtinaivedyaṃ hṛdā dadyāt svaśaktitaḥ(6)
ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pātramabhyaṅgāya padāntike / deśikaś ca sthitastatra ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasañcayaṃ(7)
śaktyādibhūmiparyantaṃ svatattvādhipasaṃyutaṃ / vinyasya puṣpamālābhistrikhaṇḍaṃ(8) parikalpayet
māyāpadeśaśaktyantanturyāśāṣṭāṃśavartulaṃ(9) / tatrātmatattvavidyākhyaṃ(10) śivaṃ sṛṣṭikramaṇa tu(11)
ekaśaḥ pratibhāgeṣu brahmaviṣṇuharādhipān / vinyasya mūrtimūrtīśān pūrvādikramato yathā

kṣmāvahniryajamānārkajalavāyuniśākarān / 1 brahmaśilāntatheti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 śastramantreti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 3 nidrākumbha dhruvāsanamiti ja.. 4 vyasedasminniti ja.. 5 sṛṣṭyā dharmādibandhanamiti kha.. /sṛṣṭyādirarghyādibandhanamiti cha.. 6 gṛhopakṛtītyardhaśloko ga.. pustake nāsti 7 ṣaḍliṅgatanusañcayamiti ja.. / ṣaḍviṃśatattvasañcayamiti gha.. 8 triśṛṅgamiti ga.. 9 māyāśādaśaśaktyantatūryā grāhyā pravartanamiti ja.. /māyāpadeśeti ardhaśloko gha.. pustake nāsti 10 tatrānutattvavidhyākhyamiti ja.. 11 sṛṣṭikrameṇa ceti ga.. :p 320 ākāśamūrtirūpāṃstān nyasettadadhināyakān
sarvaṃ paśupatiṃ(1) cograṃ rudraṃ bhavamakheśvaraṃ(2) / mahādevañca bhīmañca mantrāstadvācakā ime
lavaśaṣacayasāś ca hakāraś ca trimātrikaḥ / praṇavo hṛdayārṇurvā mūlamantro 'thavā kvacit
pañcakuṇḍātmake yāge(3) mūrtīḥ pañcāthavā nyaset / pṛthivījalatejāṃsi vāyumākāśameva ca
kramāttadadhipān pañca(4) brahmāṇaṃ dharaṇodharaṃ / rudramīśaṃ sadākhyañca sṛṣṭinyāyena mantravit(5)
mumukṣorvā nivṛttādyāḥ(6) ajātādyāstadīśvarāḥ(7) / tritattvaṃ vātha(8) sarvatra nyasedvyāptyātmakāraṇaṃ(9)
śuddhe cātmani vidyeśā aśuddhe lokanāyakāḥ / draṣṭavyā mūrtipāś caiva bhoginī mantranāyakāḥ
pañcaviṃśattathaivāṣṭapañcatrīṇi yathākramaṃ / eṣāntattvaṃ tadīśānāmindrādīnāṃ tato(10) yathā

oṃ hāṃ śaktitattvāya nama ity ādi(11) / oṃ hāṃ śaktitattvādhipāya(12) nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kṣmāmūrtyadhīśāya(13) 1 garbhe paśupatimiti ja.. 2 bhavamatheśvaramiti ga.. ,cha.. , ja.. ca 3 pañcadaṇḍātmake mārge iti ja.. / pañcadaṇḍātmake yāge iti ṅa.. 4 tadadhipālañceti kha.. 5 sṛṣṭinyāsena mantraviditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca / sṛṣṭinyāsena pūrvaviditi ja.. 6 mumuñcorvinivṛttādyā iti kha.. 7 ajātyādyāstadīśvarā iti kha.. 8 tritattvaṃ cātheti gha.. , ja.. ca 9 vyāpyātmakāraṇamiti kha.. / vyāptyā svakāraṇamiti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 10 indrādīśāntata iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 11 nama itīti gha.. , ja.. ca 12 śabdatattvādhipataye iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 13 śūkṣmamūrtaye iti gha.. :p 321 śivāya nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ pṛthivīmūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ mūrtyadhipāya(1) brahmaṇe nama ity ādi / oṃ hāṃ śivatattvādhipāya(2) rudrāya nama ity ādi nābhikandātsamuccārya ghaṇṭānādavisarpaṇaṃ(3) / brahmādikāraṇatyāgād dvādaśāntasamāśritaṃ
mantrañca manasā bhinnaṃ prāptānandarasopamaṃ / dvādaśāntātsamānīya niṣkalaṃ(4) vyāpakaṃ śivaṃ
aṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalaṃ / sarvaśaktimayaṃ sāṅgaṃ dhyātvā liṅge(5) niveśayet
jīvanyāso bhavedevaṃ liṅge sarvārthasādhakaḥ / piṇḍikādiṣu tu nyāsaḥ(6) procyate sāmprataṃ yathā
piṇḍikāñca kṛtasnānāṃ(7) viliptāñcandanādibhiḥ / sadvastraiś ca samācchādya(8) randhre ca bhagalakṣaṇe
pañcaratnādisaṃyuktāṃ(9) liṅgasyottarataḥ sthitāṃ / liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsāṃ(10) vidhivatsamprapūjayet
kṛtasnānādikāntatra liṅgamūle śilāṃ(11) nyaset / kṛtasnānādisaṃskāraṃ śaktyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā

1 pṛthivīmūrtyadhipataye iti kha.. / pṛthivīmūrtyadhipāyeti ja.. , gha.. ca 2 śivatattvāyeti ja.. 3 ghaṇṭānādavisarpiṇamiti gha.. , ja.. ca 4 niṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 liṅgamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 6 vinyāsa iti ga.. 7 kṛtasnātāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 8 sahasraiḥ sāhamāsādyeti ja.. 9 yavaratnādisaṃyuktāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca 10 liṅgavatkṛtavinyāsamiti kha.. , cha.. ca 11 kṛtasnānādikāmiti tadvalliṅgamūle śilāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca / kṛtasnānādikaṃ tadvalliṅgamūle śivāmiti ja.. :p 322 praṇavapūrvaṃ huṃ pūṃ hrīṃ(1) madhyādanyatamena ca / kriyāśaktiyutāṃ piṇḍīṃ śilāmādhararūpiṇīṃ
bhasmadarbhatilaiḥ kuryāt prākāratritayantataḥ / rakṣāyai lokapālāṃś ca sāyudhānyājayedvahiḥ(2)

oṃ hūṃ hraṃ(3) kriyāśaktaye namaḥ / oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ haḥ(4) mahāgaurī rudradayite svāheti ca(5) piṇḍikāyāṃ / oṃ hāṃ(6) ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ dhārikāṃ dīptimatyugrā jyotsnā caitā balotkaṭāḥ / tathā dhātrī vidhātrī ca nyasedvā pañcanāyikāḥ
vāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyā jñānā(7) bedhā tisrīthavā nyaset / kriyājñānā tathecchā ca(8) pūrvavacchāntimūrtiṣu
tamo mohā kṣamī niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāyābhavajvarāḥ(9) / pañca cātha mahāmohā ghorā ca tritayajvarā

1 praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ hūṃ prauṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. / praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ iti ga.. / praṇavapūrvaṃ krūṃ sūṃ kloṃ krīṃ iti cha.. / praṇavaṃ pūrvahūṃ srīṃ sūṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. /praṇavapūrvaṃ hūṃ sūṃ hūṃ iti ja.. 2 sāyudhān pūjayettata iti kha.. , cha.. ca / sāyudhān pūjayedvahiriti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / sāyudhāś ca tyajedvahiriti gha.. / sāyudhānyājagredvahiriti ja.. 3 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / oṃ hrīṃ iti gha.. / oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti ga.. 4 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ sa iti kha.. / oṃ krūṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. / oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti ga.. / oṃ hrīṃ sa iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 svāheti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 6 oṃ hrīṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 7 kriyā medheti ṅa.. 8 tathaivaiccheti ṅa.. 9 tamā mohā kṣamā niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāya bhayā jvareti kha.. / umā mohā kṣamā nityā mṛtyurmāyābhayājvarā iti ja.. :p 323 tisrothavā kriyājñānā(1) tathā bādhādhināyikā / ātmāditriṣu(2) tattveṣu tīvramūrtiṣu vinyaset
atrāpi piṇḍikā brahmaśilādiṣu yathāvidhi / gauryādisaṃvarair eva(3) pūrvavat sarvamācaret(4)
evaṃ vidhāya vinyāsaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ tataḥ / kuṇḍamadhye maheśānaṃ mekhalāsu maheśvaraṃ
kriyāśaktiṃ tathānyāsu nādamoṣṭhe ca(5) vinyaset / ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavahnīśaiḥ(6) nāḍīsandhānakantataḥ(7)
padmatantusamāṃ śaktimudvātena samudyatāṃ(8) / viśantī sūryamārgeṇa niḥsarantīṃ samudgatāṃ(9)
punaś ca śūnyamārgeṇa(10) viśatīṃ svasya cintayet / evaṃ sarvatra sandheyaṃ mūrtipaiś ca parasparaṃ
sampūjya dhārikāṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍe santarpya ca kramāt / tattvatattveśvarā murtīrmūrtīrśāṃś ca(11) ghṛtādibhiḥ(12)

sampūjya tarpayitvā tu sannidhau saṃhitāṇubhiḥ(13) / 1 kriyājñānīti ga.. , gha.. ca 2 ājñāditriṣu iti gha.. 3 gauryādisañcarair eveti gha.. , ja.. ca 4 pūrvavat sarvamarcayediti kha.. , cha.. ca / pūrvavacca samācarediti ja.. /nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācare sadidi ḍa.. 5 nādamadhye ceti ja.. 6 ghaṭaṃ sthaṇḍilavargīśair iti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 nāḍīsambhārakaṃ tata iti ja.. 8 tattvatattveśvarā mūrtiḥ svargyā tena samucyatāmiti kha.. , cha.. ca /pañcatattvasamāṃ śaktiṃ svadhā tena samudyatāmiti ṅa.. 9 samudgamāniti ja.. 10 sūryamārgeṇeti cha.. 11 mūrti mūrtīśāṃśceti ja.. 12 ghaṭasthaṇḍiletyādiḥ, ghṛtādibhiratyantaḥ pāṭho gha.. pustake nāsti 13 saṃhitātmabhiriti kha.. / sahitātmabhiriti cha.. / saṃghaṭāṇubhiriti ja.. :p 324 śataṃ sahasramardhaṃ vā pūrṇayā saha homayet(1)
tattvatattveśvarā mūrtirmūrtīśāṃś ca kareṇukān(2) / tathā santarpya sānnidhye juhuyurmūrtipā api
tato brahmabhiraṅgaiś ca(3) dravyakālānurodhataḥ / santarpya śaktiṃ kumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite(4) kuśamūlataḥ
liṅgamūlaṃ ca saṃspṛśya(5) japeyurhomasaṅkhyayā / sannidhānaṃ hṛdā kuryurvarmaṇā cāvaguṇṭhanaṃ
evaṃ saṃśodhya brahmādi(6) viṣṇvantādi viśuddhaye / vidhāya pūrvavatsarvaṃ homasaṅkhyājapādikam
kuśamadhyāgrayogena liṅgamadhyāgrakaṃ spṛśet / yathā yathā ca sandhānaṃ tadidānīmihocyate

oṃ hāṃ haṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ eṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāhyamūrtaye namaḥ(7) 1 evaṃ vidhāyetyādiḥ, pūrṇayā saha homayedityantaḥ saptaślokātmakaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 2 mūrtipāṃś ca kareṇukān iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 brahmabhiraṃśaiśceti kha.. , gha.. ca / brahmabhirajñaiśceti cha.. , ja.. ca 4 santarpya śaktikumbhāmbhaḥprokṣite iti ka.. / santarpyaśāntikumbhasthaiḥ prokṣite iti ja.. / santarpya śāntikumbhāmbhaḥ prokṣite iti gha.. 5 sampūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca 6 brahmādīniti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha ca 7 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ bīṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāstumūrtaye nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca / oṃ hāṃ oṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ hāṃ vāṃ kṣmāmūrtaye nama iti ja.. / gha.. pustake bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ iti viśeṣaḥ / oṃ hāṃ hāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāhyamūrtaye nama iti ṅa.. :p 325 o hāṃ vāṃ āṃ oṃ āṃ ṣāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vā(1) vahnimūrtaye namaḥ evañca yajamānādimūrtibhirabhisandheyaṃ(2) / pañcamūrtyātmakepyevaṃ sandhānaṃ hṛdayādibhiḥ
mūlena svīyavījair vā jñeyantattvatrayātmake(3) / śilāpiṇḍo vṛṣeṣvevaṃ pūrṇāchinnaṃ susaṃvaraiḥ(4)
bhāgābhāgaviśuddhyarthaṃ homaṃ kuryācchatādikaṃ(5) / nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya śivenāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ
hutvātha(6) yat kṛtaṃ karma śivaśrotre(7) nivedayet / etatsamanvitaṃ(8) karma tvacchaktau ca mayā prabho
oṃ namaḥ bhagavate rudrāya rudra namostu te(9)/ vidhipūrṇamapūrṇaṃ vā svaśaktyāpūrya(10) gṛhyatāṃ
oṃ hrīṃ(11) śāṅkari pūraya(12) svāhā iti piṇḍikāyāṃ / atha liṅge nyasej jñānī kriyākhyaṃ pīṭhavigrahe
ādhārarūpiṇīṃ śaktiṃ nyased brahmaśilopari / nibadhya(13) saptarātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ trirātrakaṃ

1 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ vāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , cha ca / oṃ hāṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ hūṃ hūṃ vāṃ iti ja / oṃ oṃ hāṃ vāṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ iti ṅa.. 2 mūrtibhirapi sandheyamiti gha.. , ja.. ca 3 jñeyaṃ tattu trayātmakamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / deyaṃ tatra trayātmake iti ṅa.. 4 pūrṇācchinnātmakasaṃvarair iti kha.. , cha.. ca / pūrṇācchinnaṃ svayaṃvarair iti ṅa.. 5 śatādhikamiti ga.. , gha.. ca 6 stutvātheti ṅa.. 7 śivāgre taditi ṅa.. 8 samarpitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 9 rudrāya rudro rudra namostu te iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca 10 svaśaktyāpūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca 11 oṃ hrūṃ iti gha.. 12 pūjayeti kha.. , cha.. , ṅa.. ca 13 nirudhyeti kha.. , ja.. , ṅa.. ca :p 326 ekarātramatho vāpi yadvā sadyodhivāsanaṃ(1) / vinādhivāsanaṃ yāgaḥ kṛto 'pi phalapradaḥ
svamantraiḥ pratyahaṃ deyamāhutīnāṃ śataṃ śataṃ / śivakumbhādipūjāñca digbilañca nivedayet
gurvādisahito vāso(2) rātrau niyamapūrvakam / adhivāsaḥ sa vasatevadherbhāvaḥ samīritaḥ
śivapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca (3)prātar nitpavidhiṃ kṛtvā dvārapālaprapūjanaṃ / praviśya pragvidhānena dehaśuddhyādimācaret

dikpatīṃś ca samabhyarcya śivakumbhañca vardhanīṃ / 1 satyādhivāsanamiti ja.. 2 dīkṣāntañca samabhyarcyeti ja.. 3 vāsudeva dayāśīla līlayā māṃ samuddhara / gharoddhāre samarthosi mamoddhāre kiyañchramaḥ // iti śloko kha.. , cha.. pustakedhikotrāsti :p 327 aṣṭamuṣṭikayā(1) liṅgaṃ vahniṃ sanparpya ca kramāt
śivājñātastato gacchet prāsādaṃ śastramuccaran(2) / tadgatān prakṣipedvighnān humphaḍantaśarāṇunā(3)
na madhye sthāpayelliṅgaṃ bedhadoṣaviśaṅkayā / tasmān madhyaṃ parityajya yavārdhena yavena vā
kiñcidīśānamāśritya śilāṃ madhye niveśayet / mūlena tāmanantākhyāṃ sarvādhārasvarūpiṇīṃ(4)
sarvagāṃ sṛṣṭiyogena vinyasedacalāṃ śilāṃ / athavānena mantreṇa śivasyāsanarūpiṇīṃ
oṃ namo vyāpini bhagavati sthire 'cale dhruve / hraṃ laṃ hrīṃ svāhā(5) tvayā śivājñayā śakte sthātavyamiha santataṃ
ityuktvā ca samabhyarcya(6) nirudhyādraudramudrayā(7) / vajrādīni ca ratnāni tathośīrādikauṣadhīḥ
lohān hemādikāṃsyantān haritālādikāṃs tathā / dhānyaprabhṛtiśastrāṃś ca pūrvamuktānanukramāt
prabhārāgatvadehatvavīryaśaktimayānimān(8) / bhāvayennekacittastu lokapāleśasaṃvaraiḥ(9)

pūrvādiṣu ca garteṣu(10) nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāt(11) / 1 aṣṭaputriyeti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / aṣṭapuṣpikayeti ga.. , ṅa.. , ca /aṣṭapuṣṭikayā iti ja.. 2 prāsādamastramuccaran iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca / prasādaṃ śāstramuccaranniti ga.. , ja.. ca 3 huṃ phaḍantaśivātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / huṃ phaḍantaśivāṇuneti ja.. 4 sarvādhānasvarūpiṇīmiti ja.. 5 hraṃ laṃ hraṃ svāheti kha.. , cha.. , ca / oṃ hrāṃ laṃ hāṃ svāheti ja.. 6 ity uktvā taṃ samabhyarcyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / ity unmūlaṃ samabhyarceti ga.. /ity uccārya samabhyarcyeti ṅa.. 7 virundhyādrodhamudrayeti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca 8 vīryāśaktimanukramāditi gha.. 9 lokapāleśasañcarair iti gha.. 10 pūrvādivatsvagarteṣu iti ṅa.. 11 prabhārāgetyādiḥ nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāditi pāṭhaḥ, chapustake nāsti :p 328 hemajaṃ tārajaṃ kūrmaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā dvārasammukhaṃ(1)
sarittaṭamṛdā yuktaṃ parvatāgramṛdāthavā(2) / prakṣipenmadhyagartādau(3) yadvā meruṃ suvarṇajaṃ
madhūkākṣatasaṃyuktamañjanena samanvitaṃ / pṛthivīṃ rājatīṃ yadvā yadvā hemasamudbhavāṃ
sarvavījasuvarṇābhyāṃ samāyuktāṃ vinikṣipet(4) / svarṇajaṃ rājataṃ vāpi sarvalohasamudbhavaṃ(5)
suvarṇaṃ kṛśarāyuktaṃ padmanālaṃ(6) tato nyaset / devadevasya śaktyādimūrtiparyantamāsanaṃ
prakalpya pāyasenātha liptvā(7) guggulunāthavā / śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanutreṇāstrarakṣitaṃ(8)
dikpatibhyo baliṃ(9) datvā samācānto 'tha deśikaḥ / śevena vā śilāśvabhrasaṅgadoṣanivṛttaye(10)

śastreṇa vā śataṃ samyag juhuyāt pūrṇayā saha / 2 mṛdā puna iti ga.. 3 madhyagartāyāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 4 madhūkākṣatettyādiḥ, vinikṣipedityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 5 sarvalohasamanvitamiti ga.. 6 pañcadhānyamiti kha.. , gha.. ca 7 lipteti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 8 śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanmātreṇa svarakṣitamiti kha.. , ṅa.. ca /yantramācchādya śastreṇa tanutreṇa svarakṣitamiti ja.. /śvabhrettyādipāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti 9 dikpālādibhyo balimiti ḍa.. 10 śilāstatra saṅgadoṣanivṛttaye iti gha.. , ja.. ca / śilāśvabhramaṅgadoṣavṛttaye iti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 329 ekaikāhutidānena santarpya vāstudevatāḥ
samutthāpya hṛdādevamāsanaṃ maṅgalādibhiḥ / gururdevāgrato gacchenmūrtipaiś ca diśi sthitaiḥ(1)
caturbhiḥ saha kartavyā devayajñasya(2) pṛṣṭhataḥ / prāsādādi(3) paribhramya bhadrākhyadvārasammukhaṃ
liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya datvārghyaṃ prāsādaṃ sanniveśayet(4) / dvāreṇa dvārabandhena dvāradeśena tacchilā
dvārabandhe śikhāśūnye tadardhenātha tadṛte(5) / varjayan(6) dvārasaṃsparśaṃ dvāreṇaiva maheśvaraṃ
devagṛhasamārambhe koṇenāpi praveśayet / ayameva vidhirjñeyo vyaktaliṅge 'pi sarvataḥ
gṛhe praveśanaṃ dvāre lokair api samīritaṃ / apadvārapraveśena vidurgotrakṣayaṃ gṛhaṃ(7)
atha pīṭhe(8) ca saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ dvārasya sammukhaṃ / tūryamaṅgalanirgheṣair dūrvākṣatasamanvitaṃ

samuttiṣṭhaṃ hṛdetyuktvā mahāpāśupataṃ paṭhet / 1 mūrtipaiḥ svadiśi sthitair iti ja.. 2 bandhubhiḥ saha kartavyā devayānasyeti kha.. / bandhubhiḥ sahakāre ca devālayasya iti ga.. , ja.. ca 3 prāsādārdhamiti ja.. 4 sampraveśayediti gha.. 5 tadardhenātha ghātayet iti jha.. / tadardhenātha tatsute iti ga.. / tadardhenātha tadyatimiti gha.. / tadardhe vātha tatsutamiti ja.. / tadardhe nātha tadyute iti ṅa.. 6 bandhane iti kha.. / bandhyan iti gha.. / rakṣayan iti jha.. / varjayediti cha.. 7 vittagotrakṣayaṃ guhamiti ga.. 8 atha caivaṃ iti ja.. , jha.. , gha.. ca :p 330 apanīya ghaṭaṃ śvabhrād(1) deśiko mūrtipaiḥ saha
mantraṃ sandhārayitvā tu(2) viliptaṃ(3) kuṅkumādibhiḥ / śaktiśaktimatoraikyaṃ dhyātvā caiva tu rakṣitaṃ(4)
layāntaṃ(5) mūlamuccārya spṛṣṭvā śvabhre niveśayet(5) / aṃśena brahmabhāgasya yadvā aṃśadvayena ca
ardhena vāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyātha praveśanaṃ(7) / vidhāya sīsakaṃ nābhidīrghābhiḥ(8) susamāhitaḥ
śvabhraṃ(9) vālukayāpurya brūyāt sthirībhaveti ca(10) / tato liṅge sthirībhūte dhyātvā(11) sakalarūpiṇaṃ
mūlamuccārya śaktyantaṃ sṛṣṭyā ca niṣkalaṃ(12) nyaset / sthāpyamānaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ yāmyāṃ diśamathāśrayet(13)

tattaddigīśamantreṇa pūrṇāntaṃ dakṣiṇānvitaṃ / 1 ghaṭaṃ tatra iti jha.. 2 mantraṃ sandhārayitvātha iti kha.. / patrasthaṃ dhārayitvā tu, iti gha.. 3 suliptamiti ga.. 4 lakṣitamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ca 5 namontamiti ḍa.. 6 śaktimudre niveśayediti ja.. 7 ardhena cāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyādhaḥ praveśanam iti ja.. 8 sīsakaṃ vāgbhirdīrghābhiriti cha.. / sīsakaṃ cāpi dīrghāriti ja.. 9 atheti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 10 layāmantamityādiḥ, sthirībhaveti ca ity antaḥ sārdhaślokadvayātmakaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 11 dhyāyediti gha.. 12 sṛṣṭyādivikalamiti jha.. / sṛṣṭyādiniṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ca / sṛṣṭyādi niṣphalamiti ga.. , ḍa.. ca 13 tato liṅge ity ādiḥ, diśamathāśrayedityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti :p 331 savye sthāne ca vakre ca(1) calite sphuṭitepi vā
juhuyān mūlamantreṇa bahurūpeṇa(2) vā śataṃ / kuñcānyeṣvapi doṣeṣu śivaśāntiṃ samāśrayet(3)
yuktaṃ nyāsādibhirliṅgaṃ(4) kurvannevaṃ na doṣabhāk / pīṭhabandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṃśalakṣaṇaṃ(5)
gaurīmantraṃ layaṃ nītvā sṛṣṭyā piṇḍīñca vinyaset / sampūrya pārśvasaṃsiddhiṃ vālukāvajralepanaṃ(6)
tato mūrtidharaiḥ sārdhaṃ guruḥ śāntiṃ ghaṭordhvataḥ / saṃsthāpya kalaśair anyaistadvat(7) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ
vilipya candanādyaiś ca(8) sampūjya jagadīśvaraṃ / umāmaheśamantrābhyāṃ tau spṛśelliṅgamudrayā
tatastritattvavinyāsaṃ ṣaḍarcādipuraḥsaraṃ(9) / kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tadīśānāmaṅgānāṃ brahmaṇāmatha
jñānī liṅge(10) kriyāpīṭhe vināsya snāpayettataḥ / gandhair vilipya sandhūpya vyāpitve śive nyaset

sragdhūpadīpanaivedyair hṛdayena phalāni ca / 1 vakreṇeti kha.. 2 catūrūpeṇa iti jha.. 3 sthāpyamānamityādiḥ, śāntaṃ samāśrayat ity antaḥ pāṭhī ga.. , ṅa.. , pustake nāsti 4 uktanyāsavidhiṃ liṅge iti kha.. / uktanyāsavidhau liṅge iti ga.. 5 pīṭha bandhamadhaḥ kṛtvā kurvanneva na doṣabhāk iti kha.. , ga.. ca / pīṭha bandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṅgalakṣaṇamiti gha.. 6 pārśvasiddhiṃ ca vālukāvrajalepanamiti ja.. 7 saptāranyakalaśair anyaiḥ stutvā iti jha.. 8 caturājyaiś ca iti jha.. 9 ṣaḍarghādipuraḥsaramiti jha.. / ṣaḍagrādipuraḥsaramiti kha.. 10 jñānaliṅge iti jha.. :p 332 vinivedya yathāśakti samācamya maheśvaraṃ
datvārghaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā(1) nivedya varade kare(2) / candrārkatārakaṃ yāvan mantreṇa śaivamūrtipaiḥ(3)
svecchayaiva tvayā nātha sthātavyamiha mandire / praṇamyeva vahirgatvā(4) hṛdā vā praṇavena vā
saṃsthāpya vṛṣabhaṃ paścāt pūrvavadvalimācaret / nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya(5) tato mṛtyujitā śataṃ
śivena saśivo hutvā śāntyarthaṃ pāyasena ca / jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yacca tat pūraya mahāvibho(6)
hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādi(7) gītavādyādihetave / ambikeśāya tad bhaktyā śaktyā sarvaṃ nivedayet
dānaṃ mahotsavaṃ paścāt kuryāddinacatuṣṭayaṃ / trisandhyaṃ tridinaṃ mantrī homayen mūrtipaiḥ saha
caturthehani pūrṇāñca carukaṃ bahurūpiṇā / nivedya sarvakuṇḍeṣu sampātāhutisodhitam(8)
dinacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvattannirmālyantadūrdhataḥ / nirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu(9) pūjayet

pūjā sāmānyaliṅgeṣu kāryā sādhāraṇāṇubhiḥ(10) / 1 jalaṃ hutvā iti ga.. 2 nivedya varadevake iti ja.. 3 mantreśair mūrtipaiḥ saha iti jha.. / mantreśair mūrtijaiḥ saha iti gha.. 4 vahiṣkṛtvā iti jha.. / vahirhatvā iti gha.. 5 nyūnādidoṣamokṣāyeti ja.. / nyānādidoṣanāśāyeti ṅa.. 6 mahāprabho iti jha.. 7 hiraṇyavastradhūpādi iti jha.. 8 pāyasāhutisodhitamiti jha.. / sampātāhutiśodhanamiti ga.. 9 snāpayitvā ca iti ga.. 10 sādhāraṇāṃśubhiriti kha.. / sādhāraṇādikamiti ga.. :p 333 vihāya liṅgacaitanyaṃ kuryāt sthāṇuvisarjanaṃ
asādhāraṇaliṅgeṣu kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ / āvāhanamabhivyaktirvisargaḥ śaktirūpatā
pratiṣṭhānte kvacit proktaṃ sthirādyāhutisaptakaṃ / sthiras tathāprameyaścānādibodhastathaiva ca
nityotha sarvagaś caivāvināśī dṛṣṭa eva ca(1) / ete guṇā maheśasya sannidhānāya kīrtitāḥ(2)
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sthiro bhavetyāhutīnāṃ kramaḥ / evametañca sampādya vidhāya śivakumbhavat(3)
kumbhadvayañca tanmadhyādekakumbhāmbhasā bhavaṃ / saṃsnāpya tad dvitīyantu kartṛsnānāya dhārayet
datvā baliṃ samācamya vahirgacchet śivājñayā(4) / jagatīvāhyataś caṇḍamaiśānyāndiśi mandire
dhāmagarbhapramāṇe ca(5) supīṭhe(6) kalpitāsane / pūrvavan nyāsahomādi vidhāya dhyānapūrvakaṃ
saṃsthāpya vidhivattatra brahmāṅgaiḥ(7) pūjayettataḥ / aṅgāni pūrvayuktāni(8) brahmāṇī tvarcanā yathā(9)

1 vilāsī tṛpta eva ca iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / avināśī tṛpta eva ca iti ṅa.. 2 sannidhāya prakīrtitā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 oṃ nama ity ādi, śivakumbhavat ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti /śivāya śivakumbhavat iti ga.. 4 vahiḥ kumbhe śivājñayā iti jha.. 5 vāmagarbhapramāṇena iti jha.. 6 svapīṭhe iti ga.. 7 brahmādyair iti ga.. , jha.. ca 8 pūrvamuktāni iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / pūrvabhuktānīti ja.. 9 tvadhunā yathā iti kha.. :p 334 evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(1) namaḥ / oṃ viṃ vāmadevāya hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ buṃ(2) aghorāya hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ(3) tatpuruṣāya vaumīśānāya ca hrūṃ phaṭ || japaṃ vivedya(4) santarpya vijñāpya natipūrvakaṃ / devaḥ sannihito yāvattāvattvaṃ sannidho bhava
nyūnādhikañca yatkiñcit kṛtamajñānato mayā(5) / tavatprasādena caṇḍeśa tat sarvaṃ paripūraya
vāṇaliṅge vāṇarohe(6) siddhaliṅge svayambhuvi / pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na caṇḍo 'dhikṛto bhavet
advaitabhāvanāyukte sthaṇḍileśavidhāvapi(7) / abhyarcya caṇḍaṃ sasutaṃ yajamānaṃ hi bhāryayā
pūrvasthāpitakumbhe na snāpayet snāpakaḥ(8) svayaṃ / sthāpakaṃ yajamānopi sampūjya ca(9) maheśavat(10)

vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā dadyād bhūhiraṇyādi(11) dakṣiṇāṃ / 1 oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭ iti jha.. / evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca / oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭ nama iti ga.. , ja.. ca 2 oṃ vaṃ iti jha.. 3 oṃ evaṃ ceti cha.. / oṃ evaṃ cediti ṅa.. / oṃ vai iti ja.. 4 dhūpaṃ nivedya iti gha.. 5 kṛtamajñānatopi vā iti ga.. 6 bāṇaliṅge cale lohe iti ja.. 7 sthaṇḍile sannidhāvapi iti ja.. , jha.. ca 8 sthāpaka iti ja.. 9 prapūjya ca iti ja.. 10 maheśvaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca 11 gohiraṇyādi iti ja.. , jha.. ca :p 335 mūrtimān vidhivat paścāt jāpakān brāhmaṇāṃs tathā
devajñaṃ śilpinaṃ prārcya dīnānāthādi(1) bhojayet / yadatra sammukhībhāve svedito bhagavanmayā
kṣamasva nātha tat sarvaṃ kāruṇyāmbunidhaṃ mama(2) / iti vijñaptiyuktāya yajamānāya sadguruḥ
pratiṣṭhāpuṇyasadbhāvaṃ(3) sphurattārakasaprabhaṃ(4) / kuśapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ svakareṇa samarpayet
tataḥ pāśapatopetaṃ(5) praṇamya parameśvaraṃ / tato 'pi balibhirbhūtān sannidhāya nibodhayet
sthātavyaṃ bhavatā tāvad yāvat sannihito haraḥ(6) / gururvastrādisaṃyuktaṃ gṛhṇīyādyāgamaṇḍapaṃ
sarvopakaraṇaṃ śilpī tathā snāpanamaṇḍapaṃ(7) / anye devādayaḥ sthāpyā mantrair āgamasambhavaiḥ
ādivarṇasya bhedādvā(8) sutattvavyāptibhāvitāḥ(9) / sādhya(10) pramukhadevāś ca saridoṣadhayas tathā

kṣetrapāḥ kinnarādyāś ca pṛthivītattvamāśritāḥ / 1 dīnānāthāṃśceti ja.. 2 deva tvaṃ nātha tat sarvaṃ kāruṇyān manave nama iti jha.. 3 pratiṣṭhāyajñasambhāramiti ga.. 4 sphurattārakasannibhamiti 5 tataḥ paśupatiṃ japtvā iti kha.. , ga.. ca 6 bhava iti kha.. , gha.. ca 7 gururvastrāṇītyādiḥ, snānamaṇḍapamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 8 ādivarṇasya śeṣādvā iti jha.. 9 svātantryā vyāptirīritā iti ga.. / svatattvavyāptibhāvitā iti cha.. /svatantravyāptibhedata iti ja.. 10 jāpya iti jha.. :p 336 snānaṃ sarasvatīlakṣmīnadīnāmambhasi kvacit
bhuvanādhipatīnāñca sthānaṃ yatra vyavasthitiḥ / aṇḍavṛddhipradhānāntaṃ tritattvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ
tanmātrādipradhānāntaṃ(1) padametat trikaṃ hareḥ(2) / nāṭyeśagaṇamātṝṇāṃ yakṣeśaśarajanmanāṃ
aṇḍajāḥ śuddhavidyāntaṃ padaṃ gaṇapates tathā / māyāṃśadeśaśaktyanataṃ śivā śivoptarociṣāṃ(3)
padamīśvaraparyantaṃ vyaktārcāsu ca kīrtitaṃ / kūrmādyaṃ kīrtitaṃ yacca yacca ratnādipañcakaṃ(4)
pratikṣipet pīṭhagarte ca pañcabrahmaśilāṃ vinā / ṣaḍbhirvibhājite garte(5) tyaktvā bhāvañca pṛṣṭhataḥ
sthāpanaṃ pañcamāṃśe ca yadi vā vasubhājite / sthāpanaṃ saptame bhāge pratimāsu sukhāvahaṃ
dhāraṇābhirviśuddhiḥ syāt sthāpane lepacitrayoḥ / snānādi mānasantatra śilāratnādiveśanaṃ(6)
netrodghāṭanamantreṣṭamāsanādiprakalpanaṃ / pūjā nirambubhiḥ puṣpair yathā citraṃ na duṣyati

vidhistu calaliṅgeṣu sampratyeva nigadyate / 1 tanmātrādiprayāṇāntamiti kha.. 2 tattvamekaṃ citraṃ hareriti gha.. 3 snānaṃ sarasvatītyādiḥ, rociṣāmityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 4 yadratnādikapañcakamiti ja.. 5 ṣaḍabhirbhājite garbhe iti ṅa.. 6 śilāvāhādiveśanaṃ iti jha.. / śilāratnaniveśanamiti kha.. :p 337 pañcabhirvā tribhirvāpi pṛthak kuryād(1) vibhājite(2)
bhagatrayeṇa bhāgāṃśo bhavedbhāgadvayena vā / svapīṭheṣvapi(3) tadvat syālliṅgeṣu tattvabhedataḥ
sṛṣṭimantreṇa saṃskāro vidhivat sphāṭikādiṣu / kiñca brahmaśilāratnaprabhūteścānivedanaṃ(4)
yojanaṃ piṇḍikāyāś ca manasā parikalpayet / svayambhūvāṇaliṅgādau(5) saṃskṛtau niyamo na hi
snāpanaṃ saṃhitāmantrair nyāsaṃ homañca kārayet / nadīsamudrarohāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūrvavan mataṃ
aihikam mṛṇmayaṃ liṅgaṃ piṣṭakādi ca takṣaṇāt(6) / kṛtvā sampūjayecchuddhaṃ sīkṣaṇādividhānataḥ(7)
samādāya tato mantrānātmānaṃ sannidhāya ca / tajjale prakṣipelliṅgaṃ vatsarāt kāmadaṃ bhavet
viṣṇvādisthāpanaṃ caiva pṛyaṅmantraiḥ samācaret /
gaurīpratiṣṭhākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣye gaurīpratiṣṭhāñca pūjayā sahitāṃ śṛṇu / maṇḍapādyaṃ puro yacca(1) saṃsthāpya cādhiropayet
śayyāyāntāṃś ca vinyasya mantrānmūrtyādikān guha / ātmavidyāśivāntañca(2) kuryādīśaniveśanaṃ
śaktiṃ parāṃ tato(3) nyasya hutvā(4) japtvā ca pūrvavat / sandhāya ca tathā piṇḍīṃ(5) kriyāśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ
sadeśavyāpikāṃ dhyātvā nyastaratnādikāṃ tathā / evaṃ saṃsthāpya tāṃ paścāddevīntasyānniyojayet
paraśaktisvarūpāntāṃ svāṇunā(6) śaktiyogataḥ / tato nyaset kriyāśaktiṃ pīṭhe jñānañca vigrahe
tatopi vyāpinīṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya niyojayet / ambikāṃ śivanāmnīñca samālabhya(7) prapūjayet
sūryapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣye sūryapratiṣṭhāñca pūrvavanmaṇḍapādikaṃ / snānādikañca samyādya(1) pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ
vidyāmāsanaśayyāyāṃ sāṅgaṃ vinyasya bhāskaraṃ / tritattvaṃ vinyasettatra sasvaraṃ khādipañcakaṃ
śuddhyādi pūrvavat kṛtvā piṇḍīṃ saṃśodhya pūrvavat / sadeśapadaparyantaṃ vinyasya tattvapañcakaṃ(2)
śaktyā ca sarvatomukhyā saṃsthāpya vidhivatataḥ / svāṇunā(3) vidhivat sūryaṃ śaktyantaṃ(4) sthāpayedguruḥ
svāmyantamathavādityaṃ pādāntannāma dhārayet / sūryamantrāstu(5) pūrvoktā draṣṭavyāḥ sthāpanepi ca(6)
dvārapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ īśvara uvāca dvārāśritapratiṣṭhāyā vakṣyāmi vidhimapyatha / dvārāṅgāni kaṣāyādyaiḥ saṃskṛtya śayane nyaset
mūlamadhyāgrabhāgeṣu trayamātmādiseśvaraṃ / vinyasya sanniveśyātha(1) hutvā japtvātra rūpataḥ(2)
dvārādatho yajedvāstuntatraivānantamantritaḥ / ratnādipañcakaṃ nyasya śāntihomaṃ vidhāya ca
yavasiddhārthakākrāntā ṛddhivṛddhimahātilāḥ / gomṛtsarṣaparāgendramohanīlakṣaṇāmṛtāḥ
rocanā rug vaco dūrvā prāsādadhaś ca poṭalīṃ / prakṛtyodumbare baddhvā rakṣārthaṃ praṇavena tu
dvāramuttarataḥ kiñcidāśritaṃ sanniveśayet / ātmatattvamadho nyasya vidyātattvañca śākhayoḥ
śivamakāśadeśe ca vyāpakaṃ sarvamaṅgale(3) / tato maheśanāthaṃ ca vinyasenmūlamantrataḥ

1 vinyasya ca niveśayātha iti kha.. / vinyasya sannibodhyātheti ja.. 2 ajaptvānurūpata iti ga.. 3 sarvapuṣkalamiti kha.. , gha.. ca :p 342 dvārāśritāṃś ca talpādīn(1) kṛtayuktaiḥ(2) svanāmabhiḥ / juhuyācchatamardhaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ śaktitothavā(3)
nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ hetito juhuyāccchataṃ(4) / digbalimpūrvavaddhutvā(5) pradadyāddakṣiṇādikaṃ
prāsādapratiṣṭhā īavara uvāca prāsādasthāpanaṃ vakṣye taccaitanyaṃ svayogataḥ(6) / śukanāśāsamāptau tu pūrvavedyāś ca madhyataḥ
ādhāraśaktitaḥ padme vinyaste praṇavena ca(7) / svarṇādye katamoddbhataṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutaṃ
madhukṣīrayutaṃ kumbhaṃ nyastaratrādipañcakaṃ(8) / sragvastraṃ gandhaliptañca gandhavatpuṣpabhūṣitaṃ(9)

cūtādipallavānāñca kṛtī kṛtyañca vinyaset(10) / 1 nandyādīna iti kha.. 2 kṛtyayuktair iti ja.. 3 śaktito yathā iti ga.. 4 bhāgatrayeṇetyādiḥ, juhuyācchatamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti / atra katipayaślokādhiko 'dhyāyatrayātmakaḥ pāṭhaḥ patitosti 5 pūrvavad datvā iti ga.. , gha ca 6 taccaitanyañca yogata iti ga.. / taccaitanyasvayogata iti cha.. 7 vinyaste praṇavena tu iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca / vinyaset praṇavena tu iti ga.. 8 madhukṣīrayutaṃ nyastaratnādipañcakaṃ tata iti ga.. 9 gandhavatpuṣpadhūpitamiti ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 10 vahnikṛta padmaṃ vinyasediti kha.. / vahnikūpaṃ yavaṃ nyasediti ga.. / vahnikūpeṣu ca nyasediti ja.. :p 343 pūrakeṇa samādāya sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ
sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svāṇunā(1) svāntamārutaḥ / ājñayā bodhayecchambhau(2) recakena tato guruḥ
dvādaśāntāt(3) samādāya sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ / nikṣipet kumbhagarbhe ca nyastatantrātivāhikaṃ(4)
vigrahantadguṇānāñca bodhakañca kalādikaṃ / kṣāntaṃ vāgīśvaraṃ(5) tattu brātaṃ tatra niveśayet
daśa nāḍīrdaśa prāṇānindriyāṇi trayodaśa / tadadhipāṃś ca saṃyojya praṇavādyaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ
svakāryakāraṇatvena(6) māyākāśaniyāmikāḥ(7) / vidyeśān prerakān śambhuṃ vyāpinañca susamvaraiḥ(8)
aṅgāni ca(9) vinikṣipya nirundhyādrodhamudrā(10) / suvarṇādyudbhavaṃ yadvā puruṣaṃ puruṣānugaṃ
pañcagavyakaṣāyādyaiḥ pūrvavat saṃskṛtantataḥ / śayyāyāṃ kumbhamāropya dhyātvā rudramumāpatiṃ

1 sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svātmanā iti kha.. / sarvātmābhinnamātmā ca sthāṇuneti ja.. 2 bodhayecchaktau iti kha.. , gha.. ca 3 dvādaśāntamiti ga.. , ja.. ca 4 nyasya tatra yathākramamiti ga.. / nyasya tatrābhivāhikamiti cha.. / nyasya tatrābhivādakamiti ja.. 5 vāmeśvaramiti kha.. / bāṇeśvaramiti ṅa.. 6 akāryakāraṇatve neti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 prayāmikā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 8 vyāpinañca svaśaktita iti jha.. / vyāpinañcāsya saṃsravair iti ṅa.. 9 ajñāne ceti gha.. , jha.. ca / aṅkādi ceti ṅa.. 10 nirmañchya droṇamudrayā iti ga.. / nirundhyād dravamudrayā iti jha.. :p 344 tasmiṃś ca śivamantreṇa vyāpakatvena viyaset / sannidhānāya homañca praokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ japaṃ
sānnidhyābodhanaṃ(1) sarvambhāgatrayavibhāgataḥ / vidhāyaivaṃ(2) prakṛtyante(3) kumbhe taṃ viniveśayet
dhvajāropaṇaṃ īśvara uvāca cūlake dhvajadaṇḍe ca(4) dhvaje devakule tathā / pratiṣṭhā ca yathoddiṣṭā(5) tathā skanda vadāmi te(6)
taḍāgārdhapraveśādvā yadvā savārdhaveśanāt / aiṣṭake dārujaḥ(7) śūlaḥ śailaje dhāmni śailajaḥ(8)
vaiṣṇavādau ca cakrāḍhyaḥ kumbhaḥ syānmūrtimānataḥ / sa ca triśūlayuktastu agracūlābhidho mataḥ(9)

1 sannidhyābodhanamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 vidhāyaiveti ja.. 3 prakṛtyā tu iti kha.. 4 cūḍake dhvajadaṇḍe vā iti ja.. 5 yathādiṣṭā iti jha.. 6 tathā hy ahaṃ vadāmi te iti ṅa.. 7 aiṣṭe dārubhava iti gha.. , ja.. ca 8 taḍāgārdhetyādiḥ, śailaja ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 9 agraṃ cūḍābhidho mata iti gha.. / asracūlādidoṣata iti cha.. / gṛhacūḍābhidho mata iti ṅa.. / agraṃ cūḍādidoṣata iti kha.. :p 345 īśaśūlaḥ(1) samākhyāto mūrdhni liṅgasamanvitaḥ / vījapūrakayukto vā śivaśāstreṣu tadvidhaḥ
citro dhvajaś ca jaṅghāto yathā jaṅgārdhato bhavet(2) / bhavedvā daṇḍamānastu yadi vā tadyadṛcchayā(3)
mahādhvajaḥ samākhyāto yastu pīṭhasya veṣṭakaḥ(4) / śakrair grahai rasaivāpi hastair daṇḍastu sambhitaḥ
uttamādikrameṇaiva vijñeyaḥ śūribhistataḥ / vaṃśajaḥ śālajātirvā sa daṇḍaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ
ayamāropyamāṇastu bhaṅgamāyāti vai yadi / rājñoniṣṭaṃ(5) vijānīyādyajamānasya vā tathā(6)
mantreṇa bahurūpeṇa pūrvavacchāntimācaret / dvārapālādipūjāñca mantrāṇāntarpyaṇantathā
vidhāya cūlakaṃ(7) daṇḍaṃ snāpayedastramantrataḥ / anenaiva tu mantreṇa dhvajaṃ samprokṣya deśikaḥ
mṛdu kaṣāyādibhiḥ(8) snānaṃ prāsādaṅkārayettataḥ / vilipya rasamācchādya(9) śayyāyāṃ nyasya pūrvavat

cūḍake(20) liṅgavaṇanyāso na ca jñānaṃ na ca kriyā / 1 īśaścūḍa iti iti ga.. / īśaścūla iti ṅa.. / īṣaścūla iti cha.. /śaśaḥ śūla iti ja.. 2 jaṅghāto yadvā jaṅghārdhato bhavediti kha.. / saṅghāto yathā jaṅghārdhato yajediti gha.. 3 yadi vā tadvidicchayā iti kha.. 4 yastu syāt pīṭhaveṣṭaka iti ṅa.. 5 rājñoriṣṭamiti ja.. 6 vai tathā iti ja.. 7 cūḍakamiti ja.. 8 bhṛtkāṣāyādibhiriti kha.. , cha.. ca 9 vilipya rasamādāyeti ja.. 10 cūlake iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 346 viśeṣārthā(1) caturthī ca na kuṇḍasya(2) kalpanā
daṇḍe tayārthatattvañca(3) vidyātattvaṃ dvitīyakaṃ / sadyojātāni vakrāṇi(4) śivatattvaṃ punardhvaje
niṣkalañca śivantatra nyasyāṅgāni prapūjayet / cūḍake ca(4) tato mantro sānnidhye sahitāṇubhiḥ(6)
homayet pratibhāgañca dhvaje taistu phaḍantikaiḥ(7) / anyathāpi kṛtaṃ yacca dhvajasaṃskāraṇaṃ(8) kvacit
astrayāgavidhāvevaṃ(9) tatsarvamupadarśitaṃ / prāsāde kārite sthāne(10) sragvastrādivibhūṣite
jaṅghā vedī tadūrdhve tu tritattvādi niveśya ca / homādikaṃ vidhāyātha śivaṃ sampūjya pūrvavat
sarvatattvamayaṃ dhyātvā śivañca vyāpakaṃ nyaset / anantaṃ kālarudrañca vibhāvya ca padāmbuje
kuṣmāṇḍahāṭakau pīṭhe pātālanarakaiḥ(11) saha / bhuvanair lokapālaiś ca śatarudrādibhirvṛtaṃ
brahmāṇdakamidaṃ dhyātvā jaṅghātāñca vibhāvayet / vāritejonilavyomapañcāṣṭakasamanvitaṃ(12)

1 viśeṣādyā iti gha.. 2 navadaṇḍasyeti jha.. 3 tathātmatattvañceti ga.. , gha.. ca 4 sadyojātādi vakrāṇīti jha.. 5 cūlake ca iti kha.. , ja.. ca 6 saṃhitātmabhiriti kha.. , ga.. ca 7 cūlake iti śloko jha.pustake nāsti 8 tacca dhvaje saṃharaṇamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca / yacca dhvajasaṃskaraṇamiti gha.. 9 astrayāge vidhāne ceti ja.. 10 prāsādakāritasthāne iti kha.. , jha.. ca / prāsāde kāritasthāne iti ja.. 11 pātālanavakair iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca 12 pañcāggakasamanvitamiti ga.. :p 347 sarvāvaraṇasañjñañca vṛddhayonyavṛkānvitaṃ(1) / yogāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ(2) nāśāvidhi guṇatrayaṃ
paṭasthaṃ puruṣaṃ siṃhaṃ vāmañca(3) paribhāvayet / mañjarīvedikāyāñca vidyādikacatuṣṭayaṃ
kaṇṭhe māyāṃ sarudrāñca(4) vidyāścāmalasārake(5) / kalase ceśvaraṃ vinduṃ vidyeśvarasamanvitaṃ(6)
jaṭājūṭañca taṃ vidyācchūlaṃ candrārdharūpakaṃ / śaktitrayaṃ ca tatraiva daṇḍe nādaṃ vibhāvya ca
dhvaje ca kuṇḍalīṃ śaktimiti dhāmni vibhāvayet / jagatyā vātha sandhāya liṅgaṃ piṇḍikayāthavā(7)
samutthāpya sumantraiś ca(8) vinyaste śaktipaṅkaje / nyastaratnādike tatra svādhāre viniveśayet
yajamāno dhvaje lagne bandhumitrādibhiḥ saha / dhāma pradakṣiṇīkṛtya labhate phalamīhitaṃ(9)
guruḥ pāśupataṃ dhyāyan(10) sthiramantrādhipair yutaṃ(11) / adhipān śastrayuktāṃś ca rakṣaṇāya nibodhayet(12)

1 vuddhayonyantakānvitamiti ga.. 2 yāgaṣṭakasamāyuktamiti jha.. 3 rāgaśceti kha.. , ja.. ca 4 kaṇṭhe māyāṅgavaktrañceti jha.. 5 vidyāścāmanasārake iti kha.. , ga.. ca / vidyādyā manasārake iti ja.. 6 viśveśvarasamanvitamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / vidyottarasamanvitamiti ga.. / sarvāvaraṇasañjñañcetyādiḥ, viśveśvarasamanvitamityantaḥ pāṭho ṅa.pustake nāsti 7 liṅgapiṇḍikayāthaveti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 8 svamantraiśceti ga.. , ṅa.. , ca 9 labhate phalamīpsitamiti ṅa.. 10 pāśupataṃ dhyāyediti kha.. , gha.. ca 11 śivamantrādhipair yutamiti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 12 rakṣaṇāya nivedayediti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 348 nyūnādidoṣaśāntyarthaṃ hutvā(1) datvā ca digbaliṃ / gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yajamāno divaṃ vrajet
pratimāliṅgavedīnāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ / tāvadyugasahasrāṇi karturbhogabhujaḥ(2) phalaṃ
jīrṇoddhāraḥ īśvara uvāca jīrṇādīnāñca liṅgānāmuddhāraṃ vidhinā vade / lakṣmojjhitañca bhagnañca sthūlaṃ vajrahataṃ tathā
saṃpuṭaṃ sphuṭitaṃ vyaṅgaṃ liṅgamityevamādikaṃ / ityādiduṣṭaliṅgānāṃ yojyā piṇḍī(3) tathā vṛṣaḥ
cālitañcalitaṃ liṅgamatyarthaṃ(4) viṣamasthitaṃ / diḍmūḍhaṃ pātitaṃ liṅgaṃ madhyasthaṃ patitaṃ tathā
evaṃvidhañca saṃsthāpya(5) nirbraṇañca bhavedyadi / nadyādikapravāhena tadapākriyate yadi

tato 'nyatrāpi saṃsthāpya vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā / 1 nyūnādidoṣanāśārthaṃ kṛtveti jha.. / nyūnādidoṣanāśāya hutveti gha.. , ja.. ca 2 kartarbhogavata iti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 tyājyā piṇḍīti gha.. 4 nimnamityarthamiti ja.. 5 santyājyamiti jha.. :p 349 susthitaṃ dusthitaṃ vāpi(1) śivaliṅgaṃ na cālayet
śatena sthāpanaṃ kuryāt sahasreṇa tu cālanaṃ(2) / pūjādibhiś ca saṃyuktaṃ jīrṇādyamapi susthitaṃ(3)
yāmye maṇḍapamīśe vā pratyagdvāraikatoraṇaṃ / vidhāya dvārapūjādi sthaṇḍile mantrapūjanaṃ(4)
mantrān santarpya sampūjya vāstudevātuṃ pūrvavat / digbaliṃ ca vahirdatvā samācamya svayaṃ guruḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu śambhuṃ(5) vijñāpayettataḥ / duṣṭaliṅgamidaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śāntiruddhāraṇasya cet(6)
rusistavādividhinā(7) adhitiṣṭhasva māṃ śiva / evaṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaret
madhvājyakṣīradūrvābhirmūlenāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ / tato liṅgaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayet sthiṇḍile(8) tathā

oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti nāṭyantaṃ śivavādinā(9) / 1 dusthitaṃ cāpīti ga.. 2 sahasreṇa ca cālayediti ga.. 3 jīrṇādyamapi saṃsthitamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / pūjayā rahitaṃ yattadanniṣṭhamapi duḥsthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , pustake 'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ 4 sthaṇḍileśaprapūjanamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. ca / sthaṇḍile samprapūjanamiti gha.. , ja.. ca 5 sarvamiti ka.. 6 śāntiruddharaṇe nyasediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 7 rucistavāsti vidhineti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 8 sthaṇḍilamiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 9 oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti tattvenābhyantarādine iti kha.. / oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti nātyantaśivavācineti gha.. / oṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti tattvenātyantavādine iti cha.. :p 350 oṃ vyāpakaṃ hṛdayeśvarāya namaḥ(1) / oṃ vyāpakeśvarāya śirase namaḥ(2) / ity ādyaṅgamantrāḥ(3) tatastatrāśritaṃ tattvaṃ śrāvayedastramastataḥ(4)
sattvaḥ kopīha(5) yaḥ kopiliṅgamāśritya tiṣṭhati / liṅgantyaktvā śivājñābhiryatreṣṭaṃ tatra gacchatu
vidyāvidyeśvarair yuktaḥ sa bhavotra(6) bhaviṣyati / sahasraṃ pratibhāge ca tataḥ pāśupatāṇunā(7)
hutvā śāntyambunā prokṣya spṛṣṭvā kuśair japettataḥ(8) / datvārghaṃ ca vilomena tattvatattvādhipāṃs tathā
aṣṭamūrtīśvarān liṅga(9) piṇḍikāsaṃsthitān guruḥ / visṛjya svarṇapāśena vṛṣaskandhasthayā tathā
rajvā vadhvā tayā nītvā śivamantaṃ gṛṇan janaiḥ / tajjale nikṣipen mantrī puṣṭhyarthaṃ juhuyācchataṃ
tṛptaye dikpatīnāñca vāstuśuddhau(10) śataṃ śataṃ / rakṣāṃ vidhāya taddhāmni mahāpāśupatā tataḥ
liṅgamanyattatastatra vidhivat sthāpayed guruḥ / asurair munibhirgotrastantravidbhiḥ(11) pratiṣṭhitaṃ

1 oṃ vyāpakeśvarāya hṛdayāya nama iti kha.. , ga.. ca / oṃ vyāpakeśvara hṛdayā nama iti jha.. , gha.. ca 2 śirase svāheti ja.. 3 ity aṅgamantrā iti kha.. , ṅa.. , ca / ity ādimantrā iti cha.. 4 snāpayedastramantrata iti cha.. / dhārayedastramantrata iti ja.. 5 siddhvaḥ kopīheti gha.. 6 śambhuratreti gha.. , ja.. ca / prabhuratreti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 pāśupatātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca 8 darbhair japettata iti ṅa.. 9 mūrtimūrtīśvarān liṅge iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 10 vāstumadhye gha.. 11 tattvavidbhiriti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 351 jīrṇaṃ vāpyathavā bhagnaṃ(1) vidhināpi nacālayet / eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryojīrṇadhāmasamuddhṛtau
khaḍge mantragaṇaṃ nyasya kārayet mandirāntaraṃ / saṅkoce maraṇaṃ proktaṃ vistāro tu dhanakṣayaḥ
prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ īśvara uvāca vakṣye prāsādasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ te śikhadhvaja / caturbhāgīkṛte kṣetre bhitterbhāgena vistarāt
adribhāgena(3) garbhaḥ syāt piṇḍikā pādavistarāt / pañcabhāgīkṛte kṣetrentarbhāge(4) tu piṇḍikā
suṣiraṃ bhāgavistīrṇaṃ bhittayo bhāgavistarāt / bhāgau dvau madhyame garbhe jyeṣṭhabhāgadvayena tu(5)

1 jīrṇe prāpya yathā magnamiti kha.. 2 tatpramāṇata iti gha.. 3 ardhabhāgeneti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 4 pañcabhāgīkṛte vāpi madhyabhāge iti gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 5 bhāgau dvau madhyamo garbho jyeṣṭho bhāgadvayena tu iti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 352 tribhistu kanyasāgarbhaḥ(1) śeṣo bhittiriti kvacit / ṣoḍhābhakyethavā kṣetre bhittirbhāgaikavistarāt
garbho bhāgena vistīrṇo bhāgadvayena piṇḍikā / vistārād dviguṇo vāpi sapādadviguṇo 'pi vā
ardhārdhadviguṇo vāpi(2) triguṇaḥ kvacittriducchrayaḥ / jagatī vistarārdhena tribhāgena kvacidbhavet
nemiḥ pādonaviestīrṇā(3) prāsādasya samantataḥ / paridhistrayaṃ śako madhye rathakāṃstatra kārayet
cāmuṇḍaṃ bhairavaṃ teṣu nāṭyeśaṃ ca niveśayet / prāsādārdhena devānāmaṣṭau vā caturo 'pi vā
pradakṣiṇāṃ vahiḥ kuryāt prāsādādiṣu(4) vā navā / ādityāḥ pūrvataḥ sthāpyāḥ skandognirvāyugocare(5)
evaṃ yamādayo nyasyāḥ svasyāḥ svasyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ / caturdhā śikharaṃ kṛtvā śukanāsā dvibhāgikā
tṛtīye vedikā tvagneḥ sakaṇṭho malasārakaḥ(6) / vairājaḥ puṣpakaścānyaḥ kailāso(7) maṇikas tathā
triviṣṭhapañca pañcaiva merumūrdhani saṃsthitāḥ(8) / caturasrastu tatrādyo dvitīyopi tadāyataḥ

1 tribhistu kalaso garbha iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 adhyardhadviguṇo vāpīti gha.. , ja.. ca 3 pādena vistīrṇā iti gha.. , ja.. ca 4 prāsādāddikṣu iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / prāsāde dikṣu iti ṅa.. 5 skandognirvāmagocare iti ka.. 6 sakaṇṭhomavasāraka iti ṅa.. / sakaṇṭhomavasādhaka iti cha.. 7 kailāsya iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca 8 caturdhetyādiḥ, merumūrdhni saṃsthitā ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti :p 353 vṛtto vṛttāyataścānyo(1) hy aṣṭāsraścāpi pañcamaḥ / ekaiko navadhābhedaiś catvāriṃśacca pañca ca
prāsādaḥ prathamo merurdvitiyo mandaras tathā / vimānañca tathā bhadraḥ sarvatobhadra eva ca
caruko(2) nandiko nandirvardhamānas tathāparaḥ / śrīvatsaśceti vairājyānvavāye ca samutthitāḥ
balabhī gṛharājaś ca śālāgṛhañca mandiraṃ / viśālaś ca samo brahma(3) mandiraṃ bhuvanantathā
prabhavaḥ śivikā veśma navaite puṣpakodbhavāḥ(4) / balayo(5) dundubhiḥ padmo mahāpadmaka(6) evaca
vardhanī vānya uṣṇīṣaḥ(7) śaṅkhaś ca kalasas tathā / svavṛkṣaś ca tathāpyete vṛttāḥ kailāsasambhavāḥ(8)
gajotha vṛṣabho haṃso garutmānnṛkṣanāyakaḥ / bhūṣaṇo(9) bhūdharaścānnye śrījayaḥ pṛthavīdharaḥ(10)
vṛttāyatāt samudbhūtā navaite maṇikāhvayāt(11) / vajraṃ cakrantathā cānyat svastikaṃ vajrasvastikaṃ(12)

1 caturvṛttāyataścānya iti gha.. 2 rucakā iti ka.. 3 viśālaś ca mano brahmeti kha.. , gha.. ca / viśālaś ca tathā brahmeti ga.. 4 paṇava iti ja.. 5 mahāpadmaś ca iti ka.. 6 śakunī cāsya uṣṇīṣa iti ja.. 8 vardhanītyādiḥ, kailāsasambhavā ity antaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti 9 vṛṣaṇa iti ṅa.. 10 khavṛkṣaścetyādiḥ, pṛthivīdhara ity antaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti 11 maṇikākṣayāt iti ja.. 12 vajrahastikamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / vajramuṣṭikamiti ja.. :p 354 citraṃ svastikakhaḍgañca gadā śrīkaṇṭha eva ca / vijayo nāmataś caite(1) triviṣṭapasamudbhavāḥ
nagarāṇāmimāḥ sañjñā lāṭādīnāmimās tathā(2) / grīvārdhenonnatañcūlampṛthulañca vibhāgataḥ(3)
daśadhā vedikāṅkṛtvā pañcabhiḥ skandhavistaraḥ / tribhiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ caturbhistu pracaṇḍakaṃ(4)
dikṣu dvārāṇi kāryāṇi na vidikṣu kadācana / piṇḍikā koṇavistīrṇā madhyamāntā hy udāhṛtā
kvacit pañcamabhāgena mahatāṅgarbhapādataḥ / ucchrāyā dviguṇāsteṣāmanyathā vā nigadyate
ṣaṣṭyādhikāt samārabhya aṅgulānāṃ śatādiha(5) / uttamānyapi catvāri dvārāṇi daśahānitaḥ(6)
trīṇyeva madhyamāni syustrīṇyeva kanyasānyataḥ / ucchrāyārdhena vistāro hy ucchrāyo 'bhyadhikastridhā
caturbhiraṣṭabhirvāpi daśabhiraṅgulaistataḥ(7) / ucchrāyāt pādavistīrṇā viśākhāstaduduṃvare(8)

vistarārdhena bāhulyaṃ(9) sarveṣāmeva kīrtitam / 1 vijayo nāyakaś caite iti ga.. 2 naṭādīnāmimāstatheti kha.. , ṅa.. ca / nāṭyādīnāmimāstatheti ga.. , gha.., cha.. ca / nādādīnāmimāstatheti ja.. 3 pṛthulaṃ svatribhāgata iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / pṛthusamudrabhāgata iti ṅa.. 4 caturbhistu tadaṇḍakamiti kha.. , ga.. ca / caturbhiḥ kṛtadaṇḍakamiti ja.. 5 ṣaṣṭyādhikāṃśamārabhya aṅgulānāṃ śatādhikamiti ja.. 6 uttamānyapi catvāri catvāri daśahānita iti ja.. 7 daśabhirvā guṇaiḥ śubha iti cha.. 8 viśākhāsthe tvaḍumbare iti cha.. ca 9 viśuddhena tu vāhulyamiti kha.. / vistarārdhena vā hanyāditi jha.. / vistarārdhena bahulyamiti ja.. :p 355 dvipañcasaptanavabhiḥ śākhābhirdvāramiṣṭadaṃ
adhaḥśākhācaturthāṃśe pratīhārau niveśayet / mithunaiḥ pādavarṇābhiḥ(1) śākhāśeṣaṃ vibhūṣayet
stambhabiddhe bhṛtyatā syāt vṛkṣabiddhe tvabhūtitā / kūpabiddhe bhayaṃ dvāre kṣetrabiddhe(2) dhanakṣayaḥ
prāsādagṛhaśilādimārgaviddheṣu(3) bandhanaṃ / sabhābiddhe na dāridryaṃ varṇabiddhe(4) nirākṛtiḥ
ulūkhalena dāridryaṃ śilābiddhena śatrutā(5) / chāyābiddhena dāridryaṃ bedhadoṣo na jāyate
chedādutpāṭanādvāpi tathā prākāralakṣaṇāt / sīmāyā dviguṇatyāgād bedhadoṣo na jāyate

nagarādivāstukathanaṃ īśvara uvāca nagaragrāmadurgādyā(6) gṛhaprāsādavṛddhaye / 1 mithunair atha vallībhiriti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 dvāre śvabhrabiddhe iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 mārgavedhaiś ca iti cha.. 4 cullībiddhe iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 śilābiddhena mūḍhatāṃ iti ga.. , ja.. ca 6 nagaragrāmadurgādau iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / nagaragrāmadurgākhyamiti gha.. :p 356 ekāśītipadair vastuṃ pūjayet siddhaye dhruvaṃ
prāgāsyā daśadhā nāḍyāstāsāṃ nāmāni ca bruve / śāntā yaśovatī kāntā viśālā prāṇavāhinī
satī vasumatī nandā subhadrātha(1) manoramā(2) / uttarā dvādaśānyāś ca(3) ekāśītyaṅghrikārikā
hariṇī suprabhā lakṣmīrvibhūtirvimalā priyā / jayā jvālā viśokā ca smṛtāstatrapādataḥ(4)
īśādyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ dikṣu yajedīśaṃ dhanañjayaṃ / śakramarkaṃ tathā satyaṃ(5) bhṛśaṃ vyoma ca pūrvataḥ
havyavāhañca pūrvāṇi vitathaṃ bhaumameva ca / kṛtāntamatha gandharvaṃ bhṛgaṃ mṛgañca dakṣiṇe
pitaraṃ dvārapālañca sugrīvaṃ puṣpadantakaṃ / varuṇaṃ daityaśeṣau ca yakṣmāṇaṃ paścime sadā
rogāhimukhyo(6) bhallāṭaḥ saubhāgyamaditirditiḥ(7) / navāntaḥ padago brahmā pūjyordhe ca ṣaḍaṅghigāḥ(8)
brahmeśāntarakoṣṭhastha(9) māyākhyāntu paddvaye / tadadhaścāpavatsākhyaṃ kendrantareṣu ṣaṭpade

1 subhadrā ceti ja.. 2 manojavā iti ja.. 3 uttarāsyā daśānyāśceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 4 sūtrapādata iti ga.. / sūtrapātata iti cha.. 5 śakramekaṃ tathāpatyamiti jha.. 6 rogāhimokṣeti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 somarūpyaditau ditimiti kha.. 8 ṣaḍaṅgakā iti ga.. 9 goṣṭhastha iti cha.. :p 357 marīcikāgnimadhye tu savitā dvipadasthitaḥ / sāvitrī tadadho dvyaṃśe vivasvān ṣaṭpade tvadhaḥ
pitṛbrahmāntare viṣṇumindumindraṃ tvadho jayaṃ / varuṇabrahmaṇormadhye mitrākhyaṃ ṣaṭpade yajet
rogabrahmāntare nityaṃ dvipañca(1) rudradāsakam / tadadho dvyaṅghrigaṃ yakṣma ṣaṭsaumyeṣu dharādharaṃ(2)
carakīṃ skandavikaṭaṃ vidārīṃ pūtanāṃ kramāt / jammaṃ pāpaṃ(3) pilipicchaṃ(4) yajedīśādivāhyataḥ(5)
ekāśīpadaṃ veśma maṇḍapaś ca śatāṅghrikaḥ(6) / pūrvavaddevatāḥ pūjyā brahmā tu ṣoḍaśāṃśake(7)
marīciś ca vivasvāṃś ca mitraṃ pṛthvīdharas tathā(8) / daśakoṣṭhasthitā dikṣu tvanye beśādikoṇagāḥ(9)
daityamātā tatheśāgnī(10) mṛgākhyau pitarau tathā / pāpayakṣmānilau devāḥ sarve sārdhāṃśake sthitāḥ

yatpādyokaḥ(11) pravakṣyāmi saṅkṣepeṇa kramād guha / 1 dvisthañceti kha.. , ga.. , ja.. ca 2 ṣaṭsaumyeṣu carācaramiti jha.. , gha.. ca 3 kumbhapālamiti cha.. 4 pillipiñjamiti kha.. / piñjipiñchamiti cha.. 5 carakīmityādiḥ, vāhyata ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 6 śatārdhakamiti jha.. 7 brahmāntaiḥ ṣoḍaśāṃtakair iti kha.. , cha.. ca / brahmāntāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśake iti ga.. , ja.. ca 8 pṛthvīdharantatheti kha.. 9 tvanyeveśādike gaṇā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 10 daityamātā bhaveśāgnī iti kha.. / daityamātā hareśāgnī iti gha.. , ja.. ca 11 yajñādyoka iti ṅa.. :p 358 sadigviṃśatkarair dairghyādaṣṭāviṃśati(1) vistarāt
śiśirāśrayaḥ śivākhyaś ca(2) rudrahīnaḥ sadobhayoḥ / rudradviguṇitā nāhāḥ pṛthuṣṇobhirvinā tribhiḥ
syādgrahadviguṇaṃ dairghyāttithibhiś caiva(3) vistarāt(4) / sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ kuḍyā(5) anyeṣāṃ pṛthakstriṃśāṃśataḥ
kuḍyapṛthupajaṅghoccāt kuḍyantu triguṇocchayaṃ / kuḍyasūtrasamā pṛthvī vīthī bhedādanekadhā
bhadre tulyañca vīthībhirdvāravīthī vināgrataḥ / śrījayaṃ pṛṣṭhato hīnaṃ bhadroyaṃ pārś cayorvinā
garbhapṛthusamā(9) vīthī tadardhārdhena vā kvacit / vīthyardhenopavīthyādyamekadvitripurānvitam
sāmānyānātha gṛhaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadaṃ / ekadvitricatuḥśālamaṣṭaśālaṃ yathākramāt
ekaṃ yāmye ca saumāsyaṃ dve cet paścāt puromukham(7) / catuḥśālantu sāmmukhyāttayorindrendramuktayoḥ

śivāsyamambupāsyaiṣa indrāsye yamasūryakaṃ(8) / 1 sāṣṭāviṃśati iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca 2 śivāśramaḥ śivākhyasyeti kha.. , gha.. , jha.. ca /śivāgrakaśivākhyasyeti ga.. / śivāgragaḥ śivākhyasyeti ṅa.. , ja.. ca /śivāśrayaḥ śivākhyasyeti cha.. 3 dairghyādṛṣibhibhiś caiveti gha.. 4 dairghyāt sāṣṭāviṃśativistarāditi cha.. 5 sāvitryālayaḥ kulā iti kha.. / sāvitra ity ādiḥ, triguṇocchrayamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 6 garbhapīṭhasamā iti kha.. , gha.. , jha.. ca 7 saumyāsyaṃ dve dve paścātpuromukhamiti kha.. / saumyākhyaṃ dve ca paścādadhomukhamiti jha.. 8 sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ koṭīnāṃ tapasā :p 359 prāksaumyasthe ca daṇdākhyaṃ prāgyāmye vātasañjñakaṃ
āpyendau gṛhavalyākhyaṃ(1) triśūlaṃ tadvinardhikṛt / pūrvaśalāvihīnaṃ(2) syāt sukṣetraṃ vṛddhidāyakaṃ
yāmye hīne bhavecchūlī triśālaṃ vṛddhikṛt paraṃ(3) / yakṣaghnaṃ jalahīnaukaḥ sutaghnaṃ bahuśatrukṛt

satyalokataḥ / apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi smṛtaḥ / pādādyadhasturbhūloko bhuvaḥ sūryādvavaḥ smṛtaḥ / svarloko bhuvāntaś ca niyutāni caturdaśa / ekadaṇḍaṃ kaṭāhena vṛto brahmāṇḍavistaraḥ / vārivahnyānalāśaistato bhūtādināvadhi / vṛtaṃ daśaguṇair aṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā / daśottarāṇyaśeṣāṇi śukra kasmānmāmune / mahāntañca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitaṃ / anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṃsthānaṃ na ca vidyate / hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā purā mune / asaṅkhyātāni cāṇḍāni tatra jātāni ca dṛśāṃ / daruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tena tadvat pumāniti / pradhānevasthito vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ / pradhānaś ca pumāṃś caiva sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmabhūs tathā / viṣṇuśaktyā mahatprājñavṛttau saṃśrayadharmiṇau / tayoḥ saiva pṛthagbhāve karaṇaṃ saṃśayasya ca / mahākhyaṃ svatalaścākhyaṃ pātālaṃ cāpi sattama / kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ śukraśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ / bhūmayasteṣu cānyeṣu santi daityādayaḥ sukhaṃ / pātālānāmadhaścānte śeṣo viṣṇoś ca tāmasaḥ / guṇānanyān sa cānantaḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīṃ / bhuvodho narakā lokaṃ nayate kṣatravaiṣṇavaḥ / vāriṇā bhāvitā pṛthvī yāvattāvannabho mataṃ / siddhāntamastuyābhyaiva, indrāsthe yamasūryakaṃ / mallabdheṣu ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. cihnitapustakeṣu sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ ity ataḥ paraṃ naiṣa pāṭho vartate / teṣu tu mudritapāṭha eva vartate punaḥ ja.. cihnitapustake sāvitraḥ sālaya ity ataḥ paraṃ indrāsyeyamasūryakamityantaḥ pāṭho nāsti / ja.. cihnitapustake ya uktapāṭho dṛśyate tatra pūrvāparasaṅgatirnāsti / prakaraṇāntarīyapāthoyamatra lekhakabhramāt samāgata iti bhāti 1 gṛhaśalyākhyamiti kha.. 2 pūrvaśākhāvihīnamiti ṅa.. 3 yāmye hīne bhaveccullī triśāstraṃ dititatparamiti jha.. / yāmye hīne bhavecchatrī triśālaṃ vittahṛtparamiti ga.. :p 360 indrādikramato vacmi(1) dhvajādyaṣṭau gṛhāṇyahaṃ / prakṣālānusragāvāsamagnau(2) tasya mahānasaṃ
yāmye rasakriyā śayyā dhanuḥśastrāṇi rakṣasi / dhanamuktyamvupeśākhye(3) samyagandhau ca(4) mārute
saumye(5) dhanapaśū kuryādīśe dīkṣāvarālayaṃ(6) / svāmihastamitaṃ veśma vistārāyāmapiṇḍikaṃ
triguṇaṃ hastasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvāṣṭāṃśaihṛtaṃ tathā(7) / taccheṣoyaṃ sthitastena vāyasāntaṃ dhvajādikaṃ
trayaḥ pakṣāgnivedeṣu rasarṣivasuto bhavet / sarvanāśakaraṃ veśma madhye cānte ca saṃsthitaṃ
tasmācca(8) navame bhāge śubhakṛnnilayo mataḥ / tanmadhe maṇḍapaḥ śastaḥ samo vā dviguṇāyataḥ
pratyagāpye cenduyame(9) haṭṭa eva gṛhāvalī / ekaikabhavanākhyāni dikṣvaṣṭāṣṭakasaṅkhyayā(10)
īśādyaditikāntāni phalānyeṣāṃ yathākramaṃ(11) / bhayaṃ nārī calatvaṃ ca jayo vṛddhiḥ pratāpakaḥ

1 indrādikramato vahnīti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 prakṣālanātmabhāgāraḥ samagnau iti cha.. /prakṣālānugrahāvāsamagrau iti ja.. 3 dhanabhktāmbupaśākhye iti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 śasyamañcau ceti jha.. 5 yāmye iti jha.. 6 dīkṣāsurālayamiti kha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca 7 kṛtvāṣṭāṃśair hataṃ tatheti ga.. / kṛtvāṣṭāṅgair hataṃ tatheti gha.. , ja.. ca / kṛtvāṣṭāṃśahatastatheti jha.. 8 tasmāttu iti jha.. 9 prāgīśe cenduyāmye veti kha.. / prāgāpye cenduyāmye iti cha.. , jha.. ca 10 sarvanāśakaramityādiḥ, yathākramamityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti :p 361 dharmaḥ kaliś ca naisvyañca prāgdvāreṣvaṣṭasu dhruvaṃ / dāho 'sukhaṃ suhṛnnāśo dhananāśo mṛtirdhanaṃ(1)
śilpitvaṃ tanayaḥ syācca yāmyadvāraphalāṣṭakam / āyuḥprāvrājyaśasyāni(2) dhanaśāntyarthasaṅkṣayāḥ
śoṣaṃ bhogaṃ cāpatyañca(3) jaladvāraphalāni ca / rogo madārtimukhyatvaṃ cārthāyuḥ kṛśatā matiḥ
mānaś ca dvārataḥ pūrva(4) ūtarasyāndiśi kramāt /
nagarādivāstuḥ īśvara uvāca nagarādikavāstuś ca vakṣye rājyādivṛddhaye / yojanaṃ yojanārdhaṃ vā(5) tadarthaṃ sthānamāśrayet

1 vanavāsī mṛtirdhanamiti gha.. / dharmaḥ kaliścetyādiḥ, mṛtirdhanamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 2 āyuḥ prāvāhyaśasyānīti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 bhogaṃ ca patyaṃ ceti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 dvārataḥ prokta iti gha.. 5 bhojanārdhantadardhaṃ ca iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 362 abhyarcya vāstu nagaraṃ prākārādyantu kārayet / īśāditriṃśatpadake pūrvadvāraṃ ca sūryake
gandharvābhyāṃ(1) dakṣiṇe syādvāruṇye paścime tathā / saumyadvāraṃ saumyapade kāryā haṭṭāstu vistarāḥ
yenebhādi sukhaṃ gacchet kuryād dvāraṃ tu ṣaṭkaraṃ / chinnakarṇaṃ vibhinnañca candrārdhābhaṃ puraṃ na hi
vajrasūcīmukhaṃ neṣṭaṃ(2) sakṛd dvitrisamāgamaṃ / cāpābhaṃ vajranāgābhaṃ(3) purārambhe hi śāntikṛt
prārcya viṣṇu harārkādīnnatvā dadyād baliṃ balī(4) / āgneye svarṇakarmārān(5) purasya viniveśayet
dakṣiṇe nṛtyavṛttīnāṃ(6) veśyāstrīṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca / naṭānāñcakrikādīnāṃ(7) kaivartādeś ca nairṛte
rathānāmāyudhānāñca kṛpāṇāñca vāruṇe / śauṇḍikāḥ karmādhikṛtā vāyavye parikarmaṇaḥ(8)
brāhmaṇā yatayaḥ siddhāḥ puṇyavantaś ca cottare / phalādyādivikrayiṇa īśāne ca vaṇigjanāḥ
pūrvataś ca balādhyakṣā āgneye vividhaṃ balaṃ / strīṇāmādeśino dakṣe kāṇḍārānnairṛte nyaset

paścime ca mahāmātyān koṣapālāṃś ca kārukān / 1 gandharvādyā iti ga.. , ja.. ca 2 sūcīmukhaṃ naṣṭamiti jha.. , cha.. ca 3 vyāyataṃ vajranāsābhamiti gha.. / cāpābhaṃ cakranābhābhamiti ṅa.. 4 stutvā natvā baliṃ balī iti ṅa.. 5 āgneye tu karmakārāniti kha.. 6 dakṣiṇe bhṛtyadhūrtānāmiti cha.. 7 naṭānāṃ vāhlikādīnāmiti kha.. , ja.. ca 8 parikarmaṇa iti cha.. , ja.. ca :p 363 uttare daṇḍanāthāṃś ca nāyakadvijasaṅkulān
pūrvataḥ kṣatriyān dakṣe vaiśyāñchūndrāṃś ca paścime / dikṣu vaidyān vājinaś ca balāni ca caturdiśaṃ
pūrveṇa caraliṅgyādīñchmaśānādīni dakṣiṇe / paścime godhanādyañca kṛṣikartṝṃstathottare
nyasenmlecchāṃś ca koṇeṣu grāmādiṣu tathā smṛtiṃ(1) / śriyaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ dvāri(2) pūrve tau(3) paśyatāṃ śriyaṃ
devādīnāṃ paścimataḥ pūrvāsyāni gṛhāṇi hi / pūrvataḥ paścimāsyāni dakṣiṇe cottarānanān(4)
nākeśaviṣṇvādidhāmāni rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca(5) / nirdaivatantu nagaragrāmadurgagṛhādikaṃ
bhujyate tat piśācādyai rogādyaiḥ paribhūyate / nagarādi sadaivaṃ hi jayadaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ
pūrvāyāṃ śrīgṛhaṃ proktamāgneyyāṃ vai mahānasaṃ / śanayaṃ dakṣiṇasyāntu(7) nairṛtyāmāyudhāśrayaṃ
bhojanaṃ paścimāyāntu vāyavyāṃ dhānyasaṅgrahaḥ / uttare dravyasaṃsthānamaiśānyāṃ devatāgṛhaṃ(8)
catuḥśālaṃ triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ caikaśālakaṃ / catuḥśālagṛhāṇāntu śālālindakabhedataḥ(9)

1 tathā sthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / yathāsthitamiti ja.. 2 vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi iti ga.. 3 pūrvata iti kha.. 4 dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca 5 nagarasya hīti kha.. , cha.. ca 6 rogādyair abhibhūyate iti ja.. 7 dakṣiṇāyāṃ tviti ga.. , gha.. , jha ca 8 devatālayamiti jha.. 9 śālālindaprabhedata iti ka.. :p 364 śatadvayantu jāyante pañcāśat pañca teṣvapi / triśālāni tu catvāri dviśālāni tu pañcadhā
ekaśālāni catvāri ekālindāni vacmi ca / aṣṭāviṃśadalindāni gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi ca(1)
caturbhiḥ saprabhiś caiva pañcapañcāśadeva tu / ṣaḍalindāni viṃśaiva aṣṭābhirviṃśa eva hi(2)
aṣṭālindaṃ bhavedevaṃ(3) nagarādau gṛhāṇi hi /
svāyambhuvasargaḥ agnir uvāca(4) vakṣye bhuvanakoṣañca pṛthvīdvīpādilakṣaṇaṃ / agnidhraścāgnibāhuś ca vapuṣmāndyutimāṃs tathā

medhā medhātithirbhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca(5) / 1 gṛhāṇi nagarādiṣu iti jha.. / gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi tu iti kha.. 2 viṃśa eva ceti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 aṣṭābhirvibhajedevamiti cha.. 4 īśvara uvāceti kha.. , cha.. ca 5 savanaḥ kṣaya eva ca iti ka.. :p 365 jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ satyanāmā suto 'bhavat
priyabratasutāḥ khyātāḥ saptadvīpāndadau pitā / jambudvīpamathāgnīdhre plakṣaṃ medhātitherdadau
vapuṣmate śālmalañca jyotiṣmate kuśāhvayaṃ / krauñcadvīpaṃ dyutimate śākaṃ bhavyāya dattavān
puṣkaraṃ savanāyādādagnīdhre 'dāt sute śataṃ(1) / jambūdvīpaṃ pitā lakṣaṃ nābherdattaṃ himāhvayaṃ
hemakūṭaṃ kimpuruṣe harivarṣāya naiṣadhaṃ / ilāvṛte merumadhye ramye nīlācalaśritaṃ(2)
hiraṇvate śvetavarṣaṃ kurūṃstu kurave dadau / bhadrāśvāya ca bhadrāśvaṃ ketumālāya paścimaṃ
meroḥ priyavrataḥ putrānabhiṣicya yayau vanaṃ / śālagrāme tapastaptvā yayau viṣṇorlayaṃ nṛpaḥ
yāni kumpuruṣādyāni hy aṣṭavarṣāṇi sattama / teṣāṃ svābhāvikī siddhiḥ sukhaprāyā hy ayatnataḥ
jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti dharmādharmau yugādikaṃ / nādhamaṃ madhyamantulyā himāddeśāttu nābhitaḥ(3)
ṛṣabho merudevyāñca ṛṣabhād bharato 'bhavat / ṛṣabho dattaśrīḥ putre śālagrāme hariṅgataḥ
bharatād bhārataṃ varṣaṃ bharatāt sumatistvabhūt(4) / bharato dattalakṣmīkaḥ śālagrāme hariṃ gataḥ

1 sutebhya u iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 ramyenīlācalāśriyamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. ca / ramyaṃ nīlācale sthitamiti gha.. 3 himāddeśāntanābhita iti cha.. 4 sumatistata iti ga.. :p 366 sa yogī yogaprastāve(1) vakṣye taccaritaṃ punaḥ / sumatestejasastasmādindradyumno vyajāyata(2)
parameṣṭhī tatastasmāt pratīhārastadanvayaḥ / pratīhārāt pratīhartā pratiharturbhuvastataḥ
udgītotha ca prastāro vibhuḥ prastārataḥ sutaḥ(3) / pṛthuś caiva tato nakto naktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ
naro gayasya tanayaḥ tatputro 'bhūdvirāṭ tataḥ / tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata
mahāntastatsutaścābhūnmanasyastasya cātmajaḥ / tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuś ca virajā(4)rajastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ
satyajidrajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ mune / viśvajyotiḥpradhānāste bhāratantair vivardhitaṃ
kṛtatretādisargeṇa sargaḥ svāyambhuvaḥ smṛtaḥ /
bhuvanakoṣaḥ agnir uvāca jambūplakṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo mahān / kuśaḥ krauñcas tathā śākaḥ puṣkaraśceti saptamaḥ

1 yogaprastāre iti ga.. , ja.. , jha.. ca 2 indradyumnobhyajāyateti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 pratīhārādityādiḥ, prastārataḥ suta ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 4 duṣṭāduṣṭaś ca virajā iti kha.. :p 367 ete dvīpāḥ samudraistu sapta saptabhirāvṛtāḥ / lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalaiḥ samaṃ(1)
jambūdvīpo dvīpamadhye(2) tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ(3) / caturaśītisāhasro bhūyiṣṭhaḥ(4) ṣoḍaśādvirāṭ
dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistarāt ṣoḍaśādhaḥ(5) sahasravān / bhūyastasyāsya(6) śailo 'sau karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe / nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgo ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnās tathāpare / sahasradvitayochrāyāstāvadvistāriṇaś ca te
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣantataḥ kimpuruṣaṃ smṛtaṃ / harivarsantathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvija
ramyakaṃ cottare varṣaṃ tathaivānyaddhiraṇmayaṃ(7) / uttarāḥ kuravaś caiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā
navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ munisattama / ilāvṛtañca tanmadhye sauvarṇā meruruchritaḥ

meroś caturdiśantatra navasāhasravistṛtaṃ(8) / 1 dadhidugdhajalāntakā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 jambūdvīpastasya madhye iti ja.. 3 merurutthita iti jha.. 4 bhūmiṣṭha iti gha.. , ja.. ca / bhuvistha iti ṅa.. 5 ṣoḍaśāṃśa iti jha.. 6 bhūpādmasyāsya iti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca 7 tathaivātra hiraṇmayamiti ga.. / tathaivātha hiraṇmayamiti ja.. 8 ilāvṛtaścetyādiḥ, navasāhasravistṛtamityantaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti :p 368 ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāga catvāraścātra parvatāḥ
viṣkambhā racitā meroryojanāyutavistṛtāḥ(1) / pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ
vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ(2) / kadambasteṣu jambuś ca pippalo baṭa eva ca
ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ / jambūdvīpeti sañjñā syāt phalaṃ jambā gajopamaṃ
jambūnadīrasenāsyāstvidaṃ jāmbūnadaṃ(3) paraṃ / supārśvaḥ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālastu paścime
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ / vaibhrājaṃ paścime saumye nandanañca sarāṃsyatha
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadraṃ saṃśitodaṃ(5) samānasaṃ / śitābhaś cakramuñjādyāḥ pūrvataḥ keśarācalāḥ(5)
dakṣiṇendrestrikūṭādyāḥ śiśivāsamukhā jale(6) / śaṅkhakūṭādayaḥ saumye merau ca brahmaṇaḥ purī
caturdaśasahasrāṇi yojanānāñca dikṣu ca / indrādilokapālānāṃ samantāt brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ
viṣṇupādāt plāvayitvā candraṃ svargāt patantyapi / pūrveṇa śītā bhadrāśvācchailācchailādgatārṇavaṃ

tathaivālakanandāpi dakṣiṇenaiva bhārataṃ(7) / 1 yojanāyutamucchritā iti gha.. 2 supārśvaścottare sthita iti gha.. 3 rasanāsmāddhemajāmbunadamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 4 asitodamiti ja.. 5 pūrvataḥ śiśirācalā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 6 śaśivāmamukhā jale iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 7 dakṣiṇena ca bhāratamiti kha.. / dakṣiṇenaiti bhāratamiti ga.. :p 369 prayāti sāgaraṃ kṛtvā saptabhedātha paścimaṃ
abdhiñca cakṣuḥsaumyābdhiṃ bhadrottarakurūnapi(1) / ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau(2) mālyavadgandhamādanau
tayormadhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ / bhāratāḥ ketumālāś ca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravas tathā
patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādāśailavāhyataḥ / jaṭharo devakūṭaś ca maryādāparvatāvubhau(3)
tau dakṣiṇottarāyāmāvānīlaniṣadhāyatau / gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvavacāyatāvubhau(4)
aśītiyojanāyāmāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau / niṣadhaḥ pāripātraś ca maryādāparvatāvubhau
meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathā pūrve tathā sthitau / triśṛṅgo rudhiraś caiva uttarau varṣaparvatau
pūrvapañcāyatāvetāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau / jāṭharādyāś ca maryādāśailā meroś caturdiśaṃ
keśarādiṣu yā droṇyastāsu santi purāṇi hi / lakṣmīviṣṇvagnisūryādidevānāṃ munisattama

bhaumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ na pāpāstatra yānti ca(5) / 1 bhadrodbhavakurūnapi iti kha.. 2 alīnaniṣadhāyāmā iti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 ramyakamityādiḥ, maryādāparvatāvubhāvityanntaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 4 pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 5 bhumāḥ svargā dharmiṇānte na pāpāstatra yānti ca iti cha.. , ṅa.. ca /maumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayā hy atra yānti ceti ga.. , gha.. ca / bhogināṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayāstatra yānti ceti ja.. :p 370 bhadrāśve 'sti hayagrīvo varāhaḥ ketumālake
bhārate kūrmarūpī ca matsyarūpaḥ kuruṣvapi / viśvarūpeṇa sarvatra pūjyate bhagavān hariḥ
kimpuruṣādyaṣṭasu kṣudbhītiśokādikaṃ na ca / catturviṃśatisāhasraṃ prajā jīvantyanāmayāḥ
kṛtādikalpanā nāsti bhaumānyambhāṃsi nāmbudāḥ / sarveṣveteṣu varṣeṣu sapta sapta kulācalāḥ
nadyaś ca śataśastebhyastīrthabhūtāḥ prajajñire / bhārate yāni nīrthāni tāni tīrthāni vacmi te
tīrthamāhātmyaṃ agnir uvāca māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vakṣye yadbhaktimuktidaṃ / yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaś caiva susaṃyataṃ(1)
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute / 1 svasaṃyatamiti gha.. :p 371 pratigrāhādupāvṛtto laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ
niṣpapastīrthayātrī tu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet / anupoṣya trirātrīṇi tīrthānyanabhigamya ca
adatvā kāñcanaṃ gāś ca daridro nāma jāyate / tīrthābhiogamane(1) tat syādyadyajñenāpyate phalaṃ
puṣkaraṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sānnidhyaṃ hi trisandhyakaṃ / daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ vipra puṣkare
brahmā saha surair āste munayaḥ sarvamicchavaḥ / devāḥ prāptāḥ siddhimatra snātāḥ pitṛsurārcakāḥ(2)
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya(3) brahmalokaṃ prayānti te / kārttikyāmannadānācca nirmalo brahmalokabhāk(4)
puṣkare duṣkaraṃ gantuṃ(5) puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ / duṣkaraṃ puṣkare dānaṃ vastuṃ caiva suduṣkaraṃ(6)
tatra vāsājjapacchrāddhāt kulānāṃ śatamuddharet / jambumārgaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthantaṇḍulikāśramaṃ
karṇāśramaṃ(7) koṭitīrthaṃ narmadā cārvudaṃ paraṃ / tīrthañcarmaṇvatī sindhuḥ somanāthaḥ prabhāsakaṃ

sarasvatyabdhisaṅgaś ca(8) sāgarantīrthamuttamaṃ / 1 tīrthādigamane iti gha.. 2 pitṛsurārcitā iti kha.. 3 aśvamedhaphalaścāsyeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāpyeti gha.. 4 brahmalokakamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 5 duṣkaraṃ gantumiti kha.. 6 vastuṃ tatra suduṣkaramiti ja.. 7 kaṇvāśramamiti gha.. 8 sarasvatyabdhisañjñayeti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca :p 372 piṇḍārakaṃ dvārakā ca gomatī sarvasiddhidā
bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgaṃ(1) tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ paraṃ / bhīmatīrthaṃ(2) girīndrañca devikā pāpanāśinī
tīrthaṃ vinaśanaṃ puṇyaṃ nāgodbhedamaghārdanaṃ / tīrthaṃ kumārakoṭiś ca sarvadānīritāni ca
kurukṣetraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyahaṃ / ya evaṃ satataṃ brūyātso 'malaḥ prāpnuyāddivaṃ
tatra viṣṇvādayo devāstatra vāsāddhariṃ vrajet(3) / sarasvatyāṃ sannihityāṃ snānakṛdbrahmalokabhāk(4)
pāṃśavopi kurukṣetre nayanti paramāṃ gatiṃ / dharmatīrthaṃ suvarṇākhyaṃ gaṅgādvāramanuttamaṃ
tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ bhadrakarṇahradantathā(5) / gaṅgāsasvatīsaṅgaṃ brahmāvartamaghārdanaṃ
bhṛgutuṅgañca kubjāmraṃ gaṅgodbhedamaghāntakaṃ(6) / vārāṇasī varantīrthamavimuktamanuttamaṃ
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthantīrtharājaṃ prayāgakaṃ / gomatīgaṅgayoḥ saṅgaṃ gaṅgā sarvatra nākadā

tīrthaṃ rājagṛhaṃ puṇyaṃ śālagrāmamaghāntakaṃ / 1 ṛṣitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgamiti gha.. / bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmasañjñamiti cha.. 2 bhīmātīrthamiti gha.. 3 vāmāddivaṃ brajediti ja.. 4 brahmalokaga iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 5 tatra karṇahradaṃ tatheti kha.. / bhadrakaṃ tu hradaṃ tatheti ga.. , ṅa.. ca 6 gaṅgodbhedamavantikamiti ja.. :p 373 vaṭeśaṃ vāmanntīrthaṃ kālikāsaṅgamuttamaṃ(1)
lauhityaṃ karatoyākhyaṃ śoṇañcātharṣabhaṃ paraṃ / śrīparvataṃ kolvagiriṃ(2) sahyādrirmalayo giriḥ
godāvarī tuṅgabhadrā kāvero varadā nadī / tāpī payoṣṇī revā ca daṇḍakāraṇyamuttamaṃ
kālañjaraṃ muñjavaṭantīrthaṃ sūrpārakaṃ paraṃ / mandākinī citrakūṭaṃ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ paraṃ(3)
avantī paramaṃ tīrthamayodhyā pāpanāśanī / naimiṣaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(4)
gaṅāmāhātmyaṃ agnir uvāca gaṅāmāhātmyamākhyāsye sevyā sā bhuktimuktidā / yeṣāṃ madhye yāti gaṅgā te deśā pāvanā varāḥ

1 tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalamityādiḥ, kālikāsaṅgamuttamamityantaḥ pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti 2 śrīparvataṃ kondragiririti cha.. / śrīparvataṃ kolagirimiti ja.. 3 śṛṅgaverapuaraṃ varamiti gha.. 4 agnir uvāca / māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāmityādiḥ, naimiṣaṃ paramantīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tīrthayātrāmāhātmyamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti :p 374 gatirgaṅgā tu(1) bhūtānāṃ gatimanveṣatāṃ(2) sadā gaṅgā tārayate(3) cobhau vaṃśau nityaṃ hi sevitā
cāndrāyaṇasahasrācca gaṅgāmbhaḥpānamuttamaṃ / gaṅāṃ māsantu saṃsevya sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
sakalāghaharī devī svargalokapradāyinī / yāvadasthi ca gaṅgāyāṃ tāvat svarge sa tiṣṭhati
andhādayastu(4) tāṃ sevya devair gacchanti tulyatāṃ(5) / gaṅgātīrthasamudbhūtamṛddhārī so 'ghahārkavat(6)
darśanāt sparśanāt pānāttathā gaṅgetikīrtanāt / punāti puṇyapuruṣān śataśītha sahasraśaḥ
prayāgamāhātmyaṃ agnir uvāca vakṣye prayāgamāhātmyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ paraṃ(7) / prayāge brahmaviṣṇvādyā deva munivarāḥ sthitāḥ

1 gatirgaṅgā hīti ga.. , ja.. ca 2 gatirgatimatāmiti jha.. 3 gaṅgā pāvayate iti jha.. 4 patitādayastu iti jha.. 5 gacchanti sāmyatāmiti gha.. , jha.. ca 6 gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛddhāro so 'ghahārkavaditi kha.. , ga.. , jha.. ca / gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛdaṃ mūrdhā vibharti yaḥ / vibharti rūpaṃ sorkasya tamonāśāya kevalamiti ṅa.. 7 bhaktimuktiphalapradamiti ga.. / bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti jha.. :p 375 saritaḥ sāgarāḥ siddhā gandharvasarāpsas tathā / tatra trīṇyagnikuṇḍāni teṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī
vegena samatikrāntā sarvatīrthatiraskṛtā / tapanasya sutā tatra triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
gaṅgāyamunayormadhyaṃ(1) pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtaṃ / prayāgaṃ jaghanasyāntarupasthamṛṣayo viduḥ(2)
prayāgaṃ sapratiṣṭhānam kambalāśvatarāvubhau / tīrthaṃ bhogavatī caiva vedī proktā prajāpateḥ
tatra vedāś ca yajñāś ca mūrtimantaḥ prayāgake / stavanādasya(3) tīrthasya nāmasaṅkirtanādapi
mṛttikālambhanādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / prayāge saṅgate dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ japyādi cākṣayaṃ(4)
na devavacanādvipra na lokavacanādapi / matirutkramaṇīyānte prayāge maraṇaṃ prati
daśatīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyas tathāparāḥ / teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva prayāgaṃ paramantataḥ
vāsukerbhogavatyatra haṃsaprapatanaṃ paraṃ / gavāṃ koṭipradānādyat tryahaṃ snānasya(5) tatphalaṃ

prayāge māghamāse tu evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / 1 gaṅāyamunayormadhye iti kha.. 2 saritaḥ sāgarā ity ādiḥ, upasthamṛṣayo vidurityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 3 śravaṇādasyeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 4 śrāddhadravyādi cākṣayamiti gha.. 5 tryahaṃ snātasyeti gha.. :p 376 sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā
gaṅādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame / atra dānāddivaṃ(1) yāti rājendro jāyate 'tra ca
vaṭamūle saṅgamādau mṛto viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet / urvaśīpulinaṃ ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ sandhyāvatas tathā
koṭītīrthañcāśvamedhaṃ gaṅgāyamunamuttamaṃ / mānasaṃ rajasā hīnaṃ tīrthaṃ vāsarakaṃ paraṃ(2)
vārāṇasīmāhātmyam agnir uvāca vārāṇasī(3) paraṃ tīrthaṃ gauryai prāha maheśvaraḥ / bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ vasatāṃ gṛṇatāṃ hariṃ(4)

rudra uvāca gaurīkṣetraṃ na muktaṃ vai avimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtaṃ / 2 tīrthaṃ vānarakaṃ paramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 vārāṇasīmiti kha.. , gha.. ca 4 vasatāṃ śṛṇutāṃ harimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 377 japtaṃ taptaṃ dattamamavimukte vilākṣayaṃ
aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vasetkāśīnna hi tyajet(1) / hariś candraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ guhyamāmnātakeśvaraṃ(2)
japyeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ(3) guhyaṃ śrīparvataṃ tathā / mahālayaṃ(4) paraṃ guhyaṃ bhṛguś caṇḍeśvaraṃ(5) tathā
kedāraṃ paramaṃ guhyamaṣṭau santyavimuktake / guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama
dviyojanantu pūrvaṃ syād yojanārdhaṃ tadanyathā(6) / varaṇā ca nadī cāsīt tayormadhye(7) vārāṇasī
atra snānaṃ japo homo maraṇaṃ devapūjanaṃ / śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ nivāsaś ca yadyat syādbhuktimuktidaṃ(8)
narmadādimāhātmyam agnir uvāca narmadādikamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyehaṃ narmadāṃ parāṃ(1) / sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādvāri nārmadaṃ
vistarādyojanaśataṃ yojanadvayamāyatā / ṣaṣṭistīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyas tathāparāḥ
parvatasya samantāttu tiṣṭhantyamarakaṇṭake(2) / kāverīsaṅgamaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīparvatamataḥ śṛṇu
