gaurī śrīrūpiṇī tepe tapastāmabravīddhariḥ(3) / avāpsyasi tvamadhyātmyaṃ nāmnā śrīparvatastava
samantādyojanaśataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati / atra dānantapo japyaṃ(4) śrāddhaṃ sarvamathākṣayaṃ(5)

1 narmadāparamiti jha.. 2 niryāntyamarakaṇṭake iti jha.. 3 tapastāmabravīddhara iti ga.. 4 atra dānaṃ tathā japyamiti jha.. 5 sarvamathākṣaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 379 maraṇaṃ śivalokāya sarvadaṃ tīrthamuttamaṃ / haro 'tra krīḍate devyā hiraṇyakaśipus tathā
tapastaptvā balī cābhūnmunayaḥ siddhimāpnuvan(1) /
gayāmāhātmyam agnir uvāca gayāmāhātmyamākhyāsye gayātīrthottamottamaṃ / gayāsurastapastepe tattapastāpibhiḥ(2) suraiḥ
uktaḥ kṣīrābdhigo viṣṇuḥ pālayāsmān gayāsurāt / tathetyuktvā harirdaityaṃ varaṃ brūhīti cābravīt
daityo 'bravītpavitro 'haṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvatīrthataḥ / tathetyuktvā gato viṣṇurdaityaṃ dṛṣṭvā na vā hariṃ

gatāḥ śūnyā mahī svarge devā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ(3) / 1 siddhimāpnuyuriti jha.. 2 tattapastāpitair iti ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca 3 brahmādayaḥ punaḥ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja. jha.. ca :p 380 gatā ūcurhariṃ devāḥ śūnyā bhūstridivaṃ hare
daityasya darśanādeva brahmaṇañcābravīddhariḥ / yāgārthaṃ daityadehaṃ tvaṃ prārthaya tridaśaiḥ saha
tac chrutvā sasuro brahmā(1) gayāsuramathābravīt / atithiḥ prārthayāmi tvāndehaṃ yāgāya pāvanaṃ
gayāsurastathetyuktvāpatattasya śirasyatha(2) / yāgaṃ cakāra calite dehi pūrṇāhutiṃ(3) vibhuḥ
punarbrahmābravīdviṣṇuṃ pūrṇakāle 'suro 'calat / śiṣṇurdharmamathāhūya prāha devamayīṃ śilām
dhārayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve yasyāmupari santu te / gadādharo madīyātha mūrtiḥ sthāsyati sāmaraiḥ
dharmaḥ śilāṃ devamayīṃ(4) tac chrutvādhārayat parāṃ / yā dharmāddharmavatyāñca jātā dharmavratā sutā
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putrastāmuvāha taponvitāṃ(5) / yathā hariḥ śriyā reme gauryā śambhus tathā tayā
kuśapuṣpādyaraṇyācca ānīyātiśramānvitaḥ(6) / bhuktvā dharmavratāṃ prāha pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuru
viśrāntasya muneḥ pādau tathetyuktvā priyākarot / etasminnantare brahmā munau supte tathāgataḥ(7)
dharmavratācintayañca kiṃ brahmāṇaṃ samarcaye / pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kurve brahmā pūjyo gurorguruḥ(8)

1 tac chrutvā satvaro brahmeti ṅa.. 2 śirastatheti jha.. 3 dehe pūrṇāhutimiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 4 dehamayīmiti ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 5 tapaścitāmiti jha.. 6 samānīya śramānvita iti ja.. 7 supte samāgata iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. ca 8 dharmavratetyādiḥ, gurorgururityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti :p 381 vicintya pūjayāmāsa brahmāṇaṃ cārhaṇādibhiḥ / marīcistāmapaśyat sa(1) śaśāpoktivyatikramāt
śilā bhaviṣyasi krodhāddharmavratābravīcca taṃ(2) / pādābhyaṅgaṃ parityajya tvadguruḥ pūjito mayā
adoṣāhaṃ yatastvaṃ hi śāpaṃ prāpsyasi śaṅkarāt / dharmavratā pṛthak śāpaṃ dhārayitvāgrimadhyagāt
tapaś cacāra varṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca / tato viṣṇvādayo devā varaṃ brūhīti cābruvan
dharmavratābravīddevān śāpannirvartayantu me / devā ūcuḥ datto marīcinā śāpo bhaviṣyati na cānyathā
śilā pavitrā devāṅghrilakṣitā tvaṃ(3) bhaviṣyasi / devavratā devaśilā sarvadevādirūpiṇī
sarvadevamayī(4) puṇyā niś calāyārasusya hi / devavratovāca yadi tuṣṭāstha me sarve mayi tiṣṭhantu sarvadā
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudrādyā gaurīlakṣmīmukhāḥ surāḥ / agnir uvāca devavratāvacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā divaṅgatāḥ
sā dharmaṇāsurasyāsya dhṛtā devamayī śilā / saśilaś calito daityaḥ sthitā rudrādayastataḥ
sadevaś calito daityastato devaiḥ(5) prasāditaḥ / kṣīrābdhigo hariḥ prādāt svamūrtiṃ śrīgadādharaṃ

gacchantu bhoḥ svayaṃ yāsyaṃ(6) mūrtyā vai devagamyayā(7) / 1 marīcistāmapaśyadvai iti gha.. 2 dharmavratābravīdvaca iti ja.. 3 pavitrā devānāṃ vanditā tvamiti gha.. 4 sarvatīrthamayī iti gha.. , jha.. ca 5 tadā devair iti ja.. 6 gacchetyuktvā svayaṃ gacchediti jha.. / gacchantūktvā svayaṃ yāsye iti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 mūrtyā devaikagamyayā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 382 sthito gadādharo devo vyaktāvyaktobhayātmakaḥ
niś calārthaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ sthita ādigadādharaḥ / gado nāmāsuro daityaḥ(1) sa hato viṣṇunā purā
tadasthinirmitā(2) cādyā gadā yā viśvakarmaṇā / ādyayā gadayā hetipramukhā rākṣasā hatāḥ
gadādhareṇa vidhivat(3) tasmādādigadhādharaḥ(4) / devamayyāṃ śilāyāṃ ca(5) sthite cādigadādhare
gayāsure niś caleya brahmā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadau / gayāsuro 'bravīddevān kimarthaṃ vañcito hy ahaṃ(6)
viṣṇorvacanamātreṇa kinnasyānniś calohyahaṃ / ākrānto yadyahaṃ devā dātumarhata(7) me varaṃ
devā ūcuḥ tīrthasya karaṇe yat(8) tvamasmābhir niś calīkṛtaḥ / viṣṇoḥ śambhorbrahmaṇaś ca kṣetraṃ tava bhaviṣyati
prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ pitrāderbrahmalokadaṃ / ityuktvā te sthitā devā devyastīrthādayaḥ sthitāḥ
yāgaṃ kṛtvā dadau brahmā ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tadā / pañcakrośaṃ gayākṣetraṃ pañcāśat pañca cārpayet
grāmān svarṇagirīn(9) kṛtvā nadīrdugdhamadhuśravāḥ / sarovarāṇi dadhyājyair bahūnannādiparvatān(10)

1 nāmāsuro raudra iti gha.. , jha.. ca 2 tadaṅgānnirmitā iti jha.. / tadarthā nirmitā iti cha.. 3 gadāvareṇa deveneti jha.. 4 gado nāmāsura ity ādiḥ, tasmādādigadādhara ity antaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake nāsti 5 śilāyāntu iti ja.. 6 vāñchito hy ahamiti kha.. , cha.. ca 7 dātumarhatheti ṅa.. 8 tīrthasya kāraṇāyeti gha.. , jha.. ca 9 grāmān puṇyagirīniti ṅa.. 10 dadhyādyair bahūnannādiparvatāniti ja.. :p 383 kāmadhenuṃ kalpataruṃ svarṇarūpyagṛhāṇi ca / na yācayantu viprendrā alpānuktvā(1) dadau prabhuḥ
dharmayāge pralobhāttu pratigṛhya dhanādikaṃ / sthitā yadā gayāyānte śaptāte brahmaṇā tadā
vidyāvivarjitā(2) yūyaṃ tṛṣṇāyuktā bhaviṣyatha / dugdhādivarjitā nadyaḥ śailāḥ pāṣāṇarūpiṇaḥ
brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇaścocur naṣṭaṃ śāpena śākhilaṃ / jīvanāya prasādannaḥ kuru viprāṃś ca so 'bravīt
tīrthopajīvikā yūyaṃ sacandrārkaṃ(3) bhaviṣyatha / ye yuṣmān pūjayiṣyanti gayāyāmāgatā narāḥ
havyakavyair dhanaiḥ śraddhaisteṣāṃ kulaśataṃ vrajet(4) / narakāt svargalokāya(5) svargalokāt parāṅgatiṃ
gayopi cākarodyāgaṃ bahvannaṃ(6) bahudakṣiṇaṃ / gayā purī tena nāmnā pāṇḍavā ījire hariṃ
gayāyātrāvidhiḥ agnir uvāca udyataścedgayāṃ yātuṃ(1) śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ / vidhāya kārpaṭīveśaṃ grāmasyāpi pradakṣiṇaṃ
kṛtvā pratidinaṅgacchet saṃyataścāpratigrahī / gṛhāccalitamātrasya gayayā gamanaṃ prati
svargārohaṇasopānaṃ pitṝṇāntu pade pade / brahmajñānena kiṃ kāryaṃ gogṛhe maraṇena kiṃ
kiṃ kurukṣetravāsena yadā(2) putro gayāṃ vrajet / gayāprāptaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṝṇāmutsavo bhavet
padbhyāmapi jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā asmabhyaṃ kinna dāsyati / brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ gogṛhe maraṇaṃ tathā
vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ kurukṣetre muktireṣā caturvidhā / kāṅkṣanti pitaraḥ putraṃ narakādbhayabhīravaḥ
gayāṃ yāsyati yaḥ putraḥ sa nastrātā bhaviṣyati / muṇḍanañcopavāsaś ca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ
na kālādirgayātīrthe dadyāt piṇḍāṃś ca nityaśaḥ / pakṣatrayanivāsī ca punātyāsaptatamaṃ kulaṃ
1 gantumiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 yadi iti gha.. , ga.. , jha.. ca :p 1 aṣṭakāsu ca vṛddhauca(1) gayāyāṃ mṛtavāsare / atra mātuḥ pṛthak śrāddhamanyatra patinā saha
pitrādinavadaityaṃ tathā dvādaśadaivataṃ / prathame divase snāyāttīrthe hy uttaramānase
uttare mānase puṇye āyurārogyavṛddhaye / sarvāghaughavidhānāya(2) snānaṃ kuryād vimuktaye(3)
santarpya devapitrādīn śrāddhakṛt piṇḍado bhavet / divyāntarīkṣabhaumasthān(4) devān santarpayāmyahaṃ
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādi pitṛmātrādi tarpayet / pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ
mātā pitāmahī caiva(5) tathaiva prapitāmahī / mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātāmahaḥ(6)
tebhyo.nyebhya(7) imān piṇḍānuddhārāya dadāmyahaṃ / oṃ namaḥ sūryadevāya somabhaumajñarūpiṇe(8)
jīvaśukraśanaiścārirāhuketusvarūpiṇe / uttare mānase snātā(9) uddharetsakalaṃ kulaṃ

sūryaṃ natvā(10) vrajenmaunī naro dakṣiṇamānasaṃ(11) / 1 anvaṣṭakāsu vṛddhau ceti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 2 sarvāghaughavināśāyeti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 3 snānaṃ sarvavimuktaye iti cha.. 4 divyāntarīkṣagān bhaumāniti ga.. 5 mātā mātāmahī caiveti ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 6 vṛddhapramātṛkāmaha iti ka.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 7 tebhyastebhya iti gha.. , ja.. ca 8 somabhaumasvarūpiṇe iti gha.. 9 snātveti ka.. 10 sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā iti ṅa.. 11 tato dakṣiṇamānasamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca :p 2 dakṣiṇe mānase snānaṃ karomi pitṛtṛptaye(1)
gayāyāmāgataḥ svargaṃ yāntu me pitaro 'khilāḥ / śrāddhaṃ piṇḍantataḥ kṛtvā sūryaṃ natvā vadedidaṃ
oṃ namo bhānave bhartre(2) bhavāya bhava me vibho / bhuktimuktipradaḥ sarvapitṝṇāṃ bhavabhāvitaḥ
kavyavālānalaḥ somo yamaś caivāryamā tathā / agniṣvāttā varhiṣada ājyapāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ
āgacchantu mahābhāgā yuṣmābhī rakṣitāstviha / madīyāḥ pitaro ye ca mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ
teṣāṃ piṇḍapradātāhamāgato 'smi gayāmimāṃ / udīcyāṃ muṇḍapṛṣṭhasya devarṣigaṇapūjitaṃ(3)
nāmnā kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaṃ / siddhānāṃ prītijananaiḥ pāpānāñca bhayaṅkaraiḥ
lelihānair mahānāgai rakṣyate caiva nityaśaḥ / tatra snātvā divaṃ(4) yānti krīḍante bhuvi mānavāḥ
phalgutīrthaṃ tato gacchenmahānadyāṃ sthitaṃ paraṃ / nāgājjanārdanāt kūpādvaṭāccottaramānasāt
etad gayāśiraḥ(5) proktaṃ phalgutīrthaṃ taducyate / muṇḍapṛṣṭhanāgādyāś ca sārāt sāramathāntaraṃ

1 karomi pitṛdaivate iti ja.. 2 bhānave tasmai iti ṅa.. 3 devarṣigaṇasevitamiti gha.. , ja.. ca / devatāgaṇasevitamiti jha.. 4 tatra snātā divamiti ja.. 5 phalguṃ gayāśira iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca :p 3 yasmin phalati śrīrgaurvā kāmadhenurjalaṃ mahī / dṛṣṭiramyādikaṃ yasmāt phalgutīrthaṃ na phalguvat
phalgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gadādharaṃ / etena kiṃ na paryāptaṃ nṛṇāṃ sukṛṭakāriṇāṃ
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudrātsarāṃsi ca / phalgutīrthaṃ gamiṣyanti vāramekaṃ dine dine
phalgutīrthe tīrtharāje karoti snānamādṛtaḥ / pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokāptyai ātmano bhuktimuktaye
snātvā śrāddhī piṇḍado 'tha nameddevaṃ pitāmahaṃ / kalau māheśvarā lokā atra devī(1) gadādharaḥ
pitāmaho liṅgarūpī tannamāmi maheśvaraṃ / gadādharaṃ balaṃ kāmamaniruddhaṃ narāyaṇaṃ(2)
brahmaviṣṇunṛsiṃhākhyaṃ varāhādiṃ namāmyahaṃ / tato gadādharaṃ dṛṣṭvā kulānāṃ śatamuddharet
dharmāraṇyaṃ dvitīye 'hni mataṅgasyāśrame vare / mataṅgavāpyāṃ saṃsnāya śrāddhakṛt piṇḍado(3) bhavet
mataṅgeśaṃ suddheśaṃ(4) natvā cedamudīrayet / pramāṇaṃ devatāḥ santu lokapālāś ca sākṣiṇaḥ
mayāgatya mataṅge 'smin pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā / snānatarpaṇaśrāddhādirbrahmatīrthe 'tha(5) kūpake

1 ato deva iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca 2 nārāyaṇamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca 3 śrāddhadaḥ piṇḍada iti kha.. 4 mataṅgeśañca siddheśamiti ja.. 5 brahmatīrthetreti kha.. :p 4 tatkūrpayūpayormadhye śrāddhaṃ kulaśatoddhṛtau / mahābodhaturuṃ natvā dharmavān svargalokabhāk
tṛtīye brahmasarasi(1) snānaṃ kuryādyatavrataḥ(2) / snānaṃ brahmasarastīrthe(3) karomi brahmabhūtaye
pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokāya brahmarṣigaṇasevite / tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhakṛt piṇḍaṃ pradadyāttu prasecanaṃ(4) / kuryācca vājapeyārthī brahmayūpapradakṣiṇaṃ
eko muniḥ kumbhakuśāgrahasta āmrasya mūle salilandadāti / āmnāya siktāḥ pitaraś ca tṛptā ekā kriyā dvyarthakarī prasiddhā
brahmāṇañca namaskṛtya kulānāṃ śatamuddharet / phalgutīrthe caturthe 'hni snātvā devāditarpaṇaṃ
kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍañca gayāśirasi kārayet / pañcakrośaṃ gayākṣetraṃ krośamekaṃ gayāśiraḥ
tatra piṇḍapradānena kulānāṃ śatamudharet / muṇḍapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nnyāstaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā

muṇḍapṛṣṭhe śiraḥ sākṣād gayāśira udāhṛtaṃ / 1 brahmasadasi iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 2 mayāgatyetyādiḥ, snānaṃ kuryādyatavrata ity antaḥ pāṭhaścha.. pustake nāsti 3 brahmasadastīrthe iti gha.. / brahmaśirastīrthe iti kha.. 4 tarpaṇaśrāddhakṛt piṇḍapradaścāpi prasecanamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / tarpaṇaśrāddhakṛt piṇḍapradaścāmraprasecanamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca :p 5 sākṣād gayāśirastatra phalgutīrthāśramaṃ(1) kṛtaṃ
amṛtaṃ tatra vahati pitṝṇāndattamakṣayaṃ / snātvā daśāśvamedhe tu dṛṣṭvā devaṃ pitāmahaṃ
rudrapādaṃ naraḥ spṛṣṭvā neha bhūyo 'bhijāyate / śamīpatrapramāṇena piṇḍaṃ datvā gayāśire(2)
narakasthā divaṃ yānti svargasthā mokṣamāpnuyuḥ / pāyasenātha piṣṭena śaktunā caruṇā tathā
piṇḍadānaṃ taṇḍulaiś ca godhūmaistilamiśritaiḥ / piṇḍaṃ datvā rudrapade kulānāṃ śatamuddharet
tathā viṣṇupade śrāddhapiṇḍado hy ṛṇamuktikṛt(3) / pitrādīnāṃ śatakulaṃ svātmānaṃ(4) tārayennaraḥ

pade vāhavanīyasya śrāddhī yajñaphalaṃ labhet / āvasathyasya candrasya(6) sūryasya ca gaṇasya ca
agastyakārttikeyasya śrāddhī tārayate kulaṃ / ādityasya rathaṃ natvā(7) karṇādityaṃ namīnnaraḥ

1 phalgutīrthāśrayamiti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca 2 piṇḍaṃ dadyādgayāśire iti ja.. 3 piṇḍadaḥ kulamuktikṛditi ga.. , ja.. ca / piṇḍado hy atimuktikṛditi gha.. 4 svātmaneti ja.. 5 brahmapade śrāddhamiti jha.. 6 varuṇasyātha cendrasyeti ṅa.. / āvasathyasya cendrasyeti cha.. / āvasathyasya sendrasyeti ja.. 7 rathaṃ dṛṣṭveti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 6 kanakeśapadaṃ natvā gayākedārakaṃ namet / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitṝn brahmapuraṃ nayet
viśālo 'pi gayāśīrṣe piṇḍado 'bhūcca putravān / viśālāyāṃ viśālo 'bhūdrājaputro 'bravīd dvijān
kathaṃ putrādayaḥ syurme dvijā ūcurviśālakaṃ / gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena tava sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati
viśālo 'pi gayāśīrṣe pitṛpiṇḍāndadau tataḥ(1) / dṛṣṭvākāśe sitaṃ raktaṃ puruṣāṃstāṃś capṛṣṭavān
ke yuyanteṣu caivaikaḥ sitaḥ proce viśālakaṃ / ahaṃ sitaste janaka indralokaṃ gataḥ śubhān
mama raktaḥ pitā putra kṛṣṇaś caiva pitāmahaḥ / abravīt narakaṃ prāptā tvayā muktīkṛtā vayaṃ
piṇḍadānād brahmalokaṃ brajāma iti te gatāḥ / viśālaḥ prāptaputādī rājyaṃ kṛtvā hariṃ yayau
pretarājaḥ svamuktyai ca vaṇijañcedamabravīt / pretaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahārtaḥ san sukṛtaṃ bhujyate phalaṃ
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge kumbhaḥ sānnaś ca sodakaḥ(2) / dattaḥ purā sa madhyāhne jīvanāyopatiṣṭhate
dhanaṃ gṛhītvā me gaccha gayāyāṃ piṇḍado bhava / vaṇigdhanaṃ gṛhītvā tu gayāyāṃ piṇḍado 'bhavat
1 dadau gata iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 sārthaś ca sodaka iti cha.. :p 7 pretarājaḥ saha pretair mukto nīto hareḥ puraṃ / gayāśīrṣe piṇḍadānādātmānaṃ svapitṝṃs tathā(1)
pitṛvaṃśe sutā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca / guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye cānye bāndhavā mṛtāḥ
ye me kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ(2) / kriyālopagatā ye ca jātyandhāḥ puṅgavas tathā
virūpā āmagarbhā ye jñātājñātāḥ kule mama / teṣāṃ piṇḍo mayā datto hy akṣayyamupatiṣṭhatāṃ
ye kecit pretarūpeṇa tiṣṭhanti pitaro mama / te sarve tṛptimāyāntu piṇḍadānena(3) sarvadā
piṇḍo deyastu sarvebhyaḥ sarvair vai kulatārakaiḥ / ātmanastu tathā deyo hy akṣayaṃ lokamicchatā
pañcame 'hni gadālole snāyānmantreṇa buddhimān / gadāprakṣālane tīrthe gadālole 'tipāvane
snānaṃ karāmi saṃsāragadaśāntyai janārdana / namo 'kṣayavaṭāyaiva akṣayasvargadāyine
pitrādīnāmakṣayāya sarvapāpakṣayāya ca / śrāddhaṃ vaṭatale(4) kuryād brāhmaṇānāñca bhojanaṃ
ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā / kimpunarbahubhirbhuktaiḥ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayaṃ

1 pretarājetyādiḥ, svapitṝṃstathetyantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 2 śubhakarmavivarjitā iti jha.. 3 piṇḍenāneneti ṅa.. 4 vaṭataṭe iti ja.. :p 8 gayāyāmannadātā yaḥ pitarastena putriṇaḥ / vaṭaṃ vaṭeśvaraṃ natvā pūjayet prapitāmahaṃ
akṣayāṃllabhate lokān kulānāṃ śatamuddharet / kramato 'kramato vāpi gayāyatrā mahāphalā
gayāyātrāvidhiḥ agnir uvāca gāyatryaiva mahānadyāṃ snātaḥ(1) sandhyāṃ samācaret / gāyatryā agrataḥ prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍamathākṣayaṃ
madhyāhne codyati(2) snātvā gītavādyair hyupāsya ca / sāvitrīpurataḥ sandhyāṃ piṇḍadānañca tatpade

1 prāta iti ka.. 2 madhyāhne sarasīti ga.. 3 mucyate bhayāditi cha.. , jha.. ca :p 9 baliṃ kākaśilāyāñca kumārañca namettataḥ(1) / svargadvāryāṃ somakuṇḍe vāyutīrthe 'tha piṇḍadaḥ
bhavedākaśagaṅgāyāṃ kapilāyāñca piṇḍadaḥ / kapileśaṃ śivaṃ natvā rukmikuṇḍe ca piṇḍadaḥ
koṭītīrthe ca koṭīśaṃ natvāmoghapade naraḥ(2) / gadālole vānarake gopracāre ca piṇḍadaḥ(3)
natvā gāvaṃ vaitaraṇyāmekaviṃśakuloddhṛtiḥ / śrāddhapiṇḍapradātā(4) syāt krauñcapade ca piṇḍadaḥ(5)
tṛtīyāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ niścirāyāñca piṇḍadaḥ / ṛṇamokṣe pāpamokṣe bhasmakuṇḍe 'tha bhasmanā
snānakṛn mucyate pāpānnameddevaṃ janārdanam / eṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana
paralokagate mahyamakṣyayyamupatiṣṭhatāṃ / gayāyāṃ pitṛrūpeṇa svayameva janārdanaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mucyate vai ṛṇatrayāt / mārkaṇḍeyeśvaraṃ natvā namedgṛdhreśvaraṃ naraḥ(6)

mūlakṣetre maheśasya dhārāyāṃ piṇḍado bhavet / 1 namennara iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 2 māsapade 'nnada iti kha.. , gha.. ca 3 kapileśamityādiḥ, gopracāre ca piṇḍada ity antaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti 4 śrāddhe piṇḍapradateti kha.. 5 bhavedākāśagaṅgāyāmaityādiḥ, krauñcapāde ca piṇḍada ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti 6 namedbhūteśvaraṃ nara iti gha.. :p 10 (1)gṛdhrakūṭe gṛdhravaṭe dhautapāde ca piṇḍadaḥ
puṣkariṇyāṃ kardamāle rāmatīrthe ca piṇḍadaḥ / prabhāseśannamet pretaśilāyāṃ piṇḍado bhavet
divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhāḥ pitaro bāndhavādayaḥ / pretādirūpā muktāḥ(2) syuḥ piṇḍair dattair mayākhilāḥ
sthānatraye pretaśilā gayāśirasi pāvanī / prabhāse pretakuṇḍe ca piṇḍadastārayet kulam
vasiṣṭheśannamaskṛtya tadagre piṇḍado bhavet / gayānābhau suṣumṇāyāṃ mahākoṣṭyāñca piṇḍadaḥ
gadādharāgrato muṇḍapṛṣṭhe devyāś ca sannidhau / muṇdapṛṣṭhaṃ namedādau kṣetrapālādisaṃyutam
pūjayitvā bhayaṃ na syādviṣarogādināśanam / brahmāṇañca namaskṛtya brahmalokaṃ nayet kulam
subhadrāṃ balabhadrañca prapūjya puruṣottamam / sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ kulamuddhṛtya nākabhāk(3)
hṛṣīkeśaṃ namaskṛtya tadagre piṇḍado bhavet / mādhavaṃ pūjayitvā ca devo vaimāniko(4) bhavet
mahālakṣmīṃ prārcya gaurīṃ maṅgalāñca sarasvatīm / pitṝnuddhṛtya svargastho bhuktabhogo 'tra śāstradhīḥ

1 sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ kulamuddhṛtya lokabhāgiti pāṭhotra jha.. pustake 'dhiko 'sti 2 pretādirūpamuktā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 3 kulamuddhṛtya lokabhāgiti ga.. , ja.. ca / vaśiṣṭheśamityādiḥ, kulamuddhṛtya nākabhāgityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 4 devair vaimānika iti cha.. :p 11 dvādaśādityamabhyarya vahniṃ revantamindrakam / rogādimuktaḥ svargī syācchrīkapardivināyakam
prapūjya kārttikeyañca nirvighnaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt / somanāthañca kāleśaṅkedāraṃ prapitāmaham
siddheśvarañca rudreśaṃ rāmeśaṃ brahmakeśvaram / aṣṭaliṅgāni guhyāni pūjayitvā tu(1) sarvabhāk
nārāyaṇaṃ varāhañca nārasiṃhaṃ namecchriye / brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ tripuraghnamaśeṣadam
sītāṃ rāmañca garuḍaṃ vāmanaṃ samprapūjya ca / sarvakāmānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ nayet pitṝn
devaiḥ sārdhaṃ samprapūjya devamādigadādharam / ṛṇatrayavinirmuktastārayet sakalaṃ kulam
devarūpā śilā puṇyā tasmāddevamayī śilā / gayāyāṃ nahi tat sthānaṃ yatra tīrthaṃ na vidyate
yannāmnā pātayet piṇḍaṃ tannayedbrahma śāśvatam / phalgvīśaṃ phalgucaṇḍīṃ ca praṇamyāṅgārakeśvaram
mataṅgasya pade śrāddhī bharatāśramake bhavet / haṃsatīrthe koṭitīrthe yatra pāṇḍuśilānnadaḥ
tatra syādagnidhārāyāṃ madhusravasi piṇḍadaḥ / rudreśaṃ kilikileśaṃ namedvṛddhivināyakam(2)

piṇḍado dhenukāraṇye pade dhenor namecca gām / 1 pūjayitvātheti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 2 namedbuddhivināyakamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / namedvṛddhavināyakamiti gha.. :p 12 sarvān pitṝṃstārayecca sarasvatyāñca piṇḍadaḥ
sandhyāmupāsya sāyāhne nameddevīṃ sarasvatīm / trisandhyākṛdbhavedvipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
gayāṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gayāviprān prapūjya ca / annadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtantatrākṣayaṃ bhavet
stutvā samprārthayedevamādidevaṃ gadādharam / gadādharaṃ gayāvāsaṃ pitrādīnāṃ gatipradam
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ yogadaṃ praṇamāmyaham / dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitam
nityaśuddhaṃ buddhiyuktaṃ(1) satyaṃ brahma namāmyaham / ānandamadvayaṃ devaṃ devadānavavanditam
devadevīvṛndayuktaṃ sarvadā praṇamāmyaham / kalikalmaṣakālārtidamanaṃ(2) vanamālinam
pālitākhilalokeśaṃ(3) kuloddharaṇamānasam / vyaktāvyaktavibhaktātmāvibhaktātmānamātmani
sthitaṃ sthirataraṃ(4) sāraṃ vande ghorāghamardanam(5) / āgato 'smi gayāṃ deva pitṛkārye gadādharaḥ

tvaṃ me sākṣī bhavādyeha anṛṇo 'hamṛṇatrayāt / 1 nityaśuddhabuddhiyuktamiti gha.. , cha.. ca 2 kālārtināśanamiti gha.. / kālārtidalanamiti ga.. , ṅa.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 3 pālitākhiladeveśamiti gha.. 4 sthitataramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 vandehamarimardanamiti ṅa.. / vande saṃsāramardanamiti ja.. :p 13 sākṣiṇaḥ santu me devā brahmeśānādayas tathā
mayā gayāṃ samāsādya pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā / gayāmāhātmyapaṭhanācchrāddhādau brahmalokabhāk
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhamakṣayaṃ brahmalokadam //43
śrāddhakalpaḥ agnir uvāca kātyāyanī munīnāha yathā śrāddhaṃ tathā vade / gayādau śrāddhaṃ kurvīta saṅkrāntyādau viśeṣataḥ
kāle vāparapakṣe ca caturthyā ūrdhvameva va / samyādya ca padarkṣe ca(1) pūrvedyuś ca nimantrayet
yatīn gṛhasthasādhūn vā snātakāñchrotriyān dvijān / anavadyān karmaniṣṭhān śiṣṭānācārasaṃyutān(2)
1 sampādya paramarkṣe ceti cha.. 2 ācārasaṃskṛtāniti ga.. , ja.. ca :p 14 varjayecchitrikuṣṭhyādīnna gṛhṇīyānnimantritān / snātāñchucīṃs tathā dāntān prāṅmukhān devakarmaṇi
upaveśayettrīn pitryādīnekaikamubhayatra vā / evaṃ mātāmahādeś ca śākair api ca kārayet
tadahni brahmacārī syādakopo 'tvarito mṛduḥ(1) / satyo 'pramatto 'nadhvanyo asvādhyāyaś ca(2) vāgyataḥ
sarvāṃś ca paṅktimūrdhanyān pṛcchet praśne tathāsane / darbhānāstīrya dviguṇān pitre devādikañcaret
viśvāndevānāvāhayiṣye pṛcchedāvāhayeti ca / viśvedevāsa āvāhya vikīryātha yavān japet
viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ pitṝnāvāhayiṣye ca / pṛcchedāvāhayetyukte uśantastvā samāhvayet
tilān vikīryātha japedāyāntvityādi pitrake / sapitritre niṣiñcedvā śanno devīrabhi tṛcā

yavo 'sīti yavān datvā pitre sarvatra vai tilān / tilo 'si somadevatyo gosavo devanirmitaḥ / pratnamadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝn lokān prīṇāhi naḥ svadhā / iti śrīś ca teti dadetpuṣpaṃ pātre haime 'tha rājate
audumvare vā khaḍge vā parṇapātre pradakṣiṇam / devānāmapasavyaṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ savyamācaret

1 atvarito 'tyṛjuriti ṅa.. 2 satye prapanno 'nadhvanyo hy asvādhyāyaśceti kha.. , gha.. ca :p 15 ekaikasya ekaikena sapavitrakareṣu ca / yā divyā āpaḥ payasā sambabhūvuryā antarikṣā utapārthivīryāḥ hiraṇyavarṇā yajñiyāstā na āpaḥ śivāḥ saṃśyonāḥ suhavā bhavantu || viśve devā eṣa vo 'rghaḥ svāhā ca pitareṣa te
avadhaivaṃ pitāmahadeḥ saṃsravāt prathame caret(1) / pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karotyadhaḥ
atra gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpācchādanadānakaṃ / ghṛtāktamannamuddhṛtya pṛcchatyagnau kariṣye ca
kuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto juhuyātsāgniko 'nale / anagnikaḥ pitṛhaste(2) sapavitre tu mantrataḥ
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti(3) prathamāhutiḥ / somāya pitṛmate 'tha yamāyāṅgirase pare
hutaśeṣaṃ cānnapātre datvā pātraṃ samālabhet / pṛthivī te pātrandyauḥ pidhānaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhe amṛte amṛtaṃ juhomi svāheti japtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭhanniveśayet
apahateti ca tilān vikīryānnaṃ pradāyayet / juṣadhvamiti coktvātha gāyatryādi tato japet

1 ekaikasyetyādiḥ, prathame caredityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 2 anagniko jale caiveti ṅa.. 3 svadheti ka.. :p 16 devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś ca mahāyogibhya eva ca / namaḥ svadhāyai svāhayai nityameva namo namaḥ(1)
tṛptān jñātvānnaṃ vikiredapo dadyāt sakṛt sakṛt / gāyatrīṃ pūrvavajjaptvā madhu madhviti vai japet
tṛptāḥ stha iti sampṛcchettṛptāḥ sma iti vai vadet / śeṣamannamanujñāpya sarvamannamathaikataḥ
uddhṛtyocchiṣṭapārśve tu kṛtvā caivāvanejanaṃ / dadyātkuśeṣu trīn piṇḍānācānteṣu pare jaguḥ
ācānteṣūdakaṃ puṣpāṇyakṣatāni pradāpayet / akṣayyodakamevātha āśiṣaḥ prārthayennaraḥ(2)
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu gotranno vardhatāṃ sadā / dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca
śraddhā ca no māvyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no 'stviti / annañca no bahu bhavedatithīṃś ca labhemahi
yācitāraś ca naḥ santu mā ca yācisma kañcana / svadhāvācanīyān kuśānāstīrya sapavitrakān(3)
svadhāṃ vācayiṣye pṛcchedanujñātaś ca vācyatāṃ / pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ prapitāmahamukhyake
svadhocyatāmastu svadhā ucyamānastathaiva ca / apo niṣiñceduttānaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvātha dakṣiṇāṃ

1 svāhāyai nityameva bhavantviti iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 prārthayettata iti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca 3 aghorāḥ pitara ity ādiḥ, āstīrya sapavitrakānityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.. , cha.. pustakadvaye nāsti :p 17 yathāśakti pradadyācca daive paitre 'tha vācayet / viśve devāḥ prīyantāñca vāje visarjayet
āmāvājasyetyanuvrajya kṛtvā viprān pradakṣiṇaṃ / gṛhe viśedamāvāsyāṃ māsi māsi carettathā
ekoddiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhaṃ pūrvavadācaret / ekaṃ pavitramekārdhaṃ ekaṃ piṇḍampradāpayet
nāvāhanāgnaukaraṇaṃ viśve devā na cātra hi / tṛptipraśne svaditamiti vadetsukhaditaṃ dvijaḥ
upatiṣṭhatāmityakṣayye visarge cābhiramyatāṃ / abhiratāḥ sma ity apare śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret
sapiṇṭhīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye abdānte madhyato 'pi vā / pitṝṇāṃ trīṇi pātrāṇi ekampretasya pātrakaṃ
sapavitrāṇi catvāri tilapuṣpayutāni ca / gandhodakena yuktāni(1) pūrayitvābhiṣiñcati
pretapātraṃ pitṛpātre ye samanā iti dvayāt / pūrvavat piṇḍadānādi pretānāṃ pitṛtā bhavet
athābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ vakṣye sarvaṃ tu pūrvavat / japet pitṛmantravarjaṃ pūrvāhṇe tat pradakṣiṇaṃ
upacārā ṛjukuśāstilārthaiś ca yavair iha(2) / tṛptipraśnastu sampannaṃ susampannaṃ vadeddvijaḥ

1 gandhodakena siktāni iti ja.. 2 athābhyudayikamityādiḥ, yavair iha ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti :p 18 dadhyakṣatavadarādyāḥ(1) piṇḍā nāndīmukhān pitṝn / āvāhayiṣye pṛcchecca prīyantāmiti cākṣaye
nāndīmukhāś ca pitaro vācayiṣye 'tha pṛcchati / nāndīmukhān pitṛgaṇān prīyantāmityatho vadet
nāndīmukhāś ca pitarastatpitā prapitāmahaḥ / mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātṛkāmahaḥ
svadhākāranna yuñjīta yugmān viprāṃś ca bhojayet / tṛptiṃ vakṣye pitṝṇāṃ ca grāmyair oṣadhibhis tathā
māsantṛptis tathāraṇyaiḥ(2) kandamūlaphalādibhiḥ / matsyair māsadvayaṃ mārgaistrayaṃ vai śākunena ca
caturo rauraveṇātha(3) pañca ṣaṭ chāgalena tu(4) / kūrmeṇa sapta cāṣṭau ca vārāheṇa navaiva tu
meṣamāṃsena daśa ca māhiṣaiḥ pārṣataiḥ śivaiḥ / saṃvatsarantu gavyena payasā pāyasena vā
vārdhīnasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī / khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ lohitacchāgalo(5) madhu
mahāśalkāś ca varṣāsu maghāśrāddhamathākṣayaṃ(6) / mantrādhyāyyagnihotrī ca śākhādhyāyī ṣaḍaṅgavit
tṛṇāciketaḥ trimadhurdharmadroṇasya(7) pāṭhakaḥ / triṣuparṇajyeṣṭhasāmajñānī syuḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ

1 dadhyakṣatavadaryādyā iti ga.. , cha.. ca 2 tathā vanyair iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 vatsaraṃ rauraveṇātheti gha.. 4 pañcakaṃ chāgastena tu iti ṅa.. 5 lohitacchāgaka iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 6 maghāśrāddhamihākṣayamiti jha.. 7 jaladroṇasyeti jha.. :p 19 kamyānāṃ kalpamākhyāsye(1) pratipatsu dhanaṃ bahu / striyaḥ parā dvitīyāyāñcaturthyāṃ dharmakāmadaḥ
pañcamyāṃ putrakāmastu ṣaṣṭhyāñca śraiṣṭhyabhāgapi(2) / kṛṣibhāgī ca saptamyāmaṣṭamyāmarthalābhakaḥ
navamyāñca ekaśaphā(3) daśamyāṅgogaṇo bhavet / ekadaśyāṃ parīvāro dvādaśyāndhanadhānyakaṃ
jñātiśreṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāñca śastrataḥ(4) / mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptamamāvāsyāṃ samīritaṃ(5)
sapta vyādhā daśāraṇye(6) mṛgāḥ kālañjare girau / cakravākāḥ śaradvīpe haṃsāḥ sarasi mānse
te 'pi jātāḥ(7) kurukṣetre brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / prasthitā dūramadhvānaṃ yūyantebhyo 'vasīdata
śrāddhādau paṭhite śrāddhaṃ pūrṇaṃ syādbrahmalokadaṃ / śrāddhaṃ kuryācca putrādiḥ(8) piturjīvati tatpituḥ
tatpitustatpituḥ kuryājjīvati prapitāmahe / pituḥ pitāmashasyātha parasya prapitāmāt(9)

1 kālamākhyāsye iti jha.. ca 2 śreṣṭhabhāgyapi iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / jyeṣṭhabhāgapi iti gha.. 3 navamyāṃ vai śaphapatiriti ja.. 4 caturdaśyāñca śāstrata iti kha.. , gha.. ca 5 mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptiramāvāsyā samīritā iti ka.. 6 daśārṇeṣu iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 7 te 'bhijātā iti kha.. , gha.. ca 8 kuryāt suputro 'pi iti cha.. 9 tatpiturityādiḥ, prapitāmahādityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti :p 20 evaṃ mātrādikasyāpi tathā mātāmahādike / śrāddhakalpaṃ paṭhedyastu sa labhet śrāddhakṛtphalaṃ(1)
tīrthe yugādau manvādau śrāddhaṃ dattamathākṣayaṃ / aśvayucchuklanavamī dvādaśī kartike tathā
tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca / phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣayaikādaśī tathā
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī / śrāvaṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā
kartikī phālgunī tadvaj jyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī sitā / svāyambhuvādyā manavasteṣāmādyāḥ kilākṣayāḥ
gayā prayāgo gaṅgā ca kurukṣetraṃ ca narmadā / śrīparvataḥ prabhāsaś ca śālagrāmo varāṇasī(2)
godāvarī teṣu śrāddhaṃ strīpuruṣottamādiṣu
bhāratavarṣaṃ agnir uvāca uttaraṃ yat samudrasya himādreś caiva dakṣiṇaṃ / varṣaṃ tad bhārataṃ nāma navasāhasravistṛtaṃ

karmabhūmiriyaṃ svargamapavargaṃ ca gacchatāṃ / 1 yastu labhecchrāddhakṛtaṃ phalamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 vārāṇasī iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 21 mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimān hemaparvataḥ(1)
vindhyaś ca pāripātraś ca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ / indradvīpaḥ kaseruś ca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān
nāgadvīpas tathā saumyo gāndharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ / ayaṃ tu navamasteṣu dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvīpoyaṃ dakṣiṇottarāt / nava bhedā bhāratasya(2) madhyabhede 'tha pūrvataḥ
kirātā yavanāścāpi brāhmaṇādyāś ca madhyataḥ / vedasmṛtimukhā nadyaḥ pāripātrodbhavās tathā
vindhyācca narmadādyāḥ syuḥ sahyāttāpī payoṣṇikā / godāvarībhīmarathīkṛṣṇaveṇādikās tathā
malayāt kṛtamālādyāstrisāmādyā mahendrajāḥ / kumārādyāḥ śuktimato(3) himādreś candrabhāgakā
paścime kurupāñcālamadhyadeśādayaḥsthitāḥ

mahādvīpādi agnir uvāca lakṣayojanavistāraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ samāvṛtam / 1 śaktimānṛkṣaparvata iti gha.. , cha.. ca / śuktimānṛkṣaparvata iti ja.. 2 nava bhedā bhavantyasyeti jha.. 3 śaktimata iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca :p 22 lakṣyayojanamanena kṣīrodena samantataḥ
saṃveṣṭya kṣāramudadhiṃ plakṣadvīpas tathā sthitaḥ(1) / sapta medhātitheḥ putrāḥ plakṣadvīpeśvarās tathā
syācchāntabhayaḥ śiśiraḥ sukhodaya itaḥ paraḥ / ānandaś ca śivaḥ kṣemo dhruvastannāmavarṣakaṃ
maryādāśailo gomedhaś candro nāradadundbhī / somakaḥ sumanāḥ śailo vaibhrājāstajjanāḥ śubhāḥ
nadyaḥ pradhānāḥ saptātra plakṣācchākāntikeṣu ca / jīvanaṃ pañcasāsraṃ dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ(2)
āryakāḥ kuravaś caiva viviṃśā bhāvinaś ca te / viprādyāstaiś ca somo 'rcyo dvilakṣaścābdhilakṣakaḥ
mānenekṣurasodena vṛto dviguṇaśālmalaḥ / vapuṣmataḥ sapta putrāḥ śālmaleśās tathābhavan
śveto 'tha haritaś caiva jīmūto lohitaḥ kramāt / vaidyuto mānasaś caiva suprabho nāma varṣakaḥ
dviguṇo dviguṇenaiva surodena samāvṛtaḥ / kumudaścānalaś caiva(3) tṛtīyastu valāhakaḥ
droṇaḥ kaṃko 'tha(4) mahiṣaḥ kakudmān sapta nimnagāḥ / kapilāścāruṇāḥ pītāḥ kṛṣṇāḥsyurbrāhmaṇādayaḥ

vāyurūpaṃ yajanti sma surodenāyamāvṛtaḥ(5) / 1 dvīpas tathā smṛta iti jha.. 2 varṇāśramātmaja iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 3 kumudaśconnataś caiveti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 4 karko 'theti ka.. 5 surodena samāvṛta iti gha.. :p 23 jyotiṣmataḥ kuśeśāḥ syurudgijo dhenumān sutaḥ
dvairatho laṃvano dhairyaḥ kapilaś ca prabhākaraḥ / viprādyā dadhimukhyāstu brahmarūpaṃ yajanti te
vidrumo(1) hemaśailaś ca dyutimān puṣpavāṃs tathā / kuśeśayo hariḥ śailo varṣārthaṃ mandarācalaḥ
veṣṭito 'yaṃ ghṛtodena krauñcadvīpena so 'pyatha / krauñceśvarāḥ dyutimataḥ putrāstannāmavarṣakāḥ
kuśalo manonugaścoṣṇaḥ pradhāno 'thāndhakārakaḥ / muniś ca dundubhiḥ sapta sapta śailāś ca nimnagāḥ(2)
krauñcaś ca vāmnaś caiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ(3) / devavṛt puṇḍarīkaś ca dundubhirdviguṇo mithaḥ
dvīpā dvīpeṣu ye śailā yathā dvīpāni te tathā / puṣkarāḥ puṣkalā dhanyāstīrthā(4) viprādayo harim
yajanti krauñcadvīpastu dadhimaṇḍodakāvṛtaḥ / saṃvṛtaḥ śākadvīpena havyācchākeśvarāḥ sutāḥ
jaladaś ca kumāraś ca sukumāro maṇīvakaḥ / kuśottaratho modākī drumastannāmavarṣakāḥ
udayākhyo jaladharo raivataḥ śyāmakodrakau / āmvikeyas tathā ramyaḥ keśarī sapta nimnagāḥ

1 rudrābha iti ka.. / vikrama iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 kuśala ity ādiḥ, nimnagā ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti 3 tṛtīyaścānukāraka iti gha.. , jha.. ca 4 puṣkalāvatyāṃ tīrthā iti gha.. :p 24 magā magadhamanasyā(1) mandagāś ca dvijātayaḥ(2) / yajanti sūryarūpaṃ tu(3) śākaḥ kṣīrābdhinā vṛtaḥ
puṣkareṇāvṛtaḥ so 'pi dvau putrau savanasya ca / masāvīto dhātakiś ca varṣe dve nāmacihnite(4)
eko 'drirmānasākhyo 'tra madhyato valayākṛtiḥ / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi vistārocchrāyataḥ samaḥ
jīvanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ surair brahmātra pūjyate / svādūdakenodadhinā veṣṭito dvīpamānataḥ
ūnātiriktatā cāpāṃ samudreṣu na jāyate / udayāstamaneṣvindoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ
daśottarāṇi pañcaiva(5) aṅgulānāṃ śatāni vai / apāṃ vṛddhikṣayau dṛṣṭau sāmudrīṇāṃ(6) mahāmune
svādūdakā bahuguṇā(7) bhūrhaimī jantuvarjitā / lokālokastataḥ śailo yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ
lokālokastu tamasāvṛto 'thāṇḍakaṭāhataḥ / bhūmiḥ sāṇḍakaṭāhena pañcāśatkoṭivistarā(8)
bhuvanakoṣaḥ agnir uvāca vistārastu smṛto bhūmeḥ sahasrāṇi ca saptatiḥ / ucchrāyo daśasāhasraṃ pātālañcaikamekakaṃ
atalaṃ vitalañcaiva nitalañca gabhastimat / mahākhyaṃ sutalañcāgryaṃ pātālañcāpi saptamaṃ
kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ śuklaśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ / bhūmayasteṣu ramyeṣu santi daityādayaḥ sukhaṃ
pātālānāmadhaścāste śeṣo viṣṇuś ca tāmasaḥ / guṇānantyātsa cānantataḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīṃ
bhuvo 'dho narakā naike na patettatra vaiṣṇavaḥ / raviṇā bhāsitā pṛthvī yāvattāyannabho mataṃ
bhūmeryojanalakṣantu viśiṣṭharavimaṇḍalaṃ / raver lakṣeṇa candraś ca lakṣānnākṣatramindutaḥ
dvilakṣādbhādbudhaścāste budhācchukro dvilakṣataḥ / dvilakṣeṇa kujaḥ śukrādbhaumād dvilakṣato guruḥ
gurordvilakṣataḥ sauritllakṣātsaptarṣayaḥ śaneḥ / lakṣād dhruvo hy ṛṣibhyastu trailokyañcocchrayeṇa ca
dhruvāt koṭyā maharloko yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ / jano dvikoṭitastasmādyatrāsan(1) sanakādayaḥ
janāttapaścāṣtakoṭyā vairājā yatra devatāḥ / ṣaṇavatyā tu koṭīnāntapasaḥ satyalokakaḥ
apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi sa smṛtaḥ / pādagamyastu bhūlloko bhuvaḥ sūryāntaraḥ smṛtaḥ
svargaloko dhruvāntastu niyutāni(2) caturdaśa / etadaṇḍakaṭāhena vṛto brahmāṇḍavistaraḥ
vārivahnyanilākāśaistato bhūtādinā vahiḥ / vṛtaṃ daśaguṇair aṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā
daśottarāṇi śeṣāṇi ekaikasmānmāmune / mahāntañca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitaṃ
anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṅkhyānaṃ nāpi vidyate(3) / hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune
asaṅkhyātāni śāṇḍāni tatra jātāni cedṛśāṃ / dāruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tile tadvat pumāniti(4)
pradhāne ca sthito(5) vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ / pradhānañca pumāṃś caiva sarvabhūtātmabhṛtayā(6)
viṣṇuśaktyā mahāprājña vṛtau saṃśrayadharmiṇau / tayoḥ(7) saiva pṛthagbhāve kāraṇaṃ saṃśrayasya ca

1 yatra vai iti ṅa.. 2 ayutāni iti ja.. 3 saṅkhyānaṃ naiva vidyate iti gha.. , jha.. ca / saṅkhyānaṃ na ca vidyate iti ga. 4 pumānapi iti gha.. , jha.. ca 5 pradhāne 'vasthitaṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca 6 sarvabhūtānubhūtayā iti ṅa.. 7 dvayoriti jha.. :p 27 kṣobhakāraṇabhūtaś ca sargakāle mahāmune / yathā śaityaṃ jale vāto vibharti kaṇikāgataṃ
jagacchaktis tathā viṣṇoḥ pradhānapratipādikāṃ / viṣṇuśaktiṃ samāsādya devādyāḥ sambhavanti hi
sa ca viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ brahma yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava
īśādaṇḍastathaivāsya dviguṇo munisattama /
tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ / trinābhimatipañcāraṃ ṣaṇṇemi dvyayanātmakaṃ
saṃvatsaramayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ / catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dvitīyakṣo vivasvataḥ
pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya mahāmate / akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇantadadyugārdhayoḥ
hrasvo 'kṣastadyugārdhañca dhruvādhāraṃ rathasya vai / hayāś ca sapta chandāṃsi gāyatryādīni suvrata
udayāstamanaṃ jñeyaṃ darśanādarśanaṃ raveḥ / yāvanmātrapradeśe tu vaśiṣṭho 'vasthito dhruvaḥ
svayamāyāti tāvattu bhūmerābhūtasamplave(1) / ūrdhottaramṛṣibhyastu dhruvo yatra vyavasthitaḥ
etadviṣṇupadaṃ divyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vyomni bhāsvaraṃ / nirdhūtadoṣapaṅkānāṃ yatīnāṃ sthānamuttamaṃ
1 bhūmerāhūtasamplave iti gha.. , ja.. ca :p 28 tato gaṅgā prabhavati smaraṇāt pāśanāśanī(1) / divi rūpaṃ harerjñeyaṃ śiśumārākṛti prabho
sthitaḥ pucche dhruvastatra bhraman bhrāmayati grahān / sa ratho 'dhiṣṭhitā devair ādityair ṛṣibhirvaraiḥ(2)
gandharvair apsarobhiś ca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ(3) / himoṣṇavārivarṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhagavān raviḥ
ṛgvedādimayo viṣṇuḥ sa śubhāśubhakāraṇaṃ / rathastricakraḥ somasya kundābhāstasya vājinaḥ(4)
vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena caratyasau / trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatāni ca
trayastriṃśattathā devāḥ pivanti kṣaṇadākaraṃ(5) / ekāṃ kalāñca pitara ekāmāraśmisaṃsthitāḥ
vāyvagnidravyasambhūto rathaś candrasutasya ca / aṣṭābhisturagair yukto budhastena caratyapi
śukrasyāpi ratho 'ṣṭāśvo bhaumasyāpi rathas tathā / vṛhaspate ratho 'ṣṭāśvaḥ śaneraṣṭāśvako rathaḥ
svarbhānoś ca ratho 'ṣṭāśvaḥ ketoścāṣṭāśvako rathaḥ / yadadya vaiṣṇavaḥ kāyastato vipra vasundharā

1 sarvapāpapraṇāśinīti ja.. 2 ṛṣabho raveriti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 3 saratha ity ādiḥ, rākṣasair ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti 4 kundābhāstatra vājina iti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 kṣaṇadācaramiti jha.. :p 29 padmākarā samudbhūtā parvatādyādisaṃyutā / jyotirbhuvananadyadrisamudravanakaṃ hariḥ
yadasti nāsti tadviṣṇurviṣṇujñānavijṛmbhitaṃ(1) / na vijñānamṛte kiñcij jñānaṃ viṣṇuḥ parampadaṃ
tat kuryād yena viṣṇuḥ syāt satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ / paṭhed bhuvanakoṣaṃ hi yaḥ so 'vāptasukhātmabhāk
jyotiḥśāstrādividhyāś ca śubhāśubhādhipo hariḥ(2)
jyotiḥśāstraṃ agnir uvāca jyotiḥśāstraṃ pravakṣyāmi śubhāśubhavivekadaṃ / cāturlakṣasya sāraṃ yat taj jñātvā sarvavidbhavet
ṣaḍaṣṭake(3) vivāho na na ca dvidvādaśe striyāḥ / na trikoṇe hy atha prītiḥ(4) śeṣe ca samasaptake

1 jñānavijñānajṛmbhitamiti ja.. 2 śubhāśubhāśayo haririti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 ṣaṭkāṣṭake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca 4 na trikoṇeṣu prītiḥ syāditi ja.. :p 30 dvidvādaśe trikoṇe ca maitrīkṣetrapayoryadi / bhavedekādhipatyañca tārāprītirathāpi vā
tathāpi kāryaḥ saṃyogo na tu ṣaṭkāṣṭake punaḥ / jīve bhṛgau cāstamite mriyate ca pumān striyā
gurukṣetragate sūrye sūryakṣetragate gurau / vivāhaṃ na praśaṃsanti kanyāvaidhavyakṛdbhavet
aticāre tripakṣaṃ syādvakre māsacatuṣṭayaṃ / vratodvāhau na kurvīta gurorvakrāticārayoḥ
caitre pauṣe na riktāsu harau supte kuje ravau / candrakṣaye cāśubhaṃ syāt sandhyākālaḥ śubhāvahaḥ
rohiṇī cottarā mūlaṃ svātī hasto 'tha revatī / tule na mithune śasto vivāhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
vivāhe karṇabedhe ca vrate puṃsavane tathā / prāśane cādyacūḍāyāṃ biddharkṣañca vivarjayet(1)
śravaṇe mūlapuṣye ca sūryamaṅgalajīvake / kumbhe siṃhe ca mithune karma puṃsavanaṃ smṛtaṃ
haste mūle mṛge pauṣṇe budhe śukre ca niṣkṛtiḥ / arkendujīvabhṛguje mūle tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ
annasya prāśanaṃ śukre jīve mṛge ca maunake(2) / hastādipañcake puṣpe kṛttikāditraye tathā

1 viddhamṛkṣaṃ vivarjayet iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 jīve makaramīnake iti jha.. :p 31 aśvinyāmatha revatyāṃ navānnaphalabhakṣaṇaṃ / puṣpā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā rohiṇī śravaṇāśvinau
svātisaumye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuryādanyatra varjayet / pūrvātrayaṃ(1) maghā yāmyaṃ pāvanaṃ(2) śravaṇatrayaṃ
bhaumādityaśanervāre snātavyaṃ rogamuktitaḥ / pārthive cāṣṭahrīṃkāraṃ madhye nāma ca dikṣu ca
hrīṃ puṭaṃ pārthive dikṣu hrīṃ vidikṣu likhedvasūn / gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje vastre gale dhṛtaṃ
śatravo vaśamāyānti mantreṇānena niścitaṃ / śrīṃ hrīṃ sampuṭaṃ nāma śrīṃ hrīṃ patrāṣṭakekramāt
gorocanākuṅkumena bhurje 'tha subhagāvṛte / gomadhyavāgamaḥ patre haridrāyā rasena ca
śilāpaṭṭe 'rīn stambhayati bhūmāvadhomukhīkṛṭaṃ / oṃ hūṃ saḥ(3) sampuṭannāma oṃ hūṃ saḥ(4) patrāṣṭakekramāt
gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje mṛtyunivāraṇaṃ / ekapañcanavaprītyai(5) dviṣatdvādaśayogakāḥ
trisaptaikādaśe lābho vedāṣṭadvādaśe ripuḥ / tanurdhanañca sahajaḥ suhṛt suto ripus tathā

jāyā nidhanadharmau ca karmāyavyayakaṃ kramāt / 1 pūrvātrikamiti ja.. 2 pāvakamiti ṅa.. 3 oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha.. 4 oṃ jūṃ sa iti kha.. / oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha.. 5 ekapañcanavaśāntyai iti ja.. :p 32 sphuṭaṃ mesādilagneṣu navatārābalaṃ vadet
janma sampadvipat kṣemaṃ pratyariḥ sādhakaḥ kramāt / nidhanaṃ mitrapramamitraṃ tārābalaṃ viduḥ
dhāre jñaguruśukrāṇāṃ sūryācandramasos tathā / māghādimasāṣaṭke tu kṣīramādyaṃ praśasyate
karṇabedho budhe jīve puṣye śravaṇacitrayoḥ / pañcame 'bde cādhyayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ pratipadantyajet
riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ bhaumaṃ prārcya vāṇīṃ hariṃ śriyaṃ / māghādimāsaṣatke tu(1) makhalābandhanaṃ śubhaṃ
cūḍākaraṇakādyañca śravaṇādau na śasyate / astaṃ yāte guro śukre kṣīṇe ca śaśalāñchane
upanītasya viprasya mṛtyuṃ jāḍyaṃ vinirdiśet / kṣaurarkṣe śubhavāre ca samāvartanamiṣyate
śubhakṣetre vilagneṣu śubhayuktekṣiteṣu ca / aśvinīmaghācitrāsu svātīyāmyottarāsu ca
punarvasau tathā puṣye dhanurvedaḥ praśasyate / bharaṇyārdrā maghāśleṣā vahnibhagarkṣayos tathā
jijīviṣur na kurvīta vastraprāvaraṇaṃ naraḥ / gurau śukre budhe vastraṃ vivāhādau na bhādikaṃ
revatyaśvidhaniṣṭhāsu hastādiṣu ca pañcasu / śaṅkhavidrumaratnānāṃ paridhānaṃ praśasyate
1 māghādimāsaṣaṭkeṣu iti jha . :p 33 yāmyasarpadhaniṣṭhāsu(1) triṣu pūrveṣu vāruṇe(2) / krītaṃ hānikaraṃ dravyaṃ vikrītaṃ lābhakṛdbhavet
aśvinīsvāticitrāsu revatyāṃ vāruṇe harau / krītaṃ lābhakaraṃ dravayaṃ vikrītaṃ hānikṛdbhavet
bharaṇī trīṇi pūrvāṇi ārdrāśleṣā maghānilāḥ / vahnijyeṣṭāviśākhāsu svāmino nopatiṣṭhate
dravyaṃ dattaṃ prayuktaṃ vā yatra nikṣipyate dhanaṃ / uttare śravaṇe śākre kuryādrājābhiṣecanaṃ
caitraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tathā bhādramāśvinaṃ pauṣameva ca / māghaṃ caiva parityajya śeṣamāse gṛhaṃ śubhaṃ
aśvinī rohiṇī mūlamuttarātrayamaindavaṃ / svātī hastānurādhā ca gṛhārambhe praśasyate
ādityabhaumavarjantu vāpīprāsādake tathā / siṃharāśigate jīve gurvāditye malimluce
bāle vṛddhe 'stage śukre gṛhakarma vivarjayet / agnidāho bhayaṃ rogo rājapīḍā dhanakṣatiḥ
saṅgrahe tṛṇakāṣṭhānāṃ kṛte śravaṇapañcake / gṛhapraveśanaṃ kuryāddhaniṣṭhottaravāruṇe
naukāyā ghaṭane dvitripañcasaptatrayodaśī / nṛpadarśī dhaniṣṭhāsu hastāpauṣṇāśvinīṣu ca
pūrvātrayandhaniṣṭhārdrā vahniḥ saumyaviśākhayoḥ / 1 yāmyasarpaviśākhāsu iti gha.. , ja.. ca 2 pūrveṣu cānale iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 34 aśleṣā cāśvinī caiva yātrāsiddhistu sampadā(1)
triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyāṃ sinībālī caturdaśī / śravaṇā caiva hastā ca citrā ca vaiṣṇavī tathā
goṣṭhayātrāṃ na kurvīta praveśaṃ naiva kārayet / anilottararohiṇyāṃ mṛgamūlapunarvasau
puṣyaśravaṇahasteṣu kṛṣikarma samācaret(2) / punarvasūttarāsvātībhagamūlendravāruṇe(3)
guroḥ śukrasya vāre vā vāre ca(4) somabhāsvatoḥ / vṛṣalagne ca kartavyaṅkanyāyāṃ mithune tathā
dvipañca(5) daśamī sapta tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī / revatīrohiṇīndrāgnihastamaitrottareṣu(6) ca
mandāravarjaṃ vījāni vāpayet sampadarthyapi(7) / revatīhastamūleṣu śravaṇe bhagamaitrayoḥ
pitṛdaive tathā saumye dhānyacchedaṃ mṛgodaye / hastacitrāditisvātau revatyāṃ śravaṇatraye
sthire lagne(8) gurorvāre atha(9) bhārgavasaumyayoḥ / yāmyāditimaghājyeṣṭhāsūtareṣu praveśayet

1 yātrāsiddhiṣu sampada iti ga.. , ja.. ca 2 samārabhediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 bhagamūle ca vāruṇe iti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 vāre vā iti ja.. 5 tripañceti ja.. 6 hastamaitrottarāsu iti ja.. 7 vāpayet saṃyato 'pi ceti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 8 care lagne iti jha.. 9 gurorvārethavā iti gha.. , ja.. ca :p 35 oṃ dhanadāya(1) sarvadhaneśāya dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā(2) / oṃ nave varṣe ilādevi lokasaṃvardhani kāmarūpiṇi dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā || patrasthaṃ likhitaṃ dhānyarāśisthaṃ dhānyavardhanaṃ / tripūrvāsu viśākhāyāṃ dhaniṣṭhāvāruṇe 'pi ca
eteṣu ṣaṭsu vijñeyaṃ dhānyaniṣkramaṇaṃ budhaiḥ / devatārāmavāpyādipratiṣṭhodaṅmukhe ravau
mithunasthe ravau darśādyādi syād dvādaśī tithiḥ / sadā tatraiva kartavyaṃ śayanaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ
siṃhatauliṅgate(3) cārke darśādyadvādaśīdvayaṃ / ādāvindrasamuptyānaṃ prabodhaś ca hareḥ kramāt
tathā kanyāgate bhānau(4) durgoptyāne tathāṣṭamī / tripādeṣu ca ṛkṣeṣu yadā bhadrā tithirbhavet
bhaumādityaśanaiścāri vijñeyaṃ tat tripuṣkaraṃ / sarvakarmaṇyupādeyā viśuddhiś candratarayoḥ(5)
janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaś ca saptamo daśamas tathā / ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣānteṣāmeva śubhaṃ vadet
śuklapakṣe dvītīyaś ca pañcamo navamaḥ śubhaḥ / mitrātimitrasādhakasapatkṣemāditārakāḥ

1 oṃ śrīṃ dhanadāyeti ja.. 2 ``nave varṣe gurorvāre atha bhārgavasaumyayoḥ'' eṣa pāṭhotra cha.. pustakedhiko 'sti 3 siṃhatauligate iti kha.. 4 kanyārāśigate bhānau iti gha.. 5 viśuddhiś candrasūryayoriti ja.. :p 36 janmanā mṛtyumāpnoti vipadā dhanasaṅkṣayaṃ / pratyarau maraṇaṃ vidyānnidhane yāti pañcatāṃ
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdinādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdinaṃ(1) / tāvat kālaṃ śaśī kṣīṇaḥ pūrṇastatropari smṛtaḥ
vṛṣe ca mithune bhānau jīve candrendradaivate(2) / paurṇamāsī gurorvāre mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā
aindre guruḥ śaśī caiva prājāpatye ravis tathā / pūrṇimā jyeṣṭhamāsasya mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā
svātyantare yantraniṣṭhe śakrasyotthāpayed dhvajaṃ / haryṛkṣapāde(3) cāśvinyāṃ saptāhānte visarjayet
sarvaṃ hemasamandānaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ / sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamantoyaṃ rāhugraste divākare
dhvāṅkṣī mahodarī ghorā mandā mandākinī dvijāḥ(4) / rākṣasī ca krameṇārkātsaṅkrāntirnāmabhiḥ smṛtā
bālave kaulave nāge taitile karaṇe yadi / uttiṣṭhan saṅkramatyarkrastadā lokaḥ(5) sukhī bhavet
gare vave vaṇigviṣṭau kintughne śakunau vrajet / rājño doṣeṇa loko 'yampīḍyate sampadā samaṃ

catuṣpādviṣṭivāṇijye śayitaḥ saṅkramedraviḥ / 1 kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdalādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdalamiti ḍa.. 2 jīve candrendradaivatamiti ja.. 3 indrādyapāda iti kha.. , ga.. ca / haryādyapāde iti ḍa.. 4 mandākinī tatheti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / mandākinīti ceti jha.. 5 tathā loka iti kha.. :p 37 durbhikṣaṃ rājasaṅgrāmo dampatyoḥ saṃśayo bhavet
ādhāne janmanakṣatre vyādhau kleśādikaṃ bhavet / kṛttikāyānnavadinantrirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca
mṛgaśiraḥpañcarātraṃ ārdrāsu(1) prāṇanāśanaṃ / punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate
navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāntaṃ maghāsu ca / dvau māsau pūrvaphālgunyāmuttarāsu tripañcakam(2)
haste tu dṛśyate citrā ardhamāsantu pīḍanam / māsadvayantathā svātirviśākhā viṃśatirdinaṃ

udarasthena(1) pūjā ca jayaś caivātmanas tathā / kaṭideśe sthite yodhe āhave harate parān
pucchasthitena kīrtiḥ syādrāhudṛṣṭe ca bhe mṛtiḥ / punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi ravirāhubalantava
raviḥ śukro budhaś caiva somaḥ saurirgurus tathā(2) / lohitaḥ saṃhikaś caiva ete yāmārdhabhāginaḥ
sauriṃ raviñca rāhuñca kṛtvā yatnena pṛṣṭhataḥ / sa jayet sainyasaṅghātaṃ dyūtamadhvānamāhavaṃ
rohiṇī cottarāstisro mṛgaḥ pañca sthirāṇi hi / aśvinī revatī svātī dhaniṣṭhā śatatārakā
kṣiprāṇi pañcabhānyeva yātrārthī caiva(3) yojayet / anurādhāhastamūlaṃ mṛgaḥ puṣyaṃ punarvasuḥ
sarvakāryeṣu caitāni jyeṣṭhā citrā viśākhayā / purvāstisro 'gnirbharaṇī maghārdrāśleṣādāruṇāḥ
sthāvareṣu sthiraṃ hy ṛkṣaṃ yātrāyāṃ kṣipramuttamaṃ / saubhāgyārthe mṛdūnyeva ugreṣūgrantu kārayet
dāruṇe dāruṇaṃ kuryādvakṣye cādhomukhādikaṃ / kṛtrikā bharaṇyaśleṣā viśākhā pitṛnairṛtam

1 udarasthe ceti kha.. 2 kaṭideśa ity ādiḥ, saurirgurustathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti 3 yātrādhvani ceti kha.. , gha.. ca :p 56 pūrvātrayamadhovaktraṃ karma cādhomukhañcaret(1) / eṣu kūpataḍāgādi vidyākarma bhiṣakkriyā
sthāpanannaukābhūpādividhānaṃ(2) khananantathā / revatī cāśvinī citrā hastā svātī punarvasuḥ
anurādhā mṛgo jyeṣṭhā nava vai pārśvatomukhāḥ / eṣu rājyābhiṣekañca paṭṭabandhaṅgajāśvayoḥ
ārāmagṛhaprāsādaṃ prākāraṃ kṣetratoraṇaṃ / dhvajacihnapatākāś ca(3) sarvānetāṃś ca kārayet
dvādaśī sūryadagdhā tu candreṇaikadaśī tathā / bhaumena daśamī dagdhā tṛtīyā vai budhena ca
ṣaṣṭī ca guruṇā dagdhā dvitīyā bhṛguṇā tathā / saptamī sūryaputreṇa tripuṣkaramatho vade

viśākhā kṛttikā caiva uttare dve punarvasuḥ / pūrvabhādrapadā caiva ṣaḍete tu tripuṣkarāḥ
lābho hānirjayo vṛddhiḥ putrajanma tathaiva ca / naṣṭaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā tatsarvantriguṇaṃ(7) bhavet

1 cādhomukhaṃ bhavediti kha.. 2 naukādyūtādividhānamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 3 vajracihnapatākāśceti jha.. 4 tṛtīyaketi ṅa.. , ja.. ca 5 gururbhaumastatheti ka.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 6 ṣaḍetāstriṣu puṣkarā iti ka.. , kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca 7 tatsarvaṃ dviguṇamiti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 57 aśvinī bharaṇī caiva aśleṣā puṣyameva ca / khātiś caiva viśākhā ca śravaṇaṃ saptamaṃ punaḥ
etāni dṛḍhacakṣūṃṣi paśyanati ca diśo daśa / yātrāsu dūragasyāpi āgamaḥ puṇyagocare
āṣāḍhe revatī citrā kekarāṇi punarvasuḥ / eṣu pañcasu ṛkṣeṣu(1) nirgatasyāgamo bhavet
kṛttikā rohiṇī saumyaṃ phalgunī ca maghā tathā / mūlaṃ jyeṣṭhānurādhā ca dhaniṣṭhā śatatārakāḥ

hasta uttarabhādraś ca ārdrāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca / naṣṭārthāś caiva dṛśyante saṅgrāmo naiva vidyate
punarvakṣyāmi gaṇḍāntamṛkṣamadhye yathā sthitam / revatyante caturnāḍī(3) aśvinyādicatuṣṭayam
ubhayoryāmamātrantu varjayettat prayatnataḥ / aśleṣānte maghādau tu ghaṭikānāṃ catuṣṭayam
dvitīyaṃ gaṇḍamākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhairavi śṛṇu / jyeṣṭhābhamūlayormadhye ugrarūpantu yāmakam

1 jātake cāpīti kha.. 2 agniruvāceti cha.. 3 pañca ca varjayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca 4 ṣaṭ ca gaṇḍe 'tigaṇḍe ceti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / sapta gaṇḍetigaṇḍe ceti ga.. , ṅa.. ca 5 meṣādirāśibhiriti ja.. :p 59 dvitīyo maṅgalo 'thārkaḥ sauriś caiva tu saiṃhikaḥ / dravyanāśamalābhañca āhave bhaṅgamādiśet
somo budho bhṛgurjīmo dvitīyasthāḥ śubhāvahāḥ / tṛtīyastho yadā bhānuḥ śanirbhaumo bhṛgus tathā
budhaś caivendū rāhuś ca sarve te phaladā grahāḥ / budhaśukrau caturthau tu śeṣāś caiva bhayāvahāḥ
pañcamastho yadā jīvaḥ śukraḥ saumyaś ca candramāḥ / dadeta(1) cepsitaṃ lābhaṃ ṣaṣṭhe sthāne śubho raviḥ
candraḥ saurirmaṅgalaś ca grahā devi svarāśitaḥ / budhaś ca śubhadaḥ ṣaṣṭhe tyajet ṣaṣṭhaṃ guruṃbhṛguṃ
saptamo 'rkaḥ śanirbhaumo rāhurhānyai sukhāya ca / jīvo bhṛguś ca saumyaś ca jñaśukro cāṣṭamau śubhau
śeṣā grahās tathā hānyai jñabhṛgū navamau śubhau / śeṣā hānyai ca lābhāya daśamau bhṛgubhāskarau
śanirbhaumaś ca rāhuś ca candraḥ saumyaḥ śubhāvahaḥ / śubhāś caikādaśe sarve varjayeddaśame(2) gurum
budhaśukrau dvādaśasthau śeṣān dvādaśagāṃstyajet / ahorātre dvādaśa syū rāśayastān vadāmyaham
mīno meṣo 'tha mithunañcatasro nāḍayo vṛṣaḥ / ṣaṭ karkasiṃhakanyāś ca tulā pañca ca vṛścikaḥ
dhanurnakro ghaṭaś caiva sūryago rāśirādyakaḥ / 1 dadātīti kha.. 2 varjayeddaśamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 60 carasthiradviḥsvabhāvā meṣādyāḥ syuryathākramam
kulīro makaraś caiva tulāmeṣādayaś carāḥ / carakāryaṃ jayaṃ kāmamācarecca śubhaśubham
sthiro vṛṣo hariḥ kumbho vṛścikaḥ sthirakāryake / śīghraḥ samāgamo nāsti rogārto nauva mucyate
mithunaṃ kanyakā maunī dhanuś ca dviḥsvabhāvakaḥ / dviḥsvabhāvāḥ śubhāś caite sarvakāryeṣu nityaśaḥ
yātrāvāṇijyasaṅgrāme vivāhe rājadarśane / vṛddhiṃ jayantathā lābhaṃ yuddhe jayamavāpnuyāt
aśvinī viṃśatārāś ca turagasyākṛtiryathā / yadyatra kurute vṛṣṭimekarātraṃ pravarṣati
yamabhe tu yadā vṛṣṭiḥ pakṣamekantu varṣati
koṭacakram īavara uvāca koṭacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasraṃ puraṃ likhet / caturasraṃ punarmadhye tanmadhye caturasrakam
nāḍītritayacihnāḍhyaṃ meṣādyāḥ pūrvadiṅmukhāḥ / kṛttikā pūrvabhāge tu aśleṣāgneyagocare
bharaṇī dakṣiṇe deyā viśākhāṃ nairṛte nyaset / anurādhāṃ paścime ca śravaṇaṃ vāyugocare
dhanbiṣṭhāñcottare nyasya aiśānyāṃ revatīṃ tathā / vāhyanāḍyāṃ sthitānyeva aṣṭau hy ṛkṣāṇi yatnataḥ
rohiṇīpuṣyaphalguṇyaḥ svātī jyeṣṭhā krameṇa tu / abhijicchatatārā tu aśvinī madhyanāḍikā
koṭamadhye tu yā nāḍī kathayāmi prayatnataḥ / mṛgaścābhyantare pūrvaṃ tasyāgneye punarvasuḥ
uttarāphalgunī yāmye citrā nairṛtasaṃsthitā / mūlantu paścime nyasyottarāṣāḍhāntu vāyave
pūrvabhādrapadā saumye revatī īśagocare / koṭasyābhyantare nāḍī hy ṛkṣāṣṭakasamanvitā
ārdrā hastā tathāṣāḍhā catuṣkañcottarātrikam / madhye stambhacatuṣkantu dadyāt koṭasya koṭare
evaṃ durgasya vinyāsaṃ vāhye sthānaṃ diśādhipāt / āgantuko yadā yoddhā ṛkṣavān syātphalānvitaḥ
koṭamadhye grahāḥ saumyā yadā ṛkṣānvitāḥ punaḥ / jayaṃ madhyasthitānāntu bhaṅgamāgāmino viduḥ
praveśabhe praveṣṭavyaṃ nirgamabhe ca nirgamet / bhṛguḥ saumyas tathā bhauma ṛkṣāntaṃ sakalaṃ yadā
tadā bhaṅgaṃ vijānīyājjayamāgantukasya ca / praveśarkṣacatuṣke tu saṅgrāmañcārabhed yadā
tadā siddhyati taddurgaṃ na kuryāttatra vismayam //14
arghakāṇḍam īśvara uvāca arghamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi ulkāpāto 'tha bhūś calā / nirghāto grahaṇaṃ veśo diśāṃ dāho bhavedyadā
lakṣayenmāsi māsyevaṃ yadyete syuś ca caitrake / alaṅkārādi saṅgṛhya ṣaḍbhirmāsaiś caturguṇam
vaiśākhe cāṣṭame māsi ṣaḍguṇaṃ sarvasaṅgrahaṃ / jyaiṣṭhe māsi tathāṣāḍhe yavagodhūmadhānyakaiḥ
śrāvaṇe ghṛtatailādyair āśvine vastradhānyakaiḥ / kārttike dhānyakaiḥ krītair māse syānmārgaśīrṣake
puṣye kuṅkumagandhādyair lābho dhānyaiś ca māghake / gandhādyaiḥ phālgune krītair arghakāṇḍamudāhṛtam
ghātacakraṃ īśvara uvāca maṇḍalāni pravakṣyāmi caturdhā vijayāya hi / kṛttikā ca maghā puṣpaṃ pūrvā caiva tu phalgunī
viśākhā bharaṇī caiva pūrvabhādrapadā tathā / āgneyamaṇḍalaṃ bhadre tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ
yadyatra calate vāyurveṣṭanaṃ śaśisūryayoḥ / bhūmikampo 'tha nirghāto grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ
dhūmajvālā diśāṃ dāhaḥ ketoś caiva pradarśanaṃ / raktavṛṣṭiścopatāpaḥ pāṣāṇapatanantathā
netrarogo 'tisāraś ca agniś ca prabalo bhavet / svalpakṣīrās tathā gāvaḥ svalpapuṣpaphalā drumāḥ
vināśaś caiva śasyānāṃ svalpavṛṣṭiṃ vinirdiśet / cāturvarṇāḥ prapīḍyante kṣudhārtā akhilā narāḥ
saindhavā yāmunāś caiva gurjakā bhojavāhṇikāḥ / jālandharaṃ ca kāśmīraṃ saptamañcottarāpatham
deśāś caite vinaśyanti tasminnutpātadarśane / hastā citrā maghā svātī mṛgo vātha punarvasuḥ
uttarāphalgunī caiva aśvinī ca tathaiva ca / yadātra bhavate(1) kiñcidvāyavyantaṃ vinirdiśet
naṣṭadharmāḥ prajāḥ sarvā hāhābhūtā vicetasaḥ / ḍāhalaḥ kāmarūpañca kaliṅgaḥ kośalas tathā
ayodhyā ca avantī ca naśyante koṅkaṇāndhrakāḥ / aśleṣā caiva mūlantu pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca
revatī vāruṇaṃ hy ṛkṣantathā bhādrapadottarā / yadātra calate(2) kiñcidvāruṇaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet
bahukṣīraghṛtā gāvo bahupuṣpaphalā drumāḥ / ārogyaṃ tatra jāyeta bahuśasyā ca medinī
dhānyāni ca samarghāni sukhikṣaṃ pārthiva bhavet / pparasparaṃ narendrāṇāṃ saṅgrāmo dāruṇo bhavet
jyeṣṭhā ca rohiṇī caiva anurādhā ca vaiṣṇavam / dhaniṣṭhā cottarāṣāḍhā abhijit saptamantathā
yadātra śalate(3) kiñcin māhendraṃ taṃ vinirdiśet / prajāḥ samuditāstasmin sarvarogavivarjitāḥ

aurvādyāś ca saptarṣaya indraś caiva śatakratuḥ / pārāvatāḥ satuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe 'ntare

svarūpādyāḥ suragaṇāḥ śikhirindraḥ sureśvaraḥ / jyotirdhāmādayo viprā nava khyātimukhāḥ sutāḥ
raivate vitathaścendro amitābhās tathā surāḥ / hiraṇyaromādyā munayo(1) balabandhādayaḥ sutāḥ

pūrvasya ca savarṇo 'sau sāvarṇirbhavitāṣṭamaḥ / sutapādyā devagaṇā dīptimaddrauṇikādayaḥ

audgātraṃ sāmabhioś cakre brahmatvañcāpyatharvabhiḥ / prathamaṃ vyāsaśiṣyastu pailo hy ṛgvedapāragaḥ
indraḥ pramataye prādādvāskalāya ca saṃhitāṃ / baudhyādibhyo dadau sopi caturdhā nijasaṃhitāṃ

kāṇvā vājasaneyādyā yājñavalkyādibhiḥ smṛtāḥ / sāmavedataroḥ śākhā vyāsaśiṣyaḥ sajaiminiḥ
sumantuś ca sukarmā ca ekaikāṃ saṃhitāṃ tataḥ / gṛhṇate ca sukarmākhyaḥ sahasraṃ saṃhitāṃ guruḥ

daśāhācchuddhyate vipro dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ / vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śuddhyati
guṇotkarṣe daśāhāptau tryahamekāhakaṃ tryahe / ekāhāptau sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sarvatraivaṃ samūhayet
dāsāntevāsibhṛtakāḥ śiṣyāś caivātra vāsinaḥ / svāmitulyamaśaucaṃ syānmṛte pṛthak pṛthagbhavet
maraṇādeva kartavyaṃ saṃyogo yasya nāgnibhiḥ / dāhādūrdhvamaśaucaṃ syādyasya vaitāniko vidhiḥ
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāntribhāgāt sparśanambhavet / tricatuḥpañcadaśabhiḥ spṛśyavarṇāḥ krameṇa tu
caturthe pañcame caiva saptame navame tathā / asthisañcayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ
ahastvadattakanyāsu pradattāsu tryahaṃ bhavet / pakṣiṇī saṃskṛtāsveva svasrādiṣu vidhīyate
pitṛgotraṃ kumārīṇāṃ vyūḍhānāṃ bhartṛgotratā / jalapradānaṃ pitre ca udvāhe cobhayatra tu
daśāhopari pitroś ca duhiturmaraṇe tryahaṃ / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ pūrvaṃ cūḍākṛterdvija
ekāhato hy āvivihādūrdhvaṃ hastodakāt tryahaṃ / pakṣiṇī bhrātṛputrasya sapiṇḍānāṃ ca sadyataḥ
daśāhācchuddhyate vipro janmahānau svayoniṣu / ṣadbhistribhirahaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu
etajjñeyaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ vakṣye cānaurasādiṣu / anauraseṣu putreṣu bhāryāsvanyagatāsu ca
parapūrvāsu ca strīṣu trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate / vṛthāsaṅkarajātānāṃ pravrajyāsu ca tiṣṭhatāṃ
ātmanastyāgināñcaiva nivartetodakakriyā / mātraikayā dvipitarau bhratarāvanyagāminau
ekāhaḥ sūtake tatra mṛtake tu dvyaho bhavet(1) / sapiṇḍānāmaśaucaṃ hi samānodakatāṃ vade
bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite / savāsā jalamāplutya sadya eva viśuddhyati
daśāhena sapiṇḍāstu śuddhyanti pretasūtake / trirātreṇa sukulyāstu snānāt(2) śuddhyanti gotriṇaḥ
sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate / samānodakabhāvastu nivartetācaturdaśāt
janmanāmasmṛte vaitat tatparaṃ gotramucyate / vigatantu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyādyo hy anirdaśaṃ
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevāśucirbhavet / atikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavet

saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśuddhyati / 1 mṛtake tu tryaho bhavediti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / matake tu tathā bhavediti jha.. 2 snātā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 137 mātule pakṣiṇo rātriḥ śiṣyatvigbāndhaveṣu ca
mṛṭe jāmātari prete daihitre bhaginīsute(1) / śyālake tatsute caiva snānamātraṃ vidhīyate
mātāmahyāṃ tathācārye mṛte mātāmahe tryahaṃ / durbhikṣe rāṣṭrasampāte āgatāyāṃ tathāpadi
upasargamṛtānāñca dāhe brahmavidāntathā / satrivrati(2) brahmattārisaṅgrāme deśaviplave
dāne yajñe vivāhe ca sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate / vipragonṛpahantṝṇāmanuktaṃ cātmaghātināṃ
asādhyavyādhiyuktasya svādhyāye cākṣamasya ca / prāyaścittamanujñātamagnitoyapraveśanaṃ
apamānāttathā(3) krodhāt snehātparibhavādbhayāt / udbadhya mriyate nārī puruṣo vā kathañcana
ātmaghātī caikalakṣaṃ vasetsa narake śucau / vṛddhaḥ śrautasmṛterluptaḥ parityajati yastvasūn
trirātraṃ tatra śāśaucaṃ dvitīye cāsthisañcayaṃ / tṛtīye tūdakaṃ kāryaṃ caturthe śrāddhamācaret
vidyudagnihatānāñca tryahaṃ śuddhiḥ sapiṇḍike(4) / pāṣaṇḍāśritā bhartṛghnyo nāśaucodakagāḥ striyaḥ

pitṛmātrādipāte tu ārdravāsā hy upoṣitaḥ / 1 prete, bhaginīsuta ity api iti ṭa.. 2 yativratīti ja.. 3 apamānādatheti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 4 vidyudādihatānāñca tryahācchuddhirvidhīyate iti ṭa.. :p 138 atītebde prakurvīta pretakāryaṃ yathāvidhi
yaḥ kaścittu haret pretamasapiṇḍaṃ kathañcana / snātvā scelaḥ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati
yadyannamatti teṣāntu daśāhenaiva śuddhyati / anadannannamahnyeva na vai tasmin gṛhe vaset
anāthaṃ vrāhmaṇaṃ pretaṃ ye vahanti dvijātayaḥ / pade pade yajñaphalaṃ śuddhiḥ syāt snānamātrataḥ
pretībhūtaṃ dvijaḥ śūdramanugacchaṃstryahācchuciḥ / mṛtasya bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā ca paridevanaṃ
varjayettadahorātraṃ dānaśrāddhādi kāmataḥ(1) / śūdrāyāḥ prasavo gehe śūdrasya maraṇaṃ tathā
bhāṇḍāni tu parityajya tryahādbhūlepataḥ śuciḥ / na vipraṃ sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu mṛtaṃ śūdreṇa nāyayet
nayet pretaṃ snāpitañca pūjitaṃ kusumair dahet / nagnadehaṃ dahen naiva kiñciddehaṃ parityajet
gotrajastu gṛhītvā tu citāṃ cāropayettadā / āhitāgniryathānyāyaṃ dagdhavyastibhiragnibhiḥ
anāhitāgnirekena laukikenāparas tathā / asmāt tvamabhijāto 'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ
asau svargāya lokāya sukhāgniṃ pradadetsutaḥ / sakṛtprasiñcantyudakaṃ nāmagotreṇa bāndhavāḥ
1 dānaśrāddhādikarma ceti jha.. :p 139 evaṃ mātāmahācāryapretānāñcodakakriyā / kāmyodakaṃ sakhipretasvasrīyaśvaśrurartvijāṃ
apo naḥ śośucidayaṃ daśāhañca suto 'rpayet / brāhmaṇe daśapiṇḍāḥ syuḥ kṣatriye dvādaśa smṛtāḥ
vaiśye pañcadaśa proktāḥ śūdre triṃśat prakīrtitā / putro vā putrikānyo vā piṇḍaṃ dadyācca putravat
vidiśya nimbapatrāṇi niyato dvāri veśmanaḥ / ācamya cāgnimudakaṃ gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān
praviśeyuḥ samālabhya kṛtvāśmani padaṃ śanaiḥ / akṣaralavaṇānnaḥ syur nirmāṃsā bhūmiśāyinaḥ
krītalabdhāśanāḥ snātā ādikartā daśāhakṛt / abhāve brahmacārī tu kuryātpiṇḍodakādikaṃ
yathedaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate / jananepyevaṃ syānnipuṇāṃ śuddhimicchatāṃ
sarveṣāṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ mātāpitroś ca sūtakaṃ / sūtakaṃ mātureva syādupaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ
putrajanmadine śrāddhaṃ kartavyamiti niścitaṃ / tadahastatpradānārthaṃ gohiraṇyādivāsasāṃ
maraṇaṃ maraṇenaiva sūtakaṃ sūtakena tu / ubhayorapi yat pūrvaṃ tenāśaucena śuddhyati
sūtake mṛtakaṃ cetsyān mṛtake tvatha sūtakaṃ / tatrādhikṛtya mṛtakaṃ śaucaṃ kuryānna sūtakaṃ
samānaṃ laghvaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet / asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā
śāvāntaḥ śāva āyāte(1) pūrvāśaucena śuddhyati / guruṇā laghu bādhyeta laghunā naiva tadguru
mṛtake sūtake vāpi rātrimadhye 'nyadāpatet / taccheṣeṇaiva suddhyeran rātriśeṣe dvyahādhikāt
prabhāte yadyaśaucaṃ syācchuddheraṃś ca tribhirdinaiḥ / ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate
dānādi ninivarteta kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate / ajñāte pātakaṃ nādye bhokturekamaho 'nyathā(2)
asaṃskṛtādiśaucaṃ puṣkara uvāca saṃskṛtasyāsaṃskṛtasya svargo mokṣo harimmṛteḥ / asthnāṅgaṅgāmbhasi kṣepāt pretasyābhyudayo bhavet

1 āpāta iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 ananepyevamevaṃ syādityādiḥ, bhokturekamahonyathetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , jha.. , ña.. pustakatrayeṣu nāsti :p 141 gaṅgātoye narasyāsthi yāvattāvaddivi sthatiḥ / ātmanastyāgināṃ nāsti patitānāṃ tathā kriyā
teṣāmapi tathā gāṅge toye 'sthnāṃ patanaṃ hitaṃ / teṣāṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gagane tat pralīyate
anugraheṇa mahatā pretasya patitasya ca / nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastenānugrahamaśnute
akṣayaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣastatra dattaṃ na naśyati / patanātrāyate yasmāt tasmāt pātraṃ janārdanaḥ
patatāṃ bhuktimuktyādiprada eko harirdhruvaṃ / dṛṣṭvā lokān mriyamāṇān sahāyaṃ dharmamācaret
mṛto 'pi bāndhavaḥ śakto nānugantuṃ naraṃ mṛtaṃ / jāyāvarjaṃ hi sarvasya yāmyaḥ panthā vibhidyate(1)
dharma eko(2) vrajatyenaṃ yatra kvacana gāminaṃ / śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikaṃ
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaḥ vāsya na vā kṛtaṃ / kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktamanyatragatamānasaṃ
vṛkīvīraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati / na kālasya priyaḥ kaścid dveṣyaścāsya na vidyate
āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe prasahya harite janaṃ / nāprāptakālo mriyate biddhaḥ śaraśatair api
kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati / 1 panthā vibhajyate iti ga.. 2 dharma eveti ja.. :p 142 auṣadhāni(1) na mantrādyāstrāyante mṛtyunānvitaṃ
vatsavat prākṛtaṃ karma kartāraṃ vindati dhruvaṃ / avyaktādi vyaktamadhyamavyaktanidhanaṃ jagat
kaumārādi yathā dehe tathā dehāntarāgamaḥ / navamanyadyathā vastraṃ gṛhṇātyevaṃ śarīrikaṃ
dehī nityamabadhyo 'yaṃ yataḥ śokaṃ tatastyajet //15
vānaprasthāśramaḥ puṣkara uvāca vānaprasthayatīnāñca(2) dharmaṃ vakṣye 'dhunā śṛṇu / jaṭitvamagnihotritvaṃ bhūśayyājinadhāraṇaṃ
vane vāsaḥ payomūlanīvāraphalavṛttitā / pratigrahanivṛttiś ca triḥsnānaṃ brahmacāritā
devātithīnāṃ pūjā ca dharmo 'yaṃ vanavāsinaḥ / 1 auṣadhādīti ka.. 2 yatīnāntu iti ṅa.. :p 143 gṛhī hy apatyāpatyañca dṛṣṭvāraṇyaṃ(1) samāśrayet
tṛtīyamāyuṣo bhāgamekākī vā sabhāryakaḥ / grīṣme pañcatapā nityaṃ varṣāsvabhrāvikāśikaḥ
ārdravāsāś ca hemante tapaścograñcaredbalī(2) / aparāvṛttimāsthāya vrajeddiśamajihmagaḥ(3)
yatidharmaḥ puṣkara uvāca yatirdharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi jñānamokṣādidarśakaṃ / caturdhamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ prāpya saṅgāt parivarjayet(4)
yadahni virajeddhīrastadahni(5) ca parivrajet / prajāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvadevasadakṣiṇāṃ

ātmanyagnīn samāropya pravrajedbrāhmaṇo gṛhāt / 1 dṛṣṭvāvaśyamiti ṅa.. 2 tapaścograṃ vane carediti ṅa.. 3 bhajeddiśamajimhaga iti ṅa.. 4 saṅgān parityajediti ṅa.. 5 virajedvāpi tadahni iti ṅa.. :p 144 eka eva carennityaṃ grāsamannāthamāśrayet
upekṣako 'siñcayiko munirjñānasamanvitaḥ / kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlañca(1) kucelamasahāyātā
samatā caiva sarvasminnetanmuktasya(2) lakṣaṇaṃ / nābhinandena maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvanaṃ(3)
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā / dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pivet
satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret / alāvudārupatrāṇi mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yateḥ
vidhūme nyastamuṣale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane / vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiś caret
madhūkaramasaṅkliptaṃ prākpraṇītamayācitaṃ / tātkālikañcopapannaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ
pāṇipātrī bhavedvāpi pātre pātrāt samācaret / avekṣeta gatiṃ nṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavāṃ
śuddhabhāvaś caredbharmaṃ yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ / samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇaṃ
phalaṃ katakavṛkṣasya yadyapyambuprasādakaṃ / na nāmagrahaṇādeva tasya vāri prasīdati

1 vṛkṣamūlāni kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca / vṛkṣamūlādi iti ṭa.. 2 etacchuddhasyeti ṅa.. 3 jīvitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 145 ajihmaḥ paṇḍakaḥ paṅgurandho badhira eva ca / sadbhiś ca mucyate madbhirajñānāt saṃsṛto dvijaḥ
ahni rātryāñca yān jantūn hinastyajñānato yatiḥ / teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret(1)
asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanaṃ / carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhaṃ pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturaṃ / rajasvalamanityañca bhūtāvāsamimantyajet
dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo 'steyaṃ(2) śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ / hrīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇaṃ
caturvidhaṃ bhaikṣavastu kuṭīrakavahūdake / haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaś ca yo yaḥ paścāt sa uttamaḥ
ekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍī vā(3) yogī mucyate bandhanāt / ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau
yamāḥ pañcātha niyamāḥ śaucaṃ santoṣaṇantapaḥ / svādhyāyeśvarapūjā ca padmakādyāsanaṃ yateḥ(4)
prāṇāyāmastu dvividhaḥ sa garbho 'garbha eva ca / japadhyānayuto garbho viparītastvagarbhakaḥ
pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ sopi pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ / pūraṇāt pūrako vāyor niś calatvācca kumbhakaḥ

1 samācarediti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 dayāsteyamiti ṅa.. 3 tridaṇḍī ceti ṅa.. 4 padmakādyāsanaṃ mahat iti ṭa.. :p 146 recanādrecakaḥ prokto mātrābhedena ca tridhā / dvādaśāttu caturviṃśaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmātriko 'paraḥ
tālo laghvakṣaro mātrā praṇavādi carecchanaiḥ / pratyāhāro jāpakānāṃ dhyānamīśvaracintanaṃ
manodhṛtirdhāraṇā syāt samādhirbrahmaṇi sthitiḥ / ayamātmā paraṃ brahma satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ
vijñānamānandaṃ brahma tattvamasya.ahamasmi tat / param brahma jyotirātmā vāsudevo vimukta oṃ
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ / jāgratsvapnasusuptyādimuktaṃ(1) brahma turoyakaṃ
nityaśuddhabuddhayuktasatyamānandamadvayaṃ(2) / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirakṣaraṃ sarvagaṃ hariḥ
so 'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so 'sāvahamakhaṇḍa oṃ / sarvārambhaparityāgī samaduḥkhasukhaṃ kṣamī
bhāvaśuddhaś ca brahmāṇḍaṃ bhittvā brahma bhavennaraḥ / āṣaḍhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāñca cāturmāsyaṃ vratañcaret
tato jrajet navamyādau hy ṛtusandhiṣu vāpayet / prāyaścittaṃ yatīnāñca dhyānaṃ vāyuyamas tathā
dharmaśāstrakathanaṃ puṣkara uvāca manurviṣṇuryājñavalko hārīto 'triryamo 'ṅigirāḥ / vasiṣṭhadakṣasaṃvartaśātātapaparāśarāḥ
āpastambośanovyāsāḥ kātyayanabṛhaspatī / gotamaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau dharmamete yathābruvan
tathā vakṣye samāsena bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu / pravṛttañca nivṛttañca dvividhaṅkarma vaidikaṃ
kāmyaṃ karma pravṛttaṃ syānnivṛttaṃ jñānapūrvakaṃ / vedābhyāsastapo jñānamindiyāṇāñca saṃyamaḥ
ahiṃsā gurusevā ca niḥśreyasakaraṃ paraṃ / sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāmatmajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtaṃ
taccagryaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpyate hy amṛtaṃ tataḥ / sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani
samampaśyannātmayājī svārājyamadhigacchati / ātmajñāne same ca syādvedābhyāse ca yatnavān
etaddvijanmasāmarthyaṃ(1) brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ / 1 etaddvijanmasāgryamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca / etaddvijanmasāmagrīti gha. :p 148 vedaśāstrārthatattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vasan
ihaiva loke tiṣṭhan hi brahmabhūyāya kalpyate(1) / svādhyāyānāmupākarma śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇena tu
haste cauṣadhivāre ca pañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇasya vā / pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyāmaṣṭakāyāmathāpi vā
jalānte chandasāṅkuryādutsargaṃ vidhivadvahiḥ / tryahaṃ preteṣvanadhyāyaḥ śiṣyartviggurubandhuṣu
upākarmaṇi cotsargaṃ svaśākhāśrotriye tathā(2) / sandhyāgarjitanirghāte bhūkampolkānipātane
samāpya vedaṃ hy aniśamāraṇyakamadhītya ca / pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ rāhusūtake
ṛtusandhiṣu bhuktvā vā śrādvikaṃ pratigṛhya ca / paśumaṇḍūkanakulaśvāhimārjāraśūkaraiḥ(3)
kṛtentare tvahorātraṃ śakrapāte tathocchriye / śvakroṣṭugardhabholūkamāsavāṇartunisvane
amedhyaśavaśūdrāntyaśmaśānapatitāntike / aśubhāsu ca tārāsu vidyutstanitasamplave
bhutkvārdrapāṇirambhontarardharātre 'timārute / pāṃśuvarṣe diśāndāhe sandhyānīhārabhītiṣu

dhāvataḥ prāṇibādhe ca viśiṣṭe gṛhamāgate / 1 brahmacaryāya kalpyate iti ṅa.. 2 svaśākhāśrotriye mṛte iti gha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa ca 3 śaśamārjāraśūkarair iti ṅa.. :p 149 kharoṣṭrayānahastyaśvanaukāvṛkṣādirohaṇe
saptatriṃśadanadhyāyānetāṃstātkālikānviduḥ //19
śrāddhakalpakathanaṃ puṣkara uvāca śrāddhakalpaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu / nimantrya viprān pūrvedyuḥ svāgatenāparāhṇataḥ
prācyopaveśayet pīṭhe yugmāndaive 'tha pitrake / ayugmān prāṅmukhāndaive trīn paitre caikameva vā
mātāmahānāmapyevantantraṃ vā vaiśyadevikaṃ / prāṇiprakṣālanaṃ dattvā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśānapi
āvāhayedanujñāto viśve devāsa ity ṛcā / yavairanvavakīryātha(?) bhājane sapavitrake
śannodevyā payaḥ kṣiptvā yavosīti yavāṃs tathā / yādivyā itimantreṇa haste hy arghaṃ vinikṣipet
datvodakaṃ gandhamālyaṃ dhūpadānaṃ pradīpakaṃ / apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāmapradakṣiṇaṃ
dviguṇāṃstu kuśān kṛtvā hy uśantastvetyṛcā pitṝn / āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyāntu nastataḥ
yavārthāstu tilaiḥ kāryāḥ kuryādarghyādi pūrvavat / dattvārghyaṃ saṃśravān śeṣān pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karotyadhaḥ / agnau kariṣya ādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ
kuruṣveti hy anujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat / hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāttu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ
yathālābhopapanneṣu raupyeṣu tu viśeṣataḥ / datvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātramiti pātrābhimantraṇaṃ
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet / savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhuvātā iti tyacaṃ
japtvā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃste 'pi vāgyatāḥ / annamiṣṭaṃ haviṣyañca dadyājjaptvā pavitrakaṃ
annamādāya tṛptāḥ stha śeṣaṃ caivānnamasya ca / tadannaṃ vikired bhūmau dadyāccāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt
sarvamannamupādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / ucchiṣṭasannidhau piṇḍān pradadyāt pitṛyajñavat
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ / svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣayyodakameva ca
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāramudāharet / vācyatāmityanujñātaḥ svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāṃ(1)
1 mātāmahānāmityādiḥ, svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti :p 151 kuryurastu svadhetyukte bhūmau siñcettato jalaṃ / prīyantāmiti vā daivaṃ viśve devā jalaṃ dadet
dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca / śraddhā ca no māvyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no .stviti
ityuktvā tu priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet / vāje vāja iti prītapitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanaṃ(1)
yasmiṃstu saṃśravāḥ pūrvamarghapātre nipātitāḥ / pitṛpātraṃ taduttānaṃ kṛtvā viprān visarjayet
pradakṣiṇamanubrajya bhaktvā tu pitṛsevitaṃ / brahmacārī bhavettāntu rajanīṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vṛddhau nāndīmukhān pitṝn / yajeta dadhikarkandhumiśrān piṇḍān yavaiḥ kriyā
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakaṃ / āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hy apasavyavat
upatiṣṭhatāmityakṣayyasthāne pitṛvisarjane / abhiramyatāmiti vaded brūyuste 'bhiratāḥ sma ha
gandhodakatilair yuktaṃ kuryāt pātracatuṣṭayaṃ / arghārthapitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasecayet
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret / etat sapiṇḍīkaraṇamekoddiṣṭaṃ stiyā saha(2)
arvāksapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarād bhavet / 1 pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjayediti kha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca 2 stryā apīti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 152 tasyāpyannaṃ sodakumbhaṃ dadyāt saṃvatsaraṃ dvije
mṛtāhani ca kartavyaṃ pratimāsantu vatsaraṃ / pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai māsikānnavat
haviṣyānnena vai māsaṃ pāyasena tu vatsaraṃ / mātsyahāriṇakaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ(1)
aiṇarauravavārāhaśāśair māṃsair yathākramaṃ / māsavṛddhyābhitṛpyanti dattair eva(2) pitāmahāḥ
khaḍgāmiṣaṃ mahāśalkaṃ madhuyuktānnameva ca(3) / lohāmiṣaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhīnasasya ca
yaddadāti gayāsthañca sarvamānantyamucyate(4) / tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca na saṃśayaḥ
kanyāṃ prajāṃ vandinaś ca paśūn mukhyān sutānapi / ghṛtaṃ kṛṣiṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ dviśaphaikaśaphaṃ tathā
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrān svarṇarūpye sakupyake / jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā
pratipatprabhṛtiṣvetānvarjayitvā caturdaśīṃ / śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ tatra pradīyate
svargaṃ(5) hy apatyamojaś ca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā / putraśraiṣṭhyaṃ sasaubhāgyamapatyaṃ mukhyatāṃ sutān

1 mātsyāvihāriṇaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣatair iti cha.. 2 dattair iheti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca 3 madhumudgānnameva veti ṅa.. 4 sarvamānantyamaśnute iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 svarṇamiti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 153 pravṛttacakratāṃ putrān vāṇijyaṃ prasutāṃ tathā / arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṅgatiṃ
ghanaṃ vidyāṃ bhiṣakasiddhiṃ rūpyaṃ gāścāpyajāvikaṃ / aśvānāyuś ca vidhivat yaḥ śrāddhaṃ samprayacchati
kṛttikādibharaṇyante sa kāmānāpnuyādimān / vasurudrāditisutāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ

tāmrakāt sphaṭikādraktacandanāt svarṇarkādubhau / rajatādayasaḥ śīśāt grahāḥ kāryāḥ kramādime
suvarṇair vāyajellikhya gandhamaṇḍalakeṣu vā / yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca
gandhāś ca valayaś caiva dhūpo deyastu gugguluḥ / kartavyā mantrayantaś ca caravaḥ pratidaivataṃ
ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut / udbuddhyasveti ca ṛco yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ

arkaḥ pālāśaḥ khadiro hy apāmārgotha(1) pippalaḥ / udumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāś ca samidhaḥ kramāt
ekaikasyātrāṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā / hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā caiva samanvitāḥ
guḍaudanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ kṣīrayaṣṭikaṃ / dadhyodanaṃ haviḥ pūpān māṃsaṃ citrānnameva ca
dadyādgrahakramadetaddvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ / śaktito vā yathālābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakaṃ
dhenuḥ śaṅkhas tathānaḍvān hema vāso hayas tathā / 1 khadirastvapāmārgo 'theti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca :p 155 kṛṣṇā gaurāyasaśchāga etā vai dakṣiṇāḥ kramāt
yaś ca yasya yadā dūṣyaḥ(1) sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet / brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjitasya ca

1 sadā duḥstha iti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 manuṣyāṇāmiti ṅa.. 3 vyāpine deyamiti ṅa.. :p 156 pitre caiva yadā somo haṃse caiva kare sthite / tithirvaivasvato nāma sā chāyā kuñjarasya tu
agnaukaraṇaśeṣantu na dadyādvaiśvadevike / agnyabhāve tu viprasya haste dadyāttu dakṣiṇe
na strī duṣyati jāreṇa na vipro vedakarmaṇā / balātkāropabhuktā cedvairihastagatāpi vā(1)
santyajed dūṣitānnārīmṛtukāle na śuddhyati / ya ātmatryatirekeṇa dvitīyaṃ nātra paśyati(2)

adharmo dharmabuddhyā tu gṛhītastair apaṇḍitaiḥ / ātmano manasaś caiva saṃyogañca tathā pare
vṛttihīnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā kṣetrajñaṃ paramātmani / ekīkṛtya vimucyeta bandhādyogo 'yamuttamaḥ

1 caurahastagatāpi veti kha.. , gha.. , ña ca 2 dvitīyaṃ nānupaśyatīti gha.. , ṭa.. ca 3 sa jetuṃ na ca śakyata iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca 4 śeṣā ye granthavistarā iti ṅa :p 157 yannāsti sarvalokasya tadastīti virudhyate / kathyamānaṃ tathānyasya hṛdaye nāvatiṣṭhate
asaṃvedyaṃ hi tad brahma(1) kumārī strīmukhaṃ yathā / ayogī naiva jānāti jātyandho hi ghaṭaṃ yathā
satryasantaṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthānāccalati bhāskaraḥ / eṣa me maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā paraṃ brahmādhigacchati
upavāsavratañcaiva snānantīrthaṃ phalantapaḥ / dvijasampādanañcaiva sampannantasya tat phalaṃ
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ parantapaḥ / sāvitryāstu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtaḥ
pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surair bhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ / bhuñjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitā duṣyanti kenacit
asavarṇena yo garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ yonau niṣicyate / aśuddhā tu bhavennārī yāvatchalyaṃ na muñcati
niḥsṛte tu tataḥ śalye rajasā śuddhyate tataḥ / dhyānena sadṛśannāsti śodhanaṃ pāpakarmaṇāṃ
śvapākeṣvapi bhuñjāno dhyānena hi viśuddhyati / ātmā dhyātā mano dhyānaṃ dhyeyo viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ hariḥ
akṣayāya yatiḥ śrāddhe paṅktipāvanapāvanaḥ / ārūḍho naiṣṭhikandharmaṃ yastu pracyavate dvijaḥ

1 dharmaṃ vai paramāmṛtamiti kha.. , cha.. ca :p 159 varṇadharṃaḥ sa vijñyeyo yathopanayanantriṣu / yastvāśramaṃ samāśritya padārthaḥ saṃvidhīyate
ukta āśramadharmastu bhinnapiṇḍādiko yathā / ubhayena nimittena yo vidhiḥ sampravartate
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā / brahmacārī gṛhī cāpi vānaprastho yatir nṛpa
ukta āśramadharmastu dharmaḥ syāt pañcadhā paraḥ(1) / ṣāḍguṇyasyābhidhāne yo dṛṣṭārthaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ
sa tredhā mantrayāgādyadṛṣṭārtha iti mānavāḥ / ubhayārtho vyavahārastu daṇḍadhāraṇameva ca
tulyārthānāṃ vikalpaḥ syād yāgamūlaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / vede tu vihito dharmaḥ smṛtau tādṛśa eva ca
anuvādaṃ smṛtiḥ sūte(2) kāryārthamiti mānavāḥ / guṇārthaḥ parisaṅkhyārtho vānuvādo viśeṣataḥ(3)
viśeṣadṛṣṭa evāsau phalārtha iti mānavāḥ / syādaṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhiḥ saṃskārair brahmalokagaḥ
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaḥ tataḥ / jātakarma nāmakṛtirannaprāśanacūḍakaṃ
saṃskāraścopanayanaṃ vedavratacatuṣṭayaṃ / snānaṃ svadharmacāriṇyā yogaḥ syādyajñapañcakaṃ

pañca prāṇāhutīrdadyādanāmāṅguṣṭhayogataḥ //22
ayutalakṣakoṭihomāḥ agnir uvāca śrīśāntivijayādyarthaṃ grahayajñaṃ punarvade / grahayajño 'yutahomalakṣakoṭyātmakastridhā
vederaiśe hy agnikuṇḍād grahānāvāhya maṇḍale / saumye gururbudhaś caiśe śukraḥ pūrvadale śaśī
āgneye dakṣiṇe bhaumo madhye syādbhāskaras tathā / śanirāpye 'tha nairṛtye rāhuḥ ketuś ca vāyave
īśaścomā guho viṣṇurbrahmendrau yamakālakau / citraguptaścādhidevā agnirāpaḥ kṣitirhariḥ
indra aindrī devatā ca prajeśo 'hirvidhiḥ kramāt / ete pratyadhidevāś ca gaṇeśo durgayānilaḥ
khamaśvinau ca sampūjya yajedvījaiś ca vedajaiḥ / arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiro hy apāmārgaś ca pippalaḥ
udumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāś ca samidhaḥ kramāt / madhvājyadadhisaṃmiśrā hotavyāścāṣṭadhā śatam
ekāṣṭaśaturaḥ kumbhān pūrya pūrṇāhutintathā / vasordhārāntato dadyāddakṣiṇāñca tato dadet
yajamānaṃ caturbhistair abhiṣiñcet samantrakaiḥ / surāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
vāsudevo jagannāthas tathā saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / pradyumnaścāniruddhaś ca bhavantu vijayāya te
ākhaṇḍalo 'gnirbhagavān yamo vai nairṛtas tathā / varuṇaḥ pavanaś caiva dhanādhyakṣas tathā śivaḥ
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pāntu vaḥ sadā / kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ
buddhir lajjā vapuḥ śāntistuṣṭiḥ kāntiś ca mātaraḥ / etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmapatnyāḥ samāgatāḥ
ādityaś candramā bhaumo budhajīvaśitārkajāḥ / grahāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rāhuḥ ketuś ca tarpitāḥ
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ / ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ / astrāṇi sarvaśāstrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāś ca ye / saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye(1) / alaṅkṛtastato dadyāddhemagonnabhuvādikaṃ
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇi / tīrthadevamayī yasmādataḥśāntiṃ prayaccha me
puṇyastvaṃ śaṅkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāñca maṅgalaṃ / viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me
dharma tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ / aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭānamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemavījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ / anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me
pītavastrayugaṃ yasmādvāsudevasya vallabhaṃ / pradānāttasya vai viṣṇurataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me
viṣṇustvaṃ matsyarūpeṇa yasmādamṛtasambhavaḥ / candrārkavāhano nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me
