tulāpuruṣamukhyāni mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa / annadānāni mukhyāni sarvāṇyaghaharāṇi hi
tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikālake / bratādi sūryeśaśaktiśrīśāderaghaghātanaṃ(2)

gaṅgā gayā prayāgaś ca kāśyayodhyā hy avamtikā / 1 pravṛttaistu nivṛttaistu ijyate bhuktimuktida iti gha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña.. ca 2 aghanāśanamiti ga.. :p 191 kurukṣetraṃ puṣkarañca naimiṣaṃ puruṣottamaḥ
śālagrāmaprabhāsādyaṃ tīrthañcaghoghaghātakaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiriti dhyānamaghaughanut
purāṇaṃ brahma cāgneyaṃ brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ / avatārāḥ sarvapūjāḥ pratiṣṭhāpratimādikaṃ
jyotiḥśāstrapurāṇāni smṛtayastu tapovrataṃ(1) / arthaśāstrañca sargādyā āyurvedo dhanurmatiḥ
śikṣā chando vyākaraṇaṃ niruktañcābhidhānakaṃ / kalpo nyāyaś ca mīmāṃsā hy anyat sarvaṃ hariḥ prabhuḥ
eke dvayoryato yasmin yaḥ sarvamiti veda yaḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvānyasya pāpāni vinaśyanti hariś ca saḥ
vidyāṣṭādaśarūpaś ca sūkṣmaḥ sthūlo 'paro hariḥ / jyotiḥ sadakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ viṣṇuś ca nirmalaḥ
vrataparibhāṣā agnir uvāca tithivārarkṣadivasamāsartvabdārkasaṅkrame / nṛstrīvratādi(2) vakṣyāmi vasiṣṭha śṛṇu tat kramāt

1 smṛtayaḥ śrutayo vratamiti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / ahaṃ brahmetyādiḥ, tapovratamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti 2 puṃstrī vratādīti ṅa.. , ña.. ca :p 192 śāstrodito hi niyamo vrataṃ tacca tapo mataṃ / niyamāstu viśeṣāstu vratasyaiva damādayaḥ
vrataṃ hi kartṛsantāpāttapa ity abhidhīyate / indriyagrāmaniyamānniyamaścābhidhīyate
anagnayastu ye viprāsteṣāṃ śreyo 'bhidhīyate / vratopavāsaniyamair nānādānais tathā dvijaḥ
te syurdevādayaḥ(1) prītā bhuktimuktipradāyakāḥ / upāvṛttasya pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ(2) / kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrañca caṇakaṃ koradūṣakaṃ
śākaṃ madhu parānnañca(3) tyajedupavasan striyaṃ / puṣpālaṅkāravastrāṇi dhūpagandhanulepanaṃ
upavāse na śasyanti dantadhāvanamañjanaṃ / dantakāṣṭhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kṛtvā prātarvratañcaret
asakṛjjalapānācca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇāt / upavāsaḥ praduṣyeta divāsvapnācca maithunāt
kṣamā satyandayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ / devapūjāgniharaṇaṃ(4) santoṣo 'steyameva ca
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ / pavitrāṇi japeccaiva juhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ

1 taiḥ syurdevādaya iti ga.. , cha.. ca 2 sarvapāpavivarjita iti ja.. , jha.. ca / sarvataḥ parivarjita iti cha.. 3 śākaṃ dadhi parānnañceti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 devapūjāgnihavanamiti gha.. , ṭa.. ca nityasnāyī mitāhāro(1) gurudevadvijārcakaḥ / kṣāraṃ kṣaudrañca lavaṇaṃ madhu māṃsāni varjayet
tilamudgādṛte śasyaṃ śasye godhūmakodravau / cīnakaṃ devadhānyañca śamīdhānyaṃ tathaikṣavaṃ(2)
śitadhānyaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ mūlaṃ kṣāragaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / vrīhiṣaṣṭikamudgāś ca kalāyāḥ satilā yavāḥ
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā godhūmādyā vrate hitāḥ / kuṣmāṇḍālāvuvārtākūn pālaṅkīmpūtikāntyajet
carubhaikṣyaṃ śaktukaṇāḥ śākandadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ / śyāmākaśālinīvārā yavakaṃ mūlataṇḍulaṃ
haviṣyaṃ vratanaktādāvagnikāryādike hitaṃ / madhu māṃsaṃ vihāyānyad vrate vā hitamīritaṃ
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitaṃ / tryahamparañca nāśnīyāt prājāpatyañcaran dvijaḥ
ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat / tryahañcopavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ / ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ
pṛthak śāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ / saptāhena tu kṛcchro 'yaṃ mahāśāntapano 'ghahā
dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ sarvapāpahā / 1 yatāhāra iti gha.. 2 śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ceti ga.. ,jha.. ca :p 194 mahāparākastriguṇastvayameva prakīrtitaḥ
paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśagrāsyamāvāsyabhojanaḥ / ekāpāye tato vṛddhau cāndrāyaṇamato 'nyathā
kapilāgoḥ palaṃ mūtraṃ ardhāṅguṣṭhañca gomayaṃ / kṣīraṃ saptapalandadyāt dadhnaś caiva paladvayaṃ(1)
ghṛtamekapalandadyāt palamekaṃ kuśodakaṃ / gayatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi / tejo 'sīti tathā cājyaṃ devasyeti kuśodakaṃ(2)
brahmakūrco bhavatyevaṃ āpo hiṣṭhetyṛcaṃ japet / aghamarṣaṇasūktena saṃyojya praṇavena vā
pītvā sarvāghanirmukto viṣṇulokī hy upoṣitaḥ / upavāsī sāyambhojī yatiḥ ṣaṣṭhātmakālavān
māṃsavarjī cāśvamedhī satyavādī divaṃ vrajet / agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭhāñca yajñadānavratāni ca
devavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ / māṅgalyamabhiṣekañca malamāse vivarjayet
darśāddarśastu cāndraḥ syāt triṃśāhaś caiva bhāvanaḥ / māsaḥ saurastu saṅkrānternākṣatro bhavivartanāt

sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ(3) / 1 dadhnaś caiva palatrayamiti gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 2 gāyatryā ity ādiḥ, kuśodakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti 3 sāvano mata iti cha.. :p 195 āvdhike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate
āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syātpakṣastu pañcamaḥ / kuryācchrāddhantatra raviḥ kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā
māsi saṃvatsare caiva tithidvaidhaṃ yadā bhavet / tatrottarottamā jñeyā pūrvā tu syān malimlucā
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ / divā puṇyāstu tithayo rātrau naktavrate śubhāḥ
yugmāgnikṛtabhūtāni(1) ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ / rudreṇa dvādaśo yuktā caturdaśyātha(2) pūrṇimā
pratipadā tvamāvāsyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalaṃ / etadvyastaṃ mahāghoraṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtaṃ
narendramantrivratināṃ(3) vivāhopadravādiṣu / sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ kāntārāpadi saṃṣadi
ārabdhadīrghatapasāṃ na rājā vratahā striyāḥ / garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī ca rajasvalā
yadāśuddhā tadānyena kārayeta kriyāḥ sadā / krodhāt pramādāllobhādvā vratabhaṅgo bhavedyadi
dinatrayaṃ na bhuññīta muṇḍanaṃ śiraso 'tha vā / asāmarthye vratakṛtau patnīṃ vā kārayet sutaṃ
sūtake mṛtake kārtyaṃ prārabdhaṃ pūjanojjhitaṃ / vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dugdhapānādyair uddhared guruḥ

1 yugmāgniyugabhūtānīti ja.. , jha.. ca 2 caturdaśyā ceti ga.. 3 narendrasatrivratināmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca :p 196 aṣtau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ / havirbrāhmaṇakāmyā ca gurorvacanamauṣadhaṃ
kīrtisantatividyādisaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye / nairmalyabhuktimuktyarthaṃ kurve vratapate vrataṃ
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhītaṃ puratastava / nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu tvatprasādāt jagatpate
gṛhīte 'smin vratavare(1) yadyapūrṇe mriye hy ahaṃ / tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu prasanne tvayi satpatau
vratamūrtiṃ jagadbhūtiṃ maṇḍale sarvasiddhaye / āvahaye namastubhyaṃ sannidhībhava keśava
manasā kalpitair bhaktyā pañcagavyair jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ / pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayāmi tvaṃ me ca bhava pāpahā
gandhapuṣpodakair yuktamarghyamarghyapate śubhaṃ / gṛhāṇa pādyamācāmamarghyārhaṅkuru māṃ sadā
vastraṃ vastrapate puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa kuru māṃ sadā / bhūṣaṇādyaiḥ suvastrādyaiśchāditaṃ vratasatpate
sugandhigandhaṃ vimalaṃ gandhamūrte gṛhāṇa vai / pāpagandhavihīnaṃ māṃ kuru tvaṃ hi sugandhikaṃ
puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puṣpādipūrṇa māṃ kuru sarvadā / puṣpagandhaṃ suvimalaṃ āyurārogyavṛddhaye
daśāṅgaṃ guggulughṛtayuktaṃ dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa vai / sadhūpa dhūpita māṃ tvaṃ kuru dhūpitasatpate
1 vrate deva iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca :p 197 dīpamūrdhaśikhaṃ dīptaṃ gṛhāṇākhilabhāsakaṃ / dīpamūrte prakāśāḍhyaṃ sarvadordhvagatiṃ kuru
annādikañca naivedyaṃ gṛhāṇānnādi satpate / annādipūrṇaṃ kuru māmannadaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ mayā prabho / yat pūjitaṃ vratapate paripūrṇantadasu me
dharmaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ guṇasantatiṃ / kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ(1) dehi cāyuḥ svargaṃ mokṣañca dehi me /
imāṃ pūjāṃ vratapate gṛhītvā vraja sāmprataṃ / punarāgamanāyaiva varadānāya vai prabho
snātvā vratavatā sarvavrateṣu vratamūrtayaḥ / pūjyāḥ suvarṇajāstā vai śaktyā vai bhūmiśāyinā
japo homaś ca sāmānyavratānte dānameva ca / caturviṃśā dvādaśa vā pañca vā traya ekakaḥ
viprāḥ prapūjyā guravo(2) bhojyāḥ śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā / deyā gāvaḥ suvarṇādyāḥ pādukopānahau pṛthak
jalapātrañcānnapātramṛttikācchatramāsanaṃ(3) / śayyā vastrayugaṃ kumbhāḥ paribhāṣeyamīritā
pratipadvratāni agnir uvāca vakṣye pratipadādīni vratānyakhiladāni te / kārttikāśvayuje caitre pratipadbrahmaṇastithiḥ
pañcadaśyānnirāhāraḥ pratipadyarcayedajaṃ / oṃ tat sadbrahmaṇe namo gāyatryā vāvdamekakaṃ
akṣamālāśruvandakṣe(1) vāme śrucakamaṇḍalu(2) / lambakūrcañca jaṭilaṃ haimaṃ brahmāṇamarcayet
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāmiti / nirmalo bhogabhk svarge bhūmau vipro dhanī bhavet
dhanyaṃ vrataṃ pravakṣyāmi adhanyo dhanyatāṃ vrajet / mārgaśīrṣe pratipadi naktaṃ hutvā pyupoṣitaḥ(3)
agnaye nama ity agniṃ prārcyāvdaṃ sarvabhāg bhavet / pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāpte kapilāpradaḥ
vaiśvānarapadaṃ yāti śikhivratamidaṃ smṛtaṃ /
dvitīyāvratāni agnir uvāca dvitīyāvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ / puṣpāhārī dvitīyāyāmaśvinau pūjayet surau
abdaṃ svarūpasaubhāgyaṃ svargabhāg jāyate vratī / kārttike śuktipakṣasya(1) ditīyāyāṃ yamaṃ yajet
abdamupoṣitaḥ svargaṃ gacchenna narakaṃ vratī / aśūnyaśayanaṃ vakṣye avaidhavyādidāyakaṃ
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇāsya caredidaṃ / śrīvatsadhārin śrikānta śrīdhāman śrīpate 'vyaya
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadaṃ / agnayī mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ
pitaro mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ / lakṣmyā viyujyate devo na kadāśidyathā bhavān
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me vibhidyatāṃ / lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ vibho
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana / lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ yajedavdaṃ dadyācchayyāṃ phalāni ca
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya dadyādarghyaṃ samantrakaṃ / 1 śuktapakṣe tu iti ga.. :p 200 gaganāṅgaṇasandīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava
bhābhāsitādigābhoga rāmānuja namo 'stu te / oṃ śrīṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ somātmānaṃ hariṃ yajet
ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyai namo daśarūpamahātmane / ghṛtena homo naktañca śayyāṃ dadyāddvijātaye(1)
dīpānnabhājanair yuktaṃ chatropānahamāsanaṃ / sodakumbhañca pratimāṃ viprāyātha ca pātrakaṃ(2)
patnyā ya evaṃ kurute bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / kāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi kārttikasya site caret
naktabhojī dvitīyāyāṃ pūjayed balakeśavau / varṣaṃ prāpnoti vai kāntimāyurārogyakādikaṃ
atha śiṣṇuvrataṃ vakṣye manovāñchitadāyakaṃ / pauṣaśukladvitīyādi kṛtvā dinacatuṣṭayaṃ
pūrvaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ(3)smṛtaṃ / vacayā ca tṛtīye 'hni sarvauṣadhyā caturthake
murāmāṃṣī vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvarya(4) / saṭī campakamustañca sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
nāmnā kṛṣṇācyutānanta hṛṣīkeśeti pūjayet / pāde nābhyāṃ cakṣuṣi ca kramācchirasi puṣpakaiḥ
śaśicandraśaśāṅkendusañjñābhiścārghyaṃ indave / naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ

1 śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 2 viprāyātha ca pānakamiti gha.. , ña.. ca 3 śuktatilair iti ga.. 4 pūrvaṃ siddhārthakair ityādiḥ, rajanīdvayamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti :p 201 ṣaṇmāsaṃ pāvanaṃ cābdaṃ prāpnuyāt sakalaṃ vratī / etad vrataṃ nṛpaiḥ strībhiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ surādibhiḥ
tṛtīyāvratāni agnir uvāca tṛtīyāvratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te / lalitāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ mūlagaurīvrataṃ śṛṇu
tṛtīyāyāṃ caitraśukle ūḍhā gaurī hareṇa hi / tilasnāto 'rcayecchambhuṃ gauryā haimaphalādibhiḥ
namo 'stu pāṭalāyaiva pādau devyāḥ śivasya ca / śivāyeti ca saṅkīrtya jayāyai gulphayoryajet
tripuraghnāya rudrāya bhānyai jaṅghayordvayaoḥ / śivaṃ rudrāyeśvarāya(1) vijayāyaiva jānunī

īśāyeti kaṭiṃ devyāḥ(2) śaṅkarāyeti śaṅkaram / 1 śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 2 īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāś ca iti ṅa.. / īśāyeti tāto devyā iti gha.. :p 202 kukṣidvayañca koṭavyai śūlinam śūlapāṇaye
maṅgalāyai namastubhyamudarañcābhipūjayet / sarvātmane namo rudramaiśānyai ca kucadvayaṃ
śivaṃ devātmane tadvat hrādinyai(1) kaṇṭhamarcayet / mahādevāya ca śivamanantāyai karadvayaṃ
trilocanāyeti haraṃ bāhuṃ kālānalapriye(2) / saubhāgyāyai maheśāya bhūṣaṇāni prapūjayet
aśokamadhuvāsinyai īśvarāyeti cauṣṭhakau / caturmukhapriyā cāsyaṃ harāya sthāṇave namaḥ
namo 'rdhanārīśaharamamitāṅgyai ca nāsikāṃ / nama ugrāya lokeśaṃ laliteti punarbhruvau
sarvāya purahantāraṃ(3) vāsantyai caiva tālukaṃ(4) / namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāyai śitikaṇṭhāya keśakaṃ
bhīmogrāya supūpiṇyai śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ / mallikāśokakamalakundantagaramālatī(5)
kadambakaravīrañca(6) vāṇamamlānakuṅkumaṃ / sindhuvārañca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtaṃ

umāmaheśvarau pūjya saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ(7) / 1 śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 2 harañcāntakālānalapriye iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 3 purahartāramiti gha.. 4 vāsanyai ca tathālakamiti cha.. , ṭa.. ca 5 mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 6 kundañca karavīrañceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca 7 mallikāśoketyādiḥ, saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ ity antaḥ cha.. pustake nāsti :p 203 sthāpayed(1) ghṛtaniṣpāvakusumbhakṣīrajīvakaṃ
tarurājekṣulavaṇaṃ(2) kustumburumathāṣṭamaṃ / caitre śṛgodakaṃ prāśya devadevyagrataḥ svapet
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya vipradāmpatyamarcayet(3) / tadaṣṭakaṃ dvije dadyāllalitā prīyatāṃ mama(4)
śṛṅgodakaṃ(5) gomayaṃ ca mandāraṃ bilvapatrakaṃ / kuśodakaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ kārttike pṛṣadājyakam
gomūtrājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kramāśanaṃ / lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śivā
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī / caitrādau dānakāle ca prīyatāmiti vācayet
phalamekaṃ pavitrājyaṃ(6) vratānte śayānaṃ dadet / umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhañca gavā saha
guruñca mithunānyarcya(7) vastrādyair bhuktimuktibhāk(8) / saubhāgyārogyarūpāyuḥ saubhāgyaśayanavratān

nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe kuryānmārgaśirasyatha(9) / 1 arpayediti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 tṛṇarājekṣulavaṇamiti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca 3 dvijadāmpatyamarcayediti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca 4 lalitā prīyatāmiti ṭa.. 5 pṛṣṭhodakamiti ña.. / kūpodakamiti ja.. , jha.. ca 6 parityājyamiti ka.. , ja.. , ṭha.. ca / parityajyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / parigrāhyamiti ṅa.. 7 guruṃ mithunamabharcyeti ṅa.. 8 vastrādyaiḥ sarvamāpnuyāditi kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 9 kuryādvā mārgaśīrṣake iti ṅa.. , ña.. ca :p 204 śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyām lalitāyai namo yajet
pratipakṣaṃ tataḥ prārcya vratānte(1) mityunāni ca / caturviṃśatimabhyarcya vastrādyair bhuktimuktibhāk
ukto mārgo dvitīyo 'yaṃ saubhāgyavratamāvade / phālguṇāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet
samāpte śayanandadyādgṛhaścopaskarānvitaṃ / sampūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti(2)
saubhāgyārthaṃ tṛtīyoktā gaurīlokādidāyinī / māghe bhādre ca vaiśākhe tṛtīyāvratakṛttathā
damanakatṛtīyākṛt caitre damanakair yajet / ātmatṛtīyā mārgasya prārcyecchābhojanādinā
gaurī kālī umā bhadrā durgā kāntiḥ sarasvatī / vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ prakṛtiḥ śivā nārāyaṇī kramāt(3)
mārgatṛtīyāmārabhya saubhāgyaṃ svargamāpnuyāt
caturthīvratāni agnir uvāca caturthī vratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te(1) / māghe śuklacaturthyāntu upavāsī yajed guṇaṃ
pañcamyāñca tilānnādī varṣānnirvighnataḥ(2) sukhī / gaṃ svāhā(3) mūlamantro 'yaṃ gāmādyaṃ hṛdayādikaṃ
āgaccholkāya cāvāhya gaccholkāya visarjanaṃ / ulkāntair gādigandhādyaiḥ pūjayenmodakādibhiḥ
oṃ maholkāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya(4) dhīmahi tanno dantī pracīdayāt māsi bhādrapade cāpi caturthīkṛcchivaṃ vrajet / caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā vrajet
caturthyāṃ phālgune naktamavighnākhyā caturthyapi / caturthyāṃ damanaiḥ pūjya caitre prārcya gaṇaṃ sukhī
pañcamīvratāni agnir uvāca pañcamīvratakaṃ vakṣye ārogyasvargamokṣadaṃ(1) / nabhonabhasyāśvine ca kārttike śuklapakṣake
vāsukistakṣakaḥ pūjyaḥ kālīyo maṇibhadrakaḥ / airāvato dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ karkoṭakadhanañjayau
ete prayacchantyabhayamāyurvidyāyaśaḥ śriyaṃ //3
ṣaṣṭhīvratāni agnir uvāca ṣaṣṭhīvratāni vakṣyāmi kārttikādau samācaret(2) / ṣaṣṭyāṃ phalāśano(3) 'rghyādyair bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt

1 ārogyamukhamokṣadamiti ṅa.. 2 airāvata ity ādiḥ, kārttakādau samācaredityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti 3 ṣaṣṭyāṃ malāśano 'rghyādyair iti ṭa.. :p 207 skandaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ proktaṃ bhādre ṣaṣṭyāmathākṣayaṃ / kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ vakṣye mārgaśīrṣe carecca tat(1)
anāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
saptamīvratāni agnir uvāca saptamīvratakaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ(2) / māghamāse 'bjake śukle sūryaṃ prārcya viśokabhāk
sarvāvāptistu saptabhyāṃ māsi bhādre 'rkapūjanāt / pauṣe māsi site 'naśnan prārcyārkaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāvāptistu saptamī / phālgune tu site nandā saptamī cārkapūjanāt
mārgaśīrṣe site prārcya saptamī cāparājitā / mārgaśīrṣe site cāvdaṃ putrīyā saptamī striyāḥ
aṣṭamīvratāni agnir uvāca vakṣye vratāni cāṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ prathamaṃ vrataṃ / māsi bhādrapade 'ṣṭabhyāṃ rohiṇyāmardharātrake
kṛṣṇo jāto yatastasyāṃ jayantī syāttato 'ṣṭamī / saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt mucyate copavāsataḥ
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhādrapade aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīyute / upāṣitorcayet kṛṣṇaṃ(1) bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ
āvāhayāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ balabhadrañca devakīṃ / vasudevaṃ yaśodāṅgāḥ(2) pūjayāmi namo 'stu te
yogāya yogapataye yogeśāya namo namaḥ / yogādisambhāvayaiva govindāya namo namaḥ
snānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadyāttu arghyaṃ cānena dāpayet / yajñāya yajñeśvarāya yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ
yajñādisaṃbhavāyaiva govindāya namo namaḥ / gṛhāṇa deva puṣpāṇi sugandhīni priyāṇi te
sarvakāmaprado deva bhava me devavandita / dhūpadhūpita dhūpaṃ tvaṃ dhūpitaistvaṃ gṛhāṇa me
sugandha dhūpagandhāḍhyaṃ kuru māṃ sarvadā hare / 1 viṣṇumiti ṭa.. 2 yaśodāñceti ṅa.. , ja.. ca :p 209 dīpadīpta mahādīpaṃ dīpadīptada sarvadā(1)
mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kuru cordhvagatiṃ ca māṃ / viśvāya viśvapataye viśveśāya namo namaḥ(2)
viśvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya niveditaṃ / dharmāya dharmapataye darmeśāya namo namaḥ
dharmādisambhavāyaiva govindaśayanaṃ kuru / sarvāya sarvapataye sarveśāya namao namaḥ
sarvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya ca pāvanaṃ(3) / kṣīrodārṇavasambhūta atrinetrasamudbhava
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṅkedaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama / sthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ yajet
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandakaṃ balaṃ / ardharātre parodhārāḥ pātayed guḍasarpiṣā
vastrahemādikaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇān bhojayedvratī / janmāṣṭamīvratakaraḥ putravānviṣṇulokabhāk(4)
varṣe varṣe tu yaḥ kuryāt putrārthī vetti no bhayaṃ(5) / putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi āyurārogyasantatiṃ
dharmaṃ kāmaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me /
aṣṭamīvratāni agnir uvāca brahmādimātṛyajanājjapen mātṛgaṇāṣṭamīṃ / kṛṣṇāṣṭābhyāṃ caitramāse pūjyābdaṃkṛṣṇamarthabhāk
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ vakṣye māse mārgaśire caret / naktaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā gomūtraṃ prāśayenniśi
bhūmiśāyī niśāyāñca śaṅkaraṃ pujayed vratī / pauṣe śambhuṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya māghe kṣīraṃmaheśvaram(1)
mahādevaṃ phālgune ca tilāśī(2) samupoṣitaḥ / caitre sthāṇuṃ yavāśī ca vaiśākhe 'tha śivaṃ yajet
kuśodaśī paśupatiṃ jyaiṣṭhe śṛṅgodakāśanaḥ / āṣāḍhe gomayāśyugraṃ śrāvaṇe sarvamarkabhuk
tryambakaṃ ca bhādrapade bilvapatrāśano niśi / taṇḍulāśī cāśvayuje īśaṃ rudantu kārttike
dadhyāśī homakārī syādvarṣānte maṇḍale yajet(3) / govastrahema gurave dadyādviprebhya īdṛśaṃ

prārthayitvā dvijān bhojya(4) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / 1 māghe kṣīrī maheśvaramiti gha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca 2 tilādīti ja.. 3 varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale iti ña.. 4 dvijān toṣya iti ja.. :p 211 naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ
paurandaraṃ padaṃ yāti svargativratamucyate(1) / aṣṭamī budhavāreṇa pakṣayorubhayoryadā
tadā vrataṃ prakurvīta athavā saguḍāśitā / tasyāṃ niyamakartāro na syuḥ khaṇḍitasampadaḥ
taṇḍulasyāṣṭamuṣṭīnāṃ varjayitvāṅgulīdvayaṃ / bhaktaṃ kṛtvā cāmrapuṭe sakuśe sakulāmbikāṃ
sāttvikaṃ pūjayitvāṅgaṃ bhuñjīta ca kathāśravāt / śaktito dakṣiṇāndadyāt karkaṭīntaṇḍulānvitāṃ(2)
dhīro dvijo 'sya(3) bhāryāsti rambhā putrastu kaiśikaḥ / duhitā vijayā tasya dhīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ(4)
kauśikastaṃ gṛhītvā tu gopālaiścārayan vṛṣaṃ / gaṅgāyāṃ snānakṛtye 'tha(5) nītaś caurair vṛṣastadā
snātvā vṛṣamapaśyan sa vṛṣaṃ mārgitumāgataḥ / vijayābhaginīyukto dadarśa sa sarovare
divyastrīyoṣitāṃ vṛndamavravīddehi bhojanaṃ / strīvṛndamūce vratakṛd bhuṅkṣva tvamatithiryataḥ

vrataṃ kṛtvā sa bubhuje prāptavān vanapālakaṃ / 1 sugativratamucyate iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /suśāntivratamucyate iti ja.. 2 karkarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca /gargarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti jha.. 3 vīro dvijo 'syeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 4 vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣa iti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca / vīrasya dhanado vṛṣa iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 5 snānakṛtyeṣu iti ṭa.. :p 212 gato dhīraḥ(1) savṛṣabho vijayāsahitastadā
dhīreṇa(2) vijayā dattā yamāyāntaritaḥ pitā / vratabhāvāt kauśiko 'pi hy ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo 'bhavat
pitrostu narake dṛṣṭvā vijayārtiṃ yame gatā / mṛgayāmāgataṃ proce mucyate narakāt kathaṃ
vratadvayādyamaḥ proce prāpya tat kaiśiko dadau / budhāṣṭamīdvayaphalaṃ svargatau pitarau tataḥ(3)
vijayā harṣitā cakre vrataṃ bhuktyādisiddhaye / aśokakalikāścāṣtau ye pivanti punarvasau
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ / tvāmaśokaharābhīṣṭa madhumāsasamuḍgava
pivāmi śokasantapto māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru / caitrādau mātṛpūjākṛdaṣṭamyāṃ jayate ripūn
navamīvratāni || agnir uvāca navamīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktyādisiddhidaṃ / devī pūjyāśvine śukle gauryākhyānavamīvrataṃ
1 gato vīra iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 2 vīreṇeti ṭa.. 3 pitarau tadeti kha.. :p 213 piṣṭakākhyā tu navamī piṣṭāśī devapūjanāt / aṣṭamyāmāśvine śukte kanyārkamūlabhe yadā
aghārdanā sarvadā vai mahatī navamī smṛtā / durgā tu navagehasthā ekāgārasthitāthavā
pūjitāṣṭādaśabhujā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśamatkarāḥ(1) / śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāḥ syurañjanaṃ ḍamaruntathā
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā saṇḍanāyikā / caṇḍā caṇḍavatī pūjyā caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā
kramānmadhye cogracaṇḍā durgā mahiṣamardinī(2) / oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā daśākṣāro mantraḥ
dīrghākārādimantrādir navanetro namo 'ntikaḥ / ṣaḍbhiḥ padair namaḥsvadhāvaṣaṭkārahṛdādikaṃ
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyāṅgāni japecchivāṃ(3) / etañjapati(4) yo guhyaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate
kapālaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ darpaṇantarjanīndhanuḥ / dhvajaṇḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ vāmahasteṣu vibhratīṃ
śaktimudgaraśūlāni vajraṃ khaḍgañca kuntakaṃ / śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ śalākāṃ ca āyudhāni ca pūjayet
paśuñca kālī kālīti japtvā khaḍgena ghātayet / kāli kāli vajreśvari lauhadaṇḍāyai namaḥ

1 ṣoḍaśahastakā iti ṅa.. 2 kramāt madhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṭtvā mahiṣamardinīmiti ga.. 3 dīrghākārādītyādiḥ, japecchivāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. pustake nāsti 4 evaṃ japatīti ja.. , jha.. ca :p 214 tadutthaṃ rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ pūtanāyai ca nairṛte / vāyavyāṃ pāparākṣasyai carakyai nama īśvare
vidārikāyai cāgneyyāṃ mahākauśikamagnaye(1) / tasyāgrato nṛpaḥ snāyācchatruṃ piṣṭamayaṃ haret(2)
dadyāt skandaviśākhābhyāṃ brāhmādyā niśi tā yajet / jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namo 'stu te / devīṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpya pūjayeccārhaṇādinā
dhvajādirathayātrādibalidānaṃ varādikṛt /
daśamīvrataṃ agnir uvāca daśamīvratakaṃ vakṣye dharmakāmādidāyakaṃ / daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāpte daśadhenudaḥ
diśaś ca kāñcanīrdadyādbrāhmaṇādhipatirbhavet /
ekādaśīvrataṃ agnir uvāca ekādaśīvrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyākaṃ / daśamyānniyatāhāro māṃsamaithunavarjitaḥ(1)
ekadaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi / dvādaśyekādaśī yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ
tatra(2) kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe / ekādaśī kalā yatra parato dvādaśo gatā(3)
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇe / daśamyekādaśīmiśrā nopoṣyā narakapradā
ekādaśyānnirāhāro bhuktvā caivāpare 'hani / bhokṣye 'haṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣantu yadā bhavet / sopoṣpākṣayyaphaladā proktā sā pāpanāśinī
ekādaśī dvādaśī yā śravaṇena ca saṃyutā / vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā

eṣaiva phālgune māsi puṣyarkṣeṇa ca saṃyutā / 1 madhumāṃsair vivarjita iti ga.. 2 atreti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 3 dvādaśī mateti gha.. , ña.. ca / dvādaśī bhavediti ṅa.. , jha.. ca :p 216 vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā(1)
ekādaśyāṃ viṣṇupūjā(2) kāryā sarvopakāriṇī(3) / dhanavān putravān loke viṣṇuloke mahīyate
dvādaśīvratāni agnir uvāca dvādaśīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / ekabhaktena bhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca
upavāsena bhaikṣyeṇa caivaṃ dvādaśikavratī / caitre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ madanaṃ hariṃ
pūjayedbhuktimuktyarthī(4) madanadvādaśaīvratī / māghaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ bhīmadvādaśikavratī
namo nārāyaṇāyeti yajedviṣṇuṃ sa sarvabhāk / phālgune ca site pakṣe govindadvādaśīvratī
viśokadvādaśīkārī yajedāśvayuje hariṃ / lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu kṛṣṇamabhyarcya yo naraḥ

dadāti śukladvādaśyāṃ sa sarvarasadāyakaḥ / 1 kīṭikoṭiguṇottameti kha.. 2 ekādaśyāmṛṣiṃ pūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / ekadaśyāmṛṣipūjeti ṅa.. 3 kāryā sarvāghahāriṇīti jha.. , ña.. ca 4 bhuktimuktyarthamiti cha.. , ña.. ca :p 217 govatsaṃ pūjayed bhādre govatsadvādaśīvratī
mādhyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā / dvādaśī yā bhavet kṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī
tilaiḥ snānantilair homo naivedyantilamodakaṃ / dīpaś ca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakaṃ
tilāś ca deyā viprebhyaḥ phalaṃ homopavāsataḥ / oṃ namo bhagavate 'tho vāsudevāya vai yajet
sukalaḥ svargamāpnoti ṣaṭtiladvādaśīvratī / manorathadvādaśīkṛt phālgune tu site 'rcayet
nāmadvādaśīvratakṛt keśavādyaiś ca nāmabhiḥ / varṣaṃ yajeddhariṃ svargī na bhaven nārakī naraḥ
phālgunasya site 'bhyarcya sumatidvādaśīvratī / māsi bhādrapade śukte anantadvādaśīvratī(1)
aśleṣarkṣe tu mūle vā(2) māghe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ / yajettilāṃś ca juhuyāttiladvādaśīkṛnnaraḥ
sugatidvādaśīkārī phālgune tu site yajet / jaya kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ varṣaṃ syād bhuktimuktigaḥ(3)
pauṣaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ samprāptidvādaśīvratī /
śravaṇadvādaśīvratam agnir uvāca śravaṇādaśīṃ vakṣye māsi bhādrapade site / śravaṇena yutā śreṣṭhā(1) mahatī sā hy upoṣitā
saṅgame saritāṃ snānācchravaṇadvādaśophalaṃ(2) / budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dānādau sumahāphalā
niṣiddhamapi kartavyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ / dvādṛśyāñca nirāhāro vāmanaṃ pūjayāmyahaṃ
udakumbhe svarṇamayantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ / āvāhayāmyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇaṃ
sitavastrayugacchanne ghaṭe sacchatrapāduke / snāpayāmi jalaiḥ śuddhair viṣṇuṃ(3) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ
chatradaṇḍadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ / arghyaṃ dadāmi deveśa arghyārhādyaiḥ sadārcitaḥ(4)
bhuktimuktiprajākīrtisarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kuru / vāmanāya namo gandhaṃ homo 'nenāṣṭakaṃ śataṃ

1 śravaṇena samāyukteti gha.. 2 dvādaśadvādaśīphalamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. ca 3 śuddhair harimiti ga.. , ṭa.. ca 4 mudārcita iti ga.. :p 219 oṃ namo vāsudevāya śiraḥ sampūjayeddhareḥ / śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvat kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ śrīpataye vakṣo bhujo sarvāstradhāriṇe / vyāpakāya namo nābhiṃ vāmanāya namaḥ kaṭiṃ
trailokyajayakāyeti(1) meḍhraṃ jaṅghe yajeddhareḥ / sarvādhipataye pādau viṣṇoḥ sarvātmane namaḥ
ghṛtapakvañca naivedyandadyād dadhyodanair ghaṭān / rātrau ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā ca saṅgame
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya vadet puṣpāñjalistvidaṃ / namo namaste govinda budhaśravaṇasañjñita
aghaughasaṅkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava / prīyatāndeva deveśa mama nityañjanārdana
vāmano buddhido dātā dravyastho vāmanaḥ svayaṃ / vāmanaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vāmano me dadāti ca
dravyastho vāmano nityaṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ / pradattadakṣiṇo viprān sambhojyānnaṃ svayañcaret
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ agnir uvāca akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye vratasampūrṇatākṛtaṃ / mārgaśīrṣe site viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ
pañcagavyajale snāto yajettatprāśano vratī / yavavrīhiyutampātrandvādaśyāṃ hi dvije 'rpayet
saptajanmani yat kiñcinmayā khaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ / bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṇḍamihāstu me
yathākhaṇḍaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama / tathākhilānyakhaṇḍāni vratāni mama santu vai
evamevānumāsañca cāturmāsyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ / anyaccaitrādimāseṣu śaktupātrāṇi(1) cārpayet
śrāvaṇādiṣu cārabhya kārttikānteṣu pāraṇaṃ / saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ vratānāṃ saphalaṃ kṛte
āyurārogyasaubhāgyarājyabhogādimāpnuyāt(2) /
trayodaśīvratāni agnir uvāca trayodaśīvratānīha sarvadāni vadāmi te / anaṅgena kṛtāmādau vakṣye 'naṅgatrayodaśīṃ
trayodaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe śukle 'naṅgaṃ haraṃ yajet(1) / madha samprāśayedrātrau ghṛtahomastilākṣataiḥ
pauṣe yogeśvaraṃ prārcya candanāśī kṛtāhutiḥ / maheśvaraṃ mauktikāśī māghe 'bhyarcya divaṃ vrajet
kākolaṃ prāśya nīraṃ tu(2) phālgune pūjayedvratī / karpūrāśī svarūpaṃ ca caitre saubhāgyavān bhavet
mahārūpantu vaiśākhe yajejjātīphalāśyapi / lavaṅgāśī jyaiṣṭhadine(3) pradyumnaṃ pūjayed vratī
tilodāśī tathāṣāḍhe umābhartāramarcayet / śrāvaṇe gandhatoyāśī pūjayecchūlapāṇinaṃ
sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade prāśitā gurumarcayet / suvarṇavāri saṃprāśya āśvine tridaśādhipam

1 bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /bhuktimuktisukhapradamiti ṅa.. 2 bhogabalāyuṣmāniti ṅa.. :p 223 dvādaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ phalāhāro yajet suraṃ(1) / tyaktvā phalāni dadyāttu kurvan phalacaturdaśīṃ
caturdaśyāṃ mathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayoḥśuklakṛṣṇayoḥ / anaśnan pūjayecchambhuṃ svargyubhayacaturdaśīṃ
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāntu naktena tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīṃ / iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ
kārtike ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ snānakṛt sukhī / ārādhite mahendre tu dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu(2)
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddhariṃ / kṛtvādarbhamayaṃ caiva vāridhānī samanvitaṃ
śāliprasthasya piṣṭasya pūpanāmnaḥ kṛtasya ca / ardhaṃ viprāya dātavyamardhamātmani yojayet(3)
kartavyaṃ saritāṃ cānte kathāṃ kṛtvā(4) hareriti / anantasaṃsāramahāsamudre magnān samabhyuddhara vāsudeva
anantarūpe viniyojayasva anantarūpāya namo namaste / anena pūjayitvātha sūtraṃ baddhā tu mantritaṃ
svake kare vā kaṇṭhe vā tvanantavratakṛt sukhī //11
śivarātrivratam agnir uvāca śivarātrivrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu(1) / māghaphālgunayormadhye kṛṣṇā yā tu caturdaśī
kāmayuktā tu sopoṣyā kurvan jāgaraṇaṃ vratī / śivarātrivrataṃ kurve caturdaśyāmabhojanaṃ
rātrijāgaraṇenaiva pūjayāmi śivaṃ vratī / āvāhayāmyahaṃ śambhuṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ
narakārṇavakottāranāvaṃ śiva namo 'stu te / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya prajārājyādidāyine
saubhāgyārogyavidyārthasvargamārgapradāyine(2) / dharmandehi dhanandehi kāmabhogādi dehi me
guṇakīrtisukhaṃ dehi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me / lubdhakaḥ prāptavān puṇyaṃ pāpī sundarasenakaḥ
aśokapūeṇimādivrataṃ agnir uvāca aśokapūrṇimāṃ vakṣye bhūdharaṃ ca bhuvaṃ yajet / phālgunyāṃ sitapakṣāyāṃ varṣaṃ syādbhuktimuktibhāk
kārttikyāntu vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret / śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti vṛṣavratamidaṃ paraṃ
pitryā yāmāvasī tasyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣyaṃ / upoṣyābdaṃ pitṝniṣṭvā niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt
pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya pūjyājaṃ sarvamāpnuyāt / vakṣye sāvitryamāvāsyāmbhuktimuktikarīṃ śubhāṃ
pañcadaśyāṃ vratī jyaiṣṭhe vaṭamūle mahāsatīṃ / trirātropoṣitā nārī saptadhānyaiḥ prapūjayet
prarūḍhaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtraiś ca rajanyāṃ kuṅkumādibhiḥ / vaṭāvalambanaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītaiḥ prabhātake
namaḥ sāvitryai satyavate naivedyaṃ cārpayed dvije / veśma gatvā dvijān bhojya svayaṃ bhuktvā visarjayet
sāvitrī prīyatāṃ devī saubhāgyādikamāpnuyāt
vāravratāni agnir uvāca vāravratāni vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāni hi / karaṃ punarvasuḥ sūrye snāne sarvauṣadhī śubhā
śrādhhau cādityavāre tu saptajanmasvarogabhāk / saṅkrāntau sūryavāro yaḥ so 'rkasya hṛdayaḥ śubhaḥ
kṛtvā haste sūryavāraṃ naktenābdaṃ sa sarvabhāk / citrābhasomavārāṇi sapta kṛtvā sukhī bhavet
svātyāṃ gṛhītvā cāṅgāraṃ saptanaktyārtivarjitaḥ / viśākhāyāṃ budhaṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut
anurādhe devaguruṃ saptanaktī grahārtinut(1) / śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṅgṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut
mūle śanaiś caraṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut
nakṣatravratāni agnir uvāca nakṣatravratakaṃ vakṣye bhe hariḥ pūjito 'rthadaḥ(1) / nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ cādau caitramāse hariṃ yajet
mūle pādau yajejjaṅghe rohiṇīsvarcayeddhariṃ / jānunī cāśvinīyoge āṣāḍhāsūrusañjñake
meḍhraṃ pūrvottarāsveva kaṭiṃ vai kṛttikāsu ca / pārśve bhādrapadābhyāntu kukṣiṃ vai revatīṣu ca
stanau caivānurādhāsu dhaniṣṭhāsu ca pṛṣṭhakaṃ / bhujau pūjyau viśākhāsu punarvasvaṅgulīryajet
aśleṣāsu nakhān pūjya kaṇṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāsu pūjayet / śrotre viṣṇoś ca śravaṇe mukhaṃ puṣye hareryajet
yajet svātiṣu dantāgramāsyaṃ vāruṇato 'rcayet / maghāsu nasāṃ nayane mṛgaśīrṣe lalāṭakaṃ
citrāsu cārdrāsu kacānabdānte svarṇakaṃ hariṃ / guḍapūrṇe ghaṭe 'bhyarcya śayyāgorthādi dakṣiṇā(2)

kārttike kṛttikāyāṃ ca mṛgaśīrṣe mṛgāsyake / nāmabhiḥ keśavādyaistu acyutāya namo 'pi vā
kārttike kṛttikābhe 'hni māsanakṣatragaṃ hariṃ / śāmbhavāyanīyavratakaṃ kariṣye bhuktimuktidaṃ
keśavādi mahāmūrtimacyutaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ(1) / āvāhayāmyahandevamāyurārogyavṛddhidaṃ
kārttikādau sakāsāramannaṃ(2) māsacatuṣṭayaṃ(3) / phālgunādau ca kuśaramāṣāḍhādau ca pāyasaṃ

arvāgvisarjanād dravyaṃ naivedyaṃ sarvamucyate / visarjite jagannāthe nirmālyanbhavati kṣaṇāt
namo namaste 'cyuta me kṣayostu pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyaṃ / aiśvaryavittādi sadākṣayaṃ me(5) kṣayañca mā santatirabhyapaitu

yathācyutastvamparataḥ parastāt sa brahmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātman / 1 sarvapāpahamiti ṅa.. 2 sarvasāramannamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca 3 māsacatuṣṭakamiti kha.. 4 naktaṃ naivedyamarpayediti jha.. 5 aiśvaryavittādi mahodayaṃ me iti jha.. :p 229 tathācyutaṃ tvaṃ kuru vāñchitaṃ me mayā kṛtampāpaharāprameya
acyutānanda govinda prasīda yadabhīpsitaṃ / akṣayaṃ māmameyātman kuruṣva puruṣottama
sapta varṣāṇi sampūjya bhuktimuktimavāpunuyāt / anantavratamākhyāsye nakṣatravratakerthadaṃ(1)
mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśire gomūtrāśo yajeddhariṃ / anantaṃ sarvakāmānāmananto bhagavān phalaṃ
dadātyanantañca punastadevānyatra janmani / anantapunyopacayaṅkarotyetanmahāvrataṃ
yathābhilaṣitaprāptiṃ karotyakṣayameva ca / pādādi pūjya nakte tu bhuñjīyāttailavarjitaṃ
ghṛtenānantamuddiśya homo māsacatuṣṭayaṃ / caitrādau śālinā homaḥ payasā śrāvaṇādiṣu
māndhātābhūd yuvanāśvādanantavratakāt sutaḥ
divasavratāni agnir uvāca divasavratakaṃ vakṣye hy ādau dhenuvrataṃ vade / yaścobhayamukhīndadyāt prabhūtakanakānvitāṃ
dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhet sa yāti parasampadaṃ / tryahaṃ payovrataṃ kṛtvā kāñcanaṃ kalpapādapaṃ
datvā brahmapadaṃ yāti kalpavṛkṣapradaṃ smṛtaṃ / dadyādviṃśat palādūrdhvaṃ(1) mahīṅkṛtvā tu kāñcanīṃ
dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhedrudragaḥ syāddivāvratī / pakṣe pakṣe trirātrantu bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣapet(2)
vipulaṃ dhanamāpnoti trirātravratakṛddinaṃ / māse māse trirātrāśī ekabhaktī gaṇeśatāṃ
yastrirātravrataṃ(3) kuryāt samuhiśya janārdanaṃ / kulānāṃ śatamādāya sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ
navamyāñca site pakṣe naro mārgaśirasyatha(4) / prārabheta trirātrāṇāṃ vratantu vidhivad vratī

1 dadyāt triṃśatpalādūrdhvamiti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca 2 kṣipediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca 3 yastrirātraśataṃ kuryāditi ga.. , gha.. , ña.. 4 mārgaśirasya ceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca :p 231 oṃ namo vāsudevāya sahasraṃ vā śataṃ japet / aṣṭamyāmekabhaktāśī dinatrayamupāvaset
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ kārttike kārayed vrataṃ / viprān sambhojya vastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca
chatropavītapātrāṇi dadet samprārthayeddvijān / vrato 'smin duṣkare cāpi vikalaṃ yadabhūnmama
bhavadbhistadanujñātaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhavatviti / bhuktabhogo vrajed viṣṇuṃ trirātravratakatratī(1)
kārttikavratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / daśamyāṃ pañcagavyāśo ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ
kārttikasya site 'bhyarcya(2) viṣṇuṃ devavimānagaḥ / caitre trirātraṃ naktāśī ajāpañcapradaḥ sukhī
trirātraṃ payasaḥ pānamupavāsaparastryahaṃ / ṣaṣṭhyādi kārttike śukre kṛcchro māhendra ucyate
pañcarātraṃ payaḥ pītvā dadhyāhāro hy upoṣitaḥ / ekādaśyāṃ kārttike tu kṛcchro 'yaṃ bhāskarorthadaḥ(3)
yavāgūṃ yāvakaṃ śākaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ / pañcamyādi site pakṣe kṛcchraḥ śāntapanaḥ smṛtaḥ
māsavratāni agnir uvāca māsavratakamākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / āṣāḍhādicaturmāsamabhyaṅgaṃ varjayet sudhīḥ

cāturmāsyavratānāntu kurvīta parikalpanaṃ / āṣāḍhyāñcātha saṅkrāntau karkaṭasya(4) hariṃ yajet

idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratastava / 1 māse yavāśo ceti kha.. 2 bhīmavrataparo haririti ṅa.. 3 dvādaśīvratakaṃ paramiti ṅa.. 4 āṣāḍhagaṃ vṛṣasaṅkrāntyāṃ karkaṭe ceti jha.. :p 233 nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu prasanne tvayi keśava
gṛhīte 'smin vrate deva yadyapūrṇe mriye hy ahaṃ / tanme bhavatu sampūrṇaṃ tvatprasādājjanārdana
māṃsādi tyaktvā(1) vipraḥ syāttailatyāgī hariṃ yajet / ekāntaropavāsī ca trirātraṃ viṣṇulokabhāk
cāndrāyaṇī viṣṇulokī maunī syān muktibhājanaṃ / prājāpatyavratī svargī śaktuyāvakabhakṣakaḥ
gugdhādyāhāravān svargī pañcagavyāmbubhktathā / śākamūlaphalāhārī naro viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet(2)
māṃsavarjī yavāhāro rasavarjī hariṃ vrajet / kaumudavratamākhyāsye āśvine samupoṣitaḥ
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ pralipyābjotpalādibhiḥ / ghṛtena tilatailena dīpanaivedyamarpayet
oṃ namo vāsudevāya mālatyā mālayā yajet / dharmakāmārthamokṣāṃś ca prāpnuyāt kaumudavratī
sarvaṃ labheddhariṃ prārcya māsopavāsakavratī /
nānāvratāni agnir uvāca ṛtuvratāntyahaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāni te / indhanāni tu yo dadyādvarṣādicaturo hy ṛtūn
ghṛtadhenupradaścānte brāhmaṇo 'gnivratī bhavet / kṛtvā maunantu sandhyāyāṃ māsānte ghṛtakumbhadaḥ
tilaghaṇṭāvastradātā sukhī sārasvatavratī(1) / pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvābdaṃ dhenudo nṛpaḥ
ekādaśyāntu naktāśī caitre bhaktaṃ nivedayet / haimaṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yāti māsante viṣṇusadvratī
pāyasāśī goyugadaḥ śrībhāgdevīvratī bhavet / nivedya pitṛdevebhyo yo bhuṅkte sa bhavennṛpaḥ
varṣavratāni coktāni(2) saṅkrāntivratakaṃ vade / saṅkrāntau svargalokī syādrātrijāgaraṇānnaraḥ
amāvāsyāṃ tu saṅkrāntau śivārkayajanāttathā / uttare tvayane cājyaprasthasnānena keśave

strīṇāmumāvrataṃ śrīdaṃ tṛtīyāsvaṣṭamīṣu ca / gaurīṃ maheśvaraṃ cāpi yajet saubhāgyamāpnuyāt
umāmaheśvarau prārcya aviyogādi cāpnuyāt / mūlavratakarī strī ca umeśavratakāriṇī
sūryabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣo bhavet /
dīpadānavrataṃ agnnir uvāca dīpadānavrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / devadvijātikagṛhe dīpado 'bdaṃ sa sarvabhāk
caturmāsaṃ viṣṇulokī kārttike svargalokyapi / dīpadānāt paraṃ nāsti na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
dīpenāyuṣyacakṣuṣmāndīpāllakṣmīsutādikaṃ / saubhāgyaṃ dīpadaḥ prāpya svargaloke nahīyate
vidarbharājaduhitā lalitā dīpadātmabhāk / cārudharmakṣmāpapatnī śatabhāryādhikābhavat
dadau dīpasahasraṃ sā viṣṇorāyatane satī / pṛṣṭā sā dīpamāhātmyaṃ sapatnībhya uvāca ha
lalitovāca sauvīrarājasya purā maitreyo 'bhūt purohitaḥ / tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ devikātaṭe
kārttike dīpakastena dattaḥ samprerito mayā / vaktraprāntena naśyantyā mārjārasya tadā bhayāt
nirvāṇavān pradīpto 'bhūdvartyā mūṣikayā tadā / mṛtā rājātmajā jātā rājapatnī śatādhikā
asaṅkalpitamapyasya preraṇaṃ yat kṛtaṃ mayā / viṣṇāyatanadīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalaṃ
jātismarā hy ato dīpān prayacchāmi tvahar niśaṃ / ekadaśyāṃ dīpado vai vimāne divi modate
jāyate dīpahartā tu mūko vā jaḍa eva ca / andhe tamasi duṣpāre narake patate kila
vikrośamānāṃś ca narān yamakiṅkarāhatān / vilāpair alamatrāpi kiṃ vo vilapite phalaṃ
yadā pramādibhiḥ pūrvamatyantasamupekṣitaḥ / janturjanmasahasrebhyo hy ekasmin mānuṣo yadi
tatrāpyativimūḍhātmā kiṃ bhogānabhidhāvati / svahitaṃ(1) viṣayāsvādaiḥ krandanaṃ tadihāgataṃ
1 harṣitamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca / dūṣitamiti ṅa.. :p 237 bhujyate ca kṛtaṃ pūrvametat kiṃ vo na cintitaṃ / parastrīṣu kucābhyaṅgaṃ prītaye duḥkhadaṃ hi vaḥ
muhūrtaviṣayāsvādo 'nekakoṭyavdaduḥkhadaḥ / parastrīhāriyadgītaṃ hā mātaḥ kiṃ vilapyate
ko 'tibhāro harernāmni jihvayā parikīrtane / vartitaile 'lpamūlye 'pi yadagnirlabhyate sadā
dānāśaktair harerdīpo hṛtastadvo 'sti duḥkhadaṃ / idānīṃ kiṃ vilāpena sahadhvaṃ yadupāgataṃ
agnir uvāca lalitoktañca tāḥ śrutvā dīpadānāddivaṃ yayuḥ / tasmāddīpapradānena vratānāmadhikaṃ phalaṃ
navavyūhārcanaṃ agnir uvāca navavyūhārcanaṃ vakṣye nāradāya harīritaṃ / maṇḍale 'bje 'rcayenmadhye avījaṃ vāsudevakaṃ
āvījañca saṅkarṣaṇam pradyumnaṃ ca dakṣiṇe / aḥ anuruddhaṃ naiṛte oṃ nārāyaṇamapsu ca
tat sadbrahmāṇamanile huṃ viṣṇuṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhakaṃ(1) / uttare bhūrvarāhañca īśe dvāri ca paścime
kaṃ ṭaṃ saṃ śaṃ garutmantaṃ pūrvavaktrañca dakṣiṇe(2) / khaṃ chaṃ vaṃ huṃ phaḍiti ca khaṃ ṭhaṃ phaṃ śaṃ gadāṃvidhau
baṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ koṇeśañca ghaṃ daṃ bhaṃ haṃśriyaṃ yajet / dakṣiṇe cottare puṣṭiṃ gaṃ ḍaṃ baṃ śaṃ svavījakaṃ
pīṭhasya paścime dhaṃ vaṃ vanamālāñca paścime / śrīvatsaṃ caiva saṃ haṃ laṃ chaṃ taṃ yaṃ kaustubhaṃ jale
daśamāṅgakramādviṣṇornamo 'nantamadho 'rcayet / daśāṅgādimahendrādīn pūrvādau caturo ghaṭān
toraṇāni vitānaṃ ca agnyanilenduvījakaiḥ / maṇḍalāni kramāddhyātvā tanuṃ vandya tataḥ plavet
amvarasthaṃ tato dhyātvā sūkṣmarūpamathātmanaḥ / sitāmṛte nimagnañca(3) candravimvāt srutena ca
tadeva cātmano vījamamṛtaṃ plavasaṃskṛtaṃ / utpādyamānaṃ puruṣamātmānamupakalpayet
utpanno 'smi svayaṃ viṣṇurvījaṃ dvādaśakaṃ nyaset / hṛcchirastu śikhā caiva kavacaṃ cāstrameva ca
vakṣomūrdhaśikhāpṛṣṭhalocaneṣu nyaseta punaḥ / astraṃ karadvaye nyasya tato divyatanurbhavet

sanirmālyā maṇḍalādau baddhanetrāś ca śiṣyakāḥ / puṣpaṃ kṣipeyuryanmūrtau tasya tannāma kārayet

navavyūhasya mūrtīnāmaṅgānāṃ ca śatādhikaṃ / pūṛṇāndattvā dīkṣayettān guruḥ pūjyaś ca tair dhanaiḥ
puṣpādhyāyakathanaṃ agnir uvāca puṣpagandhadhūpadīpanaivedyaistuṣyate hariḥ / puṣpāṇi devayogyāni hy ayogyāni vadāmi te

pāvantīkubjakādyaiś ca tagarair viṣṇulokabhāk / karṇikārair viṣṇulokaḥ karuṇṭhaiḥ pāpanāśanaṃ
padmaiś ca ketakībhiś ca kundapuṣpaiḥ parā gatiḥ / vāṇapuṣpair varvarābhiḥ kṛṣṇābhirharilokabhāk
aśokaistilakaistadvadaṭarūṣabhavais tathā / muktibhāgī bilvapatraiḥ śamīpatraiḥ parā gatiḥ
viṣṇulokī bhṛṅgarājaistamālasya dalais tathā / tulasī kṛṣṇagaurākhyā kalhārotpalakāni ca
padmaṃ kokanadaṃ puṇyaṃ śatābjamālayā hariḥ / nīpārjunakadambaiś ca(1) vakulaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ
kiṃśukair munipuṣpaistu gokarṇair nāgakarṇakaiḥ / sandhyāpuṣpair bilvatakai rañjanīketakībhavaiḥ(2)
kuṣmāṇḍatimirotthaiś ca kuśakāśaśarodbhavaiḥ / dyūtādibhirmaruvakaiḥ patrairanyaiḥ sugandhikaiḥ
bhuktimuktiḥ pāpahānirbhaktyā sarvaistu tuṣyati / svarṇalakṣādhikaṃ puṣpaṃ mālā koṭiguṇādhikā
svavane 'nyavane puṣpaistriguṇaṃ vanajaiḥ phalaṃ(3) / viśīrṇairnārcayedviṣṇunnādhikāṅgairna moṭitaiḥ

kāñcanāraistathonmattairgirikarṇikayā tathā / 1 muktibhāgo kadambaiśceti ṅa.. 2 rajanīketakībhavairiti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 3 jalajaiḥ phalamiti ṅa.. :p 241 kuṭajaiḥ śālmalīyaiś ca(1) śirīṣair narakādikaṃ
sugandhairbrahmapadmaiś ca(2) puṣpairnīlotpalairhariḥ(3) / arkamandāradhustūrakusumairarcyate haraḥ
kuṭajaiḥ karkaṭīpuṣpaiḥ ketakīnna śive dadet / kuṣmāṇḍanimbasambhūtaṃ paiśācaṃ gandhavarjitaṃ
ahiṃsā indriyajayaḥ(4) kṣāntirjñānaṃ(5) dayā śrutaṃ / bhāvāṣtapuṣpaiḥ sampūjya devān syād bhuktimuktibhāk
ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ / sarvapuṣpaṃ dayā bhūte puṣpaṃ śāntirviśiṣyate
śamaḥ puṣpaṃ tapaḥ puṣpaṃ dhyānaṃ puṣpaṃ casaptamaṃ / satyañcaivāṣṭamaṃ puṣpametaistuṣyati keśavaḥ
etairevāṣṭabhiḥ puṣpaistuṣyatyevārcito hariḥ / puṣpāntarāṇi santyatra vāhyāni manujottama
bhaktyā dayānvitairviṣṇuḥ pūjitaḥ parituṣyati(6) / vāruṇaṃ salilaṃ puṣpaṃ saumyaṃ ghṛtapayodadhi
prājāpatyaṃ tathānnādi āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpakaṃ / phalapuṣpādikañcaiva vānaspatyantu pañcamaṃ

āsanaṃ mūrtipañcāṅgaṃ(1) viṣṇurvā cāṣṭapuṣpikāḥ / viṣṇostu vāsudevādyairīśānādyaiḥ śivasya vā
narakasvarūpam agnir uvāca puṣpādyaiḥ pūjanādviṣṇor na yāti narakāndave / āyuṣo 'nte naraḥ prāṇairanicchannapi mucyate

nīyate yamadūtaistu yamaṃ prāṇibhayaṅkaraiḥ / kupathe dakṣiṇadvāri dharmikaḥ paścimādibhiḥ

goghātī tu mahāvīcyāṃ varṣalakṣantu pīḍyate / āmakumbhe mahādīpte brahmahā bhūmihārakaḥ
mahāpralayakaṃ yāvadraurave pīḍyate śanaiḥ / strībālavṛddhahantā tu yāvadindrāś caturdaśa
mahārauravake raudre gṛhakṣetrādidīpakaḥ / dahyate kalpamekaṃ sa caurastāmisrake patet
naikakalpantu śūlādyairbhidyate yamakiṅkaraiḥ / mahātāmisrake sarpajalaukādyaiś ca pīḍyate

mahājvāle pāpabuddhiḥ krakace 'gamyagāminaḥ / saṅkarī guḍapāke ca(2) pratudet paramarmanut

adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ viṣṇo yāvadutthānakantava / arcayetvāmanaśnan hi yāvat triṃśaddināni tu

anyaviprāya śayyāyāṃ haimaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca / ātmanaś ca tathāmūrtiṃ vastrādyaiś ca prapūjayet

vāṇabilvajavābhistu caturthe pañcame 'hani / mālatyā bhūmiśāyī syādekādaśyāntu gomayaṃ
gomūtraṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca pañcame pañcagavyakaṃ / paurṇamāsyāñcarennaktaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhedvratī

agastyārghyadānakathanaṃ agnir uvāca agastyo bhagavānviṣṇustamabhyarcyāpnuyāddhariṃ / aprāpte bhāskare kanyāṃ satribhāgaistribhirdinaiḥ

1 hariṃ lebhe tenaitaditi ga.. / hariṃ prāpa tenaitaditi ṅa.. / hariṃ prāptastenaitaditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca 2 pūjanātpañca upavāsādajavratamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. , ḍa.. ca :p 249 arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya pūjayitvā hy upoṣitaḥ / kāśapuṣpamayīṃ mūrtiṃ pradoṣe vinyased ghaṭe
muneryajettāṃ kumbhasthāṃ rātrau kuryāt prajāgaraṃ / agastya miniśārdūla tejorāśe mahāmate(1)
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇīṣva priyayā saha / āvāhyārghye ca sammukhyaṃ prārcayeccandanādinā
jalāśayasamīpe tu prātarnītvārghyamarpayet / kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa agnimārutasambhava(2)
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo 'stu te / ātāpirbhakṣito yena vātāpiś ca mahāsuraḥ
samudraḥ śoṣito yena so 'gastyaḥ sammukho 'stu me / agastiṃ prārthayiṣyāmi karmaṇā manasā girā
arcayisyāmyahaṃ maitraṃ paralokābhikāṅkṣayā / dvīpāntarasamutpannaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ priyaṃ
rājānaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ candanaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ(3) / dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bhājanī pāpanāśanī
saubhāgyārogyalakṣmīdā puṣpamālā pragṛhyatāṃ / dhūpo 'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ deva bhaktiṃ me hy acalāṅkuru
īpsitaṃ me varaṃ dehi paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ / surāsurairmuniśreṣṭha sarvakāmaphalaprada

1 tejorāśe mahādyute iti ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /tejorāśe jagatpate iti ṅa.. 2 vahnimārutasambhaveti jha.. 3 candanaṃ me pragṛhyanāmiti ja.. , ña.. ca :p 250 vastravrīhiphalairhemnā dattastvarghyo hy ayaṃ(1) mayā / agastyaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi yanmayā manasoddhṛtaṃ(2)
phalairarghyaṃ pradāsyāmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mahāmune / agastya evaṃ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃbalamīhamānaḥ / ubhau karṇāvṛṣirugratejāḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣojagāma
rājaputri namastubhyaṃ munipatnī mahāvrate / arghyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva deveśi lopāmudre yaśasvini

arghyaṃ dadyādagastyāya strīśūdrāṇāmavaidikaṃ / agastya muniśārdūla tejorāśe ca sarvada
imāṃ mama kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā vraja śāntaye / tyajedagastryamuddiśya dhānyamekaṃ phalaṃ rasaṃ
tato 'nnaṃ bhojayedviprān ghṛtapāyasamodakān / gāṃ vāsāṃsi suvarṇañca(4) tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ

gotrasantativṛddhyarthaṃ vijayāya dhanāya ca / dharmāyaiśvaryakāmāya tatpāpaśamanāya ca
saṃsāramuktaye dānantubhyaṃ sampradade hy ahaṃ / etaddānapratiṣṭhārthaṃ tubhyametad dadāmyahaṃ
etena prīyatāṃ nityaṃ sarvalokapatiḥ prabhuḥ / yajñadānavratapate vidyākīrtyādi dehi me
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṃś ca dehi me manasepsitaṃ / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ vratadānasamuccayaṃ
sa prāptakāmo vimalo bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikaṃ vrataṃ
naikadhā vāsudevāderniyamāt pūjanādbhavet /
dānaparibhāṣākathanaṃ agnir uvāca dānadharmān pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktidān śṛṇu / dānamiṣṭaṃ tathā pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ kurvan hi sarvabhāk
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca / annapradānamārāmāḥ pūrtaṃ dharmaṃ ca muktidaṃ
agnihotraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ vedānāñcānupālanaṃ / ātithyaṃ vaiśvadevañca prāhuriṣṭañca nākadaṃ
grahoparāge yaddānaṃ sūryasaṅkramaṇeṣu ca / dvādaśyādau ca yaddānaṃ pūrtaṃ tadapi nākadaṃ
deśe kāle ca pātre ca dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet / ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye
yugādiṣu ca saṅkrāntau caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca / sitapañcadaśīsarvadvādaśīṣvaṣṭakāsu ca
yajñotsavavibāheṣu tathā manvantarādiṣu / vaidhṛte dṛṣṭaduḥkhapne dravyabrāhmaṇalābhataḥ
śraddhā vā yaddine tatra sadā vā dānamiṣyate / ayane dve vipuve dve catasraḥ ṣaḍaśītayaḥ
catasro viṣṇupadyaś ca saṅkrātyo dvādaśottamāḥ / kanyāyāṃ mithune mīne dhanuṣyapi ravergatiḥ
ṣaḍaśītimukhāḥ proktāḥ ṣaḍaśītiguṇāḥ phalaiḥ / atītānāgate puṇye dve udagdakṣiṇāyane
triṃśat karkaṭake nāḍyo makare viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ / vartamāne tulāmeṣe nāḍyāstubhayato daśa
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ ṣaṣṭiruktāstu nāḍikāḥ / puṇyākhyā viṣṇupādyāñca prākpaścādapi ṣoḍaśa
śravaṇāśvidhaniṣṭhāsu nāgadaivatamastake / yadā syādravivāreṇa vyatīpātaḥ sa ucyate
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike niragāt kṛtaṃ / tretā sitatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe dvāparaṃ yugaṃ
darśe vai māghamāsasya trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyake / kṛṣṇe kaliṃ vijānīyāj jñeyā manvantarādayaḥ
aśvayukacchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttike tathā / tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca
phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā / āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī
āvāṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā / kārttike phālgune tadvaj jyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī tathā
ūrdhve caivāgrahāyaṇyā aṣtakāstisra īritāḥ / aṣṭakākhyā cāṣṭamī syādāsu(1) dānāni cākṣyayaṃ

varṇasaṅkare dviguṇaṃ śūdre dānaṃ caturguṇaṃ / vaiśye cāṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣatre ṣoḍaśatvaṃ dvijavruve

caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syād guḍavittānusārataḥ / pañca kṛṣṇalakā māṣaste suvarnastu ṣoḍaśa
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvārastulā palaśataṃ smṛtaṃ / syādbhāro viṃśatitulā droṇastu caturāḍhakaḥ
dhenuvatsau guḍasyobhau sitasūkṣmāmbarāvṛtau / śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śucimuktāphalekṣaṇau
sitasūtraśirālau ca sitakambalakamvalau / tāmragaḍḍukapṛṣṭhau tau sitacāmararomakau
vidrumabhrūyugāvetau navanītastanānvitau / kṣaumapucchau kāṃsyadohāvindranīlakatārakau
suvarṇaśṛṅgābharaṇau rajatakṣurasaṃyutau / nānāphalamayā dantā gandhaghrāṇaprakalpitau
racayitvā yajeddhenumimair mantrair dvijottama / yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deveṣvavasthitā
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama śāntiṃ prayacchatu / dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇī śaṅkarasya sadā priyā
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu / viṣṇuvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ
candrārkaṛkṣaśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye / caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīrdhanadasya ca
lakṣmīryā lokapālānāṃ sa dhenurvaradāstu me / svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ yataḥ
sarvapāpaharā dhenustasmācchāntiṃ prayaccha me / evamāmantritāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet
samānaṃ sarvadhenūnāṃ vidhānaṃ caitadeva hi / sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya nirmalo bhuktimuktibhāk
svarṇaśṛṅgo śaphai raupyaiḥ suśīlā vastrasaṃyutā / kāṃsyopadohā dātavyā kṣoriṇau gauḥ sadakṣiṇā
dātāsyāḥ svargamāpnoti vatsarān somasammitān / kapilā cettārayati bhūyaścāsaptamaṃ kulaṃ
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitāṃ / śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk
savatsaromatulyāni yugānyubhayatomukhīṃ / dattvā svargamavāpnoti pūrveṇa vidhinā dadet
āsannamṛtyunā deyā savatsā gaustu pūrvavat / yamadvāre mahāvīre taptā vaitaraṇī(1) nadī
tāntartuñca dadāmyenāṃ(2) kṛṣṇāṃ vaitaraṇīñca gāṃ /
nānādānāni agnir uvāca ekāṅgāṃ daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī / śataṃ sahasragurdadyāt sarve tulyaphalā hi te
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā / gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra yānti sahasradāḥ
gavāṃ śatapradānena mucyate narakārṇavāt / dattvā vatsatarīṃ caiva svarhaloke mahīyate
godānādāyurārogyasaubhāgyasvargamāpnuyāt / indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyādastu me sarvakāmadā(1) / dharmarājasya sāhāyye(2) yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama / mahiṣīdānācca saubhāgyaṃ vṛṣadānāddivaṃ vrajet
saṃyuktahalapaṅktyākhyaṃ dānaṃ sarvaphalapradaṃ / paṅktirdaśahalā proktā dārujā vṛṣasaṃyutā

tānyeva daśavistārādgocarme tatprado 'ghabhit(4) / gobhūhiraṇyasaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājinantu yo 'rpayet(5)
sarvaduṣkṛtakarmāpi sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo vrajet / bhājanantilasampūrṇaṃ madhunā pūrṇameva ca
dadyāt kṛṣṇatilānāñca prasthamekañca māgadhaṃ / śayyāṃ dattvā tu saguṇāṃ(6) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt
haimīṃ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā dattvā svargas tathātmanaḥ / vipulantu gṛhaṃ kṛtvā dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk

1 tatphalaṃ cākṣayaṃ syādvai iti ṭa.. 2 vṛṣabhasya vimokṣaṇe iti kha.. / vṛṣabhasya ca mokṣaṇāditi ja.. 3 daivo 'theti kha.. , cha.. ca 4 tatprado 'ghanuditi śa.. / tatprado 'ghajiditi gha.. , ṅa.. ca 5 yastu kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadediti ṭa.. 6 dattvottamaguṇāmiti gha.. :p 266 gṛhaṃ maṭhaṃ sabhāṃ svargī dattvā syācca pratiśriyaṃ / dattvā kṛtvā gogṛhañca niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt
yamamāhiṣadānāttu niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt / brahmā haro harirdevair madhye ca yamadūtakaḥ
pāśī(1) tasya śiraśchittvā taṃ dadyāt svargabhāgbhavet / trimukhākhyamidaṃ dānaṃ gṛhītvā tu dvijo 'ghabhāk
cakraṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā ke dhṛtvā tat pradāpayet / hemayuktaṃ dvijāyaitat kālacakramidammahat
ātmatulyantu yo lauhaṃ dadenna narakaṃ vrajet / pañcāśatpalasaṃyuktaṃ lauhadaṇḍaṃ tu yo 'rpayet
vastreṇācchādya viprāya yamadaṇḍo na vidyate / mūlaṃ phalādi vā dravyaṃ saṃhataṃ vātha caikaśaḥ
mṛtyujjayaṃ samuddiśya dadyādāyurvivardhaye / pumān kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadantaḥ suvarṇadṛk
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrgho javākusumamaṇḍalaḥ / raktāmvaradharaḥ sragvī śaṅkamālāvibhūṣitaḥ
upānadyugayuktāṅghriḥ kṛṣṇakambalapārśvakaḥ / gṛhītamāṃsapiṇḍaś ca vāme vai kālapūruṣaḥ
sampūjya tañca gandhādyaiḥ(2) brāhmaṇāyopapādayet / maraṇavyādhihīnaḥ syādrājarājeśvaro bhavet
govṛṣau tu dvije dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / 1 pāpo iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca 2 sampūjya vastragandhādyair iti ṅa.. :p 267 revantādhiṣṭhitañcāśvaṃ haimaṃ dattvā na mṛtybhāk
ghaṇṭādipūrṇamapyekaṃ dattvā syādbhuktimuktibhāk / sarvān kāmānavāpnoti yaḥ prayacchati kāñcanaṃ
suvarṇe dīyamāne tu rajataṃ dakṣiṇeṣyate / anyeṣāmapi dānānāṃ suvarṇaṃ(1) dakṣiṇā smṛtā
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ taṇḍulaṃ dhānyameva ca / nityaśrāddhaṃ devapūjā sarvametadadakṣiṇaṃ
rajataṃ dakṣiṇā pitre dharmakāmārthasādhanaṃ / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca
sarvametanmahāprājño dadāti vasudhāndadat / pitṝṃś ca pitṛlokasthān devasthāne ca devatāḥ
santarpayati śāntātmā yo dadāti vasundharām / kharvaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ vāpi grāmaṃ vā śasyaśālinaṃ
nivartanaśataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā gṛhādikaṃ / api gocarmamātrāmbā dattvorvīṃ sarvabhāg bhavet
tailavinduryathā cāpsu prasarped bhūgataṃ tathā / sarveṣāmevadānānamekajanmānugaṃ phalaṃ
hāṭakakṣitigaurīṇāṃ saptajanmānugaṃ phalaṃ / trisaptakulamuddhṛtya kanyādo brahmalokabhāk
gajaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dattvā nirmalaḥ svargabhāg bhavet / aśvaṃ dattvāyurārogyasaubhāgyasvargamāpnuyāt
1 hiraṇyamiti ṭa.. :p 268 dāsīṃ dattvā dvijendrāya apsarolokamāpnuyāt / dattvā tāmramayīṃ sthālīṃ palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ
ardhaistadardhair ardhair vā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt(1) / śakaṭaṃ vṛṣasaṃyuktaṃ dattvā yānena nākabhāk
vastradānāllabhedāyurārogyaṃ svargamakṣayaṃ / dhānyagodhūmakalamayavādīn svargabhāg dadat
āsanaṃ taijasaṃ pātraṃ lavaṇaṃ gandhacandanaṃ / dhūpaṃ dīpañca tāmvūlaṃ lohaṃ rūpyañca ratnakaṃ(2)
divyāni nānādravyāṇi dattvā syād bhuktimuktibhāk / tilāṃś ca tilapātrañca dattvā svargamavāpnuyāt
annadānāt paraṃ nāsti na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / hastyaśvarathadānāni dāsīdāsagṛhāṇi ca
annadānasya sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ / kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yaḥ paścādannado bhavet
sarvapāpavinirmukto lokānāpnoti cākṣayān / pānīyañca prapāndattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt
agniṃ kāṣṭhañca mārgādau dattvā dīptyādimāpnuyāt(3) / devagandharvanārībhirvimāne sevyate divi

ghṛtaṃ taikañca lavaṇaṃ dattvā sarvamavāpnuyāt / 1 tatordhvatastadardhārdhair yuktāṃ bhuktimavāpnuyāt iti cha.. 2 dhūpadīpañca naivedyaṃ tāmvūlaṃ loharatnakamiti kha.. 3 dīptāgnimāpnuyāditi ṅa.. :p 269 chatropānahakāṣṭhādi dattvā svarge sukhī vaset(1)
pratipattithimukhyeṣu viṣkumbhādikayogake / caitrādau vatsarādau ca aśvinyādau hariṃ haraṃ
brahmāṇaṃ lokapālādīn prārcya dānaṃ mahāphalaṃ / vṛkṣārāmān bhojanādīn mārgasaṃvāhanādikān
pādābhyaṅgādikaṃ dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / trīṇi tulyaphalānīha gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī
vrāhmīṃ sarasvatīndattvā nirmalo brahmalokabhāk / saptadvīpamahīdaḥ sa brahmajñānaṃ dadāti yaḥ
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadyāt sarvabhāṅ naraḥ / purāṇaṃ bhārataṃ vāpi rāmāyaṇamathāpi vā
likhitvā pustakaṃ dattvā bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / vedaśāstraṃ nṛtyagītaṃ yo 'dhyāpayati nākabhāk
vittaṃ dadyādupādhyāye chātrāṇāṃ bhojanādikaṃ / kimadattaṃ bhavettena dharmakāmādidarśinā
vājapeyasahasrasya samyagdattasya yat phalaṃ / tatphalaṃ sarvamāpnoti vidyādānanna saṃśayaḥ
śivālaye viṣṇugṛhe sūryasya bhavane tathā / sarvadānapradaḥ sa syāt pustakaṃ vācayettu yaḥ
trailokye caturo varṇāś catvāraścāśramāḥ pṛthak / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā vidyādāne pratiṣṭhatāḥ
1 svarge mahīyate iti ga.. / svarge sukhī bhavedeti gha.. , ṅa.. ca :p 270 vidyā kāmadughā dhenurvidyā cakṣuranuttamaṃ / upavedapradānena gandharvaiḥ saha modate
vedāṅgānāñca dānena svargalokamavāpnuyāt / dharmaśāstrapradānena dharmeṇa saha modate
siddhāntānāṃ pradānena mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ / vidyādānamavāpnoti pradānāt pustakasya tu
śāstrāṇi ca purāṇāni dattvā sarvamavāpnuyāt / śiṣyāṃś ca śikṣayedyastu puṇḍalīkaphalaṃ labhet
yena jīvati taddattvā phalasyānto na vidyate / loke sreṣṭhatamaṃ sarvamātmanaścāpi yat priyaṃ
sarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dātavyaṃ teṣāmevākṣayārthinā / viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ padmayoniṃ devīvighneśvarādikān
pūjayitvā pradadyādyaḥ pūjādravyaṃ sa sarvabhāk / devālayaṃ ca pratimāṃ kārayat sarvamāpnuyāt
sammārjanaṃ copalepaṃ kurvan syānnirmalaḥ pumān / nānāmaṇḍalakāryagre maṇḍalādhipatirbhavet(1)
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ naivedyañca pradakṣiṇaṃ / ghaṇṭādhvajavitānañca prekṣaṇaṃ vādyagautakaṃ
vastrādidattvādevāya bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / kastūrikāṃ śihlakañca śrīkhaṇḍamagurūntathā
karpūrañca tathāmustaṃ gugguluṃ vijayaṃ dadet / 1 sammārjanamityādiḥ maṇḍalādhipatirbhavedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti :p 271 ghṛtaprasthena saṃsthāpya saṅkrāntyādau sa sarvabhāk
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyamabhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ / palānāntu sahasreṇa mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ
daśāparādhāstoyena kṣīreṇa snāpanācchataṃ / sahasraṃ payasā dadhnā ghṛtenāyutamiṣyate
dāsīdāsamalaṅkāraṃ gobhūmyaśvagajādikaṃ / devāya dattvā saubhāgyaṃ dhanāyuṣmān vrajeddivaṃ
merudānāni agnir uvāca kāmyadānāni vakṣyāmi sarvakāma pradāni te / nityapūjāṃ māsi māsi kṛtvātho kāmyapūjanaṃ
vratārhaṇaṃ guroḥ pūjā vatsarānte mahārcanaṃ / aśvaṃ vai mārgaśairṣe tu kamalaṃ piṣṭasambhavaṃ
śivāya pūjya yo dadyāt sūryaloke ciraṃ vaset(1) / 1 svargaloke ciraṃ vasediti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca / śivaloke ciraṃ vasediti jha.. :p 272 gajaṃ pauṣe piṣṭamayaṃ trisaptakulamuddharet
māghe cāśvarathaṃ paiṣṭhaṃ dattvā narakaṃ vrajet / phālgune tu vṛṣaṃ paiṣṭaṃ svargabhuk syānmahīpatiḥ
caitre cekṣumayīṃ gāvandāsadāsīsamanvitāṃ / dattvā svarge ciraṃ sthitvā tadante syānmahīpatiḥ
saptavrīhīṃś ca vaiśākhe dattvā śivamayo bhavet / balimaṇḍalakañcānnaiḥ kṛtvāṣāḍhe śivo bhavet
vimānaṃ śrāvaṇe pauṣpaṃ dattvā svargī tato nṛpaḥ / śatadvayaṃ phalānāntu dattvoddhṛtya kulaṃ nṛpaḥ
guggulādi dahedbhādre svargī sa syāttato nṛpaḥ / kṣīrasarpirbhṛtaṃ pātramāśvine svargadambhavet
kārttike guḍakhaṇḍājyaṃ dattvā svargī tato nṛpaḥ / merudānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ vakṣye 'haṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ
meruvrate tu kārttikyāṃ ratnamerundaded dvije / sarveṣāñcaiva merūṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu
vajrapadmamahānīlanīlasphaṭikasañjñitaḥ / puṣpaṃ marakataṃ muktā prasthamātreṇa cottamaḥ
madhyo 'rdhaḥ syāttadardho 'dho vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet / kārṇikāyāṃ nyasenmeruṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśadaivataṃ
mālyavān pūrvataḥ pūjyastatpūrve bhadarasañjñitaḥ / aśvarakṣastataḥ prokto niṣadho merudakṣiṇe
hemakūṭo 'tha himavān trayaṃ saumye tathā trayaṃ / nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgī ca paścime gandhamādanaḥ
vaikaṅkaḥ ketumālaḥ syānmerurdvādaśasaṃyutaḥ / sopavāso 'rcayedviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ vā snānapūrvakaṃ
devāgre cārcya meruñca mantrair viprāya vai dadet / viprāyāmukagotrāya merundravyamayamparaṃ
bhuktyai muktyai nirmalatve viṣṇudaivaṃ dadāmi te / indraloke brahmaloke śivaloke hareḥ pure
kulamuddhṛtya krīḍeta vimāne devapūjitaḥ / anyeṣvapi ca kāleṣu saṅkrāntyādau pradāpayet
palānāntu sahasreṇa hemamerumprakalpayet / śṛṅgatrayasamāyuktaṃ brahmaviṣṇuharānvitaṃ
ekaikaṃ parvatantasya śataikaikena kārayet / meruṇā saha śailāstu khyātāstatra trayodaśa
ayane grahaṇādau ca viṣṇvagre harimarcya ca / svarṇameruṃ dvijāyārpya viṣṇuloke ciraṃ vaset
paramāṇavo yāvanta iha rājā bhavecciraṃ / raupyameruṃ dvādaśādriyutaṃ saṅkalpato dadet(1)
prāguktaṃ ca phalaṃ tasya viṣṇuṃ vipraṃprapūjya ca / bhūmimeruñca viṣayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ grāmameva ca(2)
parikalpyāṣṭamāṃśena śeṣāṃśāḥ(3) pūrvavat phalaṃ / dvādaśādrisamāyuktaṃ hastimerusvarūpiṇaṃ

1 saṅkalpya taddadediti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca 2 maṇḍalaṃ grāmameveti ga.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca 3 śeṣāṅgā iti kha.. :p 274 dadettripuruṣair yuktaṃ dattvānantaṃ phalaṃ labhet / tripañcāśvair aśvameruṃ hayayadvādaśasaṃyutaṃ
viṣṇvādīn pūjya taṃ dattvā bhuktabhogo nṛpo bhavet / aśvasaṅkhyāpramāṇena gomeruṃ pūrvavaddadet
paṭṭavastrair bhāramātrair vastrameruś ca madhyataḥ / śailair dvādaśavastraiś ca dattvā tañcākṣayaṃ phalaṃ
ghṛtapañcasahasraiś ca palānāmājyaparvataḥ / śataiḥ pañcabhirekaikaḥ pārvate 'smin hariṃ yajet
viṣṇvagre brāhmaṇāyārpya sarvaṃ prāpya hariṃ vrajet / evaṃ ca khaṇḍameruñca kṛtvā dattvāpnuyāt phalaṃ
dhānyameruḥ pañcakhāro 'para ekaikakhārakāḥ / svarṇatriśṛṅgakāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān
sarveṣu pūjya viṣṇuṃ vā viśeṣādakṣayaṃ phalaṃ / evaṃ daśāṃśamānena tilameruṃ prakalpayet
śṛṅgāṇi pūrvavattasya tathaivānyanageṣu ca / tilameruṃ pradāyātha bandhubhirviṣṇulokabhāk(1)
namo viṣṇusvarūpāya dharādharāya vai namaḥ / brahmaviṣṇvīśaśṛṅgāya dharānābhisthitāya ca
nagadvādaśanāthāya sarvapāpāpahāriṇe / viṣṇubhaktāya śāntāya trāṇaṃ me kuru sarvathā
niṣpāpaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇuṃ gacchāmi oṃ namaḥ / 1 bandhubhirbrahmalokabhāgiti jha.. :p 275 tvaṃ haristu hareragre ahaṃ viṣṇuś ca viṣṇave
nivedayāmi bhaktyā tu bhuktimuktyarthahetave /
pṛthvīdānāni agnir uvāca pṛthvīdānaṃ pravakṣyāmi pṛthivī trividhā matā / śatakoṭiryojanānāṃ saptadvīpā sasāgarā
jambudvīpāvadhiḥ sā ca uttamā medinīritā / uttamāṃ pañcabhirbhāraiḥ kāñcanaiś ca prakalpayet
tadardhāntarajaṃ kūrmaṃ tathā padmaṃ samādiśet / uttamā kathitā pṛthvī dvyaṃśenaiva tu madhyamā
kanyasā ca tribhāgena(1) trihānyā kūrmapaṅkaje / palānāntu sahasreṇa kalpayet kalpapādapaṃ
mūladaṇḍaṃ sapatrañca phalapuṣpasamanvitaṃ / 1 svalpā sā tu tribhāgeneti ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca :p 276 pañcaskandhantu saṅkalpya pañcānāndāpayet sudhīḥ
etaddātā brahmaloke pitṛbhirmodate ciraṃ / viṣṇvagre kāmadhenuntu palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā devā dhenau vyavasthitāḥ / dhenudānaṃ sarvadānaṃ sarvada brahmalokadaṃ
viṣṇvagre kapilāṃ dattvā tārayet sakalaṃ kulaṃ / alaṅkṛtya striyaṃ dadyādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet(1)
bhūmiṃ dattvā sarvabhāk syāt sarvaśasyaprarohiṇīm / grāmaṃ vātha puraṃ vāpi(2) kheṭakañca dadt sukhī
kārttikyādau(3) vṛṣotsargaṃ kurvaṃstārayate kulaṃ(4)
mantramāhatmyakathanaṃ agnir uvāca nāḍīcakraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajjñānāj jñāyate hariḥ / nābheradhastādyat kandamaṅkurāstatra nirgatāḥ

1 naramedhaphalaṃ labhediti ga.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca 2 purīṃ vāpīti kha.. 3 kārttikādāviti kha.. , ṭa.. ca 4 kurvan santārayet kulamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca :p 277 dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi nābhimadhye vyavasthitāḥ / tiryagūrdhvamadhaś caiva vyāptantābhiḥ samantataḥ
cakravatsaṃsthitā hy etāḥ pradhānā daśanāḍayaḥ / iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva susumṇā ca tathaiva ca
gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pṛthā caiva yathā tathā / alambuṣā huhuś caiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā
daśa prāṇavahā hy etā nāḍayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ / prāṇo 'pānaḥ samānaś ca udāno vyāna eva ca
nāgaḥ kūrmo 'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ / prāṇastu prathamo vāyurdaśānāmapi sa prabhuḥ
prāṇaḥ prāṇayate prāṇaṃ visargāt pūraṇaṃ prati / nityamāpūrayatyeṣa prāṇināmurasi sthitaḥ
niḥśvāsocchvāsakāsaistu prāṇo jīvasamāśritaḥ / prayāṇaṃ kurute yasmāttasmāt prāṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
adho nayatyapānastu āhārañca nṛṇāmadhaḥ / mūtraśukravaho vāyurapānastena kīrtitaḥ
pītabhakṣitamāghrātaṃ raktapittakaphānilaṃ / samannayati gātreṣu samāno nāma mārutaḥ
spandayatyadharaṃ vaktraṃ netrarāgaprakopanaṃ / udvejayati marmāṇi udāno nāma mārutaḥ
vyāno vināmayatyaṅgaṃ vyāno vyādhiprakopanaḥ / pratidānaṃ tathā kaṇṭhādvyāpānādvyāna ucyate
udgāre nāga ity uktaḥ kūrmaśconmīlane sthitaḥ / kṛkaro bhakṣaṇe caiva devadatto vijṛmbhite
dhanañjayaḥ sthito ghoṣe mṛtasyāpi na muñcati / jīvaḥ prayāti daśadhā nāḍīcakraṃ hi tena tat
saṅkrāntirviṣuvañcaiva ahorātrāyanāni ca / adhimāsa ṛṇañcaiva ūnarātra dhanantathā(1)
ūnarātraṃ bhaveddhikkā adhimāso vijṛmbhikā / ṛṇañcātra bhavet kāso niśvāso dhanamucyate(2)
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jñeyaṃ vāmaṃ dakṣiṇasañjñitaṃ / madhye tu viṣuvaṃ proktaṃ puṭadvayaviniḥsmṛtaṃ
saṅkrāntiḥ punarasyaiva svasthānāt sthānayogataḥ / susumṇā madhyame hy aṅge iḍā vāme pratiṣṭhitā
piṅgalā dakṣiṇe vipra ūrdhvaṃ prāṇo hy ahaḥ smṛtaṃ / apāno rātrirevaṃ syādeko vāyurdaśātmakaḥ
āyāmo dehamadhyasthaḥ somagrahaṇamiṣyate / dehātitattvamāyāmaṃ ādityagrahaṇaṃ viduḥ
udaraṃ pūrayettāvadvāyunā yāvadīpsitaṃ / prāṇāyāmī bhavedeṣa pūrakā dehapūrakaḥ
pidhāya sarvadvārāṇi niśvāsocchvāsavarjitaḥ / sampūraṇakumbhavattiṣṭhet prāṇāyāmaḥ sa kumbhakaḥ

sarvamantraprayogeṣu praṇavaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ / tena samparipūrṇaṃ yattat pūrṇaṃ karma netarat

yo 'dhīte 'hanyahanyetāstrīṇi varṣāṇyatantritaḥ / sa brahmaparamabhyeti vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān

na gāyatryāḥ parañjapyaṃ na vyāhṛtisamaṃ hutaṃ / gāyatryāḥ pādamapyardhamṛgardhamṛcameva vā
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ suvarṇasteyameva ca / gurudārāgamaś caiva japyenaiva punāti sā
pāpe kṛte tilair homo gāyatrījapa īritaḥ / japtvā sahasraṃ gāyatryā upavāsī sa pāpahā(1)
goghnaḥ pitṛghno mātṛghno brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ / brahmaghnaḥ svarṇahārī ca surāpo lakṣajapyataḥ
śudhyate vātha vā snātvā śatamantarjale japet / apaḥ śatena pītvā tu gāyatryāḥ pāpahā bhavet
śataṃ japtā tu gāyatrī pāpopaśamanī smṛtā / sahasraṃ śaptā sā devī upapātakanāśinī
abhīṣṭadā koṭijapyā devatvaṃ rājatāmiyāt / oṅkāraṃ pūrvamuccārya bhūrbhuvaḥ svastathaiva ca
gāyatrī praṇavaścānte jape caivamudāhṛtaṃ / viśvāmitra ṛṣicchando gāyatraṃ savitā tathā
devatopanaye japye viniyogo hute tathā / agnirvāyū ravirvidyut yamo jalapatirguruḥ
parjanya indro gandharvaḥ pūṣā ca tadanantaraṃ / mitro 'tha varuṇastvaṣṭā vasavo marutaḥ śaśī
aṅgirā viśvanāsatyau kas tathā sarvadevatāḥ / rudro brahmā ca viṣṇuś ca kramaśo 'kṣaradevatāḥ
gayatryā japakāle tu kathitāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ / pādāṅguṣṭhau ca gulphau ca nalakau jānunī tathā

vṛṇotervaraṇārthatvājjāgratsvapnādivarjitaṃ / nityaśuddhabuddhamekaṃ satyantaddhīmahīśvaraṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirdhyayemahi vimuktaye / taj jyotirbhagavān viṣṇurjagajjanmādikāraṇaṃ
śivaṃ kecit paṭhanti sma śaktirūpaṃ paṭhanti ca / kecit sūryaṅkecidagniṃ vedagā agnihotriṇaḥ

purodhasābhiṣekāt prāk kāryaindrī śāntireva ca / upavāsyabhiṣekāhe vedyagnau juhuyānmanūn(3)

vaidalānāñca bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca / ṣaḍbhāgameva cādadyān madhumāṃsasya sarpiṣaḥ
