tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ vyādhidurbhikṣataskaraiḥ / śrutaṃ vṛttantu vijñāya vṛttiṃ tasya prakalpayet
rakṣecca sarvatastvenaṃ pitā putramivaurasaṃ / saṃrakṣyamaṇo rājñā yaḥ kurute dharmamanvahaṃ
tenāyurvardhate rājño draviṇaṃ rāṣṭrameva ca / karma kuryur narendrasya māsenaikañca(1) śilpinaḥ
bhuktamātreṇa ye cānye svaśarīropajīyinaḥ //34
rājadharmāḥ puṣkara uvāca vakṣye 'ntaḥpuracintāṃ ca dharmādyāḥ puruṣārthakāḥ / anyonyarakṣayā teṣāṃ sevā kāryā striyā nṛpaiḥ
1 māsenaikeneti cha.. , ja.. ca :p 312 dharmamūlo 'rthaviṭapas tathā karmaphalo mahān / trivargapādapastatra rakṣayā phalabhāgaṃ bhavet
kāmādhīnāḥ(1) striyo rāma tadarthaṃ ratnasaṅgrahaḥ / sevyāstā nātisevyāś ca bhūbhujā viṣayaiṣiṇā
āhāro maithunannidrā sevyā nāti hi rug bhavet / mañcādhikāre(2) kartavyāḥ striyaḥ sevyāḥ svarāmikāḥ(3)
duṣṭānyācarate(4) yā tu nābinandati tatkathāṃ / aikyaṃ dviṣadbhirvrajati garvaṃ vahati coddhatā
cumbitā mārṣṭi vadanaṃ dattanna bahu manyate / svapityādau prasuptāpi tathā paścādvibudhyate
spṛṣṭā dhunoti gātrāṇi gātrañca viruṇaddhi yā / īṣacchṛṇoti vākyāni priyāṇyapi parāṅmukhī
na paśyatyagradattantu jaghanañca nigūhati / dṛṣṭe vivarṇavadanā mitreṣvatha parāṅmukhī(5)
tatkāmitāsu ca strīsu madhyastheva ca lakṣyate / jñātamaṇḍanakālāpi na karoti ca maṇḍanaṃ
yā sā viraktā tāntyaktvā sānurāgāṃ striyambhajet(6) / dṛṣṭvaiva hṛṣṭā bhavati vīkṣite ca parāṅmukhī

1 kāmādharā iti gha.. , ña.. ca 2 lajjādhikāre iti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 suvāsikā iti ka.. 4 dviṣṭānyācakṣate iti ña.. 5 na paśyatyagradattantvityādiḥ, mitreṣvatha parāṅmukhītyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti 6 striyaṃ vrajediti gha.. , ña.. ca :p 313 dṛśyamanā tathānyatra dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipati cañcalāṃ / tathāpyupāvartayituṃ naiva śaknotyaśeṣataḥ
vivṛṇīti tathāṅgāni svasyā guhyāni bhārgava / garhitañca tathaivāṅgaṃ prayatnena nigūhati
taddarśane ca kurute bālāliṅganacumbanaṃ / ābhāṣyamāṇā bhavati satyavākyā tathaiva ca
spṛṣṭā pulakitair aṅgaiḥ svedenaiva ca bhujyate / karoti ca tathā rāma sulabhadravyayācanaṃ
tataḥ svalpamapi prāpya karoti paramāṃ mudaṃ / nāmasaṅkīrtanādeva muditā bahu manyate
karajāṅkāṅkitānyasya phalāni preṣayatyapi / tatpreṣitañca hṛdaye vinyasatyapi cādarāt
āliṅganaiś ca gātrāṇi limpatīvāmṛtena yā / supte svapityathādau ca tathā tasya vibudhyate
urū spṛśati cātyarthaṃ suptañcainaṃ vibudhyate / kapitthacūrṇayogena tathā daghnaḥ srajā tathā
ghṛtaṃ sugandhi bhavati dugdhaiḥ kṣiptais tathā yavaiḥ / bhojyasya kalpanaivaṃ syādgandhamuktiḥ pradarśyate
śaucamācamanaṃ rāma tathaiva ca virecanaṃ / bhāvanā caiva pākaś ca bodhanaṃ dhūpanantathā
vāsanañcaiva nirdiṣṭaṃ karmāṣṭakamidaṃ smṛtaṃ / kapitthabilvajamvāmrakaravīrakapallavaiḥ
kṛtvodakantu yaddravyaṃ śaucitaṃ śaucanantu tat / teṣāmabhāve śaucantu mṛgadarpāmbhasā bhavet
nakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ghanaṃ māṃsī spṛkkaśaileyajaṃ jalaṃ / tathaiva kuṅkumaṃ lākṣā candanāgurunīradaṃ(1)
saralaṃ devakāṣṭhañca(2) karpūraṃ kāntayā saha / bālaḥ kundurukaś caiva gugguluḥ śrīnivāsakaḥ
saha sarjarasenaivaṃ dhūpadravyaikaviṃśatiḥ / dhūpadravyagaṇādasmādekaviṃśādyathecchayā
dve dve dravye samādāya sarjabhāgair niyojayet / nakhapiṇyākamalayaiḥ saṃyojya madhunā tathā
dhūpayogā bhavantīha yathāvat svecchayā kṛtāḥ / tvacannāḍīṃ phalantailaṃ kuṅkumaṃ granthi pravartakaṃ(3)
śaileyantagaraṃ krāntāṃ colaṅkarpūrameva ca(4) / māṃsīṃ surāñca kuṣṭhañca snānadravyāṇi nirdiśet
etebhyastu samādāya dravyatrayamathecchayā / mṛgadarpayutaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ kandarpavardhanaṃ
tvaṅmurānaladaistulyair vālakārdhasamāyutaiḥ / snānamutpalagandhi syāt satailaṃ kuṅkumāyate
jātīpuṣasugandhi syāt tagarārdhena yojitaṃ / saddhyāmakaṃ syādvakulaistulyagandhi manoharaṃ

1 candanāguruśailajamiti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 devadāruśceti gha.. , ña.. ca 3 granthiparṇakamiti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca 4 saha sarjarasenetyādiḥ colaṃ karpūrameva cetyantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa.. pustake nāsti :p 315 mañjiṣṭhātagaraṃ colaṃ tvacaṃ vyaghranakhaṃ nakkhaṃ / gandhapatrañca vinyasya gandhatailaṃ bhavecchubhaṃ
tailaṃ nipīḍitaṃ rāma tilaiḥ puṣpādhivāsitaiḥ / vāsanāt puṣpasadṛśaṃ gandhena tu bhaved dhruvaṃ
elālavaṅgakakkolajātīphalaniśākarāḥ / jātīpatrikayā sārdhaṃ svatantrā mukhavāsakāḥ
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kāntā mṛgadarpaṃ hareṇukaṃ / kakkolailālavaṅgañca jātau kośakameva ca
tvakpatraṃ truṭimustau ca latāṃ kastūrikaṃ tathā / kaṇṭakāni lavaṅgasya phalapatre ca jātitaḥ
kaṭukañca(1) phalaṃ rāma kārṣikāṇyupakalpayet / taccūrṇe khadiraṃ sāraṃ dadyātturyaṃ tu vāsitaṃ(2)
sahakārarasenāsmāt kartavyā guṭikāḥ śubhāḥ(3) / mukha nyastāḥ sugandhāstā mukharogavināśanāḥ
pūgaṃ prakṣālitaṃ samyak pañcapallavavāriṇā / śaktyā tu guṭikādravyair vāsitaṃ mukhavāsakaṃ
kaṭukaṃ dantakāṣṭhañca gomūtre vāsitaṃ tryahaṃ / kṛtañca pūgavadrāma mukhasaugandhikārakaṃ
tvakpathyayoḥ samāvaṃśau śaśibhāgārdhasaṃyutau / nāgavallīsamo bhāti mukhavāso manoharaḥ

1 kandukañceti kha.. , cha.. ca 2 dadyātturthaṃ tulonmitamiti ṭa.. , cha.. ca 3 kakkolailetyādiḥ guṭikāḥ śubhā ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja.. pustakadvaye nāsti :p 316 evaṃ kuryāt sadā strīṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ / na cāsāṃ viśvasejjātu putramāturviśeṣataḥ
na svapet strīgṛhe rātrau viśvāsaḥ kṛtrimo bhavet
rājadharmāḥ puṣkara uvāca rājaputrasya rakṣā ca kartavyā pṛthivīkṣitā / dharmārthakāmaśāstrāṇi dhanurvedañca śikṣayet
śilpāni śikṣayeccaivamāptair mithyāpriyaṃvadaiḥ / śarīrarakṣāvyājena rakṣiṇo 'sya niyojayet
na cāsya saṅgo dātavyaḥ kruddhalubdhavimānitaiḥ / aśakyantu guṇādhānaṃ kartuṃ taṃ bandhayet mukhaiḥ
adhikāreṣu sarveṣu vinītaṃ viniyojayet / mṛgayāṃ pānamakṣāṃś ca rājyanāśaṃstyajennṛpaḥ
divāsvapnaṃ vṛthāṭyāñca vākpāruṣyaṃ vivarjayet / nindāñca daṇḍapāruṣyamarthadūṣaṇamutsṛjet
ākārāṇāṃ samuchedo durgādīnāmasatkriyā / arthānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ viprakīrṇatvameva ca
adeśakāle yaddānamapātre dānameva ca / artheṣu dūṣaṇaṃ proktamasatkarmapravartanaṃ
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ mānaṃ lobhaṃ darpañca varjayet / tato bhṛtyajayaṅkṛtvā paurajānapadaṃ jayet
jayedvāhyānarīn paścādvāhyāś ca trividhārayaḥ / guravaste yathā pūrvaṃ kulyānantarakṛtrimāḥ
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mitraṃ sāmantañca tathā ripoḥ / kṛtrimañca mahābhāga mitrantrividhamucyate
svāmyamātyañjanapadā durgaṃ daṇdastathaiva ca / koṣo mitrañca dharmajña saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate
mūlaṃ svāmī sa vai rakṣyastasmādrājyaṃ(1) viśeṣataḥ / rājyāṅgadrohiṇaṃ hanyātkāle tīkṣṇo mṛdurbhavet
evaṃ lokadvayaṃ rājño bhṛtyair hāsaṃ vivarjayet / bhṛtyāḥ paribhavantīha nṛpaṃ harṣaṇasatkathaṃ
lokasaṅgrahaṇārthāya kṛtakavyasano bhavet / smitapūrvābhibhāṣī syāt lokānāṃ rañjanaṃ caret
dīrghasūtrasya nṛpateḥ karmahānirdhruvaṃ bhavet / rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi
apriye caiva vaktavye dīrghasūtraḥ praśasyate / suptamantro bhavedrājā nāpado guptamantrataḥ
1 tasmādrāṣṭramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca :p 318 jñāyate hi kṛtaṃ karma nārabdhaṃ tasya rājyakaṃ(1) / ākārair iṅgitair gatyā ceṣṭayā bhāṣitena ca
netravaktavikārābhyāṃ gṛhyate 'ntargataṃ punaḥ / naikastu mantrayen mantraṃ na rājā bahubhiḥ saha
bahubhirmantrayet kāmaṃ rājā mantrān pṛthak pṛthak / mantriṇāmapi no kuryān mantrī mantraprakāśanaṃ
kvāpi kasyāpi(2) viśvāso bhavatīha sadā nṛṇāṃ / niś cayaś ca tathā mantre kārya ekena sūriṇā
naśyedavinayādrājā rājyañca vinayāllabhet / traividyebhyastrayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiñca śāśvatīṃ
ānvīkṣikīñcārthavidyāṃ vārtārambhāṃś ca lokataḥ / jitendriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ
pūjyā devā dvijāḥ sarve dadyāddānāni teṣu ca / dvije dānañcākṣayo 'yaṃ nidhiḥ kaiścinna nāśyate
saṅgrāmeṣvanivartitvaṃ prajānāṃ paripālanaṃ / dānāni brāhmaṇānāñca rājño niḥśreyasamparaṃ
kṛpaṇānāthavṛddhānāṃ vidhavānāñca yoṣitāṃ / yogakṣemañca vṛttiñca tathaiva parikalpayet
varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kāryantāpasapūjanaṃ / na viśvasecca sarvatra tāpaseṣu ca viśvaset
viśvāsayeccāpi parantattvabhūtena hetunā / 1 tasya karmakamiti kha.. 2 kvacit kasyāpi iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca :p 319 vakaviccintayedarthaṃ siṃhavacca parākramet
vṛkavaccāvalumpeta śaśavacca viniṣpatet / dṛḍhapraharī ca bhavet tathā śūkaravannṛpaḥ
citrakāraś ca śikhivad dṛḍhabhaktis tathāśvavat / bhavecca madhurābhāṣī tathā kokilavannṛpaḥ
kākaśaṅkī bhavennityamajñātāṃ vasatiṃ vaset / nāparīkṣitapūrvañca bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ spṛśet
nāvijñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchennājñātāṃ nāvamārudvet / rāṣṭrakarṣī bhrasyate ca rājyārthāccaiva jīvitāt
bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ karmayogyo yathā bhavet / tathā rāṣṭraṃ mahābhāga bhṛtaṃ karmasahaṃ bhavet
sarvaṃ karmedamāyattaṃ vidhāne daivapauruṣe / tayordaivamacintyaṃ hi pauruṣe vidyate kriyā
janānurāgaprabhavā rājño rājyamahīśriyaḥ //34
rājadharmāḥ puṣkara uvāca svayameva karma daivākhyaṃ viddhi dehāntarārjitaṃ / tasmāt pauruṣameveha śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
pratikūlaṃ tathā daivaṃ pauruṣeṇa vihanyate / sāttvikāt karmaṇaḥ pūrvāt siddhiḥ syātpauruṣaṃ vinā
pauruṣaṃ daivasampattyā kāle phalati bhārgava / daivaṃ puruṣakāraś ca dvayaṃ puṃsaḥ phalāvahaṃ
kṛṣervṛṣṭisamāyogāt kāle syuḥ phalasiddhayaḥ / sadharmaṃ pauruṣaṃ kuryānnālaso na ca daivavān
sāmādibhirupāyaistu sarve siddhyantyupakramāḥ / sāma copapradānañca bhedadaṇḍau tathāparau
māyopekṣendrajālañca upāyāḥ sapta tāñchṛṇu / dvividhaṃ kathitaṃ sāma tathyañcātathyameva ca
tatrāpyatathyaṃ sādhūnāmākrośāyaiva jāyate / mahākulīnā hy ṛjavo dharmanityā jitendriyāḥ
sāmasādhyā atathyaiś ca gṛhyante rākṣasā api / tathā taduprakārāṇāṃ kṛtānāñcaiva varṇanaṃ
parasparantu ye dviṣṭāḥ kruddhabhītāvamānitāḥ / teṣānbhedaṃ prayuñjīta paramaṃ darśayedbhayaṃ(1)
ātmīyān darśayedāśāṃ yena doṣeṇa bibhyati / parāstenaiva te bhedyā rakṣyo vai jñātibhedakaḥ
sāmantakoṣo vāhyastu mantrāmātyātmajādikaḥ(2) / antaḥkoṣañcopaśāmya kurvan śatroś ca taṃ jayet
upāyaśreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ syāddānādubhayalokabhāk / na so 'sti nāma dānena vaśago yo na jāyate
1 parasmādarśayedbhayamiti ña.. 2 mantrāmātyānujādika iti ña.. :p 321 dānavāneva śaknoti saṃhatān bhedituṃ parān / trayāsādhyaṃ sādhayettaṃ daṇḍena ca kṛtena ca
daṇḍe sarvaṃ sthitaṃ daṇḍo nāśayedduṣpraṇīkṛtaḥ / adaṇḍyān daṇḍayannaśyeddaṇḍyānrājāpyadaṇḍayan
daivadaityoraganarāḥ siddhā bhūtāḥ patatriṇaḥ / utkrameyuḥ svamaryādāṃ yadi daṇḍān na pālayet
yasmādadāntān damayatyadaṇḍyāndaṇḍayatyapi / damanāddaṇḍanāccaiva tasmāddaṇḍa vidurbudhāḥ
tejasā dur nirīkṣyo hi rājā bhāskaravattataḥ / lokaprasādaṃ gaccheta darśanāccandravattataḥ
jagadvyāpnoti vai cārair ato rājā samīraṇaḥ / doṣanigrahakāritvādrājā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ
yadā dahati durbuddhiṃ tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ / yadā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyāt tasmāddhaneśvaraḥ
dhanadhārāpravarṣitvāddevādau varuṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / kṣamayā dhārayaṃllekān pārthivaḥ pārthivo bhavet
utsāhamantraśaktyādyai rakṣedyasmāddharistataḥ
rājadharmāḥ puṣkara uvāca daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ vakṣye yena rājñaḥ parā gatiḥ / triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ viddhi pāpastatpañcakaṃ bhavet
kṛṣṇalānāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭyā(1) karṣārdhaṃ rāmakīrtitaṃ / suvarṇaś ca vinirdiṣṭo rāma ṣoḍaśamāpakaḥ
niṣkaḥ suvarṇāś catvāro dharaṇaṃ daśabhistu taiḥ / tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ manametat prakīrtitaṃ
tāmrakaiḥ kārṣiko rāma proktaḥ kārṣāpaṇo budhaiḥ / paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhaṃ prathamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ(2)
madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasramapi cottamaḥ / caurair amūṣito yastu mūṣito 'smīti bhāṣate
tatpradātari bhāpāle sa daṇḍyastāvadeva tu / yo yāvadviparītārthaṃ mithyā vā yo vadettu taṃ
tau nṛpeṇa hy adharmajñau dāpyau taddviguṇaṃ damaṃ(3) / kūṭasākṣyantu kurvāṇāṃstrīn varṇāṃś ca pradāpayet
vivāsayedbrāhmaṇantu bhojyo vidhir na hīrataḥ / nikṣepasya samaṃ mūlyaṃ daṇḍyo nikṣepabhuk tathā

1 tathācāṣṭau iti cha.. , ja.. ca 2 tāmrikaiḥ kārṣika ity ādiḥ, sāhasaḥ smṛta ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti 3 yo yāvadityādiḥ, taddviguṇaṃ damamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti :p 323 vastrādikasya dharmajña tathā dharmo na hīyate / yo nikṣepaṃ ghātayati yaścānikṣipya yācate
tāvubhau cauravacchāsyau daṇḍyau vā dviguṇaṃ dama / ajñānādyaḥ pumān kuryāt paradravyasya vikrayaṃ
nirdoṣo jñānapūrvakantu cauravaddaṇḍamarhati(1) / mūlyamādāya yaḥ śilpaṃ na dadyād daṇḍya eva saḥ
pratiśrutyāpradātāraṃ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍayennṛpaḥ / bhṛtiṃ gṛhya na kuryādyaḥ karmāṣṭau kṛṣṇalā damaḥ
akāle tu tyajan bhṛtyaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāttāvadeva tu / krītvā vikrīya vā kiñcidyasyehānuśayo bhavet
so 'ntardaśāhāttatsvāmī dadyāccaivādadīta ca / pareṇa tu daśāhasya nādadyānnaiva dāpayet
ādadaddhi dadaccaiva rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ / vare doṣānavikhyāpya yaḥ kanyāṃ varayediha(2)
dattāpyadattā sā tasya rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatadvayaṃ / pradāya kanyāṃ yo 'nyasmai punastāṃ samprayacchati
daṇḍaḥ kāryo narendreṇa tasyāpyuttamasāhasaḥ / satyaṅkāreṇa vācā ca yuktaṃ puṇyamasaṃśayaṃ
lubdho 'nyatra ca vikretā ṣaṭśataṃ daṇḍamarhati / dadyāddhenuṃ na yaḥ pālo gṛhītvā bhaktavetanaṃ
sa tu daṇḍyaḥ śataṃ rājñā suvarṇaṃ vāpyarakṣitā / 1 cauravadvadhamarhatoti gha.. , ña.. ca 2 varayedyadi iti gha.. , ña.. ca :p 324 dhanuḥśataṃ parīṇāho grāmasya tu samantataḥ
dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi nagarasya ca kalpayet / vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yāmuṣṭro nāvalokayet
tatrāparivṛte dhānye hiṃsite naiva daṇḍanaṃ / gṛhantaḍāgamārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā bhīṣayā haran
śatāni pañca daṇḍyāḥ syādajñānād dviśato damaḥ / maryādābhedakāḥ sarve daṇḍyāḥ prathamasāhasaṃ
śataṃ brāhmaṇamākruśya kṣatriyo daṇḍamarhati / vaiśyaś ca dviśataṃ rāma śūdraś ca badhamarhati
pañcāśadbrāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣatriyasyābhiśaṃsane / vaiśye vāpyardhapañcāśacchūdre dvādaśako damaḥ
kṣatriyasyāpnuyādvaiśyaḥ sāhasaṃ pūrvameva tu / śūdraḥ kṣatriyamākruśya jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt
dharmopadeśaṃ viprāṇāṃ śūdraḥ kurvaṃś ca daṇḍabhāk / śrutadeśādivitathī dāpyo dviguṇasāhasaṃ
uttamaḥ sāhasastasya yaḥ pāpair uttamān kṣipet / pramādādyair mayā proktaṃ prītyā daṇḍārdhamarhati
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ śvaśuraṃ guruṃ / ākṣārayañcchataṃ daṇḍyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadadguroḥ
antyajātirdvijātintu yenāṅgenāparādhnuyāt / tadeva cchedayettasya kṣipramevāvicārayan
avaniṣṭhīvato darpād dvāvoṣṭhau chedayennṛpaḥ / apamūtrayato meḍhramapaśabdayato gudaṃ
utkṛṣṭāsanasaṃsthasya nīcasyādhonikṛntanaṃ / yo yadaṅgaṃ ca rujayettadaṅgantasya kartayet
ardhapādakarāḥ kāryā gogajāśvoṣṭraghātakāḥ / vṛkṣantu viphalaṃ kṛttvā suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati
dviguṇaṃ dāpayecchinne pathi sīmni jalāśaye / dravyāṇi yo haredyasya jñānato 'jñānato 'pivā
sa tasyotpādya tuṣṭintu rājñe dadyāttato damaṃ / yastu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpāddharecchindyācca tāṃ prapāṃ
sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyān māsaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāt prāṇitā.rane / dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato 'bhyadhikaṃ badhaḥ
śeṣe 'pyekādaśaguṇaṃ tasya daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet / suvarṇarajatādīnāṃ nṛstrīṇāṃ haraṇe badhaḥ
yena yena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣu viceṣṭate / tattadeva haredasy pratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ śākadhānyādi alpaṃ gṛhṇanna doṣabhāk / godevārthaṃ haraṃścāpi hanyādduṣṭaṃ badhīdyataṃ
gṛhakṣetrāpahartāraṃ tathā patnyabhigāminaṃ / agnidaṃ garadaṃ hanyāttathā cābhyudyatāyudhaṃ
rājā gavābhicārādyaṃ hanyāccaivātatāyinaḥ / parastriyaṃ na bhāṣeta pratiṣiddho viśenna hi
adaṇḍyā strī bhavedrājñā varayanto patiṃ svayaṃ / uttamāṃ sevamānaḥ strī jaghanyo badhamarhati
bhartāraṃ laṅghayedyā tāṃ śvabhiḥ saṅghātayet striyaṃ / savarṇadūṣitāṃ kuryāt piṇḍamātropajīvinīṃ
jyāyasā dūṣitā nārī muṇḍanaṃ samavāpnuyāt / vaiśyāgame tu viprasya kṣatriyasyāntyajāgame
kṣatriyaḥ prathamaṃ vaiśyo daṇḍyaḥ śūdrāgame bhavet / gṛhītvā vetanaṃ veśyā lobhādanyatra gacchati
vetanandviguṇaṃ dadyāddaṇdañca dviguṇaṃ tathā / bhāryā putrāś ca dāsāś ca śiṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ
kṛṭāparādhāstāḍyāḥ sūrajvā veṇudalena vā / pṛṣṭhe na mastake hanyāccaurasyāpnoti kilviṣaṃ
rakṣāsvadhikṛtaiyastu prajātyarthaṃ vilupyate / teṣāṃ sarvasvamādāya rājā kuryāt pravāsanaṃ
ye niyuktāḥ svakāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi karmiṇāṃ / nirghṛṇāḥ krūramanasastānniḥsvān kārayennṛpaḥ
amātyaḥ prāḍvivāko vā yaḥ kuryāt kāryamanyathā / tasya sarvasvamādāya taṃ rājā vipravāsayet
gurutalpe bhayaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāṇe surādhvajaḥ / steyeṣu śvapadaṃ vidyād brahmahatyāśiraḥ pumān
śūdrādīn ghātayedrājā pāpān viprān pravāsayet / mahāpātakināṃ vittaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet
grāmeṣvapi ca ye keciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ / bhāṇḍārakoṣadāś caiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet
rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrādhikṛtān sāmantān pāpino haret / sandhiṃ kṛtvā tu ye cauryaṃ rātrau kurvanti taskarāḥ
teṣāṃ cchitvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet / taḍāgadevatāgārabhedakān ghātayennṛpaḥ
samutsṛjedrājamārge yastvamedhyamanāpadi / sa hi kārṣāpaṇandaṇḍyastamamedhyañca śodhayet
pratimāsaṅkramabhido dadyuḥ pañcaśatāni te / samaiś ca viṣamaṃ yo vā carate mūlyato 'pi vā
samāpnuyānnaraḥ pūrvaṃ damaṃ madhyamameva vā / dravyamādāya vaṇijāmanargheṇāvarundhatāṃ
rājā pṛthak pṛthak kuryāddaṇḍamuttamasāhasaṃ / dravyāṇāṃ dūṣako yaś ca praticchandakavikrayī
madhyamaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kūṭakartā tathottamaṃ / kalahāpakṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍaś ca dviguṇastataḥ
abhakṣyabhakṣye vipre vā śūdre vā kṛṣṇalo damaḥ / tulāśāsanakartā ca kūṭakṛnnāśakasya ca
ebhiś ca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo damamuttamaṃ / viṣāgnidāṃ patiguruviprāpatyapramāpiṇīṃ
vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhī kṛtvā gobhiḥ pravāsayet / kṣetraveśmagrāmavanavidārakās tathā narāḥ
rājapatnyabhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā / ūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanaṃ
pārajāyikacaurau ca muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ / rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ
yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ / tamāyāntaṃ parājitya(1) daṇḍayed dviguṇaṃ damaṃ
āhvānakārī badhyaḥ syādanāhūtamathāhvayan / dāṇḍikasya ca yo hastādabhimuktaḥ palāyate
hīnaḥ puruṣakāreṇa tad dadyāddāṇḍiko dhanaṃ
yuddhayātrā puṣkara uvāca yadā manyeta nṛpatirākrandena balīyasā / pārṣṇigrāho 'bhibhūto me tadā yātrāṃ prayojayet
puṣtā yodhā bhṛṭā bhṛtyāḥ prabhūtañca balaṃ mama / mūlarakṣāsamartho 'smi tair gatvā(2) śivire vrajet
śatrorvā vyasane yāyāt daivādyaiḥ pīḍitaṃ paraṃ / bhūkampo yāndiśaṃ yāti yāñca keturvyadūṣayat
vidviṣṭanāśakaṃ sainyaṃ sambhūtāntaḥprakopanaṃ(3) / śarīrasphuraṇe dhanye tathā susvapradarśane

tathāvidhannaraḥ paśyetsāraṅgaṃ prathame 'hani / ātmanaś ca tathātvena jñātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ phalaṃ
śakunāni puṣkara uvāca viśanti yena mārgeṇa vāyasā bahavaḥ puraṃ / tena mārgeṇa ruddhasya purasya grahaṇaṃ bhavet
senāyāṃ yadi vāsārthe niviṣṭo vāyaso ruvan / vāmo bhayāturastrasto bhayaṃ vadati dustaraṃ(1)
chāyāṅgavāhanopānacchatravastrādikuṭṭane / mṛtyustatpūjane pūjā tadiṣṭakaraṇe śubhaṃ
proṣitāgamakṛtkākaḥ kurvan dvāri gatāgataṃ / raktaṃ dagdhaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipanvahnivedakaḥ
nyasedraktaṃ purastācca nivedayati bandhanaṃ / pītaṃ dravyaṃ tathā rukma rūpyameva tu bhārgava
yaccaivopanayed dravyaṃ tasya labdhiṃ vinirdiśet / dravyaṃ vāpanayedyattu tasya hāniṃ vinirdiśet
purato dhanalabdhiḥ syādāmamāṃsasya chardane / bhūlabdhiḥ syān mṛdaḥ kṣepe rājyaṃ ratnārpaṇe mahat
yātuḥ kāko 'nukūlastu kṣemaḥ karmakṣamo bhavet / na tvarthasādhako jñeyaḥ pratikūlo bhayāvahaḥ
sammukhe 'bhyeti viruvan yātrāghātakaro bhavet / vāmaḥ kākaḥ smṛto dhanyo dakṣiṇo 'rthavināśakṛt(2)
1 duṣkaramiti kha.. , cha ca 2 dakṣiṇo 'nnavināśakṛditi ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca :p 339 vāmo 'nulomagaḥ śreṣṭho madhyamo dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / pratilomagatirvāmo gamanapratiṣedhakṛt
nivedayati yātrārthamabhipretaṃ gṛhe gataḥ(1) / ekākṣaracaraṇastvarkaṃ vīkṣamāṇo bhayāvahaḥ
koṭare vāsamānaś ca mahānarthakaro bhavet / na śubhastūṣare kākaḥ paṅkāṅkaḥ sa tu śasyate
amedhyapūrṇavadanaḥ kākaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ(2) / jñeyāḥ patatriṇo 'nye 'pi kākavad bhṛgunandana
skandhāvārāpasavyasthāḥ śvāno vipravināśakāḥ / indrasthāne narendrasya pureśasya tu gopure
antargṛhe gṛheśasya maraṇāya bhavedbhaṣan / yasya jighrati vāmāṅgaṃ tasya syādarthasiddhaye
bhayāya dakṣiṇaṃ cāṅgaṃ tathā bhujamadakṣiṇaṃ / yātrāghātakaro yāturbhavet pratimukhāgataḥ
mārgāvarodhako mārge caurān vadati bhārgava / alābho 'sthimukhaḥ pāpo rajjucīramukhas tathā
sopānatkamukho dhanyo māṃsapūrṇamukho 'pi ca / amaṅgalyamukhadravyaṃ keśañcaivāśubhaṃ tathā
avamūtryāgrato yāti yasya tasya bhayaṃ bhavet / yasyāvamūtrya vrajati śubhaṃ deśantathā drumaṃ

1 nanvarthasādhaka ity ādiḥ, gṛhe gata ity antaḥḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa.. pustake nāsti 2 koṭare ity ādiḥ sarvārthasādhaka ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ ṭa..pustake nāsti :p 340 maṅgalañca tathā dravyaṃ tasya syādarthasiddhaye / śvavacca rāma vijñeyās tathā vai jambukādayaḥ
bhayāya svāmini jñeyamanimittaṃ rutaṅgavāṃ / niśi caurabhayāya syādvikṛtaṃ mṛtyave tathā
śivāya svāmino rātrau balīvardo nadan bhavet / utsṛṣṭavṛṣabho rājño vijayaṃ samprayacchati
abhayaṃ bhakṣayantyaś ca gāvo dattās tathā svakāḥ / tyaktasnehāḥ svavatseṣu garbhakṣayakarā matāḥ
bhūmiṃ pādair vinighnantyo dīnā bhītā bhayāvahāḥ / ārdrāṅgyo hṛṣṭaromāś ca śṛgalagnamṛdaḥ śubhāḥ
mahiṣyādiṣu cāpyetat sarvaṃ vācyaṃ vijānatā / ārohaṇaṃ tathānyena saparyāṇasya(1) vājinaḥ
jalopaveśanaṃ neṣṭaṃ bhūmau ca parivartanaṃ / vipatkaranturaṅgasya suptaṃ vāpyanimittataḥ
yavamodakayordveṣastvakasmācca na śasyate / vadanādrudhirotpattirvepanaṃ na ca śasyate
krīḍan vaikaḥ kapotaiś ca sārikābhirmṛtiṃ vadet / sāśrunetro jihvayā ca pādalehī vinaṣṭaye(2)
vāmapādena ca tathā vilikhaṃś ca vasundharāṃ / svapedvā vāmapārśvena divā vā na śubhapradaḥ
bhayāya syāt sakṛnmūtrī tathā nidrāvilānanaḥ / 1 saparyārhasyeti sādhuḥ 2 vināśakṛditi ja.. , ṭa.. ca :p 341 ārohaṇaṃ na ceddadyāt pratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet
yātrāvighātamācaṣṭe vāmapārśvaṃ tathā spṛśan / heṣamāṇaḥ śatruyodhaṃ pādasparśī jayāvahaḥ
grāme vrajati nāgaścen maithunaṃ deśahā bhavet / prasūtā nāgavanitā mattā cāntāya bhūpateḥ
ārohaṇaṃ na ceddadyāt pratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet / madaṃ vā vāraṇo jahyādrājaghātakaro bhavet
vāmaṃ dakṣiṇapādena pādamākramate śubhaḥ / dakṣiṇañca tathā dantaṃ parimārṣṭi kareṇa ca
vṛṣo 'śvaḥ kuñjaro vāpi ripusainyagato 'śubhaḥ / khaṇḍameghātivṛṣṭyā tu senā nāśamavāpnuyāt
pratikūlagraharkṣāttu tathā sammukhamārutāt(1) / yātrākāle raṇe vāpi chatrādipatanaṃ bhayaṃ
hṛṣṭā narāścānulomā grahā vai jayalakṣaṇaṃ / kākair yodhābhibhavanaṃ kravyādbhirmaṇḍalakṣayaḥ
prācīpaścimakaiśānī śaumyā preṣṭhā śubhā ca dik
yātrāmaṇḍalacintādiḥ puṣkara uvāca sarvayātrāṃ pravakṣyāmi rājadharmasamāśrayāt / astaṅgate nīcagate vikale ripurāśige
pratilome ca vidhvaste śukre yātrāṃ visarjayet(1) / pratilome budhe yātrāṃ dikpatau ca tathā ca grahe
vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte nāge ca śakunau tathā / catuṣpāde ca kintughne tathā yātrāṃ vivarjayet
vipattāre naidhane ca pratyarau cātha janmani / gaṇḍe vivarjayedyātrāṃ riktāyāñca tithāvapi
udīcī ca tathā prācī(2) tayoraikyaṃ prakīrtitaṃ / paścimā dakṣiṇā yā dik tayoraikyaṃ tathaiva ca
vāyvagnidiksamudbhūtaṃ parighanna tu laṅghayet / ādityacandraśaurāstu divasāś ca na śobhanāḥ
kṛttikādyāni pūrveṇa maghādyāni ca yāmyataḥ / maitrādyānyapare cātha vāsavādyāni vāpyudak
sarvadvārāṇi śastāni chāyāmānaṃ vadāmi te / āditye viṃśatirjñeyāś candre ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ
bhaume pañcadaśaivoktāś caturdaśa tathā budhe / 1 vivarjayet iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca 2 dik pūrvā yā tathodīcīti ja.. :p 343 trayodaśa tathā jīye śukre dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
ekādaśa tathā saure sarvakarmasu kīrtitāḥ / janmalagne śakracāpe sammukhe na vrajennaraḥ
śakunādau śubhe yāyājjayāya harimāsmaran / vakṣye maṇḍalacintānte kartavyaṃ rājarakṣaṇaṃ
svāmyamātyaṃ tathā durgaṃ koṣo daṇḍastathaiva ca / mitrañjanapadaś caiva rājyaṃ saptāṅgamucyate
saptāṅgasya tu rājyasya vighnakartṝn vināśayet / maṇḍaleṣu ca sarveṣu vṛddhiḥ kāryā mahīkṣitā
ātmamaṇḍalamevātra prathamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet / sāmantāstasya vijñeyā ripavo maṇḍalasya tu
upetastu suhṛj jñeyaḥ śatrumitramataḥ paraṃ / mitramitraṃ tato jñeyaṃ mitramitraripustataḥ
etatpurastāt kathitaṃ paścādapi nibodha me / pārṣṇigrāhastataḥ paścāttatastvākranda ucyate(1)
āsārastu tato 'nyaḥ syādākrandāsāra ucyate / jigīṣoḥ śatruyuktasya vimuktasya tathā dvija
nātrāpi niś cayaḥ śakyo vaktuṃ manujapuṅgava / nigrahānugrahe śakto madhyasthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
nigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ sarveṣāmapi yo bhavet / udāsīnaḥ sa kathito balavān pṛthivīpatiḥ

1 maṇḍaleṣu ca sarveṣu sureśvarasamā hi te ity ardhaśloka āsārastvityasya pūrvaṃ ṭa.. pustake vartate, parantvasaṃlagnaḥ :p 344 na kasyacidripurmitraṅkāraṇācchatrumitrake / maṇḍalaṃ tava samproktametad dvādaśarājakaṃ
trividhā ripavo jñeyāḥ kulyānantarakṛtrimāḥ / pūrvapūrvo gurusteṣāṃ duścikitsyatamo mataḥ
anantaro 'pi yaḥ śatruḥ so 'pi me kṛtrimo mataḥ / pārṣṇigrāho bhavecchatrormitrāṇi ripavas tathā
pārṣṇigrāhamupāyaiś ca śamayecca tathā svakaṃ / mitreṇa śatrorucchedaṃ praśaṃsanti purātanāḥ
mitrañca śatrutāmeti sāmantatvādanantaraṃ / śatruṃ jigoṣurucchindyāt(1) svayaṃ śaknoti cedyadi
pratāpavṛddhau tenāpi nāmitrājjāyate bhayaṃ / yathāsya nodvijelloko viśvāsaś ca yathā bhavet
jigīṣurdharmavijayī tathā lokaṃ vaśannayet /
ṣāḍguṇyaṃ puṣkara uvāca sāmabhedau mayā proktau dānadaṇḍau tathaiva ca / daṇḍaḥ svadeśe kathitaḥ paradeśe vravīmi te
1 śatruṃ jihīrṣurucchindyāditi gha.. , ña.. ca :p 345 prakāśaścāprakāśaś ca dvividho daṇḍa ucyate / luṇṭhanaṃ grāmaghātaś ca śasyaghāto 'gnidīpanaṃ
prakāśo 'tha viṣaṃ vahnirvividhaiḥ puruṣair badhaḥ / dūṣaṇañcaiva sādhūnāmudakānāñca dūṣaṇaṃ
daṇḍapraṇayaṇaṃ proktamupekṣāṃ śṛṇu bhārgava / yadā manyate nṛpatī raṇe na mama vigrahaḥ
anarthāyānubandhaḥ syāt sandhinā ca tathā bhavet / sāmalabdhāspadañcātra dānañcārthakṣayaṅkaraṃ
bhedadaṇḍānubandhaḥ syāttadopekṣāṃ samāśrayet / na cāyaṃ mama śaknoti kiñcit kartumupadravaṃ
na cāhamasya śaknomi tatropekṣāṃ samāśrayet / avajñopahatastatra rājñā kāryo ripurbhavet
māyopāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi utpātair anṛtaiś carat / śatrorudvejanaṃ śatroḥ śivirasthasya pakṣiṇaḥ
sthūlasya tasya pucchasthāṃ kṛtvolkāṃ vipulāṃ dvija / visṛjecca tataś caivamulkāpātaṃ pradarśayet
evamanye darśanīyā utpātā bahavo 'pi ca / udvejanaṃ tathā kuryāt kuhakair vividhair dviṣāṃ
sāṃvatsarāstāpasāś ca nāśaṃ brūyuḥ prarasya ca / jigīṣuḥ pṛthivīṃ rājā tena codvejayet parān
devatānāṃ prasādaś ca kīrtanīyaḥ parasya tu / āgatanno 'mitrabalaṃ praharadhvamabhītavat
evaṃ brūyādraṇe prāpte bhagnāḥ sarve pare iti / kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāḥ kāryā vācyaḥ śatrurhatas tathā
devājñāvṛṃhito rājā sannaddhaḥ samaraṃ prati / indrajālaṃ pravakṣyāmi indraṃ kālena darśayet
caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājā sahāyārthaṃ divaukasāṃ / balantu darśayet prāptaṃ raktavṛṣṭiñcendrapau
chinnāni ripuśīrṣāṇi prāsādāgreṣu darśayet(1) / ṣāḍguṇyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tadvarau sandhivigrahau
sandhiś ca vigrahaś caiva yānamāsanameva ca / dvaidhībhāvaḥ saṃśayaś ca ṣaḍguṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
paṇabandhaḥ smṛtaḥ sandhirapakārastu vigrahaḥ / jigīṣoḥ śatruviṣaye yānaṃ yātrābhidhīyate
vigraheṇa svake deśe sthitirāsanamucyate / balārdhena prayāṇantu dvaidhībhāvaḥ sa ucyate
udāsīno madhyago vā saṃśrayātsaṃśayaḥ smṛtaḥ / samena sandhiranveṣyo 'hīnena ca balīyasā
hīnena vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ svayaṃ rājñā balīyasā / tatrāpi śuddhapārṣṇistu balīyāṃsaṃ samāśrayet
āsīnaḥ karmavicchedaṃ śaktaḥ kartuṃ riporyadā / aśuddhapārṣṇiścāsīta vigṛhya vasudhādhipaḥ
aśuddhapārṣṇirbalavān dvaidhībhāvaṃ samāśrayet / balinā vigṛhītastu(2) yo 'sandehena pārthivaḥ
saṃśrayastena vaktavyo guṇānāmadhamo guṇaḥ / 1 prāsādāgre pradarśayediti ṭa.. 2 vigṛhītastu iti kha.. :p 347 bahukṣayavyayāyāsaṃ(1) teṣāṃ yānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ
bahulābhakaraṃ paścāttadā rājā samāśrayet(2) / sarvaśaktivihīnastu tadā kuryāttu saṃśrayaṃ
prātyahikarājakarma puṣkara uvāca ajasraṃ karma vakṣyāmi dinaṃ prati yadācaret / dvimuhūrtāvaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau nidrāntyajennṛpaḥ
vādyavandisvanair gītaiḥ paśyed gūḍhāṃstato narān / vijñāyate na ye lokāstadīyā iti kenacit
āyavyayasya śravaṇaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi / vegotsargaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rājā snānagṛhaṃ vrajet
snānaṃ kuryānnṛpaḥ paścāddantadhāvanapūrvakaṃ / kṛtvā sandhyāntato japyaṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet

vahnau pavitrān juhuyāt tarpayedudakaiḥ pitṝn / 1 bahukṣayavyayāyāmiti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca 2 āsīnaḥ karmavicchedamityādiḥ, rājā samāśrayedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake nāsti :p 348 dadyātsakāñcīṃ dhenuṃ dvijāśīrvādasaṃyutaḥ
anulipto 'laṅkṛtaś ca mukhaṃ paśyecca darpaṇe / sasuvarṇe dhṛte rājā śṛṇuyāddivasādikaṃ
auṣadhaṃ bhiṣajoktaṃ ca maṅgalālambhanañcaret / paśced guruṃ tena dattāśīrvado 'tha vrajetsabhāṃ
tatrastho brāhmaṇān paśyedamātyānmantriṇas tathā / prakṛtīś ca mahābhāga pratīhāraniveditāḥ
śrutvetihāsaṃ kāryāṇi kāryāṇāṃ kāryanirṇayam / vyavahārantataḥ paśyenmantraṃ kuryāttu mantribhiḥ
naikena sahitaḥ kuryānna kuryādbahubhiḥ saha / na ca mūrkhair nacānāptair guptaṃ na prakaṭaṃ caret(1)
mantraṃ svadhiṣṭhitaṃ kuryādyena rāṣṭraṃ na bādhate / ākāragrahaṇe rājño mantrarakṣā parā matā(2)
ākārair iṅgitaiḥ prajñā mantraṃ gṛhṇanti paṇḍitāḥ / sāṃvatsarāṇāṃ vaidyānāṃ mantriṇāṃ vacane rataḥ
rājā vibhūtimāpnoti(3) dhārayanti nṛpaṃ hi te / mantraṃ kṛtvātha vyāyāmañcakre yāne ca śastrake
niḥsattvādau nṛpaḥ snātaḥ paśyedviṣṇuṃ supūjitaṃ / hutañca pāvakaṃ paśyedviprān paśyetsupūjitān

1 guptaṃ cāprakaṭaṃ carediti ga.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca 2 ākāra grahaṇe rājño mantrarakṣā parā matā ity asya sthāne ākāreṅgitatattvajñaḥ kāryākāryavicakṣaṇa iti ṭa.. pustakapāṭhaḥ 3 rājādhibhūtimāpnotīti ja.. :p 349 bhūṣito bhojanaṅkuryād dānādyaiḥ suparīkṣitaṃ / bhuktvā gṛhītatāmbūlo vāmapārśvena saṃsthitaḥ(1)
śāstrāṇi cintayed dṛṣṭvā yodhān koṣṭhāyudhaṃ gṛhaṃ / anvāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ kāryāṇi ca vicintya tu
carān sampreṣya bhuktānnamantaḥpuracaro bhavet / vādyagītair akṣito 'nyair evannityañcarennṛpaḥ
raṇadīkṣā puṣkara uvāca yātrāvidhānapūrvantu vakṣye sāṅgrāmikaṃ vidhiṃ / saptāhena yadā yātrā bhaviṣyati mahīpateḥ
pūjanīyo hariḥ śambhurmodakādyair vināyakaḥ / dvitīye 'hani dikpālān sampūjya śayanañcaret
śayyāyāṃ vā tadagre 'tha devān prārcya manuṃ smaret / namaḥ śambhoḥ trinetrāya rudrāya varadāya ca
vāmanāya virūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ / 1 saṃviśediti ja.. :p 350 bhagavandevadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana
iṣṭāniṣṭe mamācakṣva svapne suptasya śāśvata / yajjāgrato dūramiti purodhā mantramuccaret
tṛtīye 'hani dikpālān rudrāṃstān dikpatīnyajet / grahān yajeccaturthe 'hni pañcame cāśvinau yajet
mārge yā devatāstāsānnadyādīnāñca pūjanaṃ / divyāntarīkṣabhaumasthadevānāñca tathā baliḥ
rātrau bhūtagaṇānāñca vāsudevādipūjanaṃ / bhadrakālyāḥ śriyaḥ kuryāt prārthayet sarvadevatāḥ
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ / nārāyaṇo 'bjajo viṣṇur nārasiṃho varāhakaḥ
śiva īśastatpuruṣo(1) hy aghoro rāma satyajaḥ(2) / sūryaḥ somaḥ kujaścāndrijīvaśukraśanaiś carāḥ
rāhuḥ keturgaṇapatiḥ senānī caṇḍikā hy umā / lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā brahmāṇīpramukhā gaṇāḥ
rudrā indrādayo vahnir nāgāstārkṣyo 'pare surāḥ / divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhā vijayāya bhavantu me
mardayantu raṇe śatrūn(3) sampragṛhyopahārakaṃ / saputramātṛbhṛtyo 'haṃ(4) devā vaḥ śaraṇaṅgataḥ

2 rātrāvityādiḥ, satyaja ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti 3 mardayantu ca me śatrūniti gha.. , ña.. ca 4 avantu māṃ svabhṛtyo 'hamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca :p 351 cāmūnāṃ pṛṣṭhato gatvā ripunāśā namo 'stu vaḥ(1) / vinivṛttaḥ pradāsyāmi(2) dattādabhyadhikaṃ baliṃ
ṣaṣṭhe 'hni vijayasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ cābhiṣekavat / yātrādine saptame ca pūjayecca trivikramaṃ
nīrājanoktamantraiś ca āyudhaṃ vāhanaṃ yajet / puṇyāhajayaśabdena mantrametanniśāmayet
divyāntarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhāḥ santvāyurdāḥ surāś ca te / devasiddhiṃ prāpnuhi tvaṃ devayātrāstu(3) sā tava
rakṣantu devatāḥ sarvā iti śrutvā nṛpo vrajet / gṛhītvā saśarañcāpaṃ dhanurnāgeti mantrata
tadviṣṇoriti japtvātha dadyādripumukhe padaṃ / dakṣiṇaṃ padaṃ dvātriṃśaddikṣu prācyādiṣu kramāt
nāgaṃ rathaṃ hayañcaiva dhuryāṃś caivāruhet kramāt / āruhya vādyair gacchet pṛṣthato nāvalokayet

anuyānāpasaraṇe śīghrakāryopapādanaṃ / dīnānusaraṇaṃ ghātaḥ koṭīnāṃ jaghanasya ca

nisthāṇuvṛkṣakedārā rathabhūmirakardamā / mardanīyatarucchedyavratatīpaṅkavarjitā

yodhebhyastu tato dadyāt kiñciddātuṃ(2) na yujyate / dravyalakṣaṃ rājaghāte tadardhaṃ tatsutārdane
senāpatibadhe tadvaddadyāddhastyādimardane / athavā khalu yudhyeran pratyaśvarathadantinaḥ

abhiyuktañca nānyena tyaktaṃ viprakṛtiṃ nayet / kuryāt pratyabhiyogantu kalahe sāhaseṣu ca

na cāhūto vadet kiñciddhanī daṇḍyaś ca sa smṛtaḥ / sākṣiṣūbhayataḥ satsu sākṣiṇaḥ pūrvavādinaḥ
pūrvapakṣe 'dharībhūte bhavantyuttaravādinaḥ / sagaṇaścedvivādaḥ syāttatra hīnantu dāpayet
dattaṃ paṇaṃ vasañcaiva dhanino dhanameva ca / chalannirasya dūtena vyavahārānnayennṛpaḥ

dāpyaḥ sarvānnṛpeṇārthānna grāhyastvaniveditaḥ / smṛtyorvirodhe nyāyastu vallavān vyavahārataḥ
arthaśāstrāddhi balavaddharmaśāstramiti sthitiḥ(1) / pramāṇaṃ likhitaṃ bhuktiḥ sākṣiṇaśceti kirtitam
eṣāmanyatamābhāve divyānyatamamucyate / sarveṣveva vivādeṣu balavatyuttarā kriyā
ādhau pratigrahe krīte pūrvā tu balavattarā / paśyato bruvato bhūmerhānirviṃśativārṣikī
pareṇa bhujyamānā yā dhanasya daśavārṣikī / ādhisaumopaniḥkṣepajaḍabāladhanair vinā

na dāpyo 'pahṛtaṃ tattu rājadaivakataskaraiḥ / preṣaścenmārgite datte dāpyo daṇḍaś ca tatsamam
ājīvan svecchayā daṇḍyo dāpyastaccāpi sodayaṃ / yācitāvāhitanyāse nikṣepeṣvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ
divyapramāṇakathanaṃ agnir uvāca tapasvino dānaśīlāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ / dharmapradhānā ṛjavaḥ putravanto dhanānvitāḥ
pañcayajñakriyāyuktāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ pañca vā trayaḥ / yathājāti yathāvarṇa sarve sarveṣu vā smṛtāḥ
strīvṛddhabālakitavamattonmattābhiśastakāḥ / raṅgāvatāripāṣaṇḍikūṭakṛdvikalendriyāḥ
patitāptānnasambandhisahāyariputaskarāḥ / amākṣiṇaḥ sarvasākṣī cauryapāruṣyasāhase
ubhayānumataḥ sākṣī bhavatyekopi dharmavit / abruvan hi naraḥ sākṣyamṛṇaṃ sadaśabandhakam
rājñā sarvaṃ pradāpyaḥ syāt ṣaṭcatvāriṃśake 'hnani / na dadāti hi yaḥ sākṣyaṃ jānannapi narādhamaḥ
sa kūṭasākṣiṇāṃ pāpaistulyo daṇḍena caiva hi / sākṣiṇaḥ śrāvayedvādiprativādisamīpagān
ye pātakakṛtāṃ lokā mahāpātakināṃ tathā / agnidānāñca ye lokā ye ca strībālaghātināṃ
tān sarvān samavāpnoti yaḥ sākṣyamanṛtaṃ vadet / sukṛtaṃ yattvayā kiñcijjanmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam
tatsarvaṃ tasya jānīhi yaṃ parājayase mṛṣā / dvaidhe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sameṣu guṇināntathā
guṇidvaidhe tu vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ ye guṇavattarāḥ / yasyocuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ satyāṃ pratijñāṃ sa jayī bhavet
anyathā vādino yasya dhrūvastasya parājayaḥ / ukte 'pi sākṣibhiḥ sākṣye yadyanye guṇavattarāḥ
dviguṇā vānyathā brūyuḥ kūṭāḥ syuḥpūrvasākṣiṇaḥ / pṛthak pṛthagdaṇḍanīyāḥ kūṭakṛtsākṣiṇas tathā
vivādāddviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vivāsyo brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / yaḥ sākṣyaṃ śrāvito 'nyebhyo nihnute tattamovṛtaḥ
sa dāpyo 'ṣṭaguṇam daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇantu vivāsayet / varṇināṃ hi badho yatra tatra sākṣya.anṛtaṃ vadet
yaḥ kaścidartho 'bhimataḥ svarucyā tu parasparaṃ / lekhyaṃ tu sākṣimat kāryaṃ tasmin dhanikapūrvakam
samāmāsatadarhāhar nāmajātisvagotrajaiḥ / sabrahmacārikātmīyapitṛnāmādicihnitam
samāpte 'rthe ṛṇī nāma svahastena niveśayet / mataṃ me 'mukaputrasya yadatroparilekhitaṃ
sākṣiṇaś ca svahastena pitṛnāmakapūrvakam / atrāhamamukaḥ sākṣī likheyuriti te samāḥ
alipijña ṛṇī yaḥ syālekayet svamatantu saḥ / sākṣī vā sākṣiṇānyena sarvasākṣisamīpataḥ
ubhayābhyarthitenaitanmayā hy amukasūnunā / likhitaṃ hy amukeneti lekhako 'thāntato likhet
vināpi sākṣibhir lekhyaṃ svahastalikhitañca yat / tat pramāṇaṃ smṛtaṃ sarvaṃ balopadhikṛtādṛte
ṛṇaṃ lekhyakṛtaṃ deyaṃ puruṣaistribhireva tu / ādhistu bhujyate tāvadyāvattanna pradīyate
deśāntarasthe durlekhye naṣṭonmṛṣṭe hṛte tathā / bhinne cchinne tathā dagdhe lekhyamanyattu kārayet
sandigdhārthaviśuddhyarthaṃ svahastalikhitantu yat / yuktiprāptikriyācihnasambandhāgamahetubhiḥ
lekhyasya pṛṣṭhe 'bhilikhet praviṣṭamadhamarṇinaḥ / dhanī copagataṃ dadyāt svahastaparicihnitam
datvarṇaṃ pāṭayellekhyaṃ śuddhyai cānyattu kārayet / sākṣimacca bhavedyattu taddātavyaṃ sasākṣikaṃ
tulāgnyāpo viṣaṃ koṣo divyānīha viśuddhaye / mahābhiyogeṣvetāni śīrṣakasthe 'bhiyoktari
rucyā vānyataraḥ kuryāditaro vartayecchiraḥ / vināpi śīrṣakāt kuryānnṛpadrohe 'tha pātake
nāsahasrāddharet phālaṃ na tulānna viṣantathā / nṛpārtheṣvabhiyogeṣu vaheyuḥ śucayaḥ sadā
sahasrārthe tulādīni koṣamalpe 'pi dāpayet / śatārdhaṃ dāpayecchuddhamaśuddho daṇḍabhāg bhavet
sacelasnātamāhūya sūryodaya upoṣitam / kārayetdarvadivyāni nṛpabrāhmaṇasannidhau
tulā strībālavṛddhāndhapaṅgubrāhmaṇarogiṇāṃ / agnirjvalaṃ vā śūdrasya yavāḥ sapta viṣasya vā
tulādhāraṇavidvadbhirabhiyuktastulāśritaḥ / pratimānasamībhūto rekhāṃ kṛtvāvatāritaḥ
ādityacandrāvanilo 'nalaś ca dyaurbhūmirāpohṛdayaṃ yamaś ca / ahaś ca rātriś ca ubhe ca sandhye dharmaś ca jānāti narasya vṛttam
tvaṃ tule satyadhāmāsi purā devair vinirmitā / satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi saṃśayānmāṃ vimocaya
yadyasmi pāpakṛnmātastato māṃ tvamadho naya / śuddhaścedgamayordhvammāṃ tulāmityabhimantrayet
karau vimṛditavrīherlakṣayitvā tato nyaset / saptāśvaptyasya patrāṇi tāvat sūtreṇa veṣṭayet
tvameva sarvabhūtānāmantaś carasi pāvaka / sākṣivat puṇyapāpebhyo brūhi satyaṅgare mama
tasyetyuktavato lauhaṃ pañcāśatpalikaṃ samam / agnirvarṇaṃ nyaset piṇḍaṃ hastayorubhayorapi
sa tamādāya saptaiva maṇḍalāni śatair vrajet / ṣoḍaśāṅgulakaṃ jñeyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tāvadantaram
muktvāgniṃ mṛditavrīhiradagdhaḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt / antarā patite piṇḍe sandehe vā punarharet
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitra tvaṃ śodhyaṃ śodhaya pāvana / satyena mābhirakṣasva varuṇetyabhiśastakam
nābhidaghnodakasthasya gṛhītvorū jalaṃ viśet / samakālamiṣuṃ muktamānīyānyo javo naraḥ
yadi tasminnimagnāṅgaṃ paśyecca śuddhimāpnuyāt / tvaṃ viṣa brahmaṇaḥ putra satyadharme vyavasthita
trāyasvāsmādabhīśāpāt satyena bhava me 'mṛtam / evamuktvā viṣaṃ sārṅgaṃ bhakṣayeddhimaśailajaṃ
yasya vegair vinā jīrṇaṃ śuddhiṃ tasya vinirdiśet / devānugrān samabhyarcya tatsnānodakamāharet
saṃśrāvya pāpayettasmājjalāttu prasṛtitrayam / ācaturdaśamādahno yasya no rājadaivikam
vyasanaṃ jāyate ghoraṃ sa śuddhaḥ syādasaṃśayam / satyavāhanaśastrāṇi govījakanakāni ca
devatāgurupādāś ca iṣṭāpūrtakṛtāni ca / ityete sukarāḥ proktāḥ śapathāḥ svalpasaṃśaye
dāyavibhāgakathanam agnir uvāca vibhāgañcet pitā kuryādicchayā vibhajet sutān / jyeṣṭhaṃ vā śreṣṭhabhāgena sarve vā syuḥ samāṃśinaḥ
yadi dadyāt samānaṃśān kāryāḥ patnyaḥ samāṃśikāḥ / na dattaṃ strīdhanaṃ yāsāṃ bhartrā vā śvaśurena vā
śaktasthānīhamānasya kiñciddatvā pṛthak kriyā / nyūnādhikavibhaktānāṃ dharmyaś ca pitṛnā kṛtaḥ
vibhajeyuḥ sutāḥ pitrorūrdhvamṛkthamṛṇaṃ samam / māturduhitaraḥ śeṣamṛṇāttābhya ṛte 'nnayaḥ
pitṛdravyāvināśena yadanyat svayamarjayet / maitramaudvāhikañcaiva dāyādānānna tadbhavet
sāmānyārthasamutthāne vibhāgastu samaḥ smṛtaḥ / anekapitṛkāṇāntu pitṛto bhāgakalpanā
bhūryāpitā mahopāttā nibandho dravyameva vā / tatra syāt sadṛśaṃ svāmyaṃ pituḥ putrasya cobhayoḥ
vibhakteṣu suto jātaḥ savarṇāyāṃ vibhāgabhāk / dṛśyādvā tadvibhāgaḥ syādāyavyayaviśodhitāt
kramādabhyāgataṃ dravyaṃ hṛtamabhyuddharecca yaḥ / dāyādebhyo na taddadyādvidyayā labdhameva ca
pitṛbhyāṃ yasya yaddattaṃ tattasyaiva dhanaṃ bhavet / piturūrdhvaṃ vibhajatāṃ mātāpyaṃśaṃ samaṃ haret
asaṃskṛtāstu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ / bhāginyaś ca nijādaṃśāddatvāṃśantu turīyakaṃ
catuḥstridvyekabhāgāḥ syurvarṇaśo brāhmaṇātmajāḥ / kṣatrajāstridvyekabhāgā viḍjāstu dvyekabhāginaḥ
anyonyāpahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vibhakte yattu dṛśyate / tat punaste samair aṃśair vibhajeranniti sthitiḥ
aputreṇa parakṣetre niyogotpāditaḥ sutaḥ / ubhayorapyasāvṛkthī piṇḍadātā ca dharmataḥ
auraso dharmapatnījastatsamaḥ putrikāsutaḥ / kṣetrajaḥ kṣetrajātastu sagotreṇetareṇa vā
gṛhe pracchanna utpanno gūḍhajastu sutaḥ smṛtaḥ / kānīnaḥ kanyakājāto mātāmahasuto mataḥ
kṣatāyāmakṣatāyāṃ vā jātaḥ paunarbhavaḥ sutaḥ / dadyānmātā pitā vā yaṃ sa putrī dattako bhavet
krītaś ca tābhyāṃ vikrītaḥ kṛtrimaḥ syāt svyaṃ kṛtaḥ / dattātmā tu svayaṃ datto garbhe vittaḥ sahoḍhajaḥ
utsṛṣṭo gṛhyate yastu sopaviddho bhavet sutaḥ / piṇḍado 'ṃśaharaś caiṣāṃ pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ
sajātīyeṣvayaṃ proktastanayeṣu mayā vidhiḥ / jāto 'pi dāsyāṃ śūdrasya kāmato 'ṃśaharo bhavet
mṛte pitari kuryustaṃ bhrātarastvardhabhāgikaṃ / abhrātṛko haret sarvaṃ duhitṝṇāṃ sutādṛte
patnī duhitaraś caiva pitaro bhrātaras tathā / tatsuto gotrajo bandhuḥ śiṣyaḥ sabrahmacāriṇaḥ
eṣāmabhāve pūvasya dhanabhāguttarottaraḥ / svaryātsya hy aputrasya sarvavarṇeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ
vānaprasthayatibrahmacāriṇāmṛkthabhāginaḥ / krameṇācāryasacchiṣyadharmabhrātrekatīrthinaḥ
saṃsṛṣṭinastu saṃsṛṣṭī sodarasya tu sodaraḥ / dadyāccāpahereccāṃśaṃ jātasya ca mṛtasya ca
anyodaryastu saṃsṛṣṭī nānyodaryadhanaṃ haret / asaṃsṛṣtyapi cādadyātsodaryo nānyamānṛjaḥ
patitastatsutaḥ klīvaḥ paṅgurunmattako jaḍaḥ / andho 'cikitsyarogādyā bhartavyāstu niraṃśakāḥ
aurasāḥ kṣetrajāstveṣāṃ nirdoṣā bhāgahāriṇaḥ / sutāś caiṣāṃ prabhartavyā yāvadvai bhartṛsātkṛtāḥ
aputrā yoṣitaś caiṣāṃ bhartavyāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ / nirvāsyā vyabhicāriṇyaḥ pratikūlāstathaiva ca
pitṛmātṛpatibhrātṛdattamadhyagnyupāgataṃ / ādhivedanikuñcaiva strīdhanaṃ parikīrtitaṃ
bandhudattaṃ tathā śulkamanvādheyakameva ca / aprajāyāmatītāyāṃ bāndhavāstadavāpnuyuḥ
aprajāstrīdhanaṃ bhratturbrāhmyādiṣu caturṣvapi / duhitṛṇāṃ prasūtā cecchreṣe tu pitṛgāmi tat
datvā kanyāṃ haran daṇḍyo vyayaṃ dadyācca sodayam / mṛtāyāṃ dattamādadyāt pariśodhyobhayavyayam
durbhikṣe dharmakārye ca vyādhau saṃpratirodhake / gṛhītaṃ strīdhanaṃ bhartā na striye dātumarhati
adhivittastriyai dadyādadhivedanikaṃ samam / na dattaṃ srīdhanaṃ yasyai datte tvardhaṃ prakīrtitam
vibhāganihnave jñātibandhusākṣyabhilekhitaiḥ / vibhāgabhāvanā jñeyā gṛhakṣetraiś ca yautikaiḥ
sīmāvivādādinirṇayaḥ agnir uvāca sīmno vivāde kṣetrasya sāmantāḥ sthavirā gaṇāḥ / gopāḥ sīmākṛṣāṇā ye sarve ca vanagocarāḥ
nayeyurete sīmānaṃ sthalāṅgāratuṣadrumaiḥ / setuvalmīkanimnāsthicaityādyair upalakṣitām
sāmantā vā samaṃgrāmāś catvāro 'ṣṭau daśāpi vā(1) / raktasragvasanāḥ sīmānnayeyuḥ kṣitidhāriṇaḥ
anṛte tu pṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā madhyamasāhasam / abhāve jñātṛcihnānāṃ rājā sīmnaḥ pravattakaḥ
ārāmāyatanagrāmanipānodyānaveśmasu / eṣa eva vidhirjñeyo varṣāmvupravaheṣu ca
maryādāyāḥ prabhedeṣu kṣetrasya haraṇe tathā / maryādāyāś ca daṇḍyāḥ syuradhamottamamadhyamāḥ
na niṣedhyo 'lpabādhastu setuḥ kalyāṇakārakaḥ / parabhūmiṃ haran kūpaḥ svalpakṣetro bahūdakaḥ
svāmine yo 'nivedyaiva kṣetre setuṃ prakalpayet / utpanne svāmino bhogastadabhāve mahīpateḥ
phālāhatamapi kṣetraṃ yo na kuryānna kārayet / 1 catvāro 'tha daśāpi veti kha.. , ga.. , ña.. ca :p 425 sa pradāpyo 'kṛṣṭaphalaṃ kṣetramanyena kārayet
māsānaṣṭau tu mahiṣī satyaghātasya kāriṇī / daṇḍanīyā tadardhantu gaustadardhamajāvikaṃ
bhakṣayitvopaviṣṭānāṃ yathoktād dviguṇo damaḥ / samameṣāṃ vivītepi svarāṣṭraṃ mahiṣīsamam
yāvat satyaṃ vinaṣṭantu tāvat kṣetrī phalaṃ labhet / pālastāḍyo 'tha gosvāmī pūrvoktaṃ daṇḍamarhati
pathi grāmavivītānte kṣetre doṣo na vidyate / akāmataḥ kāmacāre cauravaddaṇḍamarhati
mahotkṣotsṛṣṭapaśavaḥ sūtikāgantukā ca gauḥ / pālo yeṣāntu mocyā daivarājapariplutāḥ
yathārpitān paśūn gopoḥ sāyaṃ pratyarpayettathā / pramādamṛtanaṣṭāṃś ca pradāpyaḥ kṛtavetanaḥ
pāladoṣavināśe tu pāle daṇḍo vidhīyate / ardhatrayodaśapaṇaḥ svāmino dravyameva ca
grāmecchayā gopracāro bhūmirājavaśena vā / dvijastṛṇaidhaḥpuṣpāṇi sarvataḥ svavadāharet
dhanuḥśataṃ parīṇāho grāmakṣetrāntaraṃ bhavet / dve śate kharvaṭasya syānnagarasya catuḥśatam
svaṃ labhetānyavikrītaṃ kreturdoṣo 'prakāśite / hīnādraho hīnamūlye velāhīne ca taskaraḥ
naṣṭāpahṛtamāsādya hartāraṃ grāhayennaram / deśakālātipattau vā gṛhītvā svayamarpayet
vikreturdarśanācchuddhiḥ svāmī dravyaṃ nṛpo damam / kretā mūlyaṃ samāpnoti tasmādyastatra vikrayī
āgamenopabhogena naṣṭaṃ bhāvyamato 'nyathā / pañcabandho damastasya rājñe tenāpyabhāvite
hṛtaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ yo dravyaṃ parahastādavāpnuyāt / anivedya nṛpe daṇḍyaḥ sa tu ṣannayatiṃ paṇān
śaulkikaiḥ sthānapālair vā naṣṭāpahṛtamāhṛtaṃ / arvāk saṃvatsarāt svāmī labhate parato nṛpaḥ
paṇānekaśaphe dadyāccaturaḥ pañca mānuṣe / mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ dvau dvau pādaṃ pādamajāvike
svakuṭumbāvirodhena deyaṃ dārasutādṛte / nānvaye sati sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ yaccānyasaṃśrutam
pratigrahaḥ prakāśaḥ syāt sthāvarasya viśeṣataḥ / deyaṃ pratiśrutañcaiva datvā nāpaharet punaḥ
daśaikapañcasaptāhamāsatryahārdhamāsikaṃ / vījāyovāhyaratnastrīdohyapuṃsāṃ pratīkṣaṇam
agnau suvarṇamakṣīṇaṃ dvipalaṃ rajate śate / aṣṭau trapuṇi sīse ca tāmre pañcadaśāyasi
śate daśapalāvṛddhiraurṇe kārpāsike tathā / madhye pañcapalā jñeyā sūkṣme tu tripalā matā
kārmike romabaddhe ca triṃśadbhāgaḥ kṣayo mataḥ / na kṣayo na ca vṛddhistu kauśeye valkaleṣu ca
deśaṃ kālañca bhogañca jñātvā naṣṭe balābalam / dravyāṇāṃ kuśalā brūyuryattaddāpyamasaṃśayam
balāddāsīkṛtaś caurair vikrītaścāpi mucyate / svāmiprāṇaprado bhaktatyāgāttanniṣkrayādapi
pravrajyāvasito rājño dāsa āmaraṇāntikaḥ / varṇānāmānulomyena dāsyaṃ na pratilomataḥ
kṛtaśilpopi nivaset kṛtakālaṃ gurorgṛhe / antevāsī guruprāptabhojanastratphalaptadaḥ
rājā kṛtvā pure sthānaṃ brāhmaṇānnyasya tatra tu / traividyaṃ vṛttimadbrūyāt svadharmaḥ pālyatāmiti
nijadharmāvirodhena yastu sāmayiko bhavet / so 'pi yatnena saṃrakṣyo dharmo rājakṛtaś ca yaḥ
gaṇadravyaṃ haredyastu saṃvidaṃ laṅghayecca yaḥ / sarvasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet
kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaiḥ samūhahitavādibhiḥ / yastatra viparītaḥ syātsa dāpyaḥ prathamaṃ damam
samūhakāryaprahito yallabhettattadarpayet / ekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyo yadyasau nārpayet svayam
vedajñāḥ śucayo 'lubdhā bhaveyuḥ kāryacintakāḥ / kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāṃ samūhahitavādināṃ
śreṇinaigamapākhaṇḍigaṇānāmapyayaṃ vidhiḥ / bhedañcaiṣāṃ nṛpo rakṣet pūrvavṛttiñca pālayet
gṛhītavetanaḥ karma tyajan dviguṇamāvahet / agṛhīte samaṃ dāpyo bhṛtyai rakṣya upaskaraḥ
dāpyastu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ bāṇijyapaśusasyataḥ / aniścitya bhṛtiṃ yastu kārayetsa mahīkṣitā
deśaṃ kālañca yo 'tīyāt karma kuryācca yo 'nyathā / tatra tu svāminaśchando 'dhikaṃ deyaṃ kṛte 'dhike
yo yāvat kurute karma tāvattasya tu vetanam / ubhayorapyasādhyañcet sādhye kuryādyathāśrutam
arājadaivikannaṣṭaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ dāpyastu vāhakaḥ / prasthānavighnakṛccaiva pradāpyo dviguṇāṃ bhṛtim
prakrānte saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ caturthaṃ pathi saṃtyajan / bhṛtimardhapathe sarvāṃ pradāpyastyājakoapi ca
glahe śatikavṛddhestu sabhikaḥ pañcakaṃ gataṃ / gṛhṇīyāddhūrtakitavāditarāddaśakaṃ śataṃ
sa samyakpālito dadyādrājñe bhāgaṃ yathākṛtaṃ / jitamudgrāhayejjetre dadyātsatyaṃ vacaḥ kṣamī
prāpte nṛpatinā bhāge prasiddhe dhūrtamaṇḍale / jitaṃ saśabhike sthāne dāpayedanyathā na tu
draṣṭāro vyavahārāṇāṃ sākṣiṇaś ca ta eva hi / rājñā sacihnā nirvāsyāḥ kūṭākṣopadhidevinaḥ
dyūtamekamukhaṃ kāryaṃ taskarajñānakāraṇāt / eṣa eva vidhirjñeyaḥ prāṇidyūte samāhvaye
vākpāruṣyādiprakaraṇam agnir uvāca satyāsatyānyathā stotrair nyūnāṅgendriyarogiṇāṃ / kṣepaṃ karoti ceddaṇḍyaḥ paṇānardhatrayodaśa
abhigantāsmi bhaginīmmātaraṃ vā taveti ca / śapantaṃ dāpayedrājā pañcaviṃśatikaṃ damaṃ
ardho 'dhameṣu dviguṇaḥ parastrīṣūttameṣu ca / daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇajātyuttarādharaiḥ
prātilomyāpavādeṣu dviguṇatriguṇā damāḥ / varṇānāmānulomyena tasmādevārdhahānitaḥ
vāhugrīvānetrasakthivināśe vācike damaḥ / śatyastato 'rdhikaḥ pādanāsākarṇikarādiṣu
aśaktastu vadannevandaṇḍanīyaḥ paṇān daśa / tathā śaktaḥ pratibhuvaṃ dadyāt kṣemāya tasya tu(1)
patanīyakṛte kṣepe daṇḍī madhyamasāhasaḥ / upapātakayukte tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasaṃ
traividyanṛpadevānāṃ kṣepa uttamasāhasaḥ / 1 dadyādityatra dāpya iti pāṭho bhavituṃ yuktaḥ :p 430 madhyamo jñātipūgānāṃ prathamo grāmadeśayoḥ
asākṣikahate cihnair yuktibhinnāgamena ca / draṣṭavyo vyavahārastu kūṭacihnakṛtādbhayāt
bhasmapaṅkarajaḥsparśe daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / amedhyapārṣṇiniṣṭhyūtasparśane dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
sameṣvevaṃ parastrīṣu dviguṇastūttameṣu ca / hīneṣvardhaṃ damo mohamadādibhiradaṇḍanam
viprapīḍākaraṃ cchedyamaṅgamabrāhmaṇasya tu / udgūrṇe prathamo daṇḍaḥ saṃsparśe tu tadardhikaḥ
udgūrṇe hastapāde tu daśaviṃśatikau damau / parasparantu sarveṣāṃ śāstre madhyamasāhasaḥ
pādakeśāṃśukakarolluñcaneṣu paṇān daśa / pīḍākarṣāṃ śukāveṣṭapādādhyāse śatandamaḥ
śoṇitena vinā duḥsvaṅkurvan kāṣṭhādibhirnaraḥ / dvātriṃśataṃ paṇān(1) dāpyo dviguṇaṃ darśane 'sṛjaḥ
karapādadato bhaṅge cchedane karṇanāsayoḥ / madhyo daṇḍo vraṇodbhede mṛtakalpahate tathā
ceṣṭābhojanavāgrodhe netrādipratibhedane / kandharābāhusakthyāñca bhaṅge madhyamasāhasaḥ
ekaṃ ghnatāṃ bahūnāñca yathoktāddviguṇā damāḥ / kalahāpahṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍastu dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
duḥkhamutpādayedyastu sa samutthānajaṃ vyayam / 1 dvāviṃśatipaṇāmiti kha.. :p 431 dāpyo daṇḍañca yo yasmin kalahe samudāhṛtaḥ
tarikaḥ sthalajaṃ śulkaṃ gṛhnan daṇḍyaḥ paṇāndaśa / brāhmaṇaprātiveśyānāmetadevānimantraṇe
abhighāte tathā bhede cchede buddhyāvapātane / paṇāndāpyaḥ pañcadaśaviṃśatiṃ tattrayantathā
duḥsvotpādigṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipan prāṇaharaṃ tathā / ṣāḍaśādyaṃ paṇāt dāpyo dvitīyo madhyamandamam
duḥkhe ca śoṇitotpāde śākhāṅgacchedane tathā / daṇḍaḥ kṣudrapaśūnāṃ syāddvipaṇaprabhṛtiḥ kramāt
liṅgasya cchedane mṛttau madhyamo mūlyameva ca / mahāpaśūnāmeteṣu sthāneṣu dviguṇā damāḥ
prarohiśākhināṃ śākhāskandhasarvavidāraṇe / upajīvyadrumāṇāntu viṃśaterdviguṇā damāḥ(1)
yaḥ sāhasaṅkārayati sa dāpyo dviguṇandamam / yastvevamuktvāhaṃ dātā kārayet sa caturguṇam
āryākrośātikramakṛdbhrātṛjāyāprahāradaḥ / sandiṣṭasyāpradātā ca samudragṛhabhedakaḥ
sāmantakulikādīnāmapakārasya kārakaḥ / pañcāśatpaṇiko daṇḍa eṣāmiti viniś cayaḥ
svacchandavidhavāgāmī vikruṣṭe nābhidhāvakaḥ / akāraṇe ca vikroṣṭā caṇḍālaścottamān spṛśan
śūdraḥ pravrajitānāñca daive paitrye ca bhojakaḥ / 1 prarohiśākhināmityādirviṃśaterdviguṇā damā ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.. pustake nāsti :p 432 ayuktaṃ śapathaṃ kurvannayogyo yogyakarmakṛt
vṛṣakṣudrapaśūnāñca pūṃstvasya pratighātakṛt / sādhāraṇasyāpalopī dāsīgarbhavināśakṛt
pitāputrasvasṛbhrātṛdampatyācāryaśiṣyakāḥ / eṣāmapatitānyonyatyāgī ca śatadaṇḍabhāk
vasānastrīn paṇān daṇḍyo nejakastu parāṃśukam / vikrayāvakrayādhānayāciteṣu paṇān daśa
tulāśāsanamānānāṃ kūṭakṛnnāṇakasya ca / ebhiś ca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo daṇḍamuttamam
akūṭaṃ kūṭakaṃ brūte kūṭaṃ yaścāpyakūṭakam / sa nāṇakaparīkṣī tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasam
bhiṣaṅmithyācaran dāpyastiryakṣu prathamaṃ damam / mānuṣe madhyamaṃ rājamānuṣeṣūttamantathā
abadhyaṃ yaś ca badhnāti badhyaṃ yaś ca pramuñcati / aprāptavyavahārañca sa dāpyo damamuttamam
mānena tulayā vāpi yo 'ṃśamaṣṭamakaṃ haret / dvāviṃśatipaṇān dāpyo vṛddhau hānau ca kalpitam
bheṣajasnehalavaṇagandhānyaguḍādiṣu / paṇyeṣu prakṣipan hīnaṃ paṇāndāpyastu ṣoḍaśa
sambhūya kurvatāmarghaṃ sabādhaṃ kāruśilpināṃ / arthasya hrāsaḥ vṛddhiṃ vā sahasro daṇḍa ucyate
rājāni sthāpyate yo 'rthaḥ pratyahaṃ tena vikrayaḥ / krayo vā nisravastasmādbaṇijāṃ lābhakṛt smṛtaḥ
svadeśapaṇye tu śataṃ baṇij gṛhṇīta pañcakaṃ / daśakaṃ pāradeśye tu yaḥ sadyaḥ krayavikrayau
paṇyasyopari saṃsthāpya vyayaṃ paṇyasamudbhavaṃ / artho 'nugrahakṛt kāryaḥ kreturvikretureva ca
gṛhītamūlyaṃ yaḥ paṇyaṃ kreturnaiva prayacchati / sodayantasya dāpyo 'sau diglābhaṃ vā digāgate
vikrītamapi vikreyaṃ pūrve kretaryagṛhṇati / hāniścet kretṛdoṣeṇa kretureva hi sā bhavet
rājadaivopaghātena paṇye doṣamupāgate / hānirvikreturevāsau yācitasyāprayacchataḥ
anyahaste ca vikrītaṃ duṣṭaṃ vā duṣṭavadyadi / vikrīnīte damastatra tanmūlyādadviguṇo bhavet
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiñca baṇijā paṇyānāmavijānatā / krītvā nānuśayaḥ kāryaḥ kurvan ṣaḍ bhāgadaṇḍabhāk
samavāyena baṇijāṃ lābhārthaṃ karma kurvatāṃ / labhālābhau yathā dravyaṃ yathā vā saṃvidā kṛtau
pratiṣiddhamanādiṣṭaṃ pramādādyacca nāśitaṃ / sa taddayādvipravācca rakṣitāddaśamāṃśabhāk
arthaprekṣapaṇādviṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ śulkaṃ nṛpā haret / vyāsiddhaṃ rājayogyañca vikrītaṃ rājagāmi tat
mithyā vadan parīmāṇaṃ śulkasthānādapakraman / dāpyastvaṣṭaguṇaṃ yaś ca savyājakrayavikrayau
deśantaragate prete dravyaṃ dāyādabāndhavāḥ / jñātayo vā hareyustadāgatāstair vinā nṛpaḥ
jihmaṃ tyajeyurnirlobhamaśakto 'nyena kārayet / anena vidhirākhyāta ṛtvikkarṣakarmiṇāṃ
grāhakair gṛhyate cauro loptreṇātha padena vā / pūrvakarmāparādhī vā tathaivāśuddhavāsakaḥ
anye 'pi śaṅkayā grāhyā jātināmādinihnavaiḥ / dyūtastrīpānaśaktāś ca śuṣkabhinnamukhasvarāḥ
paradravyagṛhāṇāñca pṛcchakā gūḍhacāriṇaḥ / nirāyā vyayavantaś ca vinaṣṭa dravyavikrayāḥ
gṛhītaḥ śaṅkayā cauryenātmānañcedviśodhayet / dāpayitvā hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ cauradaṇḍena daṇḍayet
cauraṃ pradāpyāpahṛtaṃ ghātayedvividhair budhaiḥ / sacihnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā svarāṣṭrādvipravāsayet
ghātite 'pahṛte doṣo grāmabharturanirgate / svasīmni dadyādgrāmastu padaṃ vā yatra gacchati
pañcagrāmī vahiḥ krośāddaśagrāmya.atha vā punaḥ / vandigrāhāṃs tathā vājikuñjarāṇāñca hāriṇaḥ
prasahya ghātinaś caiva śūlamāropayennarān / utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasandaṃśahīnakau
kāryau dvitīyāparādhe karapādaikahīnakau / bhaktāvakāśāgnyudakamantrāpakaraṇavyayān
dattvā caurasya hanturvā jānato dama uttamaḥ / śastrāvapāte garbhasya pātane cottamo damaḥ
uttamo vādhamo vāpi puruṣastrīpramāpaṇe / śilāṃ baddhvā kṣipedapsu naraghnīṃ viṣadāṃ striyaṃ
viṣāgnidāṃ nijagurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīṃ / vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet
kṣetraveśmavanagrāmavivītakhaladāhakāḥ / rājapatny abhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā
pumān saṃgrahaṇe grāhyaḥ keśākeśiparastriyāḥ / svajātāvuttamo daṇḍa ānulomye tu madhyamaḥ
prātilomye badhaḥ puṃsāṃ nāryāḥ karṇāvakartanam / nīvīstanaprāvaraṇanābhikeśāvamardanam
adeśakālasambhāṣaṃ sahāvasthānameva ca / strī niṣedhe śataṃ dadyād dviśatantu damaṃ pumān
pratiṣedhe tayordaṇḍo yathā saṃgrahaṇe tathā / paśūn gacchaṃśchataṃ dāpyo hīnāṃ strīṃ gāś ca madhyamam
avaruddhāsu dāsīṣu bhujiṣyāsu tathaiva ca / gamyāsvapi pumāndāpyaḥ pañcāśat paṇikandamam
prasahya dāsyabhigame daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / kubandhenāṅkya gamayedantyāpravrajitāgame
nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam / pāradārikacauraṃ vā muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ
abhakṣair dūṣayan vipraṃ daṇḍa uttamasāhasam / kūṭasvarṇavyavahārī vimāṃsasya ca vikrayī
aṅgahīnaś ca kartavyo dāpyaścottamasāhasaṃ / śakto hy amokṣayan svāmī daṃṣṭriṇaḥ śṛṅgiṇas tathā
prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ dadyādvikruṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tathā / acaurañcaure 'bhivadan dāpyaḥ pañcaśataṃ damaṃ
rājño 'niṣṭapravaktāraṃ tasyaivākrośakaṃ tathā / mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitus tathā
tanmantrasya ca bhettāraṃ chittvā jihvāṃ pravāsayet / rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍo madhyamasāhasaḥ
dvinetrabhedino rājadviṣṭādeśakṛtas tathā / vipratvena ca śūdrasya jīvato 'ṣṭaśato damaḥ
yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenābhiparājitaḥ / tamāyāntaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍayeddviguṇaṃ damaṃ
rājñānyāyena yo daṇḍo gṛhīto varuṇāyataṃ / vivedya dadyādviprebhyaḥ svayaṃ triṃśadguṇīkṛtaṃ
dharmaścārthaś ca kīrtiñca lokapaṅktirupagrahaḥ / prajābhyo bahumānañca svargasthānañca śāśvatam
paśyato vyavahārāṃś ca guṇāḥ syuḥ sapta bhūpateḥ

viprāśiṣastvamoghāḥ syurbahiḥsnānantu sarvataḥ / siddhārthakā yavā dhānyaṃ payo ghṛtaṃ tathā
kṣīravṛkṣāstathedhmantu homā vai sarvakāmadāḥ / samidhaḥ kaṇṭhakinyaś ca rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣaṃ
abhicāre tathā śailaṃ aśanaṃ śaktavaḥ payaḥ / dadhi bhaikṣyaṃ phalaṃ mūlamṛgvidhānamudāhṛtaṃ
yajurvidhānaṃ puṣkara uvāca yajurvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu / oṃkārapūrvikā rāma mahāvyāhṛtayo matāḥ
sarvakalmaṣanāśinyaḥ sarvakāmapradās tathā / ājyāhutisahasreṇa devānārādhayedbudhaḥ
manasaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ rāma manasepsitakāmadaṃ / śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryāttilaiḥ pāpāpanuttaye
dhānyaiḥ siddhārthakaiś caiva sarvakāma karais tathā / audumbarībhiridhmābhiḥ pasukāmasya śasyate
dadhnā caivānnakāmasya payasā śāntimicchataḥ / apāmārgasamiddhastu kāmayan kanakaṃ bahu
kanyākāmo ghṛtāktāni yugmaśo grathitāni tu / jātīpuṣpāṇi juhuyādgrāmārthī tilataṇḍulān
vaśyakarmaṇi śākhoḍhavāsāpāmārgameva ca / viṣāsṛṅmiśrasamidho vyādhighātasya bhārgava
kruddhastu juhuyātsamyak śatrūṇāṃ badhakāmyayā / sarvavrīhimayīṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ pratikṛtiṃ dvija
sahasraśastu juhuyādrājā vaśagato bhavet / vastrakāmasya puṣpāṇi darvā vyādhivināśinī
brahmavarcasakāmasya vāsograñca vidhīyate / pratyaṅgireṣu juhuyāttuṣakaṇṭakabhasmabhiḥ
vidveṣaṇe ca pakṣmāṇi kākakauśikayos tathā / kāpilañca ghṛtaṃ hutvā tathā candragrahe dvija
vacācūrṇena sampātātsamānīya ca tāṃ vacāṃ / sahasramantritāṃ bhuktvā medhāvī jāyate naraḥ
ekādaśāṅgulaṃ śaṅku lauhaṃ khādirameva ca(1) / dviṣato badhosīti japannikhanedripuveśmani
uccāṭanamidaṃ karma śatrūṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava / cakṣuṣyā iti japtvā ca vinaṣṭañcakṣurāpnuyāt
upayuñjata ity edanuvākantathānnadaṃ / tanūnapāgne saditi dūrvāṃ hutvārtivarjitaḥ
bheṣajamasīti dadhyājyair homaḥ paśūpasarganut(2) / 1 khādirameva veti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca 2 paśūpasargaheti ka.. , cha.. ca :p 448 tryamvakaṃ yajāmahe homaḥ saubhāgyavardhanaḥ
kanyānāma gṛhītvā tu kanyalābhakaraḥ paraḥ / bhayeṣu tu japannityaṃ bhayebhyo vipramucyate
dhustūrapuṣpaṃ saghṛtaṃ hutvā syāt sarvakāmabhāk / hutvā tu guggulaṃ rāma svapne paśyati śaṅkaraṃ
yuñjate mano 'nuvākaṃ japtvā dīrghāyurāpnuyāt / viṣṇoravāṭamityetat(1) sarvabādhāvināśanaṃ
rakṣoghnañca yaśasyañca tathaiva vijayapradaṃ / ayatno agnirityetat saṃgrāme vijayapradaṃ
idamāpaḥ pravahata snāne pāpāpanodanaṃ / viśvakarmannu haviṣā sūcīṃ lauhīndaśāṅgulām
kanyāyā nikhaneddvāri sānyasmai na pradīyate / deva savitaretena juhuyādbalakāmo dvijottama
agnau svāheti juhuyādbalakāmo dvijottama / tilair yavaiś ca dharmajña tathāpāmārgataṇḍulaiḥ
sahasramantritāṃ kṛtvā tathā gorocanāṃ dvija / tilakañca tathā kṛtvā janasya priyatāmiyāt
rudrāṇāñca tathā japyaṃ sarvāghavinisūdanaṃ / sarvakarmakaro homas tathā sarvatra śantidaḥ
ajāvikānāmaśvānāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tathā gavāṃ / manuṣyāṇānnarendrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ yoṣitāmapi
grāmāṇāṃ nagarānāñca deśānāmapi bhārgava / 1 viṣṇorvirāṭamityetaditi gha.. , ña.. ca / viṣṭorarāṭamityetaditi ka.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca :p 449 upadrutānāṃ dharmajña vyādhitānāṃ tathaiva ca
marake samanuprāpte ripuje ca tathā bhaye / rudrahomaḥ parā śāntiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena ca
kuṣmāṇḍaghṛtahomena sarvān pāpān vyapohati / śaktuyāvakabhaikṣāśī naktaṃ manujasattama
bahiḥsnānarato māsānmucyate brahmahatyayā / madhuvāteti mantreṇa homādito 'khilaṃ labhet
dadhi krāvneti hutvā tu putrān prāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ / tathā ghṛtavatītyetadāyuṣyaṃ syāt ghṛtena tu
svastina indra ity etatsarvabādhāvināśanaṃ / iha gāvaḥ prajyāyadhvamiti puṣṭivivardhanam
ghṛtāhutisahasreṇa tathā lakṣmīvināśanaṃ / śruveṇa devasya tveti hutvāpāmārgataṇḍulaṃ
mucyate vikṛtācchīghramabhicārānna saṃśayaḥ / rudra pātu palaśasya samidbhiḥ kanakaṃ labhet
śivo bhavetyagnyutpāte vrīhibhirjuhuyānnaraḥ / yāḥ senā iti caitacca taskarebhyo bhayāpaham
yo asmabhyamavātīyāddhutvā kṛṣṇatilānnaraḥ / sahasraśo 'bhicārācca mucyate vikṛtāddvija
annenānnapatetyevaṃ hutvā cānnamavāpnuyāt / haṃsaḥ śuciḥ sadityetajjaptantoye 'ghanāśanaṃ
catvāri bhaṅgetyetattu sarvapāpaharaṃ jale / devā yajñeti japtvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate
vasanteti ca hutvājyaṃ ādityādvaramāpnuyāt / suparṇosīti cetyasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet
namaḥ svāheti trirjaptvā bandhanānmokṣamāpnuyāt / antarjale trirāvartya drupadā sarvapāpamuk
iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ mantroyaṃ buddhivardhanaḥ / hutantu sarpiṣā dadhnā payasā pāyasena vā
śatam ya(1) iti caitena hutvā parṇaphalāṇi ca / ārogyaṃ śriyamāpnoti jīvitañca cirantathā
oṣadhīḥ pratimodagdhvaṃ(2) vapane lavane 'rthakṛt / aśvāvatī pāyasena homācchāntimavāpnuyāt
tasmā iti ca mantrena bandhanastho vimucyate / yuvā suvāsā ity eva vāsāṃsyāpnoti cottamam
muñcantu mā śapathyāni sarvāntakavināśanam(3) / mā māhiṃsīstilājyena hutaṃ ripuvināśanaṃ(4)
namo 'stu sarvasarpebhyo ghṛtena pāyasena tu / kṛṇudhavaṃ rāja ity etadabhicāravināśanaṃ
dūrvākāṇḍāyutaṃ hutvā kāṇḍāt kāṇḍeti mānavaḥ / grāme janapade vāpi marakantu śamannayet

rogārto mucyate rogāt tathā duḥkhāttu duḥkhitaḥ / 1 śatañceti ṭa.. / śataṃ veti ka.. 2 auṣadhayaḥ pratimodadhyamiti ja.. 3 sarvakilviṣanāśanamiti gha.. , ña.. ca 4 vighnavināśanamiti ka.. , cha.. ca :p 451 auḍumbarīś ca samidho madhumānno vanaspatiḥ
hutvā sahasraśo rāma dhanamāpnoti mānavaḥ / saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti vyavahāre tathā trayam
apāṃ garbhamiti hutvā devaṃ varṣāpayeddhruvam / apaḥ piveti ca tathā hutvā dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu
pravartayati dharmajña mahāvṛṣṭimanantaraṃ / namaste rudra ity etat sarvopadravanāśanaṃ
sarvaśāntikaraṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ / adhyavocadityanena rakṣaṇaṃ vyādhitasya tu
rakṣoghnañca yaśasyañca cirāyuḥpuṣṭivardhanam / siddhārthakānāṃ kṣepeṇa pathi caitajjapan sukhī
asau yastāmra ity etat paṭhannityaṃ divākaraṃ / upatiṣṭheta dharmajña sāyaṃ prātaratandritaḥ
annamakṣayamāpnoti dīrghamāyuś ca vindati / pramuñca(1) dhanvannityetat ṣaḍbhirāyudhamantraṇaṃ
ripūṇāṃ bhayadaṃ yuddhenātrakāryā vicāraṇā / māno mahānta ity evaṃ bālānāṃ śāntikārakaṃ
namo hiraṇyavāhave ity anuvākasaptakam / rājikāṃ kaṭutailāktāṃ juhuyācchatrunāśanīṃ
namo vaḥ kirikebhyaś ca padmalakṣāhutair naraḥ / rājyalakṣmīmavāpnoti tathā bilvaiḥ suvarṇakam
imā rudrāyeti tilair homācca dhanamāpyate / 1 prayuñjeti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca :p 452 dūrvāhomena cānyena sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
āśuḥ śiśāna ity etadāyudhānāñca rakṣaṇe / saṃgrāme kathitaṃ rāma sarvaśatrunivarhaṇaṃ
rājasāmeti juhuyāt sahasraṃ pañcabhirdvija / ājyāhutīnāṃ dharmajña cakṣūrogādvimucyate
śanno vanaspate gehe homaḥ syādvāstudoṣanut / agna āyūṃsi hutvājyaṃ dveṣaṃ nāpnoti kenacit
apāṃ pheneti lājābhirhutvā jayamavāpnuyāt / bhadrā itīndriyair hīno japan syāt sakalendriyaḥ
agniś ca pṛthivī ceti vaśīkaraṇamuttamam / adhvaneti japan mantraṃ vyavahāre jayī bhavet
brahma rājanyamiti ca karmārambhe tu siddhikṛt / saṃvatsarosīti dhṛtair lakṣahomādarogavān
ketuṃ kṛṇvannitītyetat saṃgrāme jayavardhanam / indrognirdharma ity etadraṇe dharmanibandhanam(1)
dhanvā nāgeti mantraś ca dhanurgrāhanikaḥ paraḥ / yajīteti tathā mantro vijñeyo hy abhimantraṇe
mantraścāhirathetyetaccharāṇāṃ(2) mantraṇe bhavet / vahnīnāṃ pitarityetattūrṇamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ
yuñjantīti tathāśvānāṃ yojane mantra ucyate / āśuḥ śiśāna ity etadyatrārambhaṇamucyate
1 dharmavivardhanamiti ja.. 2 mantraś ca hi ratha hy etaccharāṇāmiti ka.. , cha.. ,ca :p 453 viṣṇoḥ krameti mantraś ca rathārohaṇikaḥ paraḥ / ājaṅghetīti cāśvānāṃ tāḍanīyamudāhṛtaṃ
yāḥ senā abhitvarīti parasainyamukhe japet / dundubhya iti cāpyetaddundubhītāḍnaṃ bhavet
etaiḥ pūrvahutair mantraiḥ kṛtvaivaṃ vijayī bhavet / yamena dattamityasya koṭihomādvicakṣaṇaḥ
rathamutpādayecchīghraṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradam / ā kṛṣṇeti tathaitasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet
śivasaṃkalpajāpena(1) samādhiṃ manaso labhet / pañcanadyaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ hutvā lakṣmīmavāpnuyāt
yadā badhūndakṣāyaṇāṃ mantreṇānena mantritam / sahasrakṛtvaḥ kanakaṃ dhārayedripuvāraṇaṃ
imaṃ jīvebhya drati ca śilāṃ loṣṭrañcaturdiśaṃ / kṣipedgṛhe tadā tasya na syāccaurabhayaṃ niśi
parimegāmaneneti(2) vaśīkaraṇamuttamaṃ / hantumabhyāgatastatra vaśībhavati mānavaḥ
bhakṣyatāmvūlapuṣpādyaṃ mantritantu prayacchati / yasya dharmajña vaśagaḥ somya śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati
śanno mitra itītyetat sadā sarvatra śāntidaṃ / gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ kṛtvā homañcatuṣpathe
vaśīkuryājjagatsarvam sarvadhānyair asaṃśayam / 1 śivasaṃkalpa ity etaditi gha.. , ja.. ca 2 parāṅne gāyanenetīti ka.. :p 454 hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayo mantroyamabhiṣecane
śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye tathā śāntikaraḥ paraḥ / ekacakreti mantreṇa hutenājyena bhāgaśaḥ(1)
grahebhyaḥ śāntimāpnoti prasādaṃ na ca saṃśayaḥ / gāvo bhaga iti dvābhyāṃ hutvājyaṅgā avāpnuyāt
pravādāṃśaḥ sopaditi(2) gṛhayajñe vidhīyate / devebhyo vanaspata iti drumayajñe vidhīyate
gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī jñeyā tadviṣṇoḥ paramampadaṃ / sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmakarantathā(3)
sāmavidhānaṃ puṣkara uvāca yujurvidhānaṅkathitaṃ vakṣye sāmnāṃ vidhānakaṃ / saṃhitāṃ vaiṣṇavīñjaptvā hutvā syāt sarvakāmabhāk
saṃhitāñchāndasīṃ sādhu japtvā prīṇāti śaṅkaraṃ / skandīṃ paitryāṃ saṃhitāñca japtvā syāttu prasādavān

1 bhāgata iti ka.. , ga.. , cha.. , ña.. ca 2 pravādīśaṃ sopaditīti kha.. , cha.. ca 3 sarvaśāntikarantatheti gha.. , ña.. ca :p 455 yata indra bhajāmahe hiṃsādoṣavināśanaṃ / avakīrṇī mucyate ca agnistigmeti vai japan
sarvapāpaharaṃ jñeyaṃ paritoyañca tāsu ca(1) / avikreyañca vikrīya japedghṛtavatīti ca
ayāno deva saviturjñeyanduḥsvapnanāśanaṃ / abodhyagniritimantreṇa ghṛtaṃ rāma yathāvidhi
abhyukṣya ghṛtaśeṣeṇa mekhalābandha iṣyate / strīṇāṃ yāsāntu garbhāṇi patanti bhṛgusattama
maṇiṃ jātasya bālasya vadhnīyāttadanantaraṃ / somaṃ rājānametena vyādhibhirvipramucyate
sarpasāma prayuñjīno nāpnuyāt sarpajambhayaṃ / mādya tvā vādyatetyetaddhutvā vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ
śatāvarimaṇibaddhvā nāpnuyācchastrato bhayaṃ / dīrghatamasorka iti huttvānnaṃ prāpnuyādbahu
svamadhyāyantīti japanna mriyeta pipāsayā(2) / tvamimā oṣadhī hy etajjaptvā vyādhiṃ na vāpnuyāt
pathi devavratañjaptvā bhayebhyo vipramucyate / yadindro munaye tveti hutaṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ
bhago na citra ity evaṃ netrayo rañjanaṃ hitaṃ / saubhāgyavardhanaṃ rāma nātra kārya vicāraṇā
japendreti vargañca tathā saunbhāgyavardhanaṃ / 1 paritoyaṃ yutāyutamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca 2 pipāsita iti gha.. , ña.. ca :p 456 pari priyā hi vaḥ kāriḥ(1) kāmyāṃ saṃśrāvayet striyaṃ
sā taṅkāmayate rāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / rathantaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ brahmavarcasavardhanaṃ
prāśayedbālakaṃ nityaṃ vacācūrṇaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ / indramidgāthinaṃ japtvā bhavecchrutidharastvasau
hutvā rathantarañjaptvā putramāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ / mayi śrīriti mantroyaṃ japtavyaḥ śrīvivardhanaḥ
vairūpyasyāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prayuñjānaḥ śriyaṃ labhet / saptāṣṭakaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt
gavyeṣuṇeti yo nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātaratantritaḥ / upasthānaṃ gavāṃ kuryāttasya syustāḥ sadā gṛhe
ghṛtāktantu yavadroṇaṃ vāta āvātu bheṣajaṃ / anena vidhivat sarvāṃ māyāṃ vyapohati
pradevo dāsena tilān hutvā kārmaṇakṛntanaṃ / abhi tvā pūrvapītaye vaṣaṭkārasamanvitaṃ
vāsakedhmasahasrantu hutaṃ yuddhe jayapradaṃ / hastyaśvapuruṣān kuryādbudhaḥ piṣṭamayān śubhān
parakīyānathoddeśya pradhānapuruṣāṃs tathā / susvinnān piṣṭakavarān kṣureṇot kṛtya bhāgaśaḥ
abhi tvā śūra ṇonumo mantreṇānena mantravit / kṛtvā sarṣapatailāktān krodhena(2) juhuyāttataḥ

1 paripriyādeva kāririti kha.. , cha.. ca / paripriyādeva kaviriti gha.. , ña.. ca 2 mantreṇeti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca :p 457 etat kṛtvā budhaḥ karma saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt / gāruḍaṃ vāmadevyañca rathantaravṛhadrathau
sarvapāpapraśamanāḥ kathitāḥ saṃśayaṃ vinā //25
śāntātīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntimāpnoti mānavaḥ
bhaiṣajyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvānrogān vyāpohati / trisaptīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
kvacinnāpnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṅgaṇaṃ / na kvacijjāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvā parājitaṃ
āyuṣyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā apamṛtyuṃ vyapohati / svastimāpnoti sarvatra hutvā svastyayanaṅgaṇaṃ
śreyasā yogamāpnoti śarmavarmagaṇantathā / vāstoṣpatyagaṇaṃ hutvā vāstudoṣān vyapohati
tathā raudragaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān doṣān vyapohati / etair daśaguṇair homī hy aṣṭādaśasu śāntiṣu
vaiṣṇavī śāntiraindrī ca brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca / vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauverī bhārgavī tathā
prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā / mārudgaṇā ca gāndhārī śāntair nairṛtakī tathā
śāntirāṅgirasī yāmyā pārthivī sarvakāmadā / yastvāṃ mṛtyuriti hy etajjaptaṃ mṛtyuvināśanaṃ
suparṇastveti hutvā ca bhujagair naiva bādhyate / indreṇa dattamityetat sarvakāmakarambhavet
indreṇa dattamityetat sarvabādhāvināśanaṃ / imā devīti mantraś ca sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ
devā maruta ity etat sarvakāmakarambhavet / yamasya lokādityetat duḥsvapnaśamanamparaṃ
indraś ca pañcabaṇijeti(1) hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ / kāmo me vājīti hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ
tubhyameva javīmannityayutantu hutambhavet / agne gobhinna ity etat(2) medhāvṛddhikaramparaṃ
dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet / alaktajīveti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet
ahante bhagna ity etat bhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ / ye me pāśas tathāpyetat bandhanāmnokṣakāraṇaṃ
śapantvahanniti ripūn nāśayeddhomajāpyataḥ / 1 indra vanaṃ vanik cetīti gha.. , ja.. ca 2 agne saubhāgya ity etaditi ja.. :p 459 tvamuttamamitītyetadyaśobuddhivivardhanaṃ
yathā mṛgamatītyetat strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ / yena cehadidañcaiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet
ayante yonirityetat putralābhakaraṃ bhavet / śivaḥ śivābhirityetat bhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ(1)
vṛhaspatir naḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet / muñcāmi tveti kathitamapamṛtyunivāraṇaṃ
atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcit karma taveritaṃ
vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānāntu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ / ājyañca vrīhayaś caiva tathā vai gaurasarṣapāḥ
akṣatāni tilāś caiva dadhikṣīre ca bhārgava / darbhāstathaiva dūrvāś ca vilvāni kamalāni ca
śāntipuṣṭikarāṇyāhurdravyāṇyetāni sarvaśaḥ / tailaṅkaṇāni dharmajña rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣaṃ
samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet / ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chando viniyogajña ācaret

mantrarūpauṣadhakathanaṃ dhanvantarir uvāca āyurārogyakartara oṃkāradyāś ca nākadāḥ / oṃkāraḥ paramo mantrastaṃ japtvā cāmaro bhavet
gāyatrī paramo mantrastaṃ japtvā bhuktimuktibhāk / oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya sarvadaḥ / oṃ hūṃ namo viṣṇave mantroyañcauṣadhaṃ paraṃ
anena devā hy asurāḥ saśriyo nirujo 'bhavat / bhūtānāmupakāraś ca tathā dharmo mahauṣadham
dharmaḥ saddharmakṛddharmī etair dharmaiś ca nirmalaḥ / śrīdaḥ śrīṣaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ śrīdharaḥśrīniketanaḥ
śriyaḥ patiḥ śrīparama etaiḥ śriyamavāpnuyāt / kāmī kāmapradaḥ kāmaḥ kāmapālas tathā hariḥ
ānando mādhavaś caiva nāma kāmāya vai hareḥ / rāmaḥ paraśurāmaś ca nṛsiṃho viṣṇureva ca
trivikramaś ca nāmāni japtavyāni jigīṣubhiḥ / vidyāmabhyasyatāṃ nityaṃ japtavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
dāmodaro bandhaharaḥ puṣkarākṣo 'kṣiroganut / hṛṣīkeśo bhayaharo japedauṣadhakarmaṇi
acyutañcāmṛtaṃ mantraṃ saṅgrāme cāparājitaḥ / jalatāre nārasiṃhaṃ pūrvādau kṣemakāmavān
cakriṇaṅgadinañcaiva śārṅgiṇaṃ khaḍginaṃ smaret / nārāyaṇaṃ sarvakāle nṛsiṃho 'khilabhītinut
garuḍadhvajaś ca viṣahṛt vāsudevaṃ sadājapet / dhānyādisthāpane svapne anantācyutamīrayet
nārāyaṇañca duḥsvapne dāhādau jalaśāyinaṃ / hayagrīvañca vidyārthī jagatsūtiṃ sutāptaye / balabhadraṃ śaurakārye(1) ekaṃ nāmārthasādhakam(2)
mṛtasañjīvanīkarasiddhayogaḥ dhanvantarir uvāca siddhayogān punarvakṣe mṛtasañjīvanīkarān/ ātreyabhāṣitān divyān sarvavyādhivimardanān(3)
ātreya uvāca vilvādipañcamūlasya kvāthaḥ syādvātike jvare / pāvanaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ guḍūcī viṣvajo 'tha vā
1 vīrakārye iti kha.. 2 ekanāmātha sarthakamiti kha.. , ña.. ca 3 sarvavyādhivināśakāniti kha.. :p 50 āmalakyabhayā kṛṣṇa vahniḥ sarvajvarāntakaḥ / vilvāgnimanthaśyonākakāśmaryaḥ pārlā sthirā
trikaṇṭakaṃ pṛśnaparṇī vṛhatī kaṇṭakārikāḥ / jvarāvipākapārśvārtikāśanut kuśamūlakam
guḍūcī parpaṭī mustaṃ kirātaṃ viśvabheṣajam / vātapittajvare deyaṃ pañcabhadramidaṃ smṛtam
trivṛdviśālakaṭukātriphalāragbadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ / sṃskāro bhedanakvāthaḥ peyaḥ sarvajvarāpahaḥ
devadārubalāvāsātriphalāvyopapadmakaiḥ(1) / saviḍaṅgaiḥ sitātulyaṃ taccurṇaṃ pañcakāśajit
daśamūlīśaṭīrāsnāpippalībilvapauṣkaraiḥ / śṛṅgītāmalakībhārgīguḍūcīnāgavallibhiḥ
yavāgraṃ vidhinā siddhaṃ kaśāyaṃ vā pivennaraḥ / kāśahṛdgrahaṇīpārśvahikvāśvāsapraśāntaye
madhukaṃ madhunā yuktaṃ vippalīṃ śarkarānvitāṃ / nāgaraṃ guḍasaṃyuktaṃ hikvāghnaṃ lāvaṇatrayam
kāravyajājīmaricaṃ drākṣā vṛkṣāmladāḍimam / sauvarcalaṃ guḍaṃ kṣaudraṃ sarvārocananāśanam
śṛṅgaverarasañcaiva madhunā saha pāyayet / aruciśvāsakāśaghnaṃ pratiśyāyakaphāntakam
vaṭaṃ śṛṅgī śilālodhradāḍimaṃ madhukaṃ madhu / pivet taṇḍulatoyena ccharditṛṣṇānivāraṇam
1 devadārubalārāsnātriphalāvyoṣapadmakair iti kha.. :p 51 guḍucī vāsakaṃ lodhraṃ pippalīkṣaudrasaṃyutam / kaphānvitañjayedraktaṃ tṛṣṇākāsajvarāpaham
vāsakasya rasastadvat samadhustāmrajo rasaḥ / śirīṣapuṣpasurasabhāvitaṃ maricaṃ hitaṃ
sarvārtinunmasūro 'tha pittamuk taṇḍlīyakaṃ / nirguṇḍī śārivā śelu raṅgolaś ca(1) viṣāpahaḥ
mahauṣadhaṃ mṛtāṃ kṣudrāṃ puṣkaraṃ(2)granthikodbhavaṃ(3) / pivet kaṇāyutaṃ kvāthaṃ mūrchāyāñca madeṣu ca
hiṅgusaurcalavyoṣairdviplāṃśairghṛtāḍhakaṃ(?) / caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre siddhamunmādanāśanaṃ
śaṅkhapuṣpīvattākuṣṭhaiḥ siddhaṃ brāhmīrasair yutaṃ / purāṇaṃ hantyapasmāraṃ sonmādaṃ medhyamuttamaṃ
pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tadvat kuṣṭhanuccābhayāyutaṃ / paṭolatriphalānimbaguḍucīdhāvaṇīvṛṣaiḥ

kuryāddaśapalān bhāgān ekaikasya sakuṭṭitān / jaladroṇe vipaktavyaṃ yāvatpādāvaśeṣitaṃ
ghṛtaprasthampacettena triphalāgarbhasaṃyutaṃ(4) / pañcatiktamiti khyātaṃ sarpiḥ kuṣṭhavināśanaṃ

aśītiṃ vātajānrogān catvāriṃśacca paittikān / 1 vaṅkolaśceti kha.. , ña.. , ca 2 puṣpakamiti ja.. 3 granthilodbhavamiti kha.. 4 triphalāśarkarāyutamiti kha.. , ña.. ca :p 52 viṃśatiṃ ślaiṣmikān kāsapīnasārśovraṇādikān
hantyanyān yogarajo 'yaṃ yathārkastimiraṃ khalu / triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyena bhṛṅnarājarasena ca
vraṇaprakṣālanaṅkuryādupadaṃśapraśāntaye / paṭīladalacūrṇena dāḍimatvagrajo 'tha vā
guṇḍayecca gajenāpi(1) triphalācūrṇakena ca / triphalāyorajoyaṣṭhimārkavotpalamāricaiḥ
samaindhavaiḥ pacettailamabhyaṅgācchardikāpahaṃ / sakṣīrān mārkavarasān dviprasthamadhukotpalaiḥ
pacettu tailakuḍavaṃ tannasyaṃ palitāpahaṃ / nimbampaṭolaṃ triphalā guḍūcī svadiraṃ vṛṣaṃ
bhūnimbapāṭhātriphalāguḍūcīraktacandanaṃ / yogadvayaṃ jvaraṃ hanti kuṣṭhavisphoṭakādikaṃ
paṭolāmṛtabhūnimbavāsāriṣṭakaparpaṭaiḥ / khadirāntayutaiḥ kvātho visphoṭajvaraśāntikṛt
daśamūlī cchinnaruhā pathyā dāru punarnavā / jvaravidradhiśotheṣu śigruviśvajitā hitāḥ
madhūkaṃ nimbapatrāṇi lepaḥ syadvraṇaśodhanaḥ / triphalā khadiro dārvī nyagrodhātibalākuśāḥ
nimbamūlakapatrāṇāṃ kaṣāyāḥ śodhane hitāḥ / karañjāriṣṭanirguṇḍīraso hanyādvraṇakramīn
1 guṇḍayennagajenāpīti kha.. , ña.. ca :p 53 dhātakicandanabalāsamaṅgāmadhukotpalaiḥ / dārvīmedonvitair lepaḥ samarpirvraṇaropaṇaḥ
guggulutriphalāvyoṣasamāṃrśair ghṛtayogataḥ / nāḍī duṣṭavraṇaṃ śūlambhagandaramukhaṃ haret
haritakīṃ mūtrasiddhāṃ satailalavaṇānvitāṃ / prātaḥ prātaś ca seveta kaphavātāmayāpahāṃ(1)
trikaṭutriphalākvāthaṃ(2) sakṣāralavaṇaṃ pivet / kaphavātātmakeṣveva virekaḥ kaphavṛddhinut
pappalīpippalīmūlavacācitrakanāgaraiḥ / kvāthitaṃ vā pivetpeyamāmavātavināśanaṃ
rāsnāṃ guḍucīmeraṇḍadevadārumahauṣadhaṃ / pivet sarvāṅgike vāte sāme sandhyasthimajjage
daśamūlakaśāyaṃ vā piveddhā nāgarāmbhasā / śuṇṭhīgokṣurakakvāthaḥ prātaḥ prātir niṣevitaḥ
sāmavātakaṭīśūlapācano rukpraṇāśanaḥ / samūlapatraśākhāyāḥ prasāraṇyāś ca tailakaṃ
guḍucyāḥ surasaḥ kalkaḥ cūrṇaṃ vā kvāthameva ca / prabhūtakālamāsevya mucyate vātaśoṇitāt
pippalī vardhamānaṃ vā sevyaṃ pathyā guḍena vā / paṭolatriphalātīvrakaṭukāsṛtasādhitaṃ(3)

pakvaṃ pītvā jayatyāśu sadāhaṃ vātaśoṇitaṃ / 1 kaphavātavināśinīmiti ja.. 2 trikaṭutriphalākuṣṭhamiti ña.. 3 paṭolatriphalābhirukaṭukāmṛtasādhitamiti kha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca :p 54 guggulaṃ koṣṇaśīte(1) tu guḍucī triphalāmbhasā
balāpunar navair aṇḍavṛhatīdvayagokṣuraiḥ / sahiṅgu lavanaiḥ pītaṃ sadyo vātarujāpahaṃ
kārṣikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pañcaiva lavaṇāni ca / pippalī citrakaṃ śuṇṭhī triphalā trivṛtā vacā
dvau kṣārau śādvalā dantī svarṇakṣīrī viṣāṇikā / kolapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ pivet sauvīrakāyutāṃ
śothāvapāke trivṛtā pravṛddhe codarādike / kṣīraṃ śothaharaṃ dāru varṣābhūrnāgaraiḥ śubham
sekas tathārkavarṣābhūnimbakvāthena śothajit / vyoṣagarbhaṃ palāśasya triguṇe bhasmavāriṇi
sādhitaṃ pivataḥ sarpiḥ patatyarśo na saṃśayaḥ / viśvaksenāvanirguṇḍīsādhitaṃ cāpi lāvaṇaṃ
viḍaṅgānalasindhūttharāsnāgrakṣāradārubhiḥ / tailañcaturguṇaṃ siddhaṃ kaṭudravyaṃ jalena vā
gaṇḍamālāpahaṃ tailamabhyaṅgāt galagaṇḍanut / śaṭīkunāgabalayakvāthaḥ kṣīrarase yutam
payasyāpippalīvāsākalkaṃ siddhaṃ kṣaye hitam / vacāviḍabhayāśuṇṭhīhiṅgukuṣṭhāgnidīpyakān
dvitriṣaṭcaturekāṃśasaptapañcāśikāḥ kramāt / cūrṇaṃ pītaṃ hanti gulmaṃ udaraṃ śūlakāsanut
pāṭhānikumbhatrikaṭutriphalāgniṣu sādhitam / 1 ktoṣṭuśīte 'theti kha.. :p 55 mūtreṇa cūrṇaguṭikā gulmaplīhādimardanī
vāsānimbapaṭīlāni triphalā vātapittanut(1) / lihyāt kṣaudreṇa viḍaṅgaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛmivināśanam
viḍaṅgasaindhavakṣāramūtrenāpi harītakī / śallakīvadarījambupiyālāmrārjunatvacaḥ
pītāḥ kṣīreṇa madhvaktāḥ pṛthakśīṇitavāraṇāḥ / vilvāmraghātakīpāṭhāśuṇṭhīmocarasāḥ samāḥ
pītā rundhantyatīsāraṃ guḍatakreṇa durjayam / cāṅgerīkoladadhyambunāgarakṣārasaṃyutam
ghṛtayukkvāthitaṃ peyaṃ gudaṃbhrase rujāpaham / viḍaṅgātiviṣāmustaṃ dārupāthākaliṅgakam
marīcena samāyuktaṃ śothātīsāranāśanam / śarkarāsindhuśuṇṭhībhiḥ kṛṣṇāmadhuguḍena vā
dve dve khādeddharītakyau jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī / triphalā pippalīyuktā samdhvājyā tathaiva sā
cūrnamāmalakaṃ tena surasena tu bhavitam / madhvājyaśarkarāyuktaṃ liḍhvā strīśaḥ payaḥ pivet
māsapippaliśālīnāṃ yavagodhūmayos tathā / cūrṇabhāgaiḥ samāṃśaiś ca pacet pippalīkāṃ śubhāṃ
tāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca pivet śarkarāmadhuraṃ payaḥ / navaś caṭakavajjambhed daśavārān striyaṃ dhruvam
samaṅgādhātakīpuṣpalodhranīlotpalāni ca / 1 tripalā cāmlapittanuditi kha.. , ña.. ca :p 56 etat kṣīrena dātavyaṃ strīṇāṃ pradaranaśanaṃ
vījaṅkauraṇṭakañcāpi madhukaṃ śvetacandanaṃ / padmotpalasya mūlāni madhukaṃ śarkarātilān
dravamāṇeṣu garbheṣu garbhasyāpanamuttamaṃ / devadāru nabhaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ(1) naladaṃ viśvabheṣajaṃ
lepaḥ kāñcikamampaṣṭastailayuktaḥ śirortinut / vastrapūtaṃ kṣipet koṣṇaṃ mindhūtyaṃ karṇaśūlanut
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ kadalyā vā rasaḥpṛthak / balāśatāvarīrāsnāmṛtāḥ mairīyakeḥ pivet
triphalāsahitaṃ sarpistimiraghnamanuttamaṃ / triphalāvyoṣasindhūptyair ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pivennaraḥ
cākṣuṣyambhedanaṃ hṛdyaṃ(2) dīpanaṃ krapharoganut / nīlotpalasya kiñjalkaṃ gośakṛdrasasaṃyutaṃ
guṭikāñjanametat syāt dinarātryandhayorhitaṃ / yaṣṭīmadhuvacākṛṣṇāvījānāṃ kuṭajasya ca
kalkenāloḍya nimbasya kaṣāyo vamanāya saḥ / snigdhasvinnayavantoyaṃ pradātavyaṃ virecanam
anyathā yojitaṃ kuryāt mandāgniṃ gauravāruciṃ / pathyāsaindhavakṛṣṇānāṃ(3) cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pivet

virekaḥ sarvarogaghnaḥ śreṣṭho nārācasaṃjñakaḥ / 1 kṛṣṇamiti kha.. 2 kuṣṭhamiti ña.. 3 pathyāsaindhavakuṣṭhānāmiti kha.. :p 57 siddhayogā munibhyo ye ātreyeṇa pradarśitāḥ / sarvarogaharāḥ sarvayogāgryāḥ suśrutena hi
kalpasāgaraḥ dhanvantarir uvāca kalpāmmṛtyuñcayānvakṣye hy āyurdānrogasardanān / triśatī rogahā sevyā madhvājyatriphalāmṛtā
palaṃ palārdhaṃ karṣaṃ vā triphalāṃ sakalāṃ tathā / bilvatailasya nasyañca māsaṃ pañcaśatī kaviḥ
rogāpamṛtyubalijit tilaṃ(1) bhallātakaṃ tathā / pañcāṅgaṃ vākūcīcūṇaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ khadirodakaiḥ
kvāthaiḥ kuṣṭhañjayet sevyaṃ cūrṇaṃ nīlakuruṇṭajam / kṣireṇa madhunā vāpi śatāyuḥ khaṇḍadugdhabhuk
madhvājyaśuṇṭhīṃ saṃsevya palaṃ prātaḥ samṛdyujit / balīpalitajijjīvenmāṇḍakīcūrṇadugdhapāḥ
uccaṭāmadhunā karṣaṃ payaḥpā mṛtyujinnaraḥ / madhvājyaiḥ payasā vāpi nirguṇḍī rogamṛtyujit
1 tailamiti ña.. :p 58 palāśatailaṃ karṣaikaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ madhunā pivet / dugdhabhojī pañcaśatī sahasrāyurbhavennaraḥ
jyotiṣmatīpatrarasaṃ payasā triphalāṃ pivet / madhunājyantatastadvat śatāvaryā rajaḥ palaṃ
kṣaudrājyaiḥ payasā vāpi nirguṇḍī rogamṛtyujit / pañcāṅgaṃ nimbacūrṇasya khadirakvāthabhāvitaṃ
karṣaṃ bhṛṅgarasenāpi rogajiccāmaro(1) bhavet / rudantikājyamadhubhuk dugdhabhojī ca mṛtyujit
karṣacūrṇaṃ harītakyā bhāvitaṃ bhṛṅgarāḍrasaiḥ / ghṛtena madhunā sevya triśatāyuś ca rogajit
vārāhikā bhṛṅgarasaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ śatāvarī / sājyaṃ karṣaṃ(2) pañcaśatī kartacūrṇaṃ śatāvarī
bhāvitaṃ bhṛṅgarājena madhvājyantriśatī bhavet / tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ(3) sṛtatulyaṃ(4) gandhakañca kumārikā
rasair vimṛjya dve guñje sājyaṃ pañcaśatābdavān / aśvagandhā palaṃ tailaṃ sājyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ śatābdavān
palampunar navācūrṇaṃ madhvājyapayasā pivam / aśokacūrṇasya palaṃ madhvājyaṃ payasārtinut
tilasya tailaṃ samadhu nasyāt kṛṣṇakacaḥ śatī / karṣamakṣaṃ samadhvājyaṃ śatāyuḥ payasā pivan

1 roganuccāmaro bhavediti ña.. 2 sājyaṃ sarvamiti kha.. 3 tāmrāmṛtamiti kha.. 4 suratusyamiti ja.. , ña.. ca :p 59 abhayaṃ saguḍañcagdhvā ghṛtena madhurādibhiḥ / dugdhānnabhuk kṛṣṇakeśo 'rogī pañcaśatābdavān
palaṅkuṣmāṇḍikācūrṇaṃ madhvājyapayasā pivan / māsaṃ dugdhānnabhojī ca sahasrāyurvirogavān
śālūkacūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgājyaṃ samadhvājyaṃ śatābdakṛt / kaṭutumbītailanasyaṃ karṣaṃ śatadvayābdavān
triphalā pippalī śuṇṭhī sevitā triśatābdakṛt / śatāvaryāḥ pūrvayogaḥ sahasrāyurbalātikṛt
citrakena tathā purvas tathā śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgataḥ / lohena bhṛṅgarājena balayā nimbapañcakaiḥ
khadireṇa ca nirguṇḍyā kaṇṭakāryātha vāsakāt / varṣābhuvā tadrasair vā bhāvito vaṭikākṛtaḥ
cūrṇaṅghṛtair vā madhunā guḍādyair vāriṇā tathā / oṃ hrūṃ sa itimantreṇa mantrato yogarājakaḥ
mṛtasañjīvanīkalpo rogamṛtyuñjayo bhavet / surāsuraiś ca munibhiḥ sevitāḥ kalpasāgarāḥ gajāyurvedaṃ provāca pālakāpye 'ṅgarājakaṃ
gajacikitsā pālakāpya uvāca(1) gajalakṣma cikitsāñca lomapāda yadāmi te / dīrghahastā mahocchvāsāḥ prasastāste mahiṣṇavaḥ
viṃśatyaṣṭādaśanakhāḥ śītakālamadāś ca ye / dakṣiṇañconnatandantaṃ vṛṃhitaṃ jaladopamaṃ
karṇaur ca vipūlau yeṣāṃ sūkṣmavindvanvitatvacau / te dhāryā na tathā dhāryā vāmanā ye ca saṅkuśāḥ(2)
hastinyaḥ pārśvagarbhiṇyo ca mūḍhā mataṅgajāḥ / varṇaṃ satvaṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ kāntiḥ saṃhananañjavaḥ
saptasthito gajaścedṛk saṅgrāmerīñjayetsa ca / kuñjarāḥ paramā śobhā śivirasya balasya ca
āyattaṃ kuñjaraiś caiva vijayaṃ pṛthivīkṣitāṃ / pākaleṣu ca sarveṣu kartavyamanuvāsanaṃ
ghṛtatailaparīpākaṃ sthānaṃ vātavivarjitaṃ / skandheṣu ca kriyā karyā tathā pālakavannṛpāḥ
gomūtraṃ pāṇḍurogeṣu rajanībhyāṃ ghṛtandvija / ānāhe tailasiktasya niṣekastasya śasyate
lavaṇaiḥ pañcabhirmaśrā pratipānāya vāruṇī / 1 dhanvantariruvāceti ña.. 2 mardanā iti ña.. :p 61 viḍaṅgatriphalāvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ kavalān kṛtān
mūrchāsu bhojayennāgaṃ kṣaudrantoyañca pāyayet / agyaṅgaḥ śirasaḥ śūle nasyañcaiva praśasyate

yavaṃ madhutrayaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dadhi samicchataṃ / hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ śiṣṭaṃ prāśayetsaghṛtaṃ caruṃ
sambhojya viprānācāryaṃ toṣayetsidhyate manuḥ / snātvā yathāvadācamya vāgyato yāgamandiraṃ
gatvā padmāsanaṃ baddhvā śoṣayedvidhinā vapuḥ / rakṣoghnavighnakṛddikṣu nyasedādau sudarśanam

urdhvīkṛtena hastena raktapaṅkajadhāriṇīṃ / śvetāṅgīṃ dakṣiṇe dvāri cintayedvanamālinīm

cakrāya śaṅkhāya gadāyai khaḍgāya dhanuṣe vāṇāya / aṣṭamyādyair imāṃ durgāṃ lokeśāntāṃ yajediti / durgāyogaḥ samāyuḥśrīsvāmiraktājayādikṛt
samādhyeśānamantreṇa tilahomo vaśīkaraḥ / jayaḥ padmaistu durvābhiḥ śāntiḥ kāmaḥ palāśajaiḥ

śaṅkhacakrābjaśūlāditriśūlāṃ raudrarūpiṇīṃ / yuddhādau sañjayedetāṃ yajet khaḍgādike jaye

mayūrabalayā picchamauliḥ kisalayāṃśukā / siṃhāsanasthā māyūravarhacchatrasamanvitā
trinetrā śyāmalā devī vanamālāvibhūṣaṇā / viprāhikaṇrābharaṇā catrakeyūrabhūṣaṇā
vaiśyanāgakaṭībandhā vṛṣalāhikṛtanūpurā / evaṃ rūpātmikā bhūtvā tanmantraṃ niyutaṃ japet
īśaḥ kirātarūpo 'bhūt purā gaurī ca tādṛśī / japeddhyāyet pūjayettāṃ sarvasiddhyaiviṣādihṛt
aṣṭasiṃhāsane pūjyā dale pūrvādike kramāt / aṅgagāyatrī praṇītā hūṅkārādyā dalāgrake
phaṭkārī cāgrato devyāḥ śrīvījenārcayedimāḥ / lokeśāyudhavarṇāstāḥ phaṭkārī tu dhanurdharā
