manovyāpārabhūyiṣṭho mana ārambha ucyate / dvividhaḥ pauruṣastraiṇa īdṛśo 'pi prasidhyati
śobhā vilāso mādhuryaṃ sthairyaṃ gāmbhīryameva ca / lalitañca tathaudāryantejo 'ṣṭāviti pauruṣāḥ
nīcanindottamaspardhā śauryaṃ dākṣādikāraṇaṃ / manodharme bhavecchobhā śobhate bhavanaṃ yathā
bhāvo hāvaś ca helā ca śobhā kāntistathaiva ca / dīptirmādhuryaśaurye ca prāgalbhyaṃ syādudāratā
sthairyaṃ gambhīratā strīṇāṃ vibhāvā dvādaśeritāḥ / bhāvo vilāso hāvaḥsyādbhāvaḥ kiñcicca harṣajaḥ
vāco yuktirbhavedvāgārambho dvādaśa eva saḥ / tatrābhāṣaṇamālāpaḥ pralāpo vacanaṃ vahu(1)
vilāpo duḥkhavacanamanulāpo 'sakṛdvacaḥ / saṃlāpa uktapratyuktamapalāpo 'nyathāvacaḥ
vārtāprayāṇaṃ sandeśo nirdeśaḥ pratipādanam / tattvadeśo 'tideśo 'yamapadeśo 'nyavarṇanam
upadeśaś ca śikṣāvāk vyājoktirvyapadeśakaḥ / bodhāya eṣa vyāpāraḥsubuddhyārambha iṣyate / tasya bhedāstrayaste ca rītivṛttipravṛttayaḥ
rītinirūpaṇaṃ agnirucāca vāgvidyāsampratijñāne rītiḥ sāpi caturvidhā / pāñcālī gauḍadeśīyā vaidarbhī lāṭajā tathā
upacārayutā mṛdvī pāñcālī hrasvavigrahā / anavasthitasandarbhā gauḍīyā dīrghavigrahā
upacārair na bahubhirupacārair vivarjitā / nātikomalasandarbhā vaidarbhī muktavigrahā
lāṭīyā sphuṭasandharbhā nātivisphuravigrahā / parityaktāpi bhūyobhirupacārair udāhṛtā
kriyāsvaviṣamā vṛttirbhāratyārabhaṭī tathā / kauśikī sātvatī ceti sā caturdhā pratiṣṭhitā
vākpradhānā naraprāyā strīyuktā prākṛtoktitā / bharatena praṇītatvād bhāratī rītirucyate
catvāryaṅgāni bhāratyā vīthī prahasanantathā / prastāvanā nāṭakādervīthyaṅgāś ca trayodaśa
udghātakaṃ tathaiva syāllapitaṃ syāddvitīyakam / asatpralāpo vākśreṇī(1) nālikā vipaṇantathā
vyāhārastimatañcaiva(2) chalāvaskandite tathā / 1 vāgveṇīti ka.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 2 vyāhārastrigatañcaiveti kha.. :p 211 gaṇḍo 'tha mṛdavaś caiva trayodaśamathācitam
tāpasādeḥ prahasanaṃ parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ / māyendrajālayuddhādibahulārabhaṭī smṛtā / maṅkṣiptakārapātau ca(1) vastūtthāpanameva ca
nṛtyādāvaṅgakarmanirūpaṇaṃ agnir uvāca ceṣṭāviśeṣamapyaṅgapratyaṅge karma cānayoḥ / śarīrārambhamicchanti prāyaḥ pūrvo 'valāśrayaḥ
līlā vilāso vichittirvibhramaṃ kilakiñcitaṃ / moṭṭāyitaṃ kuṭṭamitaṃ vivvoko lalitantathā
vikṛtaṃ krīḍitaṃ keliriti dvādaśadhaiva saḥ / līleṣṭajanaceṣṭānukaraṇaṃ saṃvṛtakṣaye
viśeṣān darśayan kiñcidvilāsaḥ sadbhiriṣyate / hasitakrānditādīnāṃ saṅkaraḥ kilakiñcitaṃ
vikāraḥ kopi vivvoko lalitaṃ saukumāryataḥ / śiraḥ pāṇiruraḥ pārśvaṅkaṭiraṅghririti kramāt
aṅgāni bhrūlatādīni pratyaṅgānyabhijānate / 1 saṅkṣiptakarapātau ceti ja.. :p 212 aṅgapratyaṅgayoḥ karma prayatnajanitaṃ vinā
na prayogaḥ kvacinmukhyantiraścīnañca tat kvacit / ākampitaṃ kampitañca(1) dhūtaṃ vidhūtameva ca
parivāhitamādhūtamavadhūtamathācitaṃ / nikuñcitaṃ parāvṛttamutkṣiptañcāpyadhogatam
lalitañceti vijñeyaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ śiraḥ / bhrūkarma saptadhā jñeyaṃ pātanaṃ bhrūkuṭīmukhaṃ
dṛṣtistridhā ramasthāyisañcāripratibandhanā / ṣaṭtriṃśadbhedavidhurā rasajā tatra cāṣṭadhā
navadhā tārakākarma bhramaṇañcalanādikaṃ / ṣoḍhā ca nāsikā jñeyā niśvāso navadhā mataḥ
ṣoṭauṣṭhakarmakaṃ pāpaṃ saptadhā civukakriyā / kaluṣādimukhaṃ ṣoḍhā grīvā navavidhā smṛtā
asaṃyutaḥ saṃyutaś ca bhūmnā hastaḥ pramucyate / patākastripātākaś ca tathā vai kartarīmukhaḥ
ardhacandrotkarālaś ca śukatuṇḍastathaiva ca / suṣṭiś ca śikharaś caiva kapitthaḥ kheṭakāmukhaḥ
sūcyāsyaḥ padmakoṣo hi śirāḥ samṛgaśīrṣakāḥ / kāṃmūlakālapadmau(2)* ca caturabhramarau tathā

haṃsāsyahaṃsapakṣau ca sandaṃśamukulau tathā / 1 ākalpitaṃ kalpitañceti kha.. 2 kāṅgūlakālapadmāviti ña.. kāṃmūlakālapadmau kāṅgūlakālapadmau etatpāṭhadvayaṃ na samīcīnaṃ :p 213 urṇanābhastāmracūḍaś caturviṃśatirityamī
asaṃyutakarāḥ proktāḥ saṃyutāstu trayodaśa / añjaliś ca kapotaś ca karkaṭaḥ svastikas tathā
kaṭako vardhamānaścāpyasaṅgo niṣadhas tathā / dolaḥ puṣpapuṭaś caiva tathā makara eva ca
gajadanto vahistambho vardhamāno 'pare karāḥ / uraḥ pañcavidhaṃ syāttu ābhugnanartanādikam
udaranduratikṣāmaṃ khaṇḍaṃ pūrṇamiti tridhā / pārśvayoḥ pañcakarmāṇi jaṅghākarma ca pañcadhā / anekadhā pādakarma nṛtyādau nāṭake smṛtam
abhinayādinirūpaṇaṃ agnir uvāca ābhimukhyannayannarthānvijñeyo 'bhinayo budhaiḥ / caturdhā sambhavaḥ sattvavāgaṅgāharaṇāśrayaḥ
stambhādiḥ sāttviko vāgārambho vācika āṅgikaḥ / śarīrārambha āhāryo buddhyārambhapravṛttayaḥ
rasādiviniyogo 'tha kathyate hy abhimānataḥ / tamantareṇa sarve ṣāmapārthaiva svatantratā
sambhogo vipralambhaś ca śṛṅgāro dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ / pracchannaś ca prakāśaś ca tāvapi dvividhau punaḥ
vipralambhābhidhāno yaḥ śṛṅgāraḥ sa caturvidhaḥ / pūrvānurāgānākhyaḥ pravāmakaruṇātmakaḥ
etebhyo 'nyataraṃ jāyamānamambhogalakṣaṇam / vivartate caturdhaiva na ca prāgativartate
strīpuṃsayostadudayastasya nirvirtikā ratiḥ / nikhilāḥ sāttvikāstatra vaivarṇyapralayau vinā
dharmārthakāmamokṣaiś ca śṛṅgāra upacīyate / ālamvanaviśeṣaiś ca tadviśeṣair nirantaraḥ
śṛṅgāraṃ dvividhaṃ vidyādvāṅnepathyakriyātmakam / hāsaś ca turvidho 'lakṣyadantaḥ smita itīritaḥ
kiñcillakṣitadantāgraṃ hasitaṃ phullalocanam / vihasitaṃ sasvanaṃ syājjihmopahasitantu tat
saśabdaṃ pāpahasitamaśabdamatihāsitaṃ / yaścāsau karuṇo nāma sa rasastrividho bhavet
dharmopaghātajaścittavilāsajanitas tathā / śokaḥ śokādbhavet sthāyī kaḥ sthāyī pūrvajo mataḥ
aṅganepathyavākyaiś ca raudro 'pi trividho rasaḥ / tasya nirvartakaḥ krodhaḥ svedo romāñcavapathuḥ
dānavīro dharmavīro yuddhavīra iti trayam / vīrastasya ca niṣpattiheturutsāha iṣyate
ārambheṣu bhavedyatra vīramevānuvartate / bhayānako nāma rasastasya nirvartakaṃ bhayaṃ
udvejanaḥ kṣobhaṇaś ca vībhatso dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ / udvejanaḥ syāt plutyādyaiḥ kṣobhaṇo rudhirādibhiḥ
jagupsārambhikā tasya sāttvikāṃśo nivartate / kāvyaśobhākarān dharmānalaṅkārān pracakṣyate
alaṅkariṣṇavaste ca śabdamarthamubhau tridhā / ye vyutpattyādinā śabdamalaṅkartumiha kṣamāḥ
śabdālaṅkāramāhustān kāvyamīmāṃsakā vidaḥ / chāyā mudrā tathoktiś ca yuktirgumphanayā saha
vākovākyamanuprāsaścitraṃ duṣkarameva ca / jṇeyā navālaṅkṛtayaḥ śabdānāmityasaṅkarāt
tatrānyokteranukṛtiśchāyā sāpi catruvvidhā / lokacchekārbhakoktīnāmekokteranukārataḥ
ābhāṇakoktirlokoktiḥ sarvasāmānya eva tāḥ / yānudhāvati lokoktiśchāyāmicchanti tāṃ budhāḥ
chekā vidagdhā vaidagdhyaṃ kalāsu kuśalā matiḥ / tāmullikhantī chekoktiśchāyā kavibhiriṣyate
avyutpannoktirakhilair arbhakoktyopalakṣyate / tenārbhakoktiśchāyā tanmātroktimanukurvatī
viplutākṣaramaślīlaṃ vaco mattasya tādṛśī / yā sā bhavati mattoktiśchāyoktāpyatiśobhate
abhiprāyaviśeṣeṇa kaviśaktiṃ vivṛṇvatī / mutpradāyinīti sā mudrā saiva śayyāpi no mate
uktiḥ sā kathyate yasyāmarthako 'pyupapattimān / lokayātrārthavidhinā dhinoti hṛdayaṃ satāṃ
ubhau vidhiniṣedhau ca niyamāniyamāvapi / vikalpaparisaṅkhye ca tadīyāḥ ṣaḍathoktayaḥ
ayuktayoriva mitho vācyavācakayordvayoḥ / yojanāyai kalpyamānā yuktiruktā manīṣibhiḥ
padañcaiva padārthaś ca vākyaṃ vākyarthameva ca / viṣayo 'styāḥ prakaraṇaṃ prapañcaśceti ṣaḍvidhaḥ
gumphanā racanācaryā śabdārthakramagocarā / śabdānukārādarthānupūrvārtheyaṃ kramāttridhā
uktipratyuktimadvākyaṃ vākovākyaṃ dvidhaiva tat / ṛjuvakroktibhedena tatrādyaṃ sahajaṃ vacaḥ
sā pūrvapraśnikā praśnapūrviketi dvidhā bhavet / vakroktistu bhaveḍbhaṅgyā kākustena kṛtā dvidhā
śabdālaṅkārāḥ agnirucāca syādāvṛttiranuprāso varṇānāṃ padavākyayoḥ / ekavarṇānekavarṇāvṛttervarṇaguṇo dvidhā
ekavarṇagatāvṛtterjāyante pañca vṛttayaḥ / madhurā lalitā prauṭā bhadrā paruṣayā saha
madhurāyāś ca vargantādadho vargyā raṇau svanau(1) / hrasvasvareṇāntaritau saṃyuktatvaṃ nakārayoḥ
na kāryā vargyavarṇānāmāvṛttiḥ pañcamādhikā / mahāprāṇoṣmasaṃyogapravimuktalaghūttarau(2)
lalitā balabhūyiṣṭhā(3) prauṭā yā paṇavargajā / ūrdhvaṃ repheṇa yujyante naṭavargonapañcamāḥ
bhadrāyāṃ pariśiṣṭāḥ syuḥ paruṣā sābhidhīyate / bhavanti yasyāmūṣmāṇaḥ saṃyuktāstattadakṣaraiḥ
akāravarjamāvṛttiḥ svarāṇāmatibhūyasī / anusvāravisargau ca pāruṣyāya nirantarau

śaṣasā rephasaṃyuktāścākāraścāpi bhūyasā / 1 raśau ghanāviti ña.. 2 mahāprāṇoṣmasaṃyogādaviyuktalaghūttarāviti ṭa.. 3 lalitā vanabhūyiṣṭheti kha.. / lalitā vatsabhūyiṣṭheti ṭa.. :p 218 antasthābhinnamābhyāñca haḥ pāruṣyāya saṃyutaḥ
anyathāpi gururvarṇaḥ saṃyukteparipanthini / pāruṣyāyādimāṃstatra pūjitā na tu pañcamo
kṣepe śabdānukāre ca paruṣāpi prayujyate / karṇāṭī kauntalī kauntī kauṅkaṇī vāmanāsikā(1)
drāvaṇī mādhavī pañcavarṇāntasthoṣmabhiḥ kramāt / anekavarṇāvṛttiryā bhinnārthapratipādikā
yamakaṃ sāvyapetañca vyapetañceti taddvidhā / ānantaryādavyapetaṃ vyapetaṃ vyavadhānataḥ
dvaividhyenānayoḥ sthānapādabhedāccaturvidham / ādipādādimadhyānteṣvekadvitriniyogataḥ
saptadhā saptapūrveṇa(2) cet pādenottarottaraḥ / ekadvitripadārambhastulyaḥ ṣoḍhā tadāparaṃ
tṛtīyaṃ trividhaṃ pādasyādimadhyāntagocaram / pādāntayamakañcaiva kāñcīyamakameva ca
saṃsargayamakañcaiva(3) vikrāntayamakantathā / pādādiyamakañcaiva tathāmreḍitameva ca
caturvyavasitañcaiva mālāyamakameva ca / daśadhā yamakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadbhedā bahavo 'pare

svatantrasyānyatantrasya padasyāvartanā dvidhā / 1 bālavāsiketi kha.. , ṭa.. ca / vanavāsiketi ña.. 2 pūrvapūrveṇeti ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca 3 sambandhayamakaś caiveti kha.. :p 219 bhinnaprayojanapadasyāvṛttiṃ manujā viduḥ
dvayorāvṛttapadayoḥ samastā syātsamāsataḥ / asamāsāttayorvyastā pāde tvekatra vigrahāt
vākyasyāvṛttirapyevaṃ yathāsambhavamiṣyate / alaṅkārādyanuprāso laghumadhyevamarhaṇāt(1) *
yayā kayācidvṛtyā yat samānamanubhūyate / tadrūpādipadāsattiḥ sānuprasā rasāvahā
goṣṭhyāṃ kutūhalādhyāyī vāgbandhaścitramucyate / praśnaḥ prahelikā guptaṃ cyutadatte tathobhayam
samasyā sapta tadbhedā nānārthasyānuyogataḥ / yatra pradīyate tulyavarṇavinyāsamuttaraṃ
sa praśnaḥ syādekapṛṣṭadvipṛṣṭottarabhedataḥ / dvidhaikapṛṣṭo dvividhaḥ samasto vyasta eva ca
dvayorapyarthayorguhyamānaśabdā prahelikā / sā dvidhārtho ca śābdī ca tatrārthī cārthabodhataḥ
śabdāvabodhataḥ śābdī prāhuḥ ṣoḍhā prahelikāṃ / yasmin gupte 'pi vākyāṅge bhāvyartho 'pāramārthikaḥ
tadaṅgavihitākāṅkṣastadguptaṃ gūḍhamapyadaḥ / yatrārthāntaranirbhāso vākyāṅgacyavanādibhiḥ

tadaṅgavihitākāṅkṣastaccutaṃ syāccaturvidham / 1 laghumapyevamarhaṇāditi ṭa.. / laghumadhyeva varhaṇāditi ja.. laghumadhyevamarhaṇāt, laghumapyevamarhaṇāt, laghumadhyeva varhaṇāt etat pāṭhatrayaṃ na samyak pratibhāti :p 220 svaravyañjanavindūnāṃ visargasya ca vicyuteḥ
dattepi yatra vākyāṅge dvitīyorthaḥ pratīyate / dattantadāhustadbhedāḥ svarādyaiḥ pūrvavanmatāḥ
apanītākṣarasthāne nyaste varṇāntare 'pi ca / bhāsate 'rthāntaraṃ yatra cyutadattaṃ taducyate
suśliṣṭapadyamekaṃ yannānāślokāṃśanirmitam / sā mamasyā parasyātmaparayoḥ kṛtisaṅkarāt
duḥkhena kṛtamatyarthaṃ kavisāmarthyasūcakam / duṣkaraṃ nīrasatvepi vidagdhānāṃ mahotsavaḥ
niyamācca vidarbhāca bandhācca bhavati tridhā / kaveḥ pratijñā nirmāṇaramyasya niyamaḥ smṛtaḥ
sthānenāpi svareṇāpi vyañjanenāpi sa tridhā / vikalpaḥ prātilomyānulomyādevābhidhīyate
pratilomyānulomyañca śabdenārthena jāyate / anekadhāvṛttavarṇavinyāsaiḥ śilpakalpanā
tattatprasiddhavastūnāṃ bandha ity abhidhīyate / gomūtrikārdhabhramaṇe sarvatobhadramambujam
cakrañcakrābjakaṃ daṇḍo murajāśceti cāṣṭadhā / pratyardhaṃ pratipādaṃ syādekāntarasamākṣarā
dvidhā gomūtrikāṃ pūrvāmāhuraśvapadāṃ pare / antyāṅgomūtrikāṃ dhenuṃ jālabandhaṃ(1) vadanti hi
ardhābhyāmardhapādaiś ca kuryādvinyāsametayoḥ / 1 jānubandhamiti ka.. , kha.. ca :p 221 nyastānāmiha varṇānāmadhodhaḥ kramabhāgināṃ
adhodhaḥsthitavarṇānāṃ yāvattūryapadannayet / turyapādānnayedūrdha pādārdhaṃ prātilomyataḥ
tadeva sarvatobhadraṃ trividhaṃ sarasīruhaṃ / catuṣpatraṃ tato vighnaṃ catuṣpatre ubhe api
atha prathamapādasya mūrdhanyastripadākṣaraṃ / sarveṣāmeva pādānāmante tadupajāyate
prākpadasyāntimaṃ pratyak pādādau prātilomyataḥ / antyapādāntimañcādyapādādāvakṣaradvayaṃ
catuśchade bhavedaṣṭacchade varṇatrayaṃ punaḥ / syāt ṣoḍaśacchade tvekāntarañcedekamakṣaraṃ
karṇikāṃ tolayedūrdhvaṃ patrākārākṣarāvaliṃ / praveśayet karṇikāyāñcatuṣpatrasaroruhe
karṇikāyāṃ likhedekaṃ dve dve dikṣu vidikṣu ca / praveśanirgamau dikṣu kuryādaṣṭacchade 'mbuje
viśvagviṣamavarṇānāṃ tāvat patrābalījuṣāṃ / madhye samākṣaranyāsaḥsaroje ṣoḍaśacchade
dvidhā cakraṃ caturaraṃ ṣaḍarantatra cādimaṃ / pūrvārdhe sadṛśā varṇāḥ pādaprathamapañcamāḥ
ayujo 'śvayujaś caiva turyāvapyaṣṭamāvapi / tasyopapādaprākpratyagareṣu ca yathākramaṃ
syātpādārdhacatuṣkantu nābhau tasyādyamakṣaraṃ / paścimārāvadhi nayennemau śeṣe padadvayī
tṛtīyaṃ turyapādānte prathamau sadṛśāvubhau / varṇau pādatrayasyāpi daśamaḥ sadṛśo yadi
prathame carame tasya ṣaḍtarṇāḥ pathime yadi / bhavanti dvyantaraṃ tarhi vṛhacca kramudāhṛtaṃ
sammukhāradvaye pādamekaikaṃ kramaśo likhet / nābhau tu varṇaṃ daśamaṃ nemau tūryapadannayet
ślokasyādyantadaśamāḥ samā ādyantimau yujoḥ / ādau varṇaḥ samau turyapañcamāvādyataryayoḥ
dvitīyaprātilomyena tṛtīyaṃ jāyate yadi / padaṃ vidadhyāt patrasya daṇḍaś cakrābjakaṃ kṛteḥ
dvitīyau prāgdale tulyau saptamau ca tathāparau / sadṛśāvuttaradalau dvitīyābhyāmathārdhayoḥ
dvitīyaṣaṣṭhāḥ sadṛśāś caturthapañcamāvapi / ādyantapādayostulyau parārdhasaptamāvapi
samau turyaṃ pañcamantu krameṇa viniyojayet / turyau yojyau tu tadvacca dalāntāḥ kramapādayoḥ
ardhayorantimādyau tu muraje sadṛśāvabhau / pādārdhapatito varṇaḥ prātilomyānulomataḥ
antimaṃ paribadhnīyādyāvatturyamihādimat / pādātturyādyadevādyaṃ navamāt ṣoḍaśādapi
akṣarāt puṭake madhye madhye 'kṣaracatuṣṭayam / kṛtvā kuryādyathaitasya murajākāratā bhavet
dvitīyaṃ cakraśārdūlavikrīḍitakasampadam / gomūtrikā sarvavṛttair anye bandhāstvanuṣṭubhā
nāmadheyaṃ yadi na cedamīṣu kavikāvyayoḥ / mitradheyābhituṣyanti nāmitraḥ khidyate tathā
vāṇavāṇāsanavyomakhaḍgamudgaraśaktayaḥ / dvicaturthatriśṛṅgāṭā dambholimuṣalāṅkuśāḥ
padaṃ rathasya nāgasya puṣkariṇyasiputrikā / ete bandhās tathā cānye evaṃ jñeyāḥ svayaṃ budhaiḥ
arthālaṅkārāḥ agnir uvāca alaṅkaraṇamarthānāmarthālaṅkāra iṣyate / taṃ vinā śabdasaundaryamapi nāsti manoharam
arthālaṅkārarahitā vidhaveva(1) sarasvatī / svarūpamatha sādṛśyamutprekṣātiśayāvapi

syāt prāsādo vaijayanto jayantaḥ pākaśāsaniḥ / airāvate 'bhramātaṅgairāvaṇābhramuvallabhāḥ(?)
hrīdinī vajramastrī syāt kuliśambhiduraṃ paviḥ / vyomayānaṃ vimāno 'strī pīyūṣamamṛtaṃ sudhā
syāt sudharmā devasabhā svargaṅgā suradīrghikā / striyāṃ bahuṣvapsrasaḥ svarveśyā urvaśīmukhāḥ
hāhā hūhūś ca gandharvā agnirvahnirdhanañcayaḥ / jātavedāḥ kṛṣṇavartmā āśrayāśaś ca pāvakaḥ

kālo 'ntako daṇḍadharaḥ śrāddhedevo 'tha rākṣasaḥ / kauṇapāsrapakravyādā yātudhānaś ca nairṛtiḥ
precetā varuṇaḥ pāśī śvasanaḥ sparśano 'nilaḥ / sadāgatirmātariśvā prāṇo marut samīraṇaḥ

satate 'nāratāśrāntasantatāviratāniśaṃ / nityānavaratājasramapyathātiśayo bharaḥ
ativelabhṛśātyarthātimātrodgāṭanirbharam / tīvraikāntanitāntāni gāḍhavāḍhadṛḍhāni ca
guhyakeśo yakṣarājo rājarājo dhanādhipaḥ / syāt kinnaraḥ kiṃpuruṣasturaṅgavadano mayuḥ

antardhā vyavadhā puṃsi tvantardhirapavāraṇaṃ / apidhānatirodhānapidhānacchadanāni ca
abjo jaivātṛkaḥ somo glaurmṛgāṅkaḥ kalānidhiḥ / vidhuḥ kumudavandhuś ca vimbo 'strī maṇḍalaṃ triṣu
kalā tu ṣoḍśo bhāgo bhittaṃ śakalakhaṇḍake / candrikā kaumudī jyotsnā prasādastu prasannatā
lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmakaṃ cihnaṃ śobhā kāntirdyutiśchaviḥ / suṣamā parmā śobhā tuṣārastuhinaṃ himaṃ
avasyāyastu nīhāraḥ prāleyaḥ śiśiro himaḥ / nakṣatramṛkṣaṃ bhantārā tārakā pyuḍu vā striyāṃ
gururjīva āṅgirasa uśanā bhārgavaḥ kaviḥ / vidhuntudastamo rāhur lagnaṃ rāśyudayaḥ smṛtaḥ
saptarṣayo marīcyatrimukhāścitraśikhaṇḍinaḥ / haridaśvavraghmapūṣadyumaṇirmihiro raviḥ
pariveṣastu paridhirupasūryakabhaṇḍale / kiraṇo 'sramayūkhāṃśugabhastighṛṇidhṛṣṇayaḥ
bhānuḥ karo marīciḥ strīpuṃsayordīdhitiḥ striyāṃ / syuḥ prabhā rugrucistviḍbhābhāśchavidyutidīptayaḥ
rociḥ śocirubhe klīve prakāśo dyota ātapaḥ / koṣṇaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ mandoṣṇaṃ kaduṣṇaṃ triṣu tadvati
tirmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kharaṃ tadvaddiṣṭo 'nehā ca kālakaḥ / ghasro dināhanī caiva sāyaṃsandhyā pitṛprasūḥ
pratyūṣo 'harmukhaṃ kalyamuṣaḥpratyūṣasī api / prāhṇāparāhṇamadhyāhṇāstrisandhyamatha śarvarī
yāmī tamī tamisrā ca jyotsnī candrakayānvitā / āgāmivartamānāharyuktāyāṃ niśi pakṣiṇī
ardharātraniśīthau pradoṣo rajanīmukhaṃ / sa parvasandhiḥ pratipatpañcadaśyorya dantaram
pakṣāntau pañcadaśyau dve paurṇamāsī tu pūrṇimā / kalāhīne sānumatiḥ pūrṇe rākā niśākare
amāvāsyā tvamāvasyā darśaḥ sūryendusaṅgamaḥ / sā dṛṣṭenduḥ sinīvālī sā naṣṭendukalā kuhūḥ
saṃvartaḥ pralayaḥ kalpaḥ kṣayaḥ kalpānta ity api / kaluṣaṃ vṛjinaino 'ghamaṃhoduritaduṣkṛtam
syāddharmamastriyāṃ puṇyaśreyasī sukṛtaṃ vṛṣaḥ / mutprītiḥ pramado harṣaḥ pramodāmodasammadāḥ
syādānandathurānandaḥ śarmaśātasukhāni ca / śvaḥ śreyasaṃ śivaṃ bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ maṅgalaṃ śubham
bhāvukaṃ bhavikaṃ bhavyaṃ kuśalaṃ kṣemamastriyāṃ / daivaṃ diṣṭaṃ māgadheyaṃ bhāgyaṃ strī niyatirvidhiḥ
kṣetrajña ātmā puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ striyāṃ / heturnā kāraṇaṃ vījaṃ nidānaṃ tvādikāraṇam
cittantu ceto hṛdayaṃ svāntaṃ hṛnmānasammanaḥ / buddhirmanīṣā dhiṣaṇā dhīḥ prajñā śemuṣī matiḥ
prekṣopalibdhiścitsambitpratipajjñapticetanāḥ / dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medhā saṅkalpaḥ karma mānasaṃ
saṅkhyā vicāraṇā carcā vicikitsā tu saṃśayaḥ / adhyāhārastarka ūhaḥ samau nirṇayaniś cayau
mithyādṛṣṭirnāstikatā bhrāntirmithyāmatirbhramaḥ / aṅgīkārābhyupagamapratiśravasamādhayaḥ
mokṣe dhīrjñānamanyatra vijñānaṃ śilpaśāstrayoḥ / muktiḥ kaivalyanirvāṇaśreyoniḥśreyasāmṛtaṃ
mokṣo 'pavargo 'thājñānamavidyāhammatiḥ striyāṃ / vimardotthe parimalo gandhe janamanohare
āmodaḥ so 'tinirhārī surabhirghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ / śuklaśubhraśuciśvetaviśadaśvetapāṇḍarāḥ
avadātaḥ sito gauro valakṣo dhavalo 'rjunaḥ / hariṇaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ pāṇḍurīṣatpāṇḍustu dhūsaraḥ
kṛṣṇe nīlāsitaśyāmakālaśyāmalamecakāḥ / pīto gauro haridrābhaḥ pālāśo harito harit
rohito lohito raktaḥ śoṇaḥ kokanadacchaviḥ / avyaktarāgastvaruṇaḥ śvetaraktastu pāṭalaḥ
śyāvaḥ syātkapiśo dhūmradhūmalau kṛṣṇalohite / kaḍāraḥ kapilaḥ piṅgapiśaṅgaukadrupiṅgalau
citraṃ kirmīrakalmāṣaśavalaitātha karvure / vyāhara uktirlapitamapabhraṃśo 'paśabdakaḥ
tiṅsuvantacayo kāvyaṃ kriyā vā kārakānvitā / itihāsaḥ purāvṛttaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇaṃ
ākhyāyikopalabdhārthā prabandhaḥ kalpanā kathā / samāhāraḥ saṃgrahastu pravahlikā prahelikā
samasyā tu samāsārthā smṛtistu dharmasaṃhitā / ākhyāhve cābhidhānañca vārtā vṛttānta īritaḥ
hūtirākāraṇāhvānamupanyāsastu vāṅmukhaṃ / vivādo vyavahāraḥ syāt prativākyottare same
upoddhāta udāhāro hy artha mithyābhisaṃśanam / abhiśāpo yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchānuyogakaḥ
āmreḍitaṃ dvistriruktaṃ kutsāninde ca garhaṇe / syādābhāṣaṇamālāpaḥ pralāpo 'narthakaṃ vacaḥ
anulāpo muhurbhāṣā volāpaḥ paridevanaṃ / vipralāpo virodhoktiḥ saṃlāpo bhāṣaṇaṃ mithaḥ
supralāpaḥ suvacanamapalāpastu nihnavaḥ / uṣatī vāgakalyāṇī saṅgataṃ hṛdayaṅgamaṃ
saugandhikantu kahlāraṃ nīlamindīvaraṃ kajaṃ / syādutpalaṃ kuvalayaṃ site kumudakairave
śālūkameṣāṃ kandaḥ syāt padmaṃ tāmarasaṅkajaṃ / nīlotpalaṃ kuvalayaṃ raktaṃ kokanadaṃ smṛtam
karahāṭaḥ śiphā kandaṃ kiñjalkaḥ keśaro 'striyāṃ / khaniḥ striyāmākaraḥ syāt pādāḥ pratyantaparvatāḥ
upatyakādrerāsannā bhūmirūrdhvamadhityakā / svargapātālavargādyā uktā nānārthakān śṛṇu
avyayavargāḥ agnir uvāca āṅīṣadarthe 'bhivyāptau sīmārthe dhātuyogaje / ā pragṛhyaḥ smṛtau vākye 'pyāstu syāt kopapīḍyoḥ
pāpakutseṣadarthe ku dhigjugupsananindayoḥ / cānvācayasamāhāretaretarasamuccaye
svastyāśīḥ kṣemapuṇyādau prakarṣe laṅghane 'pyati / svitpraśne ca vitarke ca tu syādbhede 'vadhāraṇe
sakṛtsahaikavāre syādārāddūrasamīpayoḥ / pratīcyāṃ carame paścādutāpyarthavikalpayoḥ
punaḥsadārthayoḥ śaśvat sākṣāt pratyakṣatulyayoḥ / khedānukampāsantoṣavismayāmantraṇe vata
hanta harṣe 'nukampāyāṃ vākyārambhaviṣādayoḥ / prati pratinidhau vīpsālakṣaṇādau prayogataḥ
iti hetau prakaraṇe prakāśādisamāptiṣu / prācyāṃ purastāt prathame purārthe 'grata ity api
yāvattāvacca sākalye 'vadhau māne 'vadhāraṇe / maṅgalānantarārambhapraśnakārtsneṣv athotha ca
vṛthā nirarthakāvidhyornānānekobhayārthayoḥ / nu pṛcchāyāṃ vikalpe ca paścātsādṛśyayoranu
praśnāvadhāraṇānujñānunayāmantraṇe nanu / garhāsamuccayapraśnaśaṅkāsambhāvanāsv api
upamāyāṃ vikalpe vā sāmitvardhe jugupsite / amā saha samīpe ca kaṃ vāriṇi ca mūrdhani
ivetthamarthayorevaṃ nūnaṃ tarke 'rthaniś caye / tūṣṇīmarthe sukhe joṣaṃ kimpṛcchāyāṃ jugupsane
nāma prākāśyasambhāvyakrodhopagamakutsane / alaṃ bhūṣaṇaparyāptiśaktivāraṇavācakam
hūṃ vitarke paripraśne samayāntikamadhyayoḥ / punaraprathame bhede nirniś cayaniṣedhayoḥ
syātprabandhe cirātīte nikaṭāgāmike purā / uraryurī corarī ca vistāre 'ṅgīkṛte trayam
svarge pare ca loke svarvārtāsambhāvayoḥ kila / niṣedhavākyālaṅkāre jijñāsāvasare(1) khalu
samīpobhayataḥśīghrasākalyābhimukhe 'bhitaḥ / nāmaprakāśayoḥ prādurmitho 'nyonyaṃ rahasyapi
tiro 'ntardhau tiryagarthe hā viṣādaśugartiṣu / ahahetyadbhute khede hi hetāvavadhāraṇe
cirāya cirarātrāya cirasyādyāścirārthakāḥ / muhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ śaśvadabhīkṣṇamasakṛt samāḥ
srāgjhaṭityañcasāhnāya sapadi drāṅmaṅkhu ca drute / balavat suṣṭhu kimuta vikalpe kiṃ kimūta ca
tu hi ca sma ha vai pādapūraṇe pūjanepyati / divāhnītyatha doṣā ca naktañca rajanāviti
tiryagarthe sāci tiro 'pyatha sambodhanārthakāḥ / syuḥ pyāṭpāḍṅga he hai bhoḥ samayā nikaṣā hiruk
atarkite tu sahasā syāt puraḥ purato 'grataḥ / svāhā devahavirdāne śrauṣaṭ vauṣaṭ vaṣaṭ svadhā
kiñcidīṣanmanāgalpe pretyāmutra bhavāntare / 1 jijñāsānunaya iti ña.. :p 274 yathā tathā caiva sāmye aho ho iti vismaye
maune tu tūṣṇīṃ tūṣṇīkaṃ sadyaḥ sapadi tatkṣaṇe / diṣṭyā śamupayoṣañcetyānande 'thāntare 'ntarā
antareṇa ca madhye syuḥ prasahya tu haṭārthakam / yukte dve sāmprataṃ sthāne 'bhīkṣṇaṃ śasvadanārate
abhāve nahyano nāpi māsma mālañca vāraṇe / pakṣāntare cedyadi ca tattve tv addhāñjasā dvayam
prākāśye prādurāviḥ syādomevaṃ paramaṃ mate / samantatastu paritaḥ sarvato viśvagityapi
akāmānumatau kāmamasūyopagame 'stu ca / nanu ca syādvirodhoktau kaccit kāmapravedane
niḥṣamaṃ duḥṣamaṃ garhye yathāsvantu yathāyathaṃ / mṛṣā mithyā ca vitathe yathārthantu yathātathaṃ
syurevantu punarvaivetyavadhāraṇavācakāḥ / prāgatītārthakaṃ nūnamavaśyaṃ niś caye dvayaṃ
saṃvadvarṣe 'vare tvarvāgāmevaṃ svayamātmanā / alpe nīcair mahatyuccaiḥ prāyobhūmny adrute śanaiḥ
sanā nitye vahirvāhye smātīte 'stamadarśane / asti sattve ruṣoktāvūmuṃ praśne 'nunaye tvayi
hūṃ tarke syāduṣā rātreravasāne namo natau / punararthe 'ṅganindāyāṃ duṣṭhu suṣṭhu praśaṃsane
sāyaṃ sāye prage prātaḥ prabhāte nikaṣāntike / parutparāryaisamo 'bde pūrve pūrvatare yati
adyātrāhny atha pūrvehnītyādau pūrvottarā parāt / tathādharānyānyataretarātpūrvedyurādayaḥ
ubhayadyuścobhayedyuḥ pare tvahni paredyapi / hyo gate 'nāgate 'hni śvaḥ paraśvaḥ śvaḥpare 'hani
tadā tadānīṃ yugapadekadā sarvadā sadā / etarhi sampratīdānīmadhunā sāmpratantathā
nānārthavargāḥ agnir uvāca ākāśe tridive nāko lokastu bhavane jane / padye yaśasi ca ślokaḥśare khaḍge ca sāyakaḥ
ānakaḥ paṭaho bherī kalaṅko 'ṅkāpavādayoḥ / mārute vedhasi vradhne puṃsi kaḥ kaṃ śiro 'mbunoḥ
syāt pulākastucchadhānye saṃkṣepe bhaktasikthake / mahendraguggulūlūkavyālagrāhiṣu kauśikaḥ
śālāvṛkau kapiśvānau mānaṃ syānmitisādhanaṃ / sargaḥ svabhāvanirmokṣaniś cayādhyāyasmṛṣṭiṣu
yogaḥ sannahanopāyadhyānasaṅgatiyuktiṣu / bhogaḥ sukhe stryādibhṛtāvabjau śaṅkaniśākarau
kāke bhagaṇḍau karaṭau duś carmā śipiviṣṭakaḥ / riṣṭaṃ kṣemāśubhābhāveṣvariṣṭe tu śubhāśubhe
vyuṣṭiḥ phale samṛddhau ca dṛṣṭirjñāne 'kṣṇi darśane / niṣṭhāniṣpattināśāntāḥ kāṣṭhotkarṣe sthitau diśi
bhūgovācastviḍā ilāḥ pragāḍhaṃ bhṛṣakṛcchrayoḥ / bhṛśapratijñayorvāḍhaṃ śaktasthūlau dṛḍhau triṣu
vinyastasaṃhatau vyūḍhau kṛṣṇo vyāse 'rjune harau / paṇo dūyatādiṣūtsṛṣṭe bhṛtau mūlye dhane 'pi ca
maurvyāṃ dravyāśrite satvaśuklasandhyādike guṇaḥ / śreṣṭhe 'dhipe grāmaṇīḥ syāt jugpsākaruṇe ghṛṇe
tṛṣṇā spṛhāpipāse dve vipaṇiḥ syādvaṇikpathe / viṣābhimaraloheṣu tīkṣṇaṃ klīve khare triṣu
pramāṇaṃ hetumaryādāśāstreyattāpramātṛṣu / karaṇaṃ kṣetragātrādāvīriṇaṃ śūnyamūṣaraṃ
yantā hastipake sūte vahnijvālā ca hetayaḥ / srutaṃ śāstrāvadhṛtayoryugaparyāptayoḥ kṛtaṃ
khyāte hṛṣṭe pratīto 'bhijātastu kulaje budhe / viviktau pūtavijanau mūrchitau mūḍsocchayau
artho 'bhidheyaraivastuprayojananivṛttiṣu / nidānāgamayostīrthamṛṣijuṣṭajale gurau
prādhānye rājaliṅge ca vṛṣāṅge kakudo 'striyāṃ / strī sambijjñānasambhāṣākriyākārājināmasu
dharme rahasyupaniṣat syādṛtau vatsare śarat / padaṃ vyavasititrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu
triṣvaṣṭamadhurau svādū mṛdū cātīkṣṇakomalau / satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste 'bhyarhite ca sat
vidhirvidhāne daive 'pi praṇidhiḥ prārthane care / vadhūrjāyā snuṣā ca sudhālepo 'mṛtaṃ snuhī
spṛhā sampratyayaḥ śraddhā paṇḍitammanyagarvitau / brahmabandhuradhikṣepe bhānū raṣmidivākarau
grāvāṇau śailapāṣānau mūrkhanīcau pṛthagjanau / taruśailau śikhariṇau tanustvagdehayorapi
ātmā yatno dhṛtirvuddhiḥ svabhāvo brahmavarṣma ca / utthānaṃ pauruṣe tantre vyutthānaṃ pratirodhane
niryātanaṃ vairaśuddhau dāne nyāsārpaṇe 'pi ca / vyasanaṃ vipadi bhraśe doṣe kāmajakopaje
mṛgayākṣo divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyo madaḥ / tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo daśako gaṇaḥ
paiśūnyaṃ sāhasaṃ droha īrṣyāsūyārthadūṣaṇam / vāgdaṇḍaś caiva pāruṣyaṃ krodhajo 'pi gaṇo 'ṣṭakaḥ
akarmaguhye kaupīnaṃ maithunaṃ saṅgatau ratau / pradhānaṃ paramārthā dhīḥ prajñānaṃ buddhicihnayoḥ
krandane rodanāhvāne varṣma dehapramāṇayoḥ / ārādhanaṃ sādhane syādavāptau toṣaṇe 'pi ca
ratnaṃ svajātiśreṣṭhe 'pi lakṣma cihnapradhānayoḥ / kalāpo bhūṣaṇe varhe tūṇīre saṃhate 'pi ca
talpaṃ śayyāṭṭāreṣu ḍimbhau tu śiśuvāliśau / stambhau sthūṇājaḍībhāvau sabhye saṃsadi vai sabhā
kiraṇapragrahau raśmī dharmāḥ puṇyayamādayaḥ / lalāmaṃ pucchapuṇḍrāśvabhūṣāprādhānyaketuṣu
pratyayo 'dhīnaśapathajñānaviśvāsahetuṣu / samayāḥ śapathācārakālasiddhāntasaṃvidaḥ
atyayo 'tikrame kṛcchre satyaṃ śapathatathyayoḥ / vīryaṃ balaprabhāvau ca rūpyaṃ rūpe praśastake
durodaro dyūtakāre paṇe dyūte durodaraṃ / mahāraṇye durgapathe kāntāraḥ punnapuṃsakaṃ
yamānilendracandrārkaviṣṇusiṃhādike hariḥ / daro 'striyāṃ bhaye śvabhre jaṭharaḥ kaṭhine 'pi ca
udāro dātṛmahatoritarastvanyanīcayoḥ / cūḍā kirīṭaṃ keśāś ca saṃyatā maulayastrayaḥ
baliḥ karopahārādau sainyasthair yādike balaṃ / strīkaṭīvastrabandhe 'pi nīvī paripaṇe 'pi ca
śukrale mūṣike śreṣṭhe sukṛte vṛṣabhe vṛṣaḥ / dyūtākṣe sāriphalake 'pyākarṣo 'thākṣamindriye
nā dyūtāṅge ca karṣe ca vyavahāre kalidrume / ūṣṇīṣaḥ syāt kirīṭādau karṣūḥ kulyābhidhāyinī
pratyakṣe 'dhikṛte 'dhyakṣaḥ sūryavahnī vibhāvasū / śṛṅgārādau viṣe vīrye guṇe rāge drave rasaḥ
tejaḥpurīṣayorvarca āgaḥ pāpāparādhayoḥ / chandaḥ padye 'bhilāse ca sādhīyān sādhuvāḍhayoḥ / vyūho vṛnde 'pyahirvṛtre 'pyagnīndvarkāstamonudaḥ
bhūmivanauṣadhyādivargāḥ agnir uvāca vakṣye bhūpurādrivanauṣadhisiṃhādinargakān / bhūranantā kakṣamā dhātrī kṣmāpyākuḥ syāddharitryapi
mṛnmṛttikā praśastā tu mṛtsā mṛtsnā ca mṛttikā / jagattrapiṣṭapaṃ lokaṃ bhuvanaṃ jagatī samā
ayanaṃ vartma mārgādhvapanthānaḥ padavī sṛtiḥ / saraṇiḥ paddhattiḥ padyā vartanyekapadīti ca
pūḥ strī purīnagaryau vā pāttanaṃ puṭabhedanam / sthānīyaṃ nigamo 'nyattu yanmūlanagarātpuram
tacchākhānagaraṃ veśo veśyājanasamāśrayaḥ / āpaṇastu niṣadyāyāṃ vipaṇiḥ paṇyavīthikā
rathyā pratolī viśikhā syāccayo vapramastriyāṃ / prākāro varaṇaḥ śālaḥ prācīraṃ prāntato vṛtiḥ
bhittiḥ strī kuhyameḍūkaṃ yadantarnastakīkasaṃ / vāsaḥ kūṭo dvayoḥ śālā sabhā sañjavanantvidam
catuḥśālaṃ munīnāntu parṇaśāloṭajo 'striyāṃ / caityamāyatanantulye vājiśālā tu mandurā
harmyādi dhanināṃ vāsaḥprāsādo devabhūbhujāṃ / strī dvārdvāraṃ pratīhāraḥ syādvitardistu vedikā
kapotapālikāyantu viṭaṅkaṃ puṃ napuṃsakaṃ / kavāṭamavarantulye niḥśreṇistvadhirohiṇī
sammārjanī śodhanī syāt saṅkaro 'vakaras tathā / adrigotrigirigrāvā gahanaṃ kānanaṃ vanaṃ
ārāmaḥ syādupavanaṃ kṛtrimaṃ vanameva yat / syādetadeva pramadavanamantaḥpurocitaṃ
vīthyālirāvaliḥ paṅktiśreṇīlekhāstu rājayaḥ / vānaspatyaḥ phalaiḥ puṣpāttairapuṣpādvanaspatiḥ(?)
oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ palāśī drudrumāgamāḥ / sthāṇu vā nā dhruvaḥ śaṅkuḥ praphullotphullasaṃsphuṭāḥ
palāśaṃ chadanaṃ parṇamidhmamedhaḥ samit striyāṃ / bodhidrumaś caladalo dadhitthagrāhimanmathāḥ
tasmin dadhiphalaḥ puṣpaphaladantaśaṭhāvapi / uḍumbare hemadugdhaḥ kovidāre dvipatrakaḥ
saptaparṇo viśālatvak kṛtamālaṃ suvarṇakaḥ / ārevatavyādhighātasampākacaturaṅgulāḥ
syājjambīre dantaśaṭho varuṇe tiktaśāvakaḥ / putrāge puruṣastuṅgaḥ keśaro devavallabhaḥ
pāribhadre nimbatarurmandāraḥ pārijātakaḥ / vañjulaścitrakṛccātha dvau pītanakapītanau
āmrātake madhūke tu guḍapuṣpamadhudrumau / pīlau guḍaphalaḥ sraṃsī nādeyī cāmbuvetasaḥ
śobhāñjane śigrutīkṣṇagandhakākṣīramocakāḥ / rakto 'sau madhuśigruḥ syādariṣṭaḥ pheṇilaḥ samau
gālavaḥśāvaro lodhrastirīṭastilvamārjanau / śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ śīta uddālo bahuvārakaḥ
vaikaṅkataḥ śruvāvṛkṣo granthilo vyāghrapādapi / tindukaḥ sphūrjakaḥ kālo nādeyī bhūmijambukaḥ
kākatindau pīlukaḥ syāt pāṭalirmokṣamuṣkakau / kramukaḥ paṭṭikākhyaḥ syātkumbhī kaiṭaryakaṭphale
vīravṛkṣo 'ruṣkaro 'gnimukhī bhallātakīṃ triṣu / savarjakāsanajīvāś ca pītasāle 'tha mālake
sarjāśvakarṇau vīrendrau indradruḥ kakubho 'rjunaḥ / iṅgudī tāpasatarurmocā śālmalireva ca

pañcālikā putrikā syādvarkarastaruṇaḥ paśuḥ / mañjūṣā peṭakaḥ peḍā tulyasādhāraṇau samau / pratimā syāt pratikṛtirvargā brahmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ

pravīṇanipuṇābhijñavijñaniṣṇātaśikṣitāḥ / syurvadānyasthūlalakṣadānaśauṇḍā bahuprade
kṛtī kṛtajñaḥ kuśala āsaktodyukta utsukaḥ / ibhya āḍhyaḥ parivṛḍho hy adhibhūrnāyako 'dhipaḥ

nityanaimīttikaprākṛtapralayāḥ agnir uvāca caturvidhastu pralayo nityo yaḥ prāṇināṃ layaḥ / sadā vināśo jātānāṃ brāhmo naimittiko layaḥ
caturyugasahasrānte prākṛtaḥ prākṛto layaḥ / laya ātyantiko jñānādātmanaḥ paramātmani
naimittikasya kalpānte vakṣye rūpaṃ layasya te / caturyugasahasrānte kṣīṇaprāye mahītale
anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā jāyate śatavārṣikī / tataḥ sattvakṣayaḥ syācca tato viṣṇurjagatpatiḥ
sthito jalāni pivati bhānoḥ saptasu raśmiṣu / bhūpātālasamudrāditoyaṃ nayati saṃkṣayaṃ
tatastasyānubhāvena toyāhāropavṛṃhitāḥ / ta eva raśmayaḥ sapta jāyante sapta bhāskarāḥ
dahanty aśeṣaṃ trailokyaṃ sapātālatalaṃ dvija / kūrmapṛṣṭhasamā bhūḥ syāttataḥ kālāgnirudrakaḥ
śeṣāhiśvāsasampātāt pātālāni dahatyadhaḥ / pātālebhyo bhuvaṃ viṣṇurbhuvaḥ svargaṃ dahatyataḥ
ambarīṣamivābhāti trailokyamakhilaṃ tathā / tatastāparītāstu lokadvayanivāsinaḥ
gācanti te maharlokaṃ maharlokājjanaṃ tataḥ / rudrarūpī jagaddagdhvā mukhaniśvāsato hareḥ
uttiṣṭanti tato medhā nānārūpāḥ savidyutaḥ / śataṃ varṣāṇi varṣantaḥ śamayantyagnimutthitam
saptarṣisthānamākramya sthite 'mbhasi śataṃ marut / mukhaniśvāsato viṣṇornāśaṃ nayati tānghanān
vāyuṃ pītvā hariḥ śeṣe śete caikārṇave prabhuḥ / brahmarūpadharaḥ siddhair jalagair munibhistutaḥ
ātmamāyāmayīṃ divyāṃ yoganidrāṃ samāsthitaḥ / ātmānaṃ vasidevākhyaṃ cintayanmadhusūdanaḥ
kalpaṃ śete prabuddho 'tha brahmarūpī sṛjaty asau / dviparārdhantato vyaktaṃ prakṛtau līyate dvija
sthānāt sthānaṃ daśaguṇamekasmādguṇyate sthale / tato 'ṣṭādaśame bhāge parārdhamabhidhīyate
parārdhaṃ dviguṇaṃ yattu prākṛtaḥ pralayaḥ smṛtaḥ / anāvṛṣṭyāgnisamparkāt kṛte saṃjvalane dvija
mahadādervikārasya viśeṣāntasya saṃkṣaye / kṛṣṇecchākārite tasmin samprāpte pratisañcare
āpo grasanti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmirgandhādikaṃ guṇaṃ / ātmagandhāttato bhūmiḥ pralayatvāya kalpate
rasātmikāś ca tiṣṭhanti hy āpastāsāṃ raso guṇaḥ / pīyate jyotiṣā tāsu naṣṭāsvagniś ca dīpyate
jyotiṣo 'pi guṇaṃ rūpaṃ vāyurgrasati bhāskaraṃ / naṣṭe jyotiṣi vāyuś cabalī dodhūyate mahān
vāyorapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśaṃ grasate tataḥ / vāyau naṣṭe tu cākāśannīravaṃ tiṣṭhati dvija
ākāśasyātha vai śabdaṃ bhūtādirgrasate ca khaṃ / abhimānātmakaṃ khañca bhūtādiṃ grasate mahān
bhūmiryāti layañcāpsu āpo jyotiṣi tadbrajet / vāyau vāyuś ca khe khañca ahaṅkāre layaṃ sa ca
mahāttatve mahāntañca prakṛtirgrasate dvija / vyaktāvyaktā ca prakṛtirvyaktasyāvyaktake layaḥ
pumāne kākṣaraḥ śuddhaḥ so 'pyaṃśaḥ paramātmanaḥ / prakṛtiḥ puruṣaś caitau līyete paramātmani
na santi yatra sarveśe nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ / sattāmātrātmake jñeye jñānātmanyātmahaḥ pare
ātyantikalayagarbhotpattinirūpaṇaṃ agnir uvāca ātyantikaṃ layaṃ vakṣye jñānādātyantiko layaḥ / ādhyātmikādisantāpaṃ jñātvā svasya virāgataḥ
ādhyātmikastu santāpaḥśārīro mānaso dvidhā / śārīro bahubhirbhedaistāpo 'sau śrūyatāṃ dvija
tyaktvā jīvo bhogadehaṃ garbhamāproti karmabhiḥ / ātivāhikasaṃjñastu deho bhavati vai dvija
kevalaṃ sa manuṣyāṇāṃ mṛtyukāla upasthite / yāmyaiḥ puṃbhirmanuṣyāṇāṃ taccharīraṃ dvijottamāḥ
nīyate yāmyamārgeṇa prāṇināṃ mune / tataḥ svaryāti narakaṃ sa bhramedghaṭayantravat
karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahman phalabhūmirasau smṛtā / yamo yonīś ca narakaṃ nirūpayati karmaṇā
pūraṇīyāś ca tenaiva yamañcaivānupaśyatāṃ / vāyubhūtāḥ prāṇinaś ca garbhante prāpnuvanti hi
yamadūtair manuṣyastu nīyate tañca paśyati / dharmī ca pūjyate tena pāpiṣṭhastāḍyate gṛhe
śubhāśubhaṃ karma tasya citragupto nirūpayet / bāndhavānāmaśauce tu dehe khalvātivāhike

pañcakarmendriyānyatra pañcabuddhīndriyāṇi ca / indriyārthāś ca pañcaiva mahābhūtā mano 'dhipāḥ
ātmāvyaktaś caturviṃśatattvāni puruṣaḥ paraḥ / saṃyuktaś ca viyuktaś ca yathā matsyodake ubhe
avyaktamāsritānīha rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca / āntaraḥ puruṣo jīvaḥ sa paraṃ brahma kāraṇaṃ
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yo vetti puruṣaṃ paraṃ / saptāśayāḥ smṛtā dehe rudhirasyaika āśayaḥ
śleṣmaṇaścāmapittābhyāṃ pakvāśayastu pañcamaḥ / vāyumūtrāśayaḥ saptaḥ strīṇāṃ garbhāśayo 'ṣṭamaḥ
pittātpakvāśayo 'gneḥ syādyonirvikaśitā dyutau / padmavadgarbhāśayaḥ syāttatra ghatte saraktakaṃ
śukraṃ svaśukrataścāṅgaṃ kuntalānyatra kālataḥ / nyastaṃ śukramato yonau neti garbhāśayaṃ mune
ṛtāvapi ca yoniścedvātapittakaphāvṛtā / bhavettadā vikāśitvaṃ naiva tasyāṃ prajāyate
bukkātpukkasakaplīhakṛtakoṣṭhāṅgahṛdvraṇāḥ / taṇḍakaś ca mahābhāga nibaddhānyāśaye mataḥ
rasasya pacyamānasya sārādbhavati dehināṃ / plīhā yakṛcca dharmajña raktapheṇācca pukkasaḥ
raktaṃ pittañca bhavati tathā taṇḍakasaṃjñakaḥ / medoraktaprasārācca vukkāyāḥ sambhavaḥ smṛtaḥ
raktamāṃsaprasārācca bhavantyantrāṇi dehināṃ / sārdhatrivyāmasaṃkhyāni tāni nṝṇāṃ vinirdiśet
trivyāmāni tathā strīṇāṃ prāhurvedavido janaḥ / raktavāyusamāyogāt kāmeyasyodbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ
kaphaprasārādbhavati hṛdayaṃ padmasannibhaṃ / adhomukhaṃ tacchūṣiraṃ yatra jīvo vyavasthitaḥ
caitanyānugatā bhāvaḥsarve tatra vyavasthitāḥ / tasya vāme tathā plīhā dakṣiṇe ca tathā yakṛt
dakṣiṇe ca tathā kloma padmasyaivaṃ prakīrtitaṃ / śrotāṃsi yāni dehe 'smin kapharaktavahāni ca
teṣāṃ bhūtānumānācca bhavatīndriyasambhavaḥ / netrayormaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ kaphādbhavati paitṛkaṃ
kṛṣṇañca maṇḍalaṃ vātāttathā mavati mātṛkaṃ / pittāttvaṅmaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ mātāpitṛsamudbhavaṃ
māṃsāsṛkkaphajā jihvā medo 'sṛkkaphamāṃsajau / vṛṣāṇau daśa prāṇasya jñeyānyāyatanāni tu
mūrdhā hṛnnābhikaṇṭhāś ca jihvā śukrañca śoṇitaṃ / gudaṃ vastiś ca gulphañca kaṇḍurāḥ śoḍaśeritāḥ

sūkṣmaiḥ saha catuḥṣaṣṭhirdaśanā viṃśatirnakhāḥ / pāṇipādaśalākāś ca tāsāṃ sthānacatuṣṭayaṃ

dve dve jānukapoloruphalakāṃśasamudbhavaṃ / akṣasthānāṃśakaśroṇiphalake caivamādiśet
bhagāstokaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe catvāriṃśacca pañca ca / grīvāyāñca tathāsthīni jatrukañca tathā hamuḥ
tanmūlaṃ dvelalāṭākṣigaṇḍanāsāṅghyravasthitāḥ / parśukāstālukaiḥ sārdhamarvudaiś ca dvisaptatiḥ
dveśaṅkhake kapālāni catvāryeva śiras tathā / uraḥ saptadaśāsthīni sandhīnāṃ dve śate daśa
aṣṭaṣaṣṭistu śākhāsu ṣaṣṭiś caikavivarjitā / antarā vai tryaśītiś ca snāyor navaśatāni ca
triṃśādhike dve śate tu antarādhau tu saptatiḥ / ūrdhvagāḥ ṣaṭśatānyeva śākhāstu kathitāni tu
pañcapeśīśatānyeva(1) catvāriṃśattathordhvagāḥ / catuḥśatantu śākhāsu antarādhau ca ṣaṣṭikā
strīṇām caikādhikā vai syādviṃśatiś caturuttarā / stanayordaśa yonau ca trayodaśa tathāśaye
garbhasya ca catasraḥ syuḥ śirāṇāñca śarīriṇāṃ / triṃśacchatasahasrāṇi tathānyāni navaiva tu
ṣaṭpañcāśatsahasrāṇi rasandehe vahanti tāḥ / kedāra iva kulyāś ca kledalepādikañca yat
dvāsaptatis tathā koṭyo vyomnāmiha mahāmune / majjāyā medasaś caiva vasāyāś ca tathā dvija
mūtrasya caiva pittasya śleṣmaṇaḥ śakṛtas tathā / 1 pañcapeśīśatānyatreti kha.. , ña.. ca :p 309 raktasya sarasasyātra kramaśo 'ñjalayo matāḥ
ardhārdhābhyadhikāḥ sarvāḥ pūrvapūrvāñjalermatāḥ / ardhāñjaliś ca śukrasya tadardhañca tataujasaḥ
rajasastu tathā strīṇāñcatasraḥ kathitā budhaiḥ / śarīraṃ maladoṣādi piṇḍaṃ jñātvātmani tyajet(1)
narakanirūpaṇam agnir uvāca uktāni yamamārgāṇi vakṣye 'tha maraṇe nṛṇāṃ / ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ
śarīramuparudhyātha kṛtsnāndoṣānruṇaddhi vai / chinatti prāṇasthānāni punarmarmāṇi caiva hi
śaityāt prakupito vāyuśchidramanviṣyate tataḥ / dve netre dvau tathā karṇau dvau tu nāsāpuṭau tathā
ūrdhvantu sapta cchidrāṇi aṣṭamaṃ vadanaṃ tathā / etaiḥ prāṇo viniryāti prāyaśaḥ śubhakarmaṇāṃ
adhaḥ pāyurupasthañca anenāśubhakāriṇāṃ / 1 piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tuvnyasediti ña.. :p 310 mūrdhānaṃ yogino bhittvā jīvo yātyatha cecchayā
antakāle tu samprāpre prāṇe 'pānamupasthite / tamasā saṃvṛte jñāne saṃvṛteṣu ca marmasu
sa jivo nābhyadhiṣṭānaścālyate mātariśvanā / bādhyamāṇaścānayate aṣṭāṅgāḥ prāṇavṛttikāḥ
cyavantaṃ jāyamānaṃ vā praviśantañca yoniṣu / prapaśyanti ca taṃ siddhā devā divyena cakṣupā
gṛhṇāti tatkṣaṇādyoge śarīrañcātivāhikam / ākāśavāyutejāṃsi vigrahādūrdhvagāminaḥ
jalaṃ mahī ca pañcatvamāpannaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ / ātivāhikadehantu yamadūtā nayanti taṃ
yāmyaṃ mārgaṃ mahāghoraṃ ṣaḍaśītisahasrakam / annodakaṃ nīyamāno bāndhavair dattamaśnute
yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamoktena citraguptena ceritān / prāpnoti narakānraudrāndharmī śubhapathair divam
bhujyante pāpibhirvakṣye narakāṃstāś ca yātanāḥ / aṣṭāviṃśatirevādhaḥkṣiternarakakoṭayaḥ
saptamasya talasyānte ghore tamasi saṃsthitāḥ / ghorākhyā prathamākoṭiḥ sughorā tadadhaḥsthitā
atighorā mahāghorā ghorarūpā ca pañcamī / ṣaṣṭhī taralatārākhyā saptamī ca bhayānakā
bhayotkaṭā kālarātrī mahācaṇḍā ca caṇḍayā / kolāhalā pracaṇḍākhyā padmā narakanāyikā
padmāvatī bhīṣaṇā ca bhīmā caiva karālikā / vikarālā mahāvajrā trikoṇā pañcakoṇikā
sadīrghā vartulā saptabhūmā caiva subhūmikā / dīptamāyāṣṭāviṃśatayaḥ koṭayaḥ pāpiduḥkhadāḥ
aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīnāṃ pañca pañca ca nāyakāḥ / rauravādyāḥ śatañcaikaṃ catvāriṃśaccatuṣṭayaṃ
tāmiśramandhatāmiśraṃ mahārauravarauravau / asipatraṃ vanañcaiva lohabhāraṃ tathaiva ca
narakaṃ kālasūtrañca mahānarakameva va / sañjīvanaṃ mahāvīci tapanaṃ sampratāpanaṃ
saṅghātañca sakākolaṃ kudmalaṃ pūtimṛttikaṃ / lohaśaṅkumṛjīṣañca pradhānaṃ śālmalīṃ nadīm
narakānviddhi koṭīśanāganvai ghoradarśanān / pātyante pāpakarmāṇa ekaikasminbahuṣvapi
mārjārolūkagomāyugṛghrādivadanāś ca te / tailadroṇyāṃ naraṃ kṣiptvā jvālayanti hutāśanaṃ
ambarīṣeṣu caivānyāṃstāmrapātreṣu cāparān / ayaḥpātreṣu caivānyān bahuvahnikaṇeṣu ca
śūlāgrāropitāścānye chidyante narake 'pare / tāḍyante ca kaśābhistu bhojyante cāpyayoguḍān
yamadūtair narāḥ pāṃśūnviṣṭhāraktakaphādikān / taptaṃ madyaṃ pāyayanti pāṭayanti punarnarān
yantreṣu pīḍayanti sma bhakṣyante vāyasādibhiḥ / tailenoṣṇena sicyante chidyante naikaghā śiraḥ
hā tāteti krandamānāḥ svakannidanti karma te / mahāpātakajānghorānnarakānprāpya garhitān
karmakṣayātprajāyante mahāpātakinastviha / mṛgaśvaśūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ brahmahā yonimṛcchati
kharapukkaśamlecchānāṃ madyapaḥ svarṇahāryapi / kṛmikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ gurugastṛṇagulmatāṃ
brahmahā kṣayarogī syāt surāpaḥ śyāvadantakaḥ / svarṇahārī tu kunakhī duś carmā gurutalpagaḥ
yo yena saṃspṛśatyeṣāṃ sa talliṅgo 'bhijāyate / annahartā māyāvī syānmūko vāgapahārakaḥ
dhānyaṃ hṛtvātiriktāṅgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ / tailahṛttailapāyī syāt pūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ
parasya yoṣitaṃ hṛtvā brahmasvamapahṛtya ca / araṇye nirjane deśe jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ
ratnahārī hīnajātirgandhān chuchundarī śubhān / patraṃ śākaṃ śikhī hṛtvā mukharo dhānyahārakaḥ
ajaḥ paśuṃpayaḥ kāko yānamuṣṭraḥ(1) phalaṃ kapiḥ / madhu daṃśaḥ phalaṃ gṛdhro gṛhakāka upaskaraṃ
śivatrī vastraṃ sārasañca jhallī lavaṇahārakaḥ / ukta ādhyātmikastāpaḥ śastrādyair ādhibhautikaḥ
grahāgnidevapīḍādyair ādhikaivika īritaḥ / 1 yānaṃ vasta+iti kha.. :p 313 trithā tāpaṃ hi saṃsāraṃ jñānayogādvināśayet / kṛcchrair vrataiś ca dānādyair viṣṇupūjādibhirnaraḥ
yamaniyamāḥ agnir uvāca saṃsāratāpamuktyarthaṃ vakṣyāmy aṣṭāṅgayogakaṃ / brahmaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ(1) yogastatraikacittatā
cittavṛttirnirodhaś ca jīvabrahmātmanoḥ paraḥ / ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau

evaṃ sarvamahiṃsāyāṃ dharmārthamabhidhīyate / udvegajananaṃ hiṃsā santāpakaraṇantathā

sukhāpahnutiḥ saṃrodho badho daśavithā ca sā / yadbhūtahitamatyantaṃ vacaḥ satyasya lakṣaṇaṃ
satyaṃ brūyātpriyaṃ brūyānna brūyātsatyamapriyaṃ / priyañca nānṛtaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
maithunasya parityāgo brahmacaryantadaṣṭadhā / smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ keliḥ prekṣyaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ
saṅkalpo 'dhyavasāyaś ca kriyānirvṛttireva ca / etanmaithunamaṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
brahmacaryaṃ kriyāmūlamanyathā viphalā kriyā / vasiṣṭhaś candramāḥ śukro devācāryaḥ pitāmahaḥ
tapovṛddhā vayovṛddhāste 'pi strībhirvimohitāḥ / gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyāstrividhāḥ surāḥ
caturthī strī surā jñeyā yayedaṃ mohitaṃ jagat / mādyati pramadāṃ dṛṣṭvā surāṃ pītvā tu mādyati
yasmāddṛṣṭamadā nārī tasmāttānnāvalokayet / yadvā tadvāparadravyamapahṛtya balānnaraḥ
avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ / kaupīnācchādanaṃ vāsaḥ kanthāṃ śītanivāriṇīṃ
pāduke cāpi gṛhṇīyāt kuryānnānyasya saṃgrahaṃ / dehasthitinimittasya vastrādeḥ syātparigrahaḥ
śarīraṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ / śaucantu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ vāhyamabhyantaraṃ tathā
gṛjjalābhyāṃ smṛtaṃ vāhyaṃ bhāvaśuddherathāntaraṃ / ubhayena śuciryastu sa śucirnetaraḥ śuciḥ
yathā kathañcitprāptyā ca santoṣastuṣṭirucyate / manasaścendriyāṇāñca aikāgryaṃ tapa ucyate
tajjayaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate / vācikaṃ mantrajapyādi mānasaṃ rāgavarjanaṃ
śārīraṃ devapūjādi sarvadantu tridhā tapaḥ / praṇavādyāstato vedāḥ praṇave paryavasthitāḥ
vāṅmayaḥ praṇavaḥ sarvaṃ tasmātpraṇavamabhyaset / akāraś ca tathokāro makāraścārdhamātrayā
tisro mātrāstrayo vedāḥ lokā bhūrādayo guṇāḥ / jāgratsvapnaḥ suṣuptiś ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
pradyumnaḥ śrīrvāsudevaḥ sarvamoṅgārakaḥ kramāt / amātro naṣṭamātraś ca dvaitasyāpagamaḥ śivaḥ
oṅkāro vidito yena sa munirnetaro muniḥ / caturthī mātrā gāndhārī prayuktā mūrdhnilakṣyate
tatturīyaṃ paraṃ brahma jyotirdīpo ghaṭe yathā / tathā hṛtpadmanilayaṃ dhyāyennityaṃ japennaraḥ
praṇavo dhanuḥ śaro hy ātmā brahma tallakṣyamucyate / apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravattanmayo bhavet
etedekākṣaraṃ brahma etadekākṣaraṃ paraṃ / detadekākṣaraṃ jñātvā yo yadicchati tasya tat
chando 'sya devī gāyatrī antaryāmī ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ / devatā paramātmāsya niyogo bhuktimuktaye
bhūragnyātmane hṛdayaṃ bhuvaḥ prājāpatyātmane / śiraḥ svaḥsūryātmane ca śikhā kavacamucyate
oṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥkavacaṃ satyātmane tato 'strakaṃ / vinyasya pūjayedviṣṇuṃ japedvai bhuktimuktaye
juhuyācca tilājyādi sarvaṃ sampadyate nare / yastu dvādaśasāhasraṃ japamanvahamācaret
tasya dvādaśabhirmāsaiḥ paraṃ brahma prakāśate / animādi koṭijapyāllakṣātsārasvatādikaṃ
vaidikastāntriko miśro viṣṇārvai trividho makhaḥ / trayānāmīpsitenaikavidhinā harimarcayet
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau namaskāreṇa yo 'rcayet / sa yāṅgatimavāpnoti na tāṃ kratuśatair api
yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau / tasyaite kathitā hy arthāḥ prakāśante mahātmanaḥ
āsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhārāḥ agnir uvāca āsanaṃ kamalādyuktaṃ tadbaddhvā cintayetparaṃ / śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ celājinakuśottaraṃ / tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yātacittendriyakriyaḥ
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye / samakāyaśīragrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svandiśaścānavalokayan / pārṣṇibhyāṃ vṛṣaṇau rakṣaṃs tathā prajananaṃ punaḥ
urubhyāmuparisthāpya vāhū tiryak prayatnataḥ / dakṣiṇaṃ karapṛṣṭhañca nyaseddhāmatalopari
unnamya śanakair vakraṃ mukhaṃ viṣṭabhya cāgrataḥ / prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyustasyāyāmo nirodhanaṃ
nāsikāpuṭamaṅgulyā pīḍyaiva ca pareṇa ca / ādaraṃ recayedvāyuṃ recanādrecakaḥ smṛtaḥ
vāhyena vāyunā dehaṃ dṛtivat pūrayedyathā / tathā purṇaś ca santiṣṭhet pūraṇāt pūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ
na bhuñcati na gṛhṇāti vāyumantarvāhiḥsthitam / sampūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhedacalaḥ sa tu kumbhakaḥ
kanyakaḥ(1) sakṛdudghātaḥ sa vai dvādaśamātrikaḥ / madhyamaś ca dvirudghātaś caturviṃśatimātrikaḥ
uttamaś ca trirudghātaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattālamātrikaḥ / svedakampābhidhātānām jananaścottamottamaḥ
ajitānnāruhedbhūmiṃ hikkāśvāsādayas tathā / jite prāṇe khalpadojavinmūtrādi prajāyate
ārogyaṃ śīghragāmitvamutsāhaḥ svarasauṣṭhavam / balavarṇaprasādaś ca sarvadoṣakṣayaḥ phalaṃ
japadhyānaṃ vināgarbhaḥ sa garbhastatsamanvitaḥ / indriyāṇāṃ jayārthāya sa garbhaṃ dhārayetparaṃ
jñānavairāgyayuktābhyāṃ prāṇāyāmavaśena ca / indriyāṃś ca vinirjitya sarvameva jitaṃ bhavet
indriyāṇyeva tatsarvaṃ yat svarganarakāvubhau / nigṛhītavisṛṣṭāni svargāya narakāya ca
śarīraṃ rathamityāhurindriyāṇyasya vājinaḥ / manaś ca sārathiḥ proktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ kaśaḥ(2)smṛtaḥ
jñānavairāgyaraśmibhyāṃ sāyayā vidhṛtaṃ manaḥ / śanair niścalatām eti prāṇāyāmaikasaṃhitam
jalavinduṃ kuśāgreṇa māse māse pivettu yaḥ / saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ prāṇayāmaś ca tatsamaḥ
indriyāṇi prasaktāni praviśya viṣayodadhau / 1 kanyasa iti ña.. 2 prāṇāyāmo 'ṅkuśa iti jha.. :p 319 āhṛtya yo nigṛhṇāti pratyāhāraḥ sa ucyate
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ majjamānaṃ yathāmbhasi / bhoganadyativegena(1) jñānavṛkṣaṃ samāśrayet
dhyānam agnir uvāca dhyai cintāyāṃ smṛto dhāturviṣṇucintā muhūrmuhuḥ / anākṣiptena manasā dhyānamityabhidhīyate
ātmanaḥ samanaskasya muktāśeṣopadhasya ca / brahmacintāsamā śaktirdhyānaṃ nāma taducyate
dhyeyālambanasaṃsthasya sadṛśapratyayasya ca / pratyāntaranirmuktaḥ pratyayo dhyānamucyate
dhyeyāvasthitacittasya pradeśe yatra kutricit / dhyānametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ pratyayasyaikabhāvanā
evaṃ dhyānasamāyuktaḥ khadehaṃ yaḥ parityajet / kulaṃ svajanamitrāṇi samuddhṛtya harirbhavet
evaṃ muhūrtamardhaṃ vā dhyāyed yaḥ śraddhayā hariṃ / sopi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ sarvair mahāmakhaiḥ

japayajñasya vai yajñāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ / japinaṃ nopasarpanti vyādhayaścādhayo grahāḥ / bhuktirmurktirmṛtyujayo japena prāpnuyāt phalaṃ(1)

yadvāhyāvasthitaṃ lakṣayaṃ tasmānna calate manaḥ / tāvat kālaṃ pradeśeṣu dhāraṇā manasi sthitiḥ
kālāvadhi paricchinnaṃ dehe saṃsthāpitaṃ manaḥ / na pracyavati yallakṣyāddhāraṇā sābhidhīyate
dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṃ dvadaśadhāraṇāḥ / dhyānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yāvatsamādhirabhidhīyate
dhāraṇābhyāsayuktātmā yadi prāṇair vimucyate / kulaikaviṃśamuttārya svaryāti paramaṃ padaṃ(1)
yasmin yasmin bhavedaṅge yogināṃ vyādhisambhavaḥ / tattadaṅgaṃ dhiyā vyāpya dhārayettattvadhāraṇaṃ

mātṛmodakavatsarvaṃ japahomārcanādikaṃ / viṣṇumantreṇa vā kuryādamṛtāṃ dhāraṇāṃ vade
saṃpūrṇendunibhaṃ dhyāyet kamalaṃ tantrimuṣṭigam / śiraḥsthaṃ cintayed yatnācchaśāṅkāyutavarcasaṃ
sampūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ vyomni śivakallolapūrṇitaṃ / tathā hṛtkamale dhyāyettanmadhye svatanuṃ smaret / sādhako vigatakleśo jāyate dhāraṇādihiḥ
samādhiḥ agnir uvāca yadātmamātraṃ nirbhāsaṃ stimitodadhivat sthitaṃ / caitanyarūpavaddhyānaṃ tat samādhirihocyate
dhyāyanmanaḥ sanniveśya yastiṣṭhedacalasthiraḥ / nirvātānalavadyogī samādhisthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na paśyati na vamyati / na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na saṅkalpayate manaḥ
na cābhimanyate kiñcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat / evamīśvarasaṃlīnaḥ samādhisthaḥ sa gīyate
yathā dīpo nivātasyo neṅgate sopamā smṛtā / dhyāyato viṣṇumātmānaṃ samādhistasya yoginaḥ
upasargāḥ pravartante divyāḥ siddhiprasūcakāḥ / pātitaḥ śrāvaṇo dhāturdaśanasvāṅgavedanāḥ
prārthayanti ca taṃ devā bhogair divyaiś ca yoginaṃ / nṛpāś ca pṛthivīdānair dhanaiś ca sudhanādhipāḥ
vedādisarvaśāstrañca svayameva pravartate / abhīṣṭachandoviṣayaṃ kāvyañcāsya pravartate
rasāyanāni divyāni divyāś cauṣadhayas tathā / samastāni ca śilpāni kalāḥ sarvāś ca vindati
surendrakanyā ity ādyā guṇāś ca pratibhādayaḥ / tṛṇavattāntyajed yastu tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaḥ śiṣye jñānaṃ prakāśya ca / bhuktvā bhogān yathecchātastanuntyaktvālayāttataḥ
tiṣṭhet svātmani vijñāna ānande brahmaṇīśvare/ malino hi yathādarśa ātmajñānāya na kṣamaḥ
sarvāśrayannije dehe dehī vindati vedanāṃ / yogayuktastu sarveṣāṃ yogānnāpnoti vedanāṃ
ākāśamekaṃ hi yathā ghaṭādiṣu pṛthag bhavet / tathātmaiko hy anekeṣu jalādhāreṣvivāṃśumān
brahmakhānilatejāṃsi jalabhūkṣitidhātavaḥ / ime lokā eṣa cātmā tasmācca sacarācaraṃ
gṛddaṇdacakrasaṃyogāt kumbhakāro yathā ghaṭaṃ / karoti tṛṇamṛtkāṣṭhair gṛhaṃ vā gṛhakārakaḥ
karaṇānyevamādāya tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu / mṛjatyātmānamātmaivaṃ sambhūya karaṇāni ca
karmaṇā doṣamohābhyāmicchayaiva sa badhyate / jñānādvimucyate jīvo dharmād yogī na rogabhāk
vartyādhārasnehayogād yathā dīpasya saṃsthitiḥ / vikriyāpi ca dṛṣṭvaivamakāle prāṇasaṃkṣayaḥ
anantā raśmayastasya dīpavad yaḥ sthito hṛdi / sitāsitāḥ kadrunīlāḥ kapilāḥ pītalohitāḥ
ūrdhvamekaḥ sthitasteṣāṃ yo bhittvā sūryamaṇḍalaṃ / brahmalokamatikramya tena yāti parāṅgatiṃ
yadasyānyadraśmiśatamūrdhvameva vyavasthitaṃ / tena devanikāyāni dhāmāni pratipadyate
ye naikarūpāścādhastādraśmayo 'sya mṛduprabhāḥ / iha karmopabhogāya taiś ca sañcarate hi saḥ
buddhīndriyāṇi sarvāṇi manaḥ karmendriyāṇi ca / ahaṅkāraś ca buddhiś ca pṛthivyādīni caiva hi
avyakta ātmā kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrastyāsya nigadyate / īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtasya sannasan sadasacca saḥ
buddherutpattiravyaktā tato 'haṅkārasambhavaḥ / tasmāt khādīni jāyante ekottaraguṇāni tu
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca raso gandhaś ca tadguṇāḥ / yo yasminnāśritaś caiṣāṃ sa tasminneva līyate
sattvaṃ rajastamaś caiva guṇāstasyaiva kīrtitāḥ / rajastamobhyāmāviṣṭaś cakravadbhrābhyate hi saḥ
anādirādimān yaś ca sa eva puruṣaḥ paraḥ / liṅgendriyair upagrāhyāḥ sa vikāra udāhṛtaḥ
yato devāḥ purāṇāni vidyopaniṣadas tathā / ślokāḥ sūtrāṇi bhāṣyāṇi yaccānyadmāṅbhayaṃ bhavet
pitṛyānopavīthyāś ca yadagastyasya cāntaraṃ / tenāgnihotriṇo yānti prajākāmā divaṃ prati
ye ca dānaparāḥ samyagaṣṭābhiś ca guṇair yutāḥ / aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munayo gṛhamedhinaḥ
punarāvartane vījabhūtā dharmapravartakāḥ / saptarṣināgvīthyāś ca devalokaṃ samāśritāḥ
tāvanta eva munayaḥ sarvārambhavivarjitāḥ / tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena medhayā
yatra yatrāvatiṣṭhante yāvadāhūtasaṃplavaṃ / vedānuvacanaṃ yajñā brahmacaryaṃ tapo damaḥ
śraddhopavāsaḥ satyatvamātmano jñānahetavaḥ / sa tvāśramair nididhyāsyaḥ samastair evameva tu
draṣṭavyastvatha mantavyaḥ śrotavyaś ca dvijātibhiḥ / ya evamenaṃ vindanti ye cāraṇyakamāśritāḥ
upāsate dvijāḥ satyaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ / kramātte sambhavantyarcirahaḥ śuklaṃ tathottaraṃ
ayanandevalokañca savitāraṃ savidyutaṃ / tatastān puruṣo 'bhyetya mānaso brahmalaukikān
karoti punarāvṛttisteṣāmiha na vidyate / yajñena tapasā dānair ye hi svargajito janāḥ
dhūmaṃ niśāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ dakṣiṇāyanameva ca / pitṛlokaṃ candramasaṃ nabho vāyuṃ jalaṃ mahīṃ
kramātte sambhavantīha punareva vrajanti ca / etadyo na vijānāti mārgadvitayamātmanaḥ
dandaśūkaḥ pataṅgo vā bhavedkīṭo 'thavā kṛmiḥ / hṛdaye dīpavadbrahma dhyānājjivo mṛto bhavet
nyāyāgatadhanastattvajñānaniṣṭho 'tithipriyaḥ / śrāddhakṛtsatyavādī ca gṛhastho 'pi vimucyate
brahmajñānaṃ agnir uvāca brahmajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃsārājñānamuktaye / ayamātmā parṃ brahma ahamasmīti mucyate
deha ātmā na bhavati dṛsyatvācca ghaṭādivat / prasapte maraṇe dehādātmānyo jñāyate dhruvaṃ
dehaḥ sa cedavyavaharedvikāryādisannibhaḥ / cakṣurādīnīndriyāṇi nātmā vai karaṇaṃ tvataḥ
mano dhīrapi ātmā na dīpavat karaṇaṃ tvataḥ / prāṇo 'pyātmā na bhavati suṣupte citprabhāvataḥ
jāgratsvapne ca caitanyaṃ saṅkīrṇatvānna budhyate / vijñānarahitaḥ prāṇaḥ suṣupte jñāyate yataḥ
ato nātmendriyaṃ tasmādintriyādikamātmanaḥ / ahaṅkāro 'pi naivātmā dehavadvyabhicārataḥ
uktebhyo vyatirikto 'yamātmā sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ / sarvadraṣṭā ca bhoktā ca naktamujjvaladīpavat
samādhyārambhakāle ca evaṃ sañcintayenmuniḥ / yato brahmaṇa ākāśaṃ khādvāyurvāyuto 'nalaḥ
agnerāpo jalātpṛthvī tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ śarīrakaṃ / apañcīkṛtabhūtebhya āsan pañcīkṛtānyataḥ
sthūlaṃ śarīraṃ dhyātvāsmāllayaṃ brahmaṇi cintayet / pañcīkṛtāni bhūtāni tatkāryañca virāṭsmṛtam
etat sthūlaṃ śarīraṃ hi ātmano jñānakalpitaṃ / indriyair atha vijñānaṃ dhīrā jāgaritaṃ viduḥ
viśvastadabhimānī syāt trayametadakārakaṃ / apañcīkṛtabhūtāni tatkāryaṃ liṅgamucyate
saṃyuktaṃ saptadaśabhirhiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñitaṃ / śarīramātmanaḥ sūkṣmaṃ liṅgamityabhidhīyate
jāgratsaṃskārajaḥ svapnaḥ pratyayo viṣayātmakaḥ / ātmā tadupamānī styāttaijaso hy aprapañcataḥ
sthūlasūkṣmaśarīrākhyadvayasyaikaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ / ātmā jñānañca sābhāsaṃ tadadhyāhṛtamucyate
na sannāsanna sadasadetatsāvayavaṃ na tat / nirgatāvayavaṃ neti nābhinnaṃ bhinnameva ca
bhinnābhinnaṃ hy anirvācyaṃ bandhasaṃsārakārakaṃ / ekaṃ sa brahma vijñānāt prāptaṃ naiva ca karmabhiḥ
sarvātmanā hīndriyāṇāṃ saṃhāraḥ kāraṇātmanāṃ / buddheḥ sthānaṃ suṣuptaṃ syāttaddvayasyābhimānavān
prājña ātmā trayañcaitat makāraḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ / akāraś ca ukāro 'sau makāro hy ayameva ca
ahaṃ sākṣī ca cinmātro jāgratsvapnādikasya ca / nājñānañcaiva tatkāryaṃ saṃsārādikabandhanaṃ
nityaśuddhabandhamuktasatyamānandamadvayaṃ / brahmāhamasmyahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvimukta oṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ samādhirbandhaghātakaḥ / ciramānandakaṃ brahma satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ
ayamātmā parambrahma tad brahma tvamasīti ca / guruṇā bodhito jīvo hy ahaṃ brahmāsmi vāhyataḥ
so 'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so 'sāvahamakhaṇḍa oṃ / mucyate 'sārasaṃsārādbrahmajño brahma tadbhavet
brahmajñānaṃ agnir uvāca ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ pṛthivyavanalojjhitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvāyvākāśavivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirādikāryavivarjitam / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvirāḍātmavivarjitaṃ

ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirākārākṣaravarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvākpāṇyaṅghrivivarjitam
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ pāyūpasthavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śrotratvakcakṣurujjhitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotīrasarūpavivarjitam / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sarvagandhavivarjitam
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirjihvāghrāṇavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sparśaśabdavivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmanobuddhivivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiścittāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ prāṇāpānavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirvyānodānavivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ samānaparivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirjarāmaraṇavarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śokamohavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ śabdodbhūtādivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirhiraṇyagarbhavarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ svapnāvasthāvivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotistaijasādivivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirapakārādivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sabhājñānavivarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiradhyāhṛtavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sattvādiguṇavarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sadasadbhāvavarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sarvāvayavavarjitaṃ
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirbhedābhedavivarjitaṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ suṣuptisthānavarjitam
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ prājñabhāvavivarjitam / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmakārādivivarjitam
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmānameyavivarjitam / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirmitimāhṛvivarjitam
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sākṣitvādivivarjitam / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ kāryakāraṇavarjitam
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ / jāgrat sapnasuṣuptyādimuktaṃ brahma turīyakaṃ
nityaśuddhabuddhamuktaṃ satyamānandamadvayam / brahmāhamasmyahaṃ brahma savijñānaṃ vimukta oṃ / ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ samādhirmokṣadaḥ paraḥ
brahmajñānaṃ agnir uvāca yajñaiś ca devānāpnoti vairājaṃ tapasā padaṃ / brahmaṇaḥ karmasannyāsādvairāgyāt prakṛtau layaṃ
jñānāt prāpnoti kaivalyaṃ pañcaitā gatayaḥsmṛtāḥ / prītitāpaviṣādādervinivṛttirviraktatā
sannyāsaḥ karmaṇāntyāgaḥ kṛtānāmakṛtaiḥ saha / avyaktādau viśeṣānte vikāro 'sminnivartate
cetanācetanānyatvajñānena jñānamucyate / paramātmā ca sarveṣāmādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ
viṣṇunāmnā ca deveṣu vedānteṣu ca gīyate / yajñeśvaro yajñapumān pravṛttair ijyate hy asau
nivṛttair jñānayogena jñānamūrtiḥ sa cekṣyate / hrasvadīrghaplutādyantu vacastatpuruṣottamaḥ
tatprāptiheturjñānañca karma coktaṃ mahāmune / āgamoktaṃ vivekācca dvidhā jñānaṃ tathocyate
śabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahma vivekajam / dve brahmaṇī veditavye brahmaśabdaparañca yat
vedādividyā hy aparamakṣaraṃ brahmasatparam / tadetadbhagavadvācyamupacāre 'rcane 'nyataḥ
sambharteti tathā bhartā bhakāro 'rthadvayānvitaḥ / netā gamayitā sraṣṭā gakāro 'yaṃ mahamune
aiśvaryasya samagrasya vīryasya yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ / jñānavairāgyayoś caiva ṣaṇāṃ bhaga itīṅganā
vasanti viṣṇau bhutāni sa ca dhātustridhātmakaḥ / evaṃ harau hi bhagavān śabdo 'nyatropacārataḥ
utpattiṃ pralayaś caiva bhūtānāmagatiṃ gatiṃ / vetti vidyāmavidyāñca sa vācyo bhagavāniti
jñānaśaktiḥ paraiśvaryaṃ vīryaṃ tejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ / bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyair guṇādibhiḥ
khāṇḍikyajanakāyāha yogaṃ keśidhvajaḥ purā / anātmanyātmabuddhiryā ātmasvamiti yā matiḥ
avidyābhavambhūtirvījametaddvidhā sthiram / pañcabhūtātmake dehe dehī mohatamāśritaḥ
ahametaditītyuccaiḥ kurute kumatirmatiṃ / itthañca putrapautreṣu taddehotpātiteṣu ca
karoti paṇḍitaḥ sāmyamanātmani kalevare / sarvadehopakārāya kurute karma mānavaḥ
dehaścānyo yadā puṃsastadā bandhāya tatparaṃ / nirvāṇamaya evāyamātmā jñānamayo 'malaḥ
duḥkhajñānamayo 'dharmaḥ prakṛteḥ sa tu nātmanaḥ / jalasya nāgninā saṅgaḥ sthālīsaṅgāttathāpi hi
śabdāste kādikā dharmāstat kṛtā vai mahāmune / tathātmā prakṛtau saṅgādahaṃmānādibhūṣitaḥ
bhajate prākṛtāndharmān anyastebhyo hi so 'vyayaḥ / vandhāya viṣayāsaṅgaṃ mano nirviṣayaṃ dhiye
viṣayāttatsamākṛṣya brahmabhūtaṃ hariṃ smaret / ātmabhāvaṃ nayatyenaṃ tadbrahmadhyāyinaṃ mune
vicārya svātmanaḥ śaktyā lauhamākarṣako yathā / ātmaprayatnasāpekṣā viśiṣṭā yā manogatiḥ
tasyā brahmaṇi saṃyogo yoga ity abhidhīyate / viniṣpandaḥ samādhisthaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati
yamaiḥ sanniyamaiḥ sthityā pratyāhṛtyā marujjayaiḥ / prāṇāyāmena pavanaiḥ pratyāhāreṇa cendriyaiḥ
vaśīkṛtaistataḥ kuryāt sthitaṃ cetaḥ śubhāśraye / āśrayaścetaso brahma mūrtañcāmūrtakaṃ dvidhā
sanandanādayo brahmabhāvabhāvanayā yutāḥ / karmabhāvanayā cānye devādyāḥ sthāvarāntakāḥ
hiraṇyagarbhādiṣu ca jñānakarmātmikā dvidhā / trividhā bhāvanā proktā viśvaṃ brahma upāsyate
pratyastamitabhedaṃ yat sattāmātramagocaraṃ / vacasāmātmasaṃvedyaṃ tajjñānaṃ brahma saṃjñitam
tacca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ rūpamarūpasyājamakṣaraṃ / aśakyaṃ prathamaṃ dhyātumato mūrtādi cintayet
sadbhāvabhāvamāpannastato 'sau paramātmanā / bhavatyabhedī bhedaś ca tasyājñānakṛto bhavet
advaitabrahmavijñānaṃ agnir uvāca advaitabrahmavijñānaṃ vakṣye yadbhavato 'gadat / śālagrāne tapaś cakre vāsudevārcanādikṛt
mṛgasaṅgāmmṛgo bhūtvā hy antakāle smaran mṛgaṃ / jātismaro mṛgastyaktvā dehaṃ yogātsvato 'bhavat
advaitabrahmabhūtaś ca jaḍavallokamācarat / kṣattāsau vīrarājasya viṣṭiyogamamanyata
uvāha śivikrāmasya kṣatturvacanacoditaḥ / gṛhīto viṣṭinā jñānī uvāhātmakṣayāya taṃ
yayau jaḍagatiḥ paścāt ye tvanye tvaritaṃ yayuḥ / śīghrān śīghragatīn dṛṣṭvā aśīghraṃ taṃ nṛpo'bravīt
rājovāca kiṃ śrānto 'syalpamadhvānaṃ tvayoḍhā śivikā mama / kimāyāsasaho na tvaṃ pīvānasi nirīkṣyase
brāhmaṇa uvāca nāhaṃ pīvānna vaiṣoḍhā śivikā bhavato mayā / na śrānto 'smi na vāyāso voḍhavyo 'si mahīpate
bhūmau pādayugantasthau jaṅghe pādadvaye sthite / urū jaṅghādvayāvasthau tadādhāraṃ tathodaram
vakṣaḥsthalaṃ tathā vāhū skandhau codarasaṃsthitau / skandhasthiteyaṃ śivikā mama bhāvo 'tra kiṃ kṛtaḥ
śivikāyāṃ sthitañcedaṃ dehaṃ tvadupalakṣitaṃ / tatra tvamahamapyatra procyate cedamanyathā
ahaṃ tvañca tathānye ca bhūtairuhyāma(1) pārthiva / guṇapravāhapatito guṇavargo hi yātyayaṃ
karmavaśyā guṇāś caite sattvādyāḥ pṛthivīpate / avidyāsañcitaṃ karma taccāśeṣeṣu jantuṣu
ātmā śuddho 'kṣaraḥ śānto nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ / pravṛddhyapacayau nāsya ekasyākhilajantuṣu
yadā nopacayastasya yadā nāpacayo nṛpa / tadā pīvānasīti tvaṃ kayā yuktyā tvayeritaṃ
bhūjaṅghāpādakaṭyūrujaṭharādiṣu saṃsthitā / śivikeyaṃ tathā skandhe tadā bhāvaḥsamastvayā
tadanyajantubhirbhūpa śivikotthānakarmaṇā / śailadravyagṛhotthopi pṛthivīsambhavopi vā
yathā puṃsaḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ prākṛtaiḥ karaṇair nṛpa / soḍhavyaḥ sa mahābhāraḥ kataro nṛpate mayā
yaddravyā śivikā ceyaṃ taddravyo bhūtasaṃgrahaḥ / bhavato me 'khilasyāsya samatvenopavṛṃhitaḥ
tacchrutvovāca rājā taṃ gṛhītvāṅghrī kṣamāpya ca / prasādaṃ kuru tyaktvemāṃ śivikāṃ brūhi śṛṇvate / yo bhavān yannimittaṃ vā yadāgamanakāraṇam
brāhmaṇa uvāca śrūyatāṃ kohamityetadvaktuṃ naiva ca śakyate / 1 pāṭho 'yaṃ na samīcīnaḥ :p 340 upabhoganimittañca sarvatrāgamanakriyā
sukhaduḥkhopabhogau tu tau deśādyupapādakau / dharmādharmodbhavau bhoktuṃ janturdeśādimṛcchati
rajovāca yo 'sti sohamiti brahman kathaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate / ātmanyeṣu na doṣāya śabdohamiti yo dvija
brāhmaṇa uvāca śabdohamiti doṣāya nātmanyeṣa tathaiva tat / anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ śabdo vā bhrāntilakṣaṇaḥ
yadā samastadeheṣu pumāneko vyavasthitaḥ / tadā hi ko bhavān kohamityetadviphalaṃ vacaḥ
tvaṃ rājā śivikā ceyaṃ vayaṃ vāhāḥ puraḥsarāḥ / ayañca bhavato loko na sadetannṛpocyate
vṛkṣāddāru tataśceyaṃ śivikā tvadadhiṣṭhitā / kā vṛkṣasaṃjñā jātasya dārusaṃjñātha vā nṛpa
vṛkṣārūḍho mahārājo nāyaṃ vadati cetanaḥ / na ca dāruṇi sarvastvāṃ bravīti śivikāgataṃ
śivikādārusaṅghāto racanāsthitisaṃsthitaḥ / anviṣyatāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tadbhede śivikā tvayā
pumān strī gaurayaṃ vājī kuñcaro vihagastaruḥ / deheṣu lokasaṃjñeyaṃ vijñeyā karmahetuṣu
jihvā bravītyahamiti dantauṣṭhau tālukaṃ nṛpa / ete nāhaṃ yataḥ sarve vāṅnipādanahetavaḥ
kiṃ hetubhirvadatyeṣā vāgevāhamiti svayaṃ / tathāpi vāṅnāhametaduktaṃ mithyā na yujyate
piṇḍaḥ pṛthag yataḥ puṃsaḥ śiraḥpāyvādilakṣaṇaḥ / tato 'hamiti kutraitāṃ saṃjñāṃ rājan karomyahaṃ
yadanyo 'sti paraḥ kopi mattaḥ pārthivasattama / tadeṣohamayaṃ cānyo vaktum evamapīṣyate
paramārthabhedo na nago na paśurnaca pādapaḥ / śarīrāś ca vibhedāś ca ya ete karmayonayaḥ
yastu rājeti yalloke yacca rājabhaṭātmakam / taccānyacca nṛpetthantu na sat samyaganāmayaṃ
tvaṃ rājā sarvalokasya pituḥ putro riporipuḥ/ patnyāḥ patiḥ pitā sūnoḥ kastvāṃ bhūpa vadāmyahaṃ
tvaṃ kimetacchiraḥ kinnu śirastava tathodaraṃ / kimu pādādikaṃ tvaṃ vai tavaitat kiṃ mahīpate
samastāvayebhyastvaṃ pṛthagbhūto vyavasthitaḥ / kohamityatra nipuṇaṃ bhūtvā cintaya pārthiva / tacchratvovāca rājā tamavadhūtaṃ dvijaṃ hariṃ
rajovāca śreyo 'rthamudyataḥ praṣṭuṃ kapilarṣimahaṃ dvija / tasyāṃśaḥ kapilarṣestvaṃ mat kṛte jñānado bhuvi / jñānavīcyudacheryasmādyacchreyastacca me vada
brāhmaṇa uvāca bhūyaḥ pṛcchasi kiṃ śreyaḥ paramārthanna pṛcchasi / śreyāṃsyaparamārthāni aśeṣāṇyeva bhūpate
devatārādhanaṃ kṛtvā dhanasampattimicchati / putrānicchati rājyañca śreyastasyaiva kiṃ nṛpa
vivekinastu saṃyogaḥ śreyo yaḥ paramātmanaḥ / yajñādikā kriyā na syāt nāsti dravyopapattitā
paramārthātmanoryogaḥ paramārtha itīṣyate / eko vyāpī samaḥ śuddho nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ
janmavṛddhyādirahita ātmā sarvagato 'vyayaḥ / paraṃ jñānamayo 'saṅgī guṇajātyādibhirvibhuḥ
nidādhaṛtusaṃvādaṃ vadāmi dvija taṃ śṛṇu(1) / ṛturbrahmasuto jñānī tacchiṣyo 'bhūt pulastyajaḥ
nidāghaḥ prāptavidyo 'smānnagare vai pure sthitaḥ / devikāyāstaṭe tañca tarkayāmāsa vai ṛtuḥ
divye varṣasahasre 'gānnidāghamavalokituṃ / nidāgho vaiśvadevānte bhuktvānnaṃ śiṣyamabravīt / bhuktante tṛptirutpannā tuṣṭidā sākṣayā yataḥ
ṛtur uvāca kṣudasti yasya bhute 'nne tuṣṭirbrāhmaṇa jāyate / na me kṣudabhavattṛptiṃ kasmāttvaṃ paripṛcchasi
kṣuttṛṣṇe dehadharmākhye na mamaite yato dvija / pṛṣṭohaṃ yattvayā brūyāṃ(2) tṛptirastye va me sadā
pumān sarvagato vyāpī ākāśavadayaṃ yataḥ / ato 'haṃ pratyagātmāsmītyetadarthe bhavet kathaṃ(3)
so 'haṃ gantā(4) na cāgantā naikadeśaniketanaḥ / tvaṃ cānyo na bhavennāpi nānyastvatto 'smi vā pyahaṃ

ṛturasmi tavācāryaḥ prajñādānāya te dvija / ihāgato 'haṃ yāsyāmi paramārthastavoditaḥ
ekamevamidaṃ viddhi na bhedaḥ sakalaṃ jagat / vāsudevābhidheyasya svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ
ṛturvarṣasahasrānte punastannagaraṃ yayau / nidāghaṃ nagaraprānte ekānte sthitamabravīt / ekānte sthīyate kasmānnidāghaṃ ṛturabravīt
nidāgha uvāca bho vipra janasaṃvādo mahāneṣa nareśvara / pravivīkṣya puraṃ ramyaṃ tenātra sthīyate mayā
ṛtur uvāca narādhipo 'tra katamaḥ katamaścetaro janaḥ / kathyatāṃ me dvijaśreṣṭha tvamabhijño dvijottama
yo 'yaṃ gajendramunmattamadriśṛṅgasamutthitaṃ / adhirūḍho narendro 'yaṃ parivārastathetaraḥ(1)
gajo yo 'yamadho brahmannuparyeṣa sa bhūpatiḥ / ṛturāha gajaḥ ko 'tra rājā cāha nidāghakaḥ
ṛturnidāgha ārūḍho dṛṣṭāntaṃ paśya vāhanaṃ / uparyahaṃ yathā rājā tvamadhaḥ kuñjaro yathā
ṛtuḥ(2) prāha nidāghantaṃ katamastvāmahaṃ vade / ukto nidāghastannatvā prāha me tvaṃ gururdhruvam

1 ārūḍho 'yaṃ gajaṃ rājā paralokastathetara iti kha.. , ña.. ca 2 ka.. pustake sarvatra ṛbhuriti ṛtusthānīyaḥ pāṭhaḥ :p 344 nānyasmāddvaitasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaṃ mānasaṃ tathā / ṛtuḥ prāha nidāghantaṃ brahmajñānāya cāgataḥ / paramārthaṃ sārabhūtamadvaitaṃ darśitaṃ mayā
brāhmaṇa uvāca nidāgho 'pyupadeśena tenādvaitaparo 'bhavat / sarvabhūtānyabhedena dadṛśe sa tadātmani
avāpa muktiṃ jñānātsa tathā tvaṃ muktimāpsyasi / ekaḥ samastaṃ tvañcāhaṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvagato yataḥ
pītanīlādibhedena yathaikaṃ dṛśyate nabhaḥ / bhrāntidṛṣṭibhirātmāpi tathaikaḥ sa pṛthak pṛthak
agnir uvāca muktiṃ hy avāpa bhavato jñānasāreṇa bhūpatiḥ(1) / saṃsārājñānavṛkṣārijñānaṃ brahmeti cintaya
gītāsāraḥ agnir uvāca gītāsāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvagītottamottamaṃ / kṛṣṇo 'rjunāya yamāha purā vai bhuktimuktidaṃ(2)
śrībhagavānuvāca gatāsuragatāsurvā na śocyo dehavānajaḥ / ātmājaro 'maro 'bhedyastasmācchokādikaṃ tyajet
1 jñānāt sauvīrabhūpatiriti kha.. , ña.. ca 2 paṭhatāṃ bhuktimuktidamiti kha.. :p 345 dhyāyato viṣayān puṃsaḥ saṅgasteṣūpajāyate / saṅgāt kāmastataḥ krodhaḥ krodhātsammoha eva ca
ammohāt smṛtivibhraṃśo buddhināśāt praṇaśyati / duḥsaṅgahāniḥ satsaṅgānmokṣakābhī ca kāmanut
kāmatyāgādātmaniṣṭhaḥ sthiraprajñastadocyate / yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ / ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate
naiva tasya kṛte nārtho nākṛte neha kaś canaḥ / tattvavittu mahāvaho guṇakarmavibhāgayoḥ
guṇā guneṣu vartante iti matvā na sajjate / sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyati
jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute 'rjuna / brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgantyaktvā karoti yaḥ
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā / sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ / śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo 'bhijāyate
na hi kalyāṇakṛt kaściddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati / devī hy eṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāntaranti te / ārto jijñāsurarthārtho jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ jñānī caikatvamāsthitaḥ / akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo 'dhyātmamucyate
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ / adhibhūtaṃ kṣarobhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivataṃ
adhiyajñohamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara / antakāle smaranmāñca madbhāvaṃ yātyasaṃśayaḥ
yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ smarannante tyajeddehantamāpnuyāt / prāṇaṃ nyasya bhruvormadhye ante prāpnoti matparam
omityekākṣaraṃ brahmavadan dehaṃ tyajantathā / brahmādistambhaparyantāḥ sarve mama vibhūtayaḥ
śrīmantaścorjitāḥ sarve mamāṃśāḥ(1) prāṇinaḥsmṛtāḥ / ahameko viśvarūpa iti jñātvā vimucyate
kṣetraṃ śarīraṃ yo vetti kṣetrajñaḥ sa prakortitaḥ / kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama
mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca / indrayāṇi deśaikañca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ / etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtaṃ
amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam / ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva ca / janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanaṃ
āsaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu / 1 mamāṅgā iti kha.. :p 347 nityañca samacittattvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī / viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
adhyātmajñānaniṣṭhatvantattvajñānānudarśanaṃ / etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato 'nyathā
jñeyaṃ yattat pravakṣyāmi yaṃ jñātvāmṛtamaśnute / anādi paramaṃ brahma sattvaṃ nāma taducyate
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham / sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam / asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
vahirantaś ca bhūtānāmacarañcarameva ca / sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthañcāntike 'pi yat
avibhaktañca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam / bhūtabhartṛ ca vijñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate / jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya dhiṣṭhitaṃ
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā / anye sāṅkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
anye tvevamajānanto śrutvānyebhya upāsate / tepi cāśu tarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca / pramādamohau tamaso bhavato jñānameva ca
guṇā vartanta ity eva yo 'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate / mānāvamānamitrāritulyastyāgī sa nirguṇaḥ
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayaṃ / chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
dvau bhūtasargau loke 'smin daiva āsura eva ca / ahiṃsādiḥ kṣamā caiva daivīsampattito nṛṇāṃ
na śaucaṃ nāpi vācāro hy āsurīsampadoddhavaḥ / narakatvāt krodhalobhakāmastasmāttrayaṃ tyajet
yajñastapas tathā dānaṃ sattvādyaistrividhaṃ smṛtam / āyuḥ sattvaṃ balārogyasukhāyānnantu sāttvikaṃ
duḥkhaśokāmayāyānnaṃ tīkṣṇarūkṣantu rājasaṃ / amedhyocchiṣṭapūtyannaṃ tāmasaṃ nīrasādikaṃ
yaṣṭavyo vidhinā yajño niṣkāmāya sa sāttvikaḥ / yajñaḥ phalāya dambhātmī rājasastāmasaḥ kratuḥ
śraddhāmantrādividhyuktaṃ tapaḥ śārīramucyate / devādipūjāhiṃsādi vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ svādhyāyasajjapaḥ / mānasaṃ cittasaṃśuddhersaunamātsavinigrahaḥ
sāttvikañca tapo 'kāmaṃ phalādyarthantu rājasaṃ / tāmasaṃ parapīḍāyai sāttvikaṃ dānamucyate
deśādau caiva dātavyamupakārāya rājasaṃ / ādeśādāvavajñātaṃ tāmasaṃ dānamīritaṃ
oṃtatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ / yajñadānādika karma buktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśrañca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ / bhavatyatyāgināṃ(1) pretya na tu sannyāsināṃ kvacit
tāmasaḥ karmasaṃyogāt mohātkleśabhayādikāt / rājasaḥ sāttviko 'kāmāt pañcaite karmahetavaḥ
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇañca pṛthagvidham / trividhāś ca pṛthak ceṣṭā daivañcaivātra pañcamaṃ
ekaṃ jñānaṃ sāttvikaṃ syāt pṛthag jñānantu rājasaṃ / atattvārthantāmasaṃ syāt karmākāmāya sāttvikaṃ
kāmāya rājasaṃ karma mohāt karma tu tāmasaṃ / sīdhyasiddhyoḥ samaḥ kartā sāttviko rājaso 'tyapi
śaṭho 'lasastāmasaḥ syāt kāryādidhīś ca sāttvikī / kāryārthaṃ sā rājasī syādviparītā tu tāmasī
manodhṛtiḥ sāttvikī syāt prītikāmeti rājasī / tāmasī tu praśokādau mukhaṃ sattvāttadantagaṃ
sukhaṃ tadrājasañcāgre ante duḥkhantu tāmasaṃ / ataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidantataṃ
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya viṣṇuṃ siddhiñca vindati / karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā
1 bhavatyayogināmiti kha.. :p 350 brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ jagadviṣṇuñca vetti yaḥ / siddhimāpnoti bhagavadbhakto bhāgavato dhruvaṃ
yamagītā agnir uvāca yamagītāṃ pravakṣyāmi uktā yā nāciketase / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhuktyai muktyai mokṣārthināṃ satāṃ
yama uvāca āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaparidhānagṛhādikam / vāñchatyaho 'timohena susthiraṃ svayamasthiraḥ
bhogeṣu śaktiḥ satataṃ tathaivātmāvalokanaṃ / śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyānāṃ kapilodgītameva hi
sarvatra samadarśitvaṃ nirmasatvamasaṅgatā / śreyaḥ param manuṣyānāṃ gītaṃ pañcaśikhena hi
āgarbhajanmabālyādivayo 'vasthādivedanaṃ / śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇām gaṅgāviṣṇupragītakaṃ
ādhyātmikādiduḥkhānāmādyantādipratikriyā / śreyaḥ paraṃ manṣyāṇāṃ janakodgītameva ca
abhinnayorbhedakaraḥ pratyayo yaḥ parātmanaḥ / tacchāntiparamaṃ śreyo brahmodgītamudāhṛtaṃ
kartavyamiti yatkarma ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñitaṃ / kurute śreyase saṅgān jaigīṣavyeṇa gīyate
hāniḥ sarvavidhitsānāmātmanaḥ sukhahaitukī / śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ devalodgītamīritaṃ
kāmatyāgāttu vijñānaṃ sukhaṃ brahma paraṃ padaṃ / kāmināṃ na hi vijñānaṃ sanakodgītameva tat
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca kāryaṃ karmaparo 'bravīt / śreyasāṃ śreya etaddhi naiṣkarmyaṃ brahma taddhariḥ
pumāṃścādhigatajñāno bhedaṃ nāpnoti sattamaḥ / brahmaṇā viṣṇusaṃjñena parameṇāvyayena ca
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ rūpamuttamam / tapasā labhyate sarvaṃ manasā yadyadicchati
nāsti viṣṇusamandhyeyaṃ tapo nānaśanātparaṃ / nāstyārogyasamaṃ dhanyaṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā sarit
na so 'sti bāndhavaḥ kaścidviṣṇuṃ muktvā jagadguruṃ / adhaścordhaṃ hariścāgre dehendriyamanomukhe
ityevaṃ saṃsmaran prāṇān yastyajetsa harirbhavet / yattad brahma yataḥ sarvaṃ yatsarvaṃ tasya saṃsthitam
agrāhyakamanirdeśyaṃ supratiṣṭhañca yatparaṃ / parāparasvarūpeṇa viṣṇuḥ sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ
yajñeśaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ kecidicchanti tatparaṃ / kecidviṣṇuṃ haraṃ kecit kecid brahmāṇamīśvaraṃ
indrādināmabhiḥ kecit sūryaṃ somañca kālakam / brahmādistambhaparyantaṃ jagadviṣṇuṃ vadanti ca
sa viṣṇuḥ paramaṃ brahma yato nāvartate punaḥ / suvarṇādimahādānapuṇyatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ
dhyānair vrataiḥ pūjayā ca dharmaśrutyā tadāpnuyāt / ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva tu
buddhintu sārathiṃ viddhi manaḥ pragrahameva ca / indrayāṇi hayānāhurviṣayāṃśceṣugocarān
ātmendriyamanoyuktaṃ bhoktetyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / yastvavijñānavān bhavatyayuktena manasā sadā
na satpadamavāpnoti saṃsārañcādhigacchati / yastu vijñānavān bhavati yuktena manasā sadā
sa tatpadamavāpnoti yasmādbhūyo na jāyate / vijñānasārathiryastu manaḥpragrahavānnaraḥ
so 'dhvānaṃ paramāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam / indriyebhyaḥ parā hy arthā arthebhyaś ca paraṃ manaḥ
manasastu parā buddhiḥ buddherātmā mahān paraḥ / mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcit sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ / eṣu sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhātmā na prakāśate
dṛśyate tvagryayā budhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ / yacchedvāṅmanasī prājñaḥ tadyacchejjñānamātmani
jñānamātmani mahati niyacchecchānta ātmani / jñātvā brahmātmanoryogaṃ yamādyair brahma sadbhavet
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau / yamāś ca niyamāḥ pañca śaucaṃ santoṣasattapaḥ
svādhyāyeśvarapūjā ca āsanaṃ padmakādikaṃ / prāṇāyāmo vāyujayaḥ pratyāhāraḥ svanigrahaḥ
śubhe hy ekatra viṣaye cetaso yat pradhāraṇaṃ / niś calatvāttu dhīmadbhirdhāraṇā dvija kathyate
paunaḥpunyena tatraiva viṣayeṣveva dhāraṇā / dhyānaṃ smṛtaṃ samādhistu ahaṃ brahmātmasaṃsthitiḥ
ghaṭadhvaṃsādyathākāśamabhinnaṃ nabhasā bhavet / mukto jīvo brahmaṇaivaṃ sadbrahma brahma vai bhavet
ātmānaṃ manyate brahma jīvo jñānena nānyathā / jīvo hy ajñānatatkāryamuktaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ
agnir uvāca vaśiṣṭha yamagītoktā paṭhatāṃ bhuktimuktidā / ātyantiko layaḥ prokto vedāntabrahmadhīmayaḥ
āgneyapurāṇamāhātmyaṃ agnir uvāca āgneyaṃ brahmarūpante purāṇaṃ kathataṃ mayā / saprapañcaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ vidyādvayamayaṃ mahat
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyā vidyā viṣṇurjagajjaniḥ / chandaḥ śikṣā vyākaraṇaṃ nighaṇṭujyotirākhyakāḥ
niruktadharmaśāstrādi mīmāṃsānyāyavistarāḥ / āyurvedapurāṇākhyā dhanurgandharvavistarāḥ
vidyā saivārthaśāstrākhyā devāntānyā harirmahān / ityeṣā cāparā vidyā parividyākṣaraṃ paraṃ
yasya bhāvo 'khilaṃ viṣṇustasya no bādhate kaliḥ / aniṣṭvā tu mahāyajñānakṛtvāpi pitṛsvadhāṃ
kṛṣṇamabhyarcayanbhaktyā nainaso bhājanaṃ bhavet / sarvakāraṇamatyantaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyanna sīdati
anyatantrādidoṣottho viṣayākṛṣṭamānasaḥ / kṛtvāpi pāpaṃ govindaṃ dhyāyanpāpaiḥ pramucyate
taddhyānaṃ yatra govindaḥ sa kathā yatra keśavaḥ / tat karma yattadarthīyaṃ kimanyair bahubhāṣitaiḥ
na tat pitā tu putrāya na śiṣyāya gururdvija / paramārthaṃ paraṃ brūyādyadetatte mayoditaṃ
saṃsāre bhramatā labhyaṃ putradāradhanaṃ vasu / suhṛdaś ca tathaivānye nopadeśo dvijedṛśaḥ
kiṃ putradārair mitrair vā kiṃ mitrakṣetravāndhavaiḥ / upadeśaḥ paro vandhurīdṛśo yo vimuktaye
dvividho bhūtamārgīyaṃ daiva āsura eva ca / viṣṇubhaktiparo daivo viparītas tathāsuraḥ
etat pavitramārogyaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ / sukhaprītikaraṃ nṝṇāṃ mokṣakṛdyattaveritaṃ
yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu likhitamāgneyaṃ hi purāṇakaṃ / pustakaṃ sthāsyati sadā tatra neśurupadravāḥ
kiṃ tīrthair gopradānair vā kiṃ yajñaiḥ kimupoṣitaiḥ / āgneyaṃ ye hi śṛṇvanti ahanyahani mānavāḥ
ye dadāti tilaprasthaṃ suvarṇasya ca māṣakaṃ / śṛṇoti ślokamekañca āgneyasya tadāpnuyāt
adhyāyapaṭhanañcāsya gopradānād viśiṣyate / ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrotumicchoḥ praṇaśyati
kapilānāṃ śate datte yad bhavejjyeṣṭhapuṣkare / tadāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ hi paṭhitvā phalamāpnuyāt
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca dharmaṃ vidyādvayātmakaṃ / āgneyasya purāṇasya śāstrasyāsya samaṃ na hi
paṭhannāgneyakaṃ nityaṃ śṛṇvan vāpi purāṇakaṃ / bhakto vaśiṣṭha manujaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
nopasargā na cānarthā na caurāribhayaṃ gṛhe / tasman syād yatra cāgneyapurāṇasya hi pustakaṃ
na garbhahāriṇībhītirna ca bālagrahā gṛhe / yatrāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ syānna piśācādikaṃ bhayaṃ
śṛṇvanvipro vedavit syāt kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ / ṛddhiṃ prāpnoti vaiśyaś ca śūdraścārogyamṛcchati
yaḥ paṭhetśṛṇuyānnityaṃ samadṛgviṣṇumānasaḥ / brahmāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ sattatra naśyantyupadravāḥ
divyāntarīkṣabhaumādyā duḥsvapnādyabhicārakāḥ / yaccānyadduritaṃ kiñcittatsarvaṃ hanti keśavaḥ
paṭhataḥ śṛṇvataḥ puṃsaḥ pustakaṃ yajato mahat / āgneyaṃ śrīpurāṇaṃ hi hemante yaḥ śṛṇoti vai
prapūjya gandhapuṣpādhyair agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet / śiśire puṇḍarīkasya vasante cāśvamedhajam
grīṣme tu vājapeyasya rājasūyasya varṣati / gosahasrasya śaradi phalaṃ tatpaṭhato hy ṛtau
āgneyaṃ hi purāṇaṃ yo bhaktyāgre paṭhete hareḥ / so 'rcayecca vasiṣṭheha jñānayajñena keśavam
yasyāgneyapurāṇasya pustakaṃ tasya vai jayaḥ / likhitaṃ pūjitaṃ gehe bhuktirmuktiḥ kare 'sti hi
iti kālāgnirūpeṇa gītaṃ me hariṇā purā / āgneyaṃ hi purāṇaṃ vai brahmavidyādvayāspadam / vidyādvayaṃ vasiṣṭhedaṃ bhaktebhyaḥ kathayiṣyasi
vasiṣṭha uvāca vyāsāgneyapurāṇaṃ te rūpaṃ vidyādvayātmakaṃ / kathitaṃ brahmaṇo viṣṇoragninā kathitaṃ yathā
sārdhaṃ devaiś ca munibhirmahyaṃ sarvāthadarśakaṃ / purāṇamagninā gautamāgneyaṃ brahmasanmitaṃ
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāddhyāsa likhedvā lekhayedapi / śrāvayetpāṭhayedvāpi pūjayeddhārayedapi
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāprakāmo divaṃ vrajet / lekhayitvā purāṇaṃ yo dadyādviprebhya uttamaṃ
sa brahmalokamāpnoti kulānāṃ śatamuddharet / ekaṃ ślokaṃ paṭhedyastu pāpapaṅkādvimucyate
tasmādvyāsa sadā śrāvyaṃ śiṣyebhyaḥ sarvadarśanaṃ / śukādyair munibhiḥ sardhaṃ śrotukāmaiḥ purāṇakaṃ
āgneyaṃ paṭhitaṃ dhyātaṃ śubhaṃ syād bhuktimuktidaṃ / agnaye tu namastasmai yena gītaṃ purānakaṃ
vyāsa uvāca vasiṣṭhena purā gītaṃ sūtaitatte mayoditaṃ / parāvidyāparāvidyāsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ padam
āgneyaṃ durlabhaṃ rūpaṃ prāpyate bhāgyasaṃyutaiḥ / dhyāyanto brahma cāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ harimāgatāḥ
vidyārthinas tathā vidyāṃ rājyaṃ rājyārthino gatāḥ / aputrāḥ putriṇaḥ santi nāśrayā āśrayaṃ gatāḥ
saubhāgyārthī ca saubhāgyaṃ mokṣaṃ mokṣārthino gatāḥ / likhanto lekhayantaś ca niṣpāpaś ca śriyaṃ gatāḥ
śukapailamukhaiḥ sūta āgneyantu purāṇakaṃ / rūpaṃ cintaya yātāsi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ
śrāvaya tvañca śiṣyebhyo bhaktebhyaś ca purāṇakam / sūta uvāca vyāsa prasādādāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutamādarāt
āgneyaṃ brahmarūpaṃ hi munayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ / bhavanto naimiṣāraṇye yajanto harimīśvaraṃ
tiṣṭhantaḥ śraddhayā yuktāstasmādvaḥ samudīritam / agninā proktamāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitaṃ
brahmavidyādvayopetaṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ mahat / nāsmātparataraḥ sāro nāsmātparataraḥ suhṛt
nāsmātparataro grantho nāsmātparataro gatiḥ / nāsmātparataraṃ śāstraṃ nāsmātparatarā śrutiḥ
nāsmātparataraṃ jñānaṃ nāsmātparatarā smṛtiḥ / nāsmātparo hy āgamo 'sti nāsmādvidyā parāsti hi
nāsmātparaḥ syātsiddhanto nāsmātparamamaṅgalam / nāsmātparo 'sti vedāntaḥ purāṇaṃ paramantvidaṃ
nāsmātparataraṃ bhūmau vidyate vastu durlabham / āgneye hi purāṇe 'smin sarvavidyāḥ pradarśitāḥ
sarve matsyāvatārādyā gītā rāmāyaṇantviha / harivaṃśo bhāratañca nava sargāḥ pradarśitāḥ
āgamo vaiṣṇavo gītaḥ pūjādīkṣāpratiṣṭhayā / pavitrārohaṇādīni pratimālakṣaṇādikaṃ
prāsādalakṣaṇādyañca mantrā vai bhuktimuktidāḥ / śaivāgamastadarthaś ca śākteyaḥ saura eva ca
maṇḍalāni ca vāstuś ca mantāṇi vividhāni ca / pratisargaścānugīto brahmāṇḍaparimaṇḍalaṃ
gīto bhuvanakoṣaś ca dvīpavarṣādinimnagāḥ / gayāgaṅgāprayāgādi tīrthamāhātmyamīritaṃ
jyotiś cakraṃ jyotiṣādi gīto yuddhajayārṇavaḥ / manvantarādayo gītāḥ dharmā varṇādikasya ca
aśaucaṃ dravyaśuddhiś ca prāyaścittaṃ pradarśitaṃ / rājadharmā dānadharmā vratāni vividhāni ca
vyavahārāḥ śāntayaś ca ṛgvedādividhānakaṃ / sūryavaṃśaḥ somavaṃśo dhanurvedaś ca vaidyakaṃ
gāndharvavedo 'rthaśāstraṃ mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ / purāṇasaṃkhyāmāhatmyaṃ chando vyakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ
alaṅkāro vighaṇḍuś ca śikṣākalpa ihoditaḥ smṛtaḥ / naimittikaḥ prākṛtiko laya ātyantikaḥ
vedāntaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ yogo hy aṣṭāṅga īritaḥ / stotraṃ purāṇamāhātmyaṃ vidyā hy aṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ
ṛgvedādyāḥ parā hy atra parāvidyākṣaraṃ paraṃ / saprapañcaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ brahmaṇo rūpamīritaṃ
idaṃ pañcadaśasohasraṃ śatakoṭipravistaraṃ / devaloke daivataiś ca purāṇaṃ paṭhyate sadā
lokānāṃ hitakāmena saṃkṣipyodgītamagninā / sarvaṃ brahmeti jānīdhvaṃ munayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ
śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedapi / likhellekhāpayedvāpi yujayetkīrtayedapi
purāṇapāṭhakañcaiva pūjayet prayato nṛpaḥ / gobhūhiraṇyadānādyair vastrālaṅkāratarpaṇaiḥ
taṃ saṃpūjya labheccaiva purāṇaśravaṇāt phalaṃ / purāṇānte ca vai kuryādavaśyaṃ dvijabhojanaṃ
nirmalaḥ prāptasarvārthaḥ sakulaḥ svargamāpnuyāt / śarayantraṃ pustakāya sūtraṃ vai patrasañcayaṃ
paṭṭikābandhavastrādi dadyād yaḥ svargamāpnuyāt / yo dadyādbrahmalokī syāt pustakaṃ yasya vai gṛhe
tasyotpātabhayaṃ nāsti bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt / yūyaṃ samarata cāgneyaṃ purāṇaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ / sūto gataḥ pujitastaiḥ śaunakādyā hariṃ yāyaḥ
